title: Arun Piti Thai Massage
ownerDescription:
Arun Piti Thai Massage offers traditional Thai massage in a serene and calming setting in the heart of Bangkok inside the MBK Shopping Center on the 5th Floor. Experience the gentle touch of skilled therapists who ease tension, relax your muscles, and bring a sense of tranquility to your mind and body.

Our calming ambiance, soft aromas, and rhythmic massage techniques help rejuvenate the body and refresh the spirit, leaving you completely at peace. Discover a true escape from the city's vibrant energy with a moment of relaxation and renewal.
address: 444 5th Floor, B21-22 MBK, Siam Centre Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: mali mila
reviews.text: Superb service . Therapist is very professional. Very high standard. Apple therapist is very good and attentive. You can ask for the level as you like. Very clean and high standard for price.

reviews.name: A WH
reviews.text:
The massage was professional and good. I would go again but a few things to keep in mind.

I had a back massage and I was in a private room but the mat I laid on could have been thicker.

The massage person/lady was big and strong and pressed quite hard on me with their entire body weight and I felt a pop in my ribs as the mat wasn't too thick!

I asked for less pressure but they called in another person to translate and it was then fine. However my ribs today are quite sore, so keep this in mind wherever you go!

Everything was very professional. My entire family had foot massages here too and everyone was happy.

I would return but will keep in mind to be careful in future with the Thai massage and perhaps get an oil massage or a gentler muscle relaxing massage (office massage etc)

:)

reviews.name: Frane Gajski
reviews.text:
Best massage parlor in MBK!
Clean,professional with older but experienced therapists.
Recommend to visit this place on 5th floor,you will be definitely highly satisfied,try aroma oil massage.
I tried many places in Thailand,more expensive ones but I can assure you it was not like in Arun piti!
Thanks and all the best to the staff,be there for my next visit to Thailand !

reviews.name: Dora Lewis
reviews.text: Mapa was awesome. She made me feel great! . Im totally relaxed and a happy lady. Best birthday massage ever! Definitely come here if you ate in MBK mall!

reviews.name: Giron Blorb
reviews.text: I was looking for (another) good massage, when i met Sati (i hope that is how he is written!). With 17+ yrs experience as a massage therapist, he was the first i met that found and relaxed spots in my neck, hands and shoulders. Went there twice, even though there's an abundance of massage places, just because i wanted the same great quality. I would always return here and ask for Sati :)

reviews.name: Erica Tang
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the massage during my first visit, which is why I decided to return. Unfortunately, the second experience was disappointing—the masseur (attached images) was less skilled in her techniques (kept doing the same thing e.g. pulling my ankle) and I felt uncomfortable throughout the entire one-hour foot massage session.
For those considering a return visit, I strongly recommend noting the masseur’s name so you can request the same person again if you enjoyed your first session.

reviews.name: Gabriel Burgos
reviews.text:
Exactly what I came to Thailand for. The masseuses here don’t all go through the same motions, each brings their own expert knowledge of Thai massage, and use it as is best for your body.

Also this place has only one marketer outside, she’s very chill, and the place is completely packed on the inside, good sign.

reviews.name: Tandy Tandy
reviews.text: We have tried many massage places in Bangkok, and this is one of the shops we recommend! The pressure is right and comfortable and my masseuse was very attentive. When my toes cramped during the massage, she immediately applied a hot towel to my foot and massaged it to relieve the tension. My friends also praised the experience, saying it was very relaxing.

reviews.name: Varitda Isarankura Na Ayuthya
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever experienced. I had my treatment with a therapist named Khun Aom, and she has definitely become my go-to therapist from now on. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.name: DS
reviews.text: I’ve visited this place a few times already and have always been happy with the service. The therapists are skilled and the massage quality is consistently good. The place is clean, the atmosphere is comfortable, and the staff are courteous. I’ll definitely keep coming back.

reviews.name: Nur Qamarina
reviews.text: Its very soothing. Love it! Would want to try the thai massage soon 💖

reviews.name: shay yakobi
reviews.text:
Arlington Piti Thai Massage at MBK was fantastic, clean, welcoming, and super professional.
Had a 30-minute foot massage for just 200 baht, while the girls enjoyed a neck and shoulder massage for 250 baht.
The staff’s attitude was excellent, and everyone truly enjoyed their treatment.
Highly recommended, felt deeply relaxed and grateful for the experience.
Would definitely return and suggest it to friends looking for authentic
Thai massage in MBK.

reviews.name: Remi Abi
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing, I feel very refreshed after the Thai massage, it felt amazing and so worth it for the price. Will recommend to everyone!!

reviews.name: kee tee
reviews.text:
I requested a herbal ball and Thai massage. It was originally 60 minutes, but since the therapist was so skilled, I extended it to 90 minutes. It was my first time trying a herbal ball treatment, and it was very good. However, the balls were hot, but the air conditioning was cold, so regulating the temperature was difficult.lol

In the latter half, they gave me a traditional Thai massage. I think they were quite skilled.

The therapist, a young man in his twenties, spoke a little Japanese, which made me happy. I regret forgetting to ask his name because my flight time was approaching.

I want to go again.

reviews.name: Claire Sasithorn
reviews.text: Very good service, all staffs here are very nice and polite. The massage quality is so good, I come back for several times. Around 2-3 times a month and everything still good as the same.

reviews.name: Greg Cutler
reviews.text: Was a bit cautious of all the 5-star ratings from many people with few other Google reviews, but this place was great. It’s in a row with 4-5 other massage places, each trying to sell their services as you walk by. Arun Piti seemed to have a better ambiance, and inside was calm, relaxing music, and a small fountain splashing gently. I got a foot and lower leg massage from Wan, while my wife got a full-body Thai massage. Both of us thoroughly enjoyed it. Perfect pressure, finding knots we didn’t know we had. Other guests also seemed very happy with the service based on their “OMG that feels good”-groans and expressions. Prices are also very good for the service. If we’re in MBK area again, we’ll be back!

reviews.name: Leeray Tachi
reviews.text: waw amazing. went in for foot neck and shoulders it was soo good i had to ask an extra  half hour for my back. Ohm gave me such a great massage would come all the way back just for another massage .🙏🏾💓

reviews.name: Boris Buconic
reviews.text: Absolute amazing and professional experience. Been there two days i a row. Came with sore back and pain in the hand. After two sessions soreness and pain went away. Its a must go for anyone looking for proffesional thai massage. 🙏

reviews.name: V C
reviews.text: We checked the previous comments and came here for a shoulder and foot massage. The masseuses are very professional, polite and friendly. They put pressure at the right place and I genuinely enjoyed the whole one hour. It is reasonably priced, we will deffo come back.

reviews.name: Eric Lim
reviews.text: My wife and I went there at 9:30pm not knowing that the place closes at 10pm. However, the masseurs obliging completed their service without any short cuts or rushing us and they paid attention to detail to unravel the knots in my wife's legs. Got to speak to the husband of the owner and he was hospitable and friendly. I will recommend to anyone who wants a reasonable priced massage with good service!

title: Le lek massage
address: 183/1-2 Thanon Suan Phlu, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

reviews.name: Daton Chris
reviews.text:
It was very impressive of how the massage skill of the staff here. After a small talk, I found that the staff implement a local Thai massaging technique that has been known as villager therapist.

I request that I do need fixing my shoulder after muscle injury, and she knows how to heal it well. I will request “Khun Sri” for the next visit for sure. Hoping that the manager should be able to read this review and be grateful of how great the staff is.

The interior of this place is bright and delightful, which typical Thai massage place are usually dark.

The light that gets inside of the place making the spa looks airy, breathable and extra clean!! that seems to be the key point that draws me to have a visit.

reviews.name: Nasser Al-Naama
reviews.text:
I ended up at La Lek Massage for a quick 30-minute neck, head, and shoulder massage and it genuinely helped regulate me physically and mentally.
Sometimes stress and tension sit in the body quietly until someone works through the right areas properly. I walked out feeling noticeably lighter, calmer, and more grounded.
It’s also one of the better affordable massage spots I’ve come across in Bangkok. 250 baht, clean, efficient, no fuss, and exactly what I needed. I even tipped the therapist afterward because she really did a great job. This was my second time here.

reviews.name: mayu mayu
reviews.text:
DON’T GO HERE!!

I booked a 90-minute massage, but the actual massage was only 75 min.

I politely asked if they could adjust the price to since I did not receive a full 90-minute massage, but they refused to offer any refund or price adjustment.

I was very disappointed by the lack of transparency about the treatment time and the way my concern was handled.

reviews.name: Katarina Protsack
reviews.text:
I received a foot massage here while staying nearby, which was lovely. After that experience, I decided to get a full body oil massage for my last night before I flew home. I really regret it... the masseuse had no idea what she was doing and really messed up my back. That night I went to bed with pain in my shoulders, sacrum, hips, and neck.

I had been in Thailand for three weeks, having fantastic massages regularly and was revelling in how fantastic my body felt. I now have to get an expensive RMT massage here in London to try and fix the damage, as it's been two days and I am still in a lot of pain.

I'd go here for the foot massages, but stay away from anything more.

reviews.name: Tata Justiciera
reviews.text:
I have been here several times here but last time they overcharged me and they did not make the massage i requested…. In the room it was very cold, i requested to turn off the AC and she stop it and 5 min later she turn it on again.

I finished 30 min earlier cause the massage was not being good and they even did not try to solve anything….. 500 Baths for 30 min of the wrong massage.

reviews.name: Pankaj
reviews.text: Efficient massage spot in Sathorn. Compact place with some loungers in the front section for foot massages and space for other treatments in the back, too. I chose the 60-minute foot massage at 300 THB. It was done by a sweet elderly lady, and she did a fine job. Definitely recommended.

reviews.name: Adriani
reviews.text: The Thai massage was good and strong, traditionally done. I am feeling better now, little sore, but relaxed. Thank you!

reviews.name: Chyrel Panlilio
reviews.text:
Had foot, Thai, and head and shoulders massages done by 2 masseuse and Liu was so much better. Liu knew where my knotted muscles were and knew how to release them. She took her time and used the one hour well.
They provided clothes for the Thai and head and shoulders massage.

They also served warm lemongrass tea at the end of the massage.

reviews.name: Minh Hai Lê
reviews.text:
Very good massage but the place is too noisy to relax. You can hear all the street noises + car honks.
There is room for body massage but without ceiling with the main area so you hear everything. The staff is noisy, discussing each other, phone call and so on. Someone was watching videos on a tablet.
It feels also a bit cheap.

reviews.name: Christian Andre Arce
reviews.text:
Nice place, therapist is very professional. All staffs are kind and approachable.

I would recommend this spa and will come back soon.

reviews.name: Monica Shin
reviews.text: I visited and asked for a traditional Thai massage for two hours. I’ve visited many massage shop before and didn’t know traditional Thai massage includes any balm or oil, and I didn’t ask for that either. The therapist used herbal balm smells minty to massage my back, arms and legs for the first one and half hour and the air-condition was very strong. Even though I asked the therapist to turn the air-condition off in the half way, I felt extremely cold and weak after the massage. The skills my therapist used was just average and not patient. I can’t relax at all.

reviews.name: J P
reviews.text: I do not recommend this place. During my foot massage, the lady had me sit on an oily towel which completely ruined my dress. I only realized this after returning to my hotel. Not only did I waste my money and tip, but my favorite dress was also ruined. Additionally, the massage did not feel good as she kept pressing too hard on my muscles causing pain.

reviews.name: Lucy Blenkinsop
reviews.text: Excellent leg, foot, back and shoulder massage. We will be back.

reviews.name: Davin Kurnia Wangsa
reviews.text:
The best Thai massage so far
This is even better than some well-known massage chain brand you can find in Bangkok. Have to take the “thai massage” for at least 90 mins for the best result

reviews.name: Orapin Salon
reviews.text: Very nice massage calming place very good therapist I love it 😀

reviews.name: Orito Chf
reviews.text: 60 min foot massage that went to 90 because Titi did really great massage, so I asked to extend. Thank you very much 😊

reviews.name: Bình Đào
reviews.text: friendly staffs but need to adjust the level of pressing a bit because I feel the massage is quite weak

reviews.name: Luis JB
reviews.text: Unfortunately the worst massage I’ve gotten so far. The masseur did not seem to have a clue what he was doing and the place did not feel hygienic.

reviews.name: M Healey
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing! The friendliest staff!
I’ve never been so relaxed I my life. Best massage I’ve received in my life. Highly recommend especially after major surgery. Very clean place very professional, very kind and  GiGi thank you so much for your amazing work. I appreciate you. 💜

reviews.name: piyakarn2010
reviews.text: The best massage in the area. Nice shop & Good service. I usually have a therapist name Su to massage me. Foot massage is recommended.

title: Wan Massage
address: 672/13 ตรอกฮองกงแบงค์ Si Phraya Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: 672/13 ตรอกฮองกงแบงค์ Si Phraya Rd

reviews.name: Sam Brun
reviews.text: Great massage 3 of us had 1 hr foot and shoulder massage for 300 baht was a great massage would be back again !!

reviews.name: Sam Root
reviews.text:
Had a 1 hour massage and it was great. Very nice ladies and Friendly. Price was 300baht and I left a 100baht tip..

Easy walk from the Sheraton hotel.

reviews.name: Katrina S
reviews.text:
Great shop. Had the Thai massage while friends had the hot stone and regular foot massage. Foot massage includes some head, shoulder and arm massage. The ladies work hard, the place is clean and pricing is good ~ 250-400B roughly depending on service for an hour.

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Michael Verheul
reviews.text: Very friendly staff! Good massage, manicure and pedicure for good prices! I will definitely come back.

reviews.name: Kiwi Kiwi
reviews.text:
Very good massage, all the staff were working hard.
The foot n Vj and shoulders massage was very good.
We tried to go back after dinner, but they were full and booked up

reviews.name: Dharshinie D
reviews.text:
Not near the best massage in Bangkok. We were shocked as how this place got such good reviews..Me and my husband were unlucky to get two really bad ones. My masseuse was talking for 5 min and falling asleep another 10minutes and coughing another minute. I mean I get it that you get tired as the day goes by.
It is the job of the owner to allow the masseuse to have adequate rest before the next customer so the quality of massage is the same as all customers are paying the same amount even during midnight..
If you have no prior experience coming here or you do not know which masseuse to choose, please don’t waste your time and money.

reviews.name: Eus Van Der Heijden
reviews.text: Been twice now. Did full body oil and 2 times foot (reflex)massage. Excellent! Lovely experienced ladies.

reviews.name: Danny Hurley
reviews.text:
My wife and I came here twice.
I had the Thai massage which was excellent - good pressure and muscle relaxation. Julie had the head and shoulder massage, the aroma massage and both manicure and pedicure all of which she rated as excellent too. I can vouch for the pedicure as I had one while I was waiting for her - very thorough, my toes have never had such attention lavished on them. We both recommend this place.

reviews.name: Ian Pearce
reviews.text: We visited WAN Massage on two occasions during our short 4 night mid July 2025 stop in Bangkok. I first visited here back in the early 2000’s and it’s always given me a good service from Thai / Oil/ Aroma massage to manicure/ pedicures. On this recent visit we just had the 90 min Foot, Leg, Head, Neck Shoulder massage which was excellent🫰🏻🥳 from the experience staff who I’ve known for a long time. Sawadee Krub🙏🏻Thank You. Until next time Bangkok🫰🏻

reviews.name: Jack Nguyen
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in Bangkok. I’m usually not a fan of foot massages since they are usually too painful, but the pressure here was just right. All of the staff were friendly and nice. The chairs were very comfortable. It was so good, we extended our massages from 60 minutes to 90 minutes. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: raymond wong
reviews.text: WARNING: Do not go to this massage place.  The masseuse stole money from my pocket, swapping a 1000Bhat note with a 100Bhat note in my trousers pocket when I was sleeping.  They denied they stole it.  They also stole my Sheraton hotel umbrella.  I warn all fellow travelers NOT to come here.  This is a terrible experience.

reviews.name: Crystal Wang
reviews.text: They will skimp many minutes here and there. You won’t get the time you pay for. My 90-minute massage ended 10 minutes early, and that was already after several pauses in between when the masseuse went away for several minutes. Then she tried arguing with me that she did the full 90 minutes, until I provided evidence with timestamps. During the massage, she also looked visibly annoyed when I asked her to increase pressure. There are many better places in Bangkok to go. I’d rather go to a place where they are not lazy.

reviews.name: Jeff Smith
reviews.text:
Had a manicure and a massage
Best manicure I’ve ever had, and I’ve had heaps
Massage almost sent me to sleep at midday
Highly recommended

reviews.name: Pam Kaur
reviews.text:
Great little place. We had a 60 minute foot massage each. Polite, welcoming ladies.
Delivered a soothing and pleasant full 60 minute massage for 300 baht.
Just round the corner from Royal Orchid Sheraton

reviews.name: ッangelseahx3
reviews.text: Foot massage was too soft and didn't even help with my tired feet. Throughout the 1 hr masseuse kept doing the same motion without any other techniques. Not even trying to press my feet points at all. Just spreading and applying lotion the whole time. Terrible. As a sgrean, any JB massage shop is wayyyyy better. Price 300 bhat for a 60 mins foot massage btw.

reviews.name: Adam Tan
reviews.text: Amazing Thai massage experience. On point and just the right amount of strength. Would visit again.

reviews.name: Margaret Ridolin
reviews.text: I had a 90-minute coconut oil massage and a 30-minute foot massage, both of which were excellent. The service was friendly, professional and very good value for money (900 baht for both massages) 100% recommend 😎

reviews.name: Kuala
reviews.text: I don’t know how this place got so many good reviews, we all got such bad experience here. We got the 90mins whole body oil massage and all we got is skin irritation and bruises. The masseuses did the massage very cursory and inconsistent, they sometimes just decided to sit on your bum for 5mins doing nothing or just skip your left leg massage. All the masseuses are lovely but they really need proper training

reviews.name: Glenn
reviews.text: A great little spot a short walk from the Royal Orchid Sheraton.  You walk past the 7-11 and a couple of other massage places until you hit Wan Massage (it's the last one if walking from the ROS). Very clean and comfortable. Very good service at the front desk and by the masseurs. A 60 min foot, leg, head and shoulder massage in 300 baht. A cold water or tea at the end. Also has wifi.

reviews.name: Frau Hartmann
reviews.text: We already knew 2 other good massage studios in Bangkok, but also wanted to try something near our accommodation (Courtyard by Marriott) and intuitively chose this studio. The main profile here are the foot massages and the combined foot-shoulder-back-head massages. Thai massage is also available, but the space is quite narrow so that the therapist cannot work comfortably. But the quality of the massages is very good and the staff are very nice. We had come back 3 nights. Our therapists were Nam, Kan, Noj, Janny and Oh. We liked it very much and even others like the place, in the evening it can get crowded.

title: DIORA Luxe Sukhumvit Spa
ownerDescription: Spa near BTS Asok Station.
address: 4 Soi Sukhumvit 12, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Jason C
reviews.text:
DIORA Luxe Sukhumvit Spa exceeded expectations from start to finish. The atmosphere is beautiful — clean, thoughtfully decorated, and it even smells wonderful the moment you walk in. Every detail felt considered.
I'd asked if they could WhatsApp me if a slot opened up for the 2-hour treatment I wanted, and honestly I didn't expect much to come of it — but they followed through and reached out when a spot became available. That kind of attentiveness says a lot about how they run things.
My massage therapist, Rose, was excellent — skilled, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend this spa if you're looking for a relaxing, high-quality experience in Sukhumvit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jason C,

Thank you for your feedback.
We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Luxe Sukhumvit

reviews.name: Kaori Dr.Travel
reviews.text:
Today we visited DIORA and enjoyed the 90-minute Hot Stone Aroma Oil Massage. It was an excellent experience from beginning to end.

The staff warmly welcomed us in the beautiful lobby, escorted us to the treatment room, and carefully asked about our preferred massage pressure before the session started. We also loved that we could choose our own essential oil, making the experience feel even more personalized.

The massage itself was incredibly relaxing, and the therapists were professional and attentive throughout.

After the treatment, we were served delicious snacks with fresh mango and pineapple, which were a perfect ending to the experience.

If you’re looking for a relaxing and high-quality spa in Bangkok, I highly recommend DIORA. We will definitely come back on our next visit!

reviews.name: Ashia Cook
reviews.text:
Diora Spa is the kind of place you go when you truly need to reset—mentally and physically. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm, clean, and intentionally designed to help you unwind. The lighting, scent, and soft music immediately set the tone for a relaxing experience.

The staff was welcoming and professional, taking the time to understand exactly what I needed before starting my treatment. My therapist was attentive and skilled, applying just the right amount of pressure and checking in throughout to make sure I was comfortable.

The treatment itself was incredible—thorough, soothing, and left me feeling completely refreshed. You can tell they prioritize both technique and client experience. Everything felt high-quality, from the products used to the overall cleanliness of the space.

What really stood out was the attention to detail. It didn’t feel rushed or routine—it felt personalized and thoughtful.

If you’re looking for a spa that delivers both relaxation and quality service, Diora Spa is definitely worth it. I left feeling lighter, recharged, and already planning my next visit.

reviews.name: Y B
reviews.text:
Had a really good experience at this massage place. It was very clean and well maintained which made me feel comfortable right away.

The Thai massage was excellent. The masseuse was skilled and applied the right pressure, and adjusted well to my needs.

Service was warm and professional. I left feeling very relaxed and refreshed

reviews.name: S Young
reviews.text:
Updated review on Feb 25, 2026:
We came in for a 60-minute body scrub followed by a two-hour oil massage. We made the reservation online without issue, and upon arrival we were asked to choose our oil and scrub as usual.

However, this visit was different from our previous experiences. The scrub lasted approximately 45–50 minutes, after which we were given time to shower. Effectively, the advertised “60-minute scrub” included about 15 minutes allocated for showering, meaning the actual treatment time was shorter than expected.

At checkout, we raised this with a staff member named Shery. She explained that the scrub is now 45 minutes so guests can use the remaining 15 minutes to shower, stating this was a new policy implemented in Jan 2026. We found this confusing, as we had visited in January and did not encounter this structure. When we mentioned that, she then said the policy had changed in February instead. The inconsistency was concerning and made the explanation feel unclear.

If the policy has indeed changed, the listing on Klook should be updated accordingly. Advertising a 60-minute scrub when the hands-on treatment time is 45 minutes is misleading. While 15 minutes may not seem significant, transparency matters. As returning customers, we simply want clarity about what we are purchasing.

We have generally enjoyed our prior visits, which makes this experience disappointing. We hope management updates its descriptions to accurately reflect the treatment structure and maintains the level of professionalism expected from an established spa.

First review on Jan 19, 2026:
The spa is just a 10-minute walk from our hotel, and given the abundance of massage places in Bangkok, we decided to give it a try. We were pleasantly surprised by how wonderful the experience was.

We made a reservation in advance, and upon arrival the check-in process was smooth and welcoming. As soon as we walked in, we felt an immediate sense of calm thanks to the beautiful decor and serene atmosphere. We were invited to choose the scents for both our scrub and massage oil, as we had booked a one-hour body scrub followed by a two-hour aromatherapy massage.

The therapists began by washing our feet before escorting us together to a private room. The scrub came first, with just the right amount of pressure. After rinsing off, the massage started and was excellent. The therapists even used their body weight, climbing onto our backs to deliver a very effective deep tissue massage.

At the end of the treatment, we were served tea along with a small mango jelly, which was a lovely finishing touch. Overall, it was a truly relaxing and rejuvenating experience, and an excellent way to recover from jet lag. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear S Young,

Thank you for your feedback and we apologize for the inconvenience caused. The details have been updated on the platform.

We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Luxe Sukhumvit

reviews.name: Anna Luu
reviews.text: Did the Thai traditional massage with herbal compress. My masseuse Dee was very skilled and very considerate with how she was handling me. The massage was very comfortable and the service was impeccable. Love how they serve cold tea and cold compress at the start but finish off with warm tea and even mango sticky rice! Really recommend!

reviews.name: Absolut YVR
reviews.text:
I recently visited Diora Spa for a 2-hour Thai oil massage, and I left feeling completely refreshed and satisfied. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is incredibly calming and professional.
The Highlights:
The Ambiance: The spa is beautifully designed with a modern, "Zen" aesthetic. The lobby is warm and welcoming, and the treatment rooms are clean, private, and dimly lit—perfect for zoning out.
The Welcome: I loved the attention to detail. Upon arrival, I was served a refreshing tea and given a cold towel and a beautiful jasmine garland. It’s those small touches that make the experience feel premium.
Personalization: They have a great scent station where you can test different essential oils (like "Minty Almond" or "Mystique Glow") to choose the one that fits your mood for the treatment.
The Massage: The 2-hour massage was the perfect length. The therapist was skilled, attentive to my pressure preferences, and ensured I was comfortable throughout the entire session.
Verdict:
If you are looking for a high-quality, professional massage in a beautiful setting, Diora Spa is a fantastic choice. The staff is polite, the facility is spotless, and the service is top-notch. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Wanwisa Rachawong
reviews.text:
This is one of the best spas in Bangkok. The place is clean, beautiful, and well-maintained. The reception staff are very welcoming and professional. The therapist provided an excellent massage that was both relaxing and rejuvenating.

The combination of the peaceful atmosphere and high-quality massage made me feel completely refreshed and at ease. The treatment room was private and comfortable, which enhanced the overall experience.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and professional spa experience.

reviews.name: Tiffy
reviews.text: I had an amazing massage experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and very relaxing, which made me feel comfortable the moment I walked in. The therapist was professional, attentive, and made sure the pressure was just right throughout the entire session.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tiffy,

Thank you for your feedback.
We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Luxe Sukhumvit

reviews.name: Anne-Cathrin Darcis
reviews.text: I did a very relaxing spa treatment with scrub, foot massage, full body oil massage, herbal ball, and face massage. The staff were very  friendly and spoke English. They also asked me about my health conditions and whether I wanted a strong medium or soft massage. The whole atmosphere was comforting with nice background music and air-conditioning neither too cold, or too warm.

reviews.name: Chilly Tang
reviews.text: My third or fourth time already at this branch. I like the consistency of the service and how comfortable every time I felt. Perfect massage in a super convenient location with friendly staff and clean environment. Will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Kelly Lam
reviews.text:
Excellent service- the top of spa experience in Thailand.
Therapist CREAM is good

reviews.text:
We visited this spa three times, which already says a lot. The massage therapists are exceptionally skilled, highly professional, and you are treated with genuine care and respect throughout the entire experience.

We tried both the classic Thai massage and the oil massage, and both were outstanding — perfectly executed, deeply relaxing, and clearly performed by very well-trained therapists.

reviews.name: Scott Fuller (Scotty)
reviews.text:
Out of this world magical experience. I’ve been to Thailand a few times and I’ve had many massages and this place is by far the most luxurious, professional, and highest quality massage I’ve gotten. We did the one hour aromatherapy oil massage and told them it was our honeymoon and also my husband’s birthday soon.

They gave us a private suite, we chose our own oils, and they did a full body amazing massage. They are very sensitive to how strong or soft you want the massage and highlight any focus areas you want. They’re very aware of any noise you make, and adjust accordingly without even having to ask you (though they do initially ask if the strength of the massage is okay at the start). You do get fully nude however they provide this kind of disposable underwear to put on and if you don’t feel comfortable you can use the towels to cover up.

The attention to detail is another level. Even the hot and ice towels are scented, there’s a scented floral and oil bowl beneath your face while you’re lying down, the lighting is soft, and the entire space is quiet and relaxing.

At the end you can shower and freshen up and they will give you a desert and tea and another scented hot towel at the end, and they even gave us a special cake for my husband’s birthday.

10/10 experience I would highly recommend anyone coming to visit Bangkok, and the prices are very good too considering the amount of luxury and attention to care that you get. Anything like this in the West would cost 4x the price.

reviews.text:
The place looks beautiful and the interior design is impressive, but unfortunately my experience with the actual treatments was extremely disappointing.

I came for hair treatment after seeing all the marketing and promises, but the results were nowhere near what was advertised. In my opinion, the hair treatment is heavily overpromoted, and the quality simply does not justify the very high prices.

What was even worse was the facial treatment. I strongly do not recommend any facial or skin treatment here. The procedure was performed in an unprofessional way, and I ended up with visible marks and irritation on my face afterward due to poor technique and excessive handling of the skin.

It feels like the focus is on paid advertising and social media marketing rather than delivering real results and professional service. For the prices they charge, I expected a much higher level of expertise and customer care.

Unfortunately, this was a waste of money, and I will not be returning. I cannot recommend this place to anyone looking for genuine hair or skincare treatments.

1.Hydra Facial Treatment  (This is in your package)
focused on deep cleansing, exfoliation, extraction,

2.Signature Face Lift Gym with Gem Stone Therapy (Best Seller and the most popular treatment)

our signature treatment designed to stimulate facial muscles, improve circulation, promote lymphatic drainage, reduce facial tension, and create a naturally lifted and refreshed appearance through specialized massage techniques and gemstone tools.

This signature treatment has been developed through years of experience and feedback from thousands of guests from around the world. 

It remains one of our most requested and highest-rated facial experiences, particularly among guests seeking relaxation, facial contouring, 
and a natural wellness-focused approach rather than medical 
or invasive procedures.

We would also like to clarify that our hair treatments are not based 
solely on cosmetic conditioning.

Our Head Spa and Hair Care programs incorporate a combination of medical-grade scalp care products, naturally derived ingredients, and concentrated ampoule serums specifically selected to support 
scalp health and overall hair wellness.

We are particularly proud that many of our guests return regularly and recommend our treatments to friends and family. 

We sincerely appreciate your comments and will continue using feedback such as yours to further enhance our communication, treatment explanations, and guest care standards.

Warm regards,
Guest Service Team
Morning Kiss Spa & Wellness

I booked the head spa with private onsen, and it was honestly one of the best wellness experiences I’ve had in Bangkok. The scalp treatment was gentle but thorough, and the hair steaming left my scalp feeling so refreshed and light. The private onsen was beautifully designed and perfectly warm — a peaceful escape right in the middle of Sukhumvit.

The entire place is spotless and well-maintained, with so much attention to detail. Even the small touches like the tea, aroma, and lighting made the experience feel luxurious.

The location is also super convenient, just a short walk from Emsphere and BTS Phrom Phong.

If you’re looking for deep relaxation and a premium wellness experience, I highly recommend this spa. I left feeling recharged, calm, and absolutely pampered. Will definitely come back again! 🌿💆‍♀️✨

The hair treatment was so soothing, the facial left my skin glowing, and the foot treatment was the perfect way to unwind after a long day. reviews.name: Nasser Al-Naama
reviews.text:
I went to Morning Kiss Spa on my birthday, just expecting a decent treatment, nothing more. It ended up being one of those experiences that catches you off guard in a quiet way.
The place itself is calm, clean, and thoughtfully put together. Not over the top, just comfortable in a way that lets you settle quickly.
I booked a facial and their signature head massage, both were done with care and attention, not rushed, not mechanical. You can tell they take what they’re doing seriously.
Rachel and Amanda were genuinely kind and easy to be around. There’s a softness in how they interact that doesn’t feel forced.
They also offered me a complimentary foot massage and onsen session, about 30 minutes each, which I wasn’t expecting. The onsen is essentially a private hot soak, simple but grounding. Yummi did my foot massage and she was excellent, very attentive without overdoing it.
At the end, they brought out a small birthday cake. It was unexpected and, honestly, it got to me. I don’t usually have moments like that, so it stayed with me more than I thought it would.
It’s not just about the treatments here. There’s a level of care that feels real. I’d come back.

You can tell she really put in the effort and knew exactly what she was doing. For the price, it felt more than worth it.

Not the place I originally looked for.

A friend is visiting me here in Bangkok and we decided to get a good Thai massage. I did some research and found a good shop we wanted to go to.

Completely booked out and they don't accept card payment.

That's the only reason we ended up at Senses Massage, because that place accepts card payment.

Already a good plus point.

And when we walked in we were welcomed warmly, took off our socks and got slippers, then booked a 60 minute Thai massage with balm.

Before that they also washed our feet with a nice smelling shampoo.

We were then led upstairs, I lay down on a bed in an air conditioned room and got the massage from my masseuse.

The woman did things to me and released tension in my body that I didn't even know I had.

That was absolutely insane, I feel so new, so happy and refreshed.

That was the first Thai massage of my life and I would come back and book again.

And not to forget, at the end there was a free tasty Thai tea. I found it an extremely good massage experience and wondered why the store has so few reviews.

reviews.name: Tan.W
reviews.text:
Managed to secure a slot for two at 4pm. The counter staff wasn’t very fluent in English but did her best, and her colleague soon stepped in, which made the whole process much easier.

Before the massage, we were given a form to indicate the type of massage, focus areas, and preferred strength. I chose medium, but my masseur’s pressure was quite strong. Even so, I went along with it. I opted for the Back, Neck & Shoulder massage for one hour at ฿400, but it turned out to be more like a full-body massage.

While washing our feet, we were served a cold cup of tea, then asked to change into the massage outfit. The Thai pants were… a challenge. There were instructions in the changing room, but I still didn’t quite get it right—managed to secure them without dropping, and that was the main thing.

We were ushered into a room with about four to five beds. There wasn’t a face hole in the bed, which I usually don’t enjoy, but it wasn’t a dealbreaker. The massage was hard and at times painful, yet I found myself drifting in and out of sleep. My favourite part was when we lay on our backs and the therapist used her legs as a “pillow”—that segment was really shiok.

After the massage, we were given a feedback form, and only then did I realise this place is an Ex-Inmate Employment and Skill Development Center. The sign was actually at the entrance, but we missed it. Definitely worth supporting—I love places that give back to society. To end the session, we were served hot tea and rice crackers.

They also have multiple outlets around Chiang Mai.

Your support means a great deal to our therapists and team.

reviews.name: Anantaya Sachdev
reviews.text: I’m mind blown!! I did the head & shoulder massage with K. Kan and she was even better than a physiotherapist. She took out all the knots and the relief was 11/10. Quality & Value for money, highly recommended. I don’t think I can go elsewhere for a massage now.

reviews.name: CH WA (Aus)
reviews.text:
This place is an absolute lifesaver. After spending the entire day walking around and exploring Bangkok, my feet and body were completely exhausted, and I desperately needed a good, deep-tissue relief. This massage center in Chong Nonsi delivered exactly that and more.

This was my revisit, and after another flawless experience, I felt compelled to finally sit down and write a review about it. It is truly a decent, reliable, and high-quality massage center in an area where it can sometimes be hard to find a spot that hits all the right notes.The highlight of the session was definitely the therapist.

The "auntie" who took care of me was an absolute professional. You can immediately tell when someone genuinely knows their job—she understood the anatomy, found every single knot in my sore muscles, and applied the perfect amount of pressure to actually relieve the fatigue rather than just rubbing the skin.Beyond her incredible skills, she was deeply respectful of my personal space and comfort.

There was no unnecessary chitchat, just a quiet, dedicated focus on making sure I left feeling completely rejuvenated. The hospitality here feels grounded, sincere, and deeply respectful of the customer.

If you are looking for a genuine, highly effective massage to heal your tired body after a long day of walking in Bangkok, skip the tourist traps and come straight here. It is worth every single Baht. I will definitely keep coming back

reviews.name: Anthony Tran
reviews.text: I went here during my vacations in Bangkok. The place was really clean and calm. I took the deep tissue massage. The masseuse was very friendly, skilled and professional. The massage was strong and perfect for the muscles. I felt very relieved at the end. I 100% recommend and will come back for sure. Thank you !

reviews.name: Vibeke Pedersen
reviews.text:
I had my heart set on getting a Hot Stone Massage in Chiang Mai. It was supposed to be gentler than Thai or Deep Tissue massages. At Lila Thai Massage Prapokklao I was treated to a amazing massage from Orapin, who made sure that the pressure and heat from the stones were just right for me.

Sometimes the massage therapists apply too much pressure for my liking - even after I've told them to be more gentle. This was not the case with this massage. It was just the right amount of pressure that it felt both relaxing as well as loosening up my sore muscles.

For this type of massage I was in a completely private room (not just behind curtains) which was much appreciated as it is a type of massage with your clothes off. I booked 90 minutes (I could not book any less), and I thought that it perhaps was a little too long, but it was not.

The massage therapist used her hands with oil and the hot stones to do the massage. So the hot stones were not just lying on my muscles but were used to massage with.

Actually, I inquired about a hot stone massage at another Lila, but they said that they didn't have a massage therapist available who was trained to do a hot stone massage at that time. I really appreciated their honesty.

The price was higher compared to other places, but they seemed professional and I would come back again if I am ever in Chiang Mai.

Southern Thai (Wat Pho) style — firm acupressure along energy lines. Less stretching, more targeted pressure.
Especially popular with Korean guests — the most discerning massage clients in the world :), who recommend us to each other and make the trip from across the city. A favorite with Israeli travelers too: located right across from Chabad Chiang Mai. Both come in with their families.

ownerUpdates.text:
𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐢, 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐓𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐞, 𝐨𝐫 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐢 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐓𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐞 — 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐒𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐦
Our menu has three sessions that look similar at first glance. They differ in method, in what they ask of the therapist, and in price — 300, 500, and 400 THB per hour. Here is the logic behind that difference.
🔹 𝐓𝐖𝐎 𝐖𝐀𝐘𝐒 𝐎𝐅 𝐋𝐎𝐎𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐀𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐁𝐎𝐃𝐘
𝙏𝙧𝙖𝙙𝙞𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙖𝙡 𝙏𝙝𝙖𝙞 𝙢𝙖𝙨𝙨𝙖𝙜𝙚 treats the body as a system. The therapist works along the Sen lines with rhythmic compression and stretching — the same logic as yoga — moving blood through tissue and restoring mobility throughout the whole body. The goal is that you leave feeling reset, not merely relaxed.
𝘿𝙚𝙚𝙥 𝙩𝙞𝙨𝙨𝙪𝙚 𝙢𝙖𝙨𝙨𝙖𝙜𝙚 works locally. It comes from Western anatomy: find the specific knot or adhesion in a specific muscle, then apply direct, sustained pressure until it releases. The goal is precise — that particular spot stops hurting.
❗️Neither is "better". They are answers to different questions.
🔹 𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐐𝐔𝐄𝐒 𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐒𝐎 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓
Thai massage uses the therapist's entire body — palms, forearms, elbows, knees, feet. Body weight does the work, and stretching sequences spread the physical load. The well-known "Thai flying" techniques exist partly so the therapist can keep working without exhausting one set of muscles.
Deep tissue, by contrast, is almost entirely hands and forearms — continuously, with real force. ...

🌿 𝐖𝐡𝐲 “𝐒𝐭𝐮𝐜𝐤” 𝐓𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐞 𝐃𝐨𝐞𝐬𝐧’𝐭 𝐀𝐥𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠
Some people describe their body as tight.
Others describe it as stuck.
These are not the same feeling — and they don’t respond to the same solutions.
📍 If you stretch every day, do yoga, roll on a foam roller, and still feel restricted in the same spots, the issue usually isn’t flexibility. It’s often the fascia — the connective tissue that wraps around your muscles, joints, and organs.
🔹 𝐖𝐇𝐀𝐓 “𝐒𝐓𝐔𝐂𝐊” 𝐔𝐒𝐔𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐘 𝐌𝐄𝐀𝐍𝐒
People describe it in different ways:
“I stretch it, but it doesn’t hold.”
“It feels dense, like it’s glued down.”
“I’m flexible, but the movement still feels blocked.”
❗️The feeling is usually deep rather than surface-level, heavy rather than sharp, resistant rather than stretchy. That’s a useful clue — stretching works well on muscle, but not on tissue that has lost its ability to glide.
🔹 𝐌𝐔𝐒𝐂𝐋𝐄 𝐕𝐒. 𝐅𝐀𝐒𝐂𝐈𝐀
Muscles shorten and lengthen, so they respond well to stretching, strengthening, and rest.
Fascia works differently. It’s meant to glide and adapt as you move. When it becomes restricted, it can limit movement even if the muscles underneath are perfectly flexible. This is why someone can stretch regularly, have good range of motion on paper, and still feel held back.
🔹 𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐄𝐓𝐂𝐇𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐎𝐅𝐓𝐄𝐍 𝐈𝐒𝐍’𝐓 𝐄𝐍𝐎𝐔𝐆𝐇
Stretching increases circulation and calms the nervous system, which is why it feels...

מכון העיסוי שלנו ידוע לא רק בשירות איכותי במחירים הוגנים, אלא גם באהבה מיוחדת לישראלים. אנחנו לצידכם!
(כאילו... בואו נגיד... לצד שלנו... נו, אתם מבינים אותי, אני מקווה 😉)

𝐉𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐭 𝐯𝐬 𝐌𝐮𝐬𝐜𝐥𝐞 𝐯𝐬 𝐋𝐢𝐠𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐏𝐚𝐢𝐧: 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐈𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞
After a long day of walking around Chiang Mai, climbing stairs, hiking, or exploring the city, something may start to hurt.
But what exactly is hurting — a joint, a muscle, or a ligament? 🤔
They can all cause pain around a similar area, but they are not the same thing.
🦴 𝐉𝐎𝐈𝐍𝐓 𝐏𝐀𝐈𝐍
Joint pain usually feels deeper — inside the joint itself. It may come with stiffness, swelling, warmth, or reduced movement.
It often becomes more noticeable when the joint is moving or bearing weight.
💪 𝐌𝐔𝐒𝐂𝐋𝐄 𝐏𝐀𝐈𝐍
Muscle pain is usually felt in the muscle itself. It can feel sore, tight, tired, or crampy.
This is common after unusual exercise, long walks, carrying luggage, poor posture, or simply asking your body to do more than usual.
Muscle discomfort often improves with rest, gentle stretching, and massage.
🦵 𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐀𝐌𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐏𝐀𝐈𝐍
Ligaments connect bones to each other around a joint.
Ligament pain is often more localized and can feel sharp, especially with a particular movement or when the ligament is placed under stress.
If the pain appeared suddenly after a fall, twist, or other injury — especially with swelling, bruising, or a feeling that the joint is unstable — don't simply ask for a stronger massage.
👆 𝐒𝐨 𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞?
Our location

𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐲 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬 🌧️
Dear friends and clients!
Kunlarat Massage — Chiang Mai's most devoted friend to travelers — is deeply concerned that you might not know what to do around here when it just won't stop drizzling outside.
If the weather were nice, we'd obviously be sending you off on one of our favorite mountain hikes — because after a good hike, you're basically guaranteed to end up at our place for a foot massage (300 baht/hour) or a back-and-shoulders massage (350 baht/hour).
So instead, follow our lead and head out to the huge, over-the-top Wat Ban Den temple complex in Mae Taeng district. It's 50 km north of Chiang Mai, right on the way to Bua Thong Waterfall (the "Sticky Waterfalls") — another 20 km past the temple.
The road is great, entry is free, parking is easy, and it's never crowded.
We went in early July — and we'll definitely be back, because the place is always growing something new, colorful, and slightly wild.
Kunlarat Kongchan

🆓 𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐅𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐭 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐢 𝐁𝐮𝐝𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐅𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐚𝐥𝐬: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐌𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐄𝐭𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞

On the evening and night of May 30th - the eve of Thailand's national holiday 𝘝𝘪𝘴𝘢𝘬𝘩𝘢 𝘗𝘶𝘫𝘢 (𝑩𝒖𝒅𝒅𝒉𝒂 𝑫𝒂𝒚) - Chiang Mai will host a mass pilgrimage walk up the sacred Doi Suthep mountain.

All along the road to Doi Suthep, you'll come across tents and tables offering free drinks, fruit, sweets, and other food. Some foreign visitors assume it's all paid for by the festival organizers; others think it's charity aimed at the poor.

In fact, this is neither "free food" in the everyday sense, nor charity. It's a Thai Buddhist tradition of mutual merit-making and karmic purification called 𝑹𝒐𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒂𝒏.

🪧 𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐫𝐞𝐠𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐫 𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐫𝐬

Regular food trucks and food carts will also be trading along the road. To avoid confusion, they usually display their price tags. The closer you get to the temple, the more frequently you'll encounter Roong Thaan stalls. Their organizers, for their part, display the word «โรงทาน» in large letters on their banners — sometimes alongside images of lotuses and the Buddha.

If you're not sure, just ask the person at the table: "𝘍𝘳𝘦𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘪 𝘬𝘳𝘢𝘣/𝘬𝘢?" ("Is this free?"). This is normal.

🙌 𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐛𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐨𝐝?

Neither the local authorities, nor the temple, and nor charities...

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭'𝐬 𝐇𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐌𝐚𝐢:  𝐁𝐮𝐝𝐝𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐲 (𝐕𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐤𝐡𝐚 𝐁𝐮𝐜𝐡𝐚)
🪷 𝐁𝐮𝐝𝐝𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐲 (𝘝𝘪𝘴𝘢𝘬𝘩𝘢 𝘉𝘶𝘤𝘩𝘢)
Every year, on the full moon of the sixth lunar month, Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries celebrate the most important Buddhist holiday — Buddha Day, or 𝘝𝘪𝘴𝘢𝘬𝘩𝘢 𝘉𝘶𝘤𝘩𝘢. It commemorates three key events in the life of Gautama Buddha: his birth, enlightenment, and passing.
In 2026, Visakha Bucha falls on Sunday, May 31.
🕯️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 (𝘞𝘪𝘢𝘯 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘢𝘯)
The main ceremony of this holiday is called 𝘞𝘪𝘢𝘯 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘢𝘯 in Thai. After sunset, people walk clockwise around the main hall of the temple three times, holding a candle, three incense sticks, and a lotus flower. The number "three" represents the Three Jewels of Buddhism — the Buddha, the Dhamma (his teaching), and the Sangha (the monastic community) — as well as the three key events in the Buddha's life mentioned above.
You can take part in this peaceful and slightly mystical ceremony at any Thai temple. However, we recommend...

𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐍𝐚𝐠𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐏𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐁𝐞𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐁𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐞? 𝐋𝐞𝐭’𝐬 𝐌𝐞𝐥𝐭 𝐓𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐌𝐮𝐬𝐜𝐥𝐞 𝐊𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐲!
Have you ever felt a tight, painful spot under or around your shoulder blade (scapula) that just won’t go away? You’re definitely not alone.
🦴 𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐚 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤?
The scapula is one of the busiest areas in the upper body — seventeen different muscles attach to it. These muscles help you lift, reach, twist, and move your arms throughout the day. Because so many muscle groups overlap here, this area easily becomes overloaded with tension.
💻 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐜𝐥𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞?
Just like “tech neck,” shoulder blade pain is often a result of our modern sedentary lifestyle. Sitting at a computer for hours, hunching over a desk, or constantly looking down at a phone forces the body into unnatural posture patterns.
Your shoulders round forward, while the muscles around the shoulder blades stay stretched, strained, and overworked for long periods of time.
Over time, poor circulation and constant tension can cause small areas of muscle fibers to remain stuck in a tight, contracted state. This creates what people commonly call a “muscle knot.”
⚠️ 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐨𝐧 𝐬𝐲𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐬 𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐥𝐮𝐝𝐞:
🔹 A deep, dull ache around the shoulder blade
🔹 A tender spot that hurts when pressed
🔹 Stiffness when rolling the shoulders or reaching overhead
🔹 Pain that radiates into the neck or upper back.

reviews.text:
I’m happy to have found Kunlarat Massage and especially to have found Bee!!

The facility is clean and all of the workers seem happy, with a smile on their face and are kind, but Bee is amazing. She is crazy strong so she is the one to go to if you are looking for deep Thai massage that gets deep into the muscle and fascia to release it.

She speaks really good English so it is easy to communicate with her and she has an ability to feel the body, find where the source of tension is coming from, and go directly towards it and massage it out. Very good pricing for a great healer.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

What you described about Bee is exactly what makes her special. Strength is part of it, of course, but many people are strong. What sets Bee apart is her ability to listen with her hands, follow the patterns of tension through the body, and work on the places that are actually causing the problem rather than just the places that hurt.

I'll make sure she reads your review. She rarely talks about her own skills, but she takes a lot of pride in helping people move and feel better, and I know your words will mean a lot to her 😊

We look forward to seeing you again, Mike.

reviews.name: Tyler Haugen
reviews.text:
Master = Flawless technique + Strength

There's a master in this house, and her name is BEE!

I'm sure she can tone down the strength, but my good people, hear me loud and clear... if you want deep "no pain, no gain" skilled therapeutic bliss that hurts so good, she's your healer! I'm 6'2 - 210lbs, and I was whincing in the most delicious pain, haha.

I've experienced several masters therapists around town, Bee is not to be missed. Gives your body full reset, by destroying your tightness/soreness in the way you dream about. Her work on my shoulders, clawing, thumb-laser digging, SQUEEZING... was exceptional and heavenly. She also identified the tightness in my hips, and laid into them proper with elbows, while twisted up in Thai massage pretzel greatness to expose the area. She worked with continued pressure, drilling into my muscle, head-to-toe. She knows where to dig into your muscular system, like Da Vinci paints clouds on the Sistine chapel, with artistic precision.

Ps. The place is clean, slightly out of the way 30 seconds - but definitely worth it. And another great thing, their massage tables had a hole for your face. Minor, but HUGE difference, and sort of rare for classic Thai beds. So that was also a win.

I caught myself laughing 40min into the massage, it was that good. I'm already looking forward to having Bee destroy my body again, in the best way.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much, Tyler. 🙏 Your review made all of us smile, especially Bee. 😊

We are delighted that Bee's therapeutic approach and strong pressure were exactly what you were looking for. Every body is different, and she always tries to identify the areas that need the most attention and then adapt the treatment to each guest individually. We are especially happy to hear that the work on your shoulders and hips brought you the deep release you were hoping for.

Bee has many years of experience in therapeutic bodywork and is also certified in Chinese therapeutic massage. In the past, she practiced Tui Na and Gua Sha treatments, and although our studio now offers only traditional Thai massage, her background in Chinese acupressure still influences her treatment style. This combination of traditional Thai techniques with focused acupressure often helps clients with shoulder tension, muscle tightness, and chronic stiffness.

Many guests who enjoy deep therapeutic massage appreciate her precise work, sustained pressure, and attention to problem areas. As you noticed, she enjoys finding the muscles that need the most work and treating them thoroughly.

Thank you also for mentioning our clean studio and the face openings on our massage tables. These small details can make a big difference during longer treatments, especially for guests receiving deep tissue or therapeutic massage.

It made us smile to hear that you found yourself laughing during the session. We truly appreciate your kind words, and Bee will be very happy to welcome you back whenever you are ready for another full-body reset.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Ealry Kim
reviews.text:
Absolutely one of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Chiang Mai. I did a 1.5-hour Thai foot massage with herbal balm for 500 THB, and it was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep during the session. The therapist was kind and attentive, and the pressure was just right.

After the massage, they served me warm tea and a little cookie—such a nice touch. What really moved me was that I asked about the herbal balm they used, and they kindly offered to give me one for free when the stock arrived the next day. Incredibly, they ended up finding a brand-new one and just gave it to me right away without charge. I was honestly so touched by their generosity and warmth.

The shop is clean, cozy, and just a 3-minute walk from Shangri-La Hotel (about 6–7 minutes from Astra). They also accept GLN (QR) payment, which was really convenient.

I finally understand why this place has so many Korean reviews—it really deserves the love. I’ll definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
얼리님, 정말 감사합니다! 🙏💕
이렇게 따뜻하고 자세한 후기를 남겨주셔서 진심으로 감사드려요. 1시간 반 동안 푹 주무시며 편안하게 쉬어가신 모습을 보니 저희도 정말 뿌듯했답니다.
허브 밤을 무료로 드릴 수 있어서 저희가 더 기뻤어요! 얼리님 같은 소중한 고객분께 작은 선물이라도 드리고 싶은 마음이었거든요. 😊
차이앙마이에서 많은 마사지샵 중에 저희를 선택해 주시고, 또 이런 소중한 후기까지 남겨주셔서 정말 고맙습니다. 
다음에 차이앙마이에 오시면 꼭 다시 들러주세요. 얼리님을 다시 뵐 수 있기를 기대하며, 항상 건강하시길 바랍니다! 💕 🇰🇷

reviews.name: Greg James
reviews.text: Simply the best massage shop in Chiang Mai and I’ve tried many in my 60 years of living!  Minnie is my favorite and she studied at Wat Po in BKK, so that’s as good of background as you can get and it shows!!!!  Just go now and feel the best massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words, Greg 🙏. We’re delighted Minnie gave you a rejuvenating Thai massage and helped lift the weight of the week. 💫 We’ll share your praise with her and look forward to welcoming you back for another full-body experience soon. 😊

reviews.name: Charlie Barfield
reviews.text: Both the foot and traditional Thai massages were excellent! Very friendly staff and great prices, great service.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Charlie, thank you for your review 🙏 And thanks for sharing the photo too, it’s always nice to see our place through a guest’s eyes 🙂  Friendly service and fair prices are something we work on every day, so it’s good to know you noticed ❤️

reviews.name: Lee Ringo
reviews.text: I tried this massage shop two days ago and I found the staff ( Manager - Bee in black and the owner in green)  all are very nice. As I am a very demanding person, I chatted with the Bee that I looked the best Masseur here. Bee introduced Dao (a young Thai girl in red as shown in the picture below) to me, and I have a 2-hour oil massage. Dao entertained all my requests, including the deep tissue massage for my right upper hand and shoulder. Her skills were very, very good. After having the oil massage for consecutive 2 days, I could feel my upper hand and shoulder were greatly improved. Although there is no pricey decoration, they have a warm atmosphere and good massage skills.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lee Ringo, thank you so much for your detailed and thoughtful review! 🌟 
Bee and I (Kunlarat "Dada" Kongchan, the owner) truly appreciate your kind words and trust in us to recommend the right therapist for your needs. Dao was delighted to know that her massage techniques helped relieve your shoulder and upper hand discomfort. 💥 She takes great pride in delivering excellent service, and feedback like yours is a testament to her skills. 

Creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere, even without extravagant decor, is one of our goals, and we're glad it resonated with you. We hope to see you again soon for more relaxing and therapeutic sessions! 🙏

reviews.name: Erra
reviews.text: My body merely a flesh dough for Beauty’s hands to knead, she targeted tension and tightness with precision and softness. Experienced a string of mid, painful massages before this, and it’s rare to be paired with somebody who has the talent for creating the chills of relief in another body. Only wish I had found this sooner as I came here my last day in chiang mai. Thank you, Beauty!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Erra 🙏 Beauty will be touched by your words — she may look gentle, but her hands truly work magic. We’re happy she could bring you real relief before you left Chiang Mai 💫

reviews.name: Brontë
reviews.text:
Had the best foot massage and the best neck/shoulder/back massage I have had so far after 4 months in Asia. Perfect intensity and got all my shoulder knots out ! Absolutely 10/10 for both massages! Lovely clean environment with enthusiastic and very talented staff!
Definitely go here ! 💛 :) xxx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Brontë, thank you for your wonderful feedback and photo!  🙏 
 We're so proud to hear that our team provided you with such exceptional foot and neck/shoulder/back massages. They're truly dedicated to their craft, and it makes us so happy to know they were able to help you. 🙂
We appreciate your 10/10 rating and hope you'll visit us again soon! 💛 :)

reviews.name: xiaobao yang
reviews.text: I came to this shop to do an hour foot massage. Wow! The massage was so soothing and cured all my knots and pains. The masseur LA even gave me a free shoulder massage! It was so good! I will definitely COME BACK AGAIN!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Xiaobao Yang, thank you for your review! 🙏 We are so glad to hear that your foot massage helped soothe those knots and pains. Addressing muscle tension is definitely our specialty, and Laa is particularly skilled at understanding muscle anatomy to provide the best relief. 😊

It was great to give you that extra relaxation for your shoulders, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! ✨

reviews.name: Nitay Levi
reviews.text: The massage was really really good and very strong. I’m like crushed now but in a good way, i’ve done many thai massages but this is the first one I feel it was amazing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ניטאי, תודה רבה על הפרגון! 🙏 שמחים מאוד לשמוע שאחרי כל כך הרבה עיסויים תאילנדיים, דווקא אצלנו הרגשת שמצאת משהו באמת מיוחד. הכי כיף בבית 😊 מחכים לך שוב בביקור הבא שלך בצ'יאנג מאי!

reviews.name: Beck Delude
reviews.text: Visited this spot twice because I enjoyed it so much! Lala did wonders for my lower back issues, I left feeling reborn. I appreciated how she really took time to focus on the areas I mentioned. Mindful, kind and consistent experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Beck, thank you so much for your glowing review and for sharing your experience with us! 

🙏We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visits and that Laa was able to help with your lower back issues—you left feeling reborn, and that’s exactly what we aim for! 😊 

Your kind words about Laa’s mindfulness and focus mean the world to us. We’ll be sure to pass along your compliments to her. We look forward to welcoming you back for another consistent and rejuvenating experience! 🌟

reviews.name: Chris Idle
reviews.text: Went here most days when we were staying in Chiang Mai.  Very relaxed and calm environment, friendly staff and an excellent massage each time.   Very much recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Chris, thank you for your review and photo! 🙏 It was a pleasure having you visit us so frequently during your time in Chiang Mai. 😊 We hope to see you again on your next trip! ✨

reviews.name: Eileen Pan
reviews.text:
I’ve had massages all over the world—from luxury spas in Koh Samui, Bali, Jakarta, and many other places—but this was honestly the best massage experience of my life.

What truly sets this place apart is their attention to detail, which is on a completely different level. From the booking process to the moment I left the spa, everything was seamless. I genuinely couldn’t find a single thing to complain about.

My therapist, Pancake, has absolute magic hands. I usually choose light pressure because I prefer gentle, relaxing massages, and she delivered exactly that. Her techniques were incredibly smooth, flowing, and consistent. It was one of the most relaxing massages I’ve ever experienced.

I’m also very sensitive to room temperature and comfort during massages. In many places, I end up feeling cold or notice that certain parts of my body aren’t properly covered, which really takes away from the experience. That never happened here. They were so attentive, constantly making sure I was warm and comfortable without me having to say a word. It honestly felt like they knew exactly what I needed before I did.

Everything—from the ambience, professionalism, and service to the massage itself—was 10/10.

I will 100% be coming back, and I’ll definitely be requesting Pancake again. She is absolutely amazing. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely appreciate you sharing such detailed and glowing feedback about your visit to our Oasis Spa Nimman. It brings us immense joy to know that your experience was one of the best you have ever had.

Our team strives to create a seamless and comfortable experience for every guest, so your comments about the room temperature and the attentiveness of our team are especially rewarding. We are delighted that Khun Pancake's technique provided the relaxing and consistent massage you were looking for.

We are truly honored by your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Valkyrie08
reviews.text:
Did 4 different spa/massages packages on different days. All were amazing, the voyage of Golden Lanna is the most unique one. Ayurveda was also my favourite.
They have an extensive wide range of spa and massages packages to choose. Online booking has 20% off and it’s easier for me to plan my days accordingly due to the long hrs package on some days.

Massage strength is just about right too for all. Therapists were all very friendly and make me feel at home the moment I step in.
Ambience and background music is also soothing. Their products are actually really good. Ocean breeze series is my favourite. Would be great if they come out travel pack series for the ocean breeze.
Overall it was an enjoyable and relaxing experience. Got a cute keychain gift too.
Thank you, will be back again next time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: WOW—what an incredible review to receive! We are truly delighted that you chose to experience several of our spa packages during your stay and that each visit left such a wonderful impression. It is especially rewarding to know that the Voyage of Golden Lanna and Ayurveda treatments became your favorites, and that you enjoyed our Ocean Breeze collection as well. Your thoughtful feedback means a great deal to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more memorable spa journeys on your next visit.

reviews.name: Betsy Robins
reviews.text: The best spa experience I have ever had! Oasis is truly one of a kind. I was picked up at my hotel ad a courtesy and met at the door by the lively ladies tha work there. As soon as I stepped in, I knew this was going to be a great experience. The room was gorgeous. Clean and it smelled amazing. The rooms had a private steam room, shower and soaking tub. The milk bath made me feel like a queen. The 4 handed massage was a game changer. Absolutely wonderful! I did try to book online, so I could receive a 20% discount but there was glitch. They honored it anyway! Thank you so much. I will return on my next holiday to Thailand ♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed account of your visit to Oasis Spa Nimman. We're delighted you appreciated all the details that go into the Oasis Spa experience, including the private in-room amenities. Our goal is to create a perfect sanctuary for relaxation, and we are so glad we succeeded. It is wonderful to hear you plan to visit us again, and we can't wait to welcome you back.

reviews.name: Aries bubu
reviews.text: This is my third visit here, and I tried the Deep Calm Recovery treatment today. It was absolutely amazing! Therapists Jammie and Bow are incredibly skilled. And Jemmie perfectly targeted all the pressure points exactly as I requested, with gentle yet effective touches. They did the entire massage purely with their hands, which must have been tiring, but they maintained great pressure throughout. I feel totally relaxed and refreshed after the session. Their foot massage technique is particularly unique and so soothing. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing and refreshing experience with us and that Jammie and Bow provided the skilled, gentle, and effective treatment you were hoping for. It’s especially rewarding to know that their hand and foot massage techniques stood out and helped make your visit so memorable. We truly appreciate your kind support and look forward to welcoming you back again for another session of pure relaxation.

reviews.name: Cecilia
reviews.text: Great experience. The place is clean, calm, and very professional. The therapist really knew what they were doing, perfect pressure and very relaxing. No pushy upselling, just a genuinely good massage. Would definitely come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your beautiful review has truly made our day. We are thrilled that you found your experience to be professional and relaxing. It brings us great joy to know that you appreciated the calm ambiance and the quality of the massage, without any sense of pressure. We are grateful for your support and can't wait to provide you with another exceptional experience on your next visit.

reviews.name: Kym Cura
reviews.text: Availed the 1 hour aromatherapy promotion on their website for 899 baht! Love how professional and courteous the staff are! Had an amazing massage as well. Complimentary mango sticky rice after the massage. Best massage I got in Chiang Mai
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a wonderful review to read! We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the Aromatherapy Massage and found our team to be professional and courteous. It is especially rewarding to hear that the complimentary mango sticky rice was a delightful surprise. Thank you for choosing Oasis Spa and for sharing your kind feedback. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: MAYLY LIFE
reviews.text: A nice, relaxing place in the heart of Nimmanhaemin, Chiang Mai. It’s clean, smells great, and the massage is very professional. My therapist James was really good, with perfect pressure. The room is spacious and beautiful, and the music is relaxing. After the massage, they served warm tea and mango sticky rice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review. It's a pleasure to know that you enjoyed the beautiful, spacious room and the relaxing music, which are all part of the tranquil experience we strive to provide. We're especially glad that your therapist, James, contributed to making your visit memorable. Thank you for your high praise. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you again in the future.

reviews.name: WatchaB
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with Oasis spa.
I went to Lanna Oasis in Prasign (CNX) once before and It was great.

Today I came to Nimman brunch for Aromatherapy hot oil. Warm greeting from stuff, from start and everyone was very attentive.
My Therapist “Calla” (เคล่า) did amazing massage.

Very satisfied. Best service and worth the price.  I couldn’t recommend this place enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback about your experiences at Oasis Spa! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed both our Lanna and Nimman branches, and that Khun Cayla provided such an amazing aromatherapy massage experience. Your kind words about our staff's warm greeting and attentive service mean a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa journey soon!

reviews.name: TzeHsiung Wong
reviews.text:
Had a splendid time here. Biggest thanks to BOOM who made it happened for me, she had to check back and forth for me for about 30 minutes to find out if I could get a customized packaged and in the end I was able to get it at a specific time that I wanted, despite a very short notice. She also booked me a private pickup service.

Then also many thanks to MERIS the therapist, she has such great attention to details that I don't think she missed any of the muscles group, and despite her small frame, she was able to deliver a very strong pressure just like how I have expected it, if not more.

Finally, I was attended by FAIRY who gave me a souvenir of a mini Thai herbal compress and sent me off to the return trip to my hotel.

The spa also provided me a pickup & return service.

If anyone is in Chiang Mai and looking for a luxurious treatment, you have to come to this spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Reading your wonderful review was truly a joy—thank you for sharing such a thoughtful experience with us. We are absolutely delighted to hear that you had such a splendid time.

Your kind recognition of BOOM, MERIS, and FAIRY means a great deal to us, and we will be sure to share your compliments with them. It is especially rewarding to know that every detail, from the personalized arrangement to the treatment itself, met your expectations so beautifully.

We are truly grateful for your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional visit.

reviews.name: Li Ying Chan
reviews.text: Oasis Spa Nimman has a sleek and clean interior. All the staff are professional. Reception staff, Fairy and Arthii, are both very patient and clear with their communication in English. Contact staff Sam was very prompt in replying to my emails and has a good command of English too. Masseur provides good service as well. A good experience overall, especially with the post-spa mango sticky rice and complimentary transport.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you sharing such a glowing review of your visit Oasis Spa at Nimman. It is a pleasure to know that you found our staff to be professional and our communication to be clear and patient. Our goal is to create a seamless and tranquil experience from beginning to end, and we are thrilled that you enjoyed the complimentary transport and our signature mango sticky rice. Your feedback is a wonderful acknowledgment of the high standards we strive to maintain. We hope to have the pleasure of your company again in the near future.

reviews.name: James Runkel (JIM)
reviews.text:
Absolutely 💯 the best spa experience i have had.  2hrs of 4 hand massage was just next level
We did a couples room and 4 ppl took care of us from head to toe all while being very professional.  Room was beautifully setup and everything was there (showers etc)
They were very precise and made sure we got our full 2h. Highly recommend this experience
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re truly honored by your wonderful feedback. Knowing that your four-hand couples massage was the best spa experience you’ve had means so much to our team. We’re delighted that the professionalism, beautifully prepared room, and attentive care throughout the full two hours made your visit so memorable. Thank you for your high recommendation and we look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

reviews.text: I booked the body scrub + hot oil massage for my birthday and it was the best decision. Everyone at the facility is extremely attentive and welcoming. The massage room had one of the best showers I’ve had in Thailand with a private bathroom. The entire experience was very relaxing- the best choice for my birthday! I even got a free birthday souvenir. Thank you for making my birthday special! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a beautiful way to celebrate a birthday! We're absolutely delighted to hear that you chose to spend your birthday with us and that the body scrub and hot oil massage was the best decision. It brings us immense joy to know that our team at the Oasis Spa Nimman, made you feel welcome and that you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere of our facilities, right down to the private shower. We are so glad the birthday souvenir added a special touch to your celebration. We look forward to welcoming you back for another special and relaxing experience soon!

reviews.name: Ria Limjap
reviews.text: Lovely space, serene and welcoming. The treatments were world-class, featuring the best in Thai spa traditions. And the sticky mango rice at the end is a nice treat!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your glowing 5-star review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the serene and welcoming ambiance of our spa and that the treatments met your expectations.
