reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly grateful for your positive feedback. We’re delighted to hear that your visit to Oasis Spa Nimman was a fantastic one, from the clean environment to the comfortable massage and friendly service. We’re delighted to know that the airport service, peaceful ambiance, and quality of your massage all met your expectations so perfectly. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing such a wonderful review of your Coconut package experience at Oasis Spa Nimman! We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating spa journey in Chiang Mai!

Best ever!!!!

Definitely will be coming back and I give it my highest recommendation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your amazing 5-star review!  We're truly delighted that you experienced such deep relaxation at Oasis Spa Nimman. reviews.name: Kim McKillop
reviews.text: Had an amazing 2 hour - 4 hands massage. I can't recommend Oasis Spa highly enough.  Last year we visited their other branch near Wat Pra Singh. Both venues are beautiful with a relaxing ambience. Also, both locations have staff who are experienced, thoughtful, and attentive.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly grateful for your glowing recommendation and for choosing to visit us again in Chiang Mai. It's a pleasure to know that you enjoyed the ambiance and the high standard of service at both our Nimman and Lanna locations. Our team is delighted that their thoughtful and attentive care contributed to your amazing experience. Your continued support means the world to us, and it reinforces our commitment to providing an exceptional spa journey for every guest. We can't wait to have the opportunity to welcome you back.

reviews.name: Sakanang Noon
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at Oasis Spa at Nimman. Ms. Apple was professional, attentive, and very skilled. She made me feel comfortable throughout the treatment, and I left feeling relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend her and the spa!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It is always a joy to receive such positive feedback! We are delighted to know that Ms. Apple provided professional and skilled care, leaving you feeling relaxed and comfortable during your visit to our Oasis Spa at Nimman. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Hernan Berrazueta
reviews.text: From the moment you enter the spa, the staff warmly welcomes you and offers you tea. The entire experience was very comfortable, respectful, and the staff was very kind. The massage was excellent and deeply relaxing. At the end, they even gave me some delicious mango sticky rice!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your wonderful experience at Oasis Spa Nimman. We are absolutely delighted to hear that you felt warmly welcomed from the moment you arrived and that our staff's kindness made your visit so comfortable and respectful. It brings us great joy to know that you enjoyed the deeply relaxing massage and the special treat of mango sticky rice. Your kind words are the greatest compliment, and we will be sure to share your feedback with our team. We look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you back for another excellent experience soon.

title: Antique Massage ( Wualai walking street branch Chiangmai)
ownerDescription:
We are pleased to introduce the second branch of Antique Massage and Salon on Wualai Walking Street — a vibrant cultural landmark in Chiang Mai. While our original location
This new branch offers a refined experience that blends modern elegance with the soothing rituals of hair-washing massage. Guests are invited to enjoy a tranquil setting thoughtfully designed to enhance relaxation and well-being.

Exclusively available at this location, our signature head massage is a uniquely developed technique that delivers a profound sense of calm and clarity. Through expertly applied pressure and carefully choreographed movements, this treatment goes beyond relaxation
address: 32-34 Wua Lai Rd, Tambon Hai Ya, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXJP+5M Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Jane Shin
reviews.text:
Me and my family had signature head spa at Antique.

If you stay in 5 km from this place, they offer you a free ride back and forth.

There were zero delay and head spa was amazing and so so relaxing.
After all the treatment, my hair felt like silk.

I would recommend this place for anyone who are looking magnificent experience

reviews.name: Shaula T
reviews.text: Friend and I came for their 90min combo set of Thai Massage + Foot Massage. The premise is very bright and clean. Felt wonderful after the session. The service was also excellent. We were well taken care of and felt so pampered. Intending to return every day until we leave Chiangmai.

reviews.name: Taylor Kiehm
reviews.text: Had such a lovely 75 minute signature head massage and wash here! I wasn’t expecting a full hair blow out too! The atmosphere is lovely here and calming as soon as you walk in. You get young coconut to start and tea and sweet treat to end. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: BaBas Benz
reviews.text:
I found this place while walking past the Saturday Night Market and decided to give it a try  and I’m so glad I did! The shop looks very professional and extremely clean, which already gave a great first impression.

They welcomed me with coconut water before the treatment, and after finishing they served tea with dried mango, which was such a lovely touch and made the whole experience feel very special.

I had the scalp treatment done by P’Bua and it was amazing. Her technique is unique and very relaxing I honestly felt so refreshed afterwards. You can tell she’s very skilled and experienced.

Definitely recommend Antique Massage to anyone looking for a quality and relaxing treatment. Just make sure you book at least one day in advance because they are very busy!

reviews.name: Kasey Beard
reviews.text:
From the moment you get here, you would think you were in a 5 star resort spa. The ladies are so welcoming and the price is very reasonable. Complete with a welcome drink and choose you're own scent for your massage. Ending woth a tea & dried banana as well as a complimentary relaxation balm.
They really have thought of everything here.
Thank you!

reviews.name: Madison Root
reviews.text: I got the coconut scrub and oil massage (90 min) and it was hands-down, the best spy experience I’ve had so far in Southeast Asia. Everyone was very professional kind, and the service was amazing. My therapist worked on my extremely tight back and shoulders. I appreciated her intuitive touch to what my body needed. I had never had a scrub like this before and I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Svenja Stapper
reviews.text:
Really lovely and relaxing experience! I booked a back, shoulder and head massage 2h before and was greeted with a refreshing coconut on my arrival. After filling out a little questionnaire about body condition/ type of pressure, my feet were scrubbed and cleaned, which I really appreciated after walking outside. I received a very gentle massage by Ann and would totally recommend her: very cute, funny, speaks English very well and made me feel comfortable. You can choose out of 3 balms to use instead of oil and I have to say, I didn’t miss the noise the oil pump bottles make next to my ear on the table :)
After almost falling asleep because it was soooo good, I could enjoy yet another beverage- hot tea - and a dried mango bite. Total bliss this place and I am very grateful to have found it!
Extra tip: there have a happy hour :) check in out!

reviews.name: Maria Badiola
reviews.text: I had the Cloud Wash Basic head spa (60 min) and it was a very relaxing experience. The scalp massage with oils, hair wash and the gentle water stream combined with arm and hand massage felt amazing. The staff were very kind and attentive, and they even offered coconut water, tea with dried banana and a small relaxing balm at the end. Highly recommended! I will come back!

reviews.name: Georgina Barry
reviews.text: Beautiful experience from start to finish. Very aesthetic spa. We were greeted and given some coconut water whilst we chose what massage and oils we wanted. Didn't feel rushed at all. The massage was lovely, was able to choose pressure and heat level for the bed. There was also an add on for 30 min extra on any area for just 60 baht. Soooo relaxing that I fell asleep. Had tea and sweets after and got to choose a massage balm to take home. 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Malgorzata K.
reviews.text: The place is very aesthetic and calming, with soft lighting and simple, tasteful decor that makes it easy to relax as soon as you walk in. The service was excellent and the staff were friendly and professional. The massage itself was very good. The therapist checked in about pressure and focused on the areas that needed the most attention. I left feeling relaxed and refreshed. I would definitely recommend this salon if you are looking for a quality massage in a nice, peaceful setting. Gosia

reviews.name: Lorenz Pata
reviews.text:
I chose a deep tissue massage, hoping it would help with my tight hips and back pain.

I was treated by Mint, who did an absolutely amazing job. She is very professional and identified the areas where I was experiencing the most tension and pain. It felt like she really understood exactly where my problem zones were and focused on them with the right amount of pressure.

During the massage, she was communicative without talking too much, which created a very comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. She also made a few jokes from time to time, which added a personal touch and made the experience even more enjoyable.

The entire salon has a very professional ambiance and makes you feel welcome!

Overall, it was an excellent experience, and I would highly recommend Mint and this massage salon to anyone looking for a high-quality massage.

reviews.name: Jo L
reviews.text:
Clean environment.
I recommend - Don’t trust many comments here.
Maybe can try once, no need to come again, there are thousands spa massages in chiang mai, you got lots of choices, to explore …

Therapist skill are very different, some good some bad.
Sometimes is about luck, if you ask me the massage is good or not, mainly depends on the therapist has enough massage skill set and good english communication skill ?
Is not about how good decoration you make it in the reception.
Not all therapists speak good English, even the receptionist told her what to do before the treatment started, she still did the wrong massage on my husband, she doesn’t listen, really bad experience

reviews.name: Lis Hotel Chiangmai
reviews.text: Happy head spa massage. Staff is super helpful and nice . My hair has been beautiful done. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jonathan Van Haeften
reviews.text:
Really recommend anyone wanting to get a great massage. Was looked after as soon as we walked in the door.
I had the hot oil massage and my friend got the Lotion massage and she didn’t stop talking about it as she loved it.
Then they offered to drive us back to our hotel.

reviews.name: rachayapor
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Antique Massage Chiangmai - Garden House Branch. The atmosphere is calm, clean, and beautifully decorated, giving a very relaxing “Lanna garden” vibe from the moment you walk in.

The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. They made me feel comfortable right away and explained the treatment clearly. My massage therapist was very professional, skilled, and attentive to the right pressure throughout the session. You can truly tell they are experienced.

It was one of the nicest massages I’ve had in Chiang Mai - relaxing, therapeutic, and worth every minute. I left feeling refreshed and completely stress-free.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a professional and relaxing massage experience in Chiang Mai. I will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Merlin Maier
reviews.text: We had an absolutely amazing experience! The staff was very friendly, the atmosphere was relaxing, and the massage was highly professional. We felt comfortable and well taken care of from the very beginning. We will definitely come back – highly recommended!

reviews.name: viktorija zieniute
reviews.text: Massage was amazing. We took Thai massage with oil and it was really strong. They served us fresh coconut before the massage, warm tea after massage and we even got little gifts (tiger balm) in the end. Highly recommend 😍

reviews.name: Germaine Goh
reviews.text: Lovely place! The decor is super clean and luxurious, makes you feel calm. Service was very friendly and thoughtful, with a hotel (or wherever) pickup and drop off, fresh coconut water to start, and a little snack and chrysanthemum tea at the end. You get to choose the scent for the massage. My masseuse Nok was lovely too, giving me feedback about my tight arms without me asking (: and being very careful and gentle with my shoulder after I told her about its injury. Her pressure was tough after I requested for it, it felt very good!

reviews.name: Richa Bryant
reviews.text:
✨ I had such a relaxing experience here!
The massage room was very spacious, clean, and private, which made me feel completely comfortable from the start. The atmosphere was calm and peaceful, perfect for unwinding.

The therapist was amazing – the pressure was just right, firm yet gentle, leaving me refreshed and energized after the session.

If you’re looking for a place that’s quiet, professional, and truly rejuvenating, I highly recommend this spot. 🌿💆‍♀️

reviews.name: Michaela Ťureková
reviews.text: A very good experience with the hair spa. Treatment was super relaxing and everything was made comfortable and nice. The environment was very cozy, reception and treatment room beautiful. From the entrance the staff was extremely kind and helpful. I had made some arrangements so they changed my plan and adjusted everything to my liking. The lady doing my treatment was very professional and skilled. Left the spa super happy with a beautiful hair. Recommend to everyone!

title: Sarinya Thai Massage for Health

reviews.name: sihan lin
reviews.text: "Just had the most amazing Thai massage! The therapist was super skilled—her hands knew exactly where all my knots were. The stretching felt intense but so satisfying, and I walked out feeling like a brand-new person. The shop had a calming vibe with gentle music and the scent of lemongrass in the air. Honestly, if you’re in Thailand and skip a massage, you’re missing out!"

We’re thrilled to hear that you had such an amazing Thai massage experience and that our therapist was able to help relieve your tension and leave you feeling refreshed. We’re also delighted that you enjoyed our calming atmosphere and the scent of lemongrass. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you back again! 💚

reviews.name: Asher-dee Lavoie
reviews.text: I have been to a few massage places on Thonglor but this is the most authentic and professional by far. I had a 60 min foot massage and it was amazing!! Great technique and included the lower leg, some pressure points on upper leg and a bit of arms, shoulder, neck, head and back. This is the one place on the whole soi that I would return to and next time would like to try the traditional Thai massage. Nice little cup of bael tea after. Highly and fully recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely feedback. We’re happy to hear you enjoyed the foot massage and the overall experience. We truly look forward to seeing you again. 🤍

reviews.name: Tasnim Hossan
reviews.text:
Amazing ambience , they are very nice and listen to
Your need. I always come here , yearly
10/15 times whenever I visit bkk . My absolute favourite place /
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review and continued support. We are truly honored to be your favorite place in Bangkok and delighted to know that you visit us so often whenever you are in the city. It means a lot to us that you appreciate our atmosphere and that our team is able to meet your needs. Your loyalty and kind words are the greatest encouragement for us. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok. 🙏✨

reviews.name: Jack
reviews.text:
Full body massage was so uncomfortable. The room is cramped and strong industrial air-con is blasting down in your face for an hour. I could barely see anything in the room due to bad lighting, and there was almost no space to even get undressed

The masseuse didn’t ask about strength so just went immediately to maximum, severely injuring my arms and upper body. I just got home from the massage and can already feel cramping, some bruising and aching all over my body.

The massage was rushed and without any structure, She started on my lower back then grabbed my arms, then my neck, then legs, then my back again - which made me unable to fully relax and I was on edge the whole time. It was just so random. When I asked her not so strong she didn’t understand me, then laughed uncontrollably when she heard me wince with pain. Honestly at one point she cracked my arm so bad that I thought it could have been fractured

I have been here 3 times (2 foot massages and one full body) and today really confirmed that this place isn’t great. There are so many better places in Thong Lor. I really don’t recommend this place

reviews.name: Lam Yet
reviews.text: Very professional massage skills with an excellent atmosphere with relaxing music. I fell asleep during the massage. And it's cheap as well
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed our professional massage service and relaxing atmosphere. We’re especially happy to know that you felt so comfortable and relaxed during your treatment. We truly appreciate your kind words and are glad you found our service to be great value for money. We look forward to welcoming you back again! 💚

reviews.name: Apple Yellow
reviews.text: Nicest place on thonglor , relaxed and quiet . Definitely best massage ❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We’re truly grateful for your support and are glad you had such a relaxing experience with us. We can’t wait to welcome you back again. 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: Clea Conner
reviews.text: Best massage my husband and I have found in Thailand. We had the extended Thai massage and both of our masseuses were excellent, super experienced and professional. Worked around various injuries and really spent time on problem areas. Lovely clean rooms, facilities on every floor (it’s an entire building) with tea at the end. Would love to go back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re delighted to hear that you and your husband enjoyed the extended Thai massage and found our therapists professional and attentive.
We’re glad you appreciated our clean facilities, and we would love to welcome you back again. 🤍

reviews.name: Pratyush Singh
reviews.text: I came here for foot neck head shoulder massage and was pleasantly surprised by how good it was. The masseuse was extremely professional and understood the parts that needed more attention. Will definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback and kind recommendation! 🤍 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your foot, neck, head, and shoulder massage. We’re especially happy that our therapist was able to focus on the areas you needed most. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you again soon! 😊✨

reviews.name: Liliia Khrystiuk
reviews.text: Place is clean and well taken care of. But a 90 minute Thai massage unfortunately was one of the worst I’ve had. The masseuse was not very skilled unfortunately, I didn’t get any relief in my back at all, as she did not even try to find problematic areas, but just kept randomly pressing here and there. It finished with 30 minutes of head massage that didn’t even make sense. Also the room was very cold w out h air blowing directly into my face, so all in all, very disappointing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your detailed feedback. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.

We’re pleased to hear that you found our place clean and well maintained. However, we sincerely apologize that your massage experience did not meet your expectations, as this is not the standard of service we strive to provide.

Your comments regarding the therapist’s technique, room temperature, and overall experience are very important to us, and we will address them with our team for immediate improvement.

Please note that your comfort is our top priority. If at any time during the treatment you feel uncomfortable or unsatisfied, you are always welcome to inform our staff and request a change of therapist immediately. Our team will be more than happy to assist you.

We truly hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with a much better and more relaxing experience. 🙏🤍

reviews.name: Clay A
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this place while walking around Thong lor.  Ladies sitting outside gave me a business card.  Reached out via What'sApp Friday and able to be seen same day.

I don't necessarily think an appointment is needed far in advance.  However, I would reach out and inquire about availability.

After entering, I took off my shoes and employee washed my feet; bamboo flipflops provided.

Requested a 60-minute Thai Massage (300 THB).  When getting a massage, you'll walk upstairs to the floor above.  An outfit is provided for you to change into.  I was concerned this wouldn't fit me as I'm plus size, but I made it work.  FYI - only a curtain will separate you from another client.  Also, if someone is walking by, you'll be visible.

The lights were kept low and for the most part noise (as it's off a busy street) was kept to a minimum.  You will hear cars from the street, but it wasn't loud enough to disrupt my massage.

Absolutely enjoyed my Thai Massage!  I didn't get her name, but she did an amazing job.  Firm pressure and the whole 60 minutes were utilized!

Highly recommend if you're in the Thong Lor area!

reviews.name: Posi0n 2G Xue
reviews.text: It's a great place to relax. The chef's skills are excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words. We’re delighted that you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and the chef’s skills. We hope to welcome you again . 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: David Chau
reviews.text: My top massage choice in Thonglor, Bangkok! I visit Sarinya Health Massage 2–3 times a week and have been consistently impressed. The facility is spotless and well‑maintained, and the staff are professional, friendly, and attentive. They now even recognize me when I arrive—it really feels like a personalized experience. With skilled therapists, a calm atmosphere, and great value, this place is my reliable go‑to. Highly recommend for anyone seeking quality massage in a clean, welcoming environment.

hotelDescription:
Set on the Ping River, this opulent spa resort with rich Lanna-style wooden carvings is a 14-minute walk from the lively  Nong Hoi Market and 18 km from the landmark Wat Phra That Doi Suthep.
 Featuring balconies and earthy tones, colonial-chic rooms offer free Wi-Fi, rainfall showers and flat-screens. Suites add 4-poster beds and separate living/dining areas; 1 has a pool, and a 2-suite duplex is available. There's 24/7 room service, and children under 12 stay free.
 There’s an all-you can eat Brazilian BBQ, a wine bar, and an open-air riverside restaurant, plus a spa, an infinity pool and a gym. Thai cooking classes are available.

reviews.name: slw_global
reviews.text:
An exceptional experience from start to finish. The property is incredibly serene and peaceful, with attentive staff who strike the perfect balance between being helpful and giving guests their space.
The location is truly special, with direct access to the Ping River and a private pier, creating a unique atmosphere that is difficult to find elsewhere in Chiang Mai. Breakfast was excellent, offering both a well-executed buffet and à la carte options.
A special mention goes to Kik (if I remember his name correctly), who provided outstanding service in the restaurant and made our stay even more memorable. The complimentary shuttle service to the Night Bazaar and Walking Street was also a thoughtful and convenient touch.
My only recommendation would be to avoid discounting rates too aggressively during low season. Part of this property's appeal is its peaceful atmosphere and mature clientele. Maintaining a certain level of pricing helps preserve the overall guest experience and ensures the hotel continues to attract visitors who appreciate the tranquility and character of the property.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you very much for your thoughtful and generous review.

We are truly delighted to learn that your stay at RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai was an exceptional experience from start to finish. It is especially rewarding to know that you appreciated the peaceful atmosphere of the resort, our riverside location, and the attentive yet discreet service provided by our team.

We are pleased that you enjoyed our unique setting along the Ping River, including the private pier, which offers guests a distinctive experience and connection to the rich cultural heritage of Chiang Mai. It is also wonderful to hear that our breakfast selection, featuring both buffet and à la carte options, met your expectations.

Your special recognition of Kik is greatly appreciated. We will be delighted to share your kind words with him, as team members who create memorable experiences for our guests deserve to be recognized and celebrated.

We are also glad that you found our complimentary shuttle service to the Night Bazaar and Walking Street convenient and beneficial during your stay.

Thank you as well for your thoughtful observation regarding pricing and the overall guest experience. We genuinely appreciate your perspective and your understanding of the unique atmosphere that defines our resort. Maintaining a tranquil environment and delivering a quality experience for our guests will always remain at the heart of what we do.

Your kind words and valuable feedback mean a great deal to us. We sincerely hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai for another memorable stay in the future.

Warm regards,

The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Droll_Pineapple2014
reviews.text: It's been three years, but the team remembered me, so it was nice to be back. I really like the location on the Ping River, adjacent to a little bridge that you can walk over and get to the Old Town via the night market. It's also a short hop from the railway station and close to some good places to eat, e.g., the Riverside. There are a whole cluster of little cafes opposite the Ringpin supermarket (the go-to place for ex-pats), which is 40m up the road. It works hard for its 3 stars with a good breakfast, spotlessly clean rooms, and communal facilities. The owner has green fingers and their gardens are obviously well-tended. The scent of jasmine as I walked back to my room at night was delicious.

reviews.name: Bant Al-Falahi
reviews.text:
We are couple from United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪 we come to our honeymoon.

The Good
The hotel is very clean. The room was beautiful and comfortable for us.

The Bad
However, the some of reception staff was very bad and not polite. When my husband asked them for help, they laughed at him. It felt like they were making fun of us. This is very disrespectful

Also, when we asked about breakfast food timings, the receptionist said "We don't have halal food!! They were not helpful at all.

But when we went to look, there was plenty of food we could eat, like bread, vegetables, cheese, yogurt, and tea.
Also, we told them clearly’ Do not let anyone enter our room when we are out. But when we came back, we found that someone entered our room. We were shocked. This is a big problem for our privacy.

Conclusion
The hotel is beautiful, but the bad service ruined our honeymoon. The manager must teach the staff how to respect guests.( respect to all Nationalities)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Baat Al-Falahi,

Thank you very much for choosing to stay with us during your honeymoon and for taking the time to share your detailed feedback.

We are pleased to hear that you found the hotel beautiful and that you enjoyed the food, including the fresh bread, vegetables, cheese, yogurt, and tea. We are also glad that our team was able to assist with your room issue and arrange another room for you.

At the same time, please accept our sincere apologies for the aspects of your stay that did not meet expectations, particularly the service experience you described at reception and the concern regarding breakfast information. This is certainly not the warm and respectful hospitality we aim to provide, and your comments have been shared with our management team for immediate review and further training.

We truly regret that these moments affected your honeymoon experience. Your feedback is very important to us, and we will use it to improve our service consistency and ensure a better experience for our guests in the future.

Thank you once again for your valuable comments. We sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a more comfortable and memorable stay.

Warm regards,
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: This was a great stay for a family with little kids. Breakfast had a lot of variety but wasn't anything special - basic buffet style. I wish there were more Thai options.

reviews.name: Vilma Valancauskaite
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful one-week stay at RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort while recovering from a leg injury, and it truly felt like being with family. Everything was exceptional — the beautiful pool, peaceful garden, river views, well-equipped gym, and especially the warm and caring staff who made my stay so comfortable and relaxing.

The room, terrace, and bathroom were all very spacious, beautifully designed, and thoughtfully decorated. The entire hotel has a charming and elegant atmosphere that makes you feel calm the moment you arrive. It was the perfect place to slow down, rest, and recover.

Thank you to everyone at the hotel for such a memorable and caring experience. I would happily return again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for your heartfelt and beautiful review.

We are truly touched to know that your one-week stay at RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai brought you comfort, relaxation, and a feeling of being cared for like family during your recovery.

It means a great deal to us that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere, beautiful pool, gardens, riverside setting along the Ping River, fitness facilities, and especially the warmth and attentiveness of our team.

We are also delighted that the spacious room, terrace, and bathroom helped create the perfect environment for you to rest and recover comfortably.

Your kind words about the charm and calming atmosphere of the resort are deeply appreciated by all of us.

Thank you once again for allowing us to be part of your healing journey in Chiang Mai. We sincerely look forward to welcoming you back again for another peaceful and memorable stay.

Warm regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Shane Emilie
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at RatiLanna Resort & Spa in Chiang Mai. The riverside setting offers a peaceful and tranquil atmosphere, perfect for relaxation. The room was clean, spacious, and beautifully designed, with a touch of luxury that made the experience even more special. We truly appreciated the complimentary room upgrade.

The service was exceptional throughout—special thanks to Ying, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful during our stay. All the staff were equally courteous and welcoming.

I also enjoyed the delicious food and a refreshing Tom Yum cocktail by the pool—definitely a highlight!

I highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for privacy, tranquility, and great value for money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review and for choosing to stay at RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai.

We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful riverside setting and found your stay relaxing and memorable. It is especially rewarding to know that you appreciated the comfort, cleanliness, and design of your room, as well as the complimentary upgrade.

Your kind words about our service mean a great deal to us. We are particularly grateful for your recognition of Ying — she will be absolutely delighted to know she made a positive impact on your stay. Your compliments will be shared with our entire team.

It is also a pleasure to hear that you enjoyed the culinary experience, especially the Tom Yum cocktail by the pool  a perfect way to relax and soak in the atmosphere.

Thank you for your generous recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back for another tranquil and memorable stay in the near future.

Warm regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.name: April Yap
reviews.text:
We chose this place primarily because of the pool - we wanted one long enough to actually do laps in, and it was great!

For those who intend to walk around town and want to be near the Old City or near the night market or things like that, this is not the ideal location. You will have to book a vehicle to get to those places. But this was fine with us. We wanted a pool, a massage, and long afternoon naps. This place delivered in spades.

The staff was very friendly. When they said breakfast would be ready at 6AM it was. Massage was good. Really a great spot for "getting away from it all." But yes, I can imagine if there was a big occasion while there it would be a bother.

We have two small details though that were a little bothersome. First was the height of the bathroom sink faucet. It was such that everytime you tried to wash your hands or brush your teeth, the water would splash all over the place. Second was that there was only one towel hook, very strange. But both are easily addressed.

Recommended, yes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you very much for sharing such a thoughtful and detailed review. We are delighted that our swimming pool, relaxing massages, peaceful surroundings, breakfast service, and the warm hospitality of our team provided exactly the restful getaway you were seeking.

We also appreciate your comments regarding our location. While we are situated a short drive from Chiang Mai’s Old City and Night Bazaar, many guests value the tranquillity of our riverside setting as a peaceful retreat from the city.

Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience caused by the height of the bathroom faucet and the limited number of towel hooks. We truly appreciate these practical observations and will share them with our management and engineering teams for review and improvement.

Thank you once again for recommending us. We hope to welcome you back for more leisurely swims, relaxing afternoons, and another memorable stay in Chiang Mai.

Warm regards,
Hotel Management Team

reviews.name: Dan A
reviews.text: Had a very enjoyable stay here. Initially had some issues with the room type booked through Agoda, but staff worked hard to be very accommodating. Room was clean, spacious, comfortable. Pool was spacious and the food poolside was good quality. Overall would highly recommend!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dan A,

Thank you very much for sharing your review and for giving us a 5-star rating. We are delighted to hear that you had a very enjoyable stay with us.

We also appreciate your understanding regarding the initial room type issue with your booking through Agoda, and we are pleased that our team was able to assist and accommodate you during your stay. It is wonderful to know that you enjoyed the clean and spacious room, comfortable bed, pool area, and the quality of our food.

Your recommendation means a great deal to us, and we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai again soon.

Warm regards,
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Allyson De La Housaye
reviews.text:
We had the best stay here as a part of our honeymoon. Every interaction we had with staff was so kind. We particularly loved the folks at breakfast. We were lucky enough to receive a room upgrade and our room was beautiful. The pool area was gorgeous and the most relaxing place to hang out after a morning of exploring.

While a little bit off the beaten path, there are some great food options within walking distance and getting a car via Grab was easy and affordable!

I wish I had taken more pictures of the space, but do have a couple photos of lovely breakfast.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Congratulations once again on your honeymoon, and thank you for choosing RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai to celebrate such a special occasion.

We are truly honored to have been part of your memorable journey and delighted to hear that you had the best stay with us. Your kind words about our team — especially our breakfast staff — mean so much. We will be sure to share your appreciation with them.

It is wonderful to know that you enjoyed the room upgrade, the beauty of your accommodation, and the relaxing atmosphere of our pool area after your mornings exploring Chiang Mai. Creating a peaceful retreat for our guests is exactly what we strive for.

We also appreciate your thoughtful comments about the location and accessibility. We are pleased that you found convenient dining options nearby and that transportation around the city was easy and affordable.

Thank you again for your heartfelt review. We hope to welcome you back in the future — perhaps for an anniversary celebration — to create even more beautiful memories together.

Warmest regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Global Citizen
reviews.text:
It is a grand property in terms of the rooms, the pool and other facilities. But when it comes to their staff it is bit on the rougher side. When we checked in we were so rushed by the staff and had to run with him, who spoke as if he is going to miss his flight. And did pass some comments as we are interracial couple.
Then in the breakfast they were overly polite to my gf who is of Asian decent but me being of the brown decent was utterly ignored and talked rudely to even in front of my gf. Clear sign of showing disrespect to a whole community and contrasting by showing extra respect to the other.
Definitely won’t recommend any of the brown friends to stay at this property!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

While we appreciate your positive comments regarding our rooms, swimming pool, and facilities, we are deeply concerned and sincerely sorry to learn about your experience with our service team.

At RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai, we are committed to treating every guest with respect and genuine hospitality regardless of nationality, ethnicity or gender. The experience you have described does not reflect the values we uphold, nor the standards of service we strive to provide.

We sincerely apologize if any interaction during your check-in or breakfast service made you feel unwelcome, uncomfortable, or disrespected. We understand how upsetting such an experience can be, and we deeply regret the negative impression it left on you and your partner.

Your comments have been taken very seriously and will be shared with our management team for careful review and internal investigation. Feedback of this nature is extremely important to us, as it helps ensure that all guests receive the respectful and inclusive service they deserve.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the disappointment caused during your stay. We regret that we did not provide the warm and welcoming experience that every guest should expect from our resort.

Warm regards,

The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Noureen Wadhwaniya
reviews.text:
The rooms were spacious and functional, several aspects of the experience did not meet the expectations of a 5-star hotel.

The bathroom layout lacks a separation between the bath and toilet, making the space difficult to share. Additionally, I found that the housekeeping services were not up to par.

The breakfast was also disappointing due to very limited vegetarian options, consisting mostly of pastries and bread. Serving the same selection of fruit every day made the offering quite repetitive. My primary concern, however, was the mandatory Christmas Eve dinner. At $120 USD per person, the vegetarian options were again very limited, consisting only of pasta and dessert. This was certainly not worth the cost for a guest with dietary restrictions who does not consume alcohol.

The hotel is located far from the market and the old city, I did appreciate that a shuttle service was provided.

Overall, the experience did not reflect the quality I expected.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your comprehensive feedback following your recent stay at RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai.

While we are pleased that you found the rooms spacious and functional, we sincerely regret that certain aspects of your experience did not meet the standards you anticipated from a five-star resort. Please accept our apologies for any disappointment caused.

Your comments regarding the bathroom layout and housekeeping services have been carefully noted and shared with the relevant department heads for review and corrective action where necessary. Constructive feedback such as yours is invaluable in helping us refine both our facilities and service delivery.

We are particularly concerned to learn that the breakfast variety and vegetarian selections did not meet your expectations. Providing a diverse and inclusive culinary experience is a priority for us, and your observations regarding limited options and repetitive offerings have been forwarded to our Executive Chef for immediate evaluation and improvement.

With regard to the mandatory Christmas Eve dinner, we fully understand your concerns, especially in relation to dietary requirements and perceived value. Festive events should provide an enjoyable and memorable experience for all guests, and we regret that the menu did not sufficiently accommodate your preferences. Your feedback will be carefully considered in the planning of future festive programs to ensure a more balanced and inclusive selection.

We also acknowledge your remarks regarding our location and appreciate your understanding. We are pleased that the shuttle service contributed positively to your overall convenience.

Please rest assured that your comments have been taken seriously at the management level. Continuous improvement remains central to our commitment to excellence, and we truly value the opportunity to learn from your experience.

Thank you once again for your candid feedback. We hope that, in the future, we may have the opportunity to restore your confidence in our hospitality.

Kind regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.name: shilpa iyer
reviews.text: Loved, loved, loved this hotel! Beautiful location by the river. Lovely ambience. Warm, welcoming staff who are always available to address your queries and general questions about the town. The rooms have that old-worldly, rustic feel, absolutely cosy. The spa service was wonderful, except the foot massage could have been a bit less intense towards the end. The back and head massage was great!

The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.text: We the David’s couple greatly appreciate the excellent service of Ying. She happily helped us in our grab car problem for which we were charged to pay eventhough we didn’t ride in the car, there was no completed ride whatsoever. She was quick, pleasing, cheerful, attentive and smart lady! Happily we were successfully refunded by grab! Thanks to Ying! Your company is so lucky to have such a charming, helpful, outstanding employee like Ying! Thanks so much Ying!!!💕💕💕

reviews.name: jamesT8522WX
reviews.text: Superb hotel, great surroundings, staff superb all through the hotel. Great hotel for all sight seeing and Chang Mai town only a 5 minute Tuk Tuk ride away which was great. You must try the Tuk Tuks! Pool was an infinity pool looking out over the river, such beautiful surroundings and pool staff great.|Overall another great experience and thanks so much to all the staff. Hopefully we will be back.

reviews.name: Nat Rudarakanchana
reviews.text: Excellent 5star hotel in the heart of Chiangmai. Amazing views, settings, decor. A homage to ancient Lanna traditions with all wood furnishings. Most staff have been there 10yrs-plus with minimal labor turnover, even through COVID. Great for weddings too!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Preserving this cultural identity while delivering refined comfort is at the heart of our philosophy.

Your recognition of our dedicated team means especially a lot to us. Many of our colleagues have indeed been with us for over a decade, and your acknowledgment of their loyalty and commitment — even through challenging times — is deeply appreciated. We are very proud of the passion and stability of our team.

Thank you as well for recommending us as a wedding destination. It is always a privilege to host such meaningful celebrations.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional stay in the near future.

With warmest regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.text: The whole staff here is excellent but especially Nina who went above and beyond to make a great trip for our group. Very nice property and facilities.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

A special thank you for recognizing Nina. We are very proud of her dedication, and it is heartwarming to know that she went above and beyond to make your trip memorable. Your kind compliments will certainly be shared with her and the entire team.

Warm regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Ibn Al-Critic
reviews.text:
One of those places that makes you bother enough to write a positive review. Where do I start?
Well, at the beginning I guess.
The reception is stunning, out of a movie set. The pool is gorgeous and blends in smoothly
with the greenery around it. The room is closer to five than four stars with a super comfy bed,
traditional wooden furniture, high ceiling, a balcony bed, a bath tub that begs for unforgettable
The reception is stunning, out of a movie set. The pool is gorgeous and blends in smoothly
with the greenery around it. The room is closer to five than four stars with a super comfy bed,
traditional wooden furniture, high ceiling, a balcony bed, a bath tub that begs for unforgettable
experiences wink wink, and last but not least the rooms were super clean with zero insects
which is apparently a common complaint in Chiang Mai hotels.
The breakfast had quite a generous selection of food, and the Thai food was top-tier.
To balance out all of the above praise: the room insulation left a lot to be desired, so expect to
be casually woken up by zealous cleaning ladies greeting other residents in the morning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for your wonderful and thoughtfully written review. It truly means a great deal to us that your experience inspired you to take the time to share such positive feedback.

We are delighted that you enjoyed the ambiance of our reception, the harmony between the pool and the surrounding greenery, and the comfort and design of your room. Your kind words about the traditional wooden furnishings, high ceilings, balcony daybed, and relaxing bathtub made us smile. We are especially pleased that you found the room exceptionally clean and comfortable, as maintaining high standards of cleanliness is one of our top priorities.

It is also a pleasure to know that you appreciated our breakfast selection and enjoyed the Thai cuisine in particular. Our culinary team will be very happy to hear your compliments.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the sound insulation and any disturbance from morning housekeeping activity. A peaceful and restful environment is essential, and your feedback has been shared with the relevant departments to review operational adjustments and minimize noise disruptions wherever possible.

Thank you once again for your balanced and generous review. We truly hope to welcome you back for another memorable and relaxing stay in the near future.

Kind regards,
The Management Team
RatiLanna Riverside Spa Resort, Chiang Mai

reviews.name: jake_johnson49
reviews.text: A fantastic hotel with very friendly staff and great facilities. Included a high quality breakfast and great river views. Only con was it was slightly out of town and far from a 7-11 however they do offer shuttle into the night market. Overall I was very happy.

reviews.name: habib jubran
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth, professionalism, and a level of hospitality that is becoming increasingly rare. The entire team is nothing short of outstanding — incredibly respectful, attentive, and genuinely committed to making every guest feel valued. Every interaction, whether at reception, housekeeping, the restaurant, or the lounge, was marked by kindness and a real desire to help.

The atmosphere throughout the hotel is absolutely wonderful: elegant, serene, and thoughtfully designed to create a sense of comfort and luxury. You can feel the attention to detail everywhere — from the immaculate rooms to the beautifully maintained common areas and the relaxing ambience that surrounds the entire property.

The service was impeccable. Every request was handled quickly and with a smile, and the staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. Their professionalism, combined with their warm personalities, truly elevated our stay.

We were especially impressed by the overall cleanliness, the calm and refined environment, and the little touches that made the experience unforgettable. It’s clear that this hotel takes pride in offering not just a room, but a complete, high-quality experience.

We left with nothing but positive feelings and a deep appreciation for the team that made our stay so special. We highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for exceptional service, a fantastic atmosphere, and a place that truly feels like a home away from home.

reviews.name: Habeel Ahmed
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely incredible experience at this massage place and felt compelled to share just how outstanding it was. From the moment I walked in, everything immediately stood out as being exceptionally clean, well-organized, and thoughtfully arranged. The environment is calm, welcoming, and clearly maintained to a very high standard, which instantly made me feel comfortable and relaxed.

The professionalism of the staff is truly impressive. They are attentive, courteous, and highly skilled, taking the time to understand exactly what you need and tailoring the experience accordingly. You can tell they take great pride in their work, and it really shows in the quality of the service they provide.

The massage itself was absolutely amazing—easily one of the best I’ve ever had. Every detail was handled with care and expertise, and I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and rejuvenated. It’s clear that they go above and beyond to ensure their clients have the best possible experience.

Overall, this place sets a very high standard. Between the cleanliness, organization, professionalism, and exceptional service, it truly stands out. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-quality massage experience—you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.name: Sue Choi
reviews.text:
I wonder if the reason there are so many good reviews is because they're currently running a review promotion.
Without participating in any promotion, I’d like to share my honest experience.
​The massage therapist pressed down hard on my calves and thighs with their elbows. (Even though I told them it hurt, they just rubbed it gently a few times and went right back to pressing hard shortly after.) As a result, I suffered severe pain in the back of my thighs and calves after the session, to the point where I couldn't even walk properly.
​I took some emergency medication I had brought with me and applied pain relief patches, which eased the pain a bit.
​I got a massage to relieve my fatigue, but I feel like I ended up getting injured instead.
When I read other reviews mentioning muscle tears or numbness after massages, I thought it was just someone else's story—I never expected it to happen to me. :(
​Pressing hard does not mean it's a good massage.
The price is cheap, but I definitely wouldn't recommend it.

reviews.name: Anne-Lene Michiels
reviews.text: you can just walk in and tell them what you need, they speak good english. The footmassage was very good, they do your calves aswel. loved the massage, she did her best the whole hour.

reviews.name: Tereza
reviews.text: It was my first Thai massage in Thailand and I enjoyed very much! So relaxing! ❤️ and the staff is really friendly which is important for me. Thank you so much again! 🙏

reviews.name: Natacha
reviews.text:
It was my first time getting a massage in Thailand, I got the full body Oil massage, with Sakura oil for 500 baht.
It was extremely good and relaxing, if you feel pain you can ask to go less hard but personally it was perfect for me !
All the ladies taking care of us were extremely kind and sweet. The massage left me so relaxed and released a lot of the tension I had all over the body. Even better than my physiotherapist appointments. After the massage you are served with hot tea for you to enjoy and some biscuits. I would definitely recommend for a relaxing moment 😊

reviews.name: Malia Begley
reviews.text:
Nice massage place. Staff were friendly and we didn't have to wait at all.
We came back twice during our stay in Chiang Mai.
Free tea and biscuits afterwards was nice.

reviews.name: Adam O Hall
reviews.text: My first Thai massage and most definitely not my last. Lovely atmosphere and staff very welcoming and accommodating. Massage had me feeling extremely relaxed and loose! Tea and biscuits at the end was a nice touch too😁 100% recommend!

reviews.name: victoria W-Y
reviews.text: We bumped into it accidentally, my husband wanted a massage after his massage he told me how great it was and that I needed to go there immediately which I did. I was very impressed and not disappointed. We had both had a massage a few days earlier we were both disappointed but Jinda Massage was great! I also loved the little tea and biscuits that I was given afterwards and for the free fresh and fragrant that was given as a gift afterwards. My husband and I will be back for a 2 hours session in a few days!  Thanks Jinda Massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the great review and experience! 

We hope to see you again 😊🙏🏻

reviews.name: Maddie Ford
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here. The atmosphere is great! It smells so good and is very clean and peaceful. The Thai massage was amazing and the pressure was great. Afterward they gave us tea and cookies. I would definitely come back.

reviews.name: Rod
reviews.text: Amazing massage, it fully renovated my back!! I Will be back!! Recommended!!

reviews.name: Ivan Lee
reviews.text: My wife and I visited the massage shop right next to our hotel—such an amazing experience! The masseurs are incredibly skilled (one of them literally fixed my back), and the prices are surprisingly affordable. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Masterbox Tom
reviews.text: Great place and very professional massage. I live in Thailand but rarely go to such good places. If you're looking for a real Thai massage, this is the place to go.

reviews.name: Neens S
reviews.text: If you are going to get a Thai massage, don't look further. We got the 1hr thai massage+oil. I've gotten many massage before, but this was absolutely amazing, they used exactly perfect amount of pressure. The shop is very calm and the masseuse are professional and kind. 👍👍

reviews.name: africa ruiz
reviews.text: Had my first ever Thai massage here, I felt so relived after and everyone was so lovely. They also offered me some tea a biscuits at the end. Would recommend!

reviews.name: rrluthra
reviews.text:
Very nice place. Neat and clean. All message artists are very friendly and knowledgeable. Already went there two days in a row.

Definitely will keep coming back.

reviews.name: Kimberly Mccool
reviews.text:
Just had the most wonderful hour long foot massage!
I feel relaxed and exhilarated!
Followed by a beautifully presented tray of tea and cookies!
A wonderful experience!
Thank you🥰

reviews.name: Amy Wyley
reviews.text: This was my first massage in Thailand and was so lovely! Excellent value for money and they knew what they were doing - I feel so much better after it!

reviews.name: Alina Zabolotsky
reviews.text:
Really nice experience - they have chairs for foot massage & beds for full body. Very friendly people, clean place and great massage! They went a bit too light at first but I just asked them to adjust an it was perfect :)
They also give hot tea and cookies in the end

reviews.name: Soraya Auer
reviews.text: Had an excellent Thai massage with oil in a peaceful, spotless massage salon. My masseuse was surprisingly strong and stretched and cracked parts of me I didn’t know could be done.

reviews.name: Patrick
reviews.text: Very good head massage and hospitable staff. Warm tea and biscuits ready for when you finish. Masseuse ask if you want softer or harder. 5*****
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the great review and experience! We hope to see you again 😊🙏🏻

reviews.name: Mihaela Sarbu
reviews.text: Awesome massage, very affordable, too!Totally recommend!

reviews.name: Kim Merza
reviews.text: Just arrived in Bangkok, great first thai massage from the lady called Dam. She finished the massage with hot lava-stone, which was the first time for me, although I used to go for thai massage regularly. reviews.name: Tracy Tan
reviews.text:
Very bad experience. Give 1 star is for the clean environment.

reviews.name: Mona B
reviews.text: Best massage we’ve ever had. The therapists here are young guys who are strong but still gentle and careful. Super friendly and everything was perfect! 10/10, we come back :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: "Thank you so much for the perfect 10/10 review! We are thrilled to hear that you had the best massage ever with our skilled and friendly therapists. reviews.name: Lee So
reviews.text: Came here for a 1.5 hr massage before shopping. The location is inside Glow Hotel, we went to the 7th floor and the recep brought us to the 6th floor. It was a happy hour promotion at about 6pm, 700 baht for 1.5 hrs Thai Balm Massage, while the 1.5 hrs Thai Massage with Oil is 1100 baht. Not crowded, but very professional service. My masseuse, Daeng, brought me to a room with abt 7 other beds separated by curtains, was the only person, quiet aside frm faint traffic noises outside. Am glad that I told Daeng to be "soft"!  Back massage was normal, but the legs felt thoroughly relaxed. Ended with a hot compress all over the body at no extra charge. Would recommend for a peaceful, relaxing and professional massage service nearby Platinum Mall

reviews.name: Dior Thum
reviews.text: Conveniently located at lvl 7 of vela glow hotel and opens late. Place is clean and quiet, massage is reasonably priced and masseurs are skilful. Staffs are also polite and friendly. It was a very comfortable and pleasant experience.

reviews.name: little dot
reviews.text: I truly believed that this massage Palour adds value to the hotel Vela Dhi Glow. There operate a corner on 7 th floor hotel lobby, with their main base on the 6 th floor. Place is clean, with good hot tea in clean cups. After a long day walking, their foot massages are strong and detailed, very relaxing. Can tell all the Masseurs are well trained in a standardised massage protocol. A special shout out to miss Kong in photo, whose command in English is commendable. She is very attentive to guests needs and check us out regularly to ensure we are happy with the massages. She says she is the receptionist but I suspect she is the manager!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you.

reviews.text: Massage staff is very friendly, skillful, the best experience I've ever had.  Quiet space, relaxation, natural sounds, after a day of walking around Bangkok we came here to have foot and Thai massages.  Absolutely worth the money!

reviews.name: Muna
reviews.text:
Prices are reasonable. The masseurs are good and the place is clean and pleasant.

Only issue, a little too bright and not cozy for a power nap during massage.

reviews.name: YD O
reviews.text: It was our first time visiting, and we were very impressed. The pricing is clear and transparent, and the staff did a great job explaining all the services. We opted for the back and shoulders massage as well as a foot massage—both were amazing! The entire experience was incredibly relaxing, and I genuinely felt an improvement afterward. We’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Jason Lee Tian Yi
reviews.text: Was doubtful but we went to try the 1hr foot massage …. Very very nice ~~~~ Will come back again

reviews.name: Celest Chong
reviews.text: Found this massage 2 years ago when we stayed at glow hotel. Initially tried those street massages and got so bad service. Decided to try out and we never looked back. Despite not staying here this time round, we came back a total of 3 times within a week. Super good service, no hardsell or upsell like certain shops. Very cozy, quiet and spa environment. Very hard to stay awake with the wonderful massage and peaceful surrounding. Will be back here again the next time Im back in bkk.

reviews.name: Rose Bonsai
reviews.text:
This was my second time here! The first time, I had an oil massage with Noi (I’m not entirely sure about the name), and today, I had a Thai massage with Sun. Both times, I was more than satisfied. Its very quiet with a relaxing music. They are very professional and have a great sense of what you need. I felt incredibly relaxed afterward.

If I come back to Bangkok, I will definitely return! Everyone here is so kind and welcoming. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Elvin. Kokfoo
reviews.text: Highly recommended. Masseuse is very skillful and use just the right force. The massage bed is very clean and not oily too. The head massage was so comfortable I fell asleep. All the staff is so polite and helpful. It's very convenient for guest staying in Veladhi Glow. Will definitely be returning for other massages.

reviews.name: Agnes Ee

reviews.name: Jasmine Kwa

reviews.name: Garedo
reviews.text: Value for money, no frills and authentic Thai massage. My masseuse was strong and attentive. By Bangkok standards, the skill level is decent. For the price (~350thb/hr), I recommend!

reviews.name: Calvin Ong
reviews.text: A very convenient massage place around my stay in Bangkok and easy to locate. Just a mere 7-8 mins walk from hotel. While walking to the massage parlour, I am still able to shop and grab some snacks along the way. The service was excellent and most importantly, service and massage skills were very good. I opt for foot massage after all the sores from walking. If you visit them during certain timing, there's happy hour prices. Opens from 10am till 2am. A must try if you love massages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you  and hope to service you again.

reviews.name: Ang Abby
reviews.text: Had a really great massage session here! Thanks other traveler for this recommendation. Location wise: if you're coming late, look for Starbucks, go in from the side door, get up using lift to 6th floor.

reviews.name: Dit dit Chong
reviews.text:
My first time was as a hotel guest and I have already posted rave reviews about this massage place.

Today I am posting as a pure massage guest.

It's damn damn damn damn good.
Forget about going to any massage place along the street.
Just come to 6th floor of GLOW hotel.

Damn damn damn damn good.

reviews.name: Jarawee Jitaree
reviews.text:
Highly recommended!

The shop is new, clean, and has a very relaxing atmosphere. Everyone was very friendly, from the receptionist to the massage therapist. The massage pressure was perfect, and I felt so relaxed that I fell asleep.

Great service, great experience, and definitely worth coming back. I’ll be visit again for sure.

reviews.name: Michelle Joy Sorvida Palacio
reviews.text:
Just had one of the best spa massages ever.
The place has such a nice, calming ambiance, super relaxing from the moment you walk in. Everything feels peaceful and well taken care of.

My therapist Aerin was amazing, really knows what she’s doing and helped release all the tension in my body. Left feeling so refreshed. Definitely coming back.

reviews.name: RIA ROSMAN
reviews.text: Was recommended to come here by our thai friend!! Booking via Whatsapp was so smooth and efficient. We’ve been to many massages during my time in Thailand and this was one of THE BEST. We took the buffet package with traditional thai massage with balm, and i almost fell asleep even after choosing Hardest on the pressure emphasis. It’s super relaxing, heard lots of great cracks of my bones, and the before and after tea and snacks were tasty!! The service was really good and the receptionist was clear about everything. There’s a 3% charge for card payments, but that’s not too big a deal since they tell you beforehand.

reviews.name: Andjela Rakic
reviews.text:
I had massage named "best seller" in which were included 3 massages and lasted 2h. I enjoyed truly and got relaxed! Women performing massage was great, skilled and polite. After treatment I was feeling much better and relaxed.
Desk stuff was very kind and all experience was indulging 😊

reviews.name: Ruby Carroll
reviews.text: Such a gorgeous experience at Home Massage and Spa. I opted for the deep tissue Thai massage which was quite firm but left me feeling extremely relaxed afterwards. All staff were extremely friendly and helpful and the interior smells great and is very clean - a peaceful atmosphere is created as soon as you step in the door. Would highly recommend if you are visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Isabella Rymill
reviews.text: Best massage both me and my boyfriend have ever had! I got the Thai massage with hemp oil and he got the upper body & foot massage. We both basically had full body massages and stretching. Feel amazing after. Can’t recommend enough! Lovely staff & eeally reasonable prices too.

reviews.name: Елизавета Рысбаева
reviews.text:
Today I had an aromatherapy massage and a hair wash with a keratin treatment; I really enjoyed it and would definitely recommend a visit!
First, they asked me to fill in a questionnaire, where they took all my preferences into account; the massage itself was brilliant)) My hair feels like new after the treatment – it’s so lovely and soft! At the end, they served some really tasty tea and biscuits 😋 I’d love to come back here again

reviews.name: samera oulkadi
reviews.text: Cindy was absolutely a god send! I had a fully body scrub and facial and I have left feeling on cloud 9. What a wonderful find this place was. Can’t recommend enough. So happy with the whole treatment and experience

reviews.name: Adam Guzman
reviews.text:
Walked in and received the Relaxing Foot and Back Massage (A1 package).

It felt like an elevated experience and was so worth it.

I came out feeling refreshed and ready to continue on with my travels. I would highly recommend!

reviews.name: Coco Handicrafts
reviews.text: l had a wonderful experience at this spa. The ambiance was calm and soothing, and the therapist was very skilled. I felt relaxed and well taken care of. Definitely worth coming back 🇹🇭🇹🇭🇹🇭

reviews.name: Eyal Levy
reviews.text:
Great massages.
Took the thai massage with hemp oil + foot massage.
Place is very clean and staff is very respectful.

You can take a shower before and after the massage.
They also greet you with tea and cookies before and after the massage

They have a certified pregnancy massagist and can be booked in advance. They gave my wife good recommendations and teaching on what can be done and what not.

reviews.name: Nattanit Sangtong
reviews.text: It was my first time here, and it was absolutely wonderful — truly worth every baht I spent. The 3-hour session was relaxing and deeply rejuvenating. I fell into a deep sleep and felt completely at ease the entire time. Both the massage therapist and the receptionist were incredibly attentive and kind, paying close attention to every detail. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jenny Long
reviews.text:
This spot is so aesthetic! Smells really nice and air conditioning. We opted for the deep tissue Thai massage and it was about 650 baht. If you pay by card it’s 3% charge.

We were served bael fruit tea and it was so nice! They started us with a foot scrub and then our full massage.

We walked in and no reservations. They put us in same room (curtain separated for diff genders).

Overall best massage I’ve ever had!

They also serve us bael tea and cookies at the end of the”.

reviews.name: Alexander Walker
reviews.text:
This is the best massage I have received in Thailand. Me and My Brother both got massages. My Therapist was Tukta, her pressure was consistent, her ability to find every attachment that was tight and needed release, and her overall flow to the massage was on point.
I come from Canada and I am a Registered Massage Therapist, so very often I find it hard to not be critical of the treatments I receive….. But seriously this was an absolute delight and genuinely a place you need to come when you visit Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Natasha
reviews.text:
I recently tried the new branch of The home massage and was really impressed with the experience! I booked a scrub and oil massage, and it was exactly what I needed — relaxing, refreshing, and professionally done.

The therapist was skilled and attentive, making sure I was comfortable throughout. The scrub left my skin feeling super smooth, and the oil massage was perfect for easing muscle tension.

The new location is clean, cozy, and has a calming atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. I’ll definitely be returning and would recommend it to anyone looking for a quality home massage service.

reviews.name: B118 Bt
reviews.text:
I had a two-hour oil massage here, and it was the most wonderful massage experience.
The staff was friendly and welcoming, the massage room was clean with a pleasant fragrance, and the relaxing atmosphere with soft music made me feel so much better after a long, hard day at work.
I couldn’t recommend it more!
if you’re looking for a massage place in Chiang Mai, this is the best one👍🏻

reviews.name: Apollo Blazing Sun
reviews.text:
I am having a good time here.
The massage was good and the place was neat and tidy.
The staff has excellent customer service skills.

The price is standard; they often have promotions for discounts.

The bed in the massage room has temperature control to ensure you don't feel cold.

The parking space is a little bit limited (only 2-3 car maximum) but you can park beside the road if it is not a peak hour.

reviews.name: thanattha jarukittiphong
reviews.text: This was one of the best Thai massages I’ve ever had. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the environment was clean and peaceful. The therapist was very skilled, she helped relieve tension in my shoulders and back. I left feeling lighter and more energized. I’ll definitely come back again!  ☺️❤️

reviews.name: merry
reviews.text:
My friends and I had such a great time at Home Massage and Spa! I got the 120-minute buffet and it was super worth it. Everything felt relaxing and well taken care of.

Gift did a very good job. She was professional, gentle, and made me feel very comfortable throughout the session.

Overall, I really enjoyed my visit and would highly recommend this spa.

reviews.name: Alenka
reviews.text:
If I were to give this 5 stars, it wouldn’t be honest. I’ve experienced Vietnamese head massage before and was curious to try Indian head massage to see how it differs. Unfortunately, it was a very boring experience. There was only one single movement repeated throughout almost the entire 50 minutes, and the last 10 minutes were shoulder massage in a seated position.
During the first 30 minutes of the treatment, the therapist was using her phone—I could clearly hear the sound next to my ear. Only after I questioned it did she turn the phone off. Because she was using her phone while working, the movements were not smooth at all. Overall, it was extremely boring, with no knowledge of pressure points and just one repetitive technique.
I paid 850B for a 60-minute Indian Head Massage with coconut oil—about 70% of what you pay is just for a nicely decorated place, while the technique itself is not worth the money at all.
The treatment room is private but noisy—the sound from the street and passing traffic comes through clearly, making it not relaxing at all.

title: Lila Thai Massage Ratchavithi

Every therapist is professionally trained, so you can trust that each session will genuinely ease your muscles and restore your well-being.

reviews.name: Joanne Lim
reviews.text: I’m a big fan of massages, and this place definitely exceeded my expectations. The prices are very reasonable, and the location is convenient. reviews.name: GiraffeGoes
reviews.text:
If i could give an honest rating it will be a solid 5 star rating with distinction 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I visited Spa Yuko in Bangkok last December and to say that I was happy would be an understatement. It was honestly one of the best deep tissue massages I have ever had.

I came with my family, my husband and daughter. Although only my husband and I were having the massage, the staff were incredibly thoughtful and made sure our daughter had a comfortable place to rest while waiting for us. They even gave her a blanket so she could lie down comfortably. It is not easy for a child to wait for a full hour, but she managed well because the waiting area was so cozy and relaxing.

The massage itself was amazing and very therapeutic. It was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep a couple of times. Yuko san, the masseuse, kept checking in to make sure the pressure was comfortable, which I really appreciated.

I chose a massage without oil because I was heading out later that day, but they actually have a wide variety of massage oils to choose from. I have never seen a spa offer such an extensive selection before. The oils even looked carefully crafted, possibly homemade, which made the experience feel very unique and special.

The service was wonderful from start to finish. The staff were genuinely warm and welcoming. They also provided clean and comfortable clothes for us to wear during the massage. The changing area and massage beds were very clean and comfortable as well.

To end the session, they served a sweet homemade dessert ice cream, which was such a lovely and thoughtful touch.

After the massage, my body felt lighter and incredibly relaxed. I even felt like my posture improved. What surprised me most was that I did not experience the usual soreness the next day. Normally after deep massages I feel some pain around the tense areas, but this time my aches were gone and my muscles felt relaxed.

It was such an unforgettable experience that I already look forward to coming back the next time I am in Bangkok.

I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for a truly relaxing massage or relief for tense muscles. There are many massage styles available, so there is something for everyone.

To Yuko san, thank you so much for your kindness, helpfulness, and the wonderful service. It was an experience I will never forget. 🙇‍♀️

P/s : I didn’t snap any pictures of the Spa because i was charging my phone during the massage but this was taken at a local eatery near the spa that was recommended by Yuko san after the massage♥️

The space is beautiful, the treatments were heavenly, and the team was incredibly kind, attentive, and so friendly. They made the whole experience feel personalized and welcoming from the moment we walked in.

Highly, highly recommend!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted you enjoyed every part of your experience with us. We use organic products to ensure a luxurious and gentle treatment. We truly hope to welcome you again.

The consultant was professional, friendly, and attentive throughout the visit. The massage therapist and hair washing staff also provided very good service, making the experience feel relaxing and well taken care of. I was also satisfied with the products used during the treatment.

Overall, I enjoyed my experience and would definitely recommend this spa to friends. I’m also looking forward to coming back again in the future.

reviews.name: T

Love from France 🇹🇭❤️🇫🇷

I will return before leaving Bankok! Thank you so much for an amazing experience!

reviews.text: I really liked the massage here and came back for the second time. I love the hospitality of the whole team - from the reception to the therapists, but Jane is exceptionally great! reviews.name: José Ignacio De Ibarrola
reviews.text: My wife and I went for a deep tissue massage and we were really impressed with how good it was. Just be aware that it's quite deep, but for us it was exactly what we needed. We'll definitely be back when we're in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jayd Milella
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible massage parlor! I wish I could give it ten out of five stars! My wife and I stumbled across this place after dinner.
