Would recommend to single travelers, couples or groups!

reviews.name: Aimi Barrett
reviews.text: Most relaxing massage. So happy I stumbled across this place. Had a 90min with Nong. So good. And the place was immaculate, so clean and premium. Will be back again tomorrow!!! Come here, you won’t regret it!!

reviews.name: Ethan Tan
reviews.text: Amazing service and always reliable. I came here during my last visit to Bangkok and back again for more! All the staff were extremely friendly and the venue was clean and comfy. I got 30 mins of foot plus an hr of oil - super relaxing after a long day.

reviews.name: Stephen Asma
reviews.text: This was by far the worst massage experience either of us has ever had. My friend’s masseuse used excessive, painful pressure and repeatedly ignored her requests to change the technique. The treatment was so rough that she ended up with significant bruising on her arm afterward. A massage should never leave a client injured, especially after the client clearly communicates that something is painful. This was completely unacceptable and raises serious concerns about the training and judgment of this particular masseuse. I would strongly recommend that management address this situation.

reviews.text: Rath is very skillful and did a very good job for the 90mins Thai massage that I did yesterday. It helps in my recovery after 2 hrs of exercise in the morning and massage in the afternoon. Highly recommended.

title: Heavena Wellness & Spa – Riverside
ownerDescription: Relax and recharge by the Chao Phraya River at Heavena Wellness & Spa, located inside Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Bangkok Menam Riverside. Experience traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy, and wellness treatments in a serene riverside atmosphere. Our professional therapists and calming environment help you unwind, restore balance, and rejuvenate your body and mind — the perfect escape from the city’s rush.
address: 3rd Floor, Ramada Plaza Menam Riverside Hotel, 2074 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
street: 3rd Floor, Ramada Plaza Menam Riverside Hotel, 2074 ถ. เจริญกรุง

ownerUpdates.text: Unwind by the Chao Phraya River at Heavena Wellness & Spa, Riverside — on the 3rd floor of Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Bangkok Menam Riverside, 2074 Charoen Krung Road, just minutes from IconSiam, Asiatique and the Sathorn/Silom riverside. Enjoy Royal Thai Massage, warm-oil aromatherapy, deep tissue, or our exclusive Heavena Signature Massage — 90 minutes blending warm-oil aromatherapy with traditional Royal Thai techniques — with river views and free parking validation. Couples treatment rooms available; service in Thai, English, Mandarin, and Korean. Open daily 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM (last booking 90 minutes before closing). Reserve via WhatsApp +66 96-242-8299 or book online.

reviews.name: Teik Seng Chong
reviews.text:
We booked the 3-hour VIP couple spa package at Heavena Wellness & Spa, and the entire experience was truly first-class from the moment we stepped in.

The session started with a relaxing one-hour jacuzzi, followed by a body scrub and aromatherapy massage. The therapists were exceptionally skilled — every pressure point on my back was spot on, delivering both deep relief and complete comfort.

The service level across all staff was excellent — warm, attentive, and professional throughout.

A pleasant surprise was the dessert served at the end. It was so good that we couldn’t stop eating, even though we were rushing for our next appointment.

Considering the quality of the experience, the price is very reasonable. This is definitely a place we would return to again.

reviews.name: Arana Kaomoolkadi
reviews.text: The best spa experience in BKK so far!! Love the excellent service and everything provided here smell so nice and premium,my skin is glowing and super smooth after the scrubs and oil massage. Great for a fancy romantic date as well because the Riverside view is everything you could ask for

reviews.name: Puniga travel
reviews.text:
My stay at Ramada, combined with the experience at Heavena  wellness & Spa, was truly beyond expectations. From the moment I stepped in, the serene atmosphere and attentive service created a deep sense of calm and comfort. The treatment was incredibly gentle and refined, with every detail thoughtfully delivered, allowing me to completely relax and even drift off to sleep.

It was a perfect moment of escape, where both my body and mind felt fully restored. I shared this beautiful experience with my aunt, and it became such a meaningful and memorable time for us.

I would highly recommend this to anyone seeking a truly luxurious and indulgent retreat.

reviews.name: Rohit Patel
reviews.text:
"A hidden gem at the Ramada Plaza Riverside! The river views from the spa are breathtaking and add a whole new level of calm to the experience. The Royal Thai Massage with Hot Herbal Compress left me feeling completely rejuvenated after a long flight. I especially appreciated the Tamarind Plum welcome drink and the seamless boat shuttle service from BTS Saphan Taksin. Truly a 5-star experience from start to finish!"

From the moment I walked into Heavena Wellness & Spa, I felt the stress of the city melt away. The atmosphere is incredibly serene, with calming aromas and elegant decor. I tried the Aromatic Oil Massage, and the therapist was exceptionally skilled at finding every knot. The highlight was definitely the post-massage coconut ice cream and tea—such a thoughtful and delicious touch! Highly recommend if you’re looking for a luxury escape.

reviews.name: Cha Lim (ชา)
reviews.text: This is the first time I experienced such a luxury spa, we went there for our wedding anniversary and we were really enjoy there. The reception attitude was great! He gave us an emergency phone as our steam and bath session was fully private, so we can call them if we need help. Desserts inside the room was too sweet, but I guess it’s traditional Thai dessert, so nothing to complain. Ice cream after the spa is quite nice. Overall, I recommend all the couple to try out this place for any occasion! It’s is really a pleasant experience!

reviews.name: Cow Duck
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience at Heavena Wellness & Spa! The atmosphere is calm, clean, and beautifully designed — from the moment I walked in, I felt relaxed. The staff were very kind, professional, and made me feel completely comfortable.

I got a traditional Thai massage, and it was one of the best I’ve ever had. The therapist knew exactly how to work on my pressure points, and I walked out feeling lighter, refreshed, and stress-free. The oils smelled wonderful, and the whole place feels peaceful with a real sense of luxury.

Perfect spot to unwind after a long day in Bangkok. Highly recommend this spa — definitely a 5-star experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Cow Duck for sharing such a wonderful and detailed review of your visit to Heavena Wellness & Spa (Ramada Plaza Riverside Hotel) — we’re truly delighted that the calm atmosphere, thoughtful design, and caring service helped you relax from the moment you arrived. title: DN Wellness Massage
ownerDescription:
DN Wellness Massage is a small massage house that provide various massage service style by experienced therapists with both men and women.
With the location as in the centre of Chiangmai, you still can find the quite place to relax and enjoy massage with DN Wellness Massage. Unlike other nearby massage shops around Nimman, we think about the privacy of our customer by providing the private zone and treat you to feel like you do massage at home.
Try new experience in massage by making appointment with us.
With the experience in massage over ten years, you will fulfil and relax with our massage technique.
address: 95/42 Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: RX28+6W Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: March Mimi
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this massage shop. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing, with beautiful decorations and lots of greenery. The shop has two sections, and today I tried the side without the garden for the first time.

The massage therapist was very attentive and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. The receptionist was also friendly and paid attention to every detail, asking about my preferences and any areas that needed extra care before the massage. After the treatment, they even served a cup of hot tea, which was a lovely touch.

I’ve tried both the balm massage and aroma massage here, and I highly recommend both. The balm massage gives a refreshing cooling sensation that really helps relax tight muscles, while the oil massage has a wonderful fragrance and provides a gentle, calming experience.

Whenever I visit Chiang Mai, this is definitely the massage shop I want to come back to. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Bn JN
reviews.text: One of the best massages in Chiang Mai. Have parking and very kind staff. They have all the apps to communicate and make bookings. Very relaxing atmosphere and the therapist had a great technique. 800 baht for 90 minutes oil massage is very good and reasonable. I will come back

reviews.name: Peggy Kwan
reviews.text: The staff were friendly, and the masseuses did their best during the two-hour massage, adjusting the pressure according to our family's requests to perfectly suit our needs. This massage parlor offers great value for money.

reviews.name: Wim Vipa
reviews.text:
I’ve been to DN Wellness Massage twice now, and overall, it’s a lovely place. It can get a bit busy at times, especially when there’s a large group of customers, but that’s quite normal for a popular spa like this. Everyone here generally understands and respects the basic etiquette of a shared relaxation space.

The herbal tea served after the massage is fragrant and elegant not too sweet, just perfect. The local snacks they provide have that authentic, home-style touch, which I really appreciate. What I love most, though, is the view of Doi Suthep from the other building, it truly relaxes both the eyes and the mind.

reviews.name: RUOMENG LIU
reviews.text: This is my second year coming here, and I’ve always had a great experience. The massage is very relaxing, and the therapists are skilled and professional. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: sandy wong
reviews.text: Amazing massage, took time to work on areas with a lot of tension. Staff are extremely friendly. Best massage I’ve had. Lovely place off a side road

reviews.name: Gordon Tan
reviews.text: Great value for money! You get your own individual private room. The masseurs are professionally trained and mine could tell I had a stiff right back straight away. She really did her best to loosen those tight muscles! The prices are really affordable and you get a nice tea set after the massage with herbs grown in their own garden. Wonderful ambience and very courteous and professional staff. My go-to massage place in Chiangmai now!

reviews.name: 정은
reviews.text:
I had a two-hour Thai and aroma massage, and unfortunately, it was one of the worst massages I’ve had. The therapist seemed completely uninterested and felt like she was just going through the motions, with very little care or attention. Instead of feeling relaxed, I actually felt uncomfortable throughout the massage and wanted to leave halfway through.

What also bothered me was that as soon as my massage was over, she turned on the lights even though the person I came with was still receiving their massage. I found that quite inconsiderate.

It seems like the experience really depends on the therapist, so I’d keep that in mind if you’re planning to visit.

After the massage, you can have some refreshments on the outdoor terrace, but there were so many ants on the sofa that I couldn’t even sit down.

The reception staff were all very friendly, but unfortunately, that was the only positive part of my experience.

reviews.name: Emilia
reviews.text: The best massage, we go there regularly. We like the Thai balm treatment for 90 minutes. The massage rooms are private. There is also a really nice garden

reviews.name: Fifi Cheng
reviews.text: If you can only come to one massage place, come here! The aromatherapy is amazing. They use products from THANN. The massage staff are really professional. Everything’s perfect! The room is clean and private. Love this amazing place. 🌟💗Make sure to make appointments at least 1 day in advance :)

reviews.name: Zahra Parkar
reviews.text: I had an amazing massage and facial! I did the two hour Thai massage which was great for all the walking and traveling I’ve been doing. They have you choose what areas to focus on and she really did! My back, legs and shoulder feel like butter. Plus the place is beautiful. Truly relaxing all around.

reviews.name: Narisara Sk
reviews.text: .This is a very excellent massage shop. I really like it. The shop is decorated in an English style, making it look shady and inviting. The massage place is clean and spacious, and the masseuses are very skilled. This makes me feel good every time I come here. Thank you DN Wellness Massage for making me feel relaxed and warm every time.

reviews.name: Tyler Schube
reviews.text: Excellent massage and very nice experience. Very relaxing, private rooms, with a nice garden area to enjoy the complimentary tea in after your massage. For 350baht you probably aren't finding a better option! Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Desiree Ong
reviews.text:
I like massages that go a little harder because I have a lot of knots and tight areas and honestly, Tian from DN does an amazing job. She knows the exact points to hit and it gives you and immediate release. I've had countless of Thai massages and nothing ever hits.

I'm so glad I found Tian at DN wellness, im going to sleep so well tonight.

reviews.name: Pawinee Santichalanan
reviews.text:
One of best massage i ever had! Like a hidden gem & i found this place randomly and booked right away. Its located in townhouse, only 2 therapist so its better to call and book time in advance. There is 1 parking lot in front of the house. Place is clean, staff is very friendly (dont expect high class service like spa or massage in hotel). They served us welcome drink, refreshing towel & clean our feet.
My husband booked office syndrome massage 60 mins & mine is aroma therapy 60 mins. 2 kinds of aroma scent from Thai famous brand Thann.
The way therapist massage was so good even i knew she massaged hard but its still very relax and i actually fall asleep twice 😅. Price is very cheap compared to what i normallt had in bangkok. Total only 1100 THB, so we gave some tips to them. They also gave us inhaler which they made by themselves. What a nice of them!. I will definitely return.
Ps after massage, they served mango & t hot tea.

reviews.name: Taeil Yoon
reviews.text: I came here because of the great reviews, and it was the best massage I've had since coming to Chiang Mai. I wanted to come back the next day but didn't get a reservation in advance. I really enjoyed the Thai massage and aroma oil massage package they recommended. I would definitely come back if I travel again.

reviews.name: Tetiana Lesiv
reviews.text: The studio is located in a beautiful quiet corner surrounded by a lot of greenery. Thai massage is very professional and with the right amount of pressure as I asked on the survey form. The atmosphere is welcoming and friendly. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: 김지영
reviews.text:
I got a massager from tai (or tei)
She was really kind and keeps asking if I feel comfortable or not.
Not only about that, but also employees of reception tried to give pack of cookies instead of giving me tea. It was very cute gift before I leave Chiang Mai. Everyone is nice and kind in here. I realized that why here is popular to make reservations.
Thank u very much! Everybody Merry Christmasssss.

reviews.name: Derrick Perry
reviews.text: Outstanding massage. Saying anything else would not suffice. Great facilities with individual rooms along with a relaxing and tranquil garden to soak up nature following your session.

reviews.name: Ivory Down
reviews.text: Hands down the best massage I’ve ever had in Thailand (yes, I’ve been to quite a lot), it’s affordable for the best quality you can get. I did Thai balm massage for 1 hour but will definitely go back there for more. Staff are friendly, professional and can communicate in English well. My therapist knew what she was doing, it relieved all the muscle tensions and pain I’ve been having for months. It’s easy to book through google maps chat, and what a relaxing, beautiful finishing touch to end the experience with tea and a seasonal fruit juice served in the garden. Absolutely loved it and will recommend it to others.

reviews.name: Danska
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at Rest And Relax Massage. I booked a 2-hour therapeutic oil massage while dealing with a sore and slightly inflamed right knee from extensive hiking and walking during my travels.

What impressed me most was how attentive and professional the therapist was. I explained that I wanted medium pressure and needed them to avoid aggressive twisting or heavy work directly on the knee joint. They listened carefully and focused on the surrounding muscles instead — quads, calves, hips, glutes and IT band — which made a noticeable difference to my stiffness and mobility afterwards.

The massage felt genuinely therapeutic rather than just a standard tourist massage. The atmosphere was calm, clean and professional, and the staff made me feel comfortable throughout the entire session.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a massage place that actually understands recovery, muscle tension and targeted treatment — not just hard pressure — I would highly recommend Rest And Relax Massage.

title: Let’s Relax Onsen and Spa (Thonglor)
subTitle: เล็ทส์ รีแลกซ์ ออนเซน แอนด์ สปา (ทองหล่อ)
ownerDescription: Escape to a blissful environment which is inspired by the traditional Japanese Onsen bathing, Let’s Relax Onsen and Spa Thonglor features wide varieties of mineral bath tubs, sauna, steam, warm and cold room, and an extended menu of massage and spa treatments that will pamper and indulge your mind and body. Located on the fifth floor of Grande Centre Point Hotel, Thonglor, Let’s Relax Onsen and Spa provides hot bath enriched with powerful luxurious minerals that continuously protect, heal, and rejuvenate the body at cellular level leaving the body and mind healthful, rejuvenated, refreshed, relaxed and cleansed.
address: 300 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Rei Perucho
reviews.text:
Had the most amazing 4 hours of massage and onsen at this spa! Highly recommend! 💯

Upon entering, you will be greated with warm welcome from the staff and will be assisted every step of the way. The entire place is kept clean and organised and the onsen is perfect for those looking to relax after a whole day or week of touring Bangkok!

The massages are outstanding! Thai massage is already amazing but the staff of Let’s Relax truly elevate it further. I will definitely come back again!

Also, they provide complimentary snacks and drinks in the lounge and a serving of Mango Sticky rice after your massage. Truly a wonderful service!

reviews.name: Olga Starodubtseva
reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience at Let’s Relax Onsen spa! So grateful for recommendation of my friends to come check this place out was one of the highlights of my trip in Bangkok. Highly recommend to visit! I loved the sauna, steamrooms and the silk bath experience 😍 as well as the massage.

reviews.name: Darwis Sunaryo
reviews.text:
I do not understand why oil massage is double the price of a normal thai massage.

I have had massaged in indonesia, singapore, malaysia and thailand. All the placed i went to will ask/inform if they have prepared a male massue and if i was okay with it. I respect all massues and have no issues with any gender. But everyone has their own preferences and comfortability, it was very weird to me that i got a male massue without being informed?!

Apologies but what made it worse was that he had wet palm. I could feel the dampness of his hands when he was massaging my feet, its like urgh! No offence.

Booked the thai massage + hot compress.
Horribly baffled that the hot compress was done over the shirt - which means that i am not getting the full benefits of the herbs that were compressed onto me. And when he was compressing it onto my butt, i can feel my undergarments getting wet. I felt kinda ew!

Lets relax spa is supposed to have a higher quality of massges, but…

reviews.name: Soozhee Pearce
reviews.text:
🌿 Let’s Relax Thonglor Onsen – A Daily Sanctuary of Peace in the Heart of Bangkok

As an avid onsen enthusiast, my husband surprised me with a Toshi Pass—a 1-year membership that grants daily access (1 entry per day) to this premium Japanese-style onsen, along with a 20% discount on all massage services. Your  guest will get a discount for a daily pass if they come with you. For someone who enjoys the mental and physical reset of a daily soak, the value has been exceptional.

Though the pass was originally purchased at the Lumphini branch, I now exclusively visit the Thonglor location—and it’s not just because of convenience. The magic of this branch lies in the presence of the incredible Boss Lady Kuhn Nui, whose warm, heartfelt welcome to every guest sets the tone for the entire experience. Her consistent 5-star hospitality and leadership radiate through the entire team, and it’s clear that staff pride themselves on upholding these high standards.

🛎️ Staff & Service: Subtle Excellence Everywhere

After visiting nearly every day, I’ve come to know who truly shines:
•	Ball at the front desk is wonderfully attentive, always making sure my bookings and VIP discounts are handled smoothly and correctly.
•	Every staff member—whether they manage your shoes, offer you towels, serve your meals at the cafe or clean the change rooms—works with quiet integrity and visible pride. Their attention to detail contributes to the peace of the whole space.
•	While there are occasional staff at reception who seem oddly quick to say “sorry, fully booked” with inappropriate glee, the higher-performing team members stand out even more by their willingness to help and accommodate returning members with grace and effort.

💧 The Onsen Experience: Zen Meets Luxury

Nestled on the 5th floor of the 5-star Grande Centre Point Hotel Thonglor, this onsen is an elegant fusion of Japanese zen and Roman-bath peace; immaculately clean, and thoughtfully designed.

Upon check-in, you’re given a numbered locker key, kimono-style top and pants, and a small bag with large and small towels. You’re then guided to swap your shoes for slippers, setting the tone for an unhurried ritual of release.

Facilities include:
•	🌿 Outdoor Area: Beautiful massage jet pools (both standing and seated), with fresh air and light
•	🛁 Indoor Baths: A creamy “milk bath,” a steaming hot bath, and a cold plunge
•	🌫️ Steam Room & Sauna: Perfect for rotation rituals to deeply detox and recharge
•	❄️ Heated + Cold Rooms: Sweat it out on warm floors, then cool down next door
•	🍹 Complimentary refreshment stations: Pandan water, lemon water, and coconut crisps await post-soak

Men’s and women’s onsen areas are completely separate, maintaining comfort and cultural respect.

🍵 Massages, Meals & Mango Sticky Rice

The onsen’s full kitchen offers a range of quality meals: fresh juices, ramen, sandwiches, cakes, teas, and excellent coffee.

One unexpected delight: a complimentary serving of mango sticky rice is included when you book full-body or 1-hour massages. On one of my visits, I booked three massages throughout the day—yes, I enjoyed three servings of mango sticky rice. No complaints.

🧘‍♀️ Work, Rest or Recalibrate

This onsen isn’t just for soaking—it’s a calm sanctuary where you can bring your laptop and work peacefully or relax in dedicated quiet rooms:
•	Tatami mat areas with low lounge beds for a nap or soft reading time
•	Heated floor zones to deeply relax or sweat gently in stillness

It’s perfect for a full-day wellness reset. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Panuwat Phiansa (Bas)
reviews.text: super super perfect onsen, the interior was so sublime with beautiful ceiling, lamps and all, with four different baths plus one cold plunge!.. with a sauna and a steam room also! also as a plus they have ramen with onsen eggs!

reviews.name: Lucy Lang
reviews.text:
I stopped by Let’s Relax Onsen & Spa after seeing a reel on IG recommending this place. It looked promising at first - very clean and spacious.

You start by paying for your service at the counter.
I opted for the onsen experience and 60 min thai massage combo. This cost 1350 baht ~ $40 USD.
I opted to start with a massage first and then onsen afterwards.

Next, you give them your shoes in exchange for slippers to wear throughout the spa. I noticed no welcome drink or tea was provided like other massage places that I’ve been to in Thailand. You are then seated in a waiting area where you can help yourself to snacks and water until you’re called for.

Massage experience: This was not up to par with other Thai massages that I’ve received in Thailand especially given the price. I had requested stronger pressure and my masseuse was kind of spotty with it. Her technique wasn’t that great either. You’re better off opting for Thai massages at other places in Bangkok and just avoid paying the premium here. You do end up with a mango sticky rice dessert and tea after your massage.

Onsen experience: I enjoyed relaxing in the Onsen. This was probably the highlight of my experience and I should’ve just opted for this from the start. There are 5 baths / plunges that you can opt for. 2 saunas - a wet sauna and steam sauna. For foreigners who are not familiar with Onsen experiences, you will be fully naked in these areas. They are separated by female and male onsens.

Overall: Go for onsen experience if you want a day to relax. Skip the massage, it is not worth it.

reviews.name: A. Kaneshiro
reviews.text:
I am an onsen lover. I have been visiting Let's Relax Onsen whenever I am in Bangkok for work before meeting my clients in the afternoon. I like going there at 10 am, when they have just opened for the day and there aren’t many customers. I usually soak in the onsen for an hour before heading for my 2hrs Thai massage.

The ambience of the massage room is quiet, peaceful and smell nice and the massage is very good. There are five pools at the onsen with different temperatures, along with a sauna and a steam room. The shower area has 16 seated showers and four standing shower stalls. The locker area is spacious, with a separate dressing area. There’s also a room with warm Himalayan hot stone bed baths and a cool-down room. A relaxing lounge is available if you’d like to take a nap.

The staff are friendly and helpful. They serve delicious mango sticky rice and tea after the massage. Your body and mind will definitely feel rejuvenated, refreshed, and relaxed. The onsen is usually not crowded in the early morning. Avoid the early afternoon and late evening as it tends to be crowded.

reviews.name: SK Tan
reviews.text:
Maseeur knows biz is good. Told Female masseur i need more strength. The masseur told me "i no power".
Their mentality is "never mind", since customers always a lot.

Only good point is good service.
Mostly just for ppl to show they been to a spa.
NOT for a massage with good strength. 👎

reviews.name: Kwong Tang
reviews.text:
🌿🧘 Rejuvenating Bliss at Let's Relax Onsen & Spa, Thonglor 🌸💆‍♂️

Visited Let's Relax Onsen & Spa in Thonglor during my Bangkok exploration and wow, what a game-changer! 🌟 I'm usually not big on massages, but their 120-minute Thai massage was simply divine, totally changing my perspective. 🙌

The onsen, inspired by Japanese traditions, was a serene escape with mineral bathtubs, sauna, steam, and more, offering an all-around soothing experience. 🛁 The balance of quality and reasonable pricing was just right.

And to top it all off, they served us a delightful Mango Sticky Rice with Tea. This sweet treat was the perfect end to massage. 🥭🍚🍵

Already planning a second visit for their Onsen next time. A must-try for anyone in need of top-notch relaxation in Bangkok! 🥰

reviews.name: Penny Gaffney
reviews.text:
Always had the best time with massage here!
Still one of my most favourite Let's relax branches in Thailand. Good relaxing space and great massage options! Plus for location with onsen available.
Lovely staff and nice, clean room!
My sister and I did the body scrub and aroma therapy this visit. The oil and body scrub were divine!
Always have hot tea with mango and sticky rice provided after massage 😘

reviews.name: Brian Pearce
reviews.text:
One of those business ideas that freaking works. Not a new one but done exceptionally well! It’s basically a hotel-situated-spa with excellent ONSEN style baths/showers/Sauna/SteamRoom and Additional Healing/Resting Space to relax or catch-up on some work.👌 PS Onsens are fully naked.

The Baths are slightly smaller than the new Lumpini branch but very similar vibes. Quality is consistent. Temps, cleanliness, facilities… Which is something we appreciate. You can achieve very similar Zen levels and healing at either locations.

I’m amazed at their 5 baths, heat bath, cold bath, milk bath, some other cool bath and their mini hydro therapy bath (massages)😈 it’s just great they have them!

Wifey opted to become a 12month member which gives her daily access plus a reduced 500baht access to her plus one. (Me) which is reduced from 750. —  if you use the space more than twice a week. It adds up quickly and we found more value with the 12month package even tho we are only using it for 6 months. Because we planned on using at least 4-5 per week average. — If you are a couple and love your spa chills, this place is an excellent extension to any hotel or living arrangement in Bangkok.

It’s nice to have a second alternative chill base where you can spend a couple of hours to relax, get some work done.

Both venues Thonglor Branch (this one) and Lumphini Branch (newer one) have super late closing hours.

They are both in an excellent hotel which is nice.

both have a mini kitchen that serves food to purchase and they also provide free snacks and waters.

We are hunters of steam rooms, saunas located in hotels, gyms and spas, and this build is a good one for putting real work in the bath facilities.

Don’t  think the experience will be perfect every time, the crowd gets busy at different times, so expect that too.

For what it is I think it’s pretty good value and definitely worth a visit once if you are ever in Bangkok and love public baths , saunas , onsens etc.

reviews.name: Becky Palmer
reviews.text: Absolutly loved this place. 750baht for the onsen day pass and I never wanted to leave, had a real luxury feel with the 5 different types of bath, sauna, steam, relaxation room, cool room and hot rock room. Staff were so lovely and patient explaining how the onsen works as it was my first time and answered any questions I had. Also im plus sized (uk size 24) and the clothes they provided i was able to fit into which I was really happy about

reviews.name: U Ni
reviews.text:
Located on the fifth floor of the Grande Centre Point Hotel in Thonglor, Let’s Relax Spa offers an exceptional wellness experience. The spa features a hot bath enriched with luxurious minerals that provide continuous protection and nourishment for your body.

Whether you’re seeking relaxation, rejuvenation, or simply a moment of tranquility, this spa delivers an unforgettable experience.

reviews.name: Pang Thunyalak
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had! I have tried many times with different branches but I really love the service here. The skills they all was perfect. Staff also nice. This place was very clean. I would recommend body scrub and oil massages. They will also provide you a hot tea and mango sticky rice 🥭 I advise you to call or book via official website before heading there. Next time I would try onsen ♨️

reviews.name: l y
reviews.text:
Everyone recommends let's relax spa. Don't be put off by it being a massive chain massage brand. It's a very good and solid option.

The environment is top notch, clean and coomfortable.  The massages were very relaxing and enjoyable. The staff were nice and friendly.

To top it off, the post massage snack is a nice mango sticky rice and jasmine tea.

It is pricey but well worth the money.

reviews.name: NNchan
reviews.text: A good spa branch that maintains consistent quality across the locations I’ve visited. This branch features an onsen as its highlight. Although the area is smaller compared to the Lumphini branch, it’s still a great experience. The staff are professional and provide excellent service.

reviews.name: Tar T
reviews.text: Incredible spa experience. We got the 90 minute oil massage and it was phenomenal, could definitely feel it lingering on me for the remainder of the day. The space is really clean, well-lit, and the workers are really polite and nice. In the spa lobby, they have pandan juice, infused water and light Thai snacks. After your session is done, you are ended with a warm cup of tea and mango sticky rice. The mango sticky rice was so good, it made me crave more afterwards haha! I would recommend this experience to anyone.

reviews.name: Wanderlust
reviews.text:
Did their aroma oil massage, the experience was alright, the therapist aren’t super powerful, so if you’re looking for powerful massage this is not the place to be.
The decor was nice and inside was clean. They take credit card and ends the massage with a mango sticky rice which was a nice touch.

reviews.name: Julia | Management – Lyvin
reviews.text: Best ever sauna experience! Sense of harmony relax and felt like heaven. Must visit in Bangkok.

reviews.name: j L
reviews.text:
Let’s Relax Spa offers a well priced array of massages, scrubs, wraps, sauna, and onsen. There are not words for how amazing their onsen is! Firstly, it is simply just beautiful, with modern design and high tech equipment, yet traditional wood as material for comfort and grounding.

Then, there is the dedication to quality in every aspect of their operations. Not only is the service outstanding with warm greetings from the staff and managers alike, but also in terms of massage services, their masseuses are well trained and professional. I tried both the 60min Thai massage and the 60min foot massage. I love that the first thing they do is soak and wash your feet in a warm bath for you. For the Thai massage, they were firm yet controlled with their strength and able to get a few cracks out of my tired back. For the foot massage, I got to lie back on a thickly padded leather chair, while the skilled masseuse worked at my weary shins and feet with great meticulousness, while applying both hot and cold compresses in between. So amazing!

And that’s just the massage. The onsen will blow you away!! There are 5 different types of baths you can soak in — soda, whirlpool, silk, gero, and cold. And there is a sizable steam sauna and dry sauna. You can choose from 3 different “paths” of onsen therapy: beauty, relaxation, and health. While there many steps to each path, you can always refer back to the wall chart in between dips to remind yourself what to do next. The onsen section is extremely well designed, allowing guest to check in with an electronic waterproof wristband that also acts as the locker key. Genius. While the male and female baths are separated, there is a relaxation room for you to meet the other gender while cooling off, although you should remain quiet.

For most packages, they offer a small mango and sticky rice dessert after the massage and before the onsen. I also love their refreshing pandan water that helps detoxify your body and rehydrates you further after a massage.

Overall, I can only highly recommend this spa to anyone who appreciates great value, service, massage and onsen!! Love love love!! Will definitely be back for more whenever I’m in Bangkok!!

title: Chanachda Massage & Spa
subTitle: Chanachda Health Massage

High quality massage

reviews.text: I initially went for a one-hour Thai massage and it was so good I asked for it to be two hours in the middle of the massage! I can’t recommend it highly enough. Defiantly has become my go-to massage spa whenever I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Елена Ельницкая
reviews.text:
Great experience I had. Thank you.

(I would suggest to add face massage, everything else is simply perfect )

reviews.name: Lavan Chiang
reviews.text:
The massage technique was fine, and the therapist was very skilled, but I found the shop to be dishonest. Online, the price list showed 600 THB for two hours, but they ended up charging me 800 THB.

The environment was very old and poorly maintained. The staff chatted loudly, and the space had a lingering musty smell. Considering the price, the cost-performance ratio was very low compared to higher-end options. It felt like they were overcharging tourists, as a nearby high-end spa next to the BTS offers a two-hour Thai massage for only 700 THB, including a foot-washing service, whereas this place only provided a simple wipe-down.

I would not recommend this place at all.

reviews.name: kristina herself
reviews.text: I have been here twice to get the foot massage and it was amazing both times. They apply good pressure and the space is very clean and calming. They also wash your feet with salts and lemon, which is a lovely touch. Quality service!

reviews.name: Emma Overton
reviews.text:
This is by far the best foot massage I have gotten in Thailand. The quality is not only excellent, but consistent as well. The owner is extremely knowledgeable and practiced (there are at least nine certificates on the wall from massage schools). She also truly enjoys what she does, so you feel like you are getting a genuine, engaged experience.

On another note, she is both owner and operator, so the fees don’t go to some nameless, faceless company—what you pay goes straight to the woman who built this business from the ground up.

Truly wonderful and worth the trip. I wish I could leave multiple reviews this place is so good.

reviews.name: mickael lefebvre
reviews.text:

This is a very very good option in this area. I would definitely go a second time if I was staying in the area.

reviews.name: julia bodys
reviews.text: That was the most amazing Thai foot massage I have ever had, and I have to say I tried a lot of those in my life! It was an amazing experience and a big pleasure! I already made another appointment for the next day!

I had a really good massage with elements of Thai massage within (but nothing that hurt my hip.) Clean, charming, and very capable massage.

reviews.name: Hadil Omar
reviews.text:
I took my mom there and she enjoyed the experience very much. The receptionist was lovely, the person who replied to me in line was helpful too and my mom said the massager was really lovely too and she found the pressure to be very suitable.
I don’t know the massager’s name but we came in today (1st of June) at 3 o’clock and my mom did the aroma oil massage for one hour.
We also got tea pack as a gift which was lovely.

We’ll definitely come back again soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a lovely and detailed review 😊 We are so glad that both you and your mother had a wonderful experience with us.

We are glad that your mother enjoyed the aromatherapy massage and felt that the therapist's pressure was just right, as well as receiving excellent care from the reception team and the staff who provided information over the phone. Your compliments mean a lot to everyone on the team.

Thank you also for liking the tea set we prepared as a small gift. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you and your mother back again soon 💙

reviews.name: Ashley Perez
reviews.text: Second time here and had another great experience. Very lovely staff, they are very friendly and helpful and the massage that I had really helped with my issues from being on the computer all day. Very reasonable prices as well. Will be back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for returning for your second visit! 🙏❤️ We are delighted that you had another excellent experience and were impressed with the friendliness, hospitality, and care of our team. 😊 We are especially glad that the massage helped you relax and relieved your fatigue from working at the computer. ✨ Thank you for your compliments on the value for money, and thank you for your continued trust in us. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon! 💆‍♀️💆‍♂️❤️

reviews.name: Carly travely
reviews.text: Best foot massage I've ever had in Thailand and I've tried over 60 massages specially in Bangkok. Definitely a MUST visit and they're very popular among Japanese people that like all things to be perfect so the details of the shop are amazing and the therapist are very skilled. I recommend to book first because they are very busy everyday. 🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a lovely and detailed review 🙏🥰 We are deeply honored that you have considered our foot massage experience one of the best in Thailand 💖
We are so glad you were impressed with both the attention to detail at our salon and the skills of our therapists. Our entire team always strives to provide the best possible care.
Thank you also for your advice on making reservations in advance 🙏 We hope to welcome you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Sathita H. (Fern)
reviews.text: Today is my first time at AT EASE 39, I found this shop from ChatGPT recommendations. All is good. This is like the way the massage shop should be. I feel relaxed since I entered. Great receptionist and all staffs are very welcome and enthusiastic. Good skillful therapist. I forgot to ask her name. I had a wonderful time doing body scrub and aromatherapy will come back again if I come around this area. Nice place, clean, nice aroma, I love healthy plants inside.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your warm and detailed review 🙏💚 We are so happy that you chose to visit us, and we are delighted that every element, from the atmosphere, the welcome, the care from our staff, to the body scrub and aromatherapy, contributed to your wonderful experience.

Your compliments mean a lot to our entire team, including our therapists. We are glad you enjoyed the tranquil atmosphere, cleanliness, pleasant scents, and green spaces within the salon, which we have carefully created to provide a truly relaxing environment for everyone.

Thank you again for your trust, and we sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome and care for you again when you are in the area. 😊✨

reviews.text:
Extremely good massage(salon). The staff is extremely friendly and attentive, the salon is very clean and serene. They just do everything a little better than elsewhere. My masseuse (Eve) was very skilled, used the perfect pressure and checked if I was comfortable.

I will definitely come again! 🙏🙏🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed the clean and serene atmosphere, as well as the attentive service. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with Eve. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon! 🙏

We look forward to seeing you again

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We truly appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention and hope we will have the opportunity to serve you better in the future.

at ease owner
Keiji Ueno

reviews.text: Great Thai massage experience, clean, calm atmosphere and very skilled therapist. I left feeling relaxed, refreshed, and much less tense. Friendly staff and good value. Would come back!

reviews.name: CHIN SOON SIAH
reviews.text:
I had a great experience here. The massage service was excellent, and the therapist’s pressure was just right—firm and very effective.

I came in with a cramp in my front thigh, and after the session, it felt significantly relieved and much more relaxed. The therapist really knew how to target the problem area.

Overall, I feel much better now and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a good, effective massage.

And get a free gift 🎁!

reviews.name: W P
reviews.text:
This was our second visit to Vela Thai Massage, and once again it was an absolutely wonderful experience! 🌿✨

From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was calm, peaceful, and beautifully relaxing. The staff are incredibly kind, professional, and skilled—they truly know how to make you feel comfortable and taken care of.

The massage was deep, therapeutic, and exactly what we needed. We left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and re-energized. Everything from the ambiance to the service is consistently top quality.

We are definitely coming back again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic, top-tier Thai massage experience. 💆‍♀️💆‍♂️

reviews.text: If only i can rate this place 0/5, I would! Do not go here! Not relaxing at all!!! Too noisy and the masseuse is not even good at all! Not worth the money! I hate this place so much. Ruined my last night in thailand

reviews.name: Jayne Ang
reviews.text:
I’m not sure why this place earns a 4.8 rating because both masseuses assigned to us both are equally poor in their skills. I had a male masseuse and was anticipating he might apply a stronger pressure than I could handle but turns out I had to ask him to step up multiple times. I’m one who is afraid of pressure pain but he wasn’t hitting all the right spots and he is just brushing on my skin without much pressure. The sequence of going through different spots are also inconsistent, can feel that he lacks experience and skills.

At the front desk, before we start the service they informed us that we can change masseuse if we do not like their service. Now that I think back, no massage places really gave that option but they made it a point to inform every customer. Seems like they experience this quite a lot so why not put in effort to train your masseuses to be better?

reviews.name: Georgina Moore
reviews.text:
I had a very uncomfortable and disappointing experience here.

I get massages regularly in both Thailand and Australia, so I’m very familiar with what a professional treatment should feel like. Unfortunately, this was one of the worst experiences I’ve had in Thailand.

I booked a back and foot massage, but the treatment felt extremely inconsistent and unprofessional. The therapist spent much more time on one side of my back than the other, using completely different techniques. One side of my lower back was even missed until I pointed it out and still didn’t do it.

Despite clearly saying I don’t like my arms being masssaged she did so. The same pattern continued throughout — one leg was massaged while the other was skipped, and I didn’t receive a proper foot massage at all, just basic rubbing up and down of my legs.

The entire session felt disorganised and not structured at all.

What made the experience even more uncomfortable was the behaviour at the end. The therapist repeatedly called me “sexy” and, without consent, touched my chest. This was completely inappropriate and made me feel very uneasy.

I would not recommend this place.

reviews.text: One of the best massages I had in Thailand. I expected a great massage, but after the first hour, I requested another 30 minutes because I knew this kind of quality is not easy to come by. Will definitely be my new go-to spot in Bangkok for now on. 7/5 if I could rate it higher

reviews.name: Chopper SOCIETY
reviews.text: Honest review friendly,clean,reasonable price. That's it.if you want a full body deep tissue massage ! this is not the place to go, the girl was nice, she stayed in all the areas way too long. I only received about 35 to 40% of my body massaged.they make you wear pants during massage which are extremely uncomfortable,especially if your use to a towl.the pants they made me wear were way too tight. they were hurting my you know what, i told her many times,she just laughed.I dont recommend! if you want to be satisfied and receive a full body massage dont go here! In some of the sensitive areas by my groin and inner legs she massaged so hard I thought I was going to pass out extremely  painful I showed signs of severe pain and moved away she still did it . I kept on telling her go easy she was hurting me. I told the owner which was a waste of time. My body is still hurting. I need to find a place that gives you a full body deep tissue massage that knows to massage the whole body not just spend 40 minutes in one area. She told me it was 10 minutes left. I said you did not even do the front she kept doing the back anyway I had to literally turn around and ask her to do the front it was such a waste of my time I really wish I could have got a good massage. I listen to all the reviews on here .there was one or two bad reviews and that's the one's that truly describe what this place is really like.I can't believe I didn't listen to the bad reviews ,they were true. I was very disappointed. I just bought a condo  up the street and I'm looking for a regular place.and I can tell you that this will not be it. Don't get me wrong I'm not trying to be mean. I'm just trying to be truthful. I still gave the girl a good tip I just don't think she was very good. very disappointed I gave two stars but I really only want to give one star. I hope this helps other people!better off going to mall for chair massage! horrible!!!

reviews.name: Mayank Mittal
reviews.text: I was searching for a foot massage place with reasonable price and good service. I found this spa place opposite to Indira Square, a small and not that good looking shop. They are charging 200 Baht for 1hr foot massage. Me and my wife decided to take our first Thai foot massage here. I really loved the service, full relaxation and giving extra time to your pain points if you tell them during massage session. Their staff is well trained and taking good care of the customers. They are putting enough time and efforts so that customers don't feel that they are not giving proper massage. I would like to recommend to try their spa atleast once. Go for their service by not seeing the size of their shop.

reviews.name: Clare FYR
reviews.text:
Amazing value for money, price is cheaper vs a lot of the other nearby stores -  250 for Thai and 400 for oil. But quality of the massage was right up there!!  No frills place but clean. And most importantly, the person who did my oil massage - Pen was one of the best massage I’ve had in Thailand. Great technique and pressure. Don’t be fooled by her small size. 100% will return. Great little underrated gem.
I also liked that they were not pushy when I walked passed, unlike some of the other nearby stores.

reviews.name: A
reviews.text:
Chose this after checking out a few massage parlors. Quite clean and inviting but instead of my original 5 star review, I decided to give 3 instead.

Massage was good but the payment part was pretty questionable after my friend analyse dfor me.

Why was I charged 5% fee for paying via youtrip. What kind of warped payment mehtid is this and it’s not mentioned upfront? We probably concluded the establishment probably want to earn extra money cause we didn’t pay by cash. If so, then it maybe wrongful and deceitful.

Guys, check carefully before you patronise them.

Update as of June 2026

Chanced upon the establishment's reply. Was appalled by their  stark response. If you felt wrongful about the review, you should adopt a professional response to highlight to the reviewed and not in a tone that comes across as potentially threat.

My review was based purely on my experience. In this instance, if you believed that my review could be factually incorrect, then bring the right attitude and professionalism to address the areas of concern and be assuring that an established brand, you uphold clean and legit practices. If your attitude was right, I may consider amending the review.

Let me also suggest to you that you could also look into display detailed signage for the sake of greater transparency, or train the cashier to be very clear with customers for future payments. Not come and tell me off, cause the tone just ticks me off.

reviews.name: Emily Muckalt
reviews.text:
I wouldn’t recommend going here.

Initially we were escorted to the upstairs rooms and the guy didn’t give us the clothes to change into. We all just stood around for like 2 minutes looking confused.

You do get a choice between a male or female masseuse. However my partner and I agreed that the massage was quite subpar. All the lady did was squeeze my legs and arms for an hour and dig her elbows into my back. I had a much better massage experience in HCMC. The price is ok but for what you get I would recommend going somewhere else as there are many other shops along the street that offer the same prices.

I can’t speak to the entire establishment, but the masseuses we had were not good. They also didn’t offer tea after the experience (which is written outside the room in Thai they’re supposed to do lol).

reviews.name: Vikas Sood
reviews.text: The best message for peanuts. It was very professional and relaxing..Went there 3 times in my 5 days trip.

reviews.name: IA CN
reviews.text: 2nd time here and I gotta say it’s definitely one of the best value for money massage places in the vicinity. Shop dosent look like much from the outside, but the massages are good. It’s a no frills place, (prob similar to most along the same street), but I can say that the quality for my oil massage by som si(?) was good. Better than a bunch of places I’ve tried near Siam at almost double the price (~750thb vs 400thb here for a 1hr oil massage). Will return to try the Thai massage at 250thb as well for sure. They also don’t pressure you to tip, but if you get a good massage I think it’s only fair to tip them for their hardwork given the great price you’re already paying

reviews.name: Aditya Shirodkar
reviews.text:
Bua Thai Massage located opposite Indra Square is a budget friendly massage parlour.

They offer a variety of services purely for therapy & no other options.

Their therapists are very good- Aon, Koh , Anne & Pen.

They charge only 200THB equal to 600INR for foot massage which is very relaxing.

reviews.name: Patricia Rushton
reviews.text: Very gentle and takes the time to find out what hurts and uses the right amount of pressure to reduce pain and help to relax sore muscles.  Will definitely be coming back.  The lady's are amazing.

reviews.name: Kang Yi Jing
reviews.text: Great service and good skill.Cat liver will loved it. Have mr meow meow at shop 🐱

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text:
i must say that i doubted at the beginning, late start, no feet washing using water.

But im super impressed with the masseuse. the pressure point was just right, its beyond their 250 baht service! They wipe your feet using some cold towel.

I highly recommend you give a try, note down the masseuse or masseur

the young quiet guy with some tattoos on hands are good!
a short lady that talkative and cheerful is also good!

reviews.name: L L
reviews.text: Foot and leg massage for 200 baht an hour. Thai body massage for 250 baht/ hour and oil massage is 500 baht/ hour. The massage is legit. Very professional and the lady masseuses are very funny. They soak and wash your feet in lemon water before the massage and ends with a short but nice shoulder, back and head massage.

reviews.name: agathos007
reviews.text: Good massage for the price! You can choose a male or female therapist. I saw some posts stating they do not have other rooms but they have an upstairs with mats/cushions. We did the Oil Massage for 400 BHT and tipped another 100 BHT. I had Tom as my therapist and he did a great job. He spent a genuine hour on the massage and really put forth great effort. Great job Tom!

reviews.name: Kathleen Bernabe
reviews.text: went here because of high reviews among the other massages near our hotel. we tried their foot massage because we were tired from all the walking, and it was sooo worth it. glad i tried this place! will definitely come back some other day when we need another massage ❤️ the staffs were very friendly as well!!! 200 thb is such a good deal for the quality of the massage.

reviews.name: Sevo Flurane
reviews.text: This place is very affordable. I’ve had two excellent massages with Mister Bomb. I highly recommended him. There is no private room for massage and a shared shower. I am totally ok with that. I recommend coconut oil massage. Left my skin super soft afterwards. Will be back for sure.

reviews.name: Sherwinson Basuel
reviews.text: Simple looking place, but the massage is good! Very polite masseur. Total relaxation!

reviews.name: CH Lam
reviews.text:
I usually go to L**s Re**x Thai massage but Bua massage is the go to place unless you are trying to impress a date.

No hard selling at the door. Very professional.

Bua massage by Moon (masseur) gave an incredible Thai massage. I requested the one hour treatment but the effectiveness was better than a two hour massage at the mentioned franchise.

Of course for this price there was no private room but I went in the afternoon and I was the only patron on the 2nd floor. Air-conditioning was good and the street nouse level was acceptable. (Similar to the payathai area with the train and cars).

As mentioned by others, feet cleaning was done using a cold towel.

Water is offered at the end of the massage but the savings here can buy you all the sticky mango rice you want.

Great value. Would definitely come again.

reviews.name: Jelena Korać

reviews.name: Cf Hew
reviews.text: i got to know this massage place via google with good comments from others..so i  decided to give it a try..i initially booked Moon for 90 minutes thai massage. after about 10 minutes massage i decided to extend to 2 hours ..👍..he is good..i had tried many places for thai massage and he is the best so far.good skill, good pressure .i will book him again whenever i go to bangkok.

reviews.name: Scott Pavon Chan
reviews.text:
I visited yesterday for their 2-hour package: Body Salt Scrub + Aroma Oil Massage

I can confidently say that Makkha's approach to massages as an experience blows all other spas I've been to out of the water.

I have been lucky enough to be offered a single room, where to my surprise, I was able to customize the entire experience, from the temperature of air-conditioning to the volume of the soothing music. There is even a padlock safe provided for peace of mind, and the shower came with amenities of all kinds that honestly beat the showers at some Bangkok hotels.

Onto the massage itself, everything went professionally. There is nothing for me to nitpick about in terms of the masseuse's technique, from start to finish I did not once feel pain; this for me is an anomaly as I am extremely sensitive and can react badly to unexpected roughness in technique.

Second, I was very surprised that the aroma oil used did not induce any allergic response, this is usually the case for me in other spas, so it really caught me off guard.

My skin felt noticeably smoother, softer after the body salt scrub, I think that is probably the most underrated treatment available at Makkha, despite it not being recommended on the menu.

I cannot emphasize how great of an experience I had at Makkha, and I can't wait to make my eventual return to Bangkok and their many branches.

title: Yunomori Onsen & Spa Sukhumvit Soi 26
subTitle: ยูโนะโมริ ออนเซ็น แอนด์ สปา สุขุมวิท ซอย 26
description: Upscale, Japanese-inspired spa facility offering thermal pools, massage therapy & body scrubs.
ownerDescription:
Discover Yunomori Onsen and Spa in Sukhumvit, where we combine Japanese onsen bathing culture with traditional Thai massage techniques. Bathe in healing water sourced from the thermal springs of Wat Wangkanai to detoxify and relax the body and enhance the effects of massages done by our spa’s expert therapists. We offer therapeutic massage treatments from head to toe for relaxation and overall well-being.

Yunomori wellness spa in Sukhumvit, Bangkok, offers a place of refuge when you want to retreat from the hectic pace of city life. Whether you need to escape for an hour or a day, our onsen, spa, cafe, and beauty clinic are designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing environment to refresh and rejuvenate the mind, body, and spirit.
address: 120, PH98+VP6, 5 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Pk
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed this onsen—it’s such a relaxing place to unwind. I love how spacious it is, with everything conveniently located on the same floor. The high ceilings in the onsen area make it feel even more open and comfortable.

My favorite part is the garden area with the outdoor teak onsen. It made me feel especially refreshed and relaxed compared with other onsens I’ve visited. One thing I was wondering about, though, is that I couldn’t find a sauna room in the onsen area.

The rest area can get a little crowded in the evening, but the beds are very comfortable, so it’s still a great place to rest.

The restaurant also serves good-quality, healthy meals, and the matcha soft serve is definitely worth trying!

Parking is convenient, it’s free for the first 2 hours and 20bath/hr afterwards

Overall, a wonderful place for a relaxing onsen experience. ♨️🌿
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Pitchapa K,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the spacious onsen, relaxing garden area, and especially our outdoor teak onsen. ♨️🌿 It’s wonderful to know that you found the atmosphere refreshing and comfortable.

We’re also glad you enjoyed our restaurant and healthy meals, as well as the matcha soft serve! 🍵🍦 Your kind words mean a lot to our team.

We truly appreciate your feedback regarding the sauna and the evening crowd in the rest area. We’ll be sure to share your comments with our team as we continue working to improve our guests’ experience.

Thank you again for your support and recommendation. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back soon for another relaxing onsen, massage, and dining experience. 😊

Kind regards,
Yunomori Onsen & Spa

reviews.name: Tammi - Luxury Travel
reviews.text:
Yunomori Spa in Bangkok is more of a full spa experience, not just a massage.

It’s set up like a Japanese onsen, and the onsen itself is amazing. There are a few different pools, hot, cold, and different temperatures, so you can move between them and actually feel your body relax.

The massages are really good too. I like to do onsen then my massage.

The whole place is clean, organized, and runs smoothly.

Just know,they do give you disposable net underwear to wear in the onsen area, which makes it more comfortable if you’re not used to it.

Quick etiquette so you’re not caught off guard:
Shower before you go in, keep your voice down, and don’t bring your towel into the water.

If you want more than just a quick massage and actually want to relax for a few hours, this is worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tammi - Luxury Travel,

We are truly grateful for your 5-star review and wonderful feedback. Your compliments mean the world to our staff and motivate us to serve every guest with passion and dedication. It was an honor to have you with us, and we hope to welcome you back to our onsen again soon.

reviews.name: Jack
reviews.text:
Stressful experience. I had the onsen from 10:30 - 11:15, but from 10:50-11:15 I was looking for my towel because I didn’t have one. Then a staff member came and took my towel away for absolutely no reason, despite the fact I was practically alone in the onsen

I panicked because I had a massage booked for 11:30, so I left the onsen early and spent almost 30 minutes standing wet and naked trying to figure out what to do. I called reception and they didn’t answer. I reached out on social media where they read my messages and ignored me.

I couldn’t leave the onsen and walk to reception because my clothes were inside my locker and the key for locker 28 wasn’t working properly! And anyway, I was soaking wet

I also didn’t receive a small towel. I have been to hundreds of onsens across Japan and they always give a small towel to take inside the onsen. But here at Yunomori they don’t provide… bizarre

They also don’t have hats or seating mats for the sauna and steam room which is shocking

I left the onsen completely stressed and upset - having wasted so much money to stand around cold, wet and naked trying to find a towel… and then I had a massage booked (which is why I had to rush in the onsen and why the time lost was so upsetting)

Also, the clocks inside the onsen are ahead of time by almost 10 minutes, perhaps to make you rush. A staff member came and told me I had to leave the onsen at 11:15 but on my phone the actual time was 11:07.

The staff seemed annoyed with me that I was late, and the massage was a little rough. I was also a little dehydrated because there was no drink offered after the onsen. Later, the masseuse burned me a few times with the hot compress.

I tried explaining the situation to staff at reception after but she said I was lying and just said “you should speak to onsen staff, not us”

They didn’t offer a single apology about the towel problem.

The restaurant next door Happy Rice is also quite bad with cold microwaved food and full of mosquitoes

There were no staff members inside the onsen for over 45 minutes which is unprofessional. They should provide additional towels for guests just in case, or have a call button for people to use in case they need a staff member.

Also, my partner and I left the spa with really bad migraines and we’re not sure why

We left stressed and upset, and now I need a nap to calm down. It’s so sad to leave one star for an onsen - something that should be so wonderful and relaxing

I really hope they read this review and share it with staff and management. I hope they improve and I can come back and enjoy it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize for the stressful experience you had during your visit. We are truly sorry that your time with us, which should have been relaxing and enjoyable, caused you inconvenience and discomfort.

We appreciate you bringing these concerns to our attention, including the issues regarding towel service, locker access, communication with our team, and your overall experience with the facilities and treatments. Your feedback is very important to us, and we will share it with our management and related teams for further review and improvement.

We sincerely regret that we did not provide the level of care and support you expected. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future and provide you with the relaxing and positive experience that you should have received.

If there is anything further that made you feel uncomfortable or if you would like to share additional details with us, please feel free to contact us directly at sukhumvit26@yunomorionsen.com. We would be happy to listen and assist you further.

All in all great experience and can definitely recommend.

reviews.text:
Update: they have actually increased the temperature of the sauna, that’s why I’m giving 5 stars now.
I have a monthly membership at this Onsen. Reason being that it is decent AND is open until late which most are not. The only real pain point is that the temperature of the sauna hovers around 55-60 degrees Celcius which is just not hot enough for me. And that really bothers me. If the sauna had a higher temperature I would give 5 stars. But I didn’t find another place that’s open until late and has a hotter sauna. But still overall it’s a good place. Staff are very friendly. Visitors are mostly quiet Asians, not many farangs, so it’s a different vibe than ice baths. Be aware that these onsens are a meeting place for LGBT people, so you might get approached. But a no is usually accepted.

reviews.text: Been coming here for years and love it so much.  My perfect little Sunday ritual. Highly recommend!! Not pretentious like some of the other spas and onsens.

reviews.name: Chris B
reviews.text: A lovely experience. If you are British like me, it’s a naked sauna and you only have a small square towel to get in. Process - go in, get undressed and you take the small towel as a cover, wash at the small basins through the door. You just have to get over being naked. You can wear the cool robes when you leave the Onsen area, in the cafe etc. you can also go back in as many times as you like, you can get a cool face towel and new towels each time you enter. The pools are very very hot, and the cold ones almost freezing so use the shower on coldest setting. Note - busy in the afternoons and evening, so go on a morning or weekday afternoon for a quieter experience. Enjoy!

reviews.name: Putthida Hensawang
reviews.text:
I am beyond frustrated and disappointed with Yurimori Onsen.

My belongings have gone missing twice at your facility, and both times there has been absolutely no accountability, no follow-up, and no effort to help recover the missing items. Every time I call, the response is simply “we don’t know,” and nobody ever contacts me back.

This is unacceptable for any business, let alone a premium spa that charges customers for a supposedly high-quality experience. Basic security and customer care should be the minimum standard.

The fact that items can disappear twice without any explanation raises serious concerns about the safety and management of your facility. Customers should not have to fear losing their belongings when visiting your establishment.

Unless this issue is properly addressed, I will have difficulty recommending Yurimori Onsen to anyone. I expect a prompt explanation and a serious investigation into what happened.

She was very professional, friendly, and always communicated with me to find out about the correct pressure and how I feel. I was happy with her massage technique as it was a gliding massage with the correct pressure rather than using firm pressure on various points of the shoulder/shoulder blades. I was very much relaxed during the massage. One of the best massages I had for a long time. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Lizard King
reviews.text:
Had high expectations due to other reviews, but won’t be coming back. The whole place is a hit or miss it seems.

So I booked “Blissful Harmony” for myself, which is a combination of 30 minutes foot massage, 30 minutes of back+head+shoulders, and 60 minutes of Thai massage.

I requested a firm pressure, and the pressure the masseuse applied was somewhere between soft and normal. The whole “massage” thing was just her touching my skin real slow. She did pay attention to the areas I asked to focus on, but in a way that she only ever focused on them, missing all the rest… not that it changed anything for me anyway, given the pressure and massage technique itself.

Now I’ve been living in Thailand for well over a year, and I get massages regularly, so I know how it feels to get a proper one.
- Was the massage I received here Thai? Well, in terms of being performed by a Thai, sure, but that’s about it. It was honestly the worst experience I had in the country, such a waste of time and money.
- Was the massage at least relaxing? In terms of me almost falling asleep, sure. But it wasn’t a muscle tension release or anything near that.

Which is a shame, given how much thought is clearly put into the organization of the whole process: the place looks great, reception is really polite and friendly, they give tasty complimentary drinks before and after the massage, wash your legs with sea salt and bergamot before the session, ask you to fill the form before and after it. But unfortunately, all that just doesn’t matter when the actual purpose of the whole business isn’t done right. I honestly received better massages for much less money pretty much anywhere else.

Oh, and on top of that, if you want to pay cashless, they would charge you not even 3% more like in some other places, but 5% more.

All in all, looks nice, but not worth it

With the price, I cannot be too disappointed— however, Thailand has some of the best, if not THE best masseuses in the world, which is where my disappointment comes in. They were friendly.

For just 500 baht per hour, I received an incredibly relaxing and professional massage that left me feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. The therapists here truly know their craft, using the perfect balance of pressure and technique to relieve tension and stress.

The atmosphere was clean, comfortable, and welcoming, making it even easier to unwind. Unlike some of the more touristy spots, this place had a more authentic and calming vibe, which made the experience even better.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a high-quality massage at an affordable price, I highly recommend giving this place a try. Sometimes, the best experiences come when you least expect them!

reviews.name: Dan Pieloch
reviews.text:
Our group of four visited here the evening of 20 June. I wanted a 1.5hr oil massage, but the menu of services only listed the one hour option for 700 Thai Baht. I asked the price for 1.5hrs, was told it was 1050 Baht, then requested two 1.5hr oil massages for my wife and I. Our other couple picked a Thai massage and foot massage for 1.5hrs. The bill was 2600 Baht, which couldn't be right. The young lady at the counter had a Trainee nametag, and I asked her was the price correct, and she said yes. She was right, but that's because she rung us all up for 1hr services instead of what we requested. Not the end of the world, and she was really friendly, so it was no big deal.

Our massage was on the fourth floor (3rd floor for the non-Americans), and we humped up three flights of stairs. Not the most comfortable, but also not a big deal.

The big deal was that our room had an AC unit that blew hot air only. The room never cooled, and my wife and I and our two masseuses were boiling. Our massages were still good, but we were sweating like Meatloaf up in that joint. It made it challenging to relax.

The service was really good from all the ladies working there. And the place is clean and pleasant. It's a decent place for a massage if you're in Chiang Mai, but we'll keep looking for our next massage.

reviews.name: Songyang Lyu
reviews.text:
Authentic Thai Atmosphere, Impeccable Service

Le Panna Massage provides a consistently excellent experience. The space is thoughtfully designed—from the tranquil massage area with its private curtained beds to the comfortable foot massage lounge with beautiful wooden screens. The staff is professional and attentive, as seen in the detailed care during treatments.

I especially appreciate the small touches: the welcome drink served in crystal glasses with a fresh flower, the neatly organized service menu, and the clean, calming decor throughout. The separate “La Princess” reception area adds a touch of elegance.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a peaceful, authentic Thai massage in a well-maintained and welcoming environment. Will definitely return.

reviews.text: It was a wonderful and relaxing experience. There were beverages ready for us before and after the massage. We did the original thai massage which was 350 thb. Very good price for this beautiful place. The masseuse was very gentle because I requested a softer thai massage.

That was really nice, as was the massage and especially the lady that massaged my wife (Jao was her name I think). I can recommend this place.

reviews.text:
The staff were warm and welcoming from the moment I arrived, which immediately set a comfortable tone. They engaged in light, friendly conversation without being intrusive, helping me relax and ease into the session.

I opted for a foot massage, and the therapist got the pressure just right—firm enough to relieve tension, but still very comfortable throughout. It felt well-paced and attentive, rather than rushed.
Overall, the experience was very pleasant. The environment was clean and calming, making it easy to unwind.

A solid choice if you’re looking for a relaxing and fuss-free massage.

reviews.text: The place is so good, they massage so well and take good care of their clients. They also give complimentary drinks and sweets. I like how wee massage me it reminds me of my mom. This is my 4th time and will come back again.

reviews.name: Catherine Yu
reviews.text:
i got a foot and head/neck/shoulder combo massage for 90 min. overall had an amazing experience! the masseuse was excellent and very receptive to my feedback on going lighter or harder. the only thing is that the only phrase she understood for that was “hard” and “soft”, if i asked for firmer or less pressure, she would just smile and nod and pretend she knew what was going on but did not change the amount of pressure used. after i figured out she understood hard and soft though, she was extremely accommodating whenever i asked for something different.

also, the entire massage treatment was done in a reclining chair, which was fine for the foot massage part. however, when she started with the upper body massage, it was a bit strange. i also kept my clothes on and she was sort of using my loose shirt as a cloth between her fingers and my skin, which seemed odd to me. additionally when she was targeting a lower section of my back she had me literally sitting in a chair, bent forward, which i have never experienced before in western style massages where you are always lying down on a massage table. in the sitting position i wasn’t able to fully relax and at times had to brace myself against the masseuse’s pressure. not 100% ideal, however i still had a great massage and it was very relaxing.

before the massage begins you fill out a form on places you want to target and avoid, and the masseuse did a superior job of hitting all of the spots that i wanted to be massaged.

overall, a great experience and very cheap for the treatment received.
