reviews.name: chloe
reviews.text:
I’ve visited this place twice, and both experiences were among the best massages I’ve had. I also love the ambience and scent of the spa.

On my first visit, around three months ago the receptionist didn't accept QR code payments and insisted on cash while trying to upsell me, which made me feel uncomfortable—though the therapist was amazing. When I returned today, there was a different receptionist who was much friendlier, and once again, the massage was absolutely fantastic!

reviews.name: Heino Seichi
reviews.text: The massage here is a must-try. I would recommend everyone to get a massage package of 2 hours or more. The massage therapist here has very good hand pressure. You can tell him to focus on different parts of your body. I’m so proud of this massage shop. If you come to Chiang Mai, you must try it at least once!!! Feel good, thanks

reviews.name: Marta Bureś
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience! The service was friendly, professional, and very well organized from start to finish. The massage was incredibly relaxing, and we left feeling refreshed and completely at ease. Thank you for such a pleasant experience – we would happily come back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage.

reviews.name: Madisen V
reviews.text: Great relaxing experience. One of the better massages I’ve gotten in Thailand and is well worth the price. The masseuse are professional, skilled and kind. You can let them know what type of pressure you prefer and any areas that need extra attention. The arch of my foot is particularly tight and she knew exactly what to do. The place is clean, cozy and modern looking. I would come here again.

reviews.name: kelly
reviews.text: Very good experience! Massage is on point, nice staff and comfortable environment, highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Quenie Ferolino
reviews.text:
The first thing I would say is the staff are very friendly and welcomes you with a warm greeting. For the woman who give me the most needed massage in life thank you so much. She indeed did a great job that she made me feel so comfortable during the massage.

After the massage I was offered with a tea in the lobby that taste so good and mini biscuit. Note you will get also a complimentary cute wallet♥️

I would greatly recommed them since it is very convinient when you stay in the hotel. Til’ next time 😉

reviews.name: Sara H
reviews.text: The aroma oil massage was amazing! The massage was relaxing, and the masseuse had great technique. The atmosphere was calm and I also appreciated the tea and cookies served afterward. Thank you

reviews.name: Basma Hamane
reviews.text: It was a good experience , after a long flight that is exactly what I needed . Clean , relaxed and calm , the staff are very nice

reviews.name: Shifan YANG
reviews.text:
It is super amazing! Place very beautiful and we pass by without appointment and the girl are so friendly 💜
The room is clean and good profume, our massager are so amazing I will definitely come back!!! Run for doing it here!!!

Especially thanks to our massager tonight: lhong and Gossi (หลงและกอสซี่) thanks to your hard work for giving us a new body, take a good rest😘💙

reviews.name: xander Felargo (Xander)
reviews.text:
Receptionist was kind and welcoming. She recommended the promtional 2 hour massage. I did. the 2 hour massage with Mint. She massaged everything that needed to me massaged and more. Now I am relaxed and ready to take a nap.

Do note that it is more expensive than other smaller shops around

reviews.name: Nadiashowntell
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing the best massage I have ever had in my life as someone who likes to travel in different countries and frequently get massages. This was absolutely my favorite Ming was amazing 20 out of 10 experience and I will definitely be revisiting next time. I’m in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Vivienne Reybell
reviews.text: A wonderful experience in Chiangmai~ excellent environment. I feel really relaxed after 1 hour oil massage. ^ love love

reviews.name: Vivian Ye
reviews.text: I had a 90 minutes hot oil massage. It was wonderful. Very relaxing. My masseuse is very professional and welcoming. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Meibh Campbell
reviews.text: amazing thai massage!! me and my boyfriend were left feeling very taken care of. we would recommend the thai oil massage. thank you to pun- my masseuse (sorry if spelling is wrong)

title: Zenza Massage and Spa (Ratchadamnoen branch)
subTitle: Zenza Massage & Spa
ownerDescription: At Zenza Massage & Spa we direct our attention to helping & caring those we love.
address: 80, 2 Rachadamnoen Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQP+8P Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Numwan PD
reviews.text:
My wonderful trip in Chiang Mai  , Have very pretty spa and look very clean next  to hotel at walking street very good location and I immediately understood what a professional Thai massage feels like. Even though it costs so reasonable, it’s absolutely worth it. I’ll definitely be back—see you again, Zenza Massage&Spa ❤️

I will come back again soon

reviews.name: Stephanie September
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa in Thailand. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and beautifully relaxing.

I chose the Oil Aromatherapy Massage, and it was everything I needed and more. My masseuse, Sa, was truly amazing — professional, attentive, and incredibly skilled. She had the perfect balance of pressure and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire session. I could feel all the tension melting away, and by the end I felt completely relaxed, refreshed, and recharged.

This was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had. If you’re looking for a peaceful, high-quality spa experience in Thailand, I highly recommend this place — and definitely ask for Sa. I’ll be coming back for sure 🌿💛

reviews.name: Alice Yan
reviews.text:
it was not a good massage experience. i had another massage in Chiang Mai, it was so wonderful. in Comparison, the experience here was bad, the staff seem cold, the receptionist didn’t smile at all and the massagist was checking her phone in the massage. i didn’t feel any warmth here , not professional either…

and they let me pay the money upfront . the service quality is not nice.

i checked the reviews, and the rating was high. but the actual experience was not good at all …

reviews.name: Roisin Culligan-Hughes
reviews.text: Excellent experience here. I got the 90 minute oil massage and it was extremely relaxing. Loved that you could pick areas to focus on and pressure etc before the massage started. The place itself is super clean and the staff are lovely. Gift was a fabulous therapist.

reviews.name: Lauralee
reviews.text:
Very nice massage with mam. She was very gentle and it was very relaxing.
The salon is very cute and everyone is so kind 🙏🎀
I 100% recommend doing the massage here 🥰

reviews.name: Phuong Tran
reviews.text: My friend and I had a very good and relaxing time here. The aromatic massage was pleasant and gentle. The food and tea were also tasty. Most importantly, the receptionist was very kind, friendly, and sweet 😍🥰 We enjoyed here so much and highly recommend you to try it ☺️

reviews.name: Eunice Wang
reviews.text:
1. No inside shoes, have to be bare feet which is ridiculous cz there are pee on the floor of the toilet.
2.60 mins Thai massage cannot cover the whole body? Never see it in chiangmai.
3. The only two stars for the staff and massage, but I don’t think it worth the money.

reviews.name: #1 Food Lover
reviews.text:
Wandered in on a whim during the Sunday weekend market because my shoulders were killing me. Got the back, neck and shoulders massage. 400 baht for 60 minutes. This place is gorgeous. White curtains lined the walls and with the soft lighting, everything looks so luxurious and modern. This facility is super clean. They washed my feet before even stepping foot into the lobby. My massage was great, the masseur listened to me when I asked for certain areas to be massaged with more pressure. I would recommend this massage facility and definitely will come back again!!!

The massage menu I posted is current as of 12/2023 :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear discerning guests, Thank you so much for your time today and for your lovely review that you just posted. It goes straight to all of our hearts here at Zenza Massage & Spa Chiangmai.

reviews.name: Atakan Akçay
reviews.text: Professional massage businesses always demonstrate their quality. Although it is a little expensive compared to the surrounding average, the service and quality are worth it. Their treats and kindness were pleasant. In addition, before receiving service, a form indicates which areas will be concentrated and which will not be touched, and the massage therapist pays attention to this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Super Thank you my dear customer for your beautiful feedback..We’re really appreciate you…hopefully can service u next time…have a great evening 
With my kind regards 
Zenza Owner 🙏

reviews.name: Bunny
reviews.text: Great massage by Sai and Lin! Super clean and friendly staff. We finished massage on Sunday then go to night market in front of the shop really recommend this place. ❤️will def come back
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Bunny,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! ❤️ We are so happy to hear that you had a great experience with Sai and Lin—we’ll be sure to pass along your sweet words to both of them! Thank you for your recommendation, and we can’t wait to welcome you back again soon!

Best regards,
Zenza Team 🤍

reviews.name: Hitesh Bapna
reviews.text: The staff was really sweet and helpful. They guided us for the perfect spa experience as per our needs. We were a group of 6 and did a special fusion Swedish massage with oil for 90 minutes. It was very relaxing. They also offered us complimentary tea, cookies and chocolates. Would recommend it to everyone who is in chiang mai!!

reviews.name: Tunsinee Dechboon
reviews.text: Great! Friendly service,lovely front desk lady and best massage .Highly recommended 👍🏻

reviews.name: Jennifer Brunet
reviews.text: We went for a massage during our stay in Chiang Mai, the place is clean, calm and beautiful. The masseuses are smiling and attentive to our desires. We had a duo oil massage with my husband for 1 hour, I can only recommend it.

reviews.name: Kathlyn McFeeley
reviews.text:
My partner and I had one hour full body massage and it was an overall lovely experience.
The staff were so welcoming and the little touches such as tea and snacks made the experience. Would come again. :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear guests, your kind words warmed our hearts so much! Thank you from all of us here at Zenza Massage & Spa Chiangmai

reviews.name: Chilly Kroford
reviews.text: Excellent experience here. The decor and ambience was very nice and tranquil. It felt like stepping into an oasis arriving at Zenza. I had 90mins Thai massage and my husband 90 mins oil massage. The team are super attentive, you can specifiy areas to focus on & how you like the pressure through the form you complete at the start which is really helpful and avoids communication complexities. My masseuse was well knowledged; she could feel where my muscles were sore and stressed and adapted her focus and pressure accordingly. Highly reccomend.

reviews.name: Lukasz Zbylut
reviews.text: Awesome and very relaxing massage. Would definitely visit again

reviews.name: Daniel Tseng
reviews.text: Serene thai massage experience. Great price and very relaxing environment. Afterwards you get some tea and snacks to wake up from the 90 minute massage.

reviews.name: Reggie Montalvo
reviews.text: We had such a great and pleasant experience. We were greeted by Dao, she was lovely and attentive. We were serviced immediately. We did a 60 minute foot massage. Rose and Mali were our service providers. They were amazing. I definitely recommend.

reviews.name: ShenronToyZ
reviews.text: One of the best, most proper massages I have had in Chiang Mai! The cleanliness level and the professionalism are unrivaled. The staff is very sweet and they really offer a fantastic experience. Me and the misses both took the 90 min oil massage. I highly recommend this place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear guests, 
Thank you so much for your kind words. We value and respect your opinion greatly. Your review cheers us all up so much here at Zenza Massage & Spa Chiangmai. 
From the bottom of our hearts, Thank You! 🩷

reviews.name: Kylie Nathan
reviews.text: I've been to Thailand several times and this is hands down the best Thai massage I've had!! I appreciated their intake form which specified areas to focus on as well as the amount of pressure. I asked for firm pressure and they definitely delivered! I plan on coming back for sure.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear guests, 
Thank you so much for your kind words. We value and respect your opinion greatly. Your review cheers us all up so much here at Zenza Massage & Spa Chiangmai. 
From the bottom of our hearts, Thank You!

reviews.name: Allyson Rodriguez
reviews.text: The most amazing and luxurious spa experience I’ve ever had! I had the 120 min aroma massage which included a complementary facial for a promotion they were having. It was absolutely amazing. Soda paid close attention to detail, gave just the right amount of pressure, and was very gentle when moving me. I really enjoyed my experience and would absolutely do it again. Very clean and relaxing spa. They even noticed it was my birthday and sang me happy birthday and gave me a cake 🥹 all the ladies there are so very sweet and I’m so happy I picked this place! Highly recommend

reviews.name: Siti Mariam
reviews.text:
I had the most incredibly relaxing Serene Nidra head spa treatment at Boossabakorn Spa & Wellness in Ao Nang, and I can’t recommend it enough!

From the moment I arrived, the ambiance was serene and welcoming. The treatment was a true journey into tranquility combining scalp detox, nourishing herbal hair care with coconut, kaffir, and aloe vera, plus a relaxing massage, sound healing elements, and a wonderful back, neck & shoulder massage. My scalp felt deeply purified and my hair incredibly nourished afterward. I left feeling completely balanced, refreshed, and glowing.

The therapists are highly skilled, professional, and attentive. Everything felt premium and authentic to Thai wellness traditions. At 60 minutes for 2,290 THB, it’s excellent value for the level of care and relaxation you receive.
If you’re in Krabi and looking for a proper pampering experience (especially for your hair and scalp), this is the place. I’ll definitely be back on my next visit! Highly, highly recommended. 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Siti Mariam,

Thank you so much for your heartfelt review and for sharing your wonderful experience with us 🤍

We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Serene Nidra Head Spa and that every part of the treatment helped you feel relaxed, refreshed, and renewed. It’s especially rewarding to know that you appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, our therapists’ care and professionalism, and the thoughtful details that make each experience special.

Your kind words and recommendation mean so much to our entire team. Thank you for choosing Boossabakorn Spa & Wellness, and we’re honored to have been part of your time in Krabi.

We can’t wait to welcome you back on your next visit for another relaxing and rejuvenating spa journey 🌿✨

Warm regards,
Boossabakorn Spa and Wellness Team

reviews.name: Kimberly Wong
reviews.text:
We did the 4 hand massage and it was truly the most relaxing experience! The staff and masseuses were attentive and warm from the time we stepped in. We were served coconuts and some sweet jellies as a welcome while waiting for our rooms to be prepped.

The sound bowl element at the start of the massage was a very nice touch. Our therapists were also highly skilled, I wish I could describe more about my experience but honestly i was in deep sleep HAHA. If that’s not enough to convince you then idk what is.

Definitely recommend & would come back next time I’m in Krabi! Kap khun ka 🙏🏻 - AFF & Noey, and Soda & Job ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Pinetree P
reviews.text:
If you’re visiting Krabi, I would highly recommend taking a couple of hours to experience Boossabakorn. It’s the kind of place that quietly adds something special to your journey and makes your trip even more memorable.

From the moment I stepped in, I felt warmly welcomed. The atmosphere was peaceful and beautifully designed. You can tell that every detail has been thoughtfully considered to create a truly relaxing experience.

The treatment was wonderful, calming, comforting and exactly what I needed for both my body and mind after spending the day enjoying Ao Nang.

What I loved most was the genuine care from the staff. There was such a warmth and positive energy throughout the experience that made it feel so personal not just like a spa treatment, but a moment where I could truly pampering myself.

Thank you Boossabakorn Spa for such a warm welcome and taking such a good care of me. 🤎

reviews.name: Veda Nimkhedkar
reviews.text: I had the 90-minute Gentle Nidra Head Spa, and it was one of the best experiences in Krabi. From the refreshing coconut water welcome to the peaceful treatment, everything was perfect. My hair has never felt softer or healthier. A special thanks to Ms. Soda she was incredibly calm, and her hands truly felt like magic. The session ended with a blow-dry, relaxing body massage, and delicious mango sticky rice. Every detail was thoughtfully planned. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Krabi!

Thank you for your kind recommendation. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back again whenever you're in Krabi 🌿✨

Boossabakorn Spa and Wellness Team

reviews.name: Jacqueline Carroll
reviews.text:
One of the best spa experiences we've ever had! The spa is beautiful, peaceful, and impeccably maintained. From the moment we arrived, the front desk staff were warm, welcoming, and informative. We were greeted with a refreshing coconut drink and a cool face towel, which was a lovely touch.

We chose the Harmony Nidra package, which included a head spa, as well as a face, hand, and leg massage. The entire experience was incredibly relaxing and thoughtfully put together.

My masseuse, Faff, was excellent. She was professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the treatment. The service from start to finish was exceptional, and every detail made the experience feel special.

If you're in Krabi and looking for a top-quality spa, I highly recommend this place. We'll definitely be back!

From the moment me and my partner arrived, we were welcomed with genuine Thai hospitality and warm smiles. The staff offered us a refreshing coconut drink, which was the perfect start to a relaxing experience.

We booked a couple’s massage session, and it was absolutely amazing. The therapists were highly skilled, attentive, and ensured the pressure was just right throughout. The ambience was calm, soothing, and beautifully set up for complete relaxation.

After the session, we were treated to delicious sticky rice with fresh mango and a soothing cup of tea — such a thoughtful and authentic Thai touch to end the experience.

Overall, it was a perfect spa day and a memorable couple’s experience. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Thailand and looking to unwind in paradise. 🌴✨

reviews.text:
Visited Boossabakorn with my wife during our Krabi trip and honestly this place blew us away.

I got the Serene Renewal package and my wife went with the Sun Soother and Gentle Nindra treatment. We both came out absolutely satisfied, felt like every penny (or baht!) was totally worth it.

The therapists were really good. They didn't just go through the motions, they actually paid attention to the pressure level each of us needed. Felt personal, which is rare. That's exactly the kind of pampering we were after.

Also the little extras they do really add up. Cold coconut water when you arrive, lemon honey water during the treatment itself and then coconut sticky rice with hot tea at the end. I wasn't expecting that at all and it was a lovely touch.

Rooms were spotless, no complaints there whatsoever.

Honestly I've been to a fair few spas and this is up there with the best I've been to. If you're in Krabi don't overthink it, just go. Easily the gold standard for spas in the area.

reviews.name: Xi Chen
reviews.text:
If you want to leave a massage with a trip to the ER, this is the place.

I came here for a Thai massage on June 21 at around 6 PM, and it was honestly the worst massage I've ever had.

Before the massage even started, I clearly marked on the iPad that my neck was NOT to be touched. Somehow the therapist either didn't read it or completely ignored it. She kept squeezing my neck really hard throughout the massage and even forcefully slapped/patted it at the end. She also kept randomly laughing during the massage, which made the whole experience feel really uncomfortable and unprofessional.

As soon as the massage was over, I started feeling nauseous, had a headache, and my neck was hurting. I even told the front desk before I left that I felt like I was going to throw up. About 20 minutes later, everything got much worse. I felt dizzy, couldn't walk properly, and even had trouble speaking, so I ended up going straight to the emergency room.

I'm still dealing with neck pain, nausea, and back pain. My neck is still hurting, and this whole experience has affected me far beyond just a "bad massage." What makes this even more frustrating is that I actually tried to sort this out with the business first. I called them, and they told me to send an email. I did exactly that—not just once, but multiple times—and nobody ever replied. Being completely ignored after ending up in the ER is honestly unacceptable. I'm only leaving this review because they chose not to respond. If you have any injuries or specific areas you need them to avoid, I would think twice before coming here.

reviews.name: Claire
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)

Location & Accessibility:
Situated in Novotel Hotel (beside Platinum Mall).
Entrance is beside Starbucks.
Take the lift to Level 6 (reception lobby) → Switch lifts → Head to Level 9.

Booking & Pricing:
Definitely a premium massage spa with a relaxing ambiance. You can purchase vouchers from Klook and similar apps for discounts.

‼️Important‼️
Book in advance! Call or visit the spa before buying vouchers, as slots fill up quickly.

Massage Experience:
Oil massages - Only female masseurs (spa policy).
Thai & foot massages - Male masseurs available upon request.
I personally prefer stronger massages, and I was assigned an elderly lady. While she was gentle, I felt a bit guilty seeing someone of her age working so hard.
Also, do note that the rooms while soothing and clean, are not well maintained.

Overall Experience:
✔ Great for those who enjoy spa-like, premium massages.
✔ Highly recommend the Thai massage (had a great experience at another outlet).
✔ Nice touch: Complimentary Mango Sticky Rice - just as good as what you'd get at a restaurant!

reviews.text:
If you had time for only one massage in Bangkok, this would be my recommendation.  The place is clean and very professional; I've been here many times and the therapists always do a great job.  Their specialty is Thai massage and they do an exceptional job- lots of stretching and plenty strong, although I am sure you can ask them to tone it down if you want.

It's not the cheapest place in Bangkok (USD $25 for 90 min Thai massage), but you really get what you pay for with this one.  It's a great place.

reviews.name: Fang
reviews.text: Great high end spa massage. Ambience within the spy is very soothing and beautiful. Started slightly late because of a previous late customer but the receptionist gave me a cup of hot tea whilst I wait. Did a 2 hours body scrub and Thai oil massage package for 1500 baht, had a room and enclosed shower to myself. Masseur no. 10 was great! Very deft with her hands, exfoliated my back and limbs well, then got my muscles tingly and warm with the hot oil. Got another cup of hot tea after the massage, will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Irvan S
reviews.text:
I frequent various spa parlors around Bangkok and finding the right one with excellent service, professional massage experience, and perfect pricing point is truly like finding a needle in a haystack.

This is it. From the genuine smiles upon arrival to professional and careful masseuse techniques, we couldn't find a single flaw during our visit. I'd recommend requesting for "medium" strength as people have different perceptions on what weak and strong massage are like, and then adjust accordingly depending on your personal preference. My partner and I took different treatments (I had a Thai massage and she had the "King & I" oil massage) and we were both very content with it. They truly go the extra mile by personalising the experience and ensuring that we feel comfortable and relaxed while working on our various tensions throughout the body. I couldn't have asked for a better massage.

Would highly recommend this rather than the common commercial massage parlors in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sheikh Asif Mahmood
reviews.text:
I love this spa and always go here when I stay in Bangkok, its next to the W hotel and rather than go there or the popular Health Land I much prefer coming here where its less busy, better quality and offers excellent thai massages.

They are very flexible and value you as a regular customer and offer a great price. Highly recommend it.

reviews.text:
The salon advertises a price of 350 baht per hour, clearly written, but once you are inside they refuse to apply that price and try to charge only the more expensive options.
When I pointed out that the price was clearly displayed, the staff simply said “that’s how it is” and refused to respect the advertised rate.
This is misleading and dishonest. Prices should be transparent and respected.
Very disappointing experience. I do not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Doha, 
Thank you for sharing your feedback.We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that the 350 Baht per hour price displayed is a genuine rate , and we do provide this service at that price as advertised, with no hidden charges or additional fees. Transparency is very important to us. 
Many of our customers have received services at this rate over the years, and we have been operating for a long time with transparent pricing. 

However, during certain busy periods, some services may already be fully booked.In those cases, our reception ists may offer other available  options so customers can still receive the massage.Of course , it is always completely the customers’s choice whether to accept an alternative option or not. 

To ensure you receive the exact service you prefer, we kindly recommend making a reservation.This helps us prepare and serve you according to your specific request.

We will also improve how we 
Communicate this clearly.We hope to have the opportunity to to welcome you again and provide you with with a better experience.

reviews.name: Piash
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience left me feeling very uncomfortable. The place itself looks nice when you first walk in — the lobby and foot massage area are clean and relaxing. However, the Thai massage area upstairs is very basic, with hard beds and thin towels placed over the pillows.

My massage started off okay, but then the therapist crossed a serious line by inappropriately touching me. When I pushed her hand away, she just giggled, which made me feel even more uncomfortable. The rest of the massage was extremely poor — she mostly just stroked my face for several minutes, which made no sense for a Thai massage. It also ended early, not the full hour I paid for.

I left feeling upset and honestly a bit violated. I had to wash my hands and face afterward because I felt so uneasy. I would strongly caution anyone considering this place.

reviews.name: Hadley Hung
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I had the worst massage experience I've ever had at Anda Phuket.

From the moment I arrived, the therapist appeared unfriendly and unhappy—perhaps because I walked in at 10:05 PM and only entered the treatment room at 10:15 PM. What immediately made me uncomfortable was that I was not given privacy to change into the disposable garments.

The massage itself was very disappointing. There was little to no pressure throughout the session. Rather than using proper massage techniques and strokes, the therapist seemed to simply spread and rub excessive amount of oil all over my body without any real focus or structure. To make matters worse, the session ended at 10:50 PM, well short of the paid 1-hour duration. It felt as though the treatment was rushed so that the therapist could finish work near closing time.

I understand that businesses have operating hours, but customers who are accepted before closing should still receive the full service they have paid for. Based on my experience, the quality of treatment was far below expectations, and I left feeling disappointed and shortchanged.

reviews.text:
This was hands down the best experience of my entire trip. I actually started my trip with it and ended it with it.

On day one, I had a Thai massage (without oil) and a foot massage by Cat (I think that was her name I might be mistaken). On my last day, I booked a three-hour session package that included a body scrub, herbal ball massage, and a full body massage. Dow did it, and I was told that her name means “star” in Thai, she was absolutely amazing.

This place is perfect for tourists. Most of the staff understand English well, which makes everything smooth and comfortable. The staff, hospitality, and location are all top-notch. It’s just a 2-minute walk to the beach (at least for me), and I personally loved the Kamala Beach side more.

The ambience is great, and they maintain proper hygiene fresh towels and everything is very clean. The receptionist was very accommodating and genuinely willing to provide the best service. They can adjust according to your timings, and walk-ins are available too.

And of course, the massages themselves, the techniques they use and the masseuses are just incredible. This is something people should definitely try. It’s a 100% hit.
Their prices are really affordable, especially compared to the quality of service they provide.

reviews.text:
I cannot rate Siladon Spa in Kamala highly enough. From the moment I arrived, I felt completely cared for and welcomed. You’re greeted with a refreshing cold towel and a cup of tea, then invited to choose your preferred oils and body scrub scent—such a thoughtful and personalized touch.

I booked the Siladon Voyage package (4 hours) which included:

• Foot massage
• Body scrub
• Herbal ball compress
• Aroma oil massage

✨ The experience was flawless from start to finish. First, my feet were gently washed and I was given slippers before being escorted to the treatment room. The body scrub was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had—thorough, relaxing, and left my skin glowing. My therapist, Nit, was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. It was my first time trying the herbal ball compress, and I was amazed at how soothing it was, especially for my lower back and neck pain. Nit intuitively focused on those areas and I left feeling like a new person.

Between treatments, I was served water, hot tea, and a delicious dried mango snack (they also offer crackers, but I’m gluten-free and appreciated the alternative). Every detail was so well thought out.

I walked out feeling completely relaxed, pampered, and deeply grateful for the experience. If you’re in Phuket and looking for a luxurious, healing escape—Siladon Spa is an absolute must. Nit is wonderful, I’d definitely go back

reviews.name: Melissa Aboy
reviews.text: The therapist is very good. Their hands are gentle i really love how they treat me. We have a massage woth my husband body scrubs and aroma oil massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate your kind words. It was our pleasure to welcome you to Siladon Spa.

reviews.name: Boss Don
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience!
Sildon Spa went above and beyond from the moment we walked in. The staff were incredibly welcoming, professional, and attentive to every detail. The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and relaxing — perfect after a long day in Phuket. The massage was one of the best I’ve ever had; they truly know what they’re doing and make sure you leave feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Phuket — you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.name: c l
reviews.text:
When it comes to environment, this spot is definitely one of the top choices in the Kamala Beach area. The service is pretty good, with the receptionist replying quickly on WhatsApp and in person. The only reason you might be paying around 200 Baht per massage is because of that. Technique wise, it's okay, but not anything special.

If you want a better vibe, definitely give it a shot!

If you’re aiming for deep relaxation or muscle relief, you might want to check out other places.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We appreciate your comments regarding your experience. Your feedback helps us improve. Our therapist can provide varieties style for massage which customer can always ask during treatment weather you need deep tissue or lighter for relaxation massage. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide an even better visit next time.

reviews.name: Nur Zahirah 'IbadurRahman
reviews.text: Very nice and clean place. Suitable for Muslim women as they have private rooms. Great customer service and soft spoken staff at the counter and masseuse. They served tea before and after the session, foot scrub was complimentary with the one hour massage, and they weren’t rushing to finish.

reviews.name: Manmith Reddy
reviews.text: One of the best massages I had in my trip. I choose the scrub and aromatherapy. They were so professional and I was so relaxed after the massage. I actually slept during my massage it was that relaxing. Plan to have an appointment before going there otherwise you might have to wait or you might not end up having a massage for that day.

reviews.name: Michael Pene
reviews.text: Siladon Spa was an amazing experience. We had a couples aroma oil massage for one hour. Would highly recommend on your next visit.

reviews.name: Daria Kostyleva
reviews.text: Went to this SPA for 5 days straight, trying out different massages. If you don’t want to play a Russian roulette with smaller massage places, just come here - private space, AC, silence, attentive work. You get welcome tea and after massage tea, you can specify the focus area and they accept card payment. Forgot to mention every employee is super sweet!

reviews.name: Jess Millward
reviews.text: Hands down the most professional massage spa in Kamala. Staff are super friendly and tentative. Prior to your massage you get a quotable conversation, cold towels and some cold tea. Afterward you have the option to shower, drink warm tea and some small biscuits. The massage itself was amazing and the staff member (Joy) made the experience very memorable and comfortable. Would 100% consider another before the end of our trip ☺️

reviews.name: EARTH TJ
reviews.text: I booked a one-hour oil body massage. They have several aroma oils, but I recommend the rose one! This program was a wonderful experience. The therapist had experienced, and they also have new and clean private rooms with en-suite bathrooms. Couples massages are also available as well. Perfect for true relaxation. At the end, they even served mango sticky rice!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your one-hour oil massage and that you loved our rose aroma oil. Our team takes great pride in providing a truly relaxing experience with our experienced therapists and our new, clean private rooms.

We are also so glad that you enjoyed the complimentary mango sticky rice at the end of your treatment! We would absolutely love to welcome you back again in the future—perhaps for a couple's massage next time.

reviews.name: Geet Agarwal
reviews.text:
Had an absolutely premium and relaxing experience at MAKKHA Health & Spa. From the moment I entered, the ambience felt calm, luxurious, and beautifully designed with a perfect spa aesthetic. The staff was extremely professional, polite, and welcoming throughout the session.
The massage therapy was exceptional — perfectly balanced pressure, soothing atmosphere, and attention to every detail made it one of the best spa experiences I’ve had. The cleanliness, fragrance, lighting, and peaceful environment truly give a five-star wellness vibe.
If you’re looking for a luxurious place to relax, de-stress, and enjoy a world-class spa treatment in Bangkok, this place is highly recommended. Definitely worth the experience and I would love to visit again. ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Geet Agarwal 🌺

We are truly grateful for your thoughtful and detailed review. It means a lot to us that you felt the premium and relaxing experience we aim to create from the moment you arrived.

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed our ambiance, service, and the professionalism of our team. Your kind words about the massage therapy, cleanliness, and overall atmosphere truly inspire us to continue delivering the highest standard of care.

Creating a luxurious and peaceful space for our guests to unwind is always our priority, and we’re so happy that you felt that throughout your visit.

Thank you again for your recommendation — we truly look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional wellness experience in the near future 🕊️✨

reviews.name: Hay
reviews.text: Reception service was wonderful. They could speak good English( and Chinese? not sure but I heard some). I tried to book online, but the price list was not exactly the same so I did the reservation in-person eventually. Did aroma oil massage and add-on 30mins oil massage. Everything was divine. The mango sticky rice after massage was delicious. If the price is not too high for you, definitely worth the go.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your detailed experience with us. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our service, the aroma oil massage, and the additional treatment time. It’s also wonderful to know that our team was able to assist you comfortably throughout your visit. We appreciate your feedback regarding the online pricing and will continue working to improve the booking experience for our guests. We're especially happy that you enjoyed the complimentary mango sticky rice. Thank you for your recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing visit.

reviews.name: praphassara preechawai
reviews.text:
⭐ Overall: 8.5/10
🏡 Ambience: 10/10
💆 Massage Experience: 8/10

The spa is absolutely beautiful, relaxing, and feels very luxurious. The atmosphere alone deserves 10/10.

Before my appointment, I informed the reception that I had pain in my neck, shoulders, and feet, and requested an experienced therapist to focus on those areas. I also marked everything clearly on the consultation form.

Unfortunately, it seems this information was not passed on to the therapist, so the massage did not focus on my problem areas as expected.

Overall, I still enjoyed the experience and would definitely return. I only hope the communication between the reception team and therapists can be improved, as this small detail would make the service truly outstanding.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your thoughtful and detailed feedback. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the ambiance of our spa and that you found the overall experience relaxing and enjoyable.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize that your specific concerns and treatment preferences were not communicated to your therapist as effectively as they should have been. Your feedback is extremely valuable, and we will share it with both our reception and therapy teams to improve communication and ensure that guest requests are followed more carefully in the future.

We truly appreciate your understanding and are grateful that you would consider visiting us again. We look forward to welcoming you back and providing an even more personalized and exceptional experience on your next visit.

reviews.name: VanAnh McCormick
reviews.text:
An upscale massage salon near Terminal 21. Quick reception on a Friday night with no appointment - I was able to get a 60 minute neck, shoulder, and back massage for 990 Baht. They do accept Visa, which is uncommon in the area, but there is a 3% fee for amounts less than 1000 Baht.

They serve tea and a small snack before your massage. Pim provided excellent service - strong and deep pressure after a lot of traveling.

The facilities (massage treatment room, restrooms, waiting area) are pristine and air conditioned.

They do serve complimentary mango sticky rice and hot tea after your massage as well.

Overall, an excellent choice for a higher-end massage in Pattaya.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, VanAnh McCormick 🌸

We truly appreciate your detailed feedback and are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us. It’s wonderful to know that our service, facilities, and overall ambiance met your expectations.

We’re especially happy that you were satisfied with the treatment and the care provided by our therapist. Your kind words mean a lot to our team.

Thank you as well for highlighting the convenience of our services and facilities. We look forward to welcoming you again for another relaxing and enjoyable experience 💫

reviews.name: Papereys
reviews.text: Great place to come for a chill and massage and spa.  We did 2 hours and got an additional 200thb discount.  They offer pickup and free drop off if you spend over 1000thb.  Probably expensive compared to local prices but compared to western it's a bargain.  Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience! We're thrilled you enjoyed a chill spa session with us and found our 2-hour discount and free shuttle service helpful. Providing a high-quality, relaxing escape is our top priority, and we're glad it felt like a great bargain compared to back home. Thanks for the high recommendation, and we hope to see you again soon. :)

reviews.name: Rebecca Ho
reviews.text: We went here few times and I think the quality of massage is sadly get not so great as the first visit. But the environment is pretty good still. I would still hope their mango sticky rice could serve with coconut milk.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are glad you enjoyed our environment, but we sincerely apologize that the massage quality did not meet your expectations this time, and that the coconut milk was missing from your mango sticky rice.

We have shared your comments with our team to improve our massage standards and dessert service immediately. We hope to welcome you back for a much better experience next time.

reviews.name: Banlang Tiyaworanon
reviews.text: Everything was great except for the massage therapist. I requested a gentle massage, but the pressure was too strong. Even after asking for less pressure, I was told the pain was because I was tense. I came for a relaxing massage, not to leave in pain.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! Nice spa, reasonable prices, relaxing atmosphere and really friendly and helpful stuff! Highly recommend you to visit this place

reviews.name: Nitesh Rajdev
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Thail Massage near Grand Centre Point Space Pattaya.

We visited on 4 June at approximately 2:30 PM as a group. While we were discussing among ourselves how many people wanted massages, the staff stood over us and repeatedly asked in a rude and impatient manner how many people would be taking the service.

The attitude only got worse from there. For a balm massage, they demanded a 140 THB advance payment. When we explained that our card was at the hotel and asked them to start the child's massage first, the staff member abruptly refused and responded in an angry and unfriendly manner.

The staff were extremely rude, arrogant, and unwelcoming throughout the interaction. Instead of a relaxing experience, they completely spoiled the mood and made us regret coming here.

Customer service is just as important as the massage itself, and unfortunately this place failed badly. I would give 0 stars if that were possible.

There are many other massage shops in Pattaya—save your money and avoid this one if you expect basic courtesy and respect.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are deeply sorry to hear about the disappointing experience you and your group had at our branch on June 4th. What you described is completely unacceptable and goes against our core standards of hospitality and respect.

Please accept our sincerest apologies for the rude and impatient behavior of our staff, as well as the unwelcoming communication regarding the payment process. We completely agree that excellent customer service is just as important as the treatment itself, and we clearly failed to deliver that to you.

We have already shared your review with our management team and the branch supervisor to investigate this matter immediately. Strict disciplinary actions and retraining on customer courtesy will be implemented to ensure this never happens again.

We truly regret that we ruined your mood and your experience in Pattaya. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future to provide the genuinely relaxing and respectful service you deserve.

reviews.name: Kim Lim Chua
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Makkha Health & Spa! The place is clean, relaxing, and has a very comfortable atmosphere. The staff are professional, friendly, and very well-trained.

I especially recommend the Four Hands Aromatherapy Spa, it was such an amazing and relaxing experience. The pressure, coordination, and overall service were excellent. It really helped me feel refreshed and completely relaxed.

Definitely one of the best spa experiences, and I would love to come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your highly recommended review, Kim Lim Chua! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our clean, relaxing, and comfortable atmosphere. Providing a peaceful escape for our guests is always our top priority. We look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful session soon!

reviews.name: Harpreet Pawar
reviews.text: Excellent massage with very friendly staff. They were so patient and baby-friendly, which made our visit comfortable and relaxing. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are glad that you had a best massage experience during your stay. We appreciate the kind review, and we are looking forward to welcoming you back again. Have a great day!

reviews.text: Very good service and skills of therapist! Atmosphere is brilliant. Will come again! Highly recommended!! The mango sticky rice and hot tea  after the massage is also Matchy!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much We’re happy you enjoyed the massage, atmosphere, mango sticky rice, and our herbal drink 😊 Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Fontip Thiawtour
reviews.text:
I have visited other branches before, and they were very, very good. The quality and service at the other branches were excellent, and I was very satisfied.

However, this branch has not been as good. I have visited twice, and both times were not very satisfying. During my recent massage session, there was loud music coming from outside the room. Even after I sent an email and they moved me to another room, it was still loud. I also heard sounds like someone opening the massage room door, which made it difficult to relax.

Compared to the other branches, this experience was disappointing. I hope this branch can improve its service and provide the same quality as the others.

But at least mango sticky rice still good 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your honest feedback and for visiting several of our branches. We truly appreciate your continued support and are very sorry that this visit did not meet the standards you experienced elsewhere.

Regarding the noise, our current location is situated near the project’s central market area. At certain times, there may be activity in the common area that is difficult for us to fully control, and some sound may carry into the spa despite our efforts. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and for the disturbance during your treatment.

Your comments are very important to us, and we will continue working on improving sound management to provide a more peaceful environment.

We’re glad you still enjoyed the mango sticky rice, and we truly hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide a much better experience next time. 🌿

reviews.name: Lina Bronz
reviews.text:
This is my favorite place for a massage, and I always recommend it to everyone. The prices are very reasonable.

I suggest booking in advance.

At the beginning, they give you a form where you can specify your preferred massage pressure, indicate any areas to avoid, and note things like menstruation, which makes the whole experience much more comfortable. I have very sensitive skin and often get bruises from massages, but here everything is done gently, and time flies during the session.

Many of the therapists check in with you during the massage to make sure everything feels right, and if they notice that you’ve fallen asleep, they won’t disturb you. The staff are polite and friendly. While they follow a general technique, each therapist has slight differences in their approach.

You can also choose the scent of the oil or scrub.

After the massage, they serve you a drink and some cookies.

Overall, the atmosphere is calm and relaxing, and I always feel comfortable here

reviews.name: Phil Caruso
reviews.text:
Rating: ★★★★☆ (4.5/5)
Vibe: Tranquil, Professional, and Authentically Thai
Siladon Spa has carved out a reputation as one of Pattaya's most reliable "mid-to-high" range day spas. It offers a more elevated experience than the standard street-side massage shops without the eye-watering prices of five-star resort spas.
The Atmosphere & Setting
Located near Wongamat Beach (Naklua 16), Siladon offers an immediate escape from Pattaya’s high-energy streets. The decor is classic Thai—dark woods, soft lighting, and the scent of lemongrass—creating a serene environment. The treatment rooms are private, clean, and well-maintained, with specific rooms available for couples or families who wish to share the experience.
Standout Treatments
Siladon is best known for its multi-hour spa packages, which offer significant value compared to booking individual services.
* The "Siladon Voyage": A 4-hour marathon that usually includes a foot massage, body scrub, herbal ball compress, and aroma oil massage.
* Thai Herbal Compress: Highly recommended for those with muscle tension; the heat from the herbal poultice combined with traditional stretching is exceptionally effective.
* Skincare: They use locally sourced, natural Thai products (oils and creams) rather than generic synthetic brands, which is a nice touch for sensitive skin.
Pros & Cons
| Pros | Cons |
|---|---|
| Professionalism: Therapists are well-trained and consistently check on pressure levels. | Booking: It’s very popular; walk-ins are often disappointed, so booking 24-48 hours ahead is essential. |
| Hygiene: High standards for cleanliness in both common areas and private rooms. | Transportation: Tucked away in Naklua, so you may need a Bolt/Grab or their shuttle (if available) to get there. |
| Value: Frequent "Flash Sales" and online booking discounts make it very affordable for the quality. | Pressure: Some guests find the "medium" pressure to be quite firm—be vocal if you prefer a lighter touch. |
The Verdict
Siladon Spa is perfect for travelers who want a professional, "spa-day" experience without spending $200 USD. It is particularly great for couples or anyone looking to spend 3–4 hours in total relaxation.
> Pro Tip: Check their official website or social media pages before you go. They frequently run "Buy One Get One" deals or 50% off "Flash Sales" for morning appointments.

reviews.text: Very nice place. The staff is very nice and caring. A legit massage place.  I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good massage place. Have attached the updated price list as of May 2024.

reviews.name: Artem Sokolov
reviews.text:
Terrible service. I came in for a Thai massage. Everything started off well, with one exception — the therapist kept chewing candy and making loud smacking noises. At first, I didn’t say anything, hoping he would eventually stop, but he kept popping candies into his mouth non-stop.

When I realized it wasn’t going to stop, I politely asked him to stop making those noises. That’s when everything changed. He started pressing on every point with full force and rushed through the massage, practically tossing my limbs around.

When I asked him to slow down, he would ease up for a moment but then go right back to pressing as hard as he could. At one point during the massage, he even pulled out more candy and shook it demonstratively — I’m not sure what message he was trying to send.

In the end, he didn’t even say goodbye or anything — he just stormed out.

We had been coming to this salon for a while and everything was fine before, but after this experience, we’re definitely not coming back.

Avoid this place — you might encounter unprofessional and inappropriate behavior from the staff.

reviews.name: Aaliyah Oke
reviews.text:
It took 1 hour and 30 minutes for a simple acrylic removal with no polish. Instead of filing it down and soaking my nails in acetone before filing again, she filed my nails and applied the tiniest amount of acetone to a tiny piece of cotton and applied clips…. This meant she had to reapply a new tiny piece of cotton 3 times to each nail because it wasn’t dissolving. As you can see my cuticles weren’t taken care of and she didn’t file it after I asked her to make it shorter.

I was seated at 10.55pm and left at 12.30am.

I was seemingly overcharged as well, I paid 500 baht for just a removal and the manicurist quoted the lady 200 baht for hers.

Very disappointing experience after reading the reviews and speed walking to get there before closing.

Otherwise, the staff are nice and the salon space is nice and they’re very hygienic.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry, but the acrylic nail removal technique you mentioned, which involves dipping your fingers in acetone, is something our salon doesn't use. Acetone is too strong and can cause skin irritation or allergic reactions. Also, your extensions are very thick, and you have painted designs with embellishments. We need to use a nail file to remove all the paint before we can file the acrylic, but you barely let me use the file. I could see your nail surface was very thin, so I carefully applied the acetone layer by layer to avoid damaging it. Furthermore, you mentioned that the person at the next table paid 200 baht for removal, which is true, but they had already reinforced their nails, and we couldn't remove all 10 fingers before applying new polish. Please understand the situation correctly. My salon never tries to take advantage of customers. Please research how many different salons use the same techniques as we do. Your statement that 500 baht is unfair is more of a technician's opinion than a fair explanation in this case. The extensions were very thick, the nail surface was thin, and using a nail file was practically impossible.

reviews.name: Oleg D
reviews.text:
Nestled in an unassuming corner of Bangkok lies Salon Massage and Spa Days—a true hidden gem that offers a surprisingly extensive range of services. From manicures and pedicures to facials, waxing, and Thai and oil massages, this salon caters to various needs with a professionalism that exceeds expectations.

I enjoyed trying nearly all the treatments tailored for men and consistently received top-notch service. However, what truly sets this place apart is the exceptional talent of a massage therapist named Lei. After years of battling chronic back pain and countless unsuccessful treatments, I finally found relief during a 90-minute oil massage session with him.

Lei's technique is unique. While I typically shy away from aggressive deep-tissue massages, his approach was firm and incredibly effective. I walked out of the salon pain-free for the first time in years, which speaks volumes about his skill and expertise. His work shows his intuitive understanding of the body, and his training shines through.

If you find yourself in Bangkok struggling with back pain, do yourself a favor and seek Lei at Salon Massage and Spa Days. I can't recommend him highly enough—he's truly a master of his craft!

reviews.name: John (J)
reviews.text:
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

I recently visited "Massage and Spa Days" based on a friend's recommendation, and overall, it was a pleasant experience. The spa is popular among locals, with only a few tourists, which adds to its authentic charm. The staff were friendly and welcoming, making us feel at ease from the moment we arrived. 😊

The massage itself was a true Thai experience 💆‍♂️ , albeit a bit softer than I had anticipated. My therapist was excellent at identifying and relieving my back pain, which was a huge relief. However, my friend's therapist was just okay, which was a bit of a letdown.

The ambiance of the spa was nice, but there were a few areas for improvement. The place can be a bit louder than desired for a relaxing massage, and the air conditioning was too cold for comfort. Additionally, there was no relaxing sound or music to enhance the overall experience.

Despite these minor drawbacks, the quality of service and the reasonable pricing make "Massage and Spa Days" a good choice for a Thai massage. If they can address the noise and ambiance issues, it would be an even better experience.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Kiwi,

Thank you so much for your message. At our spa, we take customers' feedback very seriously and we truly appreciate when our customers make effort to share their experience with us.

We are sincerely sorry that your nail colouring was not properly done as the beautician's glasses had got broken on the day that you came (March 5th, 2019). The manager and the beautician herself have just called you today (March 8th, 2019) right after we saw your review to apologise and to invite you to come in and get the nail work redone. We would like to assure you that our beautician is very well-trained and has been working in the nail field for over 30 years. We genuinely hope you would be able to come visit us asap.

Moreover, the 4SPA luxury organic foot spa with pedicure treatment uses 4SPA organic products in 4 steps: dead sea salt foot soak in whirlpool spa tub; organic scrub to remove dead skin; organic mask to keep your skin moistured and organic cream massage to deeply soothe and nourish your skin. The treatment costs 1,150 THB with pedicure and colouring.

Checking the work schedule, we saw that you paid 1,550 THB for 4SPA pedicure and express manicure (400THB) but we complementarily upgraded the treatment from Express Manicure to 4SPA luxury organic hand spa with manicure for you. As well, we are truly thankful that you complimented our staff because everyone here is wholeheartedly working very hard to take the best care of our customers.

Therefore, we hope that, apart from the nail colouring, you enjoyed the organic hand and foot spa experience at our spa. We are also looking forward to seeing you again soon.

Regards,

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Cocktail Hunter,

First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize that our service did not meet your expectations.  Also, we would like to thank you for your feedback and will share it with our staff. This experience will help us improve our service in the future. Opening for over 20 years, our spa has been renowned for our excellent service and treatments. As well, we have always been excited when seeing our once-walk-in customers became regulars and, eventually, our loyal members.

We have looked into the incident and it occurred to us that you requested for “Manicure Spa” treatment but you asked our staff to turn on the whirlpool “Pedicure Spa” tub so that you can soak your feet in hot water. When staff politely informed you that these are two different treatments, you refused to receive our nail service.

At our spa, we take comments very seriously because we believe there is always rooms for improvement in our services as well as treatments. Moreover, we appreciate customers who give efforts to let us know their thoughts and we endlessly do our best to make everyone happy because we know that we are the sanctuary where our dear customers feel at ease. To us, our customers are our family members. We have watched many of them grew into beautiful and courteous adults.

As for this time that you did not receive our service yet, we would love to welcome you to our spa in the near future so that you can get true services of our nail and spa experience. If you have more comments or suggestion, please do not hesitate to directly contact me at gaya.sathorn@gmail.com

Kind Regards,
Sam
Management Team

title: Dear Sunday Hometel
address: 27, 19 Charoen Krung 30, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
🏮 Vegen Festival in Bangkok Chinatown! 🥢✨

From October 10–19, Yaowarat comes alive with delicious vegan street food, colorful traditions, and Thai-Chinese cultural celebrations! 🇹🇭🇨🇳

Looking for things to do in Bangkok? Wander through Chinatown, taste local vegan favorites, and soak up the festive vibes!

Staying at Dear Sunday Hometel, our cozy boutique hotel in Bangkok's Charoen Krung neighborhood? You're just a short walk from Chinatown and Talad Noi!

And before heading back to your cozy room, don't forget to stop by LLOY, our little sister Thai-Chinese dessert café, for a sweet treat! 🥥💛

Your little home away from home in Bangkok. ☀️

Dear Sunday Hometel is a cozy boutique hotel in Bangkok’s Charoen Krung neighborhood, perfect for travelers looking for a home away from home. Stay near Chinatown Bangkok, Yaowarat, Talad Noi and ICONSIAM, with local cafés, street food, art and hidden gems nearby. Our Bangkok hometel offers cozy rooms, soft beds, selected rooms with bathtubs and projectors, plus a relaxing common space with complimentary fresh fruit. A charming Bangkok hidden gem for couples, staycations and travelers who want to experience the local side of Bangkok.

reviews.name: Shlz M
reviews.text:
We had such a lovely stay at Sunday Hometel, and what really sets this place apart is that although you are staying in a hotel, it genuinely feels like you have a little home with you in Bangkok.

The common area on the second floor was probably our favourite part. You can sit down comfortably, reheat your own food, have a proper meal, and they even provide complimentary fruits. Especially when travelling as a family, having that extra space outside your room makes such a difference. It never felt like we were confined to a typical hotel room.

The location was also incredibly convenient. There are plenty of facilities within walking distance, and ICONSIAM is easily accessible by walking and ferry, so getting around was really easy for us.

Most importantly, the staff were amazing. Everyone was genuinely friendly, helpful, and accommodating throughout our stay. You really feel looked after here.

If you want somewhere comfortable and convenient in Bangkok but still want that cosy feeling of having a home away from home, Sunday Hometel is such a great find. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would happily come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for stay with us. We hope you have a wonderful time of BKK back with you. Hope to welcome you again in the future. 🙏🏻💛

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: The property beautifully blends the comfort of a home with the convenience of a modern stay. The common areas are a fantastic feature—they are beautifully designed and provide a relaxed, inviting space to sit, work, or dine.The guest rooms themselves are stunning: beautifully decorated, incredibly clean, and feel very well cared for. The attention to detail in the décor, lighting, and general upkeep truly showcases the owners' thoughtful commitment to their guests' comfort.The location is excellent. It's strategically situated very close to the Si Phraya pier, which means you have easy and quick access to the river crossing and can be at ICONSIAM in mere minutes.Good to Know (The Stairs)The only minor point to note is that the building is a four-story structure and does not have an elevator. However, this is instantly mitigated by the excellent service: staff are available and happy to help carry your luggage, making the stairs a non-issue even with heavy bags.In summary, this hometel is a charming, beautifully maintained, and perfectly located alternative to a standard hotel. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Juliana Tan
reviews.text: We had a great stay at Dear Sunday Hometel! The room is clean, modern and comfortable. The location is also in an up and coming part of BKK, where you have shops and cafes, but away from the tourist crowd. The staff was welcoming from the get go, and you get a direct whatsapp line to speak to them at anytime. They even gave a map of places to see and eat at. It's great value for money and we really enjoyed our stay at Dear Sunday Hometel!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for stay with us. We hope you have a wonderful time of BKK back with you. Hope to welcome you again in the future. 🙏🏻💛

We had a bit of an issue to enter the building after midnight upon arrival because another guest ( THE IDIOT 😡) put the night lock on the frontdoor . There’s no staff at that hour but the owners solved the problem and as a courtesy offered us breakfast. Well done!

Thank you as well for allowing us the opportunity to offer breakfast as a small courtesy. We truly appreciate your support and hope to welcome you back again. 😊

The room was spotless and comfortable.

The staff were incredibly friendly and always ready to help with recommendations or anything I needed. The location is also perfect — peaceful, yet close to local attractions.

reviews.name: Jorge C
reviews.text: We had such a lovely stay here! Tucked away in a cute little nook but close to everything, this is the perfect location for first timers in Bangkok. We loved the access to Chinatown and Icomsiam using the Chao Phraya boats. The room was fantastic and the outdoor tub was a great way to unwind after exploring the city. My only wishes would be a raised surface to put luggage bags on and a room safe. The host was incredible and easy to communicate with on whatsapp making everything a breeze. I would definitely suggest staying here!

reviews.name: Dakka A
reviews.text:
It was one of the best stay I have planned out for myself. I was attracted by the great lighting and the big semi-outdoor bathtub.
The room is well furnished and the staff has been incredibly kind.
Transporting to the close-by BTS and the piers have been very accessible yet the surrounding has been decently quiet.
I had a lot of fun spending time outside throughout the day and coming back and enjoying the night watching videos using the projector.
The only downsides are:
- There is no lift in the building so you do need help carrying a heavy suitcase upstairs.
- Mosquito repellent is recommended if you plan on keeping the access to the bathroom open during the day.

reviews.name: Kesia Lois
reviews.text:
Spending 3 last nights of our holiday in Bangkok in Dear Sunday -- and I cannot emphasize much how glad we are.

- Room is super clean (daily housekeeping is available too) and comfy bed,
- Facilities and amenities offerred is so spoiling (projector in the room and complete stuff in the kitchen, and extra delicious snacks on festival!),
- Location is in very nice neighborhood (foodcourt + 7eleven is just 2minutes walking, couple of minutes driving to chinatown, around 10minutes ride to ICONSIAM, also easy access for cars so getting grab drivers are easy too),
- Management is responsive.
- They cater our special request for breakfast very well

To summarize, very recommended place to stay and we will definitely come back to stay here in our next Bangkok holiday 🫶

reviews.text: เมื่อวานไปนวด เพราะมีอาการบ่าตึง แล้วทำให้ปวดไมเกรนมาก ได้พี่เอ๋ นวดคลายเส้นแก้อาการให้ รู้สึกโล่ง ตัวเบาออกมาจากร้านเลย ประทับใจมากๆ เป็นการนวดน้ำมัน รีดเส้น ผ่อนคลายกล้ามเนื้อแบบร้านนวดสปาที่เมืองนอกทำกันแต่ราคาคนไทยเข้าถึงได้ ซึ่งหาหมอนวดที่นวดแบบนี้ในไทยยาก นวดได้ตรงจุดที่มีอาการปวดจากออฟฟิศซินโดรม ห้องนวดก็เป็นห้องส่วนตัว เราเป็นผู้หญิงไปคนเดียวได้สบายๆ มีเตียงนวด บรรยากาศผ่อนคลาย แนะนำเลยค่ะ ต้องขอบคุณพี่หมอนวดเอ๋ที่บริการอย่างดี เป็นกันเอง สุภาพ น่ารักมาก เป็น 1 ชม.ที่มีความสุขและผ่อนคลายมากๆค่ะ คิดว่าจะกลับไปซ้ำอีก ชอบมากค่ะ ให้ 10/10 เลย (หน้าร้านติดถนนใหญ่ ฝั่งตรงข้ามห้าง The street แต่แมพไปปักหมุดหลังร้าน ร้านสะอาด กว้างขวางค่ะ)
reviews.textTranslated: Yesterday I went for a massage because I had tense shoulders that were causing severe migraines. Ms. Ae massaged me to relieve the tension and pain. I felt so relieved and light afterwards! I was very impressed. It was an oil massage, deep tissue massage, and muscle relaxation massage like the ones in spas abroad, but at a price affordable for Thai people. It's hard to find masseuses who do this kind of massage in Thailand. She massaged the exact points that were causing my office syndrome pain. The massage room was private, which was comfortable for me as a woman going alone. There was a massage bed and a relaxing atmosphere. I highly recommend it! A big thank you to masseuse Ae for the excellent service; she was friendly, polite, and lovely. It was a very happy and relaxing hour. I plan to go back again. I loved it! 10/10! (The shop is on the main road, opposite The Street mall, but the map pin shows the back of the shop. The shop is clean and spacious.)

หลายคนคงเคยสงสัยว่า Keratin, Olaplex และ Hair Treatment บำรุงผมแตกต่างกันอย่างไร? ทำไมช่างผมถึงแนะนำไม่เหมือนกัน

วันนี้ The Queen Salon & Spa Thonglor ร้านทำผมพรีเมียมย่านทองหล่อ จะพามาเจาะลึกการฟื้นฟูเส้นผมแต่ละประเภท เพื่อให้คุณเลือกโปรแกรมบำรุงผมที่เหมาะกับสภาพผมมากที่สุดค่ะ

1. Olaplex (ซ่อมแซมแกนผมจากภายใน)
•	ฟื้นฟูโครงสร้างพันธะผม (Hair Bonds) ที่โดนทำลาย
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมเสียจากการทำสี ฟอกสีผม กัดผม หรือผ่านความร้อนสูง
•	ผลลัพธ์ แกนผมแข็งแรงขึ้น ยืดหยุ่น ไม่ขาดหักง่าย

2. Keratin / เคราติน (ปิดเกล็ดผม ลดผมชี้ฟู)
•	เติมเต็มโปรตีนและเรียงตัวเกล็ดผมให้เรียบเนียน
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมชี้ฟู ผมแห้งกร้าน ไร้น้ำหนัก จัดทรงยาก
•	ผลลัพธ์ ผมเรียบลื่น เงางาม ตรงสวย และลดเวลาการเซ็ตผม

3. Hair Treatment / ทรีตเมนต์ (บำรุงผิวผมด้านนอก)
•	เติมความชุ่มชื้นและความเงางามให้ชั้นนอกของเส้นผม
•	เหมาะกับคนที่ผมแห้งเล็กน้อย ต้องการความนุ่มสลวยด่วน
•	ผลลัพธ์ ผมนุ่มลื่น สัมผัสได้ทันทีตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่ทำ

สูตรฟื้นฟูผมสวยแบบครบวงจร (Combined Hair Care)
•	Olaplex = แข็งแรงจากแกนใน
•	Keratin = เรียบลื่น ลดชี้ฟู
•	Treatment = นุ่มสลวย เติมความชุ่มชื้น

reviews.name: Raquel Ordóñez Giménez
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience at this spa and felt truly taken care of from start to finish. We came to celebrate a friend’s birthday, and the team went above and beyond with so many thoughtful details that made the occasion feel extra special.

What really stood out to us was not just their kindness (which was exceptional), but the actual quality of the service. Every therapist was highly skilled, professional, and attentive - you can tell they genuinely know what they’re doing. The treatments were excellent, and even the hair styling left us looking like we had just stepped out of a salon/hairdresser.

On top of that, all the products they use feel premium and high-quality, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.
This is a place we would absolutely recommend to anyone, a must-visit if you’re looking for a top-notch spa experience 🫶🏼

They gave out a change of shoes, put on a bathrobe, also additionally covered the face with a mask, part of the eyes and covered the ears. The service was excellent. reviews.text: Got a straightening perm here and unfortunately I’m very disappointed in my results . After spending 7 hours at the salon and seemingly having pin straight hair I was quite happy initially. Until I washed it for the first time 4 days later and the result is awful. It was stiff, frizzy and still some random curls all over my hair . It’s quite upsetting considering the price I payed and how damaged my hair is that I can’t even put heat on it to try fix it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Izzy Parrish,

Thank you for sharing your feedback, and we are truly sorry to hear that you are disappointed with your results. We completely understand how upsetting this must be, especially given the time and investment you made.

To provide some context, during your consultation, we noticed that your hair is beautifully fine and delicate. Because of this, our stylists intentionally chose the gentlest straightening formula possible to protect your hair's core health and prevent severe chemical breakage. We always prioritize the long-term integrity of our clients' hair, but we sincerely regret that the final look did not meet your expectations.

We would love the opportunity to look after you and see how we can safely address this. Please contact us directly via WhatsApp or call us at +6696 897 3630 so our senior specialist can personally assist you and find the best solution.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope to hear from you soon.

Warm regards,
The Queen Salon and Spa

Never again...
I ordered a Squier Bullet Strat with Amp and other things.
But the guitar had defects. One of the screws fix the pickguard was slack and couldn't fixed again and another one was totally slanted what looked not nice and had a sharp edge. Also was the pickguard scratched.
So I called to the shop for to change the guitar. What the staff told me is not to believe but true:
"You can come to the shop and I will open another carton for you. But only one more! If that other guitar has also problems I can not do anything more. I can not open more cartons."
Fortunately I ordered with Shopee and I could send everything back and got the money back from Shopee.
After that I bought everything from Veemusic with 3 shops in Rangsit, much better...

reviews.name: Diva Khoury
reviews.text:
Absolutely excellent! I got a 60-minute Thai body massage from Namfon & it was heavenly. Perfect pressure, very attentive, I felt so relaxed I almost fell asleep 🥹

When you start, you get a foot rub & wash (with complimentary tea & towel), then clothes & slippers to change into. There is a locker for your convenience included in the price (which is so fair for what you’re getting!)

On your way out you also get hot tea & a rice cookie to enjoy! I want to point out that these ladies are given a new chance at working & having a steady life after jail time. They are all wonderful, sweet & welcoming, & it’s a great opportunity to support them 💜

My go-to whenever I am here now!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this incredibly thoughtful and heartfelt review! 💜 We’re truly honored that your 60-minute Thai massage with Namfon was such a wonderful experience. We’ll be sure to share your lovely compliments with her — we know they will mean so much to her. 🥰

We’re also very grateful that you noticed and appreciated the small details throughout the experience, from the foot wash and welcome tea to the changing clothes, locker, and tea and rice cookie at the end. ☕🍪

Most importantly, thank you for understanding and supporting the purpose behind Lila Thai Massage. Your kindness and encouragement mean so much to our team and to the women who are building new opportunities through their work.

And knowing that we’ve become your go-to place whenever you’re in Chiang Mai truly makes us smile! We look forward to welcoming you back again and again. 🙏💜

It was a pleasure to welcome you both, and we hope to see you again on your next visit to Chiang Mai! 🙏💜

reviews.textTranslated: I came for a therapeutic massage and it was amazing! This is the best massage shop I've ever been to. The massage therapists were excellent, polite, and lovely. The shop is clean. I will definitely come back again and recommend it to my friends and family. It was fantastic! 🥹💖

reviews.text: เป็นสถานที่นวดที่ดีที่สุดตั้งแต่เคยนวดมา ประทับใจตั้งแต่พนักงานต้อนรับจนถึงพนักงานที่นวดให้ เป็นคนท้องและพาลูกชายคนเล็กมาด้วย พนักงานช่วยดูแลลูกให้อย่างดีค่ะ  บรรยากาศดีมากผ่อนคลายจริงๆ วันนี้มาใช้บริการนวดผ่อนคลายเพราะตั้งครรภ์ หมอนวดให้ความดูแลเอาใจใส่อย่างดี คำนึงถึงความปลอดภัยของคุณแม่และนวดด้วยความประณีต สามีใช้บริการนวดศรีษะ บอกว่าน้ำหนักมือดีผ่อนคลายจนเผลอหลับ ประทับใจมากค่ะ ราคาเหมาะสมคุ้มค่ากับการสิ่งที่ได้รับ แนะนำมากๆค่ะดีจริงๆ ❤️❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated: This is the best massage I've ever had. I was impressed from the receptionist to the masseuse. I'm pregnant and brought my youngest son with me, and the staff took great care of him. The atmosphere was wonderful and truly relaxing. I came for a relaxing massage because of my pregnancy. The masseuse was very attentive and caring, prioritizing my safety and performing the massage with precision. My husband had a head massage and said the pressure was perfect and so relaxing he even fell asleep. I was very impressed. The price is reasonable and worth what you receive. I highly recommend it; it's truly excellent! ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.textTranslated: Khun Nunna, the Thai traditional medicine practitioner, gave a very good massage. She hit every spot correctly, and I could feel the effects clearly during the treatment.
