reviews.name: Boo Ana
reviews.text:
I went for a health check, and I was genuinely impressed from the moment I walked in. The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive, which made the whole experience feel very comfortable and relaxed.

The doctor was very professional and took the time to explain everything clearly and in detail. I didn’t feel rushed at all, and the advice given was practical and easy to apply in daily life. It really helped me better understand my body and how to take care of it moving forward.

Overall, it was a great experience both in terms of service and care. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking to take a more holistic approach to their health.

reviews.name: Sass B.
reviews.text:
Our family has been coming to this acupuncture clinic for years, and we are always impressed by the excellent care we receive. Dr. Xing is fantastic—he takes great care of our health, especially when we have injuries. This clinic is also great for elderly patients; both my mum and dad have benefited from the treatments.

Dr. Moss is highly skilled in tuina massage and has helped tremendously with sports injuries. Additionally, their Chinese medicine for skin and wellness has made a noticeable difference in my skin, making it brighter and healthier. I also love doing facial acupuncture here—it’s a great experience with visible results. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: swanya buddhavana
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of visiting XingfuClinic, and I can honestly say it’s a transformative experience. This clinic is a true haven for those seeking balance and healing. The combination of traditional Chinese acupuncture and the deep understanding of yin-yang energy really helps restore harmony to both mind and body.

What sets them apart is the thorough, system-by-system approach to healing. The acupuncture treatments worked wonders on my energy flow, and the clinic’s attention to detail in addressing the root causes of my issues was impressive. The doctors are incredibly professional, not only administering precise acupuncture but also offering customized herbal remedies tailored to your specific symptoms.

Thanks to their holistic care, I noticed significant improvement within a month. If you’re looking for a place that can genuinely heal you from the inside out, Xingfu Clinic is the place to go. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for natural, effective treatment!

reviews.name: kittiya CH
reviews.text: I have a great experience here with Dr. Angie. She did excellent job on acupuncture 💕

reviews.name: Alexandre Josue Banji
reviews.text:
Exceptional experience at Xingfu Clinic in Bangkok! The doctors (Dr.Ching) and staff truly embody the compassionate spirit of traditional Chinese medicine. From the thorough consultation to the personalized treatment plan, every step was seamless and professional.

The clinic's serene atmosphere and commitment to holistic healing made me feel at ease. I've noticed significant improvements in my overall well-being, and I'm grateful for the clinic's dedication to helping patients achieve balance and harmony.

If you're seeking authentic traditional Chinese medicine in Thailand, Xingfu Clinic is the epitome of excellence. Five stars and highest recommendations!

reviews.name: Sireepattra S.
reviews.text: The atmosphere is good and clean. The doctor treats well and gives good advice. It's amazing that the doctor can tell from just touching me about my symptoms. Recommend!

reviews.text: Awesome! Dr. Angie is amazing.

reviews.text:
ไปใช้บริการครั้งแรก กับอาการปวดตึงหัวเข่ากับปวดเมื่อยตามน่อง ประทับใจบริการมากๆค่ะ
คุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าทึ่  ให้คำแนะนำแบบไม่กั๊กไม่หวง น่ารักใจดีมากๆค่ะเป็นกันเองสุดๆ  *แถมได้รับความรู้เพิ่มเติมเรื่องการกิน เรื่องอาหารให้เหมาะกับตัวเราอีกด้วยค่ะ

สถานที่ สะอาด โปร่ง สบายตา แอร์เย็น

ราคาและบริการตามในภาพ

ที่จอดรถ สะดวก ไม่เสียค่าจอด
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first visit for knee stiffness and calf pain, and I was very impressed with the service.
The doctor and staff were very helpful and open-minded, kind, and friendly. *I also learned extra about nutrition and choosing the right food for my needs.

The place was clean, spacious, comfortable, and the air conditioning was cool.

Prices and services are as shown in the picture.

Parking was convenient and free.

reviews.name: Kanyawatt P
reviews.text: คุณหมอดูแลดีมาก หายปวดหลังเลย จากที่ก้มแล้วเจ็บเป็นเวลา 6 เดือน มาวันนี้เจอหมอเมี่ยงครั้งแรก ช่วยฝังเข็มปรับสมดุลและมีแนะนำยาจีนแผนโบราณให้ แนะนำให้มาครับ
reviews.textTranslated: The doctor provided excellent care. My back pain is completely gone. For 6 months, I experienced pain when bending over. Today was my first time seeing Dr. Miang. She helped restore balance with acupuncture and recommended traditional Chinese medicine. I highly recommend coming here.

reviews.name: Muanpa Poungkeaw
reviews.text:
ไปใช้บริการฝังเข็มเนื่องจากมีอาการปวดหลัง คลินิกสะอาด เงียบ สงบ บรรยากาศดี รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย
คุณหมอแองจี้ แนะนำดี ตรวจอาการและซักข้อมูลละเอียด อธิบายเข้าใจง่าย

ระหว่างฝังเข็มหมอมือเบา แต่ตรงจุดที่ปวดจะรู้สึกจี๊ดนิดหน่อย รู้เลยว่าตรงจุด หลังทำเสร็จอาการปวดและความตึงคลายลง รู้สึกสบายขึ้น โดยรวมประทับใจ แนะนำครับ 👍
reviews.textTranslated:
I went for acupuncture because of back pain. The clinic was clean, quiet, and peaceful with a relaxing atmosphere.
Dr. Angie gave good advice, examined my symptoms thoroughly, and explained everything in an easy-to-understand way.

During the acupuncture, the doctor was gentle, but I could feel a slight tingling sensation at the painful spots, letting me know exactly where the pain was. After the treatment, the pain and tension subsided, and I felt much better. Overall, I was impressed and recommend it. 👍

reviews.name: Kattareeya Kaewsiri
reviews.text: วันนี้มีโอกาสไปใช้บริการที่คลีนิคเจอคุณหมอเบลล์ คุณหมอสอบถามละเอียด และมีการวินิจฉัยที่ค่อนข้างตรงกับอาการที่เป็นอยู่ รวมไปถึงอาการที่เคยเป็นเลยค่ะ ให้คำแนะเรื่องการปรับอาหารการกินต่าง ๆ ให้ร่างกายปรับสมดุลให้ดี ตอนฝังเข็มมีเจ็บบ้างตรงที่ปวด ตอนครอบแก้วเสร็จตัวเบาเลยค่ะ ง่วงนอนเลย บ่า ไหล่ เบาลงเยอะค่ะ ขอบคุณคุณหมอเบลล์มาก ๆ เลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated: Today I had the opportunity to visit the clinic and met Dr. Belle. She asked detailed questions and her diagnosis was quite accurate for my current symptoms, including those I've experienced before. She gave advice on adjusting my diet to help my body regain balance. The acupuncture was a little painful in the painful areas, and after the cupping session I felt very light and sleepy. My shoulders and neck pain have significantly decreased. Thank you so much, Dr. Belle!

reviews.name: Waan-Gledpet Sumonphandh
reviews.text:
ฝังเข็มครั้งแรกไม่เจ็บเลย ประทับใจกับการรักษาที่ Xingfu Clinic ค่ะ 🙂👍

วันนี้ลองเปิดใจมารักษาอาการออฟฟิศซินโดรมและรักษาฝ้าด้วยการฝังเข็มเป็นครั้งแรกที่ Xingfu Clinic รู้สึกอุ่นใจเพราะได้รับคำแนะนำจากหมอเมี่ยงซึ่งเป็นคุณหมอประจำคลินิกและรุ่นน้อง BNI Innovation (สมาคมผู้ประกอบการ) อีกทั้งเพื่อนๆ หลายคนที่เคยมาใช้บริการแล้วบอกว่าเห็นผลดีจริง

ก่อนการรักษา..หมอเมี่ยงวัดความดันและจับแมะชีพจรอย่างละเอียด ทำให้ได้รู้ว่านอกจากความดันต่ำแล้ว ยังมีอาการวิงเวียนและปัญหาท้องอืด ควรต้องกินยาจีนปรับสมดุลก่อน ถือเป็นการวินิจฉัยที่ใส่ใจมากๆ ค่ะ

สำหรับการฝังเข็ม หมอเมี่ยงมือเบามากๆ ไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะ รู้สึกคล้ายมดกัดเท่านั้นเอง และสำหรับอาการปวดคอบ่าไหล่จากออฟฟิศซินโดรม รู้สึกได้ทันทีว่าอาการปวดเมื่อยคลายลงอย่างเห็นได้ชัดหลังทำเสร็จ ส่วนเรื่องฝ้าต้องรอดูผลในระยะยาวนะคะ

ที่ประทับใจสุดๆ คือการดูแลของหมอเมี่ยงและทีมงานทุกคนที่ดูแลเป็นอย่างดี และยังแถมการทำกัวซาหน้าใสให้ด้วย ทำให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากๆ และรู้สึกได้เลยว่าหน้าใสขึ้นทันตาจริงๆ ค่ะ 😊✨

ใครกำลังมองหาสถานที่รักษาอาการปวดเมื่อย หรืออยากมีสุขภาพดีและหน้าใส ขอแนะนำ Xingfu Clinic เลยนะคะ ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอนค่ะ!

Amazing Results for Office Syndrome at Xingfu Clinic!

Today, I finally took the plunge and tried acupuncture for the first time at Xingfu Clinic to treat my office syndrome (chronic pain) and melasma (facial pigmentation). I felt instantly reassured because the clinic's doctor, Dr. Miang, is a junior from my BNI Innovation group (an association of entrepreneurs), and many friends who have used her services said they had genuinely great results.

Before the treatment, Dr. Miang performed a detailed check, including measuring my blood pressure and doing a thorough pulse diagnosis. This revealed that besides having low blood pressure, I also experience dizziness and bloating/gastric issues, suggesting I should take Chinese medicine to balance my body first. This was a very attentive and personalized diagnosis.

As for the acupuncture itself, Dr. Miang has an incredibly gentle hand! It wasn't painful at all; it just felt like a tiny mosquito bite. For the pain in my neck, shoulders, and back from office syndrome, I could feel the muscle tension ease up significantly right after the session! I'll have to wait and see the long-term results for my melasma.

What impressed me most was the excellent care from Dr. Miang and the entire team. They even included a complimentary Guasha facial treatment, which was incredibly relaxing and I could tell my face looked brighter immediately! 😊✨

If you're looking for a place to treat aches and pains, or if you want to improve your health and get clear skin, I highly recommend Xingfu Clinic! You certainly won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: วรางคณา พรหมสิงห์
reviews.text: คลินิกสะอาด หมอเก่งมาก ให้ลองจับๆนวดๆ ตรงที่มีปัญหาหมอวิเคราะห์ได้ทันที เลยลอง ฝังเข็ม ตามที่หมอแนะนำ สรุปแก้อาการได้ดีแบบแปลกใจมาก เพราะหาหมอมาเยอะมาก ลองมาหลากหลายวิธี ก็ยังไม่หาย ฝังเข็มทีเดียว ไม่มีอาการอีกเลย 😍
reviews.textTranslated: The clinic was clean and the doctor was very skilled. He let me feel and massage the problem areas, and immediately diagnosed my condition. I tried acupuncture as recommended, and surprisingly, it effectively resolved my symptoms. I had seen many doctors and tried various methods before, but nothing worked. After just one acupuncture session, my symptoms disappeared completely! 😍

reviews.name: 梁欣欣
reviews.text: 医生能通过把脉说出我身体肺热和皮肤长疹子的情况 开了中药调理身体，目前喝了之后感觉很不错！！还有长达一两年的腰痛问题通过一次针灸之后基本康复，我会继续针灸两三次直到痊愈，非常推荐！！
reviews.textTranslated: The doctor was able to diagnose my lung heat and skin rashes by taking my pulse. He prescribed traditional Chinese medicine to regulate my body, and I feel great after taking it! My back pain, which had lasted for one or two years, was basically cured after one acupuncture session. I will continue with acupuncture two or three more times until I am fully recovered. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Fonology yéyé
reviews.text: มารักษาอาการปวดไหล่ยกไม่ขึ้น ปวดเอว ปวดสะโพก ปวดหัว ปวดกราม หมอชิ้งจัดการให้เบาสบายหมดเลย ร้านสะอาดมาก หมอน่ารัก ที่จอดรถเยอะแยะ แต่ต้องขับเข้ามาข้างในนะ หมอชิงก็อธิบายละเอียด คุณหมอที่นี่ให้เวลาและใจเย็นในการพูดคุยเป็นกันเองมาก
reviews.textTranslated: I came here for treatment of my shoulder pain (unable to lift my arm), lower back pain, hip pain, headache, and jaw pain. Dr. Ching made me feel much better. The clinic is very clean, the doctor is lovely, and there's plenty of parking, although you have to drive inside. Dr. Ching explained everything in detail. The doctors here take their time and are very patient and friendly during consultations.

reviews.name: Sirilak Kaewsoi
reviews.text: มีเพื่อนๆแฟนแนะนำมาคะว่ามีอาการปวดหัวฝังเข็มแล้วหาย เลยแวะเข้ามาด้วยมีอาการปวด ปจด หนาว ไมเกรน ครบเลยคะ คุณหมอชิงตรวจ ให้คำแนะนำ และฝังเข็ม พร้อมกับทานยาจีน ดีมากเลยคะได้ความรู้ดูแลตัวเองด้วยคะ👍😊
reviews.textTranslated: My boyfriend's friends recommended this place, saying acupuncture helped with headaches. I came in because I had menstrual cramps, chills, and migraines – the whole package! Dr. Ching examined me, gave me advice, performed acupuncture, and prescribed Chinese medicine. It was great! I also learned how to take care of myself. 👍😊

reviews.name: Aphatsara N
reviews.text: ไปครอบแก้วและฝังเข็มกับคุณหมอไหมมา ชอบมาก คุณหมอน่ารักใจดี เก่งมาก รู้อาการเราทันที อาการปวดหลังตอนนี้หายเลย  แนะนำเลยที่นี้ ดีมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I went for cupping and acupuncture with Dr. Mai and loved it. She's lovely, kind, and very skilled. She understood my symptoms immediately, and my back pain is completely gone. I highly recommend this place; it's excellent!

reviews.name: WS Sripumma
reviews.text:
คุณแม่มีอาการปวดหลังมาหลายปี ด้วยกระดูกพรุนตามอายุ และเข้ารับการฝังเข็มกับคุณหมอเมี่ยงคนสวยค่ะ😘

และเช้าวันรุ่งขึ้นก็มีเรื่องมหัศจรรย์ค่ะ…คุณแม่เดินโชว์พร้อมบอกว่า “เดินหลังตรงเลย!! ไม่ต้องแปะแผ่นลดปวดแล้ว” คำว่าเห็นผลตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกมีอยู่จริงๆ

ตอนนี้คุณแม่ฝังเข็มไปแล้ว 4 ครั้ง (อาทิตย์ละครั้ง) จบครอสล่ะคะ อาการปวดหลัง ร้อนหลังหายไป รู้สึกเบาตัวมากๆ  คุณหมอเมี่ยงเลยจัดโสมให้คุณแม่ทานบำรุงค่ะ

🏨ที่นี่เค้าดูแลดีมากๆ ค่ะ ใครมีอาการแนะนำให้เข้าไปปรึกษาเลยน๊ะคะ มาไวหายไวค่ะ

ปล.น้ำจับเลี้ยงอร่อยมากๆ ด้วยน๊ะคะ😆😁

#แม่happyเราก็happyka😘
reviews.textTranslated:
My mom had been suffering from back pain for years due to age-related osteoporosis and received acupuncture treatment from the lovely Dr. Miang. 😘

And the next morning, something miraculous happened… My mom walked around proudly, saying, “I can walk with my back straight now!! I don’t need pain relief patches anymore!” The saying "seeing results from the first time" is true!

My mom has now completed 4 acupuncture sessions (once a week). Her back pain and burning sensation are gone, and she feels much lighter. Dr. Miang prescribed ginseng for her to take as a supplement.

🏨 The care here is excellent. I highly recommend consulting them if you have any symptoms. Early intervention leads to faster recovery.

P.S. The herbal drink is delicious too! 😆😁

#MomIsHappyWeAreHappy😘

reviews.text: วันนี้ 4/7/2569 ราว 18 นาฬิกากว่าๆ ผมทำธุระเสร็จขี่รถมาแวะปัสสาวะ ซึ่งผมขี่มอไซคันใหญ่ 1300 ซีซี ที่จอดรถมอไซตรงหน้า 7-11 มันเต็มเพราะมีข่องเดียวที่จอดมอไซคันเล็กแม้จะซ้อนคันแล้วก็จอดได้ไม่เกิน 6-8 คัน ผมเลยไปจอดในช่องจอดรถยนต์แถวหน้าร้านอะเมซอนที่ว่างและตอนนั้น ช่องจอดรถยนต์ก็ว่างหลายช่อง ผมเดินไปห้องน้ำละกลับมาคิดว่าให้เวลาไม่น่าเกิน 3-4 นาที ตอนเดินกลับมาที่รถมอไซก็มีคนเดิมข้างๆ คงเป็น รปภ.ดูแลปั๊มช่วงกลางคืนเพราะตอนจอดรถทีแรกเขามองๆมา ตอนเขาจัดของตรงหน้าอเมซอนคงเป็นที่นั่งเขาตอนทำงานกลางคืน เขาเดินมาแล้วก็พูดห้วนๆว่าที่จอดมอไซอยู่หน้า 7-11 นะ ผมเลยตอบกลับไปว่ามันจอดไม่ได้รถผมคันใหญ่ไม่มีที่จอดแล้วผมจอดเข้าห้องน้ำแป๊บเดียวเอง เตือนผมไม่ได้ว่าอะไรแต่วิธีการพูดควรจะดีกว่านี้ ควรสอบถามก่อนว่าทำไมถึงมาจอดตรงนั้น ผมไม่ได้ถืออภิสิทธิ์ว่าจะจอดตรงไหนก็ได้แต่ลุงแกควรถามควรดูอีกนิดและแกสามารถใช้คำพูดดีๆได้ ซึ่งตอนออกมาผมก็หันไปมองที่จอดมอไซอีกครั้งมันก็ยังเต็มจอดไม่ได้ เผื่อเจ้าของปั๊มเปิดมาดู
reviews.textTranslated: Today, July 4th, 2026, around 6 PM, after finishing my errands, I stopped to use the restroom. I ride a large 1300cc motorcycle. The motorcycle parking in front of the 7-Eleven was full because there's only one space for smaller motorcycles, and even with double parking, it can only fit 6-8 bikes. So I parked in a car parking space near the Amazon cafe, where there were several empty spaces. I went to the restroom and returned, thinking it wouldn't take more than 3-4 minutes. When I walked back to my motorcycle, the same person next to me—probably the security guard for the night shift, because he'd been glancing at me while arranging things in front of the Amazon cafe (that's probably his seating area during his night shift)—walked over and curtly said, "The motorcycle parking is in front of the 7-Eleven." I replied that I couldn't park there because my motorcycle is too big and there was no space, and I was just quickly using the restroom. I didn't mind him warning me, but his approach should have been better. He should have asked why I parked there. I don't think I have any special privileges and can park wherever I want, but he should have asked, looked around a bit, and used more polite language. When I left, I glanced back at the motorcycle parking area again, and it was still full; I couldn't park there. I was hoping the gas station owner would come and check.

reviews.text: highly recommend! small place, but very clean and i’ve been here so many times and every time the massage is good regardless who the masseur is (i prefer a firmer massage to relieve all the knots from office work and exercise).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for recommending us and for visiting many times. We’re delighted to hear that you consistently enjoy clean surroundings and quality massages, no matter which therapist you see. It’s wonderful to know that our firmer techniques help relieve the knots from office work and exercise. Your continued trust means a great deal to us, and we look forward to welcoming you again soon for another relaxing session.

reviews.name: Haza Alfa
reviews.text: "BODY Tune Chidlom offers an exceptional Thai massage experience at an unbeatable price. From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff were professional and skilled, ensuring that every knot and tension in my muscles was expertly addressed during the massage. The ambiance was serene, allowing me to fully relax and rejuvenate. What impressed me the most was the value for money - the quality of the massage far exceeded the reasonable price. If you're in need of a therapeutic escape from the hustle and bustle of Bangkok, look no further than BODY Tune Chidlom. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking an affordable yet top-notch massage experience."
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review. We’re delighted that you enjoyed the welcoming atmosphere, professional care, and exceptional value of our Thai massage. We look forward to welcoming you again at BODY Tune Chidlom

reviews.text: I had a very unpleasant massage experience. The therapist used the wrong kind of pressure throughout the session, relying heavily on elbows, knees. reviews.name: Jason

reviews.name: Bianca Leong
reviews.text: One of my favorite massage places to go to in bbk. Been coming here for years. It’s clean and modest. Not a fancy spa where they try to upsell you packages. Was recommended by a bkk resident once long ago and have been coming back since. Always enjoyed my experience.

reviews.name: john chan

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We’re glad you enjoyed the nice ambience and clean venue, especially when visiting during less busy times. Looking forward to welcoming you again 😊

reviews.text: ลูกค้าเราสั่งชาเขียวใบหม่อน เราเลยไปหาซื้อที่ร้าน X ร้าน X ของหมด เลยไปเพื่อนดินฟ้า ที่ชั้นวางก็หมด เลยไปถามตรงแคชเชียร์ว่า ชาเขียวใบหม่อนจะมีของอีกเมื่อไหร่ค่ะ แคชเชียร์คนนั้นก็ตอบด้วยน้ำเสียงประชดว่า เอานามบัตรมั้ยคะ โทรถามเองเลยค่ะ เรางงก็เลยตอบไปว่า แต่สินค้าเป็นของเพื่อนดินฟ้าเองไม่ใช่เหรอคะ (งงว่าจะให้นามบัตรทำไม) พอนึกได้ก็เลยรู้ว่าประชดใส่ แบบนี้เราคงไม่กลับไปเหยียบร้านอีกแล้วค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Our customer ordered mulberry green tea, so we went to store X, but they were out of stock. We then went to Friend's Store, but they were also sold out. We asked the cashier when they would have more mulberry green tea, and she sarcastically replied, "Do you want my business card? Call them yourself." We were confused and replied, "But isn't this Friend's Store your own?" (We were puzzled why she would offer a business card.) Later, we realized she was being sarcastic. We'll definitely not be going back to that store again.

reviews.name: Chananya C.
reviews.text: อาหารสุขภาพเยอะมากก แถมราคาดีสุดๆ กลับมาซื้ออีกแน่นอนค่ะ❤️
reviews.textTranslated: They have so many healthy food options, and the prices are amazing! I'll definitely be back to buy more. ❤️

reviews.name: Puttaruk Viriyapannachot
reviews.text: วันก่อนปวดหลัง แวะไปที่ร้าน พี่พนักงานออกแนะนำตัวนวดสะบักให้ ใช้อย่างดีเลย ถูกใจมากๆครับ ! แนะนำ
reviews.textTranslated: The other day I had back pain and stopped by the shop. The staff recommended a shoulder blade massage, and it was excellent! I really liked it! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: montri Chan
reviews.text: ต้องการเน้นแนวสุขภาพต้องมาที่นี่มีสินค้าแนวสุขภาพให้เลือกทุกอย่างตามที่คุณต้องการ

reviews.name: vichayut sawet
reviews.text: แหล่งขายของเพื่อสุขภาพ มีผลิตภัณฑ์ดีๆที่หลากหลาย

reviews.name: ร.ต.ต.รังสิมันตุ์ ศรีจันทรากูล

reviews.name: Mai Jindalucksanalerk
reviews.text: สั่งซื้อสินค้าเพื่อการอุปโภคบริโภคทางออนไลน์ได้รับสินค้าครบถ้วน มีความซื่อสัตย์ต่อกันและกัน ช่วงโรคระบาดโควิท 19 มีลูกค้าทางร้านเยอะมาก หากติดต่อซื้อขายทางไลน์ ....ลูกค้าต้องใจเย็นมาก ๆ อาจใช้เวลารอคอยติดต่อกลับตามคิวนานหน่อยคะ
reviews.textTranslated: I ordered consumer goods online and received everything completely. There was honesty between us. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the shop had a lot of customers. If you contacted us for purchases via Line, please be very patient as you may have to wait a while for a reply.

reviews.name: Angell
reviews.text: มาซื้อของที่นี่บ่อยมากค่ะ สินค้าเยอะแล้วก็น่าสนใจทั้งนั้น ของถูกด้วย พนักงานน่ารัก บริการดีมากๆค่ะ

reviews.name: เปรมปรีญา ทองทิพย์
reviews.text: มีสินค้ามากมายให้เลือก เกี่ยวกับสุขภาพทั้งนั้น พนักงานบริการดีเลิศ อยากได้อะไรครบจบในที่เดียว ขายทั้งปลีก และ ส่ง
reviews.textTranslated: They have a wide variety of health-related products. The staff provides excellent service. You can find everything you need in one place. They sell both retail and wholesale.

reviews.name: ko pa
reviews.text: ของแนวสมุนไพร สุขภาพ เครื่องปรุงคลีน คีโตเยอะมาก ราคาถูก

reviews.name: Cubicex Cubicex
reviews.text: สินค้าอาหารและยาน่าสนใจหลายอย่าง
reviews.textTranslated: There are many interesting food and drug products.

reviews.name: รวมพร พรหมราช
reviews.text: ไปมาวันนี้ มีของใหม่ๆให้เลือกซื้อเพิ่มเติมมากมายเลยค่ะ เผื่อเวลากันไปด้วยนะคะ เพราะของเยอะ น่าซื้อไปหมดค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I went today and there are so many new items to choose from! Make sure to set aside enough time because there's so much to buy and everything looks tempting.

reviews.name: กัมปนาท กุศลาสัย
reviews.text: ใครชอบอาหารมังฯ ต้องมาที่นี่นะคับ อร่อยมากๆ ข้าวซอย+ก๋วยจั๊บ และก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือน้ำข้นชามใหญ่
reviews.textTranslated: If you like vegetarian food, you have to come here! It's delicious, especially the Khao Soi, Kuay Jab, and the large bowl of thick broth boat noodles.

reviews.name: ทรงรัฐ อยู่แสนสุข
reviews.text: มีสินค้าขายมากมายหลายอย่างมากเลยครับ คนที่ทานชีวจิต, ทานเจ, ทานมังสวิรัต สามารถหาสินค้าได้จากที่นี่เลยครับ
reviews.textTranslated: There are so many different products for sale here. People who follow a macrobiotic diet, vegetarian diet, or vegan diet can find everything they need here.

reviews.name: nuengbuddha vimuttinunt
reviews.text:
ร้านเพื่อนดินฟ้า เปิดขายสินค้าชุมชน สมุนไพร เพื่อสุขภาพ ผลิตภัณฑ์ประทินผิว ปัจจุบันตั้งอยู่หัวมุมปากซอย ถนนนวมินทร์ 50
เดิมก่อนหน้า 2559 ร้านตั้งอยู่ในซอย นวมินทร์ 46 หน้าพุทธสถาน
สันติอโศก ขายมานานกว่าสิบปีก่อน เพิ่งย้ายมาเปิดแห่งใหม่นี้
เป็นปี่ที่สอง ผู้มาช็อปร้านพลังบุญและย่านตลาดบุญนิยมสันติอโศก
เชิญแวะร้านเพื่อนดินฟ้า บริการอังคารถึงวันอาทิตย๋ หยุดวันจันทร์
reviews.textTranslated:
Friends of Earth and Sky Shop sells community products, herbal health products, and skincare products. It is currently located at the corner of Soi Nawamin 50, Nawamin Road.
Previously, before 2016, the shop was located in Soi Nawamin 46, in front of the Santi Asoke Buddhist Center, and had been selling products there for over a decade. This is its second year at this new location.
Shoppers of the Santi Asoke Buddhist Market and its community support network are welcome to visit Friends of Earth and Sky Shop. We are open Tuesday to Sunday, closed on Mondays.

reviews.name: Amnart Dang
reviews.text: สินค้าเยอะมาก แต่พนักงานไม่ค่อยสนใจลูกค้าเท่าไหร่ ระบบคิดเงินช้า คิวเลยยาวเป็นบางครั้ง
reviews.textTranslated: There are a lot of products, but the staff aren't very attentive to customers. The checkout system is slow, so the queues are sometimes long.

title: Sense Spa Phuket
subTitle: SENSE Spa Phuket Town

SENSE Spa Phuket Town is a boutique wellness spa in the heart of Phuket Town, offering a peaceful escape for body and mind.

Discover our signature Head Spa treatments, Deep Sleep Head Spa, Thai massage, relaxing hot oil aromatherapy massage, and rejuvenating facial treatments. Each experience is thoughtfully designed to ease tension, encourage relaxation, and restore a sense of balance.

Whether you’re exploring Phuket Old Town or looking for a quiet moment during your holiday, SENSE Spa welcomes you to slow down, unwind, and enjoy a more mindful spa experience in Phuket.

reviews.name: Fanny Pozo
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an amazing experience! Apple was my therapist, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. She was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive throughout the entire treatment. Her head massage technique was outstanding the perfect pressure and incredibly relaxing.

The spa has a peaceful, clean atmosphere that makes the whole experience even more enjoyable. I left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed. I highly recommend this head spa, and I’ll definitely be coming back. Thank you, Apple!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review 🤍

We’re delighted to hear you had such an amazing experience with Apple. She’ll be so happy to know that her care, professionalism, and head massage technique helped you feel completely relaxed and refreshed.

It’s also wonderful to hear you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere of our spa. We believe that every detail, from the environment to the treatment itself, plays a part in creating a truly memorable wellness experience.

Thank you for your kind recommendation and for choosing SENSE Spa Phuket. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another relaxing visit soon.

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team 🤍

reviews.name: A.Magnano
reviews.text: Apple gave me a very very nice treatment. I can’t explain in words how nice and welcoming Apple was and the staff. They are so kind and they do an amazing job. My hair was really clean and beautiful after the treatment I did a scalp treatment it took 90 min and I paid 1500 bath. It was worth it. They took care of my kids so I can relax. Which I really appreciated as a mom that I constantly stressed and caring a lot of responsibility. This place made me feel I can relax and that it’s once in a while me that is important. I will come back again 🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your heartfelt review 🤍

We’re truly touched by your kind words. It means so much to us to know that Apple and our team made you feel genuinely welcomed, cared for, and able to fully relax during your Head Spa experience. We’ll be sure to share your beautiful feedback with Apple.

As a busy mom, finding a moment just for yourself is so important, and we’re especially happy that taking care of your children allowed you to enjoy some well-deserved time to unwind. Knowing that you left feeling refreshed, with a healthy scalp and beautiful hair, is exactly what we hope for every guest.

Thank you for choosing SENSE Spa Phuket. We can’t wait to welcome you and your family back for another relaxing visit soon. 🩷

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team 🤍

reviews.name: Kat Tan
reviews.text:
Love the experience! Went for the Sleep Bliss package - and yes, I did fall asleep!

Apple was a great therapist, very calming and soothing. Just a small blip when my body got a bit too warm hahaha - but they went out of their way to make sure my body cooled down quickly.

Highly recommend if you’re in the area! You won’t go wrong!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review

We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the Sleep Bliss package and that it lived up to its name. Falling asleep during the treatment is one of the best compliments we could receive

Apple will be so happy to know you enjoyed her calming and soothing approach. We’re also glad our team was able to quickly make you comfortable when you felt a little too warm. Your comfort is always our priority

Thank you for your recommendation. We’re honored to be part of your Phuket experience and hope to welcome you back for another well-deserved rest soon

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team

reviews.name: ABO HOOR
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an amazing experience from start to finish. The spa is clean, relaxing, and very professional. I chose the Head Spa C treatment, and the deep scalp cleansing was excellent. My scalp felt incredibly clean, fresh, and refreshed afterward.

A big thank you to the entire team for their kindness and professionalism. Special thanks to Apple, who was absolutely amazing. She was attentive, skilled, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the whole treatment.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a high quality head spa and deep scalp care. I will definitely come back!

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team 🤍

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The hospitality was top-notch—all the staff were lovely, and Khun Apple did a fantastic job with the massage. She was so attentive and professional. With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team

reviews.name: Naiyanad Ohpanayikool
reviews.text: Such a relaxing massage! I did a Deep Sleep Head Spa program 90 minutes for 1,590 THB. The spa includes aromatherapy massage on the shoulder, arm, hand, and back area, then hot compress therapy all around the same area, followed by head massage and hair shampoo plus blow dry. Ms Apple is very good. Pity I don’t have enough time to try the longer program as having to rush to airport. Next time when I’m in Phuket will definitely come back to this place for a quick recovery.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review

We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the Deep Sleep Head Spa and that it gave you a relaxing moment before your flight. It’s wonderful to know you appreciated every part of the experience, from the aromatherapy massage and hot compress to the head spa and blow dry

Apple will be so happy to hear your kind words. She’ll be delighted to know she helped make your visit so enjoyable

Thank you for your recommendation and for choosing SENSE Spa Phuket. We’ll be ready to welcome you back the next time you’re in Phuket, and hopefully you’ll have time to enjoy one of our longer treatments as well

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team

reviews.name: Susan Nguyen
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Nura Awady
reviews.text:
I had such a lovely experience here today, I walked in to get a head spa for an hour and it was so luxurious.

The space is very quiet, peaceful, clean and the aroma is wonderful. The ladies greeted me with some tea and beautiful smiles. I selected my oil of choice and headed straight in to the spa area. I loved every minute of it, they take such good care of all the details, very attentive and careful. My favourite part was the steam, it made it so relaxing.

I was then taken to another room for a beautiful blow dry, again the staff were so gentle and lovely and brought me a little blanket to keep warm as they had a cool AC on and some more tea ☕️

I’m so happy 💓 thank you again. I will definitely be back here for other services they offer once I am back in Phuket 🌺
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re so happy you had this experience and we’ll be here waiting for you next time you’re back in Phuket 

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team 🤍

reviews.name: Zelene Vel

She even make my hair look curly beautiful in the end. She made my day. They even surprised me a birthday cake.They're all friendly and best service. Will definitely comeback. Highly recommended ❤️

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team

reviews.name: Tannu Malik
reviews.text:
We had a spa experience in sense and it was absolutely amazing! The staff was very friendly and professional, and the atmosphere was so relaxing that all our stress just disappeared. The massage was incredibly soothing and we truly enjoyed every moment. The place was also very clean and well maintained. Special thanks to apple
We will definitely visit again when we come back to Thailand. Highly recommended! 😊✨

reviews.name: anis fhatiha
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at this spa. The ambience is calming, cleanliness is well maintained, and the staff are highly professional. The treatment was relaxing and rejuvenating. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Azhar Yusof
reviews.text:
We visited Asana Spa Hatyai as a group of three and tried both the Indian Head Massage and Deep Tissue Massage. From start to finish, the experience was excellent.

The staff were welcoming, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout. The masseuses were truly skillful – they knew exactly how to apply the right pressure and focus on problem areas, while also making the whole session deeply relaxing. You can tell they are well-trained and experienced in their techniques.

The spa itself has a calm and cozy atmosphere, with a clean and well-maintained setup that instantly puts you at ease. What really stood out for us was the genuine service – the team checked in on our preferences, adjusted pressure when needed, and ensured we felt taken care of the entire time.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we left feeling refreshed, light, and relaxed. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Hatyai who wants both professional massage skills and warm, attentive service.

reviews.name: Jacq Chan
reviews.text:
I just had the most exceptional whole-body massage and spa experience at Asana yoga Studio & Spa Hatyai, and I am walking on air. From the moment I stepped inside, I was transported to a place of pure tranquility.

The ambiance is perfect—soft, calming music, soothing aromatherapy, and a beautifully serene decor that instantly melts your stress away. The staff greeted me with such warmth and professionalism especially the beautiful lady owner, making me feel welcome and pampered right from the start.

My aroma oil massage therapist, was absolutely incredible. Their technique was masterful. It was a true whole-body massage where every ounce of tension was expertly worked out. They found knots I didn't even know I had and released them with a pressure that was both deep and deeply relaxing. I could practically feel the stress draining from my body.

After my massage, I spent my time in their Japanese style Onsen, which was the perfect end to the treatment. Sipping on a complimentary matcha tea with a 2 sticks of  japanese glutinuos snacks called Dango if i not mistaken, I felt completely recharged. The facilities are spotless, luxurious, and clearly well-maintained.

I left feeling like a brand new person—utterly relaxed, refreshed, and rejuvenated. If you are looking for a high-quality, professional, and truly blissful spa day, Asana Yoga Studio & Spa Hatyai is highly recommended enough. It was worth every penny, and I am already planning my next visit!

title: Grandma's Home Cooking School
ownerDescription: Discover the heart of Thai culture at Grandma’s Home Cooking School near Chiang Mai! Perfect for travelers, this hands-on experience includes a market visit to explore local ingredients, harvesting fresh produce from an organic farm, and learning to cook authentic Thai dishes in a serene village setting. Suitable for all skill levels and dietary preferences, including vegetarian and halal, classes offer personalized instruction and a chance to enjoy your creations. Hotel transfers make it hassle-free. Uncover the magic of Thai food and culture!
address: 172 7 Moo.8 Tambon Khua Mung, Saraphi Chiang Mai 50140, Thailand
plusCode: M3G3+XR Saraphi, Saraphi District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Max and Amy
reviews.text:
Loved every moment of our time at the cooking school, and highly recommend the half day morning experience.

From the market tour to the school farm to plate atmosphere, the morning was so enjoyable. The school itself is beautiful, relaxing, organic and a total vibe.

Upon arrival, you select what you would like to cook from a predetermined menu, and are then guided through the steps by a skilled chef. Steps were simple and easy to follow along.

The kitchen’s were new, very clean, and well arranged. All staff, including office booking staff, chef and driver were professional and lovely to interact with.

reviews.name: tony kirk
reviews.text: This was a great experience.  Our tutor name was Best.   He is a fully trained chef as well as quite a comedian.   We all loved the experience with him.   I have all the recepies and this has given me the inspiration to cook the dishes at home.  Everything is made from natural ingredients.  Including the sauces.

reviews.name: Laureen Spielman
reviews.text: Our instructor was great, started at the market where you can buy ingredients for your own personal cooking. The meals we made were wonderful. The cooking class really explained the fruits and veg you are using and you can see how they grow. The mushroom hut was the coolest room I've ever seen for a veg grow. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Neil Attard
reviews.text: Hands down the best cooking class we have visited so far! The entire experience at Grandma's Home Cooking School was exceptional from start to finish. The instructors were warm, patient, and made every step of preparing authentic dishes both fun and easy to follow. Everything tasted incredible, the setting was lovely, and we walked away with skills we’ll definitely use back home. If you're looking for a genuine, hands-on cooking experience, do not miss this!

reviews.name: Rayan Taher
reviews.text:
Great experience at Grandma’s Cooking School in Chiang Mai. Our teacher, San, was excellent — very knowledgeable, well organised, and managed the class smoothly even though the start was delayed. The place was beautiful and the food tasted amazing. I feel like I know the cuisine much better and would happily do it again to learn new recipes.

The only downside was transportation: pickup was delayed by about an hour, and drop-off took much longer due to traffic and multiple stops.

reviews.name: Julietta Watson
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved this experience. Great to be able to cook all the Thai local dishes. The mango sticky rice at the end was delicious. We had a small group and you got to make all the dishes from scratch. Enjoyed the garden tour and collecting eggs. The kids loved having chickens placed on their heads!!!

The only criticism would be that market didn't feel authentic and would have been better to try some foods there rather than just get shown a few things in packets.

Also for the driver who collected us to explain the drive time and itinerary.

reviews.name: Katie Chipperfield
reviews.text: Jimmie was an amazing host! So funny and informative. 4 courses in total (with veggie, halal, fish options as well as chicken), and a variety of dishes to choose from for each course and free water and one complimentary iced tea drink. Class size was 10 people, each with your own station cooking your own food. It is a proper lesson where you chop your own stuff, cook everything yourself and make your own curry pastes etc rather than just a tourist attraction where you assemble the food/watch which we loved. Beginner friendly but also very engaging for an experienced cooks. Probably Not suitable for young kids as it is a whole evening. Probably Not suitable for people with nut allergy’s (peanuts and seasame loose and used in kitchen/dishes). Dairy and gluten allergy i would inquire as may be possible. absolutely loved it and all the food we cooked was incredible. Great place with lovely people. I would recommend evening class as you get the rice dish as well.  Come hungry and ready to have fun

reviews.name: Izzati Athirah
reviews.text:
Our instructor, Roger, was absolutely the best! Very friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable. He made the entire class fun and engaging from start to finish.

We cooked green curry, phad thai, tom yum, and khao soi. We were also treated with thai milk tea and mango sticky rice.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting chiang mai and wanting an authentic, fun, and hands on cooking experience!

reviews.name: Patrick De Guzman
reviews.text: We visited this class during our honeymoon. Our teacher, Patty, was so funny and charismatic, and we had an incredible time. Everything went smoothly, and we enjoyed the whole experience. We appreciated the breadth of the experience- the market tour, the garden tour, the cooking class, and the food! We especially appreciated the fact that this class offers Khao Soi on the menu, a must try dish in northern Thailand.

reviews.name: Jennifer Bourbon
reviews.text: We loved our cooking class at Grandma’s Home Cooking School! Our instructor, Roger, was funny, informative, and a great teacher! All of the meals we made were fairly easy, but totally delicious. We appreciated that they gave us the recipes at the end, along with professional photos taken throughout the class (complementary too!). The farm and instruction space were beautiful too. The only negative was the pickup - our driver got lost and was late, but the school staff were very apologetic and made sure we still got to complete the full class. We would highly recommend adding this to your Chiang Mai itinerary!

reviews.name: Jake Elliott
reviews.text:
We had Tay teach us how to make 4 separate dishes and it was amazing. She was concise in her instructions and we were over the moon with the results. Would definitely recommend to anyone considering a cooking class in Chiang Mai!

You also get a tour around the farm where everything is grown locally. All of the veg and even the eggs are organic as they have chickens on site. Couldn’t recommend it more!

reviews.name: Tan.W
reviews.text:
Pickup was scheduled between 11.30am and 12pm, with instructions to be ready at the lobby by 11.30am. At 11.55am, we received a WhatsApp saying the car would arrive in 8 minutes, along with the car plate number. At 12.04pm, another message came saying “2 minutes more”. Traffic within the city was really heavy that day.

The car arrived at 12.06pm. When we boarded, we were told we were heading to a market. The vehicle was a taxi arranged by the cooking school, but the communication was confusing as the message simply said “go market”. The market turned out to be Charoen Charoen Fresh Market, about a 30-minute drive from my hotel near Nimman.

Around 12.30pm at Charoen Charoen Fresh Market, the instructor (Miss Natalie) brought us to two stalls: one selling fresh vegetables, where she explained the ingredients used for our dishes, and another selling oils and sauces. The introduction took about 10 minutes, followed by another 10 minutes for us to shop around if we wanted to buy ingredients to bring home. All ingredients needed for the cooking class itself were already prepared by the school.

We boarded the bus at 1.15pm and arrived at the farm around 1.35pm. Upon arrival, we chose our cooking stations and selected the dishes we wanted to cook.

The session started with a short farm tour, where we got to know the vegetables and even feed the chickens — which surprisingly eat chilli!

After that, we returned to our kitchen stations, where our selected drinks were served. The first dish I cooked was Tom Yum soup. The instructor was hilarious and very attentive, going around to make sure everyone was on the right track. Once the dish was done, we enjoyed our food while the staff cleared our stations and prepared everything for the next dish.

Next was Pad Thai. Since frying was involved, the instructor demonstrated the entire process first before we went back to our own stations to cook.

The final dish was Khao Soi, although many students chose green curry instead. The school smartly grouped dishes that could be cooked together, so even when participants chose different dishes, many of the instructions could still be shared.

The whole session ended around 4.20pm, with bus pickup from 4.35pm. They could either drop us back at our hotels or in the city area. As it was Sunday, there was also a drop-off at the Sunday Walking Street market.

Overall, the lesson felt very relaxed because there was a whole team of staff working behind the scenes — cleaning up, replenishing ingredients, and preparing stations while we enjoyed our food. Once we finished eating, we could move straight on to cooking the next dish without any hassle.

Half Day Course - Afternoon Session, 1,190 THB

reviews.name: Jamie
reviews.text: A really fun and informative experience, the staff and facilities were really lovely, and we got to pick which dishes we wanted to cook. They also had options for gluten free which was amazing. Our instructor Ben was very funny and really helped us out, very worthwhile!

reviews.name: L H GOH
reviews.text:
The cooking experience was enjoyable, and our instructor was knowledgeable, friendly, and guided us well throughout the session.

Unfortunately, the transportation arrangements were disappointing. The pickup was late, and during the market tour, we were left behind even though we returned to the designated meeting point at the agreed time. This unnecessary incident affected an otherwise enjoyable experience.

reviews.name: Mary Zervakaki
reviews.text:
Our best experience, so far, in Thailand! We took the Northern cooking class! 4 people in total and the best chef/guide, Roger! Starting with the local market, continuing with the guidance in the premises and then too many hours cooking class. The place itself is also well maintained and organized!

Something to have in mind, as our hostel didn't have a lobby, we were waiting outside and the mini van didn't have a label showing that was from grandma's cooking. The driver asked a waitress and as she didn't know he was ready to leave without calling us to check where we are. We saw him searching and because all the other vans had labels we went  and ask him if he was from the cooking class and finally met each other!

reviews.name: Jessie Woo
reviews.text: I was not very interested in joining the cooking class as I always thought this is a bit gimmick. But this class is out of my expectation! The setting of the cooking class is extremely well organised and well prepared. My guide Roger is super funny and I was laughing in the whole morning. He made lots of jokes and I have learnt the Thai herbs in the class. Cooking is easy for me so I give 20% for the cooking and the 80% is the fun and atmosphere of the class👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.name: Fire King
reviews.text:
This was so worth it! I did the Northern Thai (Lanna) cooking class, and Roger was the best teacher: funny and making the best silly jokes, informative and explaining each step of the cooking process. . He even taught me some Thai words.

The organic garden tour was very nice, and they will show you all the ingredients you use. Every single dish was delicious, and there is so much preparation that makes you appreciate your food. You will have a lot of (delicious) food leftover that you can take home! The staff were also very kind, and thankyou to them for preparing all the ingredients. For the price, this is a must-try experience and the level of service and quality of everything is so good. Everything is the best, I can't find a single thing that was lacking.

Lastly, please be warned, some of the activities are physically intensive, like making your own curry paste in a mortar and pestle, and grating coconuts. You should also know how to use a knife, as the pace was moderately fast.

Best experience I've ever had in Thailand.

reviews.name: Marisa Sim
reviews.text: What a lovely afternoon spent learning about Thai ingredients, sauces and cooking methods. Our kids, 9 and 7, had a hand in cooking, and they loved the experience! The cooking school is beautiful and clean. We had a great time as a family! I highly recommend it for everyone!

reviews.name: Therese Adelgaard
reviews.text: We had such a pleasure with Grandma’s home cooking school. We started off at a local market where our teacher and guide Roger showed us some local ingredients. We had the chance to buy some curry’s we could bring home. When we came to the cooking class we started off with a garden tour to smell and taste all the different herbs. Roger made sure it was a fun experience. The cooking class was very easy and it tasted great. I can highly recommend coming here for at cooking class.

reviews.name: May Ly
reviews.text:
I did not expect to be so impressed. Worth every Baht.
I was blown away by the quality of service, food, time management, organisation. The teacher was impeccable: funny, professional, skilled, pedagogue.
The place is amazing: spacious, green, various areas to walk and take pictures, open kitchen, one stall per person. You get to really cooked and prepare everything.
The food I cooked was the best I had in Thailand! So delicious
