reviews.name: Rhonda Leiva
reviews.text:
Our family of 5 (adults) took the half day cooking class. From arrival we were made to feel like guests in a family kitchen. The chef and staff were amazing at helping us feel like we were skilled in preparing our own meal. We weren’t certain what we were in for when we arranged this class but I can whole heartedly say this has been my favorite activity in Bangkok.

The menu seemed daunting to us as we had not cooked Thai before. However, the chef walked us through preparing the meal step by step, and also offered suggestions of alternate ways to prepare in our home country if ingredients couldn’t be found. We then tasted her version to taste what we would then go cook.

Once the chef showed us how to prepare the dish we then entered the kitchen where we then made the dish ourselves. There was plenty of help in the kitchen to make sure we remembered what to do and offer even more suggestions. It was lovely to feel confident as we prepared the dish.

Each of us was offered the opportunity at the end of the class to either eat at the restaurant or to take the dishes home with us. We chose to take the meal with us as we had many bites while we were in the class.

We prepared five dishes in class. The ingredients were beyond fresh. The aromas, indescribably delicious.The chef and kitchen staff were truly amazing, so helpful and fun. We enjoyed this class far more than any of us expected to and we will prepare these dishes at home. I highly recommend this activity while you are in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Rhonda, thank you so much for your wonderful review. Knowing that our Cooking School became your favorite activity in Bangkok is the greatest compliment we could receive.
At Blue Elephant, Master Chef Nooror has always believed that Thai cuisine should be shared with generosity, passion, and simplicity. Our Cooking School was created to make everyone feel at home—whether you are discovering Thai cooking for the very first time or are already passionate about it. We are delighted that our Chef and the entire team made you feel so comfortable and confident throughout the experience.
Thai cuisine can sometimes seem intimidating, with its delicate balance of flavors and aromatic ingredients. This is why our chefs guide each guest step by step, sharing practical tips and ingredient alternatives that make it possible to recreate these treasured recipes wherever you are in the world. Watching the chef's demonstration before preparing each dish yourself is an important part of the journey, allowing you to discover not only the techniques but also the spirit of Thai cooking.
We are especially pleased that you appreciated the exceptional freshness of our ingredients and the support provided by our team in the kitchen. Preparing five authentic Thai dishes with your family and leaving with the confidence to recreate them at home is exactly the experience we hope to offer every guest.

reviews.name: Vincybie Lee
reviews.text:
We had such a memorable evening at Blue Elephant Sathorn. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt beautiful and welcoming, and the service was consistently warm and attentive. Everything tasted incredibly authentic and flavorful, and it was clear that the team pays careful attention to every detail—especially presentation.

Our favorites were the King Mackerel Kratong Thong (crispy, fragrant, and perfectly spicy), the Charcoal Pork Satay (tender with a delicious homemade peanut sauce and a great pickled vinegar balance), and the Grilled Spare Ribs (juicy and packed with flavor, especially with the sweet Royal Project honey and spicy Isaan chili dip).

Truly a great choice for a special occasion—highly recommended!👍🏻💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Vincybie, for sharing such a lovely review and for celebrating your special anniversary with us at Blue Elephant Sathorn. We’re delighted that you enjoyed our signature dishes and the warm atmosphere.
And for the perfect finale, we highly recommend not missing our desserts.  From the rich Belgian Chocolate Mousse and our signature Coconut Flan to the tropical Mango Cheesecake and Panna Cotta Tub Tim Krob, each dessert is designed to continue the journey through Thai and European flavors.
For those looking for an authentic Thai touch, our Mango with Sticky Rice and delicate Tago Sako are absolute must-tries. And if you prefer something refreshing, our homemade coconut, mango, vanilla, chocolate or tamarind ice creams are a wonderful way to finish the evening.
Whether you choose one to share or discover several, our desserts are truly not to be missed! We hope to welcome you back soon for another memorable celebration

reviews.name: Bơ
reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to enjoy the tasting menu at Blue Elephant Bangkok, and it was a wonderful fine dining experience from start to finish.

The restaurant is set inside a beautiful historic house, creating an elegant and relaxing atmosphere. The interior is tastefully decorated, blending classic Thai charm with sophistication. The service was excellent throughout the meal—friendly, attentive, and professional without being intrusive.

The tasting menu featured a variety of traditional Thai dishes prepared with premium local ingredients. Every course was beautifully presented, almost like a piece of art, and it was clear that a lot of thought had gone into both the flavors and presentation. Overall, the food was delicious, and despite being a tasting menu, it was surprisingly filling by the end.

My favorite dishes were the signature Massaman lamb and the crispy crab starter. The flavors were rich and well-balanced. The only downside for me was that several dishes contained ginger, which I’m personally not a big fan of, so those courses weren’t quite to my taste. That said, the quality of the ingredients and cooking was undeniable.

Overall, Blue Elephant offers much more than just a meal—it’s a refined dining experience in a beautiful heritage setting. If you’re looking to explore authentic Thai cuisine presented in an elegant way, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Bơ, thank you very much for your exceptional 5-star review and for taking the time to describe your experience with such care. We are delighted that our Heritage Tasting Menu provided you with a memorable fine dining journey from the first course to the last.
Created by Master Chef Nooror, our tasting menu is a celebration of Thailand's rich culinary heritage. Each course is inspired by authentic royal and family recipes, carefully reinterpreted using premium local ingredients while preserving the true essence of Heritage Thai Cuisine. We are especially pleased that you enjoyed our signature Massaman Lamb and the Crispy Crab starter, two of our guests' favourite creations. We also appreciate your comments regarding the ginger. Personal tastes vary, and your feedback is valuable as we continue to offer the best possible dining experience.
We are equally delighted that you appreciated the unique atmosphere of our historic mansion. More than a century ago, this beautiful Sino-Portuguese residence was inaugurated as one of Bangkok's most prestigious luxury textile stores before becoming the elegant landmark it is today. Today, this remarkable heritage building offers guests the opportunity to experience exceptional Thai gastronomy in a setting that reflects the history, culture and elegance of old Bangkok.
On your next visit, we invite you to begin your evening with one of our signature cocktails at the Blue Bar, followed by a carefully selected wine pairing designed to complement every course of our menu.

reviews.name: Katrina Dingley
reviews.text: What an amazing morning...we loved going round the market with Babe, her class was fun, educational and we loved seeing how thai cooking comes together sbd snaked at the ease of the recipes.  Krisna was fun in the kitchen and himself and Babe walked us through each step.  Would recommend the courses to anyone living or coming through Bangkok.  Amazing and a huge thanks to the team.  Cant wait to do another course. Katrina
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Katrina, for your wonderful photos posted on Google and for your enthusiastic comment. We are delighted that you enjoyed the market visit with Babe and Krisna — it is always a special moment to discover the fresh and typical ingredients of Thai cuisine.
After this immersion, you joined our school to prepare 4 traditional recipes, guided step by step by Babe, Krisna, and our team. Each stage is accompanied so that you can cook with confidence and understand the subtleties of Thai flavors. We were also very happy to adapt the program to your allergies, ensuring that you could fully enjoy the experience without any concern.
At the end of the class, you had the choice to enjoy your dishes during a lunch at our Blue Elephant restaurant or to take them with you to prolong the experience. We also provide each participant with a Blue Elephant apron as well as the detailed recipes, so that you can recreate these dishes at home and keep a connection with our cuisine.
We are happy that this experience was memorable for you, and we look forward to welcoming you again for another class. Thank you once more for your energy and enthusiasm!

reviewContext.Dietary restrictions: We have allergies and they catered for it

reviews.name: Anne-Marie “AMK”
reviews.text:
Three of us had dinner at the Blue Elephant in January on our way back from the Middle East en route home to Sydney.
There are two locations that I’m aware of in Bangkok, as we were staying at the IHG, Sathorn proved to be more convenient for us, and the staff at both locations were very helpful over email recommending options for us.
The restaurant is housed in a beautiful gracious building which appeared to have been a private home at some stage perhaps. There’s an old world charm in the dining room we were seated in (facing the street but the building is set back from the road, so no noise or disturbance). The staff were welcoming and helpful, you can expect to receive warm appreciative service in Thailand.
We chose a curry, a salad, a beautiful duck dish, and we shared some morning glory and dessert. Don’t be too hung up about what we had, because the menu changes from time to time, but be assured that everything you’re going to order is going to be delicious. I don’t have a gripe about by of it, but if I were pressed to suggest an improvement, I would recommend they amp the flavour up a bit to give it a more authentic feel - that could be by offering a lashing of chili on the side of each plate, or whatever works to give the dishes a bit more bite. Just a tad too europeanised for my taste.
I want to add that the staff and the management went out of their way to ensure we got transport back to our hotel  as it was a Friday night and we couldn’t get an uber for a good 30 minutes. They  arranged a taxi and waited with us, and made sure we were on our way before returning to their posts. You wouldn’t imagine this happening in any other country.
It’s a lovely place to dine and I can’t imagine anyone being disappointed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your thoughtful comments — it is truly a pleasure to read your message, which we are delighted to share with our entire team.
The building that houses Blue Elephant Bangkok on Sathorn Road was constructed more than 100 years ago. At the time of its inauguration, it was home to a luxury fabric store, already reflecting its elegance and importance within the neighborhood. It later became the property of the Thai Chinese Chamber of Commerce before being transformed into a restaurant. When Blue Elephant Bangkok opened its doors there in 2002, the aim was to give new life to this remarkable heritage building while carefully preserving its architectural identity.
Master Chef Nooror, widely regarded as a true ambassador of Thai culinary heritage, leads our culinary vision. Her cuisine is rooted in authentic recipes passed down from generation to generation, while thoughtfully incorporating refined modern techniques. Driven by her desire to preserve and transmit this invaluable know-how, she founded the Blue Elephant Cooking School in Bangkok, offering guests a hands-on immersion into traditional Thai gastronomy and the rich cultural stories behind each dish.
In Bangkok, our second restaurant is located on Sukhumvit 13, set in a charming historic teakwood house that offers an intimate and elegant atmosphere in the heart of the city. In Phuket Town, both the restaurant and the cooking school are established in the former Governor’s Mansion of the island, continuing our commitment to preserving Thailand’s architectural and culinary heritage.
Regarding the intensity of flavors, we always encourage our guests not to hesitate to share their preferred level of spiciness. Dishes can certainly be enhanced — for example by serving chili on the side — allowing each guest to tailor the experience to their personal taste. Our team, composed of true food lovers, takes great pleasure in sharing the history and heritage behind every dish, and we remain deeply committed to providing attentive, personalized service to ensure a complete Blue Elephant experience.

reviews.name: Vanda Lock
reviews.text: Had a very lovely lunch with good friends. Food was authentic, presentation was very unique and tasteful and cutlery was beautiful. Service was top notch too. Ladies  received a stalk of orchid each before leaving the place with wonderful memories. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much, Vanda Lock, for your wonderful review and for choosing Blue Elephant Sathorn for your lunch with friends.
We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the authenticity of our cuisine, the elegant presentation, and the refined details of your table setting. It means a great deal to us that our service and the lovely orchid farewell helped create wonderful memories of your visit.
Khun Vanda, at Blue Elephant Sathorn (bts Surasak), authenticity is at the heart of everything we do — from the atmosphere of our historic century-old heritage mansion to the treasured Thai recipes carefully preserved and passed down from generation to generation. Under the guidance of Master Chef Nooror, our renowned curry creations continue this culinary legacy and are also available in our boutique.
Vanda, we are also proud to share this heritage through the Blue Elephant Cooking School, where guests from around the world can discover authentic Thai cuisine and learn the secrets of these timeless recipes.
Thank you again for your kind recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another memorable experience.

reviews.name: Joseph Loera
reviews.text: Blue Elephant Bangkok Sathorn Cooking School & Restaurant left a really strong impression on me. The setting is elegant without feeling stiff, and it makes the whole meal feel a bit special. I especially appreciated how welcoming the staff were, which added to the relaxed atmosphere. It felt like a nice place to enjoy Thai food at a slower pace and take in the surroundings.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Joseph, first and foremost, thank you for the wonderful photographic journey you shared of our Blue Elephant Cooking School. We were especially delighted to discover your beautiful collection of photos showcasing this unique experience. Our Cooking School occupies an entire floor of our historic Sathorn Road Mansion, conveniently located just steps from BTS Surasak, a space entirely dedicated to preserving and sharing the rich heritage of Thai cuisine with guests from around the world.
We are delighted that you enjoyed the elegant atmosphere of our home and the warm hospitality of our team.
Our morning cooking class begins with a visit to a local fresh market alongside our chefs, where guests discover the fascinating diversity of Thai herbs, spices, vegetables and seasonal ingredients that are essential to authentic Thai cuisine. This market experience offers a unique opportunity to learn how to select the finest ingredients while discovering the stories and traditions behind them.
Returning to Blue Elephant, guests are invited to prepare four to five authentic Thai recipes during a hands-on cooking session guided by our chefs. From preparing traditional curry pastes to creating some of Thailand's most iconic dishes, each recipe reflects Master Chef Nooror's passion for preserving Thailand's culinary heritage for more than 45 years. More than a cooking class, we hope our guests take home unforgettable memories, new culinary skills and a deeper appreciation for Thailand's extraordinary gastronomic traditions.
We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another culinary adventure at Blue Elephant Bangkok Sathorn.

reviews.name: Edward Choi
reviews.text: Blue Elephant is a great place to taste an authentic Thai cuisine. The service is great especially from Amar and his colleague. Really enjoy the dinner and the vibes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much, Edward. We are especially delighted by your mention of “authentic Thai cuisine.” Authenticity is at the very heart of what Master Chef Nooror  has dedicated herself to preserving and sharing through Blue Elephant and our philosophy of Heritage Thai Cuisine.
Blue Elephant is also deeply honoured to be recognised with the prestigious Thai SELECT Signature certification. Awarded by the Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP), Ministry of Commerce of Thailand, Thai SELECT is an official mark that recognises restaurants abroad and in Thailand that present high-quality Thai cuisine while preserving the authenticity and distinctive character of Thai culinary traditions. The Signature category represents the highest level of Thai SELECT recognition, reserved for restaurants offering an exceptional Thai dining experience.
Khun Edward,  we are also delighted that Amar and his colleague contributed to making your evening special. We will be very happy to share your kind words with them.
Thank you again for appreciating our cuisine, service and atmosphere. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back soon for another authentic Blue Elephant experience.

reviews.name: Eric Lee
reviews.text: If you’re having dinner at Blue Elephant, you must come to this branch at the cooking school. It’s got a nice little courtyard in front of a beautiful bungalow. Inside there is a small gift shop and beautiful interiors that you can explore. Ordering dinner can be a bit challenging because it’s not your usual menu but every dish that comes out tastes and looks exquisite! Definitely pricey, but worthwhile experience if you’re in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Eric, we sincerely thanks you for your wonderful review, and especially for the photos you shared, which beautifully capture the unique atmosphere of our century-old building. Originally a luxury fabric store, it now reflects the rich history and elegance of Blue Elephant Bangkok Sathorn.
Thank you for taking the time to explore our building, which is part of the history of Sathorn Road. Each floor offers a distinct atmosphere, paying tribute to the heritage of Thai cuisine.
Do not miss the Blue Bar, where our talented bartenders craft both creative and classic cocktails, as well as the entire floor dedicated to our cooking school, open to everyone regardless of your level.
Created by Master Chef Nooror , this school is a true place of transmission and sharing, where the art of Thai cuisine is passionately preserved.
Finally khun Eric, our boutique offers a wide selection of carefully curated products signed by our Chef, allowing you to continue the Blue Elephant experience at home.
We are delighted that your dinner met your expectations and very much look forward to welcoming you again soon.

reviews.name: Toon Wei Lim
reviews.text: Great experience in an old school Thai fine dining restaurant and the tasting menu borrows lightly from French cuisine. Don't expect the latest fads here. Good old fashioned fine food in a charming setting. Service was superb from Koko. Come here for the experience but don't expect up to the minute gastronomy.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Toon Wei Lim, thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing your experience at Blue Elephant Sathorn (BTS Surasak). We are delighted that you enjoyed the unique atmosphere of our historic establishment, Koko's attentive service, and the timeless quality of your meal.
At Blue Elephant, our mission is to preserve, celebrate, and pass on the extraordinary heritage of traditional Thai cuisine through recipes passed down through generations.
Khun Toon Wei Lim, this commitment is embodied by the remarkable collaboration between Master Chef Nooror, founder of Blue Elephant, and Ajarn Sisamon Kongpan, one of Thailand's most respected culinary historians and experts in traditional Thai gastronomy. Together, they have dedicated decades to researching and reviving forgotten royal and regional recipes and preserving Thailand's rich culinary heritage for future generations. These exquisite recipes come to life with the finest ingredients, refined modern techniques, and elegant presentation, while remaining true to their authentic flavors and traditions.
To further enhance this culinary journey, we also offer a carefully curated wine pairing. Our sommelier, Khun Tong, has selected wines that harmonize perfectly with each dish, highlighting the delicate aromas, spices, and textures of traditional Thai cuisine and creating an even more immersive dining experience.
We look forward to welcoming you soon for another unforgettable culinary adventure.

reviews.name: Robert Domingo
reviews.text: Had a lovely meal at Blue Elephant. Tiny appetizers were delightful, especially the pancake which was a burst of flavor. The spring rolls were the best I've had, with the perfect amount of crispiness. Enjoyed the soup, coconut rice, green curry and roti. Thanks to Arm and the rest of the Blue Elephant team for their attentive service!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Robert, we are truly delighted to receive your wonderful 5-star review and sincerely thank you for choosing Blue Elephant.
It is a pleasure to know that your experience through our Heritage Menu was such a memorable culinary journey. We are especially pleased that you enjoyed the refined selection of ZAKOUSKI, including the Kanom Krok and the Klong Pham Laab Prik Ma-Kwan, as well as the elegance of the Black Diamond Scallops.
We are also glad that the Klong Phai Tom Kha soup brought you comfort and depth of flavour, and that the Wild Ka-Praow Chili Prawn and the Grilled “Sakon Nakhon” Premium Beef Panang Curry, signature creations inspired by Master Chef Nooror, stood out during your experience. It is equally rewarding to hear you appreciated the perfectly cooked Sri Saket Jasmine Rice, completing your journey through our cuisine.
Khun Robert, at Blue Elephant, every dish is part of a story carefully preserved and elevated over more than 100 years of Thai culinary heritage, guided by Master Chef Nooror’s vision.
We sincerely thank you as well for highlighting the attentive service provided by our team. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another refined exploration of Thai heritage cuisine.

reviews.name: Prit Swami
reviews.text: We got a special Private dinning area and it was a wonderful experience. We had been earlier in their phuket restaurant. The ambience, presentation & food was amazing & delicious. The captain Mr. Amar was very cooperative and superb with the services.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Prit Swami, thank you very much for sharing the beautiful photos of your Special Private Dining experience. We are especially touched by your loyalty to Blue Elephant and delighted that, after discovering Blue Elephant Phuket Town in the former Governor's Mansion, you chose to continue your culinary journey at Blue Elephant Sathorn Road.
Each Blue Elephant destination has its own unique character. Phuket Town celebrates the Peranakan flavors of Southern Thailand, Sathorn Road welcomes guests to a century-old historic mansion next to BTS Surasak, while Blue Elephant Sukhumvit 13, just steps from BTS Nana, invites guests to discover an elegant teakwood family home nestled in a tropical garden, featuring the Blue Bar, our boutique and Cooking School.
Inaugurated more than a century ago, the Sathorn Road mansion belongs to the Thai-Chinese Chamber of Commerce and was originally home to an exclusive luxury textile store. Today, it offers a unique setting to discover Master Chef Nooror's Thai Heritage Cuisine, where treasured ancestral recipes are elevated through contemporary culinary techniques and the finest ingredients.
We are delighted that the cuisine, presentation and atmosphere made your experience so memorable. Your kind words about Mr. Amar's attentive and gracious service will be shared with him and our entire team with great pleasure.
We look forward to welcoming you again at Phuket Town, Bangkok Sathorn Road or Sukhumvit13 as you continue your journey through Thailand's extraordinary culinary heritage.

reviews.name: Cloud
reviews.text:
Celebrated a birthday occasion here - the ambiance was great - a classy Thai interior that is relaxing, not too noisy and perfect for great conversations, and of course friendly staff and the food was also delicious.

I highly recommend their shrimp pad Thai (rmb to try it with fish sauce) and crab meat curry
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for celebrating your birthday with us. We are delighted that you enjoyed the atmosphere, our team's hospitality, and our cuisine. It is especially rewarding to know that our Shrimp Pad Thai and Pat Pong Crab Curry were among your favorites.
Our Shrimp Pad Thai, one of Thailand's most beloved dishes, has become a true Master Chef  Nooror Signature , prepared with premium prawns and authentic Thai ingredients to achieve the perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty, and savory flavors. We are equally pleased that you enjoyed our Pat Pong Crab Curry, featuring Surath Thani blue swimmer crab stir-fried in our house yellow curry with homemade roasted chili paste and organic eggs.
Thank you once again for your kind recommendation.

reviews.name: Colmen Wong
reviews.text: The food and environment were excellent. Especially the prawn cake and the signature pandan curry. The service from our waiter Amar and other colleague was really exceptional and hospitable. Highly recommended for the 1st time traveler!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Colmen, we are truly delighted that you enjoyed both the food and the atmosphere, and especially our prawn cakes and signature  curry. Your kind words about Amar and the team mean a lot to us — genuine Thai hospitality is at the heart of everything we do.
At Blue Elephant, we are proud to preserve and share the richness of Thai Heritage Cuisine, a culinary tradition passionately carried forward by Master Chef Nooror. Inspired by family recipes passed down through generations, she has dedicated her life to showcasing the depth and elegance of Thai flavors — particularly our carefully crafted curries, which are also available in our boutique and exported to many countries around the world.
It was a pleasure to welcome you, and we hope to have the opportunity to host you again on your next visit to Thailand

reviewContext.Noise level: Loud, but you can still talk

reviews.name: Sandeep Samtani
reviews.text: Dinner at the very authentic Blue Elephant in Bangkok. Started with the Tom kha crabmeat soup. Huge chunks of crabmeat made the soup even more enjoyable. Very subtle and mild in taste. Next was the phad Thai noodles with prawns. This was quite bland in taste and was a bit disappointing  Once again dessert was the very safe mango sticky rice. A nice way to end my stay in Thailand. Looking forward to going back to India tomorrow
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr. Samtani, thank you very much for visiting Blue Elephant Sathorn, conveniently located near BTS Surasak, and for taking the time to share your experience along with your beautiful photos.
Your appreciation of the Tom Kha crabmeat soup perfectly reflects the spirit of our cuisine, a delicate and well-balanced dish highlighting premium ingredients and authentic Thai flavors, in line with the vision of Master Chef Nooror, founder of Blue Elephant and widely regarded as an ambassador of Thailand’s culinary heritage.
Chef Nooror’s culinary philosophy is deeply rooted in preservation and transmission. 
Dear Sandeep Samtani in this spirit, she has worked closely with Ajarn Sisamone, a respected master instructor of traditional Thai cuisine. The meaning of their collaboration lies in a shared commitment to safeguarding ancestral recipes, refined techniques, and the soul of Thai cooking, while thoughtfully adapting them to meet contemporary tastes. This union of academic knowledge and modern interpretation forms one of the cornerstones of the Blue Elephant identity.
We also take careful note of your comment regarding the Pad Thai with prawns. This dish is prepared in its traditional form, emphasizing balance and subtlety rather than bold intensity, and your feedback will be shared with our culinary team.
We are delighted that you chose to conclude your meal with our classic Mango Sticky Rice — sweet glutinous rice infused with coconut milk and served with ripe seasonal mango, a timeless and comforting Thai dessert.
We wish you a pleasant flight to India and look forward to welcoming you again soon at Blue Elephant Sathorn, or at one of our Blue Elephant restaurants around the world

reviews.name: Anuradha Pethia
reviews.text:
The food was absolutely amazing! Every dish had a perfect balance of flavors, making the entire meal delightful. I never had such a delicious virgin Pima colada .
The service provided by **Amar** was exceptional — attentive, friendly, and professional. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Anuradha Pethia, thank you so much for your wonderful review and for sharing your photos — they truly make everyone’s mouth water!
We’re delighted that you enjoyed the perfect balance of flavors in each dish. Our team of passionate food lovers takes great pride in sharing the stories and traditions behind the recipes of Thai heritage cuisine, inspired and elevated by Master Chef Nooror.
The same passion you experienced with us can also be found at Blue Elephant Bangkok and Blue Elephant Phuket Town, where our teams are equally dedicated to preserving and celebrating authentic Thai culinary heritage.
We’re also thrilled that you loved the Virgin Piña Colada. Our bartenders are dedicated to crafting classic cocktails with a contemporary personal touch, along with award-winning creations, to offer a truly memorable experience.
A special thank you for your kind words about Amar, we will be sure to share your compliments with him. Your appreciation of our food, service, and atmosphere truly means a lot to us.
We look forward to welcoming you back very soon for another exceptional dining experience

reviews.name: Anderson Angkeyile (Flying Sailor)
reviews.text: Blue Elephant is a wonderful Thai restaurant that offers a truly memorable dining experience. The restaurant itself is absolutely beautiful, with elegant décor that creates a warm and refined atmosphere. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. Most importantly, the food was delicious—full of authentic Thai flavors, beautifully presented, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients. Everything felt thoughtfully prepared, from start to finish. We really enjoyed our meal and would happily return again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Khun Anderson Angkeyile, thank you so much for awarding us 5/5 across all categories! We are thrilled that you had such a wonderful experience at Blue Elephant. It is always our goal to provide not only delicious and authentic Thai cuisine, but also a warm, elegant, and welcoming atmosphere. We are delighted that you appreciated the beauty of our restaurant and its refined décor, designed to create a memorable dining environment. Our team takes great pride in providing attentive and friendly service, and it’s fantastic to hear that this contributed to your enjoyable visit.
The dishes you enjoyed are crafted under the guidance of Master Chef Nooror Somany Steppe, who specializes in Thai heritage cuisine. Each recipe honors Thailand’s rich culinary traditions while highlighting fresh, high-quality ingredients sourced from trusted suppliers, including royal projects, organic farms, and animal-friendly producers. This careful attention to detail ensures every plate is a balance of authentic flavors, textures, and beautiful presentation, offering a true taste of Thailand’s culinary legacy.
We are grateful for your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional dining experience.

reviews.name: Bruce Salzer
reviews.text:
Loved the class.  We first went to the local market where they explained the importance of each of the herbs.  Then we had a local coffee/ tea break.

Back at the school we made fresh green chile paste which involved a lot of rigorous pounding to create the perfect consistency.  What a great way to get rid of frustrations!

From there we made beef green curry and 3 other dishes.

Finally we eat our creations.

It was great fun for everyone in the class, from the 6 year old boy to the adults.

It’s a great way to experience Thai food.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bruce,  thank you for your 5/5 rating and for sharing your experience at Blue Elephant Phuket Town.
We are also very pleased that you enjoyed the visit to the market. It is truly an essential moment of the experience and a very important part of discovering the spirit of Heritage Thai Cuisine. Whether someone is new to Thai cooking or already familiar with it, the market visit helps reveal the richness of local ingredients, aromas, and traditions that inspire our cuisine, shared by Master Chef Nooror and her teams.
Thank you again for your kind support, and we hope to welcome you again soon for another culinary journey.

reviews.name: Fardeen Osmani
reviews.text:
The experience was so great we had to go back to back nights!  First evening included Rose Spring rolls then two main dishes including Tiger prawn pad Thai and the Massaman Lamb to conclude with their specialty dessert the Jasmine Pistachio Cake. Vijay our evenings waiter was excellent with the explanation and service of each course. We decided to try their specialty teas with our meal which was also a great choice!

The second evening we had Pink Pomelo salad Prawn Cakes, Forgotten Beef Curry and Blue Elephants Famous Spare Ribs. Same dessert because we loved it! Our second we were lucky to have Kookai as our waitress who was amazing i with her suggestions plus explanations.

Blue Elephant hits the mark with a romantic atmosphere, unique fine dining and friendly staff from the moment you walk in to the moment we left.
Don't miss out if your a foodie in Thailand, thank you so much Blue Elephant team for a best dining experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Fardeen, thank you sincerely for your exceptional review and for choosing to dine with us on two consecutive evenings at Blue Elephant. The entire team are truly honored by your kind words. Your selection perfectly reflects the spirit of our cuisine. Our Massaman Lamb is one of Master Chef Nooror’s signature creations, inspired by royal Thai heritage and slow cooked with an in-house Massaman curry paste, coconut milk, aromatic spices, and carefully selected ingredients to achieve depth, balance, and elegance.
Khun Fardeen, the Pad Thai, originally a popular and humble national dish, has been elevated at Blue Elephant through refined techniques and premium ingredients. Master Chef Nooror has transformed this iconic recipe into a sophisticated expression of Thai gastronomy while preserving its authentic soul.
We are also delighted that you enjoyed our desserts. Beyond the much-loved Jasmine Pistachio Cake, our dessert menu offers a wide variety of refined creations. Among them, the Chocolate Mousse holds a special place in Blue Elephant’s history, originating from Blue Elephant Brussels. Crafted with classic European pastry savoir-faire, it embodies intensity, finesse, and the international heritage that defines our culinary identity.
Your kind recognition of Vijay and Kookai is greatly appreciated; they will be delighted to know their service and guidance enhanced your experience. Creating a romantic atmosphere, offering unique fine dining, and welcoming our guests with genuine warmth from arrival to departure remain at the heart of our philosophy.
Thank you once again for your recommendation to fellow food lovers. We look forward to welcoming you back very soon for another memorable journey through Thai culinary heritage.
We also truly appreciated your beautiful selection of photos, which perfectly capture the spirit and elegance of the Blue Elephant experience.

reviews.name: Elsie Wong
reviews.text: First time here and tried their Heritage Menu and I was in awe! Food is delicious and delicately presented, love how fresh flowers are being used in the restaurant and food decoration. The bonus of the day was when I had a chance to meet and take a photo with Master Chef Noorer and Chef Kris! Highly recommended 👍👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Elise, thank you very much for your wonderful comment and for sharing so many beautiful photos! 
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your first visit to Blue Elephant Bangkok and that the Heritage Menu, along with the delicate presentation of the dishes, truly impressed you. 
Our Heritage Menu is a true celebration of traditional Thai cuisine, created by Master Chef Nooror, offering a refined culinary journey through several carefully curated courses. We are also delighted that you had the opportunity to meet Master Chef Nooror and her son, Chef Kris — an experience we hope will remain a memorable highlight of your visit.
Miss Wong, during your next visit, our Blue Bar bartenders will be pleased to introduce you to a fine selection of cocktails with or without alcohol, as well as a highly appreciated mocktail menu, especially featuring refreshing Thai-inspired flavors 🍹🌿
Thank you once again for your warm recommendation 👍👍
We truly appreciate you taking the time to capture and share your experience, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more memorable culinary moments.

reviews.name: Caitlin
reviews.text:
I had such a great time at this cooking class with my family, and a big reason was our chef, Mee. She was super fun, warm, and engaging, and made everyone had a good time while learning about Thai food.

The market tour was fun too. We got to try different stall foods while Mee explained the ingredients and how they’re used. She clearly knows Thai food inside out but keeps it entertaining, and we left feeling like we could actually recreate the dishes at home. If you can, hope you get Mee as she really makes the experience special!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Louise Stephen Jumawid
reviews.text: Everything about my experience was amazing. I've been to Thailand multiple times, but I've never had Thai dishes this good. All the ingredients were fresh, and our teacher was very nice and accommodating, especially when taking our photos. Plus, the freebies at the end were perfect to end the class. A must-try! I will definitely go back again. 💖

reviews.name: Yumi Tokoyo
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a wonderful, fun, and informative experience here at Silom Thai Cooking School! The food was delicious, the place was clean, and the staff were incredibly accommodating despite us running late for our class. We especially loved the tom yum soup and green curry!
Chef Jib was amazing and the experience was definitely bumped up to a 15/10 rating because of her! Such a warm, welcoming and happy personality.

reviews.name: Gary Hinojosa
reviews.text: Amazing experience. We were hesitant to try it, but since some friends recommended it, we did it. If you are in Thailand, you MUST try it. Before this class, we had plenty of street food (very delicious), but I must say, each course we prepared turned out to be the best Thai food we had during our stay. One tip, (please take it seriously) don’t eat before coming, or at least eat very little if your class is later in the day. Even if you don’t have experience cooking, they are excellent teachers, helpful and patient.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Robert Thompson
reviews.text:
Definitely our best experience in Bangkok so far. Of course the group being so fun and open to laughter helped, but our chef MEE was incredible. Not only was she an adept educator but she was hilarious. Her comedic timing and fast wit... On point. Honestly, she needs a stand up comedy show.

Definitely recommended. Ask for Mee's class.

reviews.name: OnSite
reviews.text: Had such a fun and memorable experience here. Everything was well organized and easy to follow, even for someone with no cooking background. The ingredients were fresh and the dishes actually tasted amazing at the end. Huge shoutout to Ju who was super friendly, patient, and made the whole class feel relaxed and enjoyable. Learned a lot, laughed a lot, and left very full. Would definitely recommend if you want a hands on Thai food experience.

reviews.name: Natália Rybárová
reviews.text:
Amazing experience, worth to try. I had morning class with market visit, where u can buy a lot of fruit and veg for amazing price, all fresh, and then went back to school. We had Ju as our teacher and she was 10/10. She was funny and really skillful, made the experience even more enhanced. Made a lot of pictures and videos, met some interesting people.
At the end you will get small gift.
Highly reccomended.👩‍🍳
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Aizi Francisco
reviews.text: As a foodie, I was so happy when I found this activity in Klook. No doubt the highlight of my trip. I really enjoyed learning about the ingredients, prepping them and actually cooking, even while I'm showering with my sweat lol. I hope I get to find ingredients back home and cook them back in the Philippines. After cooking, we also did the plating and most important, eating!! Hahahaha. I swear everything I cooked was so good huhuhu. Torn if I take away some for my sister but they were so delicious I had to finish everything.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Sakinah Muhammad
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! This was my first time taking a cooking class while on vacation and it truly exceeded my expectations. I got to learn so much about Thai cuisine and flavors along with meeting some great folks in the class. This is a perfect activity if you are solo traveling or with a group of your own. I suggest taking the morning class so you can experience going to the market for the ingredients first. My teacher was named Ju and she was fantastic. Highly recommend this experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Divya Kothari
reviews.text: An outstanding cooking school and a must-do in Bangkok! My 12 year old niece and I had a wonderful morning session from 8:45-12:45 including a market visit, tuktuk ride to a beautiful, spacious and clean cooking school where we learnt how to make a 5 course meal. We are vegetarians who don’t eat eggs and fish so they were very considerate and made substitutions with tofu and fish-free sauces. They were very considerate of other participants’ shrimp or mango allergies as well. Our chef’s name was Ju and she was excellent…very engaging and warm. The session was structured perfectly and it’s best to eat a light breakfast or skip it as you end up cooking a lot of nourishing food. We were also given a lot of gifts with the recipe book.

reviews.name: Arina AR
reviews.text: Fun activity to try out besides shopping and getting massages. Master the basics of Thai staples including somtam, tom yum goong, pad thai, green curry, and mango sticky rice. Had a wonderful time with such an organised team and schedule!

reviews.name: Земфира Сафина
reviews.text:
We had the best time on the class today!
Everything was taken perfect care of 🥹 from the entrance and market trip (morning classes) to the recipe book they give you afterwords so you don’t forget  everything you learned! This is honestly so thoughtful and nice! They explain everything - how to choose your ingredients, how to prep and cook them and even how long you can store it!
While being very informative, it’s also extremely fun cause the teachers literally joke better than some stand up comedians.

Huge shoutout to Mee and please someone give her a raise or a bonus, she is awesome!

Highly reccomend and would tell all my friends to visit you guys! All the best wishes and hope your business is always successful!

reviews.name: مصطفى عبد الحميد محسن
reviews.text:
It was one of the most beautiful experiences in Thailand. We truly enjoyed the class and felt a deeper connection to Thai culture and Thai cuisine. We became familiar with the dishes and are now able to order them confidently from restaurant menus.

We loved it so much, and the best part was that we prepared four wonderful dishes and enjoyed eating what we cooked with our own hands.

Thank you so much. I definitely recommend that everyone visiting Bangkok takes part in this lovely experience. All the love to the wonderful people behind this project 🤍

reviews.name: E K
reviews.text:
Amazing experience! Our teacher was warm and patient. We went to a vibrant local Thai market to pick out fresh ingredients, then learned to cook classic Thai dishes in a clean, cool indoor space. The food we made ourselves tasted absolutely delicious, and I felt so accomplished!
If you’re looking for a unique, immersive local food culture experience during your trip, I highly recommend this cooking school!

reviews.name: L D
reviews.text: Fern was a great instructor. She was energetic, enthusiastic, and made the whole class really enjoyable. Her instructions were clear and easy to follow, so even someone with little cooking experience could keep up. She also created a fun and relaxed atmosphere throughout the session. Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend this class.

reviews.name: dian trimaharani
reviews.text:
This was my first time attending a cooking class. I found out about this cooking class activity from social media and was very interested in participating and signing up during my recent visit to Bangkok. I purchased the cooking class package from the Klook application.

On the day of the class, I chose the morning session because I was interested in the activity of visiting a local market in Bangkok early in the morning, and indeed, that experience was very fascinating and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

Our cooking class was guided by Teacher Mee. She is a very engaging, friendly, witty woman who explained everything very clearly and enjoyably. I think I was lucky to have her as my guide—Hi Mee, greetings from Jakarta!

We cooked 5 dishes, the menu of which can be seen on the Klook application or their social media. I think this cooking class activity is very interesting, different, and a new experience when visiting Bangkok.

I also received a certificate and souvenirs: a coconut wood ladle and chopsticks.

Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jza Hoskin
reviews.text: Afternoon Class: Best part of my trip, was attending this class, loved the energy and professionalism of our teacher, the food was amazing as expected... made me want to extend my trip to Thailand... worth the money and time, thankyou Mee ❤️

reviews.name: M.m
reviews.text: This experience was amazing and a must do in bangkok. Probably the tastiest food we had while there. Teacher was great, space was neat and clean. Buy your tickets from get your guide if you want.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much

reviews.name: Berta Arque Gonzalez
reviews.text: This was our first cooking class in Thailand (although not our first cooking class ever), and overall it has been the best so far. The market tour at the beginning is super interesting and gives you a great understanding of the local ingredients. The class itself is very well organized — you learn a lot but never feel tired or overwhelmed. The dishes are really fun to prepare, and the portions are perfectly balanced so you don’t get too full and can really enjoy the whole experience. Our teacher was Mi (sorry if we spell it wrong!), and she was absolutely amazing. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Michael Moore
reviews.text:
What a fun and wonderful experience. Our guide/instructor Plane first took our group around the corner to the local street market. Where we picked up items that we would use for the class. As you can see from the photos, the staff there arranged everything beautifully. And did all the clean up. The cooking part was a lot easier than I had imagined. And all the dishes we made we got to eat them as well. Yum
The instructor spoke English well and even cracked some jokes to keep the mood and atmosphere lively.
This is the first time we have done something like this as a family and it was a great bonding experience. We will definitely book more activities like this in the future.

title: Sense Onsen Suandok Wellness & Spa
ownerDescription:
Opened in July 2024, Sense Onsen Suandok Wellness & Spa is a serene wellness destination in Chiang Mai designed to bring balance, relaxation, and rejuvenation to every guest. Inspired by traditional Japanese onsen culture and modern wellness practices, we offer a peaceful retreat where guests can enjoy authentic onsen bathing, therapeutic Thai massage, soothing oil treatments, and holistic spa experiences.

Our thoughtfully designed space blends elegance, comfort, and tranquility, creating the perfect environment to unwind from the stresses of daily life. At Sense Onsen Suandok, every detail is crafted to provide a memorable wellness journey that nurtures both body and mind.
address: 8, 1 Suan Dok Rd 1, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXP9+GV Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Tricia Ng
reviews.text:
Nice hidden gem 🌴🌴🌴✨✨✨

I booked for 240 mins, 60 mins private onsen + 90 mins thai massage + 60 mins oil massage.

At the reception, I was greeted nicely by the thai lady, however she was helping someone and the guy was just given a straight face, “do u have a booking”, a bit rude and blunt, not even smiling, after the lady confirmed as I rescheduled my appt to another day, I was given a form to show where I want to massage more on.

I then received a tote bag for the clothes and towels to use, the private onsen was very comfortable and had a nice time until some chinese family came next door and was loudly talking across and that took off my zen moment.

The masseuse was okay and great but I think she didn’t thoroughly massage through whole body given a 90 mins thai massage, she was mostly just rubbing over my calves for like 30+ mins, while I assume everywhere else could get more balance attention for a whole body massage, she spoke great english so once I told her where I wanted to focus on, she would then move onto the focused area.

Overall, it was a very nice environment and spa treatment for chiangmai. I would come back and especially not many places have a private onsen, I just wonder how often they clean the water as there are many customers everyday, hygiene is my biggest concern.

reviews.name: Panyapat I.
reviews.text:
The ambiance of the place is nice and the staff at the front desk are very friendly. However, the massage was quite disappointing. The therapist seemed very inexperienced, with almost no pressure and poor technique, so it wasn’t relaxing at all.
As for the onsen, the room didn’t have any hooks for clothes, which was inconvenient. The mineral water also had a chlorine-like smell and tasted slightly salty, which affected the overall experience

reviews.name: Mohamed Santa
reviews.text: This spa is very good! I love this place. When I want to feel relaxed. I will think about this Sense Onsen Suandok Spa first in my mind. The therapist has the best skill in massage, and the receptionists always recommend the best and are worth promotion to us. If you come to visit Chiang Mai, don’t forget to go to the Sense Onsen Suandok Spa.

reviews.name: Megan Torres
reviews.text:
Our experience at Sense Onsen was absolutely amazing ♨️✨ The vibes were so peaceful, relaxing, and luxurious from the moment we walked in. It was the perfect place to unwind and recharge after busy days exploring Thailand.

Everything felt clean, calming, and thoughtfully designed, creating such a serene atmosphere throughout the entire experience. The staff were welcoming, and the overall environment made it easy to fully relax and enjoy the moment.

If you’re looking for a relaxing spa and onsen experience with beautiful vibes and a calming atmosphere, we would definitely recommend Sense Onsen. We left feeling refreshed and would absolutely come back again 🤍🌿

reviews.name: Ananth Pillai
reviews.text: Had a very good experience here. Screwed my booking, thought I rescheduled to 3pm but did not happen. Staff were very accommodating and managed to fit me after some time. Overall very good experience with the masseuse. Will come again if able to. Do ensure to check e mail for confirmation if rescheduling..

reviews.name: Monica Ortiz Luis-Gabriel
reviews.text: Me and my husband had a great and relaxing experience at Sense Onsen Suan Dok! We came in without reservation, however we were fortunate that there was a no-show so we were able to proceed with the Onsen + Thai Yoga Massage package right away. They are very courteous and gave us welcome tea while waiting. Take note, the Onsen room is private. Right after the Onsen we proceeded with the Thai Yoga Massage which had a couple of stretches which is very relieving for those with lower back issues. Afterwards there is a relaxing hot tea and cookies to cap off your visit. A must-try for couples and travelers looking for a quick escape in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Chadapa Chankasem
reviews.text: I highly recommend coming here if you want to enjoy an onsen experience. The massage therapist is excellent—one of the best massages I’ve had in Chiang Mai. It’s definitely great value for the price, and I will absolutely come back again. ♨️✨

reviews.name: 1neta I
reviews.text: I came here on Oct 17th and have been to a few onsens since. Had to come and leave a review because this was such a memorable experience since then. The staff was completely warm and welcoming. The lobby is absolutely beautiful. The choices of oils were amazing. I choose Green Tea and Lavender and it was so refreshing during the bath i could've feel asleep. As for the deep tissue massage, I DID FALL ASLEEP lol it was too relaxing and released so much tension I was holding in my body. Overall 10/10!

reviews.name: Aleksei Kaftanov
reviews.text: It was a good experience, but I was wondering that all Onsen’s bath are private so you couldn’t use it proper way with changing temperatures between. But price is more than affordable (450 thb in one hour) and service was perfect.

reviews.name: Bella Bryan
reviews.text: Genuinely the best spa experience I’ve had in all of Thailand. To start, the vibe of the spa is amazing. Super chic, clean, and very relaxing. The Onsen was amazing as well, the perfect temperature and very relaxing. There is a fan in there if you get too hot. I also got a deep hot oil massage with Nana. She is the best masseuse. She applied the perfect amount of pressure and did extra work on the areas I wanted. Highly recommend Sense Onsen, best spa in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: 蒋天宇
reviews.text: A comfortable environment and attentive service – one of the must-visit spas in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: janet ho
reviews.text: The environment is very comfortable, and this is real onsen, the essential oil smells so good，massage Therapist Pang very professional and thoughtful, recommend!

reviews.name: Shazia Nabilla
reviews.text:
Beyond my expectation, i think the given price is super worth it
The vibes is really comforting
The staff very kind, my therapist is pang very nice
And the oil and balm really relaxing i think i need small pack for souvenir though
Hopefully it can open their branch in Indonesia!
Terima kasih!

reviews.name: Pauline Lim
reviews.text: Tucked away in an alley ...this is really an oasis of tranquillity and relaxation. I did the foot massage with my husband in a private room. Goodness, I literally fell asleep during the 1 hour of pampering and therapy. I felt all the acupuncture points were unblocked. The massuse is so skilful yet gentle. Highly, highly recommend if you are coming to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Jessica Ansell
reviews.text:
Amazing, very relaxing with the Onsen before the massage.
Peng was attentive with my massage, checking if pressure was okay and if I was comfortable. We had a wonderful experience. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Kaye Cheng
reviews.text: This massage is very relaxed that can remove the puffiness. I became thinner. The staff is Ging. She is very professional and kind. I love the aromatic massage balm. Amazing experience :)

reviews.name: hanza fg
reviews.text:
The customer service was lovely! I went here with my boyfriend and we got temporary tote bags to hold our clothes, welcome drinks and drinks after the massage itself.

This place offers parking so do not fear! You will not have to park on the side of road in nimman.

The onsen was lovely and offered shower gel and shampoo, it provided instructions as to how to effectively use the onsen and also had complimentary cold water bottles.

The space was bigger than expected and had mannyyy rooms although the massage itself was OK— The technician only used the same repeating moves which felt moderate and a bit inexperienced

reviews.name: Joruan Zhang
reviews.text: Sense is a must when you come to Chiang Mai. I’ve been here many times, and they have a few different locations with different features.

reviews.name: Phiphatthaphorn Singhon
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Beautiful and peaceful onsen. Very clean, perfect temperature, and super relaxing. The staff were kind and welcoming. Highly recommend ~ will definitely come back! 😊

reviews.name: Carmen To
reviews.text: The environment is super relaxing and comfortable. Therapist is very experienced and nice. Recommend yoga massage!!

reviews.name: Matt Goodman
reviews.text:
Writing this review to help others as I didn’t find this info elsewhere:
- great experience overall despite it being a communal room and mattresses pushed together.
- I arrived around 930AM and didn’t have to wait. There was only 1 other client. It was busier when I left around 10AM.
- I found it worth the price - It was a quality Thai massage. I got 30 minutes just to try it out and it was right for me.
- I didn’t have to change into the traditional Thai massage attire - they massaged me with my own clothes.
- Would I pay the Wat Pho entrance just to do the massage? Absolutely not. It’s a nice perk of the visit.

reviews.text: I tried the palm massage here for 580 Baht for around 1 hour and had a great experience. The massage is done in a traditional Thai way, and the staff is professional—male therapists for men and female therapists for women, which is respectful and comfortable. It’s a good, affordable option if you’re looking for a general massage in Bangkok. The place is clean, located near the Grand Palace, and at the end, they even serve tea and refreshments. They also give you a balm used during the massage to take home, which is a nice touch and can be reused. Highly recommended for a relaxing and value-for-money experience.

reviews.text: The worst massage i have ever had. Painful, but not in a good way, just no technique, digging elbow into my spine. I feel worse now than before. I tried to leave part way through because it was so bad. She convinced me to stay and it was better after that but still bad.

reviews.name: Jason Denison
reviews.text: Honestly I didn't care for this place. It's not great. There's so many better places. I will not be back. It was old and just a bad massage and I'm pretty sure my massage therapist was sick. It was pretty blah. I couldn't wait for it to be over...

reviews.name: Denzil Dsilva
reviews.text: Really good and professional masseuse. We went for the foot massage and was amazing. Highly recommend if u are going to asiatique.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you! :D

reviews.name: Paris Jones
reviews.text: We are living in Bangkok for more than a year and had visited many different places for massage. This was by far the worst we had ever been to! From beginning ladies giving us massage were setting the tip amount and after we didn’t like the masage and asked for different therapist the new one was very rude and loud. She was forcing me down then very loudly laughing with the other therapist and basically bulling and bothering. Then at the end they offered tea to other customers and not us to insult us !!!! Very rude and unprofessional. We don’t recommend this place and we hope they understand the only way they get tip and business is being professional and polite. I can only assume with country being closed to tourists they forgot about ethics of the job. Many other places we had been are really good and act with curtesy. Not this one!

reviews.name: Karen Ferguson
reviews.text: The ladies gave my girlfriends and I a lovely foot massage and accommodated us late at night after we'd been shopping at Asiatique. Very relaxing. We enjoyed it very much and the price was very reasonable. Make sure you tip these ladies. They were friendly and fit us in at last minute notice. Slept very well that night. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! 😃

reviews.name: Justin Mccormick
reviews.text: We got lots - lots of massages from different places while in Thailand. I can without hesitation say this was the absolute BEST my Spouse and I had. The therapist was able to figure out all my problem spots without even asking me and the other therapist did the same on my Wife. Each spent different amounts of time in those areas as they could tell they needed more work. Nothing was painful. My neck was in an awkward position and the therapist immediately recognized I was uncomfortable and made an adjustment to the pillow. By the time we left, we both felt 10 times better than when we came in and full of energy. AMAZING! The only negative thing I can say is it was not anywhere near my hotel! Otherwise I would have been there every day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! :D

Reserved at 8 p.m but started at 7:30 p.m.I got traditional thai massage.

It was too long to stand. lol and we paid 700batts and just ran out from there as the massagers pushed my borns using their borns instead of pushing the parts between borns. I would a lot better massaging than them. Don't waste your money and time here. Go somewhere else. I received massages  approx 18times and this is my first time to get out among having a massage. If the owner is reading this, you guys wast of my time and ruined my trip here. PLEASE train your massagers. They don't know what they are supposed to do.

reviews.name: Raya Albusaidi
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience! The head massage and relaxing hair wash were incredibly soothing. The waterfall rinse was a highlight and so unique. I have  thick hair, but the staff managed it perfectly and were so professional. The place has a lovely, relaxing atmosphere Highly recommend! 🥹❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Gus Shahin
reviews.text: Just have to say, the only thing that gave this a 3 stars was the ear spa treatment.  I added aroma oil massage. (total 120 mins) Massage was a 1 star. She did not work my shoulders and neck, or worked the gloat area. Also did not massage the chest or head. Just not a good massage all around.  My wife did the hair treatment for 120 mins. She stated it was ok. She gaves the place a 2 star. The only thing that saved it from a 1 star was the materials that they used, was great. Also the table you lay on made my back hurt. Not comfortable. After 2 hours my back is hurting. My wife stated the same thing. Also they only take cash. We spent $3920 baht for the 2 of us. You should take card if you call yourself a spa. Also for the person coughing the whole time we were there for 2 hours. Then when they blow dry someone hair you can hear it. So not relaxing at all. The walls are very thin. My wife and I travel the world and treat ourself to spas. We had high hopes, because it was on all my Facebook and tik tok feed. There are so many places in Bangkok that are much better and much cheaper price. So sad.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! I'm so happy to hear you enjoyed both services and felt well taken care of by our team. Can’t wait to welcome you back again soon. Highly appreciated!

reviews.name: Naravich Tharunram
reviews.text: A sincere ear spa experience, I've been interested in doing it since I saw a Tiktok clip a few years ago. Once I tried it, I felt thrilled. Anyone who wants to experience ear spa should give it a try.

reviews.text: We booked here last minute yesterday for an ear spa and head spa for two people on a busy Saturday and the owner was so kind. She fit us in and pampered the hell out of us. Both services were ahhhhmazing. Our hair looks incredible, my hair has never been softer. we feel so spoiled! It was even better than the head spas we got in Vietnam. The ear spa was really cool too, they were very careful and really cleaned out my gross ears. Go, you won’t regret it.

The treatment took 75 minutes. The atmosphere and service made me feel relaxed and comfortable. It was a great way to take care of myself and unwind.

reviews.text:
ประทับใจมากครับ! ✨ ร้านลาบัว สปาหู
สถานที่สะอาดสะอ้าน บรรยากาศน่านั่ง พนักงานบริการดีมากๆ สุภาพและใส่ใจสุดๆ ช่วงที่ทำความสะอาดหูคือผ่อนคลายมาก มืออาชีพจริงๆ ไม่เจ็บเลย มือเบาจนเคลิ้ม ทำเสร็จแล้วรู้สึกได้เลยว่าหูโล่ง เบาสบายขึ้นเยอะ ใครกำลังมองหาร้านสปาหูดีๆ แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน!
reviews.textTranslated:
I was very impressed! ✨ La Bua Ear Spa
The place is clean and tidy, the atmosphere is pleasant, and the staff are incredibly attentive and polite. The ear cleaning process was very relaxing; they are truly professional, it didn't hurt at all, their touch was so gentle I almost drifted off. Afterwards, I could immediately feel that my ears were clear and much more comfortable. If you're looking for a good ear spa, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Julian Rodriguez
reviews.text: The best massage and private onsen experience you can get in Bangkok! Staff is amazing, place is great and the vibe is immaculate. Feel like I’m born again after one hour aroma oil massage here. Highly recommend the 1 hour onsen + 1 hour massage package. Will come back for sure!

reviews.name: maria chaves
reviews.text: I booked a one hour Onsen and one hour oil massage for my partner and I. They were so understanding, we were late  20 mins. Things I loved: intake forms that ask about your preference for pressure and a picture of the body where you can mark where you would like the therapist to focus or not touch. We were given a cold tea when we arrived and then were taken to rinse our feet and the privó tar ones a are on the next floor up, so we were guided to the elevator upstairs ans to our private room. The decor is calming and minimalist Japanese style which helps you stay in the moment especially since you do have to travel from floor to floor. I also loved the robes provided in the room. The snacks and the water and juice were a great touch since you do get hot in the hot tub. After an hour the massage therapist come in and world their magic. I feel asleep ! I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Guangie Lizagon ttn
reviews.text: What a lovely time! I spent 3 and half hrs here. Private onsen, body scrub and aromatherapy massage. Good service, the staff are very service-minded. Good to try 😊

reviews.name: Kushal Saitia
reviews.text:
I had booked for an onsen and an aromatherapy massage through gowabi.
Riraku is an amazing place, very clean, and professional. The massage was extremely good, and the baths were warm and comfortable. They gave refreshments throughout and the aroma oils were perfect. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Skylar Andrews
reviews.text: This place was absolutely amazing! Very welcoming to foreigner and nice staff. Served rose water before and tea after the massage. Great for first timers. The onsen was warm and relaxing. The masseuse was very skillful and adjusted her pressure perfectly after being asked. Would come back again!

reviews.name: JoopJang Kamonchat
reviews.text: Private Onsen and Massage. The 90 mins Thai massage here just hits different! I really like it!!!

reviews.name: Wirunyupha Lertteeraraungkul
reviews.text: I've been to this spa 3 times, and this time they have more space! Tried the new onsen room—big, clean, and great. Got a 2-hour Thai massage today with therapist Khun Praew, who was amazing the whole time. Felt so relaxed! The massage room was nice and clean, and both receptionists were friendly, polite, and remembered my nickname every time I booked via Line or came in. Highly recommend🩷

reviews.name: Mika Apichatsakol
reviews.text: Great value for money. My husband and I booked the 1 hour private onsen and 1 hour Thai massage. Everything was well explained. The 1 hour onsen time is just right for us to not feel rushed. Our massage therapists were really good. We compared notes afterwards and only had good things to say about our masseuses. The receptionist also seemed really sweet. If I could make a small suggestion for improvement, the reception area is really bright and not relaxing like this rest of the facilities. We went at 9pm (dark everywhere) and the front desk area was a bit jarring, like a dental office or aesthetic clinic. If the light could be toned down or changed to more of a yellow hue rather than white, I think customers will feel more relaxed from the start, especially if they have to wait there a little. Either way, I was really pleased with the service and will be back for onsen + massage. 🙂
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for using our service at our store. We are pleased and grateful for your good advice. Hope to see you again next time

reviews.name: Emilia Krutilina
reviews.text: My husband and I went to a private onsen with the oil massage. I am very happy with the service👍🏼the onsen was spacious in a closed room and we were provided with drinks and snacks. The massage was very relaxing. Before the procedure, we were given a questionnaire to fill out with details about what kind of massage we wanted, also we were given a choice of massage oil. The price for these services was lower than in other places, so I recommend visiting this onsen
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🧸Thank you for the review and this recommendation. Next time, I hope you will come back again.🤎

reviews.name: Nioret
reviews.text: Very accommodating and kind staff. The massage was wonderful, they customized it to our liking. Onsen was great.

reviews.name: Pyrate Gal
reviews.text: The onsen was very nice, the venue is really wonderful. The water was hot and it was very peaceful. However the massages were not good. It felt like someone was just touching me. They were very professional, nothing improper but the massage did not feel relaxing. Just annoying. 😭

reviews.name: Mona

reviews.text:
My wife and I had a very unpleasant experience at this place 4/2/22. I would not advise anyone to go to this place as it is very expensive and was so bad that I walked out half way through my massage.

My wife and I agreed on 2 - 3 hour massages for a total of 3600 baht. Very expensive for the competition but we wanted to go because of the good reviews.

My masseuse was massaging way too fast even after I asked her to slow down and clearly not professionally trained as she was not nearly as good as the many other massages I received while in Thailand.

In addition, she left the herbal compression with no water so it started burning and smoking in the room.

After hour 2, I asked to be done and got up from the massage table which I have never done before.

We were still asked to pay 3000 baht even though my massage was terrible. I didn’t want to fight so I paid it and walked out.

I would not advise anyone to go to this place as there are many, many in Bangkok that are significantly better for a fraction of the price.

The only reason I have 2 stars instead of 1 is because my wife said her masseuse did a good job and was on par for other massages we had received.

Very unfortunate for the price and to have a bad experience with our last massage in Thailand!

Go elsewhere for a reliable and cost efficient massage.

reviews.name: Ghuang'yil Dschang
reviews.text:
I used to like this bar so much that I had visited quite often at the weekend since last year, even though I didn’t live nearby. But I will never visit here again and never recommend to anyone around me.

On the day I last visited this bar, I lost my passport. It was definitely my carelessness to have dropped it somewhere. And this bar was one of two places where I thought strongly my passport would have been dropped.

I desperately wanted it back. The passport contained stamps from more than 15 countries, representing six years of travel memories that cannot simply be replaced.

I contacted this bar and asked them if they had seen any lost passports, but they gave me a clichéd answer that if they found it they would contact me again.

As they didn’t give me any updated info about my lost passport, I contacted them again to politely ask them to make a short post on their Facebook saying that a passport had been lost at the venue. They could have typed a few words to do it, but they didn’t help me. I was hoping that someone holding my passport would see their Facebook post and return it, but I couldn’t even try that possibility, as they ignored my last opportunity.

Then, I realised that they treat their customers just as the ones who bring money to them. They post a lot of advertisements to gather customers for money, but they simply abandon customers in the issues they wouldn’t get any profit from. This kind of bar would detain customers who didn’t pay yet, even if a fire breaks out there.
