reviews.name: Ditthita Menthong
reviews.text:
So happy with my nails! 🩷💚 The salon is clean, the owner is so patient and pays attention to every little detail. She helped me find the perfect color, let me try different options, and absolutely nailed my reference (actually even better than the reference✨)

Definitely coming back! 🫶🏻

reviews.name: Caro Ordoñez H
reviews.text: Loved my nails! They were super friendly and helped me choose the color that matched my reference photo best. If you’re looking to get your nails done, this is the place to go. They also speak great English! 🙌🏻

reviews.name: Emmanuelle Raymondi
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Rose Nail and Spa. The studio is well located, it is only a short walk from On nut station.

My nails look great, the owner took such good care of me, she is very talented precise and most importantly friendly. Would 100% recommend.

reviewContext.Services: Sculpted nails, Nail extensions, Nail designs

reviews.name: Philippa Barrett
reviews.text: I think the best set of extensions I’ve ever had. The nail prep was amazing and there are so many colours to choose from. Will definitely be returning before I leave Bangkok 💜

reviewContext.Services: Nail extensions, Nail painting, Synthetic nail removal

reviews.name: Leonor Gonzalez
reviews.text: get your nails done here when in Bangkok, I could not recommend this place more. Pricing is great for the high quality: Paifon is the best nail artist I have ever had work on my nails, completely understood what it was I was looking for and delivered at such a high standard, couldn’t be happier with my design and the experience! Communicating in English was super easy!

reviews.name: Paulina Chmiel
reviews.text:
This place is a real gem on a Bangkok’s map! 🩵
Nails done at a truly high level.
My nail stylist was very professional and precise, communicative and helpful.
I’m super satisfied with the result.

reviews.name: Raham Rana
reviews.text: This salon is incredible. The design I wanted was very out there in comparison to what I usually do and Goy replicated it beautifully. There were two ladies there and they take such great care of your nails and really take their time. They have really mastered the art of nails. Thank you so much Goy for my beautiful nails. If you would like a first class experience, definitely visit!!

reviews.name: Dalia Kemble
reviews.text: Excellent service, and very welcoming and professional. The salon is clean and offers a great selection of colours. I’m very happy with the result and would highly recommend!

reviews.name: Xiang-ting Liao
reviews.text:
The manicurist is very patient and happy to answer any questions. Communication in English is not a problem at all. ☺️

The location is very convenient, within a 10-minute walk from On Nut BTS Station.

I would recommend making an appointment in advance via the LINE app. If you walk in on the day, especially during holidays, there’s a chance they may not be able to accommodate you. 😌

reviews.name: sarunya ponkhet
reviews.text:
💅✨ Rose’ Nail and Spa ✨💅
Absolutely loved the service from the moment I walked in!

The salon is clean, the staff are gentle and super detail-oriented. My nails turned out so beautiful — smooth, even color and perfectly shaped.
The best part? I asked for a quick service and they really delivered fast without sacrificing quality.
Perfect for anyone who’s short on time but still wants flawless nails!

Highly recommended! ❤️
If you’re looking for a place that’s fast, professional, and makes your nails look amazing — this is it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review and for choosing Rosè nail&spa. We hope to see you again soon 🙏🏻😊

reviews.name: Jade Lau
reviews.text: Such a lovely experience! I appreciate how the nail technicians made sure I was happy every step of the process, from nail shape, to color, to final touches. They were also transparent about pricing and the time it would take for the services. Very reasonable for the quality. Gorgeous array of colors and nail art options too! I will be a happily returning customer 🫶 thank you for your patience & care
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for lovely review 🙏🏻

reviews.name: LJ Easter
reviews.text: The best nail bar I have found in Bangkok. So friendly and really good English. I showed them a photo and then asked them for own creative interpretation. Such a good look. I will be back in a fortnight.

reviews.name: Salome Danelia
reviews.text: Naile artist girl was super cool and communicative. Talking fluent English. Did very good work, I loved my pedicure session with her 😍 Highly recommended from me!

reviewContext.Services: Foot massages, Polish removal, Nail painting, Nail polish changes, Pedicure
reviewContext.Requested style: I have requested a spa pedicure which included scrub and heel care with callus removal for 450 THB. Than I requested gel polish which they had a lot of color and painting designs.
reviewContext.Specialties: Very clean and cozy nail salon.
reviewContext.Stylist: Naile artist girl was super cool and communicative. Talking fluent English. Did very good work, I loved my pedicure session with her 😍 Highly recommended from me

reviews.name: Kim Howse
reviews.text: Wow, talk about taking your time and doing it right..Paifon did an amazing pedicure and the scrub she does to make sure all the dead skin is gone is probably the best one I've ever had in life. She is patient, kind, and even flexible with my appt. If I could give more stars I would. Thank you Paifon kop kun ka 💖

reviews.name: Chiavi Chang
reviews.text: A clean and cozy salon with a professional and caring nail technician. Transparent pricing and great service—definitely worth recommending! The foot spa was incredibly relaxing and made the whole experience even better.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely review 🥰

reviews.name: Sinan Penkhunthod
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff, and a clean, relaxing environment. My nails turned out perfect, highly recommend! 💅✨

reviews.name: Nik Starchild
reviews.text: Late review from our experience in December 2025. My wife went here for a manicure and really liked her nails. She asked me to come with her to get a foot spa. It was a very pleasant experience. I have really hard calluses on my feet and they got my feet so soft. We don't speak Thai, but we chatted with them via Line before our appointment and they had one person who spoke English. For two people we felt the price was quite reasonable. We definitely recommend this spot if you are in the area.

reviews.name: Claire
reviews.text: So happy I decided to come to Rose’ Nail & Spa. My manicure and pedicure were done beautifully, and the attention to detail even on my very short nails was excellent. Truly one of the best nails service I’ve had.

reviews.name: Layla Asssmy
reviews.text:
I really recommend this place.
The nail artist really took time and did everything I wanted.
So so happy whit the result 💖

reviewContext.Services: Sculpted nails, Nail extensions, Nail painting

reviews.name: Kate
reviews.text: Super positive experience at this nail salon! My nail technician, Phifon, was incredibly friendly, approachable, and highly professional. She made me feel very comfortable throughout the appointment, and her attention to detail was excellent. Her English is also fantastic, which made communication so easy. The prices are very reasonable for the quality of service you receive. I couldn’t recommend this salon enough 🔥💕

title: Yo Bann Pak Kay Massage
address: 46 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

reviews.name: suzie queen
reviews.text:
Been in Bangkok for 8 days and I have tried foot massages in 2 places.
This one is lower price and just as skilled and thorough. This place is not fancy but the therapists are just what you need.
I highly recommend this place.
I'll be going again tomorrow.  Their prices are the same as a picture thar someone posted 3 years ago. I had a 1 hour foot massage for 250 Baht.  Then she massaged my arms, neck and shoulders too.

reviews.name: Juliana P
reviews.text: First massage in Thailand and maybe only 5th in my life so take this with a grain of salt, but I loved it here. I did 30 min foot and 30 min neck/back and it was fantastic. I don’t like small talk and it was pleasantly quiet in there, perfect temperature, friendly staff. At the end, she cracked parts of my back that I didn’t know existed. Can’t beat it for $12 USD.

reviews.name: Jessica Miller
reviews.text: So so good. This place is very unassuming from the outside, but the quality of the massage is top tier. I had such a good quality, thorough, relaxing massage and it was my favorite experience out of all the massages I had while traveling through Thailand.

reviews.name: Aleksa Mil
reviews.text:
Did a back/shoulder massage.

I generally enjoyed the massage - it’s a bit different to other places, but guess it’s up to style/ taste.

Overall, it was good. I liked the fact that she didn’t just press and call it a massage, she used some technique to do the massage. The pressure wasn’t as strong, it was mild and pleasant.

Appreciate removing the oil of my skin so it doesn’t get on clothes.

Will probably go again.

Reg other reviews:
- they didn’t talk much > exchanged few sentences, but nothing drastic;
- she turned on the air con and did it go at me > but it was on just to cool down the place, she turned it off after 10min or so, so it was fine;
- got a basket to put my things in > which I placed under the bed, and it was fine.

reviews.name: Anthony Miles
reviews.text:
Excellent, I saw some reviews that mentioned they talk during the massages. This is true but I didn’t mind one bit, and it was only for a few minutes. I felt like I was in someone’s living room but in a good way.

It wasn’t painful at all, I was worried about being forced into positions I couldn’t handle but she eased off, I think she knew that I was inflexible and adjusted accordingly.

reviews.name: Hide
reviews.text: Really good massage. We had a lot in Bangkok and this was the best. The thaimassage and oil massage both are excellent! I would highly recommend to go to this place if you stay in chillax or nouvo city hotel. Its a 2 min walk.

reviews.name: C Ray
reviews.text:
A good professional massage.

I looked through Google map reviews and decided this was the place for a Thai massage.

I walked over there at about 8:00 in the evening. My reception was a little chilly, but I requested a 60 minute Thai massage and emphasized that I wanted a good massage and a strong one. That's what I got.  I'll likely be going back to see Ni for a two hour massage.

There were some things that I didn't really like. The massage was good but it lacked some of the more intense stretches that I've had at other places.

Also, my belongings were kept in a basket outside the curtained in massage area. I was a bit uncomfortable with that.

The massage could have been a bit more focused. The masseuse was listening to something in her earbuds, chatted a bit with coworkers and the massage wasn't quite symmetrical.

Still, much better than the average massage. I'll take it with its imperfections.

reviews.name: Sanpo
reviews.text:
It was the perfect massage.
It seemed like many locals were frequenting the place.
After a long flight, my body was aching, but thanks to her amazing massage, I was able to sleep soundly.
She didn’t speak much English, but words weren’t necessary in the face of her incredible skill.
I would definitely go back if I visit Thailand again.

reviews.name: Timo Lueck
reviews.text:
Avoid at all cost - was injured!
Reviews don't show truth.
Would give 0 stars if I could.

Booked a 1h full body massage.
Received 45min leg petting, 10min weirdest face and head rubbing, 5min injury.

Totally unskilled, nonstop loud shouting and chatting throughout entire store while 'massaging'
Constant breaks that seemed like she forgot what she was doing, then a toilet break during which I was just lying there for a few minutes as if they had forgotten I was there at all and to round up the experience I was then 'stretched' so poorly that she somehow pinched my nerve and I am still walking like a 90 year old in pain a day later even after trying to get it fixed by another massage somewhere else.

reviews.name: fany garceau
reviews.text: KokoOk gave me a full body massage. I had many since traveling here over the years, but his talent is rare. I found my guy!!

reviews.name: Marko K
reviews.text:
Went there without expecting a miracle but it was worse than I imagined . 😅
Up on the first floor facilities are very bad, aircondition blowing directly into you, masseuse was troubling with curtains and so on, and so on. Probably the worse massage in my life, around 10 out of 90min used on back massage . I was happy when it was over. 😁 The tea at the end was nice!

reviews.name: Benjamin Bigl
reviews.text: A place, where locals grab their massage at lunchtime - so don't be shy, step in, and dive into the real Bangkok beyond Khaosan party people. You will get an absolutely great and relaxing experience.

reviews.name: victor guarin gallego
reviews.text:
Austere but excellent.

This venue is a short stroll from Khaosan, enough to be out of the noise and hustle.

Very welcoming and smiling, great quality for money.

The massages were cheap compared to other places, but of a great quality, my girlfriend who knows pretty well about massages said, she had never had such a delightful experience

reviews.name: John Karwoski
reviews.text: Had the 60 minute oil massage, whole body. My massager spoke English and we had much clearer communication than I’m accustomed to having during massages in SE Asia. She asked if I wanted her to be soft or strong (I chose strong). I feel she is quite skilled and I’m happy with the way I felt when she finished.

reviews.name: Joseph Dewey
reviews.text: This is an excellent massage therapist! It's very relaxed and casual. My massage therapist was very good. I like the foot massage. They have a special service called the Hammer Massage, but I've never been brave enough to try it. They speak pretty good English. Their tea is good, too. And it's right by the 7-Eleven.

reviews.name: Unai Casado
reviews.text: The Thai massages are the best I ever had. Stayed in Bangkok 4 nights, 3 nights went to this place. Worth every penny. Don’t forget to tip the hard working ladies!

reviews.name: Cindy Hu
reviews.text: I went there for 2 hours Thai message the massage therapist did a good job. The massage parlor facility is simple but It is clean and the quality of massage is good. Price is also fair. They provide tea after massage. If you in near by area its a good place have massage.

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text: I went for a head and back massage and it was really good. I was literally "walking on the moon" after that. They offered me a warm tea and we had a small talk. I guess is a place a bit less frequented by turists than other massage shops, and I trully recommend it. Good prices too.

reviews.name: Ursula Kiener Ford
reviews.text: Not a pretty place by any means. I went because of the good reviews. They were right. Cheap price and the massage was the best I got in Bangkok considering I went to some more expensive places. Tao was my masseuse. I gave her a tip.

reviews.name: Helena Argona
reviews.text: I had severe neck pain when I entered this massage parlour. The lady who treated me understood my problem perfectly - I took the back, neck, and head massage, but she focused on the area that was painful. I have never been treated with such care and understanding of the human body. I wish we could stay one more night in Bangkok, just that I could go back to her. Five stars, this was magnificent! I was treated by the lady that was a bit older than the others - if you have the chance, ask for her!

reviews.name: Talia O
reviews.text: Walked in and got a 30 minute foot massage. My feet weren't particularly sore, but she did a great job getting out some of the tension I had. It was so relaxing in there I almost fell asleep. Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Talia,

Thank you for your kind recommendation. We are pleased to hear our foot massage provided such deep relaxation and tension relief. Providing a restful recovery is our priority at Lek Massage Chinatown MRT Wat Mangkon. As a trusted wellness destination since 1997, we look forward to welcoming you back for more relaxation near MRT Wat Mangkon soon.

Regards,
Lek Massage

reviews.name: Gordon
reviews.text: Kung and Yah were phenomenal massage therapists from start to finish. From the body scrub, oil massage and facial, they were exceptionally skilled. Will return again for another massage as it was an amazing deal and high quality.  Thank you Kung and Yah once again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your kind words truly mean everything to us, Gordon! We're thrilled to hear that Kung and Yah provided you with such an exceptional experience from the body scrub to the oil massage and facial. At Lek Massage Chinatown, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality service near Yaowarat. Thank you once again for your generous feedback, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another amazing massage!

reviews.name: 숲서울
reviews.text:
We came here with my parents during our trip to Bangkok, and it was one of the best experiences of our vacation.

The staff were incredibly kind, professional, and attentive. The massage was excellent, and they adjusted the pressure perfectly to suit each of us. We all felt completely relaxed and refreshed afterward.

The spa was clean, peaceful, and had a very comfortable atmosphere, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. My parents were especially impressed and kept saying how much they loved it.

If you’re traveling with family, I highly recommend this place. We will definitely come back the next time we visit Bangkok. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

title: Manohra Cruises
ownerDescription:
Set sail on an unforgettable journey of city sights of culinary delights.
Step aboard a beautifully restored antique rice barge and set sail on the majestic Chao Phraya River at dusk.
Glide past royal palaces, glittering temples and striking landmarks. Dine on fine Thai cuisine, including an option to upgrade to our new premium menu featuring a modern take on Thai classics, and savour refreshing drinks.

Daily
First round: 6.00 pm - 8.00 pm
- Welcome drinks and canapes at Manohra Lounge from 5.30 pm onwards.
Second round: 7.00 pm - 9.00 pm
- Welcome drinks and canapes at Manohra Lounge from 6.30 pm onwards.
address: 257/1-3 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Road, Samrae Bangkok 10600, Thailand

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text:
An absolute highlight of our trip to Bangkok Manohra Cruises is a must do if you’re visiting the city! We booked the 7 PM cruise, which was the perfect timing: watching Bangkok light up at night while cruising along the river was simply magical. The views were stunning and created such a special atmosphere.
The service was outstanding from start to finish. A special thank you to Jan, Ploy, Paint and Mick they made the evening unforgettable with their warmth, professionalism and attention to detail. They were incredibly friendly and made us feel very welcome throughout the entire experience.
The food was also excellent. Every course was beautifully presented and tasted amazing. As Europeans, we really appreciated that the dishes were very flavourful but not overly spicy, perfect balance and enjoyable for everyone.
Overall, this was such a memorable and luxurious experience and worth every penny. We would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok!

I will be sure to share your kind words with Jan, Ploy, Paint, and Mick. They take great pride in their professionalism and warmth, and they will be delighted to know they made your evening unforgettable. I am also glad our culinary team found the perfect flavor balance for your palate.

reviews.text: I have extensive experience with massages, and I can confidently say that “Na Siam Massage” is the best massage parlor in Bangkok. I usually booked my sessions in advance, although it probably wasn’t necessary since there was always a free masseuse available. Throughout my visits, I encountered both seasoned professionals and newcomers to the trade, and each session was enjoyable in its own way. The boss is a true heart of the establishment, always greeting with a smile. However, the real star of the salon is Dr. Ton. I met him at another salon and always chose him for my massages. When he moved to “Na Siam Massage,” I followed, and I have no regrets. Besides massages, I also tried the body scrub, and it was a fantastic experience. I highly recommend this salon to everyone. reviews.name: Harry
reviews.text:
Good Hotel, ruined by the current tourist crowd

Amari Pattaya still has the fundamentals: excellent location, easy access from Bangkok, big pools, good rooms, and genuinely outstanding staff. On paper, it should be an easy recommendation. But the reality on the ground has changed, and not for the better. The problem Isn’t the Amari. It’s the crowd.

Pattaya’s tourist profile has shifted dramatically in recent years. Local residents, business owners, and even Thai media have been openly complaining about the behaviour of a very specific, now dominant tourist segment. Crime reports have increased, police have tightened enforcement, and the government has tried to adjust visa rules, yet the issues remain visible everywhere.
My Thai wife noticed it immediately. Our local contacts confirmed it. And during our stay, the pattern was impossible to ignore.

At breakfast, we repeatedly encountered guests shouting across tables, behaving disorderly, and showing zero awareness of shared space. The worst moment was when a man at the next table burped loudly, deliberately, and without apology, so aggressively that it felt intentionally directed at us.
I’ll be honest: I had to hold myself back. I was this close to standing up and knocking the guy out. It would have ended very bad for him, I am Nak Muay (นักมวย)…… That’s how far the atmosphere has deteriorated. This wasn’t one incident. It was constant. And it completely destroyed the sense of relaxation that Amari used to offer.

Amari still has great staff and solid facilities, but the environment created by the current tourist mix, both inside the hotel and in Pattaya generally, has become unacceptable. The concentration of disruptive guests is simply too high, and despite recent enforcement efforts, the situation hasn’t improved enough to justify returning.

We won’t be coming back to Amari or Pattaya. The destination has changed, and until the broader tourism policies and enforcement succeed in restoring balance, it’s no longer the place it used to be.

Disappointing Stay at Amari Pattaya

I stayed at Amari Pattaya for three nights in a 3rd-floor pool-facing room. My advice: if you value your sleep, request the 8th floor or above.

Pattaya comes alive at night, so naturally many guests sleep later in the morning. Unfortunately, from around 7 AM, I was regularly disturbed by the pool attendant’s whistle and considerable noise from children around the pool.

As someone in the building business, I believe lower-floor rooms facing a busy pool should have better sound insulation. Guests shouldn’t have to figure this out after checking in.

Management communicated politely by email and mentioned compensation, which I declined. I wasn’t looking for freebies. I wanted proper hospitality.

What disappointed me most was at checkout. I asked for assistance arranging transportation to Woodlands Hotel, only about 1–1.5 km away, particularly because I was carrying a considerable amount of cash. I was simply told no cab was available.

Grab wasn’t the issue. The fare was never the issue. Hospitality was.

For the price, I expected better service and a more restful stay.

If you book here, choose a high floor. A nice pool view isn’t worth losing your sleep.

reviews.name: C Andersen
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Fantastic Family Stay at Amari Hotel

We had a truly wonderful stay as a family, and what stood out the most was the incredibly welcoming and friendly staff throughout the hotel – from the pool staff, restaurant team, executive club lounge, reception, and golf cart drivers. Everyone greeted us with smiles and genuine helpfulness.

Our children absolutely loved the hotel, and it was clear that families are made to feel very welcome here. The hotel felt safe, clean, and easy to navigate with children, which made the stay very relaxing for us as parents.

Our 2-bedroom Amari Suite was perfect for our family, offering plenty of space, comfortable beds, and a fantastic view overlooking the pool area, beach, and promenade. Having separate bedrooms made a big difference when traveling with children.

The pool area was excellent for families, with plenty of space, a lovely atmosphere, and easy access to towels, sunbeds, and refreshments. The beach being so close was also a huge advantage, making it easy to switch between pool and sea during the day.

The breakfast buffet was outstanding, with a huge variety of choices. There were many child-friendly options as well as healthy and fresh selections for adults. Hygiene standards were very good, and the food was consistently delicious.

The location is another big plus – in a great area with shops, restaurants, and attractions nearby, while still feeling calm and comfortable for families.

Of course, this level of comfort, service, and location comes at a premium price, and that should be taken into consideration when booking. However, we felt that the overall experience matched the cost.

The only small point for improvement was room service, as it took almost an hour for a pizza to arrive. That could be improved, but the food was delicious once it came.

Overall, we were extremely happy with our stay and can highly recommend this hotel – especially for families looking for comfort, excellent service, child-friendly facilities, and a fantastic location. We would gladly return.

It’s great that the diverse team, convenient bungalows, and attention to detail made your four-day adventure even better. We can’t wait to welcome you back for your Advanced Open Water with Ryan and the crew!

reviews.name: Laura Antal
reviews.text: Amazing experience on Koh Tao island thanks to the members of Scuba Shack! ☺️ We communicated very well before arriving, we’ve got all the details demanded and finally we followed an OW PADI course and an Advanced PADI course, respectively. 🐳 The instructors were attentive and professional, but also understanding and funny. The dive sites are spectacular, even though the visibility wasn’t the best during our stay. The equipment is also professional, we didn’t have issues with the gear. As a diver who tried quite a few centers around the world, I highly recommend this one in Thailand, taking into consideration the prices also (very, very good offers for the PADI courses). Thank you all for the experience! 🙌🏼

reviews.name: Geo Martinez
reviews.text:
Had a great time diving with Scuba Shack Koh Tao. Some minor hiccups but all was sorted out.
Our guide Lars was amazing. Provided safety briefings before each dive and was always aware of each diver’s capabilities and limitations.
Will dive again with them. Thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your great review! 🤿💙

We’re very happy to hear that you had a great time diving with Scuba Shack and that any small issues were quickly resolved. We always do our best to make sure our divers have a smooth, safe, and enjoyable experience.

Lars will be delighted to hear your kind words. His focus on safety, clear briefings, and understanding each diver’s individual experience and comfort level is exactly what we value as a team.

Thank you for choosing Scuba Shack and for trusting us with your dives. We would be very happy to welcome you back for more underwater adventures on Koh Tao!

Safe travels and happy bubbles! 🌊😊

reviews.name: Maximilian klostermeier
reviews.text:
My wife and I completed our Open Water certification with Scuba Shack and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. As complete beginners, we immediately felt comfortable and in good hands.

A huge thank you to our instructor Romeo, who was incredibly patient, professional, and calm throughout the entire process. He explained everything clearly and made us feel safe and confident in the water, while still keeping it fun and enjoyable.

Also a big thank you to Stefan, the owner, for being extremely accommodating and flexible. We really appreciated how easygoing and helpful the whole team was in working around schedules and making everything run smoothly.

The atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, but at the same time very professional. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience for our first diving certification and would highly recommend Scuba Shack to anyone considering diving.

reviews.name: Konrad Klimkowicz
reviews.text:
I completed a 3-day Refresher and Advanced Open Water course with Scuba Shack. The communication before I arrived on Koh Tao was excellent and gave me confidence that I would be well looked after from the start.
My instructor, Loran, was absolutely fantastic! She always gave clear explanations of what we would be doing on each dive, kept me informed of the schedule, and made sure I was comfortable both before and during every dive.
On my second dive, I was paired with Grace, who was completing her Instructor course. She gave me some great advice that helped increase my underwater time from 32 minutes to 43 minutes. She has all the makings of another talented instructor and would be a fantastic addition to the team. 😊

Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your fantastic and detailed review! 🤿💙

We’re delighted to hear that you had such a great experience completing your Refresher and Advanced Open Water course with Scuba Shack. It means a lot to know that our communication before your arrival helped you feel confident and well prepared from the very beginning.

Loran will be absolutely thrilled to hear your kind words. Her clear explanations, organisation, and attention to each diver’s comfort are exactly what help create a safe and enjoyable learning experience.

We’re also very happy that you enjoyed your dive with Grace and that her advice helped you improve your underwater time. We’ll be sure to share your encouraging words with her as she continues her journey towards becoming an instructor.

Thank you for choosing Scuba Shack and for sharing your experience with us. It was a pleasure having you on board, and we hope to welcome you back to Koh Tao for many more amazing dives in the future!

Safe travels and happy bubbles! 🌊🐠😊

reviews.name: Thomas Pohl
reviews.text: We did 4 dives at Scuba Shack to complete our OWD course. We could have the course in German which made it easier for our two boys. Our instructor Sabrina was just great and very attentive. The entire Scuba Shack team and everyone else on board was super nice. We’ve all been learning and discovering so much and had even more fun on every dive. The location and atmosphere is perfect. You should definitely go check it out! Had an amazing time overall and will be back for more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🤿💙

We're so happy to hear that you and your family had such a great experience completing your Open Water course with us. It's fantastic that taking the course in German helped make the learning experience even more enjoyable for your boys.

Sabrina will be delighted to hear your kind words. She loves sharing her passion for diving and making sure every student feels comfortable, confident, and has fun throughout the course.

Thank you for choosing Scuba Shack and for recommending us. It was a pleasure having you all with us, and we can't wait to welcome your family back for more amazing dives and underwater adventures on Koh Tao!

Safe travels and happy bubbles! 🌊😊

reviews.name: S JM
reviews.text:
A fantastic experience with Scuba Shack!

I completed my Open Water Diving course here, the process from start to finish was so well organised, fun and safe.

Huge Shoutout to Denis and Lars, who were so patient and made you feel comfortable during the whole process. Felt very safe in their the supervision.

Would 100% recommend to anyone looking to get their open water license here!

Thanks again team Scuba Shack.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear that your Open Water course was smooth, fun, and safe from start to finish. Denis and Lars will be thrilled to know their patience and guidance made you feel comfortable and secure throughout the process.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and can’t wait to welcome you back for more diving adventures with Scuba Shack!

reviews.name: Sophie Mcilwaine
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Scuba Shack and cannot recommend them enough! We initially just planned to do our open water certification but we loved the team and their teachings so much that we immediately booked our advanced. We had Jessie for our open water who was super patient, meticulous, encouraging and fun! She always had a smile on her face and I continuously felt safe and comfortable with her. We had Patrick for our advanced and he was wonderful too, very relaxed, fun and immediately made everyone feel comfortable in the water and helped us build and further develop our skills. Thanks to Stefan and the team, we’ll be back for some fun dives in the future 🩷

reviews.name: Coach Payton
reviews.text: Friendly, professional and a literal boat load of fun. I’d name drop a few folks but every single person there makes it a lovely experience. From boat crew to shop dog this isn’t a dive shop it’s a family.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing review! 🤿💙

Your words truly mean a lot to the whole Scuba Shack family. We’re so happy to hear that you felt the friendly, professional, and welcoming atmosphere that we always strive to create.

From the dive team and boat crew to our four-legged team member, everyone plays a part in making Scuba Shack feel like more than just a dive centre. We love creating a place where divers feel at home, make new friends, and share unforgettable underwater experiences.

Thank you for being part of our community. We can’t wait to welcome you back to Koh Tao for more adventures, laughs, and of course plenty of bubbles!

Safe travels and happy bubbles! 🌊🐠😊

reviews.name: I Mori
reviews.text: We had a simply fantastic day. Today we tried fun diving. We felt confident that we chose Scuba Shack. We are a family with three children. The instructors were simply calm and professional. With lots and lots of patience with the children, even when not everything worked out the first time. Thank you very much Lauren and Lars. You are simply amazing!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your fantastic review! 🤿💙

We are absolutely delighted to hear that you and your family had such a wonderful day diving with us. It means a lot to know that you felt confident and comfortable choosing Scuba Shack for your fun dives.

Lauren and Lars will be so happy to hear your kind words. Their patience, calm approach, and professionalism are exactly what help make every diver feel safe and enjoy the experience—especially when introducing children to the underwater world.

Thank you for trusting us with such a special family adventure. We loved having you all on board and hope to welcome your family back to Koh Tao for many more amazing dives in the future!

Safe travels and happy bubbles! 🌊🐠😊

reviews.name: Vasilia Tsabouri
reviews.text:
An incredible experience! I usually do not post reviews but this one I had to!

Scuba Shack was recommended by a friend and it went beyond my expectations! We had the pleasure to learn from Joanna an amazing instructor and person, with a lot of patience! The stuff was amazing, super helpful and the facilities also were super nice by the water! Plus all of us we would stay next to the beach bar to watch the sunset after every open water training or fun dive!

I really wish we can come back next year! Thank you all! See you soon!

reviews.name: Shravan Suresh
reviews.text:
I had the most amazing experience diving with Scuba Shack. I came here to complete my Advance Open Water Certification. The entire process from start to finish was so easy, smooth, safe and a lot of fun. Diving with them honestly made my trip so much more.

I also had a once in life time experience of witnessing a whale shark during one of my dives and visit a ship wreck.

All the instructors were amazing and very friendly. They really put effort in making you feel safe, a huge shout out my instructor Jessica Gawel, an absolute legend!

Thank you guys for the wonderful memories and I hope to dive with you guys again!!!

title: SPLASH BOX
ownerDescription:
Splashbox is a high-energy, dark room boxing gym set to club-like vibes with booming music and dynamic lighting🎶✨

In this fun, energizing atmosphere, you can move your body freely without worrying about anyone watching 🙌🏻💥

Our 45-minute classes include:
10 minutes of circuit training🏋️‍♂️,
10 minutes of shadow boxing🥊,
and 25 minutes of boxing💪,
all led by energetic performers, helping you aim for 🔥 500 calories burned🔥 (including afterburn).

This exciting new experience is available at Marche Thonglor in Bangkok’s Thonglor area, and it’s perfect for beginners too✨

We also offer personal training sessions, where you can work one-on-one with a trainer to achieve your ideal body💫🌟
address: 5M Floor, Marche Thonglor Building A, 150 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Ali Can Cakiroglu
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

First time at Splash Box and I absolutely loved it! 🥊🔥 The class was a high-intensity cardio workout mixed with boxing, with great music, tons of energy, and nonstop movement from beginning to end. It was challenging but SO much fun!

Everyone was incredible — from the check-in process and the staff to our instructor Palm, who was amazing! Super welcoming, friendly, and energetic.

Such a great workout and such a fun atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back!

Highly, highly recommended! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Estelle Wong
reviews.text:
really love this boxing class so much. The music is amazing and full of great rhythm. The lighting matches the music perfectly, which makes everyone feel more engaged while punching.

This workout mixes lots of high-cardio moves, such as running man, burpees and mountain climbers. It’s super effective and burns plenty of calories.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are so glad you enjoyed the rhythm and lighting in our boxing session! Blending intense fitness moves like burpees and mountain climbers into our Boxercise routine is exactly how we keep the energy high and the calories burning. Thank you for choosing us as your go-to workout activity see you in the next class! 🙌⚡

Ready for the next one? Send it over whenever you're ready!

reviews.name: Ka Ping Man
reviews.text: This is a great fitness center for boxercise classes throughout the day and also a gym for PT sessions.   I really enjoy the classes here and the staff are super friendly! You can enjoy a quick 50 min work out and burn over 500 calories.  This is my favourite 'go to' class for cardio exercise. The cost is really reasonable and you can choose a package to suit your schedule.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for this incredible review! 🤩 We love being your favorite 'go-to' cardio activity! See you on the floor for another epic sweat session soon! 🥊✨⚡

reviews.name: Taa Winitar
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed the beat and neon lights here. Super cold boxing room but felt better when my body got heat up with the boxercise 🔥👊🤗

You can drive here, there is a car park. Or you can ride from Thonglor BTS (not sure the price) but I walked here, only 550m from the BTS. Warm your body a bit 🤣

Once arrived at Marcé, go to zone A and take elevator to 5M (not 5).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much!
ขอบคุณที่รีวิวให้ Splash Box นะค้า ดีใจที่ชอบ Studio ของเราค่ะ ไว้มาเข้าคลาส Dark Beat Boxercise อีกบ่อยๆนะคะ ^^

reviews.name: Benya
reviews.text:
I tried two classes here and discovered a completely new way to work out. Splash Box combines boxing with circuit training in a dark room setting, which really helps you focus on each exercise. The studio has excellent facilities with everything you could need. One of the best features is the convenient parking - you can park for up to 4 hours for free. After your workout, you can easily grab food or groceries at Tops Market downstairs or other nearby shops.

I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking to try something new and exciting for their fitness routine.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review, Benya N.! We're so glad you enjoyed Splash Box! Training in the dark really helps you concentrate and is a refreshing experience. We're also glad to hear that you were satisfied with the facilities and parking. Four hours of free parking is really convenient! Being able to go shopping or eat right after training is also a big plus. All our staff look forward to seeing you again! Please try our new classes next time. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: suwalee phatarajumruskul
reviews.text: I just tried out the boxing + EDM class and it was such an adrenaline rush! 🥊⚡ The beats kept the energy high from start to finish, and the atmosphere made it impossible not to push harder. It felt more like a party than a workout — but trust me, you’ll sweat like crazy. Perfect for anyone who wants fitness to feel fun, powerful, and seriously motivating.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear suwalee phatarajumruskul

Thank you very much for participating in our Boxing + EDM class.

We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed such a high-energy class. Working out to the beat is so much fun, and it really creates a party-like atmosphere. It's encouraging to hear that you worked up a sweat.

It's wonderful to be able to have fun while exercising. We hope you'll come back again next time for even more excitement and fun.

All of our staff look forward to welcoming you back.

reviews.name: Abby Ta
reviews.text:
45 minutes of pure energy! 🔥🥊
This boxing class is non-stop fun — the playlist is perfectly synced, making the whole session feel like a high-energy dance party. Super motivating and uplifting.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow! I'm so happy you enjoyed it! It's great that you felt the energy of the boxing class! 🎶🥊

Thank you for liking the playlist too! I'm so excited that you felt like you were at a dance party. I hope we can have another fun session together next time!

I'm looking forward to seeing you again! ✨

reviews.name: Scarlett Maturada
reviews.text: A good cardio-focus class with EDM music and fancy lights makes me feel very excited to maximize my limit. The gym has equipment and a tower provided. Will come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience! We’re so glad to hear you enjoyed the class. We can’t wait to have you back again soon!

reviews.name: K J
reviews.text: Loved the boxing class! 🥊 The coach explained everything clearly and made it really fun. I also love that they provide everything shampoo, conditioner, Dyson hair dryer, and even cleansing wipes for removing makeup. There’s also a clean shower room, so you can just come with yourself and enjoy the workout. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello! Thank you so much for your review! We'll do our best to make our Dark Beat Boxercise class members even happier!

Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Nattida Kanti

title: House of Taste Thai Cooking School, Suan Phlu, Sathon
ownerDescription: House of Taste Thai Cooking School provide the best hands-on Thai cooking class in Sathon area with exploring Suan Phlu Market, one of Bangkok’s big fresh market, the vibrant atmosphere with countless fresh fruit and vegetables market that is in the city’s centre. Then off to the school to learn about various exotic Thai ingredients, including vegetables, rice, herbs, and spices, as well as the preparation of coconut milk and curry paste from scratch. Spend 3.5 hours making 4 authentic Thai delicious dishes, and savor each one individually while they're still hot and fresh. Get your hands dirty by making the curry paste from scratch, and take home all recipes with you so you can recreate the gastronomic experience again in the future!
address: 33 Thanon Suan Phlu, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

reviews.name: Wei Lun Lee
reviews.text:
We had several classes with House of Taste.
Bensé was our host for the experience. We really learnt a lot from her and she is a really fun and interesting teacher. Recommend to choose her class! U will have a great time.

reviews.name: Diane Petit-Bois
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this cooking class! The food was incredible and every dish turned out so flavorful and authentic. The instructor was super kind, knowledgeable, and made the entire experience feel welcoming and fun from start to finish. Shopping through the market beforehand was such a cool experience, and they made us feel like we truly belonged there instead of just tourists. I learned so much about Thai cooking and culture while having an amazing time. Highly recommend to anyone visiting!

reviews.name: Rodelio Soriano (InRodWeTrust)
reviews.text:
An very nice experience in Bangkok.

This cooking school is more than just a class, it’s a fun, interactive, and memorable activity that is perfect for team building. The session was very well organized, hands-on, and enjoyable from start to finish.

The instructors were friendly, patient, and made the cooking process easy to follow, even for beginners. Visiting the local market and learning about fresh Thai ingredients added a great cultural touch to the experience.

What made it even better was cooking together as a group, sharing laughs, and then enjoying the delicious dishes we prepared ourselves. There’s something very satisfying about eating what you cook.

One small suggestion for improvement: when the facility is fully packed, the cooking area can get quite warm. Adding more air-conditioning or improving ventilation would make the experience even more comfortable for guests.

Highly recommended for corporate teams, families, or friends looking for a unique bonding activity in Bangkok.

Great food, great atmosphere, and great memories.

reviews.name: Lisa Yurchenko
reviews.text:
Amazing experience!
We enjoyed it so much! The class was very hands-on and absolutely delicious! We would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to learn more about Thai cuisine and culture. Thank you, Pitch!

reviews.name: Jerry Tan
reviews.text:
Pitch and her team conducted a really captivating and interesting cooking class! We enjoyed and savored such a delicious Pahd Thai, Green Curry And Mango Sticky Rice dishes!

Professionally led and efficiently carried out. No better way to learn the basics of our favorite thai dishes. Well worth it to enjoy a morning of delectable recipes and making new friends from all over the globe too!

A must try when in Bangkok! PS. The cooking studio was so clean and welcoming too.

reviews.name: CH Chloe Ong
reviews.text: Did a team building here. The recipes were good and the chefs customised the dishes based on diet requirements and allergies. The cooking competition was fun and everyone is involved. The staff was very attentive and polite too. The head chef is amazing! Love this experience! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Roger Soh
reviews.text: Our company’s team bonding activity at Sompong Thai Cooking School was an absolute delight! From the engaging local market tour where we learned to select fresh ingredients to the hands-on cooking session preparing authentic Thai dishes like Tom Yum Soup, Pad Thai, and Green Curry, everyone had a role that encouraged communication and collaboration. Our instructor was patient and expert at guiding all skill levels, and the experience culminated in a wonderful shared meal where we enjoyed our delicious creations while laughing and bonding in a relaxed cultural atmosphere. The clean, group-friendly kitchen made everything smooth and stress-free, and Sompong truly understood how to make cooking classes work for corporate teams by breaking down barriers and creating genuine connection. Highly recommended for any company seeking a unique, meaningful team bonding experience in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Jason Thomas
reviews.text: A great experience where you spend 3.5 hours making 4 dishes including a market tour.. Check the menu as each day has different dishes. Small group sizes and clean kitchens and friendly staff and reasonably priced.

reviews.name: Kaylea Miyake
reviews.text: I had soooo much fun with the class. It was super interactive, Pitch was funny and kind, and definitely a highlight of my trip! A must do if you come to Thailand!

reviews.name: Laura Lee
reviews.text: Had a fantastic time here leaning to cook my favourite Thai dishes. Instructor for our class was Pitch, and she was humorous and engaging. Pace of the class is great even for beginners who may not have experience w cooking. Facilities are clean, and supporting staff make it a seamless process transiting from dish to dish.

reviews.name: Oliwia Wojcik
reviews.text: Amazing class, food is amazing and the teacher is very knowledgeable and friendly! Vegetarian options available! 10/10, must do if you’re in Thailand!

reviews.name: Sheldon Turnbull
reviews.text: The were super friendly and fun. The place was clean and set up well. Our group really enjoyed. A "must do" on your trip to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Magdalena Janusz
reviews.text: I highly recommend this few-hour Jouse of Taste cooking school. The dishes were full of authentic, vibrant flavors, and everything tasted incredibly fresh and well balanced. What I appreciated most was how clearly the techniques were explained — even complex flavors were achieved with simple, easy-to-follow steps. It’s a great experience for anyone who wants to cook delicious Thai food at home without feeling overwhelmed.

reviews.name: Jonas J
reviews.text: Great experience with delicious food. April was a great teacher! Would always recommend. Looking forward to try some of the recipes back home!

reviews.name: Melanie Campton
reviews.text: This was hands down the most fun I have had since I got to Bangkok. April, our host was witty, engaging, funny and such and incredibly good teacher and she told me to say she's super cute as well. What a fantastic experience. I would do this again and again and again.

reviews.name: Alix McDonnell
reviews.text: Really great class. Great English speaking. Very organised and quality ingredients. Air con workspace made a massive difference in the heat. Would recommend ☺️

reviews.name: Payal Patel
reviews.text: The best cooking class experience for our first trip to Thailand! We made and enjoyed 4 dishes and we left with our hearts and stomachs full.

reviews.name: Marianel Coolen
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing thai cooking class! April was a superb chef and the meal was amazing.  Really enjoyed learning about the various ingredients that each dish had! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Radhika
reviews.text: This was probably one of the best and most organized cooking class I’ve been too. The host/chef was so friendly and explained everything really well. I loved that we were able to go to the nearby market too and learn about new ingredients. Everyone got to make their own dish so it was truly a hands on experience which I loved!

reviews.name: brian bishop
reviews.text: The food was delicious and the lessons fun. I only wish I was better informed about the pepper. For flavor, not to eat (lol) The instructor was engaging and delightful!
