reviews.name: ANS
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5

I’ve had massages all over Bangkok, but this place is truly one of the best I’ve ever experienced. The massage was absolutely amazing—professional, relaxing, and exactly what I needed.

A special thank you to BUA. She is incredibly skilled, attentive, and knows exactly how to relieve tension and make you feel comfortable. Her technique was outstanding, and I left feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated.

The place itself is clean, peaceful, and welcoming, with friendly staff and a relaxing atmosphere. If you’re looking for a top-quality massage in Bangkok, I highly recommend this place and especially BUA. I will definitely be coming back on my next visit to Bangkok.

Thank you, BUA, for such a wonderful experience! 🙏✨🌸

reviews.name: Stephen sC
reviews.text:
Me and my wife  had an excellent hour foot massage here at a very reasonable price.

si and vi were excellent massuers and made us feel really relaxed. The massage included a drink of water before we started, secure lockers, a foot wash, an excellent massage including lower legs and then a quick neck massage at the end and then tea and a rice cake. Nothing was rushed.

We will definitely be visiting again soon.

reviews.name: Shawn Lee
reviews.text:
Service was decent at the start. I went to the counter and picked sport massage, 1 hour, 1250 baht. It is easily the most expensive 60 min treatment on the menu.

I needed to go to the washroom, and the therapist showed me to the first floor washroom. I took a few minutes (i think it’s 5-10 mins) in the toilet. During that 5-10 mins, they knocked on the door and rushed me twice. It was incredibly disturbing.

Overall vibe at the first floor felt like a busy restaurant even though it was a spa. Therapists were chatting, laughing, and there were quite a few guests around.

After the trauma at the toilet, there were no instructions on where to go and just a lot of different uniformed therapists speaking thai in my face. In the end I decided to sit down on a bench and one of them came after a while, told me to go to the locker and then showed me to the lift, and then to the room.

I got a room with a shower, the massage was decent but by no means a good sport massage. The therapist was friendly. At the end of the massage she told me to go shower, and she showed no signs of wanting to leave the room! I am a male, so it was quite disturbing. I had to stand up, in almost see through disposable underwear, and walk to the shower, and actually shower, all that while she was in the room. Super disturbing.

After I’m done, I looked for a hair dryer, and she said there’s no hair dryer available. Small issue because my hair was relatively short.

She guided me to the first floor, where I was again not given ANY instructions on where to go, so I just went to sit down on a sofa.

Two customers who ended the same time as me got some crisps and hot tea. WHILE I WAS SERVED THIS GLASS OF ICE WATER!!!! i wanted to hold off writing this bad review, but why am I given a glass of iced water after a massage, while everyone got the same hot tea and crisps???

I am displeased with the service, and I really hope to hear from the management of this place, why am I being treated this way?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued customer,
We would like to thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. Please accept our sincerest apologies that our service on this occasion did not meet your expectations. We truly regret the multiple issues that occurred during your visit.

Regarding the use of restrooms:
We were concerned for your safety as your were in the restroom for an extended period. We deeply apologize if our attempt to check on you by knocking on the door felt intrusive or caused and inconvenience. However, we fully understand that this action may have caused discomfort. We will use this feedback to improve our procedures, ensuring we provide care in a way that is more appropriate and respectful of our customers privacy.

Regarding drinks and snacks:
We apologize profusely that you did not receive the same standard of service as our other guests. As it was near our closing time(11:00pm), our supply of snacks and warm tea had unfortunately run out by the time you finished your service. However, we recognize that this is not the experience our customers deserve.
We sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back again, so that we may provide you with a much better experience and more impressive service.

reviews.name: S.Y
reviews.text:
Go Bangkok cannot don’t do body massage!

Upon entering, the place felt clean, calm, and relaxing. Thankfully, it was quiet and they even had signs reminding customers to keep noise levels down, which I really appreciated. For me, massage time is me time, so I decided to go for the 1.5hr full body massage at 550฿.

I’ve tried those cheaper ones below 300฿ before but you know, the kind where everyone is just lying side by side in an open space, with customers and therapists chatting non-stop. Honestly, it doesn’t feel relaxing at all, and I leave feeling more distracted than refreshed 🫣

I guess as you get older, you start to appreciate spending a bit more for proper comfort and enjoyment 😅

They only have one and only branch at Ekamai area which is walking distance from ekkamai bts station.

reviews.name: Lily
reviews.text: Omg! This was my first Thai massage and it was amazing! Every little muscle and cell was worked on. We did two hours as the price was so good! We felt welcomed from the first second, our masseuses Chun and Pao were very attentive, helpful and professional. Definitely recommend this place!

reviews.name: Melissa LovesIceCream
reviews.text: Opens punctually at 9am, clean and feels a bit more attentive and premium in service while being affordable. Will wash your feet with warm water & soap before starting. Serves hot tea and local rice crackers after session .

reviews.name: Amara Davis
reviews.text: I had the best foot massage here!! Phao was my masseuse and she was AMAZING!!! It was absolutely relaxing, great pressure, and she was extremely friendly and ensured I was comfortable and had everything I needed! The atmosphere is very relaxing and the staff is very polite and attentive! I also loved my tea and rice crackers at the end the session. I feel rejuvenated and my feet are feeling amazing especially after a long walking day in Bangkok!! Will for sure come again soon!!!

reviews.name: Chiara Noll
reviews.text:
It was perfect!! Everyone was so nice and lovely to me. Such a pleasant atmosphere :)) I felt extremely comfortable and I'm looking forward to coming back.
The only thing that could be improved would be some relaxing music in the massage rooms 🤍
I will definitely be coming back!!

reviews.name: Shruti Sharada Nambiar
reviews.text:
Excellent massages here!

I got the Ginseng Body Scrub, which was very relaxing and made my skin glow. It was so good that I opted for the Head Massage as well, with hot coconut oil to aid hair growth. It was relaxing enough that I drifted in and out of sleep throughout 😴

The in-between wait was refreshing, too, because they served fragrant Jasmine tea.

The place is very clean, very professionally run, and the masseuses are lovely, caring people who make sure that you're relaxed at every step. They have safe lockers here, so you can have a truly off-grid experience.

reviews.name: Requita Harris
reviews.text: Great experience! Definitely the place to come to for the best massage. I received a head, neck, shoulder, & back massage with Bua and it was phenomenal! 10 out of 10 for sure. The firmness and pressure was exactly what I needed, loved her. Beautiful facility and the entire staff was very friendly with smiles on their faces. So glad I came here, will definitely come back on my next trip.

reviews.name: poyee
reviews.text: Found a massage nearby. Good service and comfortable environment, a nice place to take a rest.

reviews.name: Meiqi Wang
reviews.text: I came in with my friend for a walk in at 8:30pm and they were able to book us in immediately. The place is clean and everybody at this establishment was very hospitable and welcomed us immediately, even allowing us to charge our phones while we had our massages. My masseuse, Pond, was thorough, strong and very friendly! I would come back if I am ever in the city again :)

reviews.name: MAGIC S
reviews.text: Exuberant experience , calm peaceful and soothing .. my masseuse Khun da was excellent and highly recommend .. the manager came to say hello to me and gave me free balm and made sure everything was ok.. the place is well decorated with nature .. aircon was nice and cool and palace was clean.. staff friendly with smiles , bathroom clean and smell nice .. foot massage and Thai massage I did and please tip your masseuse ,,cool after massage snack and tea .. highly recommend .. membership program loooked like good deal also for frequent visitors

reviews.name: Michael Carr
reviews.text: Amazing location. The staff is very professional & accommodating. When visiting Bangkok. You must get a wonderful spa experience from Sakura!

reviews.name: Vincent HO
reviews.text:
The first day we went there for foot massage because we have a child together, so the staff not not the child to sit together with us and suggested us for Thai massage so we could have a private room and the kid could stay there. So we come back the next day for Thai massage, however, the same lady tells us the child can only sit at the lobby if he wants to stay with us need to pay 200bath which is ridiculous and they just take back what they said ~~
The staff and shop is really bad！

reviews.name: Marie-France Marzan
reviews.text: we are staying here for 4 days in Bangkok and this spot was right next to our hotel ! I definitely recommend this place 100%, the place and the staff has been too nice ! i was taken care by Bow and Kiki and they are all caring from the start until the end ! i will definitely come back with my husband until the end of our Bangkok trip !

reviews.name: Alia Ferris
reviews.text: Best place for great massage and best service ! No spa at this quality can beat these prices in whole Bangkok. Me and my husband are coming back here for years. Highly recommend !

reviews.name: Anton Rydahl
reviews.text: Of the four massages I have had in Thailand, this one was by far the best! Within the first five minutes, most of my joints had already cracked. My back and calves feel so much better than before I went here. Will definitely come back next time I get to visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: Victoria Millson
reviews.text: Wonderful massage location! Great therapists, clean and quiet location. Feel so relaxed. They never rush and communicate well. Have come back during my holiday and hope to come back if I visit Thailand again. Really happy and you can’t go wrong if you book here!

reviews.name: Rory Williams
reviews.text: I had a trapped nerve in my neck/upper back and came to Sakura for a Thai message in hopes to relieve some pressure. Khun Pang was incredible… firm and strong.. exactly how I like it. Highly recommend this place!

title: DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn
ownerDescription: Welcome to DIORA ONSEN & SPA SATHORN, where relaxation meets rejuvenation. Indulge in our exclusive sensory heaven packages, thoughtfully designed to awaken your senses and restore your well-being.
address: 117 1 Suwan Sawat Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

reviews.name: ChenFamily
reviews.text: This serene oasis is located off a small alley (Soi). From outside it looks like a secluded private residence, but stepping into the waiting area transports you instantly into a Japanese zen like zone. A cool towel and drink to start and then into the largest therapy room I have ever seen, with washroom, private soaking tub, and a small table. All in soothing cypress-like shades. The shiatsu massage was a blend of standard oil and pressure, with a little stretching. After, you are escorted to a separate tea room for hot tea, hot towel and a Japanese snack. Pricey for a non hotel session, but on a quiet day, absolutely worth the price.

reviews.name: 0089 ธัญธรัตน์ เพ็ชรรัตน์
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience here. The onsen was very clean and relaxing, and the staff khun Nang were professional and friendly. A perfect place in the middle of Bangkok. Will definitely come back. Exactly what I needed to recharge.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality wellness time.

reviews.name: sean A
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience! The staff were so kind and professional. The massage was fantastic, and I really enjoyed trying all the teas. I’m not sure what the dessert was, but it was absolutely delicious. The onsen was so relaxing, and my wife and I felt refreshed and rejuvenated after our visit. I highly recommend booking in advance!

reviews.name: Pete Tanpipat
reviews.text:
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn is a lovely new spa near our home, open for about a year. The space is beautifully designed—quiet, calm, and serene. The treatment menu has a good variety at reasonable prices, and while the onsen is quite small, it’s perfect for a more private and relaxing experience.

Khun Ann, the manager, is especially sweet, helpful, and welcoming. Overall, a charming little spa that I would definitely recommend—and I’ll happily be returning weekly! ♨️✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Pete Tanpipat,

Thank you for your review.
We truly appreciate your support. We are happy to know that Khun Ann was able to make your experience special. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with her. 

We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: Rahayu Ayu
reviews.text: Amazing private onsen and spa experience. Makes you feel relaxed and refresh. Service was great and the experience was smooth and how the lady kindly explained the process. We had the sound of Japanese Furin touch of heart package. The massage was great and onsen was great but Im not used to the heat had to go out and get a cold bath and then go back in a few times. But overall love the experience. After we are done they brought us some warabi mochi and tea. Will definitely drop by again whenever we visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Rahayu Ayu,

Thank you for your positive feedback. We're glad to hear you're happy with our service. Your satisfaction is our priority.

We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: Ksenia Lutz
reviews.text:
Diora Onsen & Spa Sathorn is truly a little piece of Japan in the heart of Bangkok. From the moment I stepped inside, I felt as if I had been transported to another world. The beautiful design, peaceful atmosphere, and attention to every detail made the entire experience feel magical.
I started with the 30-minute private onsen, which was the perfect way to unwind before my treatment. It was peaceful, impeccably clean, and incredibly relaxing.
After that, I enjoyed a 60-minute Lomi Lomi massage with Bua, and she was exceptional. Her expert touch seemed to melt away all the tension I had been carrying. Every movement felt intentional and restorative, and by the end of the treatment my body felt lighter, deeply relaxed, and completely recharged.
A special thank you as well to Jah, whose warm hospitality and attentiveness made me feel genuinely welcome throughout my visit. The service was thoughtful from beginning to end.
This wasn't just a spa visit—it was an experience that brought me joy and tranquility. If you're looking for a luxurious escape from the bustle of Bangkok, Diora Onsen & Spa Sathorn is an absolute must-visit. I will definitely return on my next trip.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ksenia Lutz,

Thank you for taking your time sharing your positive feedback with us.
We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our service with Bua and Jah. Providing a deeply relaxing and rejuvenating experience is always our top priority, and knowing we achieved that for you truly highlights our team's dedication.

We look forward to welcome you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: Nathalie Santos
reviews.text:
My favorite spa experience!

I highly recommend this spa. The massage, the atmosphere, and the service were all outstanding. Everything was absolutely amazing from start to finish. I honestly have nothing to complain about.

The sauna and the jacuzzi area are just as perfect as the massage itself. A truly relaxing and luxurious experience. I would definitely come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nathalie Santos,

Thank you for taking your time to share your experience. We are thrilled to hear that our team provided you with excellent service. 

We look forward to welcome you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: Rujinan K.
reviews.text: I've had Onsen and massages at various spa, this one is by far the greatest. It's a beautiful, calm and peaceful setting. I felt genuinely cared for during the session because the therapist was highly skilled and attentive. The reception staff was very friendly and provided excellent assistance and clear instructions. I strongly recommend everyone to try it. If you’re visiting Bangkok, this is definitely a must! Truly the best spa experience I’ve ever had.

reviews.name: José Carlos Garza
reviews.text:
Absolutely perfect experience from start to finish.
The facilities are beautiful, spotless, and very peaceful. The onsen experience was incredible — honestly felt even better than some onsens I visited in Japan. The massage therapists were extremely skilled and technically excellent, one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The service throughout was warm, professional, and attentive.

Highly recommend — 10/10 experience.

reviews.name: Julaluk Chaiyakarn
reviews.text:
I felt disappointed because my first visit was at the same price, but I got a much better private onsen room with two pools, an outdoor area, and an outdoor shower. This time, despite paying the same price, I was assigned a much smaller room with only one pool and no outdoor area.

When I asked the staff, I was told that guests need to select their room in advance, and the larger rooms were already fully booked. I don't think it's fair to charge the same price when the room quality and facilities are clearly different. It would be better if there were different pricing tiers or clearer information about the room options.

That said, the staff were very kind, friendly, and provided excellent service throughout my visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Julaluk Chaiyakarn,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize that we could not accommodate your preferred spa room during your recent visit. Please allow us to inform you that our spa treatment rooms are assigned based on the specific equipment and setup required for each unique service to ensure the highest quality treatment. We always do our best to honor all specific requests and we apologize for any frustration caused.

We will share your feedback with our team to ensure a clear information about room options is delivered accurately. 

We hope you will give us another opportunity to provide the seamless experience you deserve.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: fatima alali
reviews.text: I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa! From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was calm, clean, and beautifully scented. The staff were professional, welcoming, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout. My massage was incredible — the perfect balance of relaxation and pressure. Every detail, from the soothing music to the warm towels, showed real care and attention. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely renewed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly perfect spa service in Bangkok, i did the signature shiatsu fusion massage ❤️

reviews.name: Wai Tin KWOK
reviews.text:
They get lots of 5-star reviews and they certainly deserve them.  The place is pristine, and what's better than a therapeutic massage after an hour of relaxing onsen?  I cannot judge the skills of my therapist as I asked for Thai fusion massage at soft level, and some of the usual pain points were skipped, but all I can say is I wished my first massage ever 10 years ago were like that.  Anyway, the place was serene and tranquil, and the trickle of the Onsen water added to the authentic experience.  One star was taken off for the location.  Best walk 3 minutes from Lumpini MRT to their other shop and let them arrange shuttle for you, the traffic around would annihilate any expectations for a good time.
Grab the BUY ONE GET ONE FREE promotion NOW!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Wai Tin KWOK,

Thank you for visiting and sharing your experience with us. We apologize  for the inconvenience from the traffic nearby. We will do our best to accommodate our guests in any way possible.

We look forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Onsen & Spa Sathorn

reviews.name: Sassy Que
reviews.text: Had our best & luxurious spa and onsen experience at Diora. Exceptional atmosphere, service and massage quality - the staff are professional, highly experienced, meticulous and thoughtful. And we were so lucky to enjoy their 1-for-1 package! Will definitely visit again.

reviews.name: Adrian Lai
reviews.text: Amazing experience, clean and zen environment. All the staffs were very friendly and welcoming. Onsen was at the perfect temperature and massage was perfect. Specifically asked for tight spots and massaged on point. Add on the facial and face massage and it feels so rejuvenating. Ended off with a tea and mini dessert set which cleansed the stomach and mind. Simply amazing.

reviews.name: vivian cheow
reviews.text: Amazing onsen and massage experience, interior and design of the place really makes you feel like you’re in japan. Very zen and relaxing👍 staff were very friendly, attentive and welcoming. Highly recommend

reviews.name: C Choong
reviews.text: In a city full of massage places, this place is outstanding for its quality, service and ambiance, the dessert and tea after in a beautiful japanese teahouse style setting is just the icing on the cake.

reviews.name: chan david
reviews.text:
Recommend to have reservation directly with Diora. I was 45 mins late due to the horrific traffic congestion on a rainy day in Bangkok, the Diora team make immediate arrangement for us even though it is almost closing time.
This branch is brand new with onsen decoration that the atmosphere makes you feel like you are in Japan. We had the Jet Lag package and was offered a buy 1 get 1 free promotion. The receptionist is friendly and the massage therapists are really skillful. We had a great time here and would definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Alysper Cormanes
reviews.text:
Best massage I have ever had and worth every penny!
everything was well-placed and intentional to give a wonderful experience. The massage was excellent! The staff are lovely and they offer free transpo service to lumpini MRT station too. Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Patcharaporn Sonsri
reviews.text: Recommend newest Onsen&Spa Sathorn. everything was very good, I got warm welcome and nice service. There are 8 choices of tea for choosing after massage, I would like recommend tea named is “Tie Guen Yin” was very good.

reviews.name: Christopher Rager
reviews.text: This was our first couples spa for me and my wife and it was amazing everything was perfect from the private onsen to the body scrub and massage. We did the energizing of life package and it’s definitely worth the price. We will be coming back again next time we are in Bangkok.

title: Plant Day Spa PloenChit Tower B
ownerDescription: Embraced With Nature, Right at The Heart Of Bangkok
address: 15, Woodberry Common Building B , 2 Floors Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Lynla. P
reviews.text: I got oil aromatherapy massage with massage therapist named Khun Ja. She has the perfect level of massage that I want. I feel sooo comfortable after finishing the session. The location is easy to find, near bts staion with  nice decoration. After the session, they also served very tasty Thai dessert and hot drink that even make it more special.  I will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Jessica Johnson
reviews.text:
Ugh where to begin?! Came for an aromatherapy massage and a body scrub, left with my whole body up in the clouds! The service was great, fantastic hospitality. Their selection of body scrubs is deliciously aromatic (I went with the coffee body scrub but they also had their signature scrub, rice milk, coconut and papaya), as well as their body oil selections (I went for coconut oil but they also had their signature oil (eucalyptus), lemongrass, lavender, a flower and orange concoction, and something else I can’t remember). The masseuse was fantastic, great pressure and asked if I wanted it deeper or softer which is considerate. Thank you for having me, I highly recommend to all as a little treat to yourself 🤍

P.S., you know those lines you get on your body when you’ve had a great nap? I had a few on my face when I woke up, so you know this is good!

P.p.s, my photos don’t do justice for how well designed this place is.

reviews.name: Buphkaree Jankaew
reviews.text:
Luxury Oriental Spa with a calm, warm, and sophisticated atmosphere. The space is beautifully designed, spotless, and incredibly relaxing.

The service is exceptional. Guests are welcomed with a refreshing welcome drink before the treatment, and after the session, homemade dessert and fragrant bael fruit tea are served — a thoughtful touch that makes the experience even more special.

The location is also very convenient. It’s only about a 300-meter walk from BTS Ploenchit, Exit 4. Head into Soi Ruamrudee, and you’ll find it on the left-hand side. The spa is located on the 2nd floor.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Nicole Fonovich
reviews.text: Best Thai massage I ever had! I do deep tissue all the time and this is the only place that was able to actually get to my nuts. Cannot recommended enough.

reviews.name: Liz Cachuela
reviews.text:
Had such a lovely experience at Plant Day Spa. The atmosphere is beautiful, calm, and very relaxing from the moment you walk in. Everything feels thoughtfully designed and well maintained.

The staff were very warm, attentive, and professional, and they made sure I was comfortable throughout the treatment. I had the body scrub and really enjoyed it — the whole experience felt peaceful and unrushed.

It’s such a nice little escape in the middle of Bangkok, and the service really made it feel special. I’d definitely recommend it if you’re looking for a relaxing spa experience around Ploen Chit.

reviews.name: Jeff Chu
reviews.text:
Very pleasant experience.

Very professional therapist.  Feel so relaxed after treatment.  Strongly recommend the ‘Office Symptom’ and ‘Deep Tissue’ treatment.  I’ll certainly come again.

reviews.name: Kim Yick
reviews.text: What a gem in Bangkok. Truly professional service and clean environment. I had aromatherapy and a Thai herbal ball; very relaxing and soothing. Feel recharged!

reviews.name: Charmaine Tan
reviews.text: Had a wonderful Signature Footology Treatment at Plant Day Spa ☺️ A beautiful and relaxing space that is clean and hygenic. The front desk staff and therapists were friendly and provided great service. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: sapphire muller
reviews.text: I came in for a deep tissue and the massage therapist did an excellent job. Everyone who works here is so friendly and the atmosphere is calm and relaxed. I left feeling so much relief.

reviews.name: Phitchaya Artchanapan
reviews.text: Love the visit today, the massage is very relaxing. The environment is also nice and not crowded. Absolutely recommend!

reviews.name: Liyana Soh
reviews.text: Had a FAB Chinese reflexology session here. My masseuse was a young skinny lady but gosh she was strong and could deliver the right strength to the precise right points. The whole experience was so relaxing and top notch, just what I needed after 3 days of shopping! My therapist was Yok. I would totally come back.

reviews.name: Visa Travel Team Phi Phi
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my visit today. I came in without an appointment and was able to book an aromatherapy massage right away. The service was excellent and the surroundings were incredibly beautiful and calming , I felt relaxed the moment I arrived.

The massage itself was amazing, and the staff were extremely friendly and professional throughout. I 100% recommend this place and will definitely be coming back on my next visit.

reviews.name: Laura Selig
reviews.text: Such a great experience! I wasn’t quite sure what to expect worn the yoga massage but I’m leaving feeling all renewed, refreshed and stretched out. I can’t wait to try more services here. Truly one of the nicest spas I’ve ever been to. The welcome and finishing beverage and dessert is a lovely touch as well. Thank you!

reviews.name: Valerie Pinto
reviews.text: My partner and I came to Plant Day Spa and had a luxurious experience together! From the aroma therapy full massage experience with four different varieties of oils, to the delicious snacks & tea before and after - it was simply an awesome experience. Honestly can’t think of anything negative about the place, they even had a shower room inside the massage room 🥹 would like to shout out to our receptionist Ann for her helpful service! 10/10 will recommend and come again

reviews.name: Paul Salloum
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience at Plant Day Spa in Ploenchit Tower B. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and beautifully designed for relaxation. The service was excellent from start to finish.
My masseuse, was outstanding — incredibly professional, attentive, and skillful. She really knew how to apply the perfect pressure and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. It was one of the best massages I’ve ever had, leaving me refreshed, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.
I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for a top-quality massage in Bangkok. I’ll definitely be coming back and asking for deep tissue massage again!

reviews.name: Anna Morgenroth
reviews.text: Beautiful spa, super friendly staff, very welcoming, massage was super relaxing and exactly what we asked for. Would recommend 🥰

reviews.name: angevin
reviews.text:
EDIT: I am amending my review to 4 stars as the business did reach out to me, albeit 4 days later, to apologise and offer me a complimentary oil massage session. I'm no longer in BKK and won't be able to use it but I appreciate the apology and the gesture, although maybe next time it would be better to reply within 24 hours as a lot of customers are probably tourists like me.

---

I booked a 90-minute Aromatherapy Massage and was really looking forward to it, but unfortunately the experience did not fully meet expectations.

During the session, around 10 minutes were spent on room/tool preparation, and another ~10 minutes were used to braid my hair. This was not something I asked for, and the braiding involved quite a lot of pulling, which felt uncomfortable. As a result, I did not feel I received the full value of the 90-minute treatment and left feeling a bit disappointed.
This is one of the more expensive massage options in the area, and given the price point (1900 BHT for 90 mins), I expected the full session time to be dedicated to the massage itself.

One practical note for future visitors: Google Maps currently lists the location as Tower B, but the spa is actually located in Tower A, which may cause confusion when finding the place.

The staff were really nice, but I think clearer boundaries around treatment time and consent would significantly improve the experience.

reviews.name: vanessa chin
reviews.text:
Had a very relaxing 90-minute aromatherapy massage at Plant Day Spa. The overall environment was clean, calming, and peaceful, which made it easy to unwind. The therapist was professional and attentive, and the massage pressure was comfortable throughout.

I liked that the treatment felt soothing without being too rushed, and the aromatherapy added a nice relaxing touch. It was a good balance of relaxation and muscle relief, especially after travelling/walking around. Overall, a pleasant spa experience and good value for a 90-minute session. Would recommend for anyone looking for a relaxing massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Wachi Nualkhao
reviews.text: Having a head, neck, and shoulder massage with P’Nok. I was very impressed with her massage - she was very attentive, knew exactly where to focus and applied just the right amount of pressure. I felt so much more relaxed afterward. She was also very professional and made the whole experience incredibly comfortable. Would definitely come back for another session with p Nok again

reviews.name: oilobster K
reviews.text: Good vibes, nice front staff, and relaxing time. It'a a lovely scrub an daroma massage time.

title: ThaiThai Massage Signature BTS PhromPhong (Sukhumvit 24)
ownerDescription:
Urgent reservation please call 0941232479
Line OA : @thaithaimassage
address: 2, 3-4 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Joycelin Yeo
reviews.text:
Absolutely one of the best foot reflexology experiences I’ve had! Aunty Yao was highly skilled, knew exactly where the tension points were, and applied just the right amount of pressure. It was relaxing, yet I could genuinely feel the knots and soreness melting away.

The environment was clean, comfortable, and peaceful, making it easy to unwind. By the end of the session, my feet felt incredibly light, and I left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. If you’re looking for quality foot reflexology with excellent service, I highly recommend this place. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Edit: I’ve actually been here all 3 days of my trip because it was just that good. I came back for both the foot reflexology and the hot stone body massage, and every session was consistently amazing.

reviews.name: Elamarie Carmel Mission
reviews.text: I got the 3-in-1 massage for 90 minutes (head, kneck, shoulders). I was assigned one of their available masseuses, Khun Teen. She was really kind and accommodating during the service. The atmosphere is very quiet and relaxing for a massage. I definitely recommend

reviews.name: Maddie
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience here! The massage was so relaxing and the staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional from start to finish. Everyone made me feel comfortable and taken care of, and the atmosphere was peaceful and clean. One of the best massages I’ve had — highly recommend if you’re visiting Thailand! Thank you again for such a wonderful experience 💛

reviews.name: Mohammed Havas KV
reviews.text:
Good experience overall, but I felt it was a bit overrated for the price. I opted for the men’s massage and took the 90-minute session. A major portion of the time was spent on the foot massage, while the head and neck areas received comparatively less attention. The service was decent, but I expected a more balanced experience. :)

Nice ambience btw.

reviews.name: ดวงกมล เห็มกอง
reviews.text:
If you've been grinding at work and your back and shoulders are absolutely wrecked — just go to Thaithaimassage, no cap.
The receptionist is super sweet and makes you feel right at home the moment you walk in. The massage therapist is also genuinely kind and the service is chef's kiss.
We booked the Office Syndrome + Herbal Compress combo for 120 mins. The therapist really knows where to press — like, hits all the right spots. You'll literally melt into the table. So relaxing fr.
Also super easy to get there — just hop on the BTS to Phrom Phong station and you're good

reviews.name: Mariam Shenizz Adam
reviews.text: I have an Excellent experience with Thai Thai massage ,  The place very clean and very Professional Therapist , skill full , all the staff very friendly and polite ,  surely this place will be one of my favorite every time when I’m back to Thailand I will visit here again. keep doing good job

reviews.name: Boeing driver
reviews.text: Nice spot for a cheeky massage. I had head, back and foot massage. Male massage therapist was strong which I wanted. Lots of these branches around. Price was competitive for the area.

reviews.name: Sophie James
reviews.text: I had a the signature 5 in 1 massage for 90 mins by a lovely lady called oil. She was able to adapt it to suit any pains or problems that I had. Even though there were lots of others in the room I did not hear them or feel their presence. Fantastic massage I will be back in a few days before I leave!

reviews.name: Mukul Mahajan
reviews.text: Loved the experience and massage. Yar was my  masseuse and she was absolutely brilliant. I informed her about my back injury and took time to massage on the right spots.

reviews.name: piya Neo
reviews.text: I had a one-hour traditional Thai massage and thoroughly enjoyed it. It was incredibly relaxing, and I felt great afterwards. I’ll definitely be back again!

reviews.name: Diana Chee
reviews.text:
Check the timing of your sessions if you redeem your gowabi or other vouchers. Bought a 90 min office syndrome massage on the website but the receptionist wrote the wrong time down and I only got a 60 min massage. (Not the fault of the masseuse if the wrong message was communicated haha) they had good service recovery and offered a 30 min foot massage to make up the time but it delays our dinner plans for the group.

The outlet has many rooms for treatment and other the faint whiff of sewage at the reception area, the rest of the rooms smell ok. Other than the mistake made by reception the rest of the experience was uneventful.

reviews.name: BC C
reviews.text: The place is clean and aesthetically pleasing. The front desk staff were very friendly and full of smiles. The massage was decent and the service was on point. They offer a 20% discount until 6 PM, so it’s quite worth it. I would definitely come back

reviews.name: Chan Charisa
reviews.text:
I had the worst massage experience ever. Usually massages are either average or very good, but this is the first time I was counting down and hoping for it to end the whole time.

I travel a lot around Southeast Asia and get massages quite regularly, so I understand I need to communicate about pressure. Normally I only need to ask “softer” once or twice and the therapist adjusts. But during this 2-hour massage, I had to ask for softer pressure at least 10 times and it was still extremely painful.

At one point, the hot pad placed on my chest was so hot that I screamed and asked her to stop immediately. The entire massage felt rushed and rough instead of relaxing. This was also the first time in my life I wanted to change therapists halfway through, but I didn’t because I felt it might be disrespectful.

Overall, I really did not enjoy the massage at all.

reviews.name: EveC
reviews.text: Saw their shops already and crowded with people. After trying i understand why. Other than the really nice atmosphere the quality of the therapist is very good. Very on the point and ease my tension. The receptionist lady was humorous. I enjoyed her hospitality.

reviews.name: MCM
reviews.text: I had a full traditional Thai body massage with hot herbal compress today, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. The massage was deeply relaxing and very professional. I am especially grateful to the lady who took care of me — her technique, pressure, and attention to detail were excellent. I felt completely refreshed and relieved after the session. Highly recommended, and thank you so much for such a lovely treatment.

reviews.name: Stephanie Cao
reviews.text: My husband and I scheduled in advance through Klook, and chose a location within walking distance from our hotel. The space is beautiful with lots of warm wood tones and macrome. Massage was great, and such a good value. Caveat: you are not guaranteed an appointment just because you reserved through Klook; it's important to speak/text them directly for confirmation. Otherwise, was great and recommend!

reviews.name: samantha wong
reviews.text:
There is only one type of foot massage called “relaxing foot massage “ to choose from. But then when I feedback to the masseur  I need stronger massage as the massage was really below pressure (like her fingers touching my leg instead of massaging). She left and return with the receptionist.
The receptionist told me (in an rude and impatient manner ) that it is called “relaxing foot massage” and if I need more pressure, I need to upgrade to head neck back shoulder massage, even I just need foot massage. I  have no choice but to pay more for the remaining 30 mins in order to make up the first 30 mins “massage”
I have lived in Bangkok for quite some years  and has massage countless times. All these years , I never had this experience and I never know that relax = soft massage or simply touching your legs with oil.
Ok, fool me once , but can’t fool me twice

reviews.name: Natt S.
reviews.text:
Clean.
Nice & Cozy place.
Walking distance from BTS.
Polite and friendly staff.
Private room in every booking.
Reasonable price
They offered 20% discount before 6 pm.

reviews.name: Myra Nimchaiyong
reviews.text: Thai Thai Massage with a very serene aromatic spa setting as you walk in. You’re greeted by friendly receptionist with a massage menu and escorted to a foot scrub before you head into a private room massage with a private shower. I had a 90 minute deep tissue massage and 30 minute herbal wrap completed with a full body stretch after the massage and hot tea. Doueng was great and applied deep pressure to my sore muscles from lifting and I left feeling extremely relaxed. Will definitely return as it is convenient to all shops and Thailand’s CBD.

reviews.name: Nan Khin Oo
reviews.text: I am very satisfied with this place, I will definitely come to this massage parlor every time I come to Thailand. 💆‍♀️ 💆‍♀️💆‍♀️💆‍♀️💆‍♀️👍👍👍

title: P's Thai Massage 3
ownerDescription: Traditional Original Thai Massage.
address: 92 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: jane lee
reviews.text:
Nice massage. Worth for money.
400 Thai bath for 60min massage.

Masseuse - Chair know which area to use more strength n focus. All lot of technique she can create the "crack" moments without pain.

This thai massage include some head, neck, shoulder, chest massage. Where u lying on her knee... She massage accordingly...

I definitely will come again on my next business trip.. Just locate next to JW Marriot.. (Hotel pastry cafe exit turn right, in front on weed)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jane Lee,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your Thai massage and found it to be great value for money. It’s wonderful to know that the treatment was tailored to your needs and left you feeling satisfied.

We truly appreciate your kind recommendation and are very happy to hear that you plan to visit us again on your next business trip. We look forward to welcoming you back soon 😊

reviews.name: Darshana Makaju
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Bangkok! P Massage Centre in the Sukhumvit area is very professional, clean, and relaxing. The masseur clearly knows exactly what they’re doing and worked perfectly on all the right pressure points. Highly recommend if you’re in the area. Will definitely come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Darshana Makaju,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you had such a great massage experience and appreciated the professionalism, cleanliness, and relaxing atmosphere. Your kind recommendation truly means a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit 😊

reviews.name: G.J L
reviews.text: Excellent deep tissue Thai oil massage of 'Ann 35'. Best massage in Thailand so far. And I had many. Most masseuse can do good relax massage. Not so many can do good, deep tissue massage. Clean and neat massage salon. Very friendly and helpful staf.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear G.J L,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the deep tissue Thai oil massage with Ann and that it was the best you’ve had in Thailand so far. Your recognition of her technique and professionalism means a lot to us. We’re also happy you appreciated our cleanliness and friendly team. We hope to welcome you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Frrr Pen
reviews.text: The place was ok however the massage is not that good. The masseuse was being touchy in uneeded places and she even revealed my private parts many times by removing the towels completely. The oil massage itself felt boring and it did not hit the correct spots
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We're sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. We take comments regarding guest comfort and privacy very seriously and will review your feedback with our team.

Regarding the massage itself, we would like to point out that an oil massage and a traditional Thai massage are two very different treatments. An oil massage is primarily designed for relaxation with gentle techniques, while a traditional Thai massage focuses on deeper pressure and stretching to relieve muscle tension. Guests seeking a stronger therapeutic treatment often find that a Thai massage is the more suitable option.

We appreciate your feedback and will continue working to provide the best possible experience for all of our guests.

reviews.name: Kiran Rama
reviews.text:
My husband and I popped into this place in the neighborhood and they know their stuff! Clean, smells nice, perfect authentic Thai massage. You can discuss pressure with them also. KHEM was amazing and so kind!
Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Kiran Rama,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you and your husband enjoyed the authentic Thai massage and appreciated the clean and relaxing environment. It’s great to know that the pressure was well adjusted to your preference. Your kind recommendation truly means a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Amrita
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience receiving a massage from Rita recently. She was pleasant, gentle and kind and made me feel at ease and relaxed. I look forward to hopefully having the chance of receiving a massage from her again next time I’m in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Amrita,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing and comfortable experience. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team, and we’re very happy you felt at ease during your visit. We look forward to welcoming you again on your next trip to Bangkok 😊

reviews.name: Juree Butsri
reviews.text: “I had a wonderful experience here with AU. The staff were very friendly and professional, and the atmosphere was relaxing and welcoming. The massage was excellent – it really helped relieve my tension and made me feel refreshed. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage.”
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Juree Butsri, thank you very much for your comment, and five stars recommend, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Gajanan Wankhede
reviews.text: I recently visited the massage center and had the best experience of my life. They are highly professional. Especially June. If possible I wish to visit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Gajanan,

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!

We are truly delighted to hear that you had such an exceptional experience with us. It means a great deal to know that you found our team professional and that your visit was so memorable.

Thank you again for your kind words and support. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: MsOmNom
reviews.text:
Great place for a quick foot massage if you just want something fast and easy from all the hustle and bustle of the noisy streets and crowds.

Note that for foot massage, they wash your feet at a tiny wash area in the corner of the store just enough for 2 people at most.

Don’t expect luxury type experience like Let’s Relax given the much more economical price!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: DearMsOmNom, thank you for your comment, and four stars recommend, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Dominic
reviews.text: I had probably one of the best massages in Thailand here. Ask for Num, no 3. She is very skilfull, highly professional, and gave an excellent massage. It's rare that I recommend a massage place, but this was excellent. I can't comment on the others working here, yet Num was very good. You won't be disappointed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Dominic, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Max
reviews.text:
P's Thai Massage 3 earns a solid 4-star rating, offering excellent massage services with one notable limitation.

The quality of the massage itself is outstanding, with skilled practitioners delivering effective and therapeutic treatments. The level of expertise demonstrated suggests well-trained staff who understand various massage techniques and can adapt to individual needs.

However, the lack of shower facilities after the massage is a significant drawback. Post-massage shower access is a common amenity in many Thai massage establishments, as it allows clients to refresh themselves after their treatment, particularly important in Bangkok's warm climate.

Despite this limitation, the high quality of the massage work itself maintains the establishment's appeal. The core service - the massage - meets professional standards and provides the therapeutic benefits customers seek.

While the absence of shower facilities prevents P's Thai Massage 3 from earning a perfect score, the excellence of their massage services still makes it a worthwhile choice for those seeking quality therapeutic treatments, provided they're comfortable with the lack of post-massage shower facilities.

For customers who prioritize massage quality over additional amenities, P's Thai Massage 3 remains a strong option in the area.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Maximilian Mende, thank you very much for your comment and the four-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

However, I don't understand your criticism. The shower room is on the third floor. Perhaps it was just a communication error, but of course I have to provide a shower, that's the regulation.

reviews.name: Mohd Zulkarnain Mohd Zulkefli
reviews.text: I had foot + head and shoulder massage for 1 hour (400 THB). I was great and the therapist easily find the pain spot on my feet and made it away! Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Mohd Zulkarnain Mohd Zulkefli, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Onkar Malani
reviews.text:
Genuine massage service. The setup is a bit cramped but adequate. It's near buzzing places so expect it to be more than half full most of the times.

I opted for a traditional Thai massage which was done well. The pressure was adjusted higher after I gave feedback to the masseur. Pretty good service at a reasonable price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Onkar Malani, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Vik Zeng
reviews.text: Honestly, I never had to stop a full body massage before but i had to stop 30mins in though I paid for a 60 min oil balm massage. The reviews looked good. And the responses to reviews were convincing. sadly quite disappointing. Skill and technique of the massage wasn't great. Barely felt the massage. I did ask her to use more strength but consistency wasn't there. No strength and really no technique cause she couldn't apply pressure where the main muscle areas are. Prob good f beginners who prefer light massages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
(Übersetzt von Google) Lieber Vik Zeng, wenn du den Unterschied zwischen einer Öl- und einer Thai-Massage nicht verstehst, ist diese Rezension von dir leider sinnlos.

„Ölmassage ist das Reiben und Kneten von Muskeln und Gelenken des Körpers mit Massageölen, um Verspannungen oder Schmerzen zu lindern. Dies ist eine sehr beliebte Massagetechnik, die auf der ganzen Welt eingesetzt wird. Ölmassagen können sehr entspannend sein und sind sanfter als traditionelle Thai-Massagen massieren.“

Sie hören nach 30 Minuten auf, weil Sie das bekommen haben, wofür Sie bezahlt haben, und beschweren sich dann ernsthaft darüber?

(Original)
Dear Vik Zeng, if you don't understand the difference between an oil and a Thai massage, this review of yours is unfortunately pointless.

"Oil massage is the rubbing and kneading of muscles and joints of the body using massage oils to relieve tension or pain. This is a very popular massaging technique used all over the world. Oil massages can be very relaxing and are more gentle than traditional Thai massaging."

You stop after 30 minutes because you got what you paid for and then complain about it, seriously?

So and after my answer you change your 3 stars to 1 star, that shows once again that you can dish it out on the internet but can't handle the answer, just sad, you should be ashamed of yourself.

reviews.name: Brooke
reviews.text: I've lived in Bangkok for almost 2 yrs now and have been to many massage places but I always find myself coming back to P's massage at this location. I always request "Chair" #44. She's Amazing!!! She is strong and knows exactly what's she's doing!!  Foot massages are absolutely heavenly and I always walk out feeling like a new woman. Call ahead and ask for Chair #44!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Brooke Noriega, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Lait au Meow
reviews.text: I did a 60 mins thai herbal balm massage and boyfriend did a traditional thai. We both enjoyed it, and coming from my boy, it's saying a lot. It's a no-nonsense massage place - they just provide what you see in the menu, which should be the case for every massage parlour. My masseuse was really caring - she turned off the fan when she heard my blocked nose. Hopefully they maintain this standard and we will definitely love to come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear L Freya, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: K
reviews.text:
Had the head, neck and shoulder massage for 60 mins, masseuse was skilful and could pinpoint the areas to ease the knots. Excellent massage at a very reasonable price. Would return and recommend to anyone looking for a good and affordable massage.
Do not expect a luxury experience, definitely a massage and go kind of place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear K, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Christina
reviews.text: Really great for the price. I would say that a lot of the Thai masseuse whether it at affordable or luxury places all have the same skill set. So, coming to P’s is really affordable! I tried Thai massage, foot and shoulder/neck. Great service and enjoyed the massage experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Christina, thank you for your comment, and four stars recommend, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Miriam KC
reviews.text: Great massage place; convenient location from my hotel. Great ambiance.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Miriam KC,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re happy to hear that you enjoyed the convenient location and the ambiance of our place. Your kind feedback truly means a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Hieu Tran (AznMadness)
reviews.text: Got a 1 hr foot massage here since it was closest to the hotel we were staying at (Double Tree Phloenchit). After a long day of walking everywhere ending up here for a foot massage was exactly what my wife and I needed. The masseuse applied enough pressure on all parts of the leg and foot for us to close our eyes in relaxation. The 5 minute back massage at the end was a nice add, though they could have used a little less pressure. Overall experience was still great and I would come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Hieu Tran (AznMadness), thank you very much for your comment, and five stars recommend, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

We came here every day for different massages (food massage 180 THB|1/2 h, Thaimassage 300 THB|1 h, hot oil massage 450 THB|1 h and oil massage 400 THB|1 h) which we all enjoyed. reviews.name: Shea
reviews.text: Mod did a great job on my pedicure❤️he got the touch callouses and pressure points just right! Get the pedicure package. Also Tukta did amazing on my nails! She took her time took care of my cuticles , and did exactly as I wanted. I will definitely go back on my next visit
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Mariah Price
reviews.text: Service was extremely friendly. It was 1400 baht for a gel manicure and pedicure. The same polish was used on both my hands and feet, the manicure is amazing but sadly my pedicure started chipping not even 5 hours later, this was very disappointing as I did not have the time to get them re done for the rest of the trip. I’m assuming it was not cured properly.

reviews.name: Johann Quadros
reviews.text: Samsen Massage Bangkok offers a clean space but a very average massage center. We took a foot massage and the therapists did a mediocre job. They press a particular point a couple of times and immediately change to running the hands along the full leg upto the knee. So you just begin to feel relaxation and its gone in a split second. Even the oil they application is not gentle. They rub oil as if they're mopping the floor. The lady at the counter insists to make the payment first. Initially she sounded rude but later when we were leaving she was sweet. The massage offers a water cup post the massage and local bananas. Overall I wouldn't recommend this place for a massage if you're looking for a relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Uriah Tenae
reviews.text: The owner of this salon actively targets travelers to pocket extra money. She completely changes the set menu prices once it is time to pay, quoting 350-400 Baht for a simple 150 Baht removal. Even after breaking down the math and exposing her hustle, she still overcharged me 1,050 Baht. Worse yet, the technical work is incredibly sloppy. I spent 3 hours in a chair for a basic fill that is full of trapped air bubbles and a bumpy, uneven top coat. Totally dishonest management and low-quality work.

reviews.name: Katrien Ackx
reviews.text: I've been coming to this place for a long time, every time I'm in the khaosan area and here's the deal: the massages are decent, I'm sure you can get better ones but they're perfectly fine. Come here for nails or Pedi and you won't be disappointed! Honestly, I've done so many pedicures all over Thailand and Asia and this is the only one where they use callus shaver (with blade) instead of just a pumice stone. This is the place to go for smooth feet!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏😊

reviews.name: Madison Keto
reviews.text: love!! only 400 baht to remove my old gel nails & get this new sparkly night blue set! cheapest nail shop in the area and a very friendly nail tech. the area has so many stalls and cafes too for a walk about in the morning! ✨💙🫐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Mathis Verleyen
reviews.text: At first a bit weird when you come in and every employee stares at you. But nice people and amazing massage. We had a duo Thai massage for 1 hour and it felt like 5 minutes. I really recommend this place!

reviews.name: Jessica Matelska

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot☺️

reviews.name: John Dahill
reviews.text: Enjoyed one of the best massages ever at this location! Attractive comfortable clean professional and reasonably priced experience. Very convenient location and no wait. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Manu F.
reviews.text:
After several foot massages and neck, shoulder, and back massages, I can say: I am amazed!

Overall, it is very clean. The chairs for the foot massages are super comfortable (I would have loved to take the pillows home with me). Only once was the mattress sheet not quite as clean. But that was a one-off.

Everyone is very friendly and funny. Even though communication is sometimes complicated (probably due to my poor English), they always knew what I wanted.

The atmosphere there is very calm and relaxed. Many guests fall asleep during their massages.

Since the massages, I feel great and am walking more upright and straight again.

I also think the prices are absolutely fine.

I felt completely at home there.

Unfortunately, I wasn't allowed to take anyone back to Germany with me. That I found a bit of a shame.

reviews.name: Aysha Begum
reviews.text: They will put white men before any woman. I waited for 30min for a pedicure and a white man walked in and the owner dragged him in and said that he had made an appointment hours ago. He did not want a pedicure, he was enquiring about massages. Terrible culture

reviews.name: Rapolas Saulius
reviews.text: Really average massage place. Got a full body 1 hour massage and it was just meh. My friend got her nails done and it was done with minimum sterile equipment. Would skip this place.

reviews.name: Emile LEFEBVRE
reviews.text:
Great professional massage !
Probably top 2 out of the 5 we did in Bangkok.
Really kind lady.

reviews.name: A McS
reviews.text: Wouldn’t recommend for nails. Mine were wonky and my nails were different shapes. I will need to spend more money having them done again. Staff were nice and the atmosphere seemed nice though.

reviews.name: Esmée
reviews.text:
I paid for the Spa Pedicure here, which my interpretation included a foot/lower leg massage. I chose to pay for the more premium treatment for this reason, and disappointingly this was not the case.

Whilst the nail tech was polite and gentle, the exfoliant they used on my legs burnt, and has left red dots all over my legs.

When they used the pumice stone on my feet, they hardly rubbed away the harder skin on my big toes and they are still rough. Obviously, I do not expect them to be able to make them baby soft again, but the work and effort they made I found unsatisfactory.

Then the polish on my big toes was uneven, and although they fixed them, they sat a fan in front of me for 25 minutes to dry the nails even though I was unbearably cold.

Overall, I am very disappointed with my experience and I would advise patronage elsewhere for premium pedicures.

I paid ฿600.

reviews.name: Musti
reviews.text:
Tried a pedicure here 4 years ago and it was amazing , I didn't leave a review back then.

Today I returned to Thailand again and returned here and services was just as good as 4 years ago.

300 baht for a pedicure if anyone is wondering

reviews.name: Mathilde S (Msznz)

reviews.name: Denise Stevens

reviews.name: Milan Willms

reviews.name: Tasha (AutismFamilyTravelGuide)
reviews.text:
First Impressions & Ambience 💆‍♀️

Walking in, you’d probably notice:

A slightly antique / characterful décor — darker woods, vintage touches, more “old-style spa” than sleek minimalism. (Part of what gives it charm).

Soft lighting, quiet music, subtle scent (maybe herbal / essential oils) to help you ease into relaxation. Overall, it is lovely and quiet, very peaceful inside.

Cleanliness is good — the reception and common areas feel maintained and their effort toward cleanliness is evident right away - they'll have you change your dirty shoes and they wash your feet for you. You are given a pain of clean slide-on shoes to use during your visit.

The Treatment & Therapist Interaction...

One therapist approached me outside while I looked at the "menu" of massages available. I am glad she did because I couldn't quite determine what it was I needed or wanted, but she helped me decide hy asking some helpful questions and recognising my pain and what needed done.

During the massage:

The therapist is good at her job, that is for sure. Although we had a language barrier she was able to see my problem areas and worked hard to relieve my pain for me. She knew enough English to ask permission to move to other areas of my body and check that I was okay (she must have recognised that my back is very painful and that her work would cause discomfort while it was being touched).

You’ll feel a mix of deep pressure and stretching — the classic Thai / therapeutic style, pushing knots, elongating tight muscles. If you are lucky, like me, they will even help you to "pop" your back. What a releif!

There might be moments where it gets intense — but as expected, a good therapist will check with you or sense when to ease up.

Aftercare & wrap up:

After the massage, I was given privacy, space and time to get dressed and make my way back to the main room of the massage parlour. I was greeted with a seat and a warm tea to enjoy before I left.

For a couple of days, my muscles were tender and I enjoyed time in a warm bath to help soothe them. I was able to straighten my back and neck more - a huge achievement because I suffer with painful kyphosis which usually leaves me hunched over and in pain.
