The boutique hotel is beautiful and charming and immerses you in the Thai experience!

The spa is fabulous! Amazing welcome staff and brilliant massage therapists.  Some of the best massages we’ve ever had. We will keep coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted you enjoyed both our boutique hotel and spa. Your kind words mean the world to our team, and we're honored to be one of the best massage experiences you've had. We can't wait to welcome you back to Rachamaya again soon!

reviews.name: Sabine Allgäuer
reviews.text:
I had a deep clean & cryo cooling facial with Sara, and it was an amazing experience. The treatment was both relaxing and refreshing.

Sara was kind, professional, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived until the end of the treatment. I really enjoyed the experience and will definitely come back. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review! We're delighted you enjoyed your facial with Sara. She'll be so happy to hear your lovely feedback. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back to Rachamaya Retreat soon!

reviews.name: Nilesh
reviews.text: This spa is really great. The ambience, presence, customer friendly staff with a welcome tender coconut water presentation drink and end drink with hi tea jasmine tea. The massage is really a skilled masseuse. The receptionist Mimi was really awesome and customer friendly. Thanks and worth for money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review. We’re very happy you enjoyed the atmosphere, welcome coconut drink, tea service, and massage experience with us. Mimi and our team will be so happy to hear your lovely words. Hope to welcome you back again soon.

reviews.name: Actress Lonnie Grant
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Rachamaya Retreat Massage & Spa in Chiang Mai. I treated myself to the 24K Gold Radiance Facial, and from the moment I walked in, everything felt luxurious, relaxing, and welcoming. The atmosphere was beautiful, peaceful, and the perfect place to unwind. The facial itself left my skin feeling refreshed, glowing, and incredibly soft.

What truly made this experience special was the staff. Everyone was kind, attentive, professional, and genuinely cared about making sure I was comfortable throughout my visit. Their attention to detail and warm hospitality made me feel pampered from start to finish.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your 24K Gold Radiance Facial and found your experience relaxing, luxurious, and rejuvenating.

Your kind words about our team mean a great deal to us. Providing attentive service, personalized care, and a peaceful spa environment is at the heart of what we do at Rachamaya Retreat Massage & Spa. We’re especially pleased that you felt welcomed and pampered throughout your visit.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back for another facial or spa experience in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Pamela Velazco
reviews.text: The massage was incredible! They ask you for exactly what you need and very kindly follow. I did the full body massage and facial which was top notch. They made my day better before my long haul flight! Thanks for the kind staff. Their English is perfect and they accept credit card for a small extra fee.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed both your full body massage and facial at Rachamaya Retreat Massage & Spa. Our team always strives to provide personalized treatments tailored to each guest’s needs, so it’s rewarding to know we helped you relax before your long-haul flight. Thank you for your kind words about our staff, and we hope to welcome you back for another spa experience in Chiang Mai soon.

reviews.name: Thomas Kent
reviews.text: Really a five star experience! Couldn’t find any other place in the area with this many good reviews so I decided to give this a try. I did a body scrub, back and shoulder massage, aroma oil massage and a facial package. It was nothing short of spectacular. I would recommend this place a million times over. Everything can be tailored to you, and it’s so easy to let your therapist know what you would like/dislike. No anxieties with the experience (if you are shy like me)! Aoh was my massage therapist and she was excellent. Even though the service was around 3 hours, her massages remained consistent in strength and she had the most gentle hands yet the perfect pressure one could ask for in a massage! Pretty affordable too compared to other places, another place nearby charged us more for one person (with the same services) than both of our packages combined at Rachamaya. I highly recommend this place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful and detailed review! We’re truly delighted to hear that you had a five-star experience with us and enjoyed your Body Scrub, Back & Shoulder Massage, Aromatherapy Oil Massage, and Facial package.

We’re especially happy to hear that Aoh made you feel comfortable throughout your treatment and was able to tailor the massage perfectly to your preferences. We’ll be sure to share your lovely compliments with her — she will be so happy to hear them!

Creating a relaxing, comfortable experience where every guest feels at ease is very important to us, so your kind words mean a great deal to our entire team.

Thank you again for your amazing recommendation and for choosing Rachamaya Retreat. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again whenever you’re in Chiang Mai! ❤️

reviews.name: Andrei Dumitrescu
reviews.text: Amazing experience. I have came twice in my 3 day vacation in Chiang Mai. I feel like a new-born after massage. Everyone is so welcoming. I strongly recommend this experience. The back massage is amazing. My muscles now are so soft and I feel no pain at all. And the tea at the end… so tasty
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words. We’re very happy you enjoyed the massage and felt refreshed. Hope to see you again in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Jason Cartmell
reviews.text: I just enjoyed the most wonderful facial and Thai massage. It’s was professional, thoughtful and absolutely serene. I just loved it. My skin feels so hydrated & clean. Fah was my therapist and I highly recommend her. Attention to detail was wonderful. Thank you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review, Jason! We're delighted you enjoyed your facial and Thai massage with Fah. She'll be so happy to hear your compliments. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back to Rachamaya Retreat soon!

reviews.name: Nina G
reviews.text: I’m so glad we found this place. I had the back and shoulder massage with herbal balm and it was AMAZING!! The masseuse was very caring, gentle and put her heart into making sure she got all the knots in my shoulder and back. One of my wrists popped quite a few times and she immediately investigated the root cause and reinforced that elbow area for me. I felt so much more relaxed after the massage. The house is very well decorated, neat and tranquil. Location is easy to find and right in the middle of old city.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your detailed review. We’re so happy you felt the care and attention from our therapist. It means a lot that you enjoyed both the massage and the atmosphere. Hope to welcome you back to Rachamaya Retreat again soon.

reviews.name: Hengxin Services
reviews.text: Lovely experience doing the Guasha Facial. The staff here are super accommodating, they have warm beds, and steam machine (to open up the pores). With this experience, they also give you a neck mask, hand mask, and massage for your hands, neck and shoulder. Such a relaxing and wondering experience, I’ll definitely come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Lovely experience doing the Guasha Facial. The staff here are super accommodating, they have warm beds, and steam machine (to open up the pores). With this experience, they also give you a neck mask, hand mask, and massage for your hands, neck and shoulder. Such a relaxing and wondering experience, I’ll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Sagi Balahsan
reviews.text:
We came to the hotel and spa by complete chance, and we are so lucky we did! The place smells like a spa, there is nice relaxing music, the room is clean and cozy, the water is hot, and the bed is very comfortable ❤️

We are celebrating our honeymoon, and the staff prepared a surprise for us. Everyone was so sweet.

Then we decided to enjoy the spa, how could we not, when it is right next to the room? We had a couple’s Thai massage, and it was relaxing and so, so good.

We highly recommend coming here for a stay, or at least for the spa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review and congratulations on your honeymoon! We’re honored to be part of your special time and hope to welcome you back again.

reviews.name: Aomam
reviews.text: Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ "I am absolutely in love with this Rachamaya hot compress! The herbal scent is incredibly authentic and soothing—it immediately turns my living room into a spa. It holds heat much longer than other compresses I’ve tried, and the weight of it provides a deep, penetrating relief for my sore shoulders. It’s become my go-to ritual after a long day at the desk. Highly recommend for anyone needing some serious self-care!"
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review. We’re truly happy to hear that our Rachamaya hot compress has become part of your self-care routine and brings a spa-like feeling to your home. Your kind support means a lot to us, and we hope to continue taking care of you for many more relaxing moments ahead.

reviews.name: Brittany Wingham
reviews.text:
I just finished the 990 Baht package for a 90 minute deep cleansing facial and back and shoulder massage and it was amazing!

The building looked beautiful and there were so many options to choose from, I had to ask the girl at reception (Earn) to help me decide.

She was lovely and spoke great English which really helped. My therapist was also really professional, and kindly spent time on all the right areas I needed it!

A girl passed me on my way out and said “wow your skin is glowing, did you have a facial?!” 😂😘

I recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! It made us smile to hear someone noticed your glowing skin on the way out. 😊 We'll be sure to share your kind words with Earn and our therapist. We hope to welcome you back to Rachamaya Retreat again soon!

reviews.name: Miyu
reviews.text:
Did a quick 60-minute foot and body massage upon landing in Chiang Mai and I did not regret it, and will definitely be back for more. Massage service was great for someone who works out alot.
Staff were lovely and friendly as well. They also serve coconut juice before getting to the massage treatment, tea and biscuits after the massage.
Definitely a memorable experience for me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your thoughtful review.
We’re delighted to hear that your massage experience at Rachamaya Retreat Massage & Spa was relaxing and memorable. It’s wonderful to know you enjoyed our service, refreshments, and friendly team. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: Cristina Eickhoff de Oliveira
reviews.text: Amazing ! Both myself and my husband loved everything here, our best massage and facial treatment in Thailand ! Thank you so much Nana ! And the gorl at the reception ! So good !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review. We’re truly happy to hear both you and your husband enjoyed the massage and facial treatment with us. Nana and our reception team will be so happy to hear your kind words. Hope to welcome you both back again soon :)

reviews.name: Micl
reviews.text: We have visited quiet a view massage places all over Thailand from Koh Samui to Bangkok to Chiangmai. This retreat deserves the name and all credit it got so far. We had a two hour massage and I never felt this relieved after any of the massages I got so far. We got both a hearty welcome and a treatment first class from our amazing masseuses if you want the best result, skip the other places and just come here but please leave a spot for us.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your heartfelt and thoughtful review. We’re truly honored that, after visiting many places across Thailand, you found Rachamaya Retreat, a boutique spa sanctuary in Chiang Mai Old Town, so memorable. It’s wonderful to know that your two-hour treatment brought real relief and relaxation. Our therapists will be delighted to hear your kind words. We sincerely appreciate your trust and hope to welcome you again soon — we’ll be sure to keep a spot for you.

reviews.name: kate Hunt
reviews.text: "My husband and I had an absolutely incredible experience at Rajamaya. We opted for the 4-Hand Oil & Hydra facial Massage, and it was pure bliss! The skill and synchronization of the therapists were top-notch. What’s even more amazing is how quiet and peaceful the place is—you’ll completely forget that you’re right in the middle of a bustling city. It’s the perfect sanctuary for couples looking to unwind."
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your beautiful review. We’re truly happy you and your husband enjoyed the 4-Hand Oil & Hydra Facial Massage and felt the calm, peaceful atmosphere we aim to create. It means a lot to us that Rachamaya could be a little sanctuary for you both. We look forward to welcoming you back again.

reviews.name: Aurane Quignon
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with both the massage and the facial treatment here. The facial, especially with the machine, left my skin looking fresher, brighter, and genuinely more youthful. I could really see and feel the difference afterward, which made the whole treatment feel even more worthwhile. The massage was also excellent, very relaxing, skillful, and exactly what I needed.
The atmosphere was super pleasant from start to finish. The place is lovely, clean, and welcoming, which immediately made me feel comfortable. The staff were absolutely amazing: warm, professional, attentive, and genuinely kind. They made sure everything was done with care, and you can tell they really know what they are doing.
Overall, this is a fantastic place if you want a relaxing treatment and real results. I left feeling refreshed and very happy with the experience. I would definitely come back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great massage and facial treatment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review. We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed both your massage and facial experience with us. It means so much to know you could see and feel the results after the facial treatment, especially the fresh, bright, and youthful glow.

We’re also very happy that our relaxing atmosphere, cleanliness, and warm hospitality helped make your visit even more special. Your kind words about our attentive and caring team truly mean the world to us.

Thank you again for your recommendation, and we would be honored to welcome you back to Rachamaya Retreat
 whenever you return to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Kristian Browning
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! The aloe vera facial and massage were both amazing. The building is beautiful, the staff are kind and welcoming, and the treatments are top quality. Everything felt relaxing and professional. I highly recommend this spa and would definitely return!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted you enjoyed your facial and massage. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we truly appreciate your recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back to Rachamaya Retreat soon!

reviews.name: Alex Linville
reviews.text: The massage was great!!! Me and my mom had an amazing time!!! The herbals and oils were some of the highest quality. The herbals in the compress was amazing and smell so good!!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're so happy you and your mom had such a great experience with us. It means a lot to hear you enjoyed the herbal compress and our oils. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you both back to Rachamaya Retreat again soon!

reviews.name: Kamonwan Srikittichai
reviews.text:
This clinic offers excellent care for scoliosis, with a professional yet welcoming environment. The staff are knowledgeable, supportive, and attentive, always taking the time to explain treatment clearly.

I especially appreciate their use of Pilates-based exercises tailored for scoliosis, which not only help improve posture but also strengthen the body in a safe and effective way. Their personalized approach ensures each patient receives the right guidance and care. It’s clear they are dedicated to helping patients feel better and live healthier.

I highly recommend this clinic for scoliosis treatment and Pilates programs.

reviews.name: Pamai S
reviews.text:
I came here because I was having a one-sided headache related to neck muscle strain, and my symptoms improved by around 80% after just the second treatment. Really impressed with the quality of the clinic, clean, professional, beautifully decorated, and honestly quite hard to find this standard around Salaya. I would normally expect this kind of experience around Sukhumvit. The treatment rooms are very nice and even the treatment clothes they provide are comfortable and cute compared with the usual hospital-style ones.

I also love the follow-up via LINE, especially having the exercise videos sent directly there after treatment - very convenient and great CRM/customer care.

A couple of things to be aware of: the price is on the higher side, so I recommend checking with their LINE OA beforehand. The clinic is also next to a big road, so you can occasionally feel the building shake when a large truck passes and parking right in front can be a little challenging if you’re not a confident driver.

Overall, though, I’ve had a very good experience here.

reviews.name: Chompunuch H.
reviews.text: ได้มาลองใช้บริการ Hybrid Program ที่นี่ ประทับใจมากกกๆๆ 🌟 เป็นโปรแกรมที่มีการผสมผสานระหว่าง กายภาพบำบัดกับพิลาทีส ทำให้ได้ทั้งการฟื้นฟู ร่างกายและการออกกำลังกายที่เหมาะกับปัญหาของ เรา พี่ๆเจ้าหน้าที่ที่นี่ทุกคนดูแลดีมากกกกกๆ ใส่ใจ รายละเอียด และปรับโปรแกรมให้เหมาะกับแต่ละคน แถมสถานที่สะอาด บรรยากาศดี(มีที่จอดรถ) แนะนำเลยสำหรับคนที่มีอาการปวดเมื่อยหรืออยากฟื้นฟู ร่างกายอย่างถูกวิธี 🩷
reviews.textTranslated: I tried the Hybrid Program here and was very impressed! 🌟 It's a program that combines physiotherapy and Pilates, providing both physical rehabilitation and exercise tailored to my specific needs. The staff here are all incredibly caring, attentive to detail, and customize the program for each individual. Plus, the place is clean, has a great atmosphere (and parking is available). I highly recommend it for anyone experiencing aches and pains or wanting to recover properly. 🩷

reviews.text: นวดอโรม่าสบายตัวมากค่ะ บรรยากาศดีมาก เห็นเป็นตึกแถวก็จริง แต่เข้ามาบรรยากาศเหมือนอยู่ในธรรมชาติมากๆ โฮมมี่เป็นกันเอง แถมเลือกทุกอย่างตามความต้องการตั้งแต่แรก บริการนวดดีมากค่ะ ❤️🫰🏻
reviews.textTranslated: The aromatherapy massage was so relaxing! The atmosphere was wonderful. Although it's a shophouse, once inside it feels like being in nature. It's very homey and friendly, and they cater to your every need from the start. The massage service was excellent. ❤️🫰🏻

reviews.name: สุจิตรา ลีเลิศสุมานนท์
reviews.text: "ประทับใจมากค่ะ/ครับ มาลองเล่นพิลาทิสครั้งแรกที่นี่ เป็นคลาสไพรเวทกับครูสิน ตัวคลินิกสะอาด บรรยากาศดีและผ่อนคลายมาก เนื่องจากที่นี่เป็นคลินิกกายภาพบำบัดด้วย ก่อนเริ่มครูเลยช่วยประเมินโครงสร้างกระดูกและเช็กจุดที่มีปัญหาอย่างละเอียด ทำให้ตอนเล่นบนเครื่อง Reformer รู้สึกเซฟและมั่นใจมาก ครูสอนเข้าใจง่าย คอยปรับท่าทางให้ถูกต้องตลอดเวลา หลังเล่นเสร็จคือตัวโล่ง เบาสบาย อาการตึงที่หลังดีขึ้นทันตาเลย ใครอยากเล่นพิลาทิสที่ดูแลโดยผู้เชี่ยวชาญ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: "I was very impressed! I tried Pilates for the first time here, in a private class with Instructor Sin. The clinic is clean, and the atmosphere is very relaxing. Since it's also a physical therapy clinic, the instructor carefully assessed my bone structure and checked for any problems before starting. This made me feel safe and confident while using the Reformer. The instructor explained things clearly and constantly adjusted my posture to ensure it was correct. After the class, I felt light and refreshed, and the tension in my back improved immediately. If you want to try Pilates under the care of an expert, I highly recommend this place!"

reviews.name: Passaranant Chaowthanathanyaboon
reviews.text: วันนี้มาตรวจเช็ค และทำกายภาพ ร่วมกับการทำพิลาทิส จะบอกว่ารู้สึกดีมาก คลีนิกบรรยากาศอบอุ่น มีดนตรีเบาๆ ช่วยบำบัดอารมณ์ เจ้าหน้าที่กายภาพให้คำแนะนำดีมาก ครูสอนพิลาทิสน่ารักให้ข้อมูล ดูแลดีแบบตัวต่อตัว เจ้าหน้าที่ยิ้มแย้มให้บริการดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Today I came for a check-up and physical therapy combined with Pilates. I have to say, I feel great. The clinic has a warm atmosphere with soft music that helps with mood. The physical therapy staff gave excellent advice. The Pilates instructor was lovely, provided information, and gave good, one-on-one care. The staff were all smiling and provided great service.

reviews.name: Nidchapat Lekchupon
reviews.text: บรรยากาศดีมากๆ การบริการดีเยี่ยม ตั้งแต่การปรึกษาคุณหมอ และการแนะนำบริการ พอมาใช้บริการจริง ดีทุกอย่าง / ทำอัลตาซาวบำบัด ดีขึ้นตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก / นวดRelax ดีมาก พี่นิดนวดตรงจุด นวดเส้นเก่ง overall experience ให้ 10/10 เลยค่ะ มีfollow up ถามอาการ & Reminds 😄👍🙏ชอบมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere was great, and the service was excellent, from the consultation with the doctor and the service recommendations to the actual experience. Everything was great. The ultrasound therapy showed improvement from the first session. The relaxation massage was fantastic; the masseuse, P'Nid, was very skilled at targeting pressure points and key muscles. Overall, I give the experience a 10/10. They also followed up to ask about my condition and gave reminders. 😄👍🙏 I loved it!

reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time trying Pilates. The clinic was clean, and I felt very relaxed as soon as I entered. The staff were friendly, and the instructor gave great guidance. The equipment is modern. I will definitely come back again. 🩷

reviews.name: Lucky Everytime
reviews.text: สถานที่ดีมาก เหมือนมาเที่ยวคาเฟ่ มีห้องปรึกษาแบบส่วนตัวก่อนการรักษา ถ้าคุณมีเงินเหลือเฟือ ที่นี่จะเป็นที่ที่ตอบโจทก์มาก เพราะด้วยสถานที่และการดูแลต่างๆ …เรามาด้วยอาการรองช้ำ ทำแล้วรู้สึกดีขึ้น เจ็บเท้าน้อยลง เมื่อยน้อยลง แต่จากการพูดคุยต้องมีอย่างน้อย4ครั้ง อาการจะเกือยหายไป ถ้าคำนวณการรักษาครั้งละ3,700 อย่างน้อย4ครั้ง ก็14,800 โอ้วเอาเรื่องอยู่
reviews.textTranslated: The place is great, like visiting a cafe. They have private consultation rooms before treatment. If you have a lot of money to spare, this place would be perfect because of the location and the care provided… I came for plantar fasciitis, and after the treatment I feel much better, less pain and fatigue in my feet. However, from what we discussed, at least 4 sessions are needed for the symptoms to almost completely disappear. If each session costs 3,700, then at least 4 sessions would be 14,800. Wow, that's quite a lot.

reviews.textTranslated: The clinic was clean. We brought my mother for treatment of early-stage osteoarthritis of the knee. The doctor gave excellent advice; it was easy to understand and provided a clear analysis and explanation.

reviews.name: Wiriya Boonyathikarn
reviews.text: กายภาพ+พิลาทิสครั้งแรก คิดถูกมากที่มาที่นี่ ต้อนรับดี คลินิกน่ารักเป็นกันเองสุดๆ ไม่เกร็งเลย ครูพิลาทิสใจเย็นสอนดีมากๆ นักกายภาพบำบัดให้คำปรึกษาแบบครบวงจรสุดๆ ใครอยากลองพิลาทิสหรือกายภาพบำบัดแนะนำที่นี่เลย สบายตัวขึ้นเยอะมากกกก 🤍🤍
reviews.textTranslated: My first time getting physiotherapy and Pilates was a great decision! The welcome was warm, the clinic was lovely and very friendly – ​​I didn't feel nervous at all. The Pilates instructor was very patient and taught exceptionally well. The physiotherapist provided comprehensive consultations. If you want to try Pilates or physiotherapy, I highly recommend this place. I feel so much better afterwards! 🤍🤍

reviews.name: Danunuch Masawat
reviews.text: ใครที่กำลังที่นวด / กายภาพ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะบรรยากาศดีมากแบบมาก ๆ พนักงานเป็นกันเองน่ารักทุกคนเลย เรามานวดอโรม่สบอกเลยว่าสบายมากกแบบมากกๆ เหมือนได้ให้รางวัลตัวเองจากการทำงานหนักมาหลายวัน แอบเสริมว่ากลิ่นออยล์เค้าหอมทุกตัวเลยอะ มาอีกแน่นอนและรอบหน้าว่าจะมาลองเล่นพิลาทิสของเค้า
reviews.textTranslated: For anyone looking for a massage/physical therapy, I highly recommend this place. The atmosphere is amazing, and the staff are all friendly and lovely. I had an aromatherapy massage and it was incredibly relaxing – like a reward for working hard for many days. I should also add that all their oils smell wonderful. I'll definitely be back and next time I plan to try their Pilates.

reviews.name: Pongthep Suttipan
reviews.text: ประสบการณ์ทำกายภาพครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากครับ นักกายภาพแนะนำดีใส่ใจรายละเอียด ทำเสร็จสบายตัวมาก ใครอยากลองทำกายภาพดีๆ แนะนำที่นี่ครับ
reviews.textTranslated: My first physical therapy experience was very impressive. The physiotherapist was very helpful and attentive to detail. I felt so much better afterwards. If you want to try good physical therapy, I highly recommend this place.

reviews.text:
เจ็บใต้เท้ามานาน วันนี้ถึงเวลามาหาคุณหมอแล้ว สรุปรองช้ำจริงๆด้วย
คุณหมอแนะนำดีมากๆ ทำให้พู่คลายเจ็บได้เยอะเลย
ที่คลีนิคสวยเหมือนคาเฟ่ เข้าไปรู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากๆค่ะ ใครกำลังมองหาคลีนิคกายภาพ แนะนำที่นี้มากๆเลยค่ะ ☺️💖
reviews.textTranslated:
I've had pain under my feet for a long time, and today was the day to see the doctor. It turns out I really do have plantar fasciitis.
The doctor gave excellent advice, which really relieved my pain.
The clinic is beautiful, like a cafe. It was very relaxing inside. If you're looking for a physical therapy clinic, I highly recommend this one! ☺️💖

reviews.name: 0070 Saibut
reviews.text: วันนี้มาลองเล่นพิลาทิสที่นี่คือดีมาก ครูสอนน่ารัก เป็นกันเองสุดๆ แค่เดินเข้ามาในร้านก็รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย ส่วนมู้ดของร้านคือ aesthetic มากๆ แนะนำเลยถ้าใครกำลังหาที่เล่นพิลาทิสแถวนี้
reviews.textTranslated: I tried Pilates here today and it was amazing! The instructor was lovely and super friendly. Just walking into the shop made me feel relaxed. The mood of the shop is very aesthetic. I highly recommend it if you're looking for a Pilates place in this area.

reviews.name: LittleEyesPan
reviews.text: พิลาทิสใกล้บ้าน ดีมากก บริการดี สถานที่สวยสะอาด มองผ่านๆนึกว่าโรงแรม💓
reviews.textTranslated: Pilates near my house is great! Good service, beautiful and clean place. At first glance, it looks like a hotel.💓

reviews.name: Arisa Buakhlee
reviews.text: ปวดเข่ามาเกือบ 10วันค่ะมาหาหมอที่นี่ ทำกายภาพไม่เกิน2ชั่วโมงเบาสบายขึ้น ไม่น่าทนตั้งสิบวัน แม่แนะนำคลินิกเยียวยาค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I've had knee pain for almost 10 days. I came to see a doctor here, and after less than 2 hours of physical therapy, I feel much better. It's unbelievable that I endured it for ten days. My mother recommended this healing clinic.

reviews.name: JamJam Wichiansri
reviews.text:
พาคุณแม่มารักษาอาการข้อเข่าเสื่อมที่นี่ ประทับใจมากค่ะ 🥰
คุณหมอและทีมงานอธิบายละเอียด ใส่ใจคนไข้ แนะนำวิธีดูแลตัวเองหลังการรักษาอย่างเข้าใจง่าย
การรักษาใช้เทคโนโลยีที่ทันสมัย ทำให้คุณแม่รู้สึกดีขึ้นตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่มา 👍

บรรยากาศคลินิกสะอาด เป็นกันเอง เดินทางสะดวก
ใครที่มีอาการปวดข้อเข่า เดินไม่สะดวก แนะนำให้ลองมาที่นี่เลยค่ะ 💯
reviews.textTranslated:
I brought my mother here for treatment of osteoarthritis of the knee, and I was very impressed. 🥰
The doctor and staff explained everything in detail, were attentive to patients, and provided easy-to-understand instructions on how to care for herself after treatment.
The treatment uses modern technology, and my mother felt better from the very first visit. 👍

reviews.name: Leah del Mundo
reviews.text:
We chose Makka because we didn’t want to use the spa at our hotel and it was conveniently located just outside. Being in Chiang Mai, I expected most Thai massages to follow a similar style but I was a little disappointed that this one didn’t include the deep stretches I personally look for, especially for my back and chest.

That said, the ambiance is really lovely——very clean, peaceful, and welcoming. The treatment rooms are on the smaller side, which isn’t quite my preference, but everything was tidy and well-maintained. The therapists were excellent, and one of them spoke very good English, which made communication a lot easier.

I had the Thai massage and the Indian head massage. The Thai massage was decent, just missing those signature stretches I enjoy. The Indian head massage didn’t leave much of an impression for me, especially considering it was one of the pricier options on the menu.

A few thoughtful touches I appreciated: they served pandan tea and crackers before the session, and after the massage, they brought out mango sticky rice, which was a nice surprise and very enjoyable.

Overall, I’d give it 4 out of 5 stars. It’s a clean, well-run spa with kind staff and relaxing ambiance, but if you’re looking for a traditional Thai massage with strong stretching, you might want to clarify expectations ahead of time.

reviews.name: Truc Mai
reviews.text:
Hands down - one of the most worthwhile luxury to splurge on in Chiang Mai and it's at Makkha spa! It was worth every baht. From the front desk to the private room to the technique by the masseuse - everything was excellent! The 5-star rating is true!

I splurged on their package with massage & facial. If you spend 1,000+ baht, they will pick you up & drop you off in a Tesla (within short distance to the spa). Front desk speaks excellent English, greets you with tea & cookies before your treatment. Fill out a form to show areas to avoid & areas of concentration; plus picking out essential oil (jasmine was divine)! All the rooms are private with en suite shower. I was a party of 1 & was surprised with a 2-person room to myself. Guest can opt to shower before or after the treatment - with luxurious shampoo & bodywash. After the treatment, the most gorgeous mango sticky rice is served. Not the best I've had but it was pretty good. Mango was perfectly ripe & sweet, rice was so-so. (2) things I wish could be better - wish my masseuse spoke English - communication was a bit hard with a 2-hour package and we didn't speak. For the facial - no information was provided beforehand what the treatment details are. It would be nice to know what it entails. I felt so bad for showering after and washed it all off, thinking I could still reapply the moisturizer. Despite these things, experience was still phenomenal. 11/10 would return! They are often booked up, appointment is highly recommended!

reviews.name: Angela Gill Nelms
reviews.text:
Amazing experience from start to finish—an absolute must-do.
The instructions were clear, engaging, and easy to follow, even for someone who’s taken many cooking classes before. The owner speaks excellent English and is genuinely spunky in the best possible way—funny, warm, and full of personality, which made the whole experience feel relaxed and joyful instead of stiff or scripted.

The team was incredibly friendly and attentive, constantly taking photos so you can actually stay present (and not worry about documenting every moment). You’ll receive a beautifully done electronic cookbook afterward, which is such a thoughtful touch and makes it easy to recreate everything at home.

One of the biggest luxuries? Cooking incredible food and having everything cleaned up immediately afterward. No dishes. No stress. Just enjoyment. I’ve done cooking classes all over the world, and this was hands-down my favorite.

It was the perfect mix of culture, incredible flavors, humor, connection with new friends, and even a small gift at the end that made it feel extra special. I would do this again in a heartbeat—and I’m already recommending it to everyone I know.

The teachers (or as I lovingly called Thai grandma) are kind and so patient. My friend is pescatarian and they’re about to substitute with fish and tofu to accommodate her dietary needs.

reviews.text: Beautiful experience. We opted for a 1hr oil massage which is relaxing massage with pressure points. reviews.name: Esmé
reviews.text:
Great experience! The environment was extremely relaxing and I would highly recommend it to anyone who visits Chiang Mai. I recieved the "Foot, Back, and Shoulder" massage and it was lovely!

They started off with a quick cleanse of the feet in a flower petal bowl of water followed by some sort of sugar scrub.

My partner and I was then led upstairs to our respective rooms with curtains. The music was extremely calming and the employees were very kind. I never knew my back could pop as much as it did today!

🗒 Please note if you do not speak Thai, they do seem limited in English.

reviews.name: Jaymie Yang
reviews.text:
I had such an amazing hair spa experience here. I've gone to other hair spas and honestly I enjoyed them all, but Cleann has such a genuinely sweet staff. They're the most considerate and thoughtful.

They put a lot of thought into the customer care experience and give you options to curate your ideal experience. There's a menu that shows you what the steps include. I was asked if I want the water to be warm, cool, or room temperature. I was even asked this for my drinking water. For the mask, I was able to choose between three types and I chose the one for pores. I also got to select the pressure of the massage - light, normal, or deeper. I was also encouraged to make adjustment requests during the massage.

They accommodated my last minute nighttime appt. The most difficult experience was picking between the two lovely scents! I chose "Clean" and it was AMAZING! Other hair spas have lovely scent options, too, but I could barely smell them. This one was a lovely, soft, clear, and of course clean scent floating over me.

I got the double shampoo, conditioner, face cleanse and mask, neck, shoulder, arm, and hand massage, hair spa, and other things. I especially loved the feathers on my face and the spider hair thing. It was so tingly and relaxing.

Out of the hair spas I've been to, I enjoyed their facial experience the most. At other places it cost more and it made the experience almost less enjoyable and kinda distracting. It was a face mask and at certain times it made it hard to breathe. I can't remember why but the woman giving me the hair spa had such good technique with cleansing my face and applying the mask like I went to an esthetician. There was a smoothness and flow to it, which I really enjoyed.

The blankets are wayyy cushiony and softer than other places I went to. They're really mindful about making sure you enjoy your experience and maintain a quiet atmosphere.

While my hair was being blowdried, I was given a delicious butterfly pea and panda tea blend. I love butterfly pea but I never had it with panda before. I drank over 5 cups! 😂🤣 And they even gave me some to go! 😍

I'm particular when it comes to getting my hair done because I'm sensitive to energy and as an Astrologer, I can say that the people who touch our hair affect our minds whether you realize it or not. Mercury rules our hands and our minds and energy travels thru our hands. So it's important to have good hearted, good energy people touching our hair and head. I felt so good during and after my experience.

And their price is sooo amazing for what they offer! 599 THB 🤯 Next door they have food, too, which makes it super convenient! I also love that they post their Line on their Google maps. I wish more businesses do this cuz as a foreigner I can't search for numbers unless I have the business name, which can be frustrating. Sometimes I have to go to the business to request a service even when they don't accept walk in's just to contact them if they don't pick up the phone.

I'm new to BKK and they even offered to talk to the grab driver if they got lost. 😍

All in all, they're meticulously thoughtful and considerate. They're amazing human beings and professional.

Please give them a try!

reviews.text:

Negatives: I was there for two hours because four nails needed extensions; that’s 200 THB per nail, meaning an extra 800 THB – or 21€ more – which is excessive. reviews.text:

We were able to have our treatments in the same rooms, which was a lovely treat.  Before we entered the treatment rooms we both had our feet cleaned and then given sliders to enter the treatment room.  The treatment that I had on my feet and legs was extremely relaxing, and was finished with a Thai shoulder/neck massage for 5  minutes.  The neck, shoulder and back massage was totally amazing and my partner would have this treatment here again.  The massage prices are very reasonable in comparison to the uk.  shoulder, neck and back was 450bht, leg and foot was 350bht.
On our return we will most definitely be back for more treatments.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Phuket — we would definitely return again.

title: Thai Akha Kitchen - Chiang Mai
ownerDescription: Thai Akha Kitchen is Chiang Mai's heritage cooking class, run by an Akha family who bring the flavours of northern Thailand's hill tribes into your hands. In one hands-on session you cook authentic Thai and Akha dishes, guided by cooks born and raised in these mountains. Every class starts with a local market tour to pick fresh ingredients, and free hotel pickup is included. The Akha people settled in Thailand in the early 1900s and kept their own food, traditions and beliefs alive; here we share that story through cooking. Morning class with market tour or evening class, available daily. Book your seat online today. Proudly named the number one cooking school in Thailand for 2026.
address: 14, 10 Soi Rat Chiang Saen 2, Haiya Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: QXGR+FW Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Ein Kochkurs in Chiang Mai, der am Markt beginnt und nicht am Herd.

Der Vormittagskurs startet mit einer Stunde zwischen den Ständen: Kräuter, Currypasten, Chilis, dazu probieren Sie sich durch. Danach kochen Sie elf thailändische und Akha Gerichte. Die Gerichte, die Sie sich aus unserer Karte aussuchen, kochen Sie an Ihrer eigenen Station, die übrigen entstehen gemeinsam mit der Gruppe.

Schärfe und Würzung bestimmen Sie selbst. Vegetarisch, vegan, glutenfrei und halal sind kein Problem, sagen Sie es uns bei der Buchung. Abholung vom Hotel und zurück ist inklusive, und das gedruckte Rezeptbuch nehmen Sie mit nach Hause.

Die Akha Gerichte sind der Teil, mit dem niemand rechnet. Wir sind eine Familie aus den Bergen des Nordens.

Looking for a cooking course in Chiang Mai rather than a demonstration? You will be the one cooking.

Every guest has their own station. You choose your main dishes from our menu, you pound your own curry paste in a stone mortar, and over the morning you cook eleven Thai and Akha dishes: the ones you chose at your station, the rest together with the group, the way a Thai kitchen really runs.

The morning begins with an hour at the local market, where the ingredients stop being names on a card.

Heat and seasoning are your call. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten free and halal all work, and hotel pickup both ways is included. The recipe book goes home with you, which is the part that matters three months later in your own kitchen.

Un cours de cuisine à Chiang Mai qui commence à 17 h, quand la ville se calme.

Le cours du soir n'inclut pas le marché: tout le temps passe au wok. Onze plats thaïs et akha, ceux que vous choisissez dans notre menu à votre propre poste, les autres préparés ensemble avec le groupe.

Vous décidez du piment et de l'assaisonnement. Végétarien, végétalien, sans gluten et halal: dites-le nous à la réservation. Le transfert depuis et vers votre hôtel est compris, et vous repartez avec le livre de recettes imprimé.

Les plats akha sont ceux que personne ne s'attend à cuisiner ici. Nous sommes une famille des montagnes du nord, et ces recettes sont celles avec lesquelles nous avons grandi.

A cooking school in Chiang Mai that starts at the market, not at the stove.

The morning class opens with an hour among the stalls: herbs, curry pastes, chillies, the vegetables you are about to cook with, tasting as you go. By the time you reach the kitchen you already know what half the ingredients are, and cooking them stops being a list of steps.

Then eleven Thai and Akha dishes, from pounding curry paste in a stone mortar to mango sticky rice. The main dishes are yours to choose from our menu and yours to cook at your own station. A few are made together as a table, which is how a Thai kitchen actually works.

You set your own heat and seasoning. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten free and halal all work: tell us when you book. Hotel pickup both ways is included, and the printed recipe book goes home with you.

Looking for a cooking school in Chiang Mai? Over 8,500 reviews say the same thing, so we will let a guest say it instead of saying it ourselves.

"The best in chiang mai 100%" is what Krzysztof wrote after his class in September. Here is what actually happens.

The morning begins at the market: one hour among the herbs, pastes and chillies you are about to cook with, tasting as you go. Then back to the kitchen, where you cook eleven Thai and Akha dishes: the ones you choose from the menu at your own station, the rest together with the group, from pounding curry paste in a stone mortar to mango sticky rice. You choose your own heat and seasoning. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten free and halal all work: tell us when you book. Hotel pickup both ways is included, and the printed recipe book goes home with you.

The Akha dishes are the part guests do not expect. We are a highland family, and those recipes are the ones we grew up with, served next to the Thai classics you came for.

Unser Abendkochkurs in Chiang Mai beginnt um fünf, und das Abendessen ist genau das, was Sie selbst gekocht haben. Am Abend gibt es keinen Marktbesuch, dafür geht die ganze Zeit an den Wok: elf thailändische und Akha Gerichte, die Hauptgerichte an Ihrer eigenen Station, einige gemeinsam am Tisch. Abholung vom Hotel in beide Richtungen ist inklusive, und das gedruckte Rezeptbuch nehmen Sie mit nach Hause. Fünf Stunden, von der Abholung bis zum letzten Teller.

치앙마이에서 진짜 태국 요리를 배워보세요. 아침에는 현지 시장에서 한 시간 동안 레몬그라스, 갈랑갈, 고추를 직접 고르고 맛봅니다. 그다음 주방으로 돌아와 태국 요리와 아카족 요리 열한 가지를 만듭니다. 메인 요리는 각자 자기 조리대에서, 몇 가지는 다 함께 만듭니다. 절구로 카레 페이스트를 빻는 것부터 망고 찹쌀밥까지. 맵기와 간은 직접 정하시면 됩니다. 채식, 비건, 글루텐프리, 할랄 모두 가능하니 예약할 때 알려주세요. 호텔 왕복 픽업 포함, 레시피북도 드립니다.

The curry paste is where a Thai cooking class either teaches you something or does not. Ours starts in a stone mortar, with lemongrass, galangal, garlic and chilli going in one at a time, in an order that is not random. It takes longer than a blender and it tastes like a different dish. You pound your own in our Chiang Mai class, and once you have felt it, you will never buy paste in a jar again.

Nous ne sommes pas une école de cuisine thaïe de plus: nous sommes une famille akha. Les Akha sont un peuple des montagnes du nord, et les plats akha que vous cuisinez chez nous sont ceux avec lesquels nous avons grandi, servis à côté des classiques thaïs que vous êtes venu apprendre. Nos professeurs vous expliquent ce que fait chaque ingrédient dans la marmite, pas seulement l'étape suivante.
春卷看起来简单，其实最考验手上的功夫。皮要包得紧，油温要刚好，早一秒晚一秒，口感就完全不同。在我们清迈的烹饪课上，你会自己动手包、自己下锅炸，不是坐在旁边看老师做。每位客人有自己独立的灶台，从头到尾都是你亲手完成的。这只是十一道菜里的一道，一天从早上逛本地菜市场开始，到最后大家一起坐下来把菜吃完。彩色食谱书带回家，回国以后想再做一次也不难。

reviews.name: Natalie Ho
reviews.text:
Amazing experience from start to finish. The venue was so spacious, very clean and well maintained. I got picked up from my hotel to the venue and drove to a local market to get fresh ingredients to cook, the lovely Mor has teach us different kinds of Thai herbs and vegetables while we doing shopping.
We have learned 11 dishes and got to eat all of them!
Head chief Niti is very attentive and professional, not only taught us cooking skills but also told us about Thai food history of different part of Thailand.
I would highly recommend Thai Akha cooking experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Natalie. A clean, roomy kitchen is something we work at every single day, so it means a lot that you noticed it. The pickup both ways is there so the class starts the moment you sit down, not after you have found us. Come back any time.

reviews.name: Irene Schuurman
reviews.text:
What a well organized cooking class! I enjoyed the variety of the different dishes and the English was very good. There is the option to cook vegan, which was perfect for me. I ended up making:
-Fresh deep-fried spring rolls
- Papaya salad
- Pumpkin in coconut milk with cinnamon
- Akha soup with winter melon
- Massaman curry with tofu
- Akha salad
- Clear soup with tofu
- Sapo thong: tomato dipping sauce
- Tofu with cashew nuts
- Mango sticky rice, including the blue variation with butterfly pea

The only advice I have is to eat less than you normally would prior to the course, and if you're feeling full you can absolutely ask for take away containers. I would choose this cooking class again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Irene. Good English in the kitchen matters more than people think, because a recipe you half understand is a recipe you will not make again at home. The variety is the point: eleven preparations, the main ones chosen by you 📖

reviews.name: Erel Afuta
reviews.text:
Incredible, I've been to many cooking classes, including in Chiang mai.
And I have never found one as good as this for begginers. Loved it!
Reccomanded for every one, especially for groups of 2 or 4
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Erel. Being called the best for beginners by someone who has already done other classes here in Chiang Mai is the compliment we care about most. That is who we build the class for: everyone cooks at their own station, so nobody ends up watching over someone else’s shoulder. Bring the next group of four whenever you are back.

reviews.name: Ben Davis
reviews.text:
Simply spectacular.

Cheaper than almost all the places we looked into in Bangkok.

You were able to book just a few days in advance and still had a small class. Was awesome how they picked us up at our hotel and took us to the market. Not just to buy and look at ingredients, but they actually see what we'd be shopping for when we were at home and get explanations of what might be available in our home markets outside of thailand. Also got to try out at least a dozen unique street foods that were sold at the market.

Class itself was excellent in the sense that all the members of our group were able to choose different foods and we ended up trying 11 different dishes in total. On one hand I'm glad that we went at the end of our trip because having such fresh food prepared with such excellent recipes was better than almost everything we ate on our whole trip.

The recipes were fantastic and the food was simply exceptional. The instruction was clear and even though our instructor spoke English as a second language she was easy to understand, very clear and able to help all the different students with different dishes simultaneously during cooking. We also got to try a few Akha dishes, from this subculture, indigenous to Nepal, but living here for 100+ years.

Absolutely highly recommend this experience.

reviews.name: Roger Wiederkehr
reviews.text: Best cooking class I've ever done. We were guided so well, ate more than enough and learned so much. Would highly recommend it, our chef/instructor had such good energy as well! Only regret is that I didn't take more photos of the dishes before I ate them..
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Roger, what a wonderful thing to read! Guiding you well, feeding you generously and teaching you plenty is exactly our aim. We would love to welcome you back anytime.

reviews.name: breanna o
reviews.text: this cooking class was great! we started going through the markets and trying some local snacks, then ended up enjoying 11 different dishes! On was an amazing host with all the other staff being super helpful too. The food was great, learning about culture and history was cool too, highly recommend !! (great for vegetarians and vegans too)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, breanna! The market walk and those first local snacks are such a fun way to start, and we are so glad you enjoyed it all. We would love to cook with you again.

reviews.name: Xinyu Song
reviews.text: I booked a class through Klook and it was well worth every baht. The instructors were friendly and knowledgeable, the ingredients were fresh, and the dishes we made were delicious. The whole session lasted about 4 hours, and the atmosphere felt warm and authentic. Instant confirmation and mobile ticket made it super easy. Highly recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Xinyu. Friendly and knowledgeable is exactly the pair we hope for, because one without the other does not teach anyone to cook. Come back whenever you are in Chiang Mai again.

reviews.name: Prashanth Ratnabala
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience with On! The day started with a trip to the local market in Chiang Mai, which was a really fun way to get to know the ingredients and see how people shop locally. On made the whole experience really interesting and easy to follow, and you could tell she genuinely enjoyed sharing her knowledge with us.

The best part was learning about the Akha traditions and culture behind the food. On explained everything in such an engaging and personal way, so it felt like much more than just a cooking class — we got a real insight into the traditions, ingredients, and stories behind the dishes.

We ended up cooking 11 different dishes, which was honestly amazing, and everything was delicious! On was so friendly, patient, and knowledgeable throughout the whole experience. We couldn't recommend it enough if you're looking for something authentic and memorable to do in Chiang Mai.

And as a lovely bonus, you get a cookbook afterwards, so you can actually take the experience home and try making the dishes again. Such a positive experience from start to finish!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Prashanth. Aon will be very glad to read this, and the part you noticed is the part she cares about most: the stories behind the dishes are not an add-on to the cooking, they are the reason we teach it this way 👨‍🍳. Eleven dishes in a day is a lot, and doing it after an hour at the market is what makes the ingredients stay with you. Come back and cook with us again.

reviews.name: Mariyam Abdulkarim
reviews.text: I had such a fun experience at Thai Akha Kitchen! Everyone was super nice, welcoming, and funny throughout the entire cooking class. Everything easy to follow, and I loved getting to learn little tricks when making Thai food. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The little tricks are the part we care most about, Mariyam. Anyone can follow a recipe; knowing when the pan is actually ready is what you take home. Thank you for the recommendation, and come back to us whenever Chiang Mai is on your route again.

reviews.name: KIM
reviews.text: I joined the evening class with 11 menus, and it was an amazing experience. The staff provided excellent service, and the class was run in a very professional and well-organized way. We cooked a lot and had four breaks to enjoy the food. There was a wide variety of options, so whether you eat everything, follow a vegan or vegetarian diet, or have food allergies, you will feel very well accommodated. The instructor was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the class both fun and easy to follow.

reviews.name: April Wong
reviews.text:
Such a great cooking experience. 🧑‍🍳🔪
Aon was super kind and nice explaining stuff. Totally recommend it. 👍😊
We made 10 dishes in 4 hours. Took away lots of Akha cuisine knowledge too. 🍜🍚
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you April, Aon will be glad to read this. She explains until it makes sense, which is why the dishes come out right. Come back and cook the ones you did not choose 🍲

reviews.name: Natanya Savitt
reviews.text: What an amazing way to spend an evening in Chiang Mai!! The owner is SUCH a delight, and SUCH an amazing teacher. She made sure we knew exactly the process and how to prepare each ingredient. This was such a special experience. Book this now! You won’t regret it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Natanya. That is Niti, and the part she never rushes is telling you what each ingredient is doing in the pot. If you come back to Chiang Mai, try the morning class: same kitchen, with an hour at the local market first.

reviews.name: Anu Radhakrishnan
reviews.text: Attended an amazing cooking class covering 10 Vegan dishes. The instructor was amazing and made the class a lot of fun. The dishes turned out super tasty and were simple to follow and make. Will definitely be trying to make them at home.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Anu. A fully plant-based menu is not a smaller version of the class, it is the same class with different ingredients, and we are glad it felt that way. Come back any time 🌿

reviews.name: Frenkie
reviews.text:
Aon was my teacher, she spoke very well English and she had a fitting sense of humor while explaining about the Thai ways of cooking and I was free to adjust the measurements to my likings.
Afterwards I got a little book that contained all ingredients we used and the recipes, so I could try to make it at home as well.
I would definitely recommend to do this when you are staying in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Frenkie. Aon teaches in English all day and keeps the room laughing while she does it, which is harder than it looks. Come back and cook with her again.

reviews.name: Patrick Connors
reviews.text:
My husband and I joined the morning Thai Akha Cooking Class today, and it ended up being one of the absolute highlights of our trip. The experience started with an easy, perfectly on-time hotel pickup, which made the whole morning feel effortless and well organized.

We began with a small group visit to a local market, where our instructor walked us through ingredients, traditions, and what we’d be using later in the class. It was personal, relaxed, and really informative without ever feeling rushed.

The class takes place in a beautiful open-air cooking space, full of thoughtful decorations and carefully planned stations. The setting felt warm, colorful, and very inviting. Everything was spotless and already laid out, so we could focus on cooking and enjoying the experience.

The instruction was excellent. Every dish could be customized for spice level, allergies, or preferences, and everyone had the chance to choose and make their own meals. The instruction team did a wonderful job making each person feel comfortable and confident while still keeping it fun.

One of the unexpected highlights was our group. We had fellow travelers from all over the world, and it made the experience even more enjoyable. Sharing the dishes we made together and chatting over the meal added a really memorable social element to the morning.

I’d recommend this class to anyone visiting Chiang Mai. It’s organized, welcoming, delicious, and a great way to spend a morning learning, cooking, and meeting people from around the world.

reviews.name: Fi Fio
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at this place! From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable, the staff were super friendly and attentive, and I felt genuinely taken care of it really felt like a 5-star experience. The food (or activity/service whatever applied) was top-notch: delicious, thoughtfully prepared, and beautifully presented. I also appreciated how smoothly everything ran, with no hiccups at all.

Overall, this was one of the best experiences I’ve had in Chiang Mai I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to friends or come back again.

reviews.name: Clay Newman
reviews.text: So much fun. So much food. Our instructor was a blast. Super informative and very entertaining. The equipment was solid, and the ingredients were all super fresh and vibrant. You get to make a lot of dishes compared to your average cooking class. There are drinks you can buy at the class too, which is a nice little perk. Plus you get to set your own menu, so if you're with another person or two then you can try so many different things. They'll send you home with a cookbook and some cool knowledge about a culture that most of the world knows nothing about. Akha food isn't too far removed from the Northern Thai food you're used to. As they say, apparently: same same but different.

reviews.name: Sara Manetti
reviews.text:
Great experience to do in Chiang Mai! the teachers are so nice and they do a variety of dishes, one more delicious than the other!
Definitely recommend to join one of their classes at Akha Kitchen! 💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Sara! Our teachers will be delighted to read this. We are glad you enjoyed the variety of dishes and the warm welcome. Come cook with us again whenever you are in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: sonia maclay
reviews.text: A great experience! From picking us up at the hotel to dropping us off, it was great. We did the evening class, which started promptly at 5 & we finished around 9pm. Our instructor was a lot of fun and also a very good teacher. We accomplished 11 dishes & we were able to choose which to do in some of them, but we got instructions on the differences between all of them. She also taught us about the Ankha. The cooking area was very nice & we had plenty of space. At the end we got a book with all the recipes, plus it’s also available online and a pack of the spices to make a curry at home. We learned a lot & had a great time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sonia. Door to door is how we like the evening to run, so that the only thing you think about is the wok in front of you. We would love to cook with you again.

reviews.name: sofia Rabindran
reviews.text: Amazing experience from start to finish! The staff were so lovely and welcoming, and everything was really well organised. The food was delicious, and going to the local market to pick out ingredients made the whole experience even more fun and authentic. The venue was beautiful, clean and spacious. Would definitely recommend! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, sofia! We are thrilled that you had an amazing experience from start to finish and that our staff made you feel so welcome. Come back and cook with us whenever you are in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Piyaphat Mc Intyre
reviews.text:
I am proprietor of Thai Massage Room & Spa in Scotland and would like to say a massive thank you to the ‘ Kruthan Akira  Academy’ for their excellent training and facilities.

I was lucky enough to find the school on Facebook and I took the opportunity to study her video on YouTube as the treatments offered looked facinating. I followed the school Facebook page and this convinced me that I must I must visit myself and experience the training for myself.

The course and facilities were wonderful and it provided me with skills to add the treatments to my own treatment list in the Thai Massage Room & Spa.

The school uses excellent quality organic products and 'Unique' that make you feel so good.

The training course that I took covered 'Facial Massage Lifts' and the staff allowed me to work closely with them for 3 days. I found them all to be very friendly and helpful throughout and it was obvious that they worked well as a team.

The School has all of the good quality equipment that is needed, is clean and tidy and is situated in an excellent location with parking facilities and lots of nice places nearby to relax when you have a break.

Thank you so much again for the course that you provided and I am delighted to be able to highly recommend to all of my therapists friends and hope that they will come and study with you in the future.

With my very best wishes.

Noi  McIntyre

reviews.textTranslated: We offer comprehensive, all-in-one instruction with flexible courses tailored to students' schedules and conveniences. Students can review courses if they've forgotten something after a long break. Our teachers are kind, explain things in detail, and work well as a team with a positive atmosphere. Beyond simply learning the curriculum, students gain confidence and are able to apply their knowledge in their future careers. The school is clean and well-organized.

reviews.name: พิมพ์ชนก พิมพ์บรรเจิด
reviews.text: คุณครูธัญญ์ สวยเก่ง สอนเนื้อหาละเอียดมากค่ะ ชอบตอนที่แนะนำตัวผู้เรียนของแต่ละคนเหตุผลการมาเรียนนั้นแตกต่างกัน คุณครูให้คำแนะนำของแต่ละคนได้ดีสำหรับการต่อยอดธุรกิจค่ะ และคุณครูพี่เลี้ยงทุกๆท่านก็น่ารัก ใจดี ประกบจับมือกันจนเป็น บรรยากาศของโรงเรียนดีมาก ตกแต่งสวยงาม ที่สำคัญคือสะอาดมากกกกๆๆๆๆ สำหรับการมาเรียนครั้งนี้เริ่ดดดด และคุ้มค่ามากค่ะ 🥰🥰🥰

I liked how each student introduced themselves and explained their different reasons for attending the course. The teacher gave each student excellent advice for business development. All the mentor teachers were lovely, kind, and supportive. The school atmosphere was great, beautifully decorated, and most importantly, incredibly clean! reviews.name: Salynn Passionbox
reviews.text: ตัดสินใจไม่ผิดเลยค่ะ ที่เลือกเรียนที่นี่ค่ะ คุณครูทุกคนสอนละเอียดมาก ใส่ใจทุกขั้นตอนไม่ปล่อยให้หลุดมือเลยค่ะ บรรยากาศเป็นกันเองกับเพื่อนๆ ในคลาสและคุณครูครูธัญญ์ให้สุดพร้อมให้โอกาสเติบโตในสายอาชีพนี้เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I made the right decision choosing to study here. All the teachers are very thorough and attentive to every detail, not letting anything slip through. The atmosphere is friendly with my classmates and teachers. Teacher Thanya is incredibly supportive and provides opportunities for career growth.

reviews.name: thass chuen
reviews.text:
ที่นี่่ี่่ครูน่ารักทุกท่าน ใจเย็นมากค่ะ สอนแบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ช่วยให้บรรยากาศการเรียนไม่เครียด

เรียนที่นี่มีใบประกาศถูกต้อง สามารถเปิดร้านได้
หลักสูตรการเรียนดีเป็นขั้นตอน ไม่สับสน และยังมี
คลิปให้ดูทบทวนอีกด้วย

และครูธัญญ์ ยังช่วยแนะนำ การสร้างอาชีพการทำร้านให้ปัง ให้เป็นที่รู้จักบนโลกโซลเชียลอีกด้วย

ก่อนมาเรียนก็หาก้อมองหาหลายที่นะคะ  แต่ก็เลือกมาเรียนที่ “ธัญญ์ญาณี“  ไม่ผิดหวังเลยค่ะ ได้ความรู้นวดหน้าแล้ว  ครูธัญญ์ยังมีเสริมศาสตร์การดูแลสุขภาพไว้ต่อยอดให้ลูกศิษย์นำไปต่อยอดได้อีก
บอกเลยว่าคุ้มสุด ❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
Here, all the teachers are lovely and very patient. They teach at a gradual pace, which helps create a stress-free learning atmosphere.

Studying here provides a valid certificate, allowing you to open your own shop.
The curriculum is well-structured, clear, and easy to understand. There are also
review videos available for review.

Teacher Thanya also provides guidance on building a successful business and gaining recognition on social media.

Before coming to study, I looked at many places, but I chose to study at "Thanyanee" and I wasn't disappointed at all. I gained knowledge in facial massage, and Teacher Thanya also added health and wellness techniques to help students further their skills.
I can honestly say it was totally worth it! ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Sirada Sekkeseter
reviews.text: พอมาเรียนแล้วรู้สึกว่าคุ้มค่ามากค่ะ เลือกไม่ผิดที่มาเรียนที่นี่ ได้รู้อะไรใหม่ๆเยอะเลย ได้ลงมือทำจริงกับเพื่อนๆที่มาเรียน และเพื่อนๆและครูก็ลงมือทำกับตัวเราให้เรารับรู้ความรู้สึกจริงด้วย ครูใจดีและใจเย็นทุกท่านเลยค่ะ อะไรที่เราทำไม่ได้ ครูจับมือทำจนเราเข้าใจและทำได้เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: After coming to study here, I feel it was so worthwhile. I made the right choice to study here. I learned so many new things. I got to do hands-on activities with my classmates, and both my classmates and the teachers worked with me, letting me experience the real feeling of doing it. All the teachers are kind and patient. If there was something I couldn't do, the teachers would hold my hand and guide me until I understood and could do it.

reviews.name: Pinrat Hongjindapong
reviews.text:
🌸ครูธัญญ์ และทีมงานครูผู้สอน ให้ความรู้ความเข้าใจของร่างกายและสอนทุกขั้นตอน ประกบตัวและดูว่าเราทำถูกผิด
🌸ทีมครูและครูธัญญ์ ให้ความเป็นกันเอง คำแนะนำ ข้อควรระวังและตอบคำถาม ในเรื่องของปัญหาผิวหน้าต่างๆ ทุกคนยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใสเป็นกันเอง บริการลูกศิษย์แบบ 5 ดาวค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
🌸Teacher Thanya and the teaching team provided knowledge and understanding of the human body and taught every step, closely monitoring and checking if we were doing things correctly or incorrectly.
🌸The teaching team and Teacher Thanya were very friendly, offering advice, precautions, and answering questions about various facial skin problems. Everyone was smiling, cheerful, and welcoming, providing 5-star service to their students.

reviews.name: Om Thaimassage Uffenheim
reviews.text:
จากคนที่ไม่เคยคิดว่าจะเรียนแล้วทำได้จริง… วันนี้กล้าบอกเลยว่า “เลือกไม่ผิดที่มาเรียนที่นี่”

ที่นี่ไม่ได้สอนแค่ให้ “จำ” อย่างเดียว
แต่สอนให้ ทำเป็นจริง
บรรยากาศการเรียนสนุกมาก ครูทุกคนใจดี เป็นกันเอง และสอนแบบไม่กดดันเลย ❤️
มีอะไรไม่เข้าใจถามได้ตลอด ครูค่อย ๆ อธิบายจนเราเข้าใจและทำตามได้

ที่ชอบที่สุดคือ ได้ลงมือทำจริง ไม่ใช่นั่งฟังอย่างเดียว ทำบ่อยจนมือเริ่มจำ ขั้นตอนเริ่มคล่อง และจากที่คิดว่า “เราจะทำได้ไหม?” กลายเป็น “เออ…เราทำได้จริง!”

สอนเข้าใจง่าย เป็นไว ได้เทคนิคครบ ตั้งแต่พื้นฐานจนสามารถนำไปต่อยอดทำงานได้
เรียกได้ว่า มาเรียนที่เดียว ได้ทั้งความรู้ ได้ทั้งทักษะ และได้ความมั่นใจกลับไปเต็ม ๆ
ครบ จบ พร้อมต่อยอด
เรียนสนุก ไม่เครียด
ครูใจดี ดูแลใกล้ชิด ได้ฝึกจริง ทำจริง
เรียนแล้วมีความมั่นใจในการเริ่มงาน

สำหรับใครที่กำลังมองหาโรงเรียนสอนนวดหน้า/เสริมความงาม และอยากเรียนแบบ “เรียนจบแล้วเอาไปใช้ได้จริง” บอกเลยว่า ที่นี่เป็นอีกหนึ่งที่ที่อยากแนะนำจากประสบการณ์ตรงค่ะ

ไม่ได้แค่เรียนให้จบ แต่เรียนให้ “ทำเป็น” และพร้อมก้าวไปเริ่มงานจริง
ขอบคุณเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนค่ะ ได้ประสบการณ์ดีกลับบ้าน🙏
reviews.textTranslated:
From someone who never thought they could actually learn and do it… today I can confidently say, “I made the right choice studying here.”

This place doesn't just teach you to “memorize,”

but teaches you to actually do it.
The learning atmosphere is so much fun. All the teachers are kind, friendly, and teach without any pressure. ❤️
You can ask questions anytime. The teachers patiently explain until you understand and can follow along.

What I liked most was getting to do it hands-on, not just sitting and listening. I practiced so much that my hands started to remember the steps, and I became proficient. From thinking, “Can I really do this?” it became, “Wow… I can actually do it!”

The teaching is easy to understand, quick to learn, and covers all the techniques, from the basics to advanced levels that can be applied to your work.
In short, studying here gives you knowledge, skills, and complete confidence.
Complete, finished, and ready to advance.
Learning is fun and stress-free.
Kind teachers provide close supervision, and you get real practice and hands-on experience.
After learning, I feel confident enough to start my career.

For anyone looking for a facial massage/beauty school and wanting to learn something that “you can actually use after graduation,” I highly recommend this place based on my personal experience.

It's not just about graduating, but about learning to “do it” and being ready to start working.
Thank you to all the staff. I gained a great experience. 🙏

title: RECHILL Asok
ownerDescription: Rechill is Bangkok's community-centered wellness destination, offering ice baths, saunas, steam rooms, and cold plunges for holistic rejuvenation. Nestled in a lush garden, our co-ed facility provides a tranquil outdoor setting that enhances your experience. We integrate modern science with time-tested wellness methods to optimize health and wellbeing. Founded by a dedicated team passionate about holistic practices, Rechill includes a cozy café where guests can unwind and socialize. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned wellness enthusiast, discover the transformative power of contrast therapy and enjoy ultimate relaxation and revitalization at Rechill.
address: 24 Sukhumvit Soi 27, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: paisleylover
reviews.text: I was looking for something unique to try while visiting Bangkok, and that’s how I discovered cold plunging. It was my very first cold plunge experience, and I absolutely loved it! The staffs were kind and welcoming, and the facilities were spotless and very well maintained. I had such a great time here and truly enjoyed every minute of the two-hour session. Highly recommend 🫦♥️

reviews.name: Thanida Somprakhon
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place!!! Super clean, relaxing, and such a good vibe overall. The sauna and steam room helped me feel so refreshed, and the ice bath was amazing after. Staff were friendly and made the whole experience even better. Definitely worth visiting if you need a reset. ♥️🧖‍♀️

reviews.name: Mona
reviews.text:
Great spot. Very relaxing.
Has all the things you need. Ice bath, sauna, hot+cold plunge and shower rooms.

I especially liked the decor/atmosphere.

reviews.name: Pink Nattaporn
reviews.text:
Best vibe you could find from ice bath place.

Good facilities, full system-services for your recovery and retreat in the middle of Bangkok city.

reviews.name: Tim Shen
reviews.text: Will definitely come back for the ice bathing. This place is smaller than thonglor but I liked it much better as it accommodates less people and you can enjoy chill and zen vibe.

reviews.name: maii phava
reviews.text: This was the first ice bath place I ever tried and honestly I don’t want to go anywhere else. Been here so many times and still can’t get enough of the calm vibe, super friendly staff, and great facilities. They’re also the first in Bangkok with a fully filtered ice tub so it’s always clean every time you hop in. Only a 10 minutes walk from BTS Asok too. 100% recommended!

reviews.name: cghitaa
reviews.text:
First time doing Ice Baths!!! I booked an hour in advance. The environment is quiet, people respect each other and the vibe is calmm.
The instructor Joe is so kind and informative. We had to switch between hot and cold tubs/sauna/steam/plunge. The place has hair dryer, hair tie, cotton buds. Shower is clean and modern. There are lockers you can use

reviews.name: Edouard Bellin
reviews.text: Amazing relaxing space for a morning of detox and physical recharge before kickstarting the day. Really also appreciate their friendly staff who guided my 5-min ice bath (longest I’ve ever done). I’m excited to make this more of a regular routine 🙏

reviews.name: Pink Phungdet
reviews.text: Very clean and quiet in the week days evening. Love the multiple ice baths pods and dry sauna and steam. Really like it here the staff is very friendly and helpful. Will be back 😍

reviews.name: Ruari Hockley
reviews.text: Had an awesome time, staff are super helpful and friendly. The facilities were luxurious, clean, and perfect for relaxation. Will be back

reviews.text: A truely thrilling experience! . Great staff, very understanding, friendly and helpful.. Very clean and comfortable. I'll be back for sure. Thank you. 😊🙏

reviews.name: Unchaleeporn Kh.
reviews.text:
Hi! The ice bath and sauna experience here is incredible, perfectly balanced between recovery and relaxation. The space is modern, calm, and beautifully designed, while the staff are super friendly and guide you through everything. After the session, you’ll feel refreshed, re-energized, and totally at peace.
✨ Highly recommended for anyone who wants to recharge both body and mind! :)

reviews.name: Guitar Sahachai
reviews.text:
The vibe is so cozy, clean, minimalist, and never overcrowded.
The staffs are the absolute best—so sweet and attentive, guiding my breathing through the ice bath like pro coaches.
A major highlight is the cafe; the food is surprisingly delicious and the smoothies are incredibly rich, creamy, and refreshing.
Stepping out of the sauna/ice bath to enjoy amazing food and drinks is pure bliss, leaving all my fatigue completely gone.
Overall, I highly recommend this place for an amazing body reset, top-notch service, and great food. Worth every penny!

reviews.name: John Jeremy Vincent Aperocho
reviews.text: Had such a good time here, will prolly be back again before I end my trip. best way and place to recover because they have everything and staff are nice also

reviews.name: Thav Phouthavong
reviews.text: First experience in an icebath. The facility is very nice and clean. Staff are very friendly and informative about how one should conduct themselves to minimise any kind of injury. Definitely worth giving it a try. There is water available for consumption if you should need it.

reviews.name: Pim Nava
reviews.text:
Clean place. Professional staff. Easy process.

The ice bath is cold and consistent. Warm recovery area helps balance the session.

You feel calm and energized after.

Best spot in Bangkok for recovery and stress relief. I will return.

reviews.name: Chrisyyp
reviews.text:
Exactly what this city needs, yes we have many ice bath centers in Bangkok now but this one is special!!

The food and drinks menu definitely have that extra edge and the outside seating area is perfect to relax after using the facilities.

5 Ice bath (with filter system), Hot and Cold plunge pools, Sauna, Steam Room.

Everything is clean, stylish, and relaxing — perfect for recovery or just switching off for a couple of hours after that daily grind !

Also very friendly staff

⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

reviews.name: Ratchaneekorn Pakkasang
reviews.text: This is a brand new place for ice bath right in the middle of Bangkok city. I love the vibe of the place, such an amazing place. The staffs are helpful, friendly, and supportive. They serve healthy drink and food after the hot-cold therapy. Definitely, I will be back for this experience.

reviews.text:

Ice Pack! Great place to reset your body, clear your mind, and chill out.

Atmosphere feels super refreshing yet calm with green vibes, lots of plants, and an overall nature-filled energy, making recovery way more enjoyable.

Zen mode on!
From ice baths that freeze your stress away, to cold showers that snap you awake, and a sauna that gently roasts your worries away.

reviews.name: y mk
reviews.text:
Although the spa has a nice atmosphere, the quality of the massage was very poor and felt completely untrained. I had to ask twice for more pressure on my calves, but the therapist spent barely five seconds on the area before shifting away. Given the premium pricing, this was a highly disappointing experience that did not live up to expectations.
My husband and I experienced this bad experience and will never to come back again !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear guest,
Thank you for taking the time to share this, and I'm truly sorry your experience did not meet the standard we aim for. Being asked twice for more pressure without it being addressed is not the level of care we expect from our team, and I completely understand your disappointment.
I would very much like to look into what happened and make this right. If you're willing, please contact us directly at support@defloraspa.com so we can speak personally. Your feedback helps us improve, and we're grateful you shared it.
With sincere apologies,
De Flora Spa Team

reviews.name: Sudeshna Chakraborty
reviews.text: I got a spa done at the last day of my trip in phuket and it was totally worth it. Kwan was very professional and I had a good time at the Spa, I found the  Perfect Life Package to be a great choice coz it included both body and face. I felt very moisturized the next day.♥️

reviews.name: Chintan morabia
reviews.text:
Visited Deflora for a Thai oil massage after hearing good things about the ambience and overall experience. I must say the interiors, lighting, and setup are genuinely beautiful and premium. The place feels calm, clean, and well-designed from the moment you enter.

However, the actual massage experience did not meet my expectations. The therapist was decent, polite, and professional, but the therapy itself lacked effectiveness. I had specifically requested stronger pressure and more focus on certain pain and tension points, but the massage remained quite mild throughout despite informing them multiple times. Because of that, I didn’t get the deep relaxation or relief I was hoping for.

Considering the branding and the “heaven-like” experience they promote, I expected a much more rejuvenating and personalized therapy session. Overall, great ambience and presentation, but the massage quality and pressure customization need improvement.

reviews.name: Leinani
reviews.text: Had a great relaxing time today. Thank you to my masseuse Pitch/Pitcha. She suggested me to do hot stone and i can really feel the difference. I felt pain and bloated when i came and now so much better. Thank you so much. Hope to come back here soon.

reviews.name: Michelle Mc
reviews.text: Cannot recommend enough! Felt welcomed and comfortable as soon as entering, went for a couples massage, after a welcome drink was given slippers to wear and a locker to keep our valuables safe then led up to the private room where it was explained what the next steps of the body scrub and massage would be.. when asked about the massage I honestly can’t answer because within 5 mins I was asleep from being so relaxed. You’re given the choice of 6 aromatic scents to choose for your massage and the staff are just lovely. If we had more days we would’ve visited again.

reviews.name: R R
reviews.text: A great spa, one of the best we’d been to in Thailand. Very nice interior, the staff were really friendly and welcoming too. The massage I received was great but the whole experience was great, you get to choose your oils, the rooms are very cosy. Would come here again.

reviews.name: Poonam Basu
reviews.text:
Phuket has spas in every corner, but this one is so special. De Flora Spa will definitely floor you 😄. This beautiful place is not only so aesthetically appealing, but everyone here is so welcoming and inviting.
My family got our massages and facials done from here. Truly the best massage ever!
If you’re in this part of the world, don’t miss out on this.

reviews.name: Shane Dwitizki
reviews.text: Amazing massage spa and wellness center, my therapist YO was very professional and did one of the best deep tissue massage, she knew all the points and worked it her elbow with the right pressure, definitely one of the top 3 massage I have had. Also the spa is very clean and great ambiance Highly recommended!!

reviews.text: Experience was phenomenal. My masseuse took her time and got  every knot in my body. The Place is very clean and efficient. Highly recommended.

reviews.text: Me & my 3 friends had a full body massage at De Flora, and it was a very calm and beautifully decorated place...
