After the massage, we all felt extremely relaxed and satisfied.. I would say De Flora is one of the best massage parlors in Patong. Highly recommended! 💟

reviews.name: Ubah Abdi
reviews.text: Best thing you can treat yourself with while in Phuket. I enjoyed a calming body massage at this lovely place, and it was exactly what I needed. The atmosphere was serene, with soft music and a relaxing scent in the air that instantly put me at ease

reviews.name: Terence Ang
reviews.text:
Came here by cruise, and this place is a short walk away (~10-15 mins walk) from the Phuket Jetty.

As of writing this review, i’ve been here at least 5 times now and the massage has always been very good.

Did before the thai massags, healing package and also the romantic couple package. Highly recommend the couple package as you get a private room with toilet.

The masseuses are usually very experienced, and i usually come out of here very refreshed. Prices are typically more expensive than most massage places around here, but i would say it is definitely worth it.

Will always be back when im back in Phuket!

reviews.name: Aissatou
reviews.text: The masseuse Chan was amazing! I feel so relaxed exactly what I needed after a long flight and busy days. The massage was relaxing while also targeting some of my tight muscles.

reviews.name: Shelly Medikonda
reviews.text: My husband and I went to De Flora and were warmly welcomed. The interior design is so beautiful, the space is so peaceful and the staff is very respectful. We got the signature massage which was 3 hours long and it was an amazing experience. It was a full body massage which included a bubble bath with tea and some snacks. The in-spa slippers they provide were so comfortable that we bought a pair for both of us lol. If you ever find yourself there, you’ll have an amazing time.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience at De Flora Spa & Massage! We came in with a large group of 8 people, and the team was incredibly welcoming and more than happy to accommodate all of us seamlessly.
Between our group, we tried their signature Thai massage, pedicures, body scrubs, and facial treatments. Every single service was top-notch. The staff was professional, attentive, and made sure we were completely relaxed and taken care of. If you are looking for a place that can handle a group while still maintaining a high quality of service, this is it. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mohammad Al Sayyed

The atmosphere is so calm that you’ll probably fall asleep, so please keep your phone on silent.
Special thanks to (Meaw) for the excellent massage, truly appreciated!

reviews.name: Victoria Visky
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at this herbal massage place, and I truly can’t recommend it enough. From the moment I walked in, I felt an immediate sense of calm and relaxation. The atmosphere is peaceful, beautifully maintained, and thoughtfully designed to help you slow down and unwind. Soft lighting, gentle herbal scents, and a quiet, soothing environment make it feel like a little sanctuary away from the busy world outside.

What really stood out to me was the staff. Every single person was incredibly kind, polite, and welcoming. They genuinely take the time to listen to what you need and what your body is asking for. Before the massage started, they carefully asked about any tension, pain points, or preferences, and throughout the session they checked in to make sure the pressure and technique were just right. You can truly feel that they care about your comfort and well-being, not just rushing through a routine.

The herbal massage itself was absolutely amazing. The therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and intuitive, knowing exactly where my body needed extra care. The warm herbal compress and massage techniques helped release deep tension, improve circulation, and left my body feeling lighter, looser, and deeply relaxed. It wasn’t just physically soothing, but mentally calming as well — I felt refreshed and rebalanced afterward.

Overall, this place is perfect for anyone looking to truly relax, recharge, and take care of themselves. The combination of a calm environment, professional and compassionate staff, and high-quality massage makes it a place I would happily return to again and again. If you’re looking for a massage experience that feels personal, healing, and genuinely relaxing, this herbal massage place is a must-visit. ☺️🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ​"Thank you so much, Victoria, for such a wonderful and detailed review! We are incredibly touched by your kind words. It’s our goal to create a peaceful sanctuary for our guests, and we’re so glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and the warm herbal compress massage. I will definitely share your feedback with our team—they will be thrilled to know their attentiveness and care made your visit so special. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing session soon! 🙏🏻😊

reviews.text: Absolutely extraordinary experience here. Did the 3h Spa Package #3, which included a foot bath, aloe body wrap, aromatherapy massage, foot reflexology massage and Thai facial. My therapist was Jit, and she was phenomenal. You begin by choosing your essential oil scent for your massage and you are then brought into the gorgeous treatment rooms. The room featured a bathroom, foot bath throne, and private outdoor shower and tub. I have never been so relaxed in my entire life. The spa itself is simply stunning, smells amazing, and is located in the beautiful Sawasdee Village hotel. You finish the treatment with a platter of delicious fruit and cookies with jasmine tea. 10/10.

reviews.name: Alfiia
reviews.text:
This is truly a magical place. From the very entrance, you are immersed in the atmosphere of a mysterious and beautiful Eastern palace. Massive Moroccan-style vases, oversized swings, and colorful glass lanterns create the feeling of stepping into a fairytale.

In the evening, it becomes even more enchanting — the pathways glow like tiny fireflies, and the soft light spilling from the decorative vases creates a warm, dreamy, almost surreal atmosphere that feels both intimate and unforgettable.

The walk to The Baray Spa is especially impressive. The spa itself is designed in a refined Moroccan style, elegant and immersive. The service is truly exceptional — the staff are kind, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, making it easy to relax and fully surrender to the experience.

We chose a three-hour spa package and were absolutely delighted. The massages are performed by highly professional therapists who are well-informed about your specific needs and give extra attention to problem areas.

It was pure bliss.

Without a doubt, this is the best spa experience on Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing The Baray Spa for your spa experience and for your lovely review 🙏🪷. We are happy to hear that you had a good experience and I will pass your kind compliments to the team 🌺. We hope to welcome you back again 🙂‍↕️.

title: DIAMOND THAI MASSAGE
ownerDescription: We offer a different kind of massage services by professional masseuses at friendly prices. We welcome Muslim ladies. We have private massage rooms for ladies. And we have male masseuse for male customers. We welcome you and are ready to serve you with all our hearts. ร้านนวดแผนไทย มีบริการนวดหลากหลาย โดยพนักงานมืออาชีพที่ทำให้คุณประทับใจในราคามิตรภาพ
address: เลขที่ 21 Charoen Prathet Rd, Tambon Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
street: เลขที่ 21 Charoen Prathet Rd
plusCode: Q2P2+HR Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Isni Sukrianah
reviews.text:
I’ve always wanted to try a Thai massage in Chiang Mai, but I was always worried it might be one of those “plus” places 😂
Luckily I saw this place while having lunch across the street. The “Muslim-friendly” sign immediately caught my attention 🫶🏼. It’s also located near a mosque, so Muslim brothers and sisters who want to experience a Thai massage without any worries, just head to Diamond!

The service was excellent. The lady at the reception was super friendly and helpful, and of course, the massage was amazing! I also loved that this place is clean and so aesthetic (love the flowers💐!!!)

It was my first time trying a Thai massage, and it left such a great impression on me. I’ll definitely come back if I have the chance to visit Chiang Mai again. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for visiting us and leaving such a wonderful review. Our team is thrilled to hear that you had a relaxing experience. We hope to welcome you back for another great massage in the future!🙏😇💗💕

reviews.name: Ranini Cundasawmy & Patrick
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Diamond Thai Massage. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with such warmth and genuine kindness, which immediately made me feel comfortable and relaxed.

The atmosphere is peaceful and welcoming, and the massage itself was incredibly professional and soothing. You can truly feel the care and skill in every touch. It was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had in Chiang Mai.

Thank you for the amazing service, the beautiful ambiance, and the lovely smiles. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a truly relaxing experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate your kind review and for taking the time to share your feedback. It was a pleasure to have you. We hope to welcome you back again.🙏😇💕

reviews.name: P R
reviews.text:
Absolutely a hidden gem! Such an underrated I came across this place by chance and didn’t expect such a high quality massage I had 90 mins Coconut Oil massage The therapist was very skilled and knew exactly how to adjust the pressure carefully
Clean peaceful environment and great value for money I will definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience. It means a lot to our team. We hope to welcome you back again soon.🙏💕😊

reviews.name: Sean Francis Borchmann
reviews.text:
Yes. This one is the real Thai Massage experience. I did the 90, should have went longer. Get the sport massage if you feel stressed and sore.

She had in an almost psychedelic experience!

They got so deep, and it made me remember why these massages are so good for you. There’s a true art that they do here.

There’s a little black cat 🐈‍⬛ near the door who’s in a meditative trance. the first woman to great you is the sweetest woman. It’s a cute studio where you have to walk up several flights of stairs for the lay down massage.

There’s host greets you, helps you inside and makes you feel like a king/queen.

They understand service here and we’re trying their absolute best. Just be specific about what you want, as my girlfriend seemed to say hers wasn’t as transcendental as mine.

I was far more specific and felt feeling like I could move again!

Thank you all so much!
10-10
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for taking the time to leave us such a wonderful review. We are thrilled that enjoyed our massage. We look forward to welcoming you back! 🙏😇💙

reviews.name: Lyna Lam
reviews.text: One of the best massage places I’ve been to in Thailand so far! In addition to the great prices, the service and holistic experience are excellent. I like that they provide so many different massage options. My masseuse was clearly experienced, very strong, and receptive to my requests. I fell asleep during the head massage. There were also several other customers who were returning customers, so I would recommend booking in advance; my group had just been lucky that we walked in at a good time. They also provide local snacks and tea which were delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for wonderful review! We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed our service. We look forward to welcoming you back to Diamond Thai Massage soon! 🙏😇😁💕💙

reviews.name: IULIA
reviews.text:
Your go-to place for a good, reliable massage.
Let me tell you👇

I've been in Chiang Mai for a month and tried several massage parlors. This is undoubtedly the best.

The service was impeccable from start to finish.
We tried several massages and enjoyed them all.

I especially recommend the Thai herbal massage. They also apply an ointment that helps your body relax.

At the end, they offered us tea, pastries, and grapes.

If you're unsure where to go, this is a very, very good place for the price. Honestly, the experience was flawless.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate you taking the time to write us a detailed review. We look forward to serving you again. 🙏😇💕

reviews.name: 林瑜芯
reviews.text:
it‘s in a alley which’s a little invisible .
looks local but inside, not that local
you can feel comfy once stepping in.
they have fresh flowers decorated the table
and all the little stuff they offer are so lovely

the most important of all ,they all doing the massage so well, not just touching muscle
but precisely reach the deep soreness

this is the best massage i’ve ever had
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review and choosing our massage shop. Your comfort is our top priority.🙏😇💙

reviews.name: Lucy Mcnair
reviews.text:
I had such an amazing experience here, and will be back soon!
I had a full body massage and the atmosphere from the beginning was wonderful, the staff are so lovely, I could have sat and talked all evening because they are so friendly.
The place feels so calm, the massage was great and they brought me tea after to relax, I would 100% recommend! <3
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your support and the wonderful review! We are so happy you enjoyed your time with us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another blissful session soon. 🙏😊💕🥰

reviews.name: Sebastián Monsalvo
reviews.text: the staff was overly nice and welcoming. the lady that owns the parlor treated us super nicely. the masseuses were amazing and gave us such nice massages. they gave us tea and biscuits after the massage and gave us parting gifts! (small woven wallet)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We are absolutely delighted to hear that you had a relaxing experience at our shop. Your support means the world to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another blissful session soon.🙏😇🥰💕💗👍🏻

reviews.name: Hagi Erez
reviews.text:
I love Thai massage and do a lot, but here it was the best experience.
The place is nicely designed, clean, beautiful flowers all around. Definitely different experience from other places. The owner KT hospitality is outstanding and the massage is very professional. I took foot massage and it was so good that I decided to do a Thai massage one hour that was also amazing.
Totally recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your support. We hope that our shop will be able to serve you again next time.

reviews.name: Marc Cortez
reviews.text: Hdhu was amazing! Came in for a last minute foot massage and am super happy. The shop manager is so friendly and the masseuse gave me a relaxing session. No pain! I just wanted to chill today and it was perfect. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind review and for choosing us. We hope to welcome you back again.🙏😇💕

reviews.name: Mona Harsman
reviews.text: One of the best Thai Massages I ever had. The staff is friendly and really welcoming. We even came back and would have waited for an hour to get an appointment. After having been in Thailand for more than half a year in total, this place I can really recommend..also for runners and trailrunners. They managed to get me back on the trails after my muscles got really tight.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review and you trust in our service. We hope to see you again soon.🙏😇💕

reviews.name: Maryam Affendi
reviews.text: Probably one of the best massage place I've ever been. The owner, Key is very friendly and considerate. She tries to understand your needs. She has private rooms for Muslim women to have their massage. Her staff Pong is so good with the massage too! Would recommend this to anyone especially Muslim. They also have male masseuse for men. The shop is located nearby Masjid Hidayatul Islam Ban Ho. I'd definitely come again  the next time I'm in Chiang Mai ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. We really  appreciate your advice on Muslim customs. We will learn and practice them so that my Muslim female customers feel relaxed and comfortable. We hope next time Diamond Thai Massage will be able to serve you again. Thank you.🙏💕

reviews.name: Joe Shuford
reviews.text: Lovely, cute place that is clean with friendly and professional staff. Had an amazing Thai massage. The owner is so gracious and welcoming. While I was waiting, they soaked my feet in warm water and cleaned my feet thoroughly before my massage. Afterwards I was served tea with fruit. They even have an area and room for women who need extra privacy due to specific religious requirements.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking time to leave us review. We are grateful for your trust in our service. We are honored to serve you.🙏😇

reviews.name: Panukorn Sombut
reviews.text:
I honestly can’t remember the last time I had such a great massage. This place is truly one of the best Thai massage spots I have ever been to. I liked it so much that I went there two days in a row.
The staff were very friendly and gave me a warm welcome. My therapist was highly professional and immediately understood the problem with my shoulder. After the massage, I felt deeply relaxed, and I could move my shoulder much more easily.
I will definitely come back the next time I’m in Chiang Mai. The prices are also very reasonable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience. We are thrilled to hear that you had a wonderful time with us.🙏😇💙

reviews.name: Zhouzhou Zhou (Joy)
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this massage shop after the night market and was pleasantly surprised. The owner was very welcoming and even gave me a small gift, which felt really thoughtful. The shop is clean, cozy, and relaxing.

I chose the Thai & Oil massage, and my therapist was professional with a gentle yet effective technique. The stretching and pressure were just right, easing all the fatigue from a long day.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience that made me feel cared for and completely relaxed. I’d definitely recommend it and would love to come back again：）
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We are very happy to serve customers like you. We hope that our small massage will be another choice for you next time. 🙏💕

reviews.name: sakinah muzarpar
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience here, definitely recommended! Great massage with cheap price. Loved the ambience and hospitality. The staffs are very welcoming and it's muslim-friendly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. Your review means a lot to us.🙏💕

reviews.name: foodandtravelbyretta
reviews.text:
I had 90mins traditional Thai massage (without oil) with Marry this evening. Marry is a very good masseuse. Her strength was just right for me and she kept asking if I was okay with her pressure.

The owner is also very nice. You can book an appointment via whatsapp. The response time is very good.

Definitely a really good Thai massage in Chiang Mai.

Note that payment with credit card attract a 5% surcharge.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to share your experience . So glad you liked the massage with Marry .  Hope our massage made your day better! 🙏😇💕

reviews.name: Salvatore La Cagnina
reviews.text: We got an oil massage for two. We were there quite late but they still served us which was nice. You can choose your own scent for the aroma of the oil which was nice as the selection was bigger then in the massage parlors we had before. The staff was super helpful and the lady managing the place was also really nice and polite, offered us some tee and snacks after our massage. We felt very welcome and I'd recommend checking this place out, for example after a trip in the night market for some relaxation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful review! Your satisfaction is our priority.🙏😊❤️💕

reviews.name: Tere K
reviews.text: I visited there few days ago. It was a super good massage experience for me😆😆👍🏻 Excellent massage techniques and very reasonable price!! The owner lady was very nice to customers! Highly recommended👍🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review!  We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your massage and had a relaxing time with our therapist. We look forward to welcoming you back again next time.🙏😇💕💙

Why XERF? Next-Gen Dual- frequency Monopolar RF Skin Tightening & Lifting without Fat Loss | LEIA CLINIC ✨
Tired of skin sagging, jowls, or loose facial contour but worried about hollow cheeks? Discover XERF, the breakthrough aesthetic Monopolar RF innovation engineered to target three distinct dermal layers all the way down to the SMAS layer. It delivers clinical structural skin tightening and lifting simultaneously—preserving essential facial volume without fat loss.

What sets XERF apart from conventional RF treatments:
* Higher, deeper energy delivery: Delivers an impressive 60–80 kJ to the targeted layer compared to standard 35–40 kJ treatments, unlocking dramatic structural tightening and lifting in just one session.
* Maximum comfort and safety: Advanced 8-point active cooling, a larger treatment tip, and real-time thermal monitoring prevent overheating, protect the epidermis, and minimize pain.
* Zero downtime, long-lasting results: no after care, no downtime just results visible for 8–10 months.

Addresses full-face aging signs across key zones: Lifts sagging jowls, sculpts the jawline, refines double chins, smooths marionette lines and smile folds, lifts droopy brows, minimizes enlarged pores, firms aging necks, and revives dull under-eye hollows.

Every aesthetic procedure is carefully assessed and clinically tailored by Dr. Proud (Dr. Sanitta Kannrabvikorn) at LEIA CLINIC to match your unique facial anatomy with precision and natural artistry.
อัพเดทตารางคุณหมอพราวประจำเดือน กันยายน 2569 นะคะ😊🙏🏻

บอกลาฝ้า กระตื้น กระแดด ผิวหมองคล้ำ คืนผิวขาวใสเรียบเนียนสม่ำเสมอด้วย Miin Laser (โปรแกรมเลเซอร์มีอิน)
โปรแกรมเลเซอร์จัดการเม็ดสีอย่างตรงจุด(ผิวไม่แดง-ไม่เลือดหลังทำ)
* เคลียร์เม็ดสีตรงจุด: รักษากระตื้น กระแดด และฝ้า พร้อมช่วยปรับโทนสีผิวให้กระจ่างใสสม่ำเสมอขึ้น
* ไม่เจ็บ สบายผิว: ให้พลังงานที่เสถียร ไม่ต้องแปะยาชาก่อนทำ
* ไม่ต้องพักหน้า: หลังทำหน้าไม่แดง-ไม่เลือด
* ใช้ชีวิตได้ทันที: หลังทำเสร็จสามารถล้างหน้า ทาครีมบำรุง และแต่งหน้าได้ตามปกติ
* ปลอดภัย โอกาสเกิด PIH ต่ำ: ลดความเสี่ยงการเกิดรอยดำหลังทำเลเซอร์ (Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation)
ดูแลและประเมินทุกเคสโดย

กระลึกรักษายากจริงไหม? ทำไมทาครีมถึงไม่หาย พร้อมแนวทางรักษาให้จางลงอย่างตรงจุด ✨
หลายท่านที่มีปัญหากระจุดเทาๆหรือสีน้ำตาลเข้มบริเวณโหนกแก้มทั้งสองข้าง มักเข้าใจผิดว่าเป็นฝ้าหรือรอยดำทั่วไป แต่ในทางการแพทย์ ปัญหานี้คือ “กระลึก” (Hori’s Nevus หรือ Acquired Bilateral Nevus of Ota-like Macules) ซึ่งเป็นความผิดปกติของเม็ดสีเมลานินที่สะสมตัวอยู่ในชั้นผิวแท้ (Dermis)

สาเหตุสำคัญของการเกิดกระลึก❓
* พันธุกรรมและฮอร์โมน: เป็นปัจจัยหลักที่กระตุ้นให้เซลล์สร้างเม็ดสี (Melanocyte) ทำงานผิดปกติและฝังตัวอยู่ในชั้นหนังแท้
* รังสี UV และแสงแดด: ตัวการกระตุ้นให้เม็ดสีเข้มขึ้นและขยายวงกว้างชัดเจนขึ้น
* โครงสร้างผิวชั้นลึก: เนื่องจากเม็ดสีอยู่ลึกกว่าผิวชั้นนอก ครีมบำรุงหรือยาทาทั่วไปจึงซึมลงไปไม่ถึง ทำให้ไม่สามารถรักษาให้หายด้วยการทาครีมเพียงอย่างเดียว

การรักษากระลึกให้จางลงอย่างปลอดภัย✅
แม้กระลึกจะจัดเป็นกลุ่มเม็ดสีที่รักษายากและต้องใช้เวลา แต่สามารถฟื้นฟูให้จางลงจนผิวกลับมาสม่ำเสมอได้ด้วย โปรแกรมเลเซอร์มีอิน ที่มีความยาวคลื่นจำเพาะ เพื่อเข้าไปสลายเม็ดสีในชั้นหนังแท้ให้แตกตัวเป็นอนุภาคเล็กๆ ก่อนที่ร่างกายจะกำจัดออกตามธรรมชาติอย่างปลอดภัย โดยไม่ทำร้ายผิวชั้นบน
* ประเมินสภาพผิวและความลึกของเม็ดสีอย่างละเอียดก่อนทำ
* ปรับตั้งค่าพลังงานให้เหมาะกับระดับเม็ดสีของแต่ละบุคคล เพื่อลดโอกาสเกิดรอยคล้ำหลังเลเซอร์ (PIH)
* วางแผนการรักษาต่อเนื่องเพื่อผลลัพธ์ที่ค่อยๆ กระจ่างใสขึ้นอย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ
* ช่วยปรับสีผิวให้กระจ่างใสขึ้นทั่วใบหน้า

XERF ช่วยยกกระชับใต้ตาและลดริ้วรอยได้อย่างไร?
ทำไมผิวใต้ตาถึงเกิดริ้วรอยและหย่อนคล้อยได้ง่าย? คำตอบคือ ผิวบริเวณใต้ตาบางกว่าผิวส่วนอื่น และร่างกายเราเริ่มสร้างคอลลาเจนน้อยลงตามวัย การทำโปรแกรมยกกระชับ XERF จึงเข้ามาช่วยฟื้นฟูโครงสร้างผิวบริเวณนี้โดยเฉพาะ

XERF ทำงานอย่างไรกับชั้นผิว?
XERF ใช้พลังงานคลื่นความถี่วิทยุปล่อยความร้อนที่เหมาะสมลงลึกถึงชั้นผิวอย่างแม่นยำ ครอบคลุมตั้งแต่ชั้นผิวส่วนบน จนถึงชั้นโครงสร้างพยุงผิว(SMAS)โดยมีกลไกหลัก 3 อย่าง:
* 1. ช่วยให้คอลลาเจนหดตัวและกระชับทันที ความร้อนอุ่นๆ จะเข้าไปทำให้เส้นใยคอลลาเจนเดิมที่หย่อนคล้อยเกิดการตึงกระชับขึ้น ส่งผลให้ผิวใต้ตาดูเรียบตึงขึ้นตั้งแต่หลังทำ
* 2. กระตุ้นการสร้างคอลลาเจนใหม่ พลังงานจะไปส่งสัญญาณกระตุ้นเซลล์ผิว ให้สร้างคอลลาเจนและอิลาสตินชุดใหม่ขึ้นมาแทนที่ ริ้วรอยเล็กๆจึงค่อยๆ ตื้นขึ้นอย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ
* 3. ช่วยกระตุ้นการไหลเวียนเลือดใต้ตา เมื่อการไหลเวียนของเลือดและน้ำเหลืองรอบดวงตาดีขึ้น จะช่วยลดการสะสมของเม็ดสี ของเหลว และความเหนื่อยล้า ทำให้ใต้ตาดูสดใส ความคล้ำดูลดลง

ทำไมผลลัพธ์ XERF ถึงอยู่ได้นาน 8–10 เดือน?
หลังทำ XERF ร่างกายจะไม่ได้หยุดทำงานทันที แต่จะ สร้างและจัดเรียงตัวของคอลลาเจนใหม่อย่างต่อเนื่อง ไปเรื่อยๆ โดยจะเห็นผลลัพธ์เต็มที่ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรก โครงข่ายคอลลาเจนใหม่ที่แข็งแรงขึ้นช่วยพยุงผิวให้เรียบเนียนและกระชับยาวนานถึง 8–10 เดือน

* กระชับผิวใต้ตา ลดความหย่อนคล้อย

reviews.text:

ประทับใจค่ะ กลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน ☺️👍🏼
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been following this doctor on TikTok for a while now. I love how they explain the procedures in an easy-to-understand way, so I decided to try laser treatment for acne scars here. Before the treatment, they took photos of my face from every angle to compare the results afterward. The doctor assessed my skin thoroughly, personally oversaw every case, and recommended treatments based on my actual skin condition. They didn't try to sell me any extra packages, which made me feel comfortable. It was a little painful during the procedure, but bearable. I could use my face immediately afterward. There was only redness on the first day; it was almost gone the next day. My skin started to look smoother after the first treatment.

I also appreciated the service from the staff; they were attentive and lovely. They followed up after the treatment. The clinic is clean, has a cafe-like atmosphere, and convenient parking in front of the clinic.

I'm very impressed and will definitely be back for more services. ☺️👍🏼

reviews.text:

reviews.textTranslated:
We used their Botox injection program for wrinkles (we had been following the doctor for a year through social media and decided to try it purely out of trust and confidence).

We were very impressed with the service here. Compared to other clinics we've been to, this one made us feel comfortable undergoing the procedure. There were no salespeople trying to push packages, and the doctor didn't try to sell anything either (other places do!😅). It felt like visiting a real hospital, and the wait time was minimal.

We had a consultation and facial assessment with the doctor. We received 50 units. During the injection, the doctor opened the box in front of us, showed us how to check the production date/lot number (you can scan the box to verify), and mixed the medication right next to the bed. The doctor was incredibly gentle, constantly pointing out any discomfort or stinging, and apologizing every time. They were very attentive to every detail. They provided free numbing cream. The pain level during the injection was about 1/10; there was no swelling or bruising.

There were only 2-3 staff members, so it wasn't crowded, and the service was excellent. The clinic is large and beautiful, clean and comfortable. We will definitely return and highly recommend it to others. The price is reasonable, not too expensive. The clinic is quite far from home, but we still went! For those who have read this far and are still deciding, I highly recommend going. It's worth it! 💖

reviews.name: naveed masum
reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing experience here yesterday.

There were four of us, and because it was raining heavily we didn’t have many options. The staff at our hotel directed us here, so we expected a professional and reliable experience.

We were encouraged to take a 1,000-baht oil massage, only to later find that many nearby massage shops offered similar services at lower prices and had significantly better reviews.

In my case, the therapist repeatedly applied excessive pressure, including pressing an elbow directly down my spine toward my tailbone, which left me with persistent lower back pain for the rest of my trip. There were also several moments where the massage felt uncomfortably close to sensitive areas.

My wife had the opposite problem: her session consisted mostly of oil being rubbed onto her body with very little actual massage work.

Overall, none of us felt that the therapists were adequately trained, and the experience fell far below our expectations. Unfortunately, we would not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Naveed, thank you for sharing your feedback.

We sincerely apologize that your oil massage at Lek Massage Sukhumvit 22 did not meet expectations and caused discomfort. We take these concerns seriously and are reviewing our training to ensure a safe, premium recovery experience.

As a trusted wellness destination since 1997, we strive for excellence in every massage in Bangkok. We hope to welcome you back for a better experience.

Regards,
Lek Massage

reviews.name: Wilfred Spykerman
reviews.text:
Such a good massage experience here.

I took the 90 mins massage with hot stone treatment. Nid my masseuse was very good. She really focused on my stiff shoulders and applied good pressure where needed.

Some hot towel treatments in between was a good addition. Cant remember when I enjoyed a massage so much.

Looking forward to come back soon.

reviews.name: a “a” a
reviews.text: The Thai massage was surprisingly good. Never had a dry massage (no oils) before. But this certainly is one for the books. The therapist did well during the 1 ½ hour massage. Pressure points were pressed well though it would be lovely to have it with oil. I would definitely recommend this place. It is clean and the place has soothing music that goes well with the massage.

reviews.name: Natalie Yang
reviews.text: This is the best massage place I have been in Chiang Mai, I had 3 hours package, my lady is Nam, she is very caring and at the same time very strong in the perfect way to me. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tien Nguyen
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve ever tried in my life, professional therapists, great and friendly customer service staff, super comfortable space. Thank you so much for improving my health significantly, the tea and cookies are tasty too! Highly recommend for everyone!

reviews.name: talia
reviews.text: The environment of the store is so good, vibe is relaxing. Hot stone for 90min only cost 700, the strength are well controlled that me and my fri even fall asleep. For people doing spa is seperated room.

reviews.name: Chase Quimby
reviews.text: Hands down the best massage I’ve ever had, and I’ve had plenty to compare to. I chose the 1.5 hour oil massage. Strong enough to work out the knots, gentle in the really sore spots, she was able to release both hip flexors and a couple of other spots that had been really bothering me. Clean and comfortable, pre and post massage beverages, can book ahead or walk in. She not only focused on the massage but on stretching, acupressure and fascia release as well. My back and body haven’t felt this good in ages! Pricing was more than reasonable especially compared to other parlors of the same caliber, clean, modern, mid-tier. Absolutely zero complaints. Thank you!

reviews.name: LynC
reviews.text: Fantastic! Amazing! The reviews really live up to their reputation! Best ever foot massage by Nam with the correct pressure and technique in a clean and pleasant environment!

reviews.name: Kullanart Chaima
reviews.text:
Great experience Thai massage also with hot stones massage.
Nice and clean place. With welcome drinks and hot tea when we finished massage..
Highly recommend

reviews.name: Via
reviews.text: This shop is spotlessly clean – the moment you walk in, you're greeted by a lovely aroma of essential oils. The front desk staff is so kind and gentle, and they even offer delicious refreshments. The massage was incredibly relaxing and professional – it was such a fantastic experience! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Tommy Park
reviews.text: Omg guys definitely good experiences, me and my girlfriend did neck and shoulder massages and foot massage, aunties have good strengths and they asked if we feel good or nah, really friendly and the price is decent too! Suitable for couples and individual🔥

reviews.name: Olivia Bignell
reviews.text:
One of my best massage experiences!
I made a last minute booking with the ladies through WhatsApp and not only did I have to move my appointment back with ease, the ladies at reception were lovely.

I am coming back as promised, I have Nam who was so gentle and soft and asked a few times through the massage if everything was ok!
Very happy with the service and how clean the place is as well!

reviews.name: 김영호
reviews.text: I ever first met Thai massage shop in Chiangmai. Of course there are lof of luxury massage shops in Old town & other places But Its too expensive and Massage Quality is depend on each Therapists. But This Shop provided Cleanliness, Kindness and excellent therapy quality. Even Managers was very supportive. She tried to help & listen the voice from the customer with her best. I got a great experience in there. Especially If You consider about staying at Nimmanhaemin or Santitham then Giving Tree could be a best choice for Massage shop

reviews.name: Bn JN
reviews.text: Amazing massage. Very good and relaxing atmosphere including the rooms and the music. Therapist was kind and had good technique. The receptionis also was very lovely. I highly recommend this shop

reviews.name: genie zee
reviews.text: I can't put into words how amazing this is - the best massage I've gotten in Chiang Mai in all these years! The therapist was extremely professional and the service was top-notch, hitting all the right spots perfectly!

reviews.name: Jenna Barker
reviews.text: I did a 2 hour aroma oil massage with the hot stones today. A full two hours of massaging my whole body and massaging all the hard to reach places. The hot stones also hot and feel wonderful on my sore muscles. It was really nice and wonderful experience. The room is cool and very comfortable. You also get fun services like a refreshment and foot bath before you start, and a hot tea and snacks when you finish. This is my third time here and have enjoyed each time I’ve been. It may be bit pricier than other places but I think it’s well worth the price.

reviews.name: Ryan
reviews.text: Chiang Mai massage is the best here. The facility was clean. The bed was fresh without any smell. The masseuse knew my uncomfortable areas well and tried to relieve them, and I was impressed by that. I will visit again. The clean and cool massage made my day feel good.

reviews.name: Radjoe Mangla
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I visited Amarin Spa Massage in Bangkok for a traditional Thai massage, and honestly — it was exactly what we needed. From the moment we stepped in, the energy was calm, clean, and inviting — a peaceful escape from the chaos of the city outside.

The therapists were professional, warm, and incredibly skilled. They knew how to work the tension out of every muscle with the perfect pressure and flow. We both walked out feeling lighter, more flexible, and deeply recharged.

It’s the small things that made the experience 5-star: herbal welcome tea, clean rooms, fresh towels, a peaceful ambiance with soft music, and a strong sense of Thai hospitality.

If you're in Bangkok and need to reset your body and mind, Amarin Spa is the real deal. We’ll definitely come back for another round. ✨

reviews.name: Ghelga
reviews.text:
It was an incredible experience, I had an head/shoulder/back and foot massage for an hour. First they wash your feet, if you have long pants they give you shorts. Then it is a very complete back and shoulder massage laying face down, then you turn around and they give you the feet massage. And for the last head massage half sitting up and some stretching as well for the upper body. All of the time with relaxing music and atmosphere. The temperature was perfect the whole time.
Afterwards they give you hot tea and some cookies.
I recommend it 100%. Thank you very much! 💫

reviews.name: Mk Aus Trvl
reviews.text: Great little massage place.  Very friendly staff. Good price. Had the full body oil massage with male masseur - nice and firm but not painful. Did some strong Thai massage moves as well to sort out my sore back! And nice tea in the garden afterwards. All round terrific! Thank you.

reviews.name: Tyler Oakson
reviews.text:
AMAZING STAFF, AMAZING LOCATION, AMAZING PRICE, AND THE BEST THAI MASSAGE!!

My wife and I came here and had the Thai Massage with Oil… it was the most incredible experience!! Seriously, if you’re in Chiang Mai looking for a massage, you need to come here!! I can’t imagine there being a better place than this!!

We sat in their garden after the massage and enjoyed a complementary cup of tea with some cookies!! So PEACEFUL

reviews.name: Syrristen
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best massage places in town, and trust me, I live here and I've been to a ton of them. This one has professional staff that work on your muscle knots, stretching and generally healing your body. I've been struggling with my back, shoulder and neck for a long time and these guys really hit the spot! I highly recommend if you have sore or tense muscles. I'm definetly coming back!

reviews.name: Two_o
reviews.text: Amazing massage experience. The therapist was very skilled and knew exactly what she was doing. Clean, cozy place with affordable prices. Loved the tea and snacks after the massage. Will definitely come back and try other services. 🥳

reviews.name: J Fisher
reviews.text: One of the best physio Thai style massages I've had during this trip. Painful, yet very good for my tight muscles, and for the price excellent value. We had the legs, back and head. The finishing touch is green tea and biscuits in the tranquil gardens.

reviews.name: Kevin Pinto
reviews.text: Came here for Thai massage. Man, this was the best by far on my Thailand trip. The masseur was professional and knew exactly my pain points. Felt very relaxed. Highly recommend. Don’t even look elsewhere, come here. They end it with a cute green tea session.

reviews.name: Kayra Gani Cantürk
reviews.text: We got back neck and shoulder massage and it was awesome. This was the first time I received a massage from a male masseuse (im a man myself) and I realized thats what my stone back actually needed. Also the whole menu is fair priced. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: EdT
reviews.text: Lovely garden and price also affordable. I did foot massage and scrub and it was decent.

reviews.name: Nessa Nguyen
reviews.text: Decent no frills massage place. I got the back neck and shoulder massage with oil. The back part was not great, a lot of rubbing. She did get into the knots on my shoulder but not as much work on the neck area as I would like. The Thai massage techniques were better. My husband was happy with his Thai massage with oil.

reviews.name: Lyon Lee
reviews.text: I myself have learned different types of massages and I know when it’s a good massage. The masseuse who gave me the massage is really really really good! It’s a bummer that I only found this massage centre one day before I leave! It’s on my list of things to do next time I pass by Chiangmai!

reviews.name: Phil Gee
reviews.text: Best massage in my opinion in chiang mai. Lovely staff. Beautiful place, lovely separate chalet style room. Brilliant massage. Lovely calming garden with water feature to sit in afterwards and drink tea. Really amazing experience for the price you pay anywhere. 400 bhat for oil. Highly recommend

reviews.name: fangwei he
reviews.text: We got foot massage here. The service is really good and the massage is soooo gooood!!! After walking all day, this is really what we needed the most. The staff is very caring and friendly. They really care about if you feel comfortable or not. The vibe is also nice here. They have a small garden where you can chill and have hot tea after the massage. Strongly recommended!

reviews.name: Samara Z
reviews.text:
I got a foot massage with hot stone and it was absolutely amazing! The massage felt so good, I almost fell asleep. The experience was really great and having a tea in their garden was a perfect way to end it.

Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Sam Logie
reviews.text: I stumbled across this place and so pleased I did. I had the 30 mins special offer back, neck and shoulders. It was amazing. Yaa (I’m not sure I’ve spelt her name correctly) was very skilled and excellent at her job. She was strong and knew which areas to work on. It’s a lovely little spot and the hot tea and snacks afterwards were a welcome bonus. Thank you Da Massage, I will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Montana Gerardi
reviews.text: The stone massage was perfect after a long hike I did the day before. They really dug into my deep tissues. And the place itself is a very nice little oasis. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Hartney Molina
reviews.text: Had the best massage in Chiang Mai on my first night upon arriving in the area. WIT(the greatest masseur) gave extra relaxing and fabulous massage that everyone should try so you will say you need to go back over and over again! Would definitely go back to this cool and relaxing place! Affordable as well! Must try!

reviews.name: cynthia rodriguez
reviews.text: A small quaint place by the hotel and one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The service was amazing. Right after a 60 minute massage we sat outside and drank tea. Very very relaxing. For sure coming again before we leave.

reviews.name: Jess Toh
reviews.text: Found this place after reading the reviews, and it didn’t disappoint. The environment was clean and comfortable.  The masseuse was fabulous—every single spot she worked on was absolutely on point. A must-try if you’re visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Trusty Traveller
reviews.text: Lovely walkway to get to the therapy room. As you expect anywhere in Thailand very friendly and attentive staff. Great massage (foot peel and massage) genuinely surprised how soft my feet felt after the massage. Lovely service and tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Phat Ou
reviews.text:
The clinic is very clean and the facilities are excellent. However, the time management is extremely disappointing. I have arrived on time for every appointment, yet I have had to wait every single time—sometimes for up to two hours. The waiting doesn’t stop before the treatment; there are often additional delays afterward as well.

For a premium clinic that charges premium prices, this level of waiting is unacceptable. Patients shouldn’t have to sacrifice several hours despite having scheduled appointments.

I sincerely hope the clinic takes this issue seriously and improves its scheduling system. The quality of service should include respecting patients’ time.

reviews.name: Angie Taberer

reviews.name: Godiva
reviews.text:
This is by far the WORST service experience I’ve ever had in my life—left me physically in agony and emotionally crushed, and I was even threatened just for asking for a reasonable solution. I’m absolutely devastated and disgusted!

I visited this place for the second time and even brought a friend along, all because my first massage here was actually nice. I specifically requested the same masseuse who served me last time (the staff agreed right away), and I also told them I was extremely thirsty and needed some water or tea before the service—both requests were totally ignored. I was randomly assigned a stranger, and no one even bothered to attend to my thirst at all.

It gets worse. The massage room is on the top floor, with blinding bright incandescent lights—I asked if they could dim the lights a little, but my request was brushed off completely. What’s more, there was no background music at all on the top floor, nothing like the relaxing atmosphere I had during my first visit. The masseuse was beyond perfunctory the entire time: rushing through the massage with messy, unskilled movements, pressing all the wrong acupoints that caused sharp, unbearable pain. He even yanked my hair hard mid-massage, making my scalp throb with pain. Finally, he pressed the wrong acupoint on my hip so hard that I burst into tears on the spot and had to stop the massage immediately.

The absolute worst part, the thing that made this nightmare experience infinitely worse, was the owner’s appalling and arrogant attitude. My friend and I approached her to give feedback in a calm, gentle tone—we just wanted to negotiate a reasonable compensation for this painful, ruined massage. But she didn’t care the slightest bit about the pain and discomfort I’d been through. She spoke to us in an overbearing, aggressive tone and even threatened to call the police on us for no reason at all! This black-and-white, unreasonable mindset is utterly sickening. She had no intention of solving the problem whatsoever; she only made my already terrible mood worse, leaving me with an indescribable sense of grievance and heartache.

I came here with full expectations, brought a friend to share the nice experience I had before, and instead I ended up physically hurt and verbally threatened. This shop has zero respect for customers, no sense of service at all, and absolutely no sincerity in resolving problems. 100% STRONGLY NOT RECOMMENDED—stay far away from this awful place unless you want to be in pain and threatened!

To add insult to injury, their reason for refusing a refund is utterly absurd and unfair: they claim I should have requested a new masseuse 30 minutes prior. But let’s be clear—for the first 30 minutes, the so-called "service" was just foot washing and essential oil application, mindless tasks that any staff could do, with absolutely no way to judge the masseuse’s technical skills. I only felt mild perfunctoriness in those first 30 minutes, nothing unbearable enough to demand a change. It was in the latter 30 minutes that the masseuse’s terrible, unskilled work caused intense, unbearable pain—how could I possibly raise an objection before his poor technique even showed itself? This so-called "rule" is just a ridiculous excuse to shirk responsibility and bully customers, with no regard for basic fairness or the actual experience of patrons.

I have visited this place four or five times before and had always been impressed with the service. Unfortunately, after this experience, this will most likely be my last visit.

The service this time was extremely disappointing. I paid extra for the balm massage, but the therapist barely used any balm. She said that it made her hands feel cold, so instead, she placed a towel over my body and simply applied pressure through it. Although the session lasted for the full scheduled time, I did not receive the full service that I had paid for.

The worst and most unacceptable part was that after massaging my feet, she did not wash her hands before immediately proceeding to massage my head. During my previous visits, the therapists always washed their hands before moving on to the head massage, so I found this extremely unhygienic and unacceptable.

This was by far the worst experience I have had here. I had always been satisfied with my previous visits, which makes this experience even more disappointing. Unfortunately, I do not think I will be returning.

reviews.text:
Visited this massage shop expecting a relaxing experience, but unfortunately it was quite disappointing. The pressure applied was excessively hard to the point that I felt bruised the next morning. At first I thought it might be their style but the soreness felt uncomfortable rather than relieving. I did ask the masseuse multiple times to reduce the pressure, but it only lasted a few minutes before becoming very hard again. I also requested focus on a specific area, but that request was not really followed.

Another issue was that the shop never asked about preferred pressure level, focus areas, or areas to avoid — something most massage places usually check before starting.

Lastly, the constantly creaking door was quite disturbing during the session and made it hard to fully relax.

Overall, the experience did not meet expectations, especially considering the importance of communication and comfort in a massage session.

reviews.text:
I recently visited Sukrue Thai Massage and overall had a positive experience. The lady who gave me the massage was very sweet and kind, and she gave me a good massage. While it wasn’t the best massage I’ve ever had, I genuinely appreciated her effort and caring presence.

I do have a small piece of feedback regarding the environment. At the end of my session, someone who seemed like a supervisor abruptly opened the curtain while I was still on the table and enjoying the final moments of the massage. It felt a bit intrusive and lacked bedside manner. Additionally, there was someone talking during the massage, and no one addressed it, which made the atmosphere less peaceful than I had hoped.

Thai massage can be such a deeply relaxing experience, and I would really appreciate a quieter and more private environment in the future. With a bit more attention to these details, the experience could be much more serene and restorative.

reviews.text: This salon seems misleading. When you ask for a bikini wax, they only remove the hair along the two sides and call it a bikini wax. reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
​We have been proudly serving our clients for nearly 17 years, and we always aim to be transparent about our services.
​A bikini wax and a Brazilian wax are completely different treatments. A bikini wax only clears the bikini line and costs 800 baht. A Brazilian wax removes all pubic hair and costs 1,500 baht. When you asked for a bikini wax, we quoted the 800 baht price. However, once you specified to our staff that you wanted all hair removed, they correctly advised that you would need a Brazilian wax. We hope this clarifies our pricing structure.

I’ve visited twice and left disappointed both times. The manicure technique itself is solid, but the gel polish application is a real issue, particularly for anything beyond a plain color.

If you’re after chrome or cat eye finishes, be warned: the results look nothing like the color swatches on display. When I pointed this out, the staff became outright rude. Their justification? That the same person had done both the swatch and my nails, so it had to be identical. No matter how clearly I explained the difference, they kept arguing rather than listening. They eventually said they’d take note of my feedback, but their tone was so dismissive it felt like an empty gesture.

What makes it worse is the wait time — two hours for a gel manicure alone is simply too long.

To summarize: fine for a simple, classic gel color. Not recommended if you want specialty finishes done properly or expect to be treated with respect when something goes wrong.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

reviews.name: Jacob Reynolds
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of receiving a Traditional Thai massage from Boom just before beginning an extensive journey back to the United States—nearly 33 hours of travel in total. As someone who is not typically a big fan of massages (I can be a bit particular about personal space), I went in feeling slightly unsure of what to expect. However, I am so glad I made the decision to book this session.

From start to finish, the experience was handled with professionalism, care, and genuine kindness. Boom was attentive, respectful, and clearly very skilled. The massage itself was thorough and thoughtfully executed—each muscle group was carefully worked and stretched in a way that felt both therapeutic and rejuvenating. I could genuinely feel tension being released, especially in areas that tend to tighten up during long trips. By the end of the session, my body felt noticeably looser, lighter, and far more relaxed than when I arrived.

What stood out most was how comfortable I felt despite my usual hesitation around massages. Boom created a calm, welcoming atmosphere that made it easy to relax and trust the process. It truly made a difference, especially knowing I had such a long travel day ahead of me. Instead of feeling stiff and anxious about the journey, I left feeling prepared, refreshed, and ready to take on the trip home.

After the massage, I was warmly greeted with tea and snacks, which was such a thoughtful and appreciated touch. It allowed me a few extra moments to unwind and reflect on how much better my body felt. That level of hospitality speaks volumes about the care and attention given to each client.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Boom to anyone—especially travelers preparing for a long flight or journey home. Even if you’re someone who doesn’t typically gravitate toward massages, this experience may pleasantly surprise you, just as it did for me. Five stars without hesitation.

reviews.text: It is soooooo relaxing. The atmosphere and music is soothing and calm. The service is good. Attentive. The counter staff can speak good English. Worth to give it a try when you are here in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Rachel Lim
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Siesta Signature Scalp Treatment at the Emsphere branch today and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok.

My visit started with an AI scalp analysis by Sky, who was very knowledgeable and took the time to explain my scalp condition in detail. The analysis was insightful and helped me better understand what my scalp needed before starting the treatment.

My scalp treatment was done by Honey, and she was absolutely wonderful. She was gentle, professional, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire session. The treatment was incredibly relaxing, and my scalp felt so clean, refreshed, and healthy afterwards.

The salon was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained, creating the perfect environment to unwind. Every staff member I met was warm, welcoming, and attentive, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.

A heartfelt thank you to Sky and Honey for their exceptional care and service. I will definitely come back to the Emsphere branch on my next visit to Bangkok, and I’ll be bringing my family with me so they can enjoy this wonderful experience too. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much ka khun Rachel for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. It truly means a lot to all of us at Siesta. 💛

We’re delighted to hear that you had such a wonderful experience at our Emsphere branch. It’s especially rewarding to know that the AI scalp analysis helped you better understand your scalp condition before beginning the treatment. Khun Sky will be so happy to hear that you found the consultation informative and helpful.

We’re also incredibly grateful for your kind words about Khun Honey. She takes great pride in providing a gentle, attentive, and relaxing experience for every guest, and we’re thrilled that she made your visit so memorable. We’ll be sure to share your compliments with both Khun Sky and Khun Honey—they will truly appreciate your encouragement.

It also means a great deal to know that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and the warm hospitality from our entire team. We always strive to create a space where our guests can completely unwind, and we’re so happy that you felt comfortable and well cared for throughout your visit.

The greatest compliment of all is knowing that you plan to return and even bring your family with you on your next trip to Bangkok. Thank you once again for your trust, recommendation, and generous support. We can’t wait to welcome you and your family back to Siesta for another relaxing and refreshing experience. Safe travels, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊💛

reviews.name: Maureen Aw
reviews.text: I read a lot of good reviews and I thought I gave it a try. In short, I’m not sure I’m convinced. The environment and atmosphere was great, as per what you see in the videos. Only problem was that they use hot water to wash the hair. Even for the water flow with red light add-on. Anyone who has done hair or scalp treatment would know that hot water is generally not good for your scalp. After the treatment i noticed consist hair fall and slight itch on the scalp, which shouldn’t be the case. Typically after any scalp/ hair treatment my hair fall situation would improve momentarily, which isn’t the case for this. Hence I question its effectiveness. Although everything else was great including the service!

reviews.name: keerthi sai
reviews.text:
I had the Aroma Oil Head Spa with the Scalp Scrub and Waterfall Therapy add-ons, and it was an amazing experience from start to finish.
My therapist, Jasmine, was wonderful—very gentle, professional, and attentive throughout the treatment. The entire experience was incredibly relaxing, and I actually fell asleep during the session, which says a lot about how comfortable and soothing it was.
The scalp massage, cleansing, and waterfall treatment felt luxurious and left my scalp feeling refreshed and my hair feeling soft and clean. The spa itself was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained.
If you're looking for a relaxing head spa experience in Bangkok, I highly recommend Siesta Head Spa, and especially Jasmine. I'll definitely visit again on my next trip to Bangkok.
❤️ Thank you for such a memorable and relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Naratip Rodkhong
reviews.text:
A hidden gem in the heart of Chiang Mai
Located right in the centre of the city, Zenza Spa is incredibly easy to find — no winding back alleys or complicated directions needed. From the moment you step inside, the atmosphere wraps around you: warm, cozy, and impeccably clean. It instantly feels like a world away from the busy streets outside.
The staff are genuinely welcoming and attentive — the kind of service that feels natural and sincere rather than scripted. You can tell they actually care about your comfort.
I booked a 1-hour oil massage and it was wonderfully relaxing. The pressure and technique were spot on, and honestly the only complaint I have is that it ended too soon — I found myself wishing I’d booked the longer session. Next time, I definitely will!
If you’re looking for a quality spa experience in Chiang Mai without having to venture far, Zenza is well worth a visit. Already looking forward to coming back. 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Naratip,

Thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing your experience at Zenza Spa. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the 'hidden gem' atmosphere we strive to create in the heart of Chiang Mai.

It is wonderful to know that our team’s attentive service and your 1-hour oil massage met your expectations. We completely understand that feeling of wishing for a longer session—it’s the best compliment we could receive! We would be more than happy to recommend our 90-minute or 120-minute signature treatments for your next visit to ensure you have even more time to fully unwind.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon. 

Warm regards,
Zenza Spa Team 🙏🏻🩷

reviews.name: Miki Osaka
reviews.text:
A Truly Rejuvenating Experience at Chaan Massage by Sirin

From the moment I walked into Chaan Massage by Sirin, I felt an overwhelming sense of calm and care. The space is beautifully designed—peaceful, clean, and filled with the subtle scent of essential oils that immediately put me at ease.

Wanmai is not only incredibly skilled, but also deeply intuitive. She listened carefully to my needs and customized the massage to target areas of tension I didn’t even realize I had. Her technique blends traditional Thai methods with a gentle, healing touch that left me feeling both relaxed and revitalized.

What sets Wanmai apart is the genuine warmth and professionalism she brings to every session. She creates a safe, nurturing environment where it’s easy to fully let go and truly unwind.

Whether you’re dealing with stress, muscle soreness, or simply in need of some self-care, Chaan Massage by Sirin is an absolute gem. I can’t recommend it highly enough. I’ll definitely be returning—again and again!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)

If you're looking for a massage place that strikes the perfect balance between professionalism, relaxation, and great value for money, this spot is a hidden gem. From the moment you walk in, you're welcomed with a warm smile from the front desk staff, creating a friendly and inviting atmosphere.

The space is clean and well-maintained, with a comfortable layout that makes you feel at ease. The massage therapists are polite, attentive, and highly responsive to your individual needs, adjusting their techniques to ensure a soothing experience. If you prefer a gentle, relaxing massage without pain, this place delivers beautifully.

One highlight worth mentioning is their current "Buy 1, Get 1 Free" promotion—you can choose either an extra person or an extra hour, which adds amazing value to your visit. Complimentary drinks are also served, which is a thoughtful touch before your session begins.

Prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of service provided. Whether you're a local or a traveler needing a break, this place is definitely worth adding to your self-care list.

reviews.name: TT Medici
reviews.text:
At first glance, and based on online reviews, I thought this massage place was a hidden gem—and entering, it felt that way too. However, after communicating with the staff and experiencing the massage, I cannot recommend it.

I am an experienced massage enthusiast and have tried many types of formal massages. The reception staff appeared professional but didn’t understand my requests at all. I specifically asked them not to massage my lower back due to an injury and wanted focus on my legs and glutes, but no one understood. It even felt like they deliberately massaged areas I asked them to avoid.

Although I paid for a full hour, I left after 30 minutes. The interior is like a maze, and the massage itself felt no better than the cheapest street-side massage. Decoration and etiquette matter less—what truly matters is massage quality, and this place fails completely.

reviews.text: Therapist was good. Ambience is good. Rooms are clean and proper hygiene were maintained.

reviews.name: 김도연
reviews.text: It feels amazing from head to toe. I fell asleep during the massage because it was so refreshing—it really took the edge off my exhaustion. The staff are super friendly, the place is nice, and it smells amazing in there. Plus, it's reservation-only , so I didn't have to wait.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your kind words made our day. thank you for trusting us 💛

reviews.name: 김창석
reviews.text:
The value for money is amazing!
It was kind and refreshing.
The aroma scent was subtly pleasant, and the Thai chestnut massage felt like it was very nice, almost unsettling.

reviews.name: Connie Ng
reviews.text: Very clean place and great staff! Good massage!

reviews.name: Nana tsai
reviews.text: Very clean and calming place with skilful masseuse. It's the most expensive option on the street for a reason. I tried both the cheapest and this one, I think this is worth paying a bit more for sure.

reviews.name: Robert Yang
reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience at this massage temple! The space is spotless, the atmosphere calm, and the staff highly professional. We loved the Thai Nagar 60 minutes so much we went back again. Excellent value for the price and truly worth it!

reviews.name: shahar gladshtein
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at the Khagee. My therapist was excellent—very kind, professional, and clearly experienced. She made me feel completely at ease, and her attention to detail really stood out. The service was exceptional from start to finish. Highly recommended!

title: LIFE MASSAGE BTS ASOK

We are providing Thai/Therapeutic Massage in the heart of Bangkok.

address: 390/17 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Miki HO
reviews.text: Better than my expectations!  The massage therapist's technique was skillful, with just the right amount of pressure. They also applied pressure accurately to the muscles! Great value for money! Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. Yes most of our customers are walking out feeling better than when they walked in. 🙏

reviews.name: 방지영
reviews.text: The place was clean, the prices were very reasonable, and the service exceeded my expectations. I booked a one-hour foot massage, but they also worked on my arms and shoulders, which was such a nice surprise. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking for a great massage at a fair price!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you. We try to give best massage as we can for everyone. 🙏

reviews.name: YS
reviews.text: Highly recommended for a great value massage! The friendly service and discounted promo prices before 5pm make it no brainer to give it a go. They accept walk-ins. The morning and early afternoon slots are great because it is not too busy. The masseur was professional and did a thorough job and really focused on the right areas for a great massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the review. Much appreciated. 🙏

reviews.name: Sasha S.
reviews.text: Great Experience! Just before i went to next door massage snd was dissapointed with their foot massage. Decided to walk for a thai massage and it was wonderful. No comparaison. Ning was great. I felt so relaxed and felt the hour strech it was just heavenly. Thank you! I can only highly recommend. I ll definitely come back now that i found this gem of a place!

reviews.name: Cynthia Wu
reviews.text:
Very relaxing ! Strongly recommend!! Come before 5 pm there are promotions!
My therapist Doung is professional, very good skill .
Friendly counter staff
If I visit Asok will definitely come back again .

reviews.name: Ro Smith
reviews.text: It took me years to find my favourite massage place in Bangkok. But I did find it. Best money-quality value. No bling bling, no annoying publicity, no big corporation. Just this lovely place. My sincere recommendation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. Your words mean a lot to us. You noticed exactly what we try to achieve in this business. We do focus on skilled and customer service rather than spending ridiculous amount of decorations and deliver poor massage and bad staff. Appreciate your observation. 🙏

reviews.name: WANDERLUSTMUSTS
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I visited after a long day of shopping in Bangkok and treated ourselves to a traditional Thai massage. It was exactly what we needed.

The staff were incredibly kind, professional, and attentive, making sure we were comfortable throughout the entire experience. My therapist, Dew, was absolutely wonderful, and my boyfriend’s therapist, Mon, was equally fantastic. We would highly recommend both of them.

The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, and the spa itself felt welcoming from the moment we arrived. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of service we received, and we both left feeling refreshed and much more relaxed after a busy day exploring the city.

The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the treatment rooms were located upstairs, meaning you have to climb a flight of stairs to access them. This may not be suitable for everyone, particularly those with mobility issues.

Overall, this was a lovely experience, and I would happily return the next time I’m in Bangkok. If you do visit, I highly recommend requesting Dew or Mon – they really made our experience memorable.

reviews.name: Daniel Qiu
reviews.text: Went for a 60 minute aroma oil massage + 30 minute feet massage for 800THB. The massage was very therapeutic and relaxing. It is a good massage for the price and the service was excellent. My body feels much better now.

reviews.name: Yvette Farrer
reviews.text: Literally the first place I go after arriving in Bangkok. The salon is beautiful and clean and relaxing and the staff are welcoming and so polite. Best massage spot near BTS Asok. THB350 1 hour massage before 5pm. You owe it to yourself to come here for a foot massage if you are in the area.

reviews.name: Viewapcy
reviews.text: Very relaxing. P' Noy gave a great massage, and the place was very comfortable. Everyone was friendly
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you. We would like to provide best customer service we can. 🙏

reviews.name: Jessica Potter
reviews.text: I looked up massage places in my area and decided on life massage. I got a foot massage and It was fantastic, Yuko was my masseuse and she has great pressure the whole way through. The place was clean and very quiet with nice relaxing music, the chairs are among the comfiest I’ve experienced in Bangkok for foot massages. I will return again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for looking up. We try our best to keep our standard high. Customers who care about massage seem to appreciate us more than people just hop in whatever they see on the street. 🙏

reviews.name: Kinsley Raye
reviews.text:
I was about to fly back home for a 15 hour flight and decided to get a foot massage before heading to the airport.

Doung was my masseuse and she was so smiley and friendly throughout.
I’ve got plenty of foot massages at various places in Thailand but she is truly fantastic- top 5 for sure.

I love that this place really places importance on being quiet. The staff don’t talk and there is nice relaxing music. The foot massage chairs are super comfy - probably the best I’ve tried!

I will be back next year!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. We care about cuatomers' comfort. Out staff do not carry on conversation once they start their work. 🙏

reviews.name: Baris Ayyildiz
reviews.text:
I had a 90-minute massage at Life Massage Bangkok and it was great. My therapist SKY was very professional and really knew what she was doing. She found all the right tension points and adjusted the pressure perfectly throughout the session.
The massage felt personalized, not like a standard routine. I left feeling relaxed, refreshed, and much lighter.
The place is clean, calm, and well-organized. Definitely recommend this shop if you’re looking for a proper massage in Bangkok.
Will come back again.

reviews.name: José Antonio Farto
reviews.text: A highly recommended place for a great massage. I've been coming here for four years. Trustworthy people. Thanks again! 🇹🇭🙏❤️

reviews.name: Property Rental Club
reviews.text: Had a wonderful massage for me and my family. The 7 of us left super relaxed! Definitely recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the review. Hope we see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: 서동혁
reviews.text:
Great foot massage for families (walk-in friendly!)

I had a 60-minute foot massage at Life Massage BTS Asok and it was absolutely amazing.
Even though we came in without a reservation, they welcomed us kindly and were able to accommodate our family of four without any trouble.
The massage was very relaxing and professional, with great pressure and attention to detail. The staff made us feel comfortable from start to finish, and we all left feeling refreshed and satisfied.
Highly recommended if you’re near BTS Asok and looking for a high-quality foot massage, especially for families!

reviews.name: Todd McDonald
reviews.text: Our go-to place as locals. Great quality. Great service. Professional massage. Highly recommended. I always request Yoku, she's been my favorite there for a while.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. Yes we do have regular customers living in Bangkok.🙏

reviews.name: thaichrislife
reviews.text:
We highly recommend Life Massage as a super High CP value thai massage shop. It is affordable High-Value Massage. The price is starting from 400baht, with additional special discount is extremely reasonable with high quality massage.

Foot massage is the top choice, thai massage and oil massage have surprise that the service quality is super high over than the price level. Good design with big sofa and quiet environment for foot massage. Massage utensils are clean. Super relaxing and enjoy massage.

Therapist all have good experience. For more information and full video for the environment and massage, please check it on YT: rcenjoylife (🎉with Exclusive Video Discount🎉)

reviews.name: 김혜연
reviews.text: "I had such a wonderful experience here! The facilities are very clean and comfortable, and the atmosphere is relaxing from the moment you walk in. The massage was professional and truly refreshing. Best of all, the price is very reasonable for the quality you get. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great value and a pleasant, clean place to enjoy Thai massage!"

reviews.name: 한지영
reviews.text:

title: Zabai Thai Massage & Spa
