reviews.name: Azaria Hartzenberg
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience at Zabai Thai Massage. The staff is extremely friendly and welcoming. A clean and peaceful environment with calming music. They have a us a refreshing drink upon arrival and when we were done with our massage they had a bowl of fruit and delicious ginger tea waiting for us. They were very helpful. I would definitely recommend going here!

reviews.name: Bona Lee
reviews.text:
I have received Thai Original massage from Aor. Her massage was incredibly relaxing and effective. She had a great sense of where I was holding tension and focused on those areas perfectly. After the session, I felt so much better and relaxed.

The place was clean and inviting, with a calming atmosphere. I loved the subtle scent in the air. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: David F.
reviews.text:
Wonderful place. The experience was fantastic from start to finish:

You get a tasty Juice in the beginning and your feet are washed in a wooden bowl. Massage 2h was affordable and done very diligently and patiently. You fill out a sheet with preferences (strength etc) beforehand. Afterwards, I got a tea and some fruit.

The place also looks wonderful and really underlines the best of Thai culture.

Recommended :)

reviews.name: Casting Shadow
reviews.text: Booked the 4 hour romantic package with multiple massages, a body scrub and facial. Great relaxing experience. Booking was for two people - asked for a private room for myself and was given it (non-couple). Compress massage was very nice. Pressure could be a bit better with some of the massages but otherwise was good. Was given a feast afterwards with fresh fruits, coconut juice, tea, mango sticky rice, and lots of other Thai desserts. Romantic package was 2000 baht per person.

reviews.name: Kerry
reviews.text:
We did the Royal Honeymoon and spent half a day at Zabai Thai. Felt so welcome from the time we went in to the time we left. The place was spotlessly clean and professional.

We chose this place after seeing all of the amazing reviews, and I'm so glad we did. They don't have the big marketing budgets of other spots, so the least I can do is let others know what a treat Zabai Thai is.

Very strong massage for my husband and not too strong for me, at our request. The therapists met all our needs, focussing on certain areas.

Body wra, face mask and outdoor shower left us feeling absolutely pampered. Dessert at the end was spectacular and they even gifted us a beautiful garland.

reviews.name: Lindsay Mills-Steffe
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews but after having a few very unskilled “Thai” massages, I was grateful to find this place. I booked the 2.5 hour special for my husband and I, so we were put in a room with two beds. The ladies were both gentle with our bodies, but strong and precise in their treatments. After having been to one of the many other massage places in town, I ended up injured by a “massage professional.” Don’t hesitate to book with Zabai if you’re looking for a legit Thai massage experience.

reviews.name: felfelfel
reviews.text: Best massage ever!! We had the Thai massage for 2 hours and it cost Thb 750. My masseuse is Tim and she’s so good!! She knows all the right points to massage (idk how to explain but she massages the nerve points till it’s “gone”?). It’s a little painful but this is also my first time falling asleep during a massage cos I find massages painful all the time & can never sleep. This makes me feel like all the massages I did in bangkok were a scam 🥲 I had 1 masseuse in bkk that stepped on me and it’s so painful & not good at all!! Tim massages with her hands and elbows throughout so it’s very enjoyable and you can tell it’s a lot of effort on her end. My mum also loves her masseuse Phai who is very helpful and asked her a lot of questions because my mum had knee surgery and needed more care. Highly recommend to everyone that comes to Chiangmai!!!

reviews.name: Monique Liem
reviews.text:
Incredibly fantastic place! ♥️🤗

Extremely painful, but worth it! She said, I was so tight!! Today I feel absolutely rejuvenated, no soaring, painful sinews, joints, back, tissue, muscles- she loosened them all! Wow, I was a wreck!! 🤪

My therapist really knew what she was doing 💗, unlike so many others we met!! 😲

At the beginning you fill in a formular. You explain injuries etc. And they realllly follow the instructions!! It is a heavenly result!! Feeling so much better!

The therapists speak English quite well, so you can make yourself understandable 😍. The boss is very caring and very much engaged to offer you the best service as possible!

It’s a real 7 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Massage Institute!! 💖👍

You can pay with credit card. 💕🐬

Love you guys- will surely come back and have a daily massage and will book a hotel closeby!! 💜😃💜

A very satisfied customer!! 🦋🙏💕🤗💗

reviews.name: Vanessa
reviews.text:
The staff is exceptionally friendly, and the location offers a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere that is super clean. My overall experience was outstanding; I enjoyed a body scrub, an aromatherapy massage, and a facial. Love the tea and fruit offered after massage.

Worth every second!

reviews.name: Kim Thuận Nguyễn
reviews.text: The best excited and wonderful massage I have ever had. The therapist (Ten) was really professional, focus on what we call a real massage with strong press. Tranquil atmospher besides friendly staff welcoming you from when you coming in. We have a light dessert of hot tea (really good) and some fruit and a piece of cake after all. Highly recommended. ขอบคุณ for the time here.

reviews.name: 잘좀시켜봐요
reviews.text:
If you feel Michelin at Kazon Whatcat, simple tour at the Waroro Market, and get a massage, the morning is perfect.

In particular, not only is the owner of the store kind, but the Moo-moo massager is also so skillful in massaging.

I received an hour-long Thai massage, but I want to get a longer one next time.

reviews.name: L C
reviews.text: They take the Thai foot massage to a different level. We love the fact that you can choose how strong you want the massage to be. We choose medium strength and it was perfect. They offer you very tasty tea at the beginning and end of the session. We had 1 hour massage for 500 THB, it's indeed more pricey then other ones but you get a totally different experience and it's definitely worth it.

reviews.name: Matt Tunguy-Desmarais
reviews.text:
Looking for a romantic spa experience? Look no further than this couples massage, performed by two skilled and handsome men. From the moment you step into the tranquil environment, you'll be transported to a world of relaxation and bliss. The full body oil massage is expertly delivered, with the two masseurs working in perfect harmony to release tension and soothe tired muscles. You'll leave feeling rejuvenated and refreshed, ready to take on the world together. The attention to detail and the warm and friendly service make this a truly exceptional experience that's not to be missed.
The experienced topped off with some fresh Watermelon balls and local Rosella water.

reviews.name: J제이
reviews.text: I had 2hours massage from Tle the other say and he was amazing, the best massage I have ever had in Chiangmai so far. I went back yesterday but the place was fully booked so could not do it. if you want to go, better to make a reservation before you go!

reviews.name: Kainat
reviews.text:
I recently visited Zabai for a two-hour aromatherapy massage and had an outstanding experience. From the moment I stepped in, I was treated like royalty. The cleanliness of the center is top-notch, and the therapists are incredibly skilled.

Upon arrival, I was greeted with a welcome drink and then had my feet scrubbed with rose-infused water, which set a relaxing tone. My therapist, Ying Ying, was amazing and ensured I walked out completely stress-free. After the massage, I was served a delightful herbal tea accompanied by fresh fruit bites. Even though we were the last customers of the day, the staff did not rush and provided us with the best experience possible.

If you're looking for a clean, professional, and truly relaxing massage experience, Zabai is the place to go. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Rajendran Vijayanaman
reviews.text: Back here after 5 years.... I am definitely not disappointed....I was here with my parents and partner for 2hr massage. My dad and partner tried original Thai, my mum did East meets West while I had Nirvana. It was truly Nirvana....the warm scrub following by the warm oil massage was sublime.  Dom my therapist know where exactly my pressure point and knots were and loosen them. I felt much lighter n well scrubbed when I walked out. My mum who is terrified of massage waa full of praises of her therapist. Her  sore arm was well taken care of. My dad never does body massage came out like he was 5 years younger.. thanks you guys ...the welcome drink of rosehip as well as post message fruit and ginger pandan honey tea was perfect! See you guys again soon....

reviews.name: Kirsten Kostomarov
reviews.text: Such a relaxing experience. We did a 4 hour spa night and felt calm and relaxed afterwards! Staff is friendly and front staff speaks English well. An unexpected feast of taro, sticky rice, fruits and fresh coconut water awaited us afterwards! Definitely found my zen! Thank you!

reviews.name: F B
reviews.text: Very welcoming and nice people. Professional massage. The only recommendation is would be great if they provide under pants like other places. My under pants was oily after the massage. But in overall great place

reviews.name: Kyungwon Lee
reviews.text:
It’s a hidden gem you should never miss.

The atmosphere is good and the massage is very satisfying. They will serve you some nice tea before and after the session which you will definitely love!

reviews.name: James Chu
reviews.text: Good atmosphere and wonderful massage skill. The traditional Thai massage not like others, here they use some lotion for your foot and back. Very comfortable e experience!

reviews.name: Haya Almutairi
reviews.text: The clinic is clean and the Hydrafacial was excellent. But when I arrived, the doctor came out, saw us, and went straight inside without giving me a consultation. Later, when I was leaving, I saw him giving a consultation to others. For me, this shows he is selective with clients. The nurses were really nice but only explained cleaning options, not based on my skin condition, and the prices are higher than expected. The clinic is mainly specialized in skin cleaning treatments.

reviews.name: Jennifer S
reviews.text: Got the gla-more-rous facial by Pang and it was the most relaxing experience. I wish I could came back every time for a hydrafacial session 😭 lovely location in The Commons and very pretty clinic, will be back next time I’m in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your kind review.
We’re very pleased to hear you had a relaxing experience with our Glam-more-rous. Your kind words for Khun Pang and our team truly mean a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you again next time you’re in Bangkok

reviews.name: Karnravee Eamvorasombat
reviews.text: Went for the fountain of youth treatment, the treatment went perfect, the skin feel rejuvenated and deep clean. The atmostphere of the clinic is very calm and relax. The staffs are very polite and nice :)

reviews.name: Poon Jeevarat
reviews.text: Fantastic! This is the unique beauty clinic in this universe. Apart from a cool decoration, I feel a high quality of service and safe treatment. I'm sure that "Every girls will love this place"

reviews.name: Ingrid Siciliano
reviews.text:
After an initial misunderstanding during my first visit, the clinic reached out and offered me another treatment. This time it was a full one-hour session (Glam facial), handled with care and professionalism. I really appreciated how they managed the situation and made sure I left satisfied.

Mistakes can happen, but how a place responds shows their real standard. They handled it very well.

reviews.name: Mariella Kuenghakit
reviews.text: The best clinic for facial treatment in Bangkok. The atmosphere and service are off the chart. Totally recommended!

reviews.name: Margot Seghers
reviews.text: I went for the rip pimple treatment, because i have been traveling for several months and my skin was breaking out badly. The salon was very nice, the lady who did my facial was so friendly and gentle. My face felt very soft and clean afterwards. 100% recommend and if i would live in Bangkok this would be my go to place!

reviews.name: Jacqueline Wechsler
reviews.text: Amazing staff and shout out to pang for the amazing treatment. Staff is super well trained and the facilities are beautiful. Great experience from the moment we walked in and out the door. Highly recommend! ✨🤩

reviews.name: Carlo Bertini
reviews.text: You can count on the doctors here. Every treatment is guaranteed for satisfaction. The clinic is located inside Silom soi 3 or Sathorn soi 6 next to the unicorn cafe. The best transportation is to drive here and to park at the hotel beside the clinic

reviews.name: Siriyapa Ariyanon
reviews.text: Me and my sisters always get facial treatments and acne care from this clinic for almost 5 years. They are using organic and mild products which work perfectly well for sensitive skin. We got well serviced from P'Blueberry. She takes care of us very well since our first visit. I would recommend you all to come and try once.

reviews.name: Chumpol Khongsakul
reviews.text: Located in the heart of Sathorn. Can walk from BTS Chong Non Si station. Good environment, great service. I can say this is my favorite place.

reviews.name: Symphony Loo
reviews.text: Thank you Wild Clinic for the amazing service and always pampering my skin. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: nichamol sriratanaban
reviews.text:
I heard lots of good things about this place …. and  YES! I Love the clinic! It’s giving a spa vibe! I had such a relaxing time and also had fun shopping lol i bought  their skin care products and room spray is so goodddd  😂
I went for fountain of youth treatment with khun Blueberry, shes very kind and very professional!

Cant for the my next treatment ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Mudmie Chuthamsatid
reviews.text: Love the place! I used to go to the Sukhumvit branch and so happy they now have a branch in Silom. Glam-more-rous is my fav treatment– super relaxing and nourishing. The staff here are super nice and friendly too 💕

reviews.name: errain kang
reviews.text:
I’ve been doing my facial treatment at wild clinic since January, even before they moved to this new branch at the commons -silom.

HARU is my favourite beautician, she speaks English and Mandarin which makes effective communication and she is very professional to suggest which treatment I should go for.

Also, she is very details and gentle, I can tell she is really doing her job well and not rushing to finish the treatment.
At the beginning, I did Poreless treatment, deep cleanse effect was obvious after the treatment. Once I had some red rash and pain on my face after a week of skin laser , Haru suggested me Rashaway treatment, it does calm my skin and cure the redness, my skin feels not dry as before. Recently I tried Glamourous and Skin high gloss treatment , can’t wait to try the Glass Glow treatment on my next visit!

reviews.name: Sasiya Suttijit
reviews.text:
One of the best clinic in BKK
The doctor and aesthetician(P'Blueberry)
are professional and good service.
There are a variety of facial treatment, which I can choose to answer my skin
and I really love the result after treatment
Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Krystle Morais
reviews.text: It was an amazing facial and i can’t wait to come back for my next one. The facial therapist was gentle yet effective, considerate and very professional. Love it so much!

reviews.name: Eva Fisher
reviews.text: I did the glam more rous and it was such a beautiful experience, my skin feels glowing after, and the girls were so sweet and kind:)

reviews.name: Samatchaya Jamorn
reviews.text: Good services and treatment. The staffs are very friendly and helpful

reviews.name: Hans Montana
reviews.text: I had the best time ever! I definitely recommend coming here, my facialist was absolutely amazing. She allowed me to have such a relaxing experience!

title: G Spa
ownerDescription: G Spa is your escape to peace, tranquility, and the complete relaxation. Surrender yourself to the warmth of Thai hospitality, a sanctuary built on the foundations of promoting a calm mind, healthy body, and joyful soul. Inspired by Thai heritage and the needs of today’s urbanite, G Spa offers a wide variety of specially designed treatments that use a combination of ancient healing therapy and modern approaches to restore, relax, and rejuvenate.
address: ชั้น 4 โรงแรมพูลแมนกรุงเทพจี 188 Si Lom Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: ชั้น 4 โรงแรมพูลแมนกรุงเทพจี 188 Si Lom Rd

reviews.name: Api K.
reviews.text:
I had a very relaxing and pleasant experience at G Spa at Pullman Bangkok Hotel G.

From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was calm and soothing, and the overall service was excellent.

The receptionist, NAT, was very welcoming and professional. She provided clear recommendations and handled the booking queue smoothly, making the whole process easy and stress-free from the start.

For the massage session, the therapist Tanya was exceptional. She was highly skilled and accurately targeted areas of tension. Her pressure was just right, and I felt noticeably more relaxed and refreshed after the treatment.

⭐️ Overall, it was a very satisfying spa experience with great service and high-quality massage. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and fully recharge.

Thanks!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We are truly delighted to hear that you had a relaxing and pleasant spa experience from the moment you arrived. It is wonderful to know that you appreciated the calm atmosphere and excellent service provided by our team.

Your kind recognition of Khun Nat is greatly appreciated. We are pleased to hear that she provided a warm welcome, clear recommendations, and smooth assistance throughout the booking process, helping to make your experience comfortable and stress-free from the beginning.

We are also delighted that Khun Tanya delivered an exceptional massage experience, with attentive care, skilled techniques, and the perfect pressure to help relieve your tension and leave you feeling refreshed and relaxed.

Thank you once again for your generous recommendation and support. We truly look forward to welcoming you back to G Spa for another relaxing and rejuvenating experience in the near future.

Warm regards,
Chalinee Raksabun
Guest Experience Manager

reviews.name: N S
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at G Spa at Pullman Hotel today. The atmosphere was relaxing and beautiful, and the service was excellent. A special thank you to Muay and Tanya for taking such great care of us throughout our treatment today. We truly appreciated their warm and attentive service. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.text:
I returned to G Spa at Pullman Bangkok G Hotel this Valentine’s Day. I have been visiting since last year, and it was a pleasure to come back again. Although I met Khun Pim this time, I did not have a session with her. My therapists were Khun Nan and Khun Tanya.

The experience began with a cold towel and a glass of bael fruit juice, which was refreshing and well presented. After completing the consultation form with Khun Pim, I selected one of three aromatherapy oil scents before starting the treatment.

The session opened with a warm foot soak and salt scrub, followed by a 90 minute aromatherapy massage. The room temperature was comfortable, the air conditioning worked well, and all equipment functioned properly. The spa also provided thoughtful amenities such as body lotion, cotton buds, a comb, and a shower cap, which added convenience and showed attention to detail.

Khun Tanya’s technique stood out. She maintained consistent pressure throughout the session and adjusted the intensity immediately upon request. She was attentive to my office syndrome areas and applied pressure precisely where needed. She also checked regularly to ensure the pressure was appropriate, demonstrating professionalism and care.

At the end of the session, a herbal hot compress was applied to help relax the muscles and reduce post massage soreness. The experience concluded with a hot tea, which was a pleasant and familiar finish.

Overall, the visit was smooth, well organized, and professionally delivered. The therapists were skilled and attentive, and the environment was comfortable. It continues to deserve a place among my top three favorite spas in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jay Radford
reviews.text:
A must if visiting Sukhumvit!

Absolutely fantastic experience at Vana Spa. The massage and experience was 10 out of 10.

Professional, deeply relaxing and exactly what I needed. The service from start to finish was warm, attentive and top-notch.

Kim was amazing, incredibly skilled and made me feel completely comfortable throughout the treatment. Highly recommended and I’ll definitely be coming back before we fly home.

title: Chang Massage - Silom
ownerDescription: Known for its previous operation in Suvarnabhumi, Don Muang Airport and Siam in the past. Chang Massage is back with elegance but refreshing tones, new energy and faces but proven experience!
address: 30 Soi Silom 2, 1 Si Lom Rd, Suriyawong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Anastasiia Makovka
reviews.text: Today I spent half an hour searching for a massage on Google😝and finally found it! I chose this place for its style and cleanliness, and my husband and I were thrilled! It's quiet and peaceful, the staff is friendly, everything is clean, and at the end they treated me to delicious tea and Thai cookies. Thank you so much! We'll definitely be back 😍💘

reviews.name: Camping By Tar
reviews.text: A bit anonymous upstairs place from the street, but once you find it, the visit is definitely worth it! Very pleasant and accommodating staff, all the way from reception to the masseuses. Got a lovely couples room, comfortable and balanced aircon and relaxing (not annoying at all) music. Professional massage, and not chit-chatting as we went along. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.name: Tamsin Fernandez-Cox
reviews.text:
Having lived in Thailand 6 years, the atmosphere / quality is not befitting of the price tag. E.g Massage is overpriced - 700THB for 1h Thai, but ultimately no different to massage parlour next door that is half the price..

Extremely noisy massage beds due to being right on the front of the road, and the rooms are not massively atmospheric - apart from the waiting area that is nice. No water/anything on arrival. Good massage quality, but noting out of the ordinary. Save yourself the money and go next door.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We're pleased to hear you enjoyed the quality of the massage, though we regret that the atmosphere did not fully meet your expectations. Creating a peaceful and inviting environment is a priority for us, and your insights will help us enhance this experience.

To clarify, we do to provide refreshments during wait times or whenever requested. In this instance, water was offered as per your request before your massage, as noted in our records. Additionally, we are actively working on improvements to minimize noise on the second floor as much as possible and enhance the overall ambiance, ensuring a serene experience for our guests.

We pride ourselves on being a premier destination for massage therapy and strive to offer a high-quality experience that stands out in our area. Thank you again for your valuable feedback, and we hope to welcome you back soon to experience these ongoing enhancements.

reviews.name: Olena Stepanets
reviews.text: It was my second visit today. I’ve got 1h Thai massage. Came with an injured shoulder and mentioned it to the masseuse. Well, she did some magic and it improved a lot. If the pain was 8 out of 10 it went to 4. I like the place and def will be back.

reviews.name: Dilyan G
reviews.text: Had a foot massage by Mon. What an amazing experience! She is very experienced, dedicated and knows exactly how to eliminate all tension built in feet and legs during travelling. The best foot massage I've ever had

reviews.name: Collin Koh
reviews.text:
Took 1H feet massage and the therapist was very good to be able to do a proper good massage.

This place is a hidden gem and I do hope they continue to provide this level of service.

Used to visit the one at Siam square but after that is closed this would be my next best place to do massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Andy Piamchon
reviews.text: Really good massage! The rooms and sheets were very clean. Masseuse was incredibly professional and proactive in making sure I felt comfortable. Truly a tucked away gem in the city. It also felt very private since it wasn't directly on the street and had to go inside a building and walk up a flight of stairs. There was also a really good smoothie bar underneath the massage parlor. Super refreshing right after a rigorous massage. Price was also so much cheaper than other competitors with the same caliber of massage therapists. Get the smoothie afterwards!

reviews.name: Miranda Tsang l Realtor
reviews.text: Amazing experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was peaceful and welcoming, and the staff were professional and kind. They also offer manicure/pedicure services and did a great job on my gel manicure. I’d definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Arisa S
reviews.text: I went for a foot massage with no expectations but was surprised by their well-trained staff, ambiance, and cleanliness. The masseuse was very professional. At Chang, they open a new package of massage balm for each client who chooses the foot massage menu, which I found very hygienic. They also gave me the balm after my session ended.

reviews.name: Jocelyn Bennett
reviews.text: Hidden massage gem! I had the 90min deep tissue massage and my masseuse was able to pinpoint and work on problem areas without me saying anything. Tucked away above Chevy Chase juice bar, it is more expensive than the other street-side massage parlours but is worth the extra. Everything is clean and hygienic,  the temperature is perfect (not humid, not too cold), and the massage beds are good quality (foot massage/ pedicure chairs looked clean and comfortable too). The staff are all friendly and clearly enjoy their jobs. We were offered tea at the start and end which was a delight. I wish I'd found this place at the start of my holiday, not the very end. Note - they do accept card

reviews.name: Neeti Mody
reviews.text: Excellent Massage, very clean, very no nonsense. Extremely kind people. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Yumyum Fu
reviews.text:
$1000/hr aroma massage

The place is nice and clean,but it only feels like someone touching my body with oil instead of massage🥲

按完=無按

reviews.name: chiaoshu YU
reviews.text:
Poor experience.
Same price as chain stores like Let’s Relax (600 baht/hour for foot massage), but much lower quality.

The only positive is the clean environment. The therapist mostly just rubbed my calves and feet without proper technique or pressure points. It felt more like skin rubbing than an actual massage.

This was the first time ever I didn’t leave a tip because the 600 baht price was clearly overpriced for the service

reviews.name: Y K
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at the massage spa. The service was outstanding, and the masseur was incredibly nice and attentive. The atmosphere was relaxing. Highly recommend this spa.

reviews.name: Sutira Uaamnuichai
reviews.text: I had the best Thai massage with Khun Bow as my therapist. Technique was excellent, and she was very precise. All my muscle knots melted away. The spa area is clean and well-designed. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: PLOY TANISORN (PLOYTANI)
reviews.text: Had a great experience here, the atmospheres are super calm and relaxing, private shower room for aromatherapy 🤍 will def come back for more!

reviews.name: Ahyeon Lee
reviews.text: Highly recommended especially for tired tourists. An hour foot massage erased fatigue from intense sightseeing. Love the atmosphere and the tea❤️

reviews.name: charlotte KIM
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Bangkok! I got a 60-minute Thai massage and my body feels so light afterward. I often get manual therapy back in Korea, so I can usually tell if someone knows what they’re doing — and Mo really does. She gave a proper, professional massage. Truly amazing!

reviews.name: PRAOPONGPHUN
reviews.text: Had a very relaxing aromatherapy massage here this morning. Very nice and cozy facility with private shower room in each and every room. Staffs were well-trained and super friendly as well. 👍

reviews.name: Mahi Tahaei
reviews.text: I was looking for a clean and peaceful space to get an oil massage, and I came here. It was very clean and quiet. The staff's behavior was very respectful. The person who gave me the massage was a very kind lady. The services here were a bit expensive, but it provided me with an experience that made me return for a second time during my trip to get a foot massage. Thank you for the wonderful experience you created!

title: Bangkok Sports Massage - Ari
ownerDescription:
Thailand's premiere sports massage services now at 3 locations: Thonglor, Phaholyothin, and Silom.

Bangkok Sports Massage Ari Branch (Phaholyothin Rd) is a mere 250m from BTS Ari.

Open since 2015 and having served over 13,000 customers (as of June 2026), BSM provides relaxation for all, not only athletes. Sports massage works exclusively with all 3 layers of your muscles to help you relax, recover, and perform better.

Our certified therapists and sports scientists are here to help.
address: Unit 20, 412 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
💪 Ready to challenge yourself in a whole new way?
Push past your limits, test your grit, and sign up for the Spartan race that calls your name 🔥

BSM will be there as the Official Recovery Partner at EVERY Spartan Thailand 2026 event 🙌
So race hard… we’ll help you recover smarter 😉

Which battlefield will you choose?
📍 Chiang Mai | 📍 Pattaya | 📍 Chiang Rai

reviews.name: Sarina
reviews.text:
Recovery day well spent ✨💆🏼‍♀️

Today I got a sports massage at Bangkok sports massage (Ari branch). It was only ฿950 per hour and totally worth it! My upper back and calves feel so much better and my whole body feel less stiff

I’ll definitely be coming back whenever my muscles start feeling tight again. 🫶🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your great review!

We are glad we were able to help you in your recovery.

Our aim is to provide our services as affordably as possible so more people can benefit.

reviews.name: Manassanan Ruangkhasap
reviews.text: Awesome experience at BSM. The massage therapists Kun Dew and Kun Gial really helped with my recovery as I play a lot of sports. I highly recommend either of these massage therapists as they are both very professional and used the right pressure. The facility is also very clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review. It is very encouraging for all of us here at BSM.

reviews.name: Yanisa Nippaya
reviews.text:
This service does not even deserve 1 star.
I booked my session through ClassPass and arrived exactly on time. However, the studio told me they had "no slots" available. To make matters worse, the staff asked me, "Why didn't you call to check first?" This is completely unacceptable. ClassPass explicitly states that users should not call the studio directly.

It is Sunday, and I had to clear my busy schedule specifically for this appointment. My time is precious. The studio offered zero compensation and unacceptably just told me to go to another branch the next day.

Is this service u expected?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K.Yanisa,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced during your visit.

After reviewing the incident with our team, we found that an unexpected internet connectivity issue prevented your ClassPass reservation from appearing in our booking system. Because of this, we were unable to contact you in advance to let you know that the appointment time was no longer available. This was our mistake, and we sincerely apologize.

We understand that you had arranged your Sunday around this appointment, and we recognize how frustrating it must have been to arrive on time only to find that we were unable to provide your treatment. While our team tried to offer alternative appointment options, we understand that this did not make up for the inconvenience you experienced.

We are already reviewing our booking procedures to reduce the chance of this happening again.

If you are willing to give us another opportunity, we would be pleased to offer you a complimentary 20-minute Red Light Therapy session with your next treatment as a gesture of our apology. Please contact us directly, and we will personally arrange everything for you.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. We truly hope to have the opportunity to provide you with the experience you originally expected.

Sincerely yours,
Surisa - Owner of BSM

reviews.name: Abdulrahman Al Wabel
reviews.text: First time visiting, and definitely not the last. Tanakrit delivered an outstanding massage — professional, relaxing, and exactly what I needed. I walked out feeling lighter, refreshed, and fully taken care of. Highly recommend booking a session with him

reviews.name: Brittany M
reviews.text:
I arrived a few minutes late and asked if that would make my massage shorter. He said no I will still get the full hour. However, my massage ended at least 10 minutes early. The massage is a bit costly so I was disappointed to not receive the full time I paid for. The massage was effective for stretching my problem areas. He focused time on the side of my shoulder and chest which I appreciated and gave tips for stretching at home. I will book again but not with Mr. Park.

Located on the second floor. Staff are nice, facility is clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We are sorry there was a lapse in service offering. We appreciate your suggestion and will improve our communications and service. 🙏

reviews.name: Thanagid Chaichayanon (M)
reviews.text: Tried sport massage here for the first time. Booking was easy, staff were friendly, and the massage hit every spot. Left feeling so much lighter!

reviews.name: Napat Romrun (Malangpong19)
reviews.text: My first hand experience with BSM was when I joined Spartan Race Thailand in Hua Hin. I got the sport massage at the event venue and it made my body ready to rock the race. Then, I decided to purchase one of the service packages there right away. This is my second time here. I highly recommend. All the staffs are very kind,  supportive, helpful and professional.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the fantastic review! We're thrilled to hear that our massage helped you at the Spartan Race Thailand in Hua Hin.

We truly appreciate you trusting us with your recovery and are so happy that you decided to purchase a package and come back to see us. It's wonderful to know that our team has made such a positive impression. We look forward to seeing you again soon and helping you continue to feel your best!

reviews.name: N I
reviews.text: amazing amazing remedial massage! Mr Park helped to release my muscle at my lower body, and made it feel better to walk. the 90 mins felt too fast and wished i had booked a longer session as i had a few issues to fix. Will definitely come back again soon!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We appreciate it and are motivated to keep providing great service to all customers.

reviews.name: Chittima Lohthong
reviews.text:
Great place for therapy. My knees feel better even after one therapy, less pain. Will come again, healing process takes more than one time in my case.
The staff is very helpful to get me the specific advices for me.
Clean place, well equipped. Easy booking process via Line OA.
The parking is tricky but the staff gave me clear instructions so I entered the right entrance. (It’s in Soi 8, don’t use the front entrance on the main road.)

reviews.name: Tom
reviews.text: such a good pleasant experience, staff all very polite and the massage was really good, deep work. listened to what i needed and did a brilliant job!! thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review! Your review is encouraging for our staff and means a lot to us. 🙏

reviews.name: Paveena J. Virojthanachai
reviews.text:
Good massage.
Might get lost from the parking building to the place a bit. But really heal my backache.

Photo taken date : August 10th 2024 / iPhone 14 pro max
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are glad we were able to help you with your issues.
Thank you so much for your feedback regarding the parking. Parking is available on the 4th floor as well as Level B1.

reviews.name: wara m
reviews.text: For everyone experiencing body pain from sports or office-related symptoms, I’d love for you to come by — you’ll feel better. The staff are very kind and really know how to relieve your pain.

reviews.name: umesh gurung
reviews.text:
120 min for 1750 baht for sports massage was all worth it.
At least based on my previous massage experiences, if you want sports massage then better go sports massage place, it makes more sense right?
Mr.Dew provided an incredibly strong and skilful much needed sports massage.
See you soon BSM.

reviews.name: Frida Kieninger
reviews.text: I am so glad i decided to get a massage here a few days ago! The masseuse wasn’t only very nice and friendly, but she also worked on the many dense knots in my back & shoulders and I feel much better now. Definitely a recommendation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for putting your trust in us for your recovery and relaxation needs. We greatly appreciate the positive review!

reviews.name: Tatjana D
reviews.text:
Had my first massage (office syndrome) with Khun Gail and it was so far the best treatment I’ve ever received.
Easy booking process and very professional and well managed massage studio. Will definitely use Bangkok Sport Massage frequently from now on.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing your experience!
We’re thrilled to hear that your first massage with Khun Gail was the best treatment you’ve ever received. She is truly skilled, and we’re proud to have her on our team. It’s also great to know that you found the booking process smooth and our studio professionally run — we work hard to make every part of your experience seamless and comfortable.
We’re very happy to welcome you into the Bangkok Sport Massage community and look forward to seeing you again soon!

Warm regards,
Bangkok Sport Massage

reviews.name: Nonny P
reviews.text: Good service. Been coming back here for the 5th time. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for putting your trust in us for your recovery and relaxation needs. We greatly appreciate the positive review!

reviews.name: Mateo Inasal
reviews.text:
Ms.Gail addressed my shoulder issue and  is very knowledgeable. Very kind and professional.

Will go again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆ ค่ะ รีวิวของคุณลูกค้าคือกำลังใจสำคัญของทีมงานทุกคนเลยค่ะ

reviews.name: Worawat Chumpangern
reviews.text:
Easy to go there by public transportation (BTS-Ari). Staff with service mind. Reasonable price.

I booked 60-minute massage for exercise. The therapist (Park) was amazing. I’m happy with an outcome. He was so thoughful. I highly recommend this place. I will go back soon!

reviews.name: Kristin M.
reviews.text:
Highly recommend a sports massage and acupressure from Kenika (Ms. Gail)! I had a quick layover back in November and decided to try out Bangkok Sports Massage and was plesantly (and painfully in a good way) surprised.

She was so strong, using her fingers, hands, arm, and her body weight to really get into my ache points. I will say I did suffer some but it was worth it, and for the times that were painfully she evened it out with more gentle and relaxing gestures to recover in between.

I rockclimb and had several problem areas that were bothering me. And I felt like I had a new body the next day, especially my shoulders!

They also served me a yummy strong hot ginger tea at the end.

I hope to one day go back 🙏 thank you so much Kenika!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms Mark,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your positive experience with us! 🌟

We're absolutely thrilled to hear that you enjoyed Gail's therapy services. It's customers like you who make our work so rewarding. Your kind words and appreciation truly inspire us to continue delivering the best service possible.

If there's anything else we can do for you, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're here to help and ensure your continued satisfaction. Thank you once again for your wonderful review!

Warm regards,
BSM

reviews.name: Sophie Neuhut
reviews.text:
A gem! I only wish I had found that place earlier.
I had two massages:
With DEW, 90’ sport massage. OMG. After 3 months travelling my muscles were tense. He managed to relax them and worked on knots in my neck and back.
Then 2 days after I treated myself to another 90’ “office syndrome massage “ with TIK. wonderful. Again he worked on knots in my whole body. Before taking a long flight that was perfect. My body and mind thank me.
They were both professional, really good (not my 1st sport manage so I can compare), attentive to the tensions and knots throughout my body, and spending time to work on them. And stop in time to not traumatise my body.
And their prices are really affordable. They have two locations in Bangkok.
I wish I could have access to such massages, professionals and affordable prices like that at home.
Thanks!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms.Sophie,

Thank you so much for your heartfelt and thoughtful review!

We’re absolutely delighted to hear that you had such a positive experience with both Dew and Tik. It means a lot to know that after months of traveling, we were able to help you relax and feel renewed—especially before a long flight. Our team takes great pride in being attentive, professional, and respectful of each guest's needs, and your kind words truly affirm their dedication.

We’re glad you appreciated both the quality of care and the affordability of our services. It’s always our goal to make expert massage therapy accessible and effective for everyone.

We hope to welcome you back whenever your travels bring you to Bangkok again. Until then, we wish you all the best—body and mind!

Warm regards,
Bangkok Sports Massage

title: Zenza Massage & Spa Phuket (Laguna branch)
address: 87 Soi Cherngtalay 14 Bang Tao Beach, Tambon Choeng Thale, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
plusCode: X8R2+6M Choeng Thale, Thalang District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Yana Domnitskaya
reviews.text: Zenza is the best massage salon in Phuket. During our vacation, we had four massages here. We really enjoyed everything, the massage therapists are very professional and do their job excellently. We were absolutely delighted with the herbal hot compress massage and all the other massages were also very enjoyable. The atmosphere is pleasant, the receptionist and all the staff are friendly. Thank you very much for the pleasure and relaxation from the treatments ❤️🌹 I kindly recommend Zenza salon to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Yana Domnitskaya,

Thank you so much for this beautiful and heartwarming review! We are absolutely honored to be called the best massage salon in Phuket. Having you visit us four times during your vacation is the greatest compliment we could ever receive!

We are thrilled that you loved our herbal hot compress massage and found our therapists and receptionist to be professional and welcoming. Knowing that we could add such relaxation and pleasure to your holiday means everything to us. Thank you for your kind recommendations, and we truly hope to welcome you back to Zenza Spa on your next trip to Phuket! ❤️🌹

Best regards,
Zenza Team 🤍

reviews.name: Aree Handy
reviews.text: Had an absolute amazing massage! Like the best I've had in years. I received a 90 min oil full body Thai massage and it was incredibly relaxing. The environment is so peaceful and relaxing from the music, lighting, massage rooms and the aroma. The staff are friendly, polite and inviting. Super bonus on the welcome drink tea and for the end of the massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear guests, 
Thank you so much for your kind words. We value and respect your opinion greatly. Your review cheers us all up so much here at Zenza Massage & Spa Phuket 
From the bottom of our hearts, Thank You! 🩷

reviews.name: Peter Te
reviews.text: Had the Swedish Fusion Massage and it was amazing. The two ladies were also super friendly and welcoming! Best Massage I had in Bang Tao and the prices are also very moderate compared to many other places like this in Bang Tao. It is also super clean and beautifully designed. See you definitely next time again!

reviews.name: Joachim Zintl
reviews.text: We had an excellent massage (oil massage) which came at a decent price for 90 min. The therapists were excellent and the strength exactly as wished. We both felt refreshed and relaxed at the same time after. Parking is easy since there is a shop just across the street (scooter and car). Staff is extremely friendly, helpful and very attentive. We can very much recommend this place for a nice relaxing and refreshing massage!!!

reviews.name: Baransel KARA
reviews.text: For those seeking a high-quality, professional massage in the Laguna area, this is a great choice. The place is very stylish, clean, and meticulously hygienic. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, and the staff are friendly and professional. The massage quality was generally excellent. While prices are slightly higher than other places in the area, the ambiance and quality of service largely justify this. However, I noticed a difference in the therapist's performance during my visits at different times; the service I received during the daytime was more enjoyable and attentive. For a more relaxed experience, it might be better to choose daytime hours.

reviews.name: Mohamed Elkilany
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Zenza Massage & Spa. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The whole place has a calm, relaxing atmosphere and is very clean and comfortable.

The massage was excellent and exactly what I needed. You can tell the team genuinely cares about their customers and takes pride in what they do. Left feeling refreshed and relaxed. Will definitely be back again. Highly recommended! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Mohamed Elkilany,

Thank you for this beautiful review and the high recommendation! 😊

We are thrilled that you enjoyed our calm atmosphere and that our massage team hit the spot for you. Taking pride in our service and genuinely caring for our guests is what we do best, and your kind words are the perfect reward for our hard work.

See you again soon on your next visit!

Best regards,
Zenza team 🩷

reviews.name: Edrie Boomz
reviews.text:
Really love the massage here that I went twice during my visit to Phuket last week!

The price is more affordable me as compared to the other posh spas around the area so that’s good for me.

The service is top notch, you’ll be taken care of!

The treats and drinks before and after the massage made the experience much better.

reviews.name: Kate Leyshon
reviews.text: Heavenly, from beginning to end! Such a welcoming, soothing atmosphere and the 90 minute oil massage was pure bliss. Also, if you're at all self conscious about your body, the low lighting in the rooms will help you feel extra relaxed. Couldn't have wished for a more wonderful experience, highly, highly recommend coming here. 10/10
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Kate,

Thank you so much for your heavenly review! We are incredibly touched by your kind words. Creating a welcoming, safe, and soothing space where everyone can feel fully relaxed and comfortable in their own skin is exactly what we strive for. We are so glad our 90-minute oil massage and the room lighting provided that pure bliss for you. Your 10/10 rating and high recommendation mean the world to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful experience! 🥰✨

Best regards,
Zenza Team 🤍

reviews.name: Laura Petrus
reviews.text: This was honestly the best massage I’ve ever had! The place looks beautiful, the atmosphere is super relaxing, and everyone was incredibly kind. I felt very comfortable from the moment I walked in. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Hasan AlKaff
reviews.text: Everything about this place is as perfect as can be when it comes to doing a massage. We did the thai massage, started with the foot scrub and it was very professional and comforting. Another thing that I haven’t seen in any massage place was that you can choose which body part to focus on, which is a game changer. Price also is a steal for what you are getting. Cannot recommend enough. Big up our masseuses, Mint, Preaw, Fha, Bee
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K.Hasan AlKaff,

Thank you so much for this incredible review! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that your experience was perfect. Providing customized care, like letting you choose which area to focus on, is something we take great pride in.

We will definitely pass on your wonderful words and "big up" to Mint, Preaw, Fha, and Bee—they will be so happy to hear they made your visit special! We look forward to welcoming you back for another amazing session.

Best regards,
Zenza Team🙏🏻

reviews.name: Sherry Shanatikarn
reviews.text: White and warm welcome place, I love they clean our feet by washing / scrub in the tub. The excellent therapists for our treatments with great promotion so I ‘d like to go back to this nice & clean spa again.

reviews.name: Aura
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Zenza.  I went on two separate occasions and each time it was great. The hostesses Pear and Apple were amazing.
I was welcomed with tea, rice cakes and coconut treat; which perfectly set the mood for my massage.
The spa space is stylish, clean and has a serene vibe.
I chose the Aromatherapy treatment with the Jasmine Rice oil. My masseuse Nouss was beyond amazing! She really focused on my knotted areas and released sore muscles. I’m also now obsessed with the jasmine rice scent.
I  highly recommend Zenza to family and friends!

reviews.name: KP
reviews.text: One of the best massage I had in a long time  Plus a very relaxing atmosphere with tea to finsh off the experience.

reviews.name: Steve Baav
reviews.text: Have headaches ver much before, but this massage help very much, one of the best on Phuket
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Steve Baav,

Thank you so much for sharing this! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that our massage helped relieve your headaches. There is nothing more rewarding for our team than knowing we could bring you comfort and relief.

We are also incredibly honored to be named one of the best on Phuket! Please take care of yourself, and whenever you need a moment of deep relaxation or relief, our doors are always open for you.

Best regards,
Zenza Team 🤍

reviews.name: Nophaket Kwanthong
reviews.text: This place is amazing! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed. The environment is clean, quiet, and very relaxing. The therapist was skilled and knew exactly where my body needed attention. After the session, I felt refreshed and much lighter. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. Nophaket,

Thank you so much for your amazing review! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you felt welcomed from the moment you walked in. Providing a clean, quiet, and deeply relaxing environment is exactly what we strive for, and knowing that our therapist hit all the right spots to make you feel refreshed and lighter means the world to our team. Thank you for your high recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful session soon! 🥰✨

Best regards,

address: 190 Thaweewong Rd, Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand
plusCode: W73W+3W Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand
hotelDescription:
This polished resort is a 2-minute walk from Patong Beach and 18 km from Wat Chalong, a Buddhist temple.
 Ranging from modern to classic wood decor, subdued rooms provide Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minifridges. Some quarters have direct pool access, kitchenettes, and/or balconies with sea or garden views. Suites add whirlpool tubs and saunas; upgraded suites offer living rooms.
 There are 9 bars and restaurants, including a Belgian beer cafe, 2 Thai fusion eateries and 1 serving halal cuisine. Other amenities consist of 4 sea-view outdoor pools, a spa and a bowling alley, plus a gym, a snooker room and a kids' club. Breakfast is available.

reviews.name: Steven Pritchard
reviews.text: We are one week into a two week stay but I have seen enough to do an honest review. We arrived to find out we had been upgraded to a Sunset pool access room which is much larger and has a semi private pool so that was a pleasant surprise. The room is great with a balcony and the pool is right there with only seven other rooms having access to it. The room service has been first class. Every staff member greets us with a smile and a hello. The buffet breakfast is terrific with plenty to choose from and the menu changes daily. We ate a bit in the Sunset beer cafe and once again service and food were brilliant. Even the lobby cafe has some great sweets available. We did have an issue with one of the other guests so I reported it to Paul who acted swiftly to resolve the situation so thanks to Paul. The guards at the front gate were a laugh a minute always standing to attention and saluting us as we came and went. We could see that they did however take their job very seriously which was good to see. If I can make some observations, ( not Complaints) At the buffet breakfast if you want to have crispy bacon the rashers need to be thicker and not paper thin because otherwise all you end up with is cardboard that tastes like bacon. Also There seems to be a lack of garbage bins in the lobby and around the resort. I found myself a couple of times with some rubbish and couldn't find a bin so I took it back to my room. Also in the buffet (and this is just me as an Aussie, I would like to see some vegemite for the toast) Overall a really great place to stay and should we return this is where we will stay. To the management of the resort well done and please pass on our thanks to all staff

reviews.name: Babbel
reviews.text:
I was really looking forward for this hotel. Fully booked even low season. Well done. However, we have to change 3 rooms to avoid the mold smell. It was so bad. After a long flight, we were wandering around to find a better room. We were in the sunset deluxe section (the refurbished one.., well i don’t think so..). Every room had the same smell. We ended up staying in the least worst one and move on, even though that room didn’t have enough water pressure in the shower.
Furthermore, day by day our clothes started getting the mold smell, as well as it was hard to sleep as the smell was getting worse when using the air condition.
Interestingly enough, none from the staff tried to have a look in any of the rooms, despite we were complaining, and the highlight was the cleaner lady who sprayed it and said “now is fine”. Ouaooo. Hahaha.
Everything else was fine, great job to the entertainment team, good location, nice breakfast.
Unfortunately, can’t recommend, unless some proper maintenance is done.
I would love to come back in a few years and see improvements.
Thank you.

reviews.text: recently stayed at Graceland Resort & Spa in Phuket from May 11 to May 16 with my boyfriend, and it was truly a 5-star experience from start to finish.The location is perfect—just steps away from Patong Beach, yet peaceful enough to relax away from the crowds. We loved being able to walk to the beach in minutes while still having easy access to nearby restaurants, shops, and nightlife.The resort itself is beautiful and well-maintained, with spacious rooms and very comfortable beds. Our room was clean, modern, and had a lovely balcony where we could unwind in the evenings. The housekeeping team did a great job every day, keeping everything spotless.One of the highlights of our stay was definitely the pool area. The resort has multiple pools, so it never felt too crowded, and there were always plenty of loungers available. It created a really relaxing atmosphere, perfect for a couple’s getaway.The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout our stay. From check-in to check-out, everyone was welcoming and helpful, always greeting us with a smile. Their service really made us feel valued and taken care of.We also enjoyed the breakfast buffet, which had a wide variety of options—both local Thai dishes and international choices. reviews.name: Mohit Sajwani
reviews.text:
Poor vegetarian options, avoid if you don't eat meat/eggs
Stayed here recently and was seriously let down by the breakfast spread if you're vegetarian. The buffet is built almost entirely around meat and egg dishes, with barely any thought given to vegetarian guests — a few bland sides at best, nothing substantial or fresh rotated in. For a resort that hosts a large number of Indian and other vegetarian travelers, this is a significant gap that should have been fixed long ago.
I raised this directly with the resort during my stay and nothing changed. Rooms were good and the location is excellent — but if you're vegetarian and considering this property, go in with very low expectations for breakfast, or be ready to arrange your own food elsewhere. Everything else aside, this is a basic hospitality miss that Graceland needs to address.

reviews.text: Graceland Phuket Resort is located across the road from Patong Beach, with many many shops, restaurants, 7-11 shops within a short walking distance. From the moment we entered the resort, from security at gates to door person to reception staff and porters, it was very clear they are exceptional with regard to hospitality. The room was spacious, spotless and comfortable . Every staff member we encountered were very friendly and attentive . We cannot fault any of the services we used from the spa , buffet breakfast ( fantastic) , room service, on site coffee shop, gift shop and the swim up pool bar staff were fantastic.  The cleaners work very hard and do a top notch service of cleaning rooms .  This was our first trip to Thailand and we absolutely love Phuket and the Thai people. Only issue we had was leaving the resort to go home after only one week 😩 We have rebooked already for next year in the sunset wing ( pool access room) for 2 weeks and can’t wait to return. reviews.name: Minx Chique
reviews.text:
Centrally located in Patong area, close to pretty much everything.

The property itself is enclosed in a very large complex with lots of sections: families, groups, honeymooners. With about five pools around the resort. The resort is very dated and in serious need of renovation.

My friend and I stayed in the Sunset section that faced the pool, it was beautifully large room with balcony. However, as there were a lot of families, it can get noisy with kids in the pool (open from 0800-2000). You can tell staff to tell people to be quiet if they make too much noise in the pool, which I totally did.

Also, the pool water is not very clear, the resort should get better filter system. I also got bad food poisoning from one breakfast dish, which I felt was contaminated (chicken pad krapao). I would recommend people to avoid that dish.

Had to minus one star for my food poisoning.

Other than that, the staff at the resort was all very lovely, especially our housekeeper, who looked after our room for ten days, she was so sweet, especially when she saw how sick I was, gave us extra water.

With a private beach on the Gulf of Siam, this upscale resort is 2.8 km from Pattaya and 9.4 km from The Sanctuary of Truth temple.
 Rooms with Asian-style decor come with satellite TV, WiFi access, coffeemakers and private balconies; some have water views. Upgraded rooms and villas add amenities such as 2-person tubs, butler service, private pools and/or sundecks.
 Beachfront dining options include a global cuisine spot, tapas lounge and casual grill. There are 3 pools amid tropical gardens, a posh spa, a 24-hour gym and business facilities. On-site parking and a shuttle to downtown Pattaya are both free. There's a speedboat to Koh Larn island.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at InterContinental Pattaya Resort.

The location is excellent, offering beautiful sea views and a peaceful atmosphere. The room is beautiful . The scenery around the resort is stunning, especially during sunset.

One thing to note is that the resort may not be the most suitable for elderly guests due to the hilly layout. However, the buggy service is extremely convenient, and the staff are always quick to respond whenever transportation is needed.

We experienced a minor issue with the shower during our stay, but it was resolved promptly and professionally by the hotel team, which we greatly appreciated.

What impressed us the most was the service. Every staff member we encountered was friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful. Their hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable.

A special recommendation is the beachside Moo Krata in the beach .The food was delicious, and the atmosphere during sunset was absolutely fantastic.

Overall, we had a very pleasant experience and would definitely return on our next visit to Pattaya. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
I recently stayed at InterContinental Pattaya Resort and had a very pleasant experience overall. The service was excellent, the room was beautiful and spotless, and I could really see that the hotel is continuously well maintained and updated. The furniture felt modern and everything worked perfectly.

One of my favorite parts of the stay was the BYREDO amenities. I absolutely loved the shampoo, shower gel, and body lotion in the Bal d’Afrique scent. Interestingly, I had just returned from InterContinental Barcelona and they used the same fragrance there as well — such a luxurious and memorable touch.

I booked a Club Lounge room, so I was able to enjoy Afternoon Tea during check-in. The presentation was beautiful and the staff provided wonderful service, although the pastries themselves tasted quite average and were mostly dough-based. The next morning, I chose to have breakfast at the main restaurant instead of the Club Lounge after the staff informed me that the lounge breakfast selection was not very extensive. Honestly, I probably would not book the Club Lounge package again, as it did not feel particularly special beyond the separate check-in experience and Afternoon Tea.

That said, if you do not mind the lack of a swimmable beach, this hotel would definitely remain one of my top choices whenever I visit Pattaya. The atmosphere, cleanliness, and service quality make it a very comfortable and relaxing stay.

Stayed 2 nights at InterContinental Pattaya and honestly, the service was what made this stay so memorable ❤️

The Afternoon Tea and Happy Hour at the Club Lounge were fantastic. There was a great variety of food and drinks, and it was the perfect place to relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

For breakfast, I tried both the main restaurant and the Club Lounge breakfast. Both were excellent with plenty of options. If you're staying here, definitely try the Steak & Eggs , it was one of my favorite dishes.

We also dined at the Italian restaurant on both evenings. A big thank you to Gel and Gigi for their outstanding service. Even though we were there for only two days, they remembered exactly what I liked to drink and took care of everything without me having to ask. Those little details really made a difference.

Overall, a beautiful resort with excellent food, great facilities, and truly exceptional service. I would happily return again.

One small tip: if you plan to spend a lot of time relaxing in your room during the day, consider requesting a quieter room away from busy areas, as the walls are a little thin and outside noise can sometimes be noticeable.

reviews.text: I have the opportunity to stay here every year, and each time I have a positive experience and leave with a great impression. This has made me a regular guest, and I can't bring myself to stay anywhere else. I especially enjoy the club lounge because the cocktail hour starts at 8 PM, which is a perfect time for me. All the staff here are excellent, except for one person in the club lounge nicknamed JJ. You know what? Throughout my entire stay, I never saw a smile from her. No welcome, no farewell, no smile, no laughter, no greeting to guests of any nationality. All I heard from her was, "What would you like?" Yes, she was doing her job, but she lacked the heart to serve. I saw other staff members chatting and interacting with guests of all nationalities; she was the only one who was so reserved and made me feel uncomfortable. Even the staff at the outdoor restaurants, the main restaurant upstairs, and the pool staff made me feel good about returning here. I don't understand why someone with this kind of personality is assigned to the club lounge, serving guests. Someone with that personality would be better suited for accounting or office work, where they wouldn't have to interact with anyone and wouldn't feel forced to work there. Anyway, I hope the hotel will listen to my feedback. I just don't want a small number of people to tarnish the reputation of the hotel I love.

reviews.text:
We were disappointed by the service and the way this property handled benefits that are expected from an InterContinental resort.

We booked through Chase The Edit, which includes a US$100 on-property credit. However, the hotel insisted on providing only 3,000 THB (approximately US$90), explaining that they could not honor the full US$100 because of currency exchange fluctuations. This was surprising, as we have stayed at many other luxury hotels participating in Chase The Edit across different countries and have always received the full US$100 equivalent. Managing exchange rate differences should be the hotel’s responsibility, not something passed on to guests.

In addition, none of the Chase The Edit benefits were proactively explained at check-in. We had to ask about the room upgrade ourselves, even though upgraded rooms were available. Guests should not have to remind the hotel about benefits that come with their booking.

While the property itself is beautiful, the service and operational standards did not reflect what we expect from an InterContinental resort or a hotel participating in Chase The Edit. We hope management improves staff training and ensures these partner program benefits are honored consistently and communicated proactively.

reviews.name: Madeleine Rotrand
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about this hotel. Overall, we had a pleasant stay, and it is a lovely property for relaxing by the pool. However, as someone who stays at InterContinental hotels regularly and is an IHG Ambassador member, I felt this property fell short in several areas where stronger management and a greater focus on the guest experience could make a significant difference.

From an IHG Ambassador perspective, the experience did not meet expectations. There was no dedicated Ambassador check-in or meaningful recognition throughout our four-night stay. Despite traveling with young children, no staff member greeted us by name or took the opportunity to engage with us personally. I also did not receive my Ambassador welcome amenities until I called to request them, which was disappointing.

While every staff member we encountered was polite, many struggled with English, making it difficult to answer even basic questions. This was especially noticeable at the Kids Club, where there were several staff members on duty, but they were unable to provide simple information and spent much of their time chatting together rather than interacting with families.

There were also several operational issues that, individually, were minor but together affected the overall experience. Housekeeping recorded that we had declined turndown service, despite never asking us. A bag of dirty linen was left outside our room for most of the day on multiple occasions, and one of our room service orders was delivered to the wrong room. The in-room television selection was also surprisingly limited, with no children's channels available, so our children ended up using their tablets instead.

The moment that stood out most to me happened on our arrival. My daughter was experiencing a medical issue, and I asked the front desk to help me contact a doctor before taking a Grab to a clinic. The staff assisted with the initial request and even took a photo to send to their manager. While the hotel had no obligation to do more, a simple follow-up call to ask how she was doing would have been the kind of thoughtful, personalized service I have come to expect from a five-star luxury hotel. Small gestures like this often leave the biggest impression. More broadly, throughout our stay we never really felt personally recognized or that there was genuine engagement from the staff.

On our final morning, heavy rain exposed what seemed to be a design issue around the breakfast area. Because there was little overhead protection, rainwater flooded the walkways, stairs, and parts of the restaurant. This created long queues, overcrowding, and a chaotic breakfast experience that felt inconsistent with the standards of a luxury hotel. Given that heavy rain is common in Thailand, this seems like an area that could benefit from a more permanent solution.

It is also worth noting that the property is not particularly accessible. Although the hillside layout is beautiful, it requires navigating numerous staircases, many of which become slippery when wet. Even the lobby does not have an easily accessible restroom, requiring guests to walk down two flights of stairs.

Overall, this is an attractive resort with excellent potential, and we still enjoyed our stay. However, I believe there is considerable room for improvement in service consistency, staff training, guest recognition, and operational management. Addressing these areas would elevate the experience and better align the hotel with the standards guests expect from the InterContinental brand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Madeleine Rotrand,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and constructive review of your recent stay with us. We truly appreciate your loyalty as an IHG Ambassador member and are grateful that you chose InterContinental Pattaya Resort for your family holiday.

While we are pleased to know that you enjoyed our beautiful resort and found it to be a relaxing place to spend time by the pool, we are sincerely sorry that several aspects of your experience did not meet the standards you have come to expect from InterContinental and the IHG Ambassador program.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the lack of personalized recognition during your stay, the delay in delivering your Ambassador welcome amenities, and the operational shortcomings you encountered, including the housekeeping oversight, the room service delivery error, and the limited television channel selection. We also regret that communication challenges affected your interactions with some of our colleagues, particularly at the Kids Club.

We are especially concerned to learn about your daughter's medical situation upon arrival. While we are glad our team was able to assist with your initial request, we fully understand how a thoughtful follow-up would have demonstrated the genuine care and personalized hospitality that should define a luxury experience. Your feedback has been shared with our leadership team, as it highlights an important opportunity for us to better care for our guests in meaningful moments.

We also appreciate your observations regarding the breakfast experience during the heavy rainfall, as well as the accessibility challenges presented by our hillside setting. Your comments have been carefully noted and will be reviewed as we continue to improve both our operations and the overall guest experience.

Your candid feedback is invaluable, and we sincerely thank you for recognizing the potential of our resort while highlighting the areas where we can do better. Please be assured that your comments have been shared with the relevant department heads for review and improvement.

We truly appreciate your loyalty to InterContinental and IHG, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you and your family back in the future to provide the seamless, personalized experience you rightfully expected.

Warm regards,

Orawan Phadungdaen
Guest Experience Manager

reviews.text:
I had a massage and body scrub here and both were absolutely top notch. The massage therapist was highly skilled and really knew how to work out all the tension, using a perfect combination of pressure and technique that left me feeling completely renewed. It was one of those sessions where you can tell the therapist has real experience and genuinely takes pride in their work.
The body scrub was equally impressive. My skin felt incredibly smooth and fresh afterwards, and the products they used were of high quality without any harsh or irritating feeling. The combination of massage and body scrub together made for a truly complete spa experience that I would highly recommend to anyone looking to treat themselves.
The place itself was clean and had a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere. The staff was welcoming and attentive, making sure everything was comfortable before and during the treatment. There was no rushing through the services, everything felt like it was given the proper time and attention it deserved.
If you are in Bangkok and want a really excellent massage paired with a rejuvenating body scrub, Rakuten should be at the top of your list. The quality of service here is outstanding and I would not hesitate to come back again. One of the best spa experiences I have had in the city.

ownerDescription: Learn to cook Thai food like a Thai, completely hands on! — from the Thai garden to the wok.
address: 225 Moo 9 เทศบาลเมืองแม่โจ้ San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand
