reviews.name: Danyal Rahman
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of attending a cooking class with Siam Garden Cooking School. My family and I booked relatively last minute the night before, but they picked us up directly from our hotel the next morning. They contacted us in advance to check for any food allergies, and let us pick the 6 dishes to cook.

The guides brought us to a thai market where we got to try some of the fresh fruit and vegetables. It was really informative and cool! Then, we went to the kitchen which was about 30 minutes from Old City. Their campus was beautiful, and they gave us a quick tour of their garden.

The teaching ability at the kitchen was excellent. The guides spoke excellent English. With so many guides helping, it was impossible to make a mistake. Everything was also clean, efficient, and informative. We were able to eat and rest in an air conditioned room in between preparation. They even had a cute dog to play with named Krapow.

It was my family's favorite experience in Chiang Mai, and I highly recommend booking with Siam Garden Cooking School!

reviews.name: Nick Smith
reviews.text:
All cooking schools follow a similar format. Pick up from accommodation, market tour. Garden tour, welcome introduction,  cooking.
I have been to several.  This is not the best I have been to but by no means the worst.
The staff would answer questions but appeared disinterested in sharing knowledge.  The market and garden tours were heavily scripted and done so many times previously that the staff appeared bored.
Good for people that have not dared venture into a Thai wet market before. The garden tour slightly interesting but the links from plant in t he ground to ingredient for cooking not always obvious.
It did spark me to get back home and get my own garden going.  My garden beds are almost ready to plant.
A good range of dishes to pick from to cook. Most people ended up with credible and edible dishes. My focus was to learn how to make Khao Soi and with the experience I gained i will be able to practice at home.
Using the ingredients given my flavour balances were not right, it would have been nice if the staff had tasted and helped me improve.
You won't learn how to cook Thai food at most 1 or 1/2 day courses, but by doing what you are told, when you are told you will get reasonable food.
Overall this place ticks most of the boxes for a Thai cooking experience, you will get well fed during the cooking and it is one of the cheaper schools.

reviews.name: Michelle De Meyer
reviews.text: We had a very good experience at the Siam Garden Cooking school. It was very interesting  to get to know more about the thai kitchen. The food was delicious and especially the hospitality was amazing. Would definitely recommend booking a cooking class in here!

reviews.name: Lavistara Yuki
reviews.text: Very interesting experience in Chiang Mai. My very first ever cooking class. The service of the staff was top notch. If you are very new to cooking, you don’t have to worry because they really guide you well. Definitely will recommend this to my friends and family.

reviews.name: Danielle Lam
reviews.text:
Thank you for a wonderful cooking experience last night.  We really enjoyed each part of the class - the market tour, the cooking garden, cooking the dishes, and the air con dining room to enjoy our delicious dinner and meet other like minded travelling foodies. Our family can't wait for us to cook mango sticky rice with butterfly pea flower with them!

🥭🥥🫶💜

reviews.name: Zachary Mindel
reviews.text: One of the highlights of our trip to Chiang Mai! This experience gave us a new appreciation for Thai food and culture. The staff is friendly and sweet and the food was fresh from the garden and delicious, authentic Thai cuisine.

reviews.name: Kevin Roux
reviews.text: My wife and I attended a cooking class at this location and it was superb. They had multiple people helping our group so it felt like one-on-one attention when you needed it. They all spoke English very well and were happy and cheerful throughout the class, making jokes and keeping the mood lighthearted. All of the food that we made was amazing, I highly recommend this as a fun thing to do in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: veini qui
reviews.text: Loved the experience. Everyone is helpful. We learned a lot. We connect to other students. All we cooked are all delicious. Hope to try those recipes back in our home. 🥰

reviews.name: Steve Millward
reviews.text:
The staff were so kind and helpful. They made the cooking experience so easy.  It’s a must do experience. We had the best time.

I feel like a top chef as the food was delicious.

Watch out masterchef 😂

reviews.name: Caleb Xävier Petcu
reviews.text: I had a super great experience at this cooking class. After we got picked up, we stopped by the market where we have been introduced to some local products and grains. We had about 20 minutes to go around the market if we wanted to buy anything. Afterwards we went to the location and we had a tour around the garden. We were explained thoroughly the ingredients and was super interesting to learn about the properties of the organic produce. Not long after the graden tour we started our cooking experience, we had 5 dishes in total which I think it was amazing plus super delicious. We started with the appetiser and soup- i chose papaya salad and chicken in Coconut milk. For mains i had khao soi and fried cashew nuts with chicken. Lastly for dessert I had mango sticky rice. I couldn't have been more pleased. I was amazed at the quality if ingredients, therefore not requiring big amounts. It was impressive to see that with just a little amount of the right ingredients you can create such amazing flavours. The team was amazing, supportive and funny. I absolutely recommend! Thank you Siam Garden Cooking School for an amazing experience!

reviews.name: Ajmal Shaikh
reviews.text: One of the best thing to do is cooking. I learnt vegetarian dishes and they have multiple veg & non veg option to learn. The class was for around 3 hours and we also went market to see the vegetable & other ingredients which are used in thai cuisine.

reviews.name: taha snj
reviews.text:
Fantastic Thai Cooking Class Experience!
I had an amazing time joining this half-day Thai cooking class a perfect mix of culture, fun, and great food!

The experience started with a convenient hotel pick-up, followed by a visit to a local market where our guide explained all the typical fruits, herbs, and spices used in Thai cuisine. We then headed to the cooking center, where we explored their beautiful garden full of aromatic plants and fresh herbs grown on-site for the class.

The cooking session itself was very well organized and full of positive energy. Each participant could choose five dishes to prepare from a list of popular Thai recipes.

The atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, and the instructors were incredibly kind, helpful, and patient. Special shout-out to "Gift", who took great care of our group with lots of energy, humor, and attention.

They also thoughtfully accommodated any allergies or dietary restrictions.

At the end, we got to enjoy the delicious dishes we had cooked ourselves everything tasted amazing!

A must-do experience for anyone who wants to learn how to prepare authentic Thai dishes and better understand the wonderful ingredients behind each iconic recipe.

reviews.name: Ingeborg Muhsfeldt
reviews.text:
Our guide was very informative. Took us to local market to view and buy ingredients. At the school they showed us how to prepare and good. Delicious 😋.
A very pleasant afternoon spent.

reviews.name: Charlie Lackenby
reviews.text: This cooking school was incredible! I highly recommend this school to anyone visiting Chiang Mai no matter their cooking ability - it is suitable for everyone! The staff were so welcoming and patient in guiding us through each step of the recipes. They also let you pick the spice level of your dishes to your liking! Thank you Cream, Gift, Bank, Aon and the team for a beautiful experience 😊🙏

reviews.name: Joseph Diacon
reviews.text:
Bubble bubble bubble… Boil Boil
I just went to this cooking school, and the experience was incredible, we were picked up at the promised time and driven to a market where we were given information on local Thai fruits and got a sense of the market culture and atmosphere. After a short drive to the cooking school, we were shown around their herb garden and informed on many of the plants that we would be using for our own menus which was a nice extra touch. The staff were incredibly knowledgeable and ran the classes efficiently for an all around incredible experience! Thank you very much!

reviews.name: Lucy
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience. We made 5 dishes here (khao soi, glass noodle soup, morning glory, spring rolls and mango sticky rice). Everything is explained so clearly and the staff are so friendly. We loved all the dishes made and were so happy with the experience.

reviews.name: H F
reviews.text:
We had a very enjoyable experience cooking a 5-course Thai meal at the cooking school with a beautiful herb/fruit garden. Our guide, Gift, did a great job instructing the cooking class and explaining all the ingredients. Our final products tasted just like in local Thai restaurants!

My only complaint is that they were late by 20 minutes when picking us up at the prearranged pickup point.

reviews.name: Shaine Miller
reviews.text: Such a well rounded experience! We started at the market and learned about all the fresh ingredients. Then onto the garden to learn about different herbs used in Thai cooking. The classes were so well organized, and the instructors were amazing. I went into this class, a little intimidated by Thai cooking and came out feeling like an expert! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: michal havlík
reviews.text: Really good thai cooking class, gift was really sweat and kind, she explained every step of the proces and the food was just soo good, and for price of 800baht i really recommend going !

reviews.name: Tilde Larsson
reviews.text: Very good cooking class in Chiang Mai! Our tour guides Gift and Cream were very sweet and helpful! Would recommend! We went here in september (low season) so we got the entire place for ourselves:D

title: WOODDY KITCHEN THAI COOKING CLASS
ownerDescription:
Make your Phuket journey unforgettable with Wooddy Kitchen Thai Cooking Class. Begin at the local fresh market, selecting vibrant ingredients while experiencing Thai daily life. Explore our tropical fruit and herb garden, then cook authentic dishes in a traditional, family-style kitchen. Halal, vegetarian, and vegan menus available. Everyone can join — kids, families, and travelers worldwide. Cook, taste, and take home real Thai flavors!

We offer two classes daily, morning and afternoon, with free pick-up in Kata, Karon, Patong, and Chalong. Contact us directly by phone or WhatsApp for the best price and clear information, or visit our website to book your class.
📞 WhatsApp/Call: +66 95 274 2719
📧 Email: phuketcookingcourse@gmail.com
address: 1 Soi Plukjae, Tambon Karon, เมือง Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R897+FV Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Syaza Mohammad
reviews.text: Wooddy was very fun and patient with us. We enjoyed cooking the three dishes, Tom Yum, Green Curry and Pad Thai. The mango sticky rice was amazing as well! He will also pick you up from your place and send you back. Timing was good also! Definitely enjoyed myself here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for review

reviews.name: Isuri S.
reviews.text:
This was amazing!!! Woody picked us up from the airport, took us to a local market to go some shopping for our meals. He is very knowledgeable and funny!

He taught us how to prep and cook the food. Everything was delicious and overall an amazing experience I will definately come back for again!

If your looking for a cooking class in Phuket I highly recommend this one!

reviews.name: ewa rowicka
reviews.text: We participated in the morning cooking class. The experience was unforgettable. The atmosphere was fantastic! We had the opportunity to visit a local market and see, among other things, how coconuts are processed to obtain the ingredients necessary for our dishes. The cooking took place in a wonderful atmosphere, and Wooddy and his team made every effort to ensure everyone had a good time. The place itself is so clean, welcoming and tidy. Highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Alyssa Davis
reviews.text:
Wooddy Kitchen is an absolute 10/5 ⭐️ experience! This was hands down one of the best meals I’ve had in Thailand—and the fact that I got to make it myself made it even more special. We learned how to cook Pad Thai, Thai Green Curry, and Mango Sticky Rice, and everything turned out incredible.

What really sets this class apart is the full experience. We visited the local market beforehand, so we knew exactly where the fresh ingredients were coming from, and the property itself has beautiful gardens that make the whole setting feel peaceful and authentic.

If you’re in Phuket, this is a must-do. Amazing food, great atmosphere, and such a fun, hands-on way to experience Thai culture!

reviews.name: majda amanina
reviews.text: Wooddy Kitchen very informative and fun! Wooddy is very kind, friendly and supportive when cooking. Very easy to follow and cook. Would recommend especially for friends and family! Thank you Wooddy!

reviews.name: Kelly Mcmillan
reviews.text: Wonderful cooking experience! From the fresh market tour to the amazing garden end to end cooking was explained. I have food intolerances and they forced for me and even taught me a meal not on the normal menu. Woody and his team are funny and informative. Highly recommend this tour!!!

reviews.name: Tina Le
reviews.text:
5 stars! This cooking class in Thailand was such a fun and memorable experience. Our instructor was amazing—so friendly, patient, and knowledgeable. He first took us to the market to buy all the fresh ingredients, which made the experience feel even more authentic and special. It was so interesting learning about the local produce, herbs, and spices before we started cooking.

We made pad see ew, green chicken curry, tom yum, and mango sticky rice, and everything turned out so delicious. The best part was that we got to make the dishes ourselves, and the instructor broke everything down into very easy, step-by-step instructions that were simple to follow, even for beginners.

The food was absolutely yummy, and I loved being able to enjoy dishes we made from scratch. Highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Thailand—it was delicious, fun, and a great way to experience Thai culture!

reviews.name: Pablo Quilez
reviews.text: Amazing cooking class!! Woody was super nice, funny, and helpful! Hands-on cooking experience. You really learn how thai cuisine works. The market tour was also great, and it’s cool that you get to choose your own ingredients. Would come back, 10/10!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks very appreciated

reviews.name: Jason Neave
reviews.text:
Woody and his team were absolutely fantastic! My wife and I took their Thai cooking class and learned how to make Pad Thai, Massaman curry, Tom Yum, and Mango Sticky Rice. Every step was explained clearly, the instructions were easy to follow, and the team made the whole experience fun, welcoming, and engaging.

The instructors were incredibly professional, patient, and helpful throughout the class, making sure that we felt confident and learned the everything properly. The dishes were beautifully presented at the end, and everything tasted absolutely amazing. It was genuinely some of the best Thai food we've ever had.

I couldn't recommend Woody and his team more. If you're looking for an authentic, enjoyable, and well run cooking class while you're here, this is an absolute must-do!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for join us Thai cooking class.

reviews.name: Sarah Ebert
reviews.text: An amazing experience definitely put this on your list to do. Chef Wooddy is very knowledgeable, friendly and helpful. The food we cooked was incredibly tasty. This has inspired me to want to cook more Thai food at home. Big Thank you 😊

reviews.name: WayneAndMary Bader
reviews.text: Wooddy and his team made us look like great chefs! We got to tag along at the market to collect some of the ingredients, and then got a garden tour for the things grown right on-site. With Wooddy’s instructions and guidance, we prepared a delicious meal of Green Curry, Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and Sticky Rice with Mango. What a fun morning, and definitely a gem in Phuket 😋!

reviews.name: Amy Jones
reviews.text: This was the most amazing activity I’ve ever done! The food was so delicious and so fresh, we bought the produce fresh from the market before the class and grown in his own garden. There is vegetarian options too (the photo is a vegetarian option) he also gives a written recipe at the end so you can recreate it at home!! 10000/10 recommend!!!!!

reviews.name: majushkina
reviews.text: Cooking classes were very detailed explained, I learned a lot. Woody was an excellent teacher so if you looking for some real thai kitchen experience I recommend! At the begging he took us to market to buy fresh ingredients and decide what we want to cook - you can choose. He also showed us his garden and his cute pet squirrel😊

reviews.name: Melissa Carr (Mel)
reviews.text:
What an incredible experience! This was so much more than a cooking class – it was a genuine introduction to Thai culture, food and hospitality.

The team at Woody Kitchen were warm, welcoming and made everyone feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The class was fun, interactive and easy to follow, with plenty of tips and techniques that we’ll definitely be using back home.

Using fresh local ingredients, we created authentic Thai dishes that were bursting with flavour. Sitting down to enjoy everything we’d cooked together was the perfect way to finish the experience.

If you’re visiting Phuket and want to do something memorable, I couldn’t recommend Woody Kitchen more highly. Whether you’re an experienced cook or a complete beginner, you’ll leave with new skills, fantastic recipes and wonderful memories.

Thank you to the amazing team for such a fun and unforgettable day. We’ll be talking about this experience for a long time!

reviews.name: Watto
reviews.text: Had a Thai cooking class today with Mr Wooddy. Fantastic class. Mr Wooddy is very knowledgeable and we made some fantastic food and had a great morning. Would definitely recommend to anyone travelling in the Phuket area of Thailand

reviews.name: Jennifer Abel
reviews.text: We did Woody kitchen through get your guide and this was a great experience! Well worth the money and the food you make is amazing! Best pad Thai and Thai green curry we have ever had!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for your review

reviews.name: Patricia Kheng
reviews.text: teacher wooddy is veryyyyyy passionate about his class!!! and the location is super duper clean and comfortable (plus point there’s aircon!!)!!  worth every penny

reviews.name: Anna Melnikova
reviews.text: Really good class, Woody showed us local market and gave tips on choosing ingredients. He also shared the technics to cook really yummy Thai dishes and we cooked them together!  Love this experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for the review

reviews.name: Shane Ostenfeld
reviews.text:
We had the most incredible experience today at Woody Kitchen! From the moment Woody picked us up from our hotel, we felt genuinely welcomed and cared for. Woody is not only an outstanding chef, but also a warm, patient and enthusiastic teacher who clearly loves sharing his passion for Thai cuisine.

The kitchen was spotlessly clean, beautifully set up, and made learning so easy and enjoyable. Every dish we prepared was explained clearly, with plenty of hands-on involvement and helpful tips along the way. The ingredients were fresh, the techniques were authentic, and best of all — the food we cooked was absolutely delicious!

This was not just a cooking class — it was a truly memorable cultural experience that we'll treasure. We left with new skills, full of amazing food, and a real appreciation for Thai cooking. We cannot recommend Woody Kitchen highly enough. If you are in Phuket, do not miss this!

Thank you Woody for such a wonderful day!

reviews.name: Karen McPhail-Bell
reviews.text: Very patient with our excitable group, delicious food - better than anything we had yet in Kata! I only got to make two of my three dishes though, would have been good to do all three. Still got to eat someone else making it though! The market visit was fun too

title: i-Like Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Thai cooking class in Chiang Mai, right on the water at Grand Canyon Lake in Hang Dong. Five hours, seven dishes, never more than 14 people per group. Free hotel pickup within 5km of the Old City.

Your class starts at a local market, where your teacher walks you through Thai herbs, chilies and pastes. Then you cook: pick your own appetizer, stir fry, soup and curry, pound your curry paste from scratch, and finish with mango sticky rice. Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options available.

Morning, afternoon and evening sessions run daily, 1,000 THB per person. After the morning and afternoon classes you can stay by the lake, swim, or take photos before we head back.

You'll go home with our e-recipe book and dishes you can actually cook a
address: 244, 2 Moo 3, Nam Phrae, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai 50230, Thailand
plusCode: MVWV+M5 Nam Phrae, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Jessica Sarah
reviews.text: Incredible activity to do in Chiang Mai! This cooking school was amazing, you get to make 6 traditional Thai dishes and learn about all the ingredients at the market first. Everything was taken care of for us making it a really smooth, easy experience. The highlight for us was our teacher, Aim, who was not only great at explaining everything to us but was also absolutely hilarious and so friendly! I would recommend I Like Thai to everyone! :)

reviews.name: Mia Byrne
reviews.text:
This experience was so so so much fun and I would recommend this cooking school over any other in chiang mai!

Not only were the views of the canyon absolutely insane but all of the staff were so lovely. From the driver, to the market guide, to the instructor, to the staff behind the scenes. All were so lovely.

We had Richie as our instructor and I don’t have a bad thing to say at all, he was so helpful, charismatic, kind, and above all else, absolutely hilarious. He was just great.

The food was delicious, and I learned so much about Thai cooking in the class, and so much about the local food and ingredients in the market tour.

10/10. If you are between this class and another business, absolutely choose this one!!!!!!

reviews.name: Mai Truong
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at the cooking school! Beautiful view and food and very attentive and fun cooking instructors. Everything went smoothly and the swimming and kayaking at the Grand Canyon was very fun too. I met Aim already a couple years prior and loved her cooking class and funny energy so much I had to come back.Thank you so much for the amazing experience Aim! :)

reviews.name: Butsaraphorn Mungmern
reviews.text: I had a great time at this cooking class! The instructor was friendly and explained everything clearly. The food was delicious, and the whole experience was fun and enjoyable. After cooking, we could relax and swim in the river, which made the experience even more special. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Phoenix
reviews.text: Richie and Brian were great and enteritaing chefs to cooking amazing dishes. Do love the energy and interaction they give throughout the process. Did learn more about Thai food at the supermarket. Vegetarian options are available replacing fish sauce with soy, and meat with tofu. The view is amazing. Do recommend to give it a go!

reviews.name: Brian Venter
reviews.text:
We had an amazing cooking class experience and couldn’t recommend it more! From start to finish, everything was perfectly organized and professional. The chef was incredibly funny, friendly, and made us feel comfortable right away, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

The kitchen was spotless, very clean, and well-prepared with everything we needed. We also really appreciated the hotel pick-up and drop-off service — it made the experience completely stress-free and convenient.

This was truly a memorable experience and one of the highlights of our trip. If you’re looking for a fun, authentic, and well-organized cooking class, this is definitely the place to book!

reviews.name: Holly Campbell
reviews.text: Best cooking class ever! Right from the start Aim was kind, informative and of course beautiful! She made the whole experience beyond worth it and with an added bonus of learning to make so many amazing dishes! Would highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!!

reviews.name: Hsuan Chen
reviews.text:
We had the morning cooking class with Am, and she was fabulous!! We adored her personality and high spirit. She introduced all the ingredients in a light and fun way. Our group was also very friendly and I enjoyed the whole session. The cooking stations are clean and the whole process organized well.

We were able to have several choices for the different 7 dishes provided, and I really liked the Tom Yum Gong, Pad Thai, Thai Curry, and Mango Sticky Rice I made. Lastly, a short kayak session over at the lake was super soothing. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a good cultural immersive yet enjoyable activity.

reviews.name: Lillie Baxter
reviews.text:
The best cooking school in Chiang Mai!
The cooking instructors were so friendly and helpful, they also spoke perfect English!
I can’t recommend this cooking school enough, the food was so fresh and tasted delicious. We got to choose from a variety of meals and cooked 4 dishes altogether. The location is absolutely stunning and could spend all day with a great canyon for you to swim in. Overall I had a wonderful day and want to do it all over again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: That makes our whole team smile! We’re so glad you had such a fun time and enjoyed every part of the experience. Thank you for cooking (and laughing) with us — hope your Thai dishes turn out amazing at home! 🙏💜

reviews.name: Nichole Stevens
reviews.text: Such a fun, educational and tasty experience! We met “Bryan” at the market and learned about the foods we would be making and selecting them. Class was hands on, delicious cooking and great conversation! Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Anisha
reviews.text: A must do when you are in Chiang Mai. I had a private cooking class with chef Richie. He’s funny, experienced and very helpful! Thank you Richie! Also the other staffs were super kind, which made this whole experience even better🫶🏼

reviews.name: Zoe Carpenter
reviews.text: Had a great experience with this cooking class! did the afternoon one and got to try and make so many dishes and so many different options! vegetarian options are great too! Oi was an amazing instructor, informative but funny and casual too. food was delicious!! only complaint is that our stomaches weren’t big enough to eat more! equipment was so good too, sharp knives and amazing pans. cant recommend more!

reviews.name: christian garner
reviews.text: My partner and I did an evening session, had the best time cooking and eating the different dishes. Staff were super welcoming, informative and friendly. Was our first cooking class and we loved it. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Talia O
reviews.text:
We came for the afternoon Thai cooking class with Ritchie and ended up having the best time! My boyfriend is not a huge fan of cooking classes but he admits that this was a highlight of our trip.
There were plenty of options of dishes to cook and even though everyone was making different things, the flow of the class went very smoothly. It ends up being quite a long day, so it was great that it was divided into sections where we could eat the starters first and then focus on the mains (everything of course turned out delicious). Ritchie made the time go by quickly with his humor and guidance.
The time afterwards to enjoy the lake was also a bonus so if you're deciding which cooking school to go with, I highly recommend this one

reviews.name: jam
reviews.text: Such a fun experience, the views were amazing the food was amazing the teacher was absolutely the best part, so funny and engaging she made it extra special if you have a chance to do a cooking class in chiang mai do it !! And do it here ! Honestly such an amazing experience after we cooked 7! Dishes we got to go down to the lake and canoe, swim and go on the floaty things and the water was almost hot !! So so fun

reviews.name: Jessica Murdoch
reviews.text: Had the best time ever at the cooking class! Richie was so lovely and funny and it was so interesting to learn about different cooking techniques. The food was so so yummy especially the massaman curry and we were sooo soo full after. So worth the money and one of the best days I’ve had in Thailand.

reviews.name: Jason LeSieur
reviews.text: We did a class with Brian and had an amazing time.  My wife loves to cook and I know nothing about it.  But we both truly enjoyed this class, it's fun for all skill levels and the food we made was the best we've had in Thailand.  There were couples and single people in our group.  It's great for anyone because you enjoy the whole experience as a group.  This is a surprise highlight of Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Kristle De La Cruz
reviews.text:
You would be so lucky if you get Ritchie, his hilarious and a great Chef! These classes are well worth it and ridiculously great value! You not only get to learn your dish but view the others as well.
It's well organised and everything taste amazing!!!!

Thank you so much to Ritchie and the crew!

P.S Love that they take time to let you buy things in the market and enjoy the Grand Canyon.

reviews.name: Rena
reviews.text: It was a really nice experience! I enjoyed cooking so much. I could never have imagined that cooking could be this fun. Thanks a lot to our chef, Aim! She explained everything perfectly clearly and made our cooking class unforgettable with her vibe and energy! Highly recommend this school!

reviews.name: Jenny
reviews.text:
A gorgeous cooking school- deserves a lot more recognition! Ritchie is lovely and a great teacher. The food we made was absolutely delicious I’m impressed we made such lovely food! & the amount of food you get here is a great value for money- you get a choice for each dish which suits for all dietary needs (I am veggie and this was no problem at all). You get to make an appetiser, soup, stir fry, curry, butterfly tea drink on arrival (super cool changes colour) & also the nicest mango sticky rice I have ever had.

The setting here is absolutely beautiful- overlooking the Grand Canyon. We found out it used to be a really popular swimming spot but not since Covid as the big waterpark opened up.

As well as a market visit, tour of the garden and the plants you then eat, the cooking class, delicious meal, you can also go down and swim on the canyon! There are kayaks and a little beach it’s gorgeous

Highly highly highly recommend!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So glad you enjoyed cooking with our team! They always love sharing Thai food and laughter with everyone. Thanks for taking the time to leave a review — it really means a lot to us 🙏

title: PUMP FITNESS
subTitle: PUMP FITNESS AND GYM CHIANG MAI

street: Chang Phuak Residence 25/1 Chang Phuak Rd Chang Phueak Rd
plusCode: QXXQ+P9 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Beautysalon Diversity
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Pump Fitness! It’s a small but very nice gym with new, modern equipment. Everything feels clean and well maintained.

The price is amazing – you only pay 100 baht, which is very affordable. You even get a free locker included, which is a big plus. They also have small extras and helpful facilities that make your workout more comfortable.

If you’re looking for a friendly, budget-friendly gym with good equipment, I definitely recommend Pump Fitness!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to write such a nice review.

reviews.name: Daniel Teurn
reviews.text:
The equipment is new and well maintained, but the gym is extremely small and feels cramped, especially during busy hours.

One downside is that even setting weights down gently creates a loud noise, yet there’s a strict “no dropping weights” rule. If you’re lifting heavy and training close to failure, that can be difficult to avoid.

If you’re a serious lifter focused on progressive overload and heavy compound lifts, this gym may feel a bit restrictive. However, for the average gym-goer looking for a clean place to get a workout in, it does the job well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Daniel. Our gym is in an apartment complex so dropping the weights heavily on the floors send vibrations up to the next floor up. Hence the 'no dropping' rule. Sorry you did not enjoy your workout.

reviews.name: Liam Lipham
reviews.text: I've been to gyms all over the world, both expensive and cheap. This gym is small but hands down nicest gym I've ever been to. It's super clean, there are always 1 or 2 cleaners walking around making sure everything is spotless. The gym-goers are also very respectful, all weights and equipment are put back and not slammed. The equipment itself looks brand new and is high-tech. On top of all of that it's only 100 baht for a day pass!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Liam. I think you summed up our gym very well. Thanks again for the review .

reviews.name: Than Raskul
reviews.text:
Really well-equipped, mad props to the efficient use of space. Clean and reasonably priced. Friendly staff and owner, highly sensible house rules (rerack, don't hoard equipment, etc.)

Bring gym shoes or rent a pair for THB 50, bring your own padlock if you'd like to use a locker.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the nice review, Than. Appreciate it.

reviews.name: Adi Cohen
reviews.text:
Such an amazing gym! Tons of equipment, new machines, and everything is well-maintained. They also have a lot of accessories, like bands and more, which is great. There’s one squat rack, one Smith machine, and a designated deadlift area. Plenty of benches and dumbbells too.

They give you a free banana at the end of your workout, which is amazing!

I would totally recommend coming here.
I trained around 1 PM, and it wasn’t busy at all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We really appreciate the positive words about our gym. Thank you.

reviews.name: Rose Therapies by Amy Rose
reviews.text:
Visited this gym once- overall it is a nice gym. I would say it’s better for upper body as there aren’t the amount of leg machines available as in other gyms. Old school feel as the machines are all very tightly next to one another. There is only one rack to deadlift or squat so may be tricky in busier times.
I have given it 4 as we went there to do legs and it just didn’t have the choice we are used to. Also very odd that they play the same 3 songs on loop - it makes you nutty!!
Clean and respectful gym users.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: This is amendment to my original reply. Thanks for your comments. Allow me to defend our gym with regards to our leg machines. We have 4 heavy duty plate-loaded leg  machines :  linear leg press, hack squat, V squat and belt squat. Most gyms do not have some of these. Pin-loaded leg  machines : 2 leg extensions and a prone leg curl. Also, an excellent hip ab /adductor and a plate loaded hip thrust to get the hips and glutes going. We believe that we have more than adequate equipment for good leg training. Yes we have a small gym. But lots of equipment. Please try our 1000+ SQM Pump Fitness 2.0 location at the South Gate of the Old City.

reviews.name: Benito
reviews.text: I've been a regular customer of Pump Fitness for 3 years now and I cannot be more happy. Before I had tried other gyms in Chiang Mai but this is exactly what I was looking for. Well located, AC, clean, small but with an excellent equipment (continuously renovated), good atmosphere and great staff. They offer a wide range of prices depending on the suscription; one day pass is currently (2026) 100bh. I totally recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for this lovely review, Benito. We truly appreciate your loyalty to our gym.

reviews.name: Degen Hill
reviews.text:
Really nice gym. Super clean, all equipment is brand new, and it has everything you need for a solid workout.
Squat bench, bench press, smith machine, dumbbells, barbells, cable machines, and various cardio equipment.

1 day costs 80 baht and luckily, it was open over the New Year (12.31, 1.01, 1.02). Would definitely recommend this gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive words. We replace machines with new ones all the time.

reviews.name: Evan Garr
reviews.text: Best gym I’ve been to since traveling around both Thailand and Japan. They have just about everything you need. Their staff was super friendly and it’s VERY affordable for what you get. I would’ve liked a sled but I know that’s a lot to ask from any gym so it’s fine they don’t have that (NOT a criticism but I’m sure they’ll focus on this in their response lol). I also didn’t see any protein shakes but I also didn’t ask and there’s plenty of macro-meal options around the area. If you’re in Chang Mai and want to get a workout in, this is the spot you need to go!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We just don't have the space for a sled. Thank you for your review.

reviews.name: Stanislav Kanderka
reviews.text: As a fitness center operator, I had the opportunity to personally visit this amazing gym and it was an unforgettable experience for me because I have never seen such high-quality service, professional machines and a clean gym anywhere in Thailand. Pump Fitness can undoubtedly be the perfect motivation for all fitness service providers not only in Thailand but also anywhere else. I recommend visiting this gym to every athlete who will come to Chiang Mai and wants quality training in a perfect environment !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Stanislav. As a fellow gym operator, your positive review means a lot.

reviews.name: Raizza Aliviado
reviews.text: Lots of equipment, quiet location, not so crowded (i went at 1-2pm), very clean —staff always clean the equipment right after  you use it, have free lockers , air conditioning, and nice staff (receptionist don’t speak English that much but it is fine). I did day pass for just 100 baht!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Raizza, for your visit ans youe lovely review.

reviews.name: Olym
reviews.text:
A nice gym with lots of equipments, could get busy sometimes. My issue with it is that there’s not enough space for everything, you’ll have to squeeze through to reach somewhere, and I keep seeing signs about the stretching area, but there was absolutely no where that I could stretch after work out.
Price is decent, staff are super friendly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Yes, we made a conscious decision to fill our gym with a lot of the best equipment, which the majority of our customers really enjoy exploring and using. And it is at the expense of space. We had to choose. The stretching area is small, but people seem to make do and we do have a great body stretching bench. Next time you're in town, you can visit our 2nd location, Pump Fitness 2.0 at the south of the moat. It's a lot larger.  Thanks for the review

reviews.name: Terence Tay
reviews.text: Excellent gym with good range of machines and gym receptionist. You can't go wrong training. It's not crowded unlike the larger and more established gyms. The price might be a little higher but not much more. For anyone looking to train in a gym that is clean and uncluttered with good support staff, consider this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Our 1-time charge is 80bt. Most gyms charge 60bt but NONE of them have ALL brand new equipment and FULL air conditioning AND a full-time cleaner like us. We feel the 20bt extra is more than justified. If you visit Chiang Mai again, please drop by.

reviews.name: Luxury thai
reviews.text:
a complete fitness room which has modern functional machines and a lot of accessories for torture your muscles haha !

The gym is located in front of Thailand National Sports University Chiang Mai Campus, so you’ll find lots of hot and fit women. ;)

Beginners as well as advanced cardio machines. Highly recommend….
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for taking the time to write such a nice review. Please come again.

reviews.name: Philipp Hirschler
reviews.text: My favorite gym in Chiangmai. It's rather small but equipment is excellent and well maintained. It's also clean and aircon is good during hot season. Day pass at 100 thb is great value.

reviews.name: Maibritt Pieper
reviews.text: Really clean and nice gym, good atmosphere with music. On the smaller side but people are very considerate of eachother
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Maibritt. It is a nice summary of what our gym is about. Appreciate it.

reviews.name: artemiy rubtsov
reviews.text:
Excellent gym with a lot of modern and new equipment. Restrooms are clean all the time and all benches get cleaned always.
They don’t have a water machine tough, but you can buy a bottle for just 10 baht. Current daily pass is 100 baht which is extremely cheap for what you get. Definitely my favorite in town.
(If you come early in the morning you even get a free banana :) )
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks. Let me explain. Drinking water is expensive in Thailand. Tap water is NOT potable. At 100 bt a workout, unfortunately, we cannot afford to offer a water machine. Glad you enjoyed your visit. Thanks for understanding.

reviews.name: Rick de Jong
reviews.text: Very nice gym with tons of equipment. Some of them a bit strange, but if you want to workout, this is a nice gym to try. Price per day is just 80 bath.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the review. Yes, our equipment is the latest, newest stuff, so s lot of customers have never seen them before. And we have new items all the time.

reviews.name: oliver Zhang
reviews.text: Best gym in Chiangmai as know. there are plent of fitness equipments，and new. and it has good air condition，in just suitable temperature，which is very impartant in thailand as I think. 100B per day.1000 per month.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the nice words.

reviews.name: Francisco Becerra
reviews.text:
I made a good research before entering to any gym in Chiang Mai. We were working remotely for 2 weeks here and we wanted a good gym to have decent workouts. This had everything we needed: good value for the money, great machines, and AC was not mandatory but a big plus.
Here they have really good machines even better that the ones you usually see in western gyms. My personal workout routine ideally requires a good variety of machines and they have a great selection for every muscular group. The gym is VERY clean, there is always one person cleaning.
AC works great and you feel fresh the whole workout.
It can get a little bit crowded in the morning, but it becomes less busy around noon.
Also they seel water for 10/20 bahts and have free bananas 🫶🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for taking the time for that nice detailed review. Appreciate it and glad you liked our gym.

title: Thai Cooking Class Phuket by Tony
ownerDescription: Join our top-rated Thai cooking class in Phuket and learn to cook authentic Thai dishes in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Perfect for travelers, families, and food lovers, our hands-on classes guide you from fresh ingredients to delicious meals you can proudly recreate at home. With over 1,000 five-star reviews across all platforms, we’ve been sharing the joy of Thai cooking for years and we can’t wait to welcome you!
address: 80/7 Phanason Residence, Wichit-Songkram RD. Wichit, Muang, Maung, Phuket 83000, Thailand
street: 80/7 Phanason Residence, Wichit-Songkram RD. Wichit, Muang
plusCode: V9V6+QQ Wichit, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Special Promotion – Cooking Only Class (No Market Tour)
Enjoy a more relaxed Thai cooking experience at a special price!

Join our hands-on Thai cooking class without the market visit—perfect if you prefer to start later and focus fully on cooking. Learn authentic Thai recipes step by step with our local chef and create your own delicious meal.

✨ 20% OFF – Limited Offer (Direct Booking Only via WhatsApp)

What you’ll cook (4 dishes):

Stir-fry (Pad Thai / Pad Krapao / Fried Rice – one choice per group)

Dessert (Mango Sticky Rice or seasonal dessert)

Class time:

Morning: Start at 10:30
Afternoon/Evening: Start at 17:30

Highlights:

Same full cooking experience (4 dishes)
Smaller group, more time to cook
All ingredients included
Vegetarian / vegan / gluten-free options available
Eat what you cook

Location: Phuket Old Town
(Search: “Thai Cooking Class Phuket by Tony”)

👉 To get this promotion, please book directly via WhatsApp

Perfect for guests who want a shorter, easier schedule—no market, just cooking!

reviews.name: Rosa Garcia
reviews.text:
Today’s cooking class with Anne was the best. She took us all from scratch on a fantastic cooking class in Phuket, Thailand.
We took a Taxi to one of the local Kathu (?)Market to buy fresh produce for the 4 dishes we were cooking today.
Once we bought fresh ingredients we proceeded to be transported to Tony Cooking Class in Phuket.
Once there we cooked together, she showed us step by step what each ingredient smelt like, what it was used for, how to use knife effectively.
Each dish had a meal prep procedure shown to us, after she showed us, we had to use what we saw and do it our selves.
My children and family friend enjoyed the dishes we had to cook. Finally eating at the table was such a delight.
I strongly recommend coming here as an activity to do with friends and family.
Anne was enthusiastic and very experienced and I could see her love for cooking!.

reviews.name: Jarek Barc
reviews.text: I’m no chef. On most days I can successfully boil water. So trust me when I say, if Chef Ann can teach me how to make Thai dishes, she can do the same for you. We cooked Tom Yung Gong, Pad Thai, curry, and had a choice of various versions of each dish. We were also treated to a dessert afterwards. Chef Ann’s kitchen and dining area is clean, professional, and her style is fun and relaxed. We all had a genuinely good time.

reviews.name: Nithiya Pillai
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the Thai cooking class with Chef Ann. She explained the different Thai herbs in a very detailed but easy-to-understand way, which made it much easier to follow along even without prior experience. She was also very generous with the ingredients, so we got to fully enjoy the cooking without worrying about portions. The whole class felt relaxed and hands-on, and the dishes turned out really tasty. Overall, it was a fun and informative experience, and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone interested in Thai cooking. Look for Chef Ann if you wanna the extra touch of home style cooking.

reviews.name: Kerry Searle
reviews.text: The BEST food we’ve had so far in Thailand after our first month here. Ann guided us through everything and is a very talented chef. She made it fun, informative and delicious. We left with full bellies and new skills. The food is really great, recipes easy to follow, and brilliant examples of Thai cuisine. Nice small group, very clean kitchen. Thank you very much.

reviews.name: Rebeca Avellaneda
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience at this cooking class! My fiancé and I joined Tony and his team, and they did an outstanding job from start to finish.

The local market visit was such a highlight — we learned so much about the ingredients and Thai culture before even stepping into the kitchen. It made the whole experience feel authentic and immersive.

We cooked four different dishes, and every single one was better than the last. There was so much food, we could barely finish it all — but we didn’t want to stop eating because everything tasted incredible!

Tony and his team were welcoming, knowledgeable, and made the class both fun and easy to follow. It felt like cooking with friends rather than attending a formal class.

We will be back :)

reviews.name: saskiafrica
reviews.text: A one-of-a-kind experience with Chef An. She is so humble, kind & patient. We've learnt a good few dishes and so grateful to have found this class! The kitchen is clean and so efficient. Chef Tony was also great, offering suggestions and answering all of our questions. Highly recommend 👌

reviews.name: Jane Tung
reviews.text:
I had a such an amazing cooking class with Chef Ann💫 and it was the best meal I’ve had in Phuket so far (stayed for 2 weeks) 🙌🙌

She is so patient and detailed, walking me through every step while sharing fascinating food knowledge — from ingredients and spices to the differences between home cooking and restaurant meals. Truly a passionate and lovely instructor‼️‼️

An incredible hands-on class that I highly recommend everyone to come while staying in Phuket 🫶🏽✨🎖️

reviews.name: Aly
reviews.text: Lovely time with Ann at the cooking class — she brought us around the market to shop for the ingredients to cook the dishes for today, and explained in great detail how to cook the dishes. She was so friendly and her pleasant attitude made the experience even greater! Last but not least, the food was so yummy and portions were so big! Definitely would recommend :)

reviews.name: Linsey McLean
reviews.text: Wow! If you love food and want a true culinary delight, there is only one place! Can’t recommend Thai Cooking Class Phuket by Tony. Chef Ann took us to the food market, shared her vast experience with us and we have 4 dishes to eat. Lunch and dinner. Fantastic experience, can’t recommend enough. Thank you so much Tony, Chef Ann and the lovely ladies 💕

reviews.name: Bea Baker
reviews.text: We had a great time at Tony’s cooking class. We made lots of great food and Tony walked us through it with excellent professionalism and cleaning crew! Got very full and got to take home the dishes we made. Great way to experience Thai Culture and learn about cooking and local food. Thank you Tony for a great night with laughs and fun!

reviews.name: Kelsie
reviews.text: Such a fun and authentic thai experience! Tony and Ann took us to the local market to pick out fresh ingredients before heading back to make everything together from scratch. Tony teaches each meal in a way that is approachable for beginners and simple to try to recreate at home. Ann also makes sure to capture lots of group photos which was much appreciated! Thank you for such a wonderful experience!!

reviews.name: Davin
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at the Thai cooking class run by Tony and Anne. The whole experience was relaxed, fun, and incredibly well organised. Tony and Anne are both super knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate about Thai food, which made the class enjoyable no matter your skill level.

We cooked a variety of authentic Thai dishes from scratch, learned about ingredients, flavours, and techniques, and best of all got to eat everything we made — which was unreal. The food tasted just as good as what you’d get in a great Thai restaurant.

The atmosphere was friendly and welcoming, instructions were clear, and there was plenty of hands-on cooking. You never felt rushed, and questions were always encouraged.

If you’re visiting Thailand and want a memorable experience (and to actually learn how to cook proper Thai food), this class is a must-do. Huge thanks to Tony and Anne — easily one of the highlights of the trip.

reviews.name: Angelina Sophia Gast
reviews.text:
One of the best things we did in Phuket! We joined Thai Cooking Class Phuket by Tony (with Ann) we were the only two who booked that slot, so it ended up being just the two of us — which made the experience even more special.

Ann was the absolute highlight: super friendly, funny, and incredibly skilled. She explained everything step by step and made the whole class feel relaxed and almost family-like. The local market visit was genuinely authentic — Ann showed us so many ingredients, told us about life in Thailand, and even treated us to local sweets. It honestly felt like being shown around by a favourite aunt.

The cooking studio was spotless and very hygienic. We cooked Tom Yum & Tom Kha, Massaman & Panang curry, Pad Thai (one vegetarian and one with shrimp), and mango sticky rice — everything tasted amazing. One of the best meals we had in Thailand.

We’d come back anytime and can recommend this class to everyone visiting Phuket!

reviews.name: Brittany Spencer
reviews.text: I could not recommend this cooking class more. I was the only person booked into this class and was treated with a one on one class by Ann. She took me to the market to collect ingredients for our class and took the time to explains everything as we worked our way through. She also bought me a Thai style iced coffee and fresh fruit juice. She took her time to explain not only how to prepare and cook the dishes I had selected but also how to apply this to different curries and Thai dishes. Ann was an absolute delight to spend the morning with.

reviews.name: Mathias Rolen
reviews.text: A wonderful host, great indoor space and a exciting visit to the local market! Would highly recomend to any and all who find interest in thai cuisine.

reviews.name: Manish Mehta
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Outstanding Thai Cooking Experience with Tony in Phuket!

As someone with intermediate-level cooking experience, I joined Tony’s Thai cooking class hoping to refine my techniques and learn more about authentic Thai flavors — and I was completely blown away!

Tony is not only a skilled chef but also an incredibly patient and engaging teacher. He explained each step clearly, offering great insights into balancing sweet, sour, salty, and spicy elements — the essence of Thai cuisine. Even though I’m comfortable in the kitchen, I learned so many new tips and tricks, from achieving the perfect wok temperature for stir-frying to spring roll making.

The kitchen itself was spotless — genuinely one of the cleanest cooking spaces I’ve seen in any class. The ingredients were top-notch and incredibly fresh, which made a huge difference in the final dishes. You can tell Tony takes great pride in the quality and presentation of everything he provides.

By the end, I felt confident recreating the recipes at home and gained a much deeper appreciation for Thai cooking techniques. Whether you’re a beginner or already experienced, this class is an absolute must-do in Phuket. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Hye Ju Song
reviews.text: Tony and the entire staff were incredibly warm and kind, which made the experience even more special. Even though I’m not confident in my cooking, the dish I created with Tony turned out surprisingly amazing—it honestly felt like magic in the kitchen. I’ll never forget this experience, and I would love to come back and join the class again someday. Thank you so much for such a wonderful memory.

reviews.name: Burhan Riaz
reviews.text: Not only was this a great cooking class, we had the best food so far during our stay in Thailand. Ann especially took care of us and was entertaining and highly knowledgeable. We also had a bunch of food to take to our hotel as leftovers.

reviews.name: Bob Stan
reviews.text:
Thai Cooking by Chef Tony in Phuket was hands down one of the highlights of our trip! Chef Tony has an incredible gift for simplifying what can feel like complex Thai recipes into clear, easy-to-follow steps. In just a few hours, we went from total beginners to confidently preparing multiple authentic dishes from scratch.

He broke down each ingredient, explained the balance of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy (the heart of Thai cuisine!), and made sure everyone felt comfortable at every step. What we loved most was how he turned what could have been intimidating into something fun, relaxed, and totally doable.

The class was interactive, informative, and full of flavor—literally. We left not only with a full stomach but with real skills we can use at home. If you’re in Phuket and want an authentic, hands-on experience that’s both educational and enjoyable, Chef Tony’s class is a must. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Robert Clark
reviews.text: Our class started out shopping for some of the ingredients  at a local market with chef Ann. It was an eye opener to see all the organic foods there. Then it was back to the kitchen for our cooking class.  Chef Ann was excellent teaching us about Thai cooking - lots of fun. Food tasted wonderful. Thank you Chef Ann and her sous chef (sorry forgot her name) for sharing your knowledge on Thai cooking. Would highly recommend this activity.

reviews.name: Lydia Tan
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Cherry. She is an excellent masseuse with truly exceptional, personalised service. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with a refreshing drink and fresh fruits, which made me feel instantly relaxed and well taken care of.
The massage itself was amazing — Cherry was attentive, skilled, and clearly experienced, tailoring everything perfectly to my needs. After the massage, I was treated to a delightful dessert of mango sticky rice and tea, which was such a thoughtful and special touch.
This was more than just a massage; it was a full, luxurious experience. Highly recommended, and I will definitely be back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lydia Tan,

Thank you so much for sharing such a beautiful review. We’re truly delighted to hear that you had an absolutely wonderful experience with Cherry.

We’re so glad everything helped you feel relaxed and well taken care of. Cherry will be very happy to know that her attentiveness, skill, and experience made such a positive impression and that the treatment was perfectly tailored to your needs.

We’re also pleased you enjoyed the mango sticky rice and tea after your massage. Thank you for describing it as a full, luxurious experience; that means a great deal to us.

We sincerely appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

Kind Regards,
Olivia A.
Assistant Guest Relations Manager

reviews.name: WJ Ang
reviews.text:
Visited for a full body massage and had a really great experience.

The reception team was very detailed in explaining the different massage options available and made us feel very welcomed from the start. The therapists were highly skilled and very well trained, the 2-hour massage passed by so quickly that I even wished I had booked a 3-hour session instead.

It also happened to be my friend’s actual birthday, and the team thoughtfully prepared a slice of cake for her, which was such a sweet gesture and made the experience even more memorable.

The environment was relaxing and comfortable throughout. Definitely a place I would come back to again when visiting Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear WJ Ang, Thank you for your wonderful review. We’re delighted the reception team, therapists, and relaxing environment made your 2hour massage so enjoyable. We look forward to welcoming you back next time you’re in Bangkok and would be happy to arrange a longer session for you. Kind Regards, Olivia A. Assistant Spa Manager

reviews.name: Etty Mosli
reviews.text: From the moment I walked in, I felt completely relaxed. The peaceful atmosphere, the thoughtful selection of essential oils, and the incredibly pampering massage made this an unforgettable experience. Every little detail was carefully considered, making the entire visit feel truly luxurious and special. Everything was simply perfect. I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for a relaxing and high-quality experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Etty Mosli, Thank you so much for your beautiful review. We're truly delighted to hear that you felt relaxed from the moment you arrived and enjoyed every detail of your experience. Your kind words mean so much to our team, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another luxurious and relaxing visit soon. Kind Regards, Olivia A. Assistant Guest Relations Manager

reviews.name: Padcha W
reviews.text: The spa is really nice and clean, with a modern and cozy ambiance. I did a 120-minute massage with Khun Cherry, and she’s truly amazing! If you have office syndrome, tightness from sports, and prefer medium to strong pressure, I highly recommend Khun Cherry. She really puts her heart and soul into every stroke. I’ll definitely come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear P W, 

Thank you for the wonderful review. We're delighted you enjoyed our clean, modern, and cozy spa and that Cherry gave you such an effective massage. We will share your kind words with Cherry, she will be thrilled to hear she helped with your office syndrome tightness. We look forward to welcoming you back soon. 

Kind Regards, 
Olivia A. 
Assistant Guest Relations Manager

reviews.name: Worawalan Bunyamalik (Meen)
reviews.text:
I had a fabulous and truly relaxing time. Thank you to Massage Therapist Ann for giving me one of the best massages I’ve had in a long time. The pressure was perfect and every spot was expertly treated.

All of the staff were very welcoming, and the service was excellent. The snacks were also a lovely touch. I really enjoyed my experience and had such a wonderful time here. Highly recommended! Definitely be back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Worawalan Bunyamalik (Meen), Thank you for your wonderful review. We’re delighted Ann gave you one of the best massages you’ve had and that the pressure and treatment were perfect. I will share your kind words with Ann and the team, they’ll be delighted to hear it. We look forward to welcoming you back soon and truly appreciate your recommendation. Kind Regards, Olivia A. Assistant Spa Manager

reviews.name: D C
reviews.text:
I had two spa sessions at this location: a traditional Thai massage with Pui and the Infinity-Aroma session with Cherry. Both were absolutely amazing—they worked real magic on my body! You cannot ask for a better masseuse!

The service was excellent, and overall the experience exceeded my expectations. Easily one of the best massage spa in the Sukhumvit area. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear D C,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed both the traditional Thai massage with Pui and the Infinity Aroma session with Cherry. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we’re thrilled that the service and overall experience exceeded your expectations. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another relaxing visit.

Kind Regards,
Olivia A.
Assistant Guest Relations Manager

reviews.name: mex dir
reviews.text:
Best deep tissue/sport massage I ever had! 2 hours firm massage... Wow, Tina was such a great Masseuse, so so strong and always adjusted her massage to my needs in terms of location or firmness, she had a great feeling for my hard muscles. I am feeling totally relaxed now 🥹🙏🙏🙏❤️❤️❤️
The whole place is wonderful, clean and fresh and all the staff is extremely kind and friendly.Wonderful Tee and fruits/sticky rice before and after the treatment. Real luxury!

Thank you so much and see you soon!
Sarah
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing Infinity Wellbeing.

We’re delighted to hear that you had such an amazing deep tissue massage experience. Tina will be so happy to know that her strength and ability to adjust the pressure and focus areas made such a difference for you.

We’re also glad you enjoyed the clean and relaxing environment. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team.

We look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

Kind Regards,
Olivia A.
Assistant Guest Relations Manager

reviews.name: Lorene Millet Trost
reviews.text:
My favourite spa of all time and the ultimate five-star experience. Every time I come to Bangkok, I pay a visit to Infinity religiously! Every aspect of it is top-notch: from the facilities to the services offered; from the welcome check-in to the post-treatment treats; from the products used to the staff — it is a FLAWLESS experience.
Infinity has a special place in my heart, and I am very much looking forward to my next visit 🤩
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Lorene Millet Trost, Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing Infinity whenever you're in Bangkok. We are thrilled to hear every aspect of your experience was flawless and that we hold a special place in your heart. Our team will be delighted by your kind words. title: Olivia Massage 3
address: 111/4-5 Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Fakhruddin
reviews.text:
After walking around Bangkok for most of the day, I felt that a foot massage was exactly what I needed before heading back to my hotel for the night. While exploring the area near my hotel, I noticed Olivia Massage 3 and decided to give it a try.

One of the main reasons I chose this place was because it was much quieter than the neighbouring massage parlours. I generally prefer a peaceful environment when getting a massage, and this seemed like the right choice.

I arrived at around 11pm and booked a 1-hour foot massage. The therapist assigned to me was very good, and the massage was exactly what my tired feet needed after a long day of walking. The sofa was also surprisingly comfortable, so much so that I ended up falling asleep during the session.

The entire experience was relaxing and hassle-free. By the time the massage ended, I felt refreshed and ready for a good night's sleep.

One thing I felt bad about was that I wanted to leave a tip for the therapist, but I realised too late that I did not have any small notes or change with me. Sorry about that. I will definitely be better prepared next time.

Before leaving, I was given a bottle of water, which was a thoughtful gesture after the massage.

Overall, I was satisfied with the experience. Good massage, comfortable seating, a quiet atmosphere and a thoughtful service made it a pleasant way to end the day.

reviews.name: wk
reviews.text:
Very mediocre massage, poor service! We bought 1.5hour oil massage at ฿800 but the massage finished at 1hr5m ish! No greeting service, no water, no slippers, no lemongrass tea whatsoever!!

The masseur’s phone kept vibrating on the same bed throughout the session. In the end, the massage just ended abruptly without those typical head massage and back pulling etc. Won’t return and won’t recommend at all.

reviews.name: WT
reviews.text:
The quality of the massage from the masseuse that I got was ok, nothing amazing or not that bad either.
The place looked inviting from the outside, the staffs were a lot more friendlier than the receptionist lady (man be the owner). She was more rather rude, didn’t say anything and just demanded for money not even a smile.
So I don’t think I will go back. Plenty of other places around. Not sure how they got 4+ stars though.

reviews.name: Will Chen
reviews.text: 所有人避雷！ WORST experience ever in Thai! we paid 1 hour Thai and 1 hour oil. because of a little wound of my feet, I didn't wash my feet and go up to the room directly to wait. the guy came in at 8:30 and finished at 9:25(and it's not Thai massage at all, just like touch! the guy even used his mobile for messages while I faced downk) Then we went downstairs to another room for oil massage. he came in at 9:40 and finished at 10:15! we paid for 2 hours and at last we received 90mins Services! Which is even worse! the boss told me it started when you washed your feet, and no matter how long you wait in the room. The minute you step inside, your clock tiks! ridiculously bad and unprofessional!

reviews.name: Ricky Au
reviews.text:
I’ve visited Thailand many times and had massages at various places, but unfortunately this was the most disappointing experience I’ve had so far. I would not recommend this place to anyone seeking a proper massage.

At the shop entrance, I clearly asked for a 2-hour full body oil massage. I was then told it was sold out, which made no sense at all, as there were clearly other therapists available at the time. In the end, I was only offered a 90-minute massage, which was not what I originally requested, leaving me completely confused and disappointed by the explanation.

The room was extremely small and stuffy, making it impossible to relax. The therapist had to keep moving the massage bed to adjust her position, and I could also hear beds being moved in other rooms, which completely ruined any sense of peace or privacy.
If you are looking for a quiet and relaxing massage environment, this place is definitely not suitable.

Another serious issue was the massage bed design  there was no face hole for lying face down, making it very uncomfortable and difficult to breathe.

As for the massage itself, the technique was extremely poor. A proper oil massage usually starts from the back, but the therapist started directly from my chest, which felt very unprofessional and awkward. The rest of the massage was just random rubbing on the legs and arms, with no technique or flow at all.

I eventually asked to stop and change to another therapist. The second therapist was slightly better than the first, but unfortunately still lacked proper skills, and I was never able to fully relax throughout the session.

Overall, this was by far the worst massage experience I’ve had in Thailand. I genuinely do not understand how this place has a 4.6-star rating on Google.

reviews.name: Pier
reviews.text: From the reviews I expected a very good massage but than I realized it was very poor and simple. There was not a very appropriate technique. The cabin upstairs for massage was also super tiny and the lady had issues while massaging me because the space was very small. She touched many times the massage table. Unfortunately this was my experience.

reviews.name: Prettynice
reviews.text: This was the only massage place we visited in 5 days that asked for tips on top of their so-so service. The masseuse even body shamed me when asking for tips for having to massage my XL body for 2hrs. The sheet on the massage bed was probably used for few days, towel used to cover my body was damp. I will go to Urban Thai next door next time!

reviews.name: leej2630
reviews.text:
Been in Bangkok for a week. Found gem of shop called Olivia Massage on Surawong St. The staff are friendly, massage was awesome! You definitely get your money’s worth.
You’ll find your favorite therapist. I found mine: #49! I highly recommend him. You won’t be disappointed! Guaranteed to leave shop totally rejuvenated!
Karp kun kup!
Jim from Hawaii

reviews.name: Nisha
reviews.text: One of the worst massages I’ve had—there was no consistency or flow. It felt like the therapist was randomly pressing on spots they happened to remember. Most of the pressure just came from them leaning their body weight onto me. The lighting was harsh rather than calming, and there was no soothing music to set a relaxing mood. Overall, the experience felt impersonal and rushed—more like a conveyor belt than a place of relaxation.

reviews.name: ALGIS MIDVERIS
reviews.text: 8 of us came second time!!!  My  Strong masaage was done by men  Nr 46 -!!!!   Price -400 baht food massage ( and left 50 baht tips to everyone) -only in cash-with botlle of water after massage...

reviews.name: Suradej Porntavetat

reviews.name: Agne Dirgele
reviews.text:
THIEVES I CAN NOT BELIEVE IT!! 🆘We got robbed at the salon‼️
Me and my husband after long trip deciced to treat ourselves and went to this salon for foot and body massage. First we got a foot massage which was ok and then we been asked to go upstairs for full body massage. They have send us to separate rooms which at first seemed very strange as normally if you are couple you going to the same room. Once I changed my clothes I notice a sign which stated that salon is not responsible for your belongings, but in reality in the room is only you and therapist, I did not mind a lot this as was very tired after trip and to want to get massage.
After 10 min of the massage my husband come to my room and says we need to leave the place a soon as possible as he catch the lady that her hands was in his bag and pounch of his monies holding in her hands. We straight went to the reception and asked to give as our monies back as you need to pay upfront before massage. Lady at the reception did not say any sorry and looks like was not siurprised at all. She gave the money back for body massage and said that we need to pay for foot as we got it, we accepted and left the place without looking back. After we were outside my husband says to me what happened, once he was in the room he noticed that lady was doing massage with one hand and he start noticing that something is not right, so he could not get relaxed and all this minutes was so intense and at the end cath lady holding his monies. We are third time in Thailand and we shocked by this situation and still can not believe that this happen. Please be very careful if you decide to use this salon services.

reviews.text: I have been going to olivia message for years . Earlier it was art massage. I feel very comfortable and relaxed. It's very good with a comfortable atmosphere. All the therapists r very good. Great place.

reviews.name: Puah kuan sheng
reviews.text: Make sure your newbie part time staff is well trained before serve customer.

reviews.name: Latisha Hill
reviews.text: I’ve had multiple great 90-minute traditional Thai massages with NR—“61” and “89”—and both were amazing. I was nervous going into a new massage parlour but the staff are kind & welcoming the atmosphere is really relaxing. The massage itself was firm and soothing “I fell asleep” and felt refreshed afterwards all the tension was released! Definitely recommend booking with “61” and 89.

reviews.name: Joey Bebe
reviews.text: The counter staff, the old lady, have very bad manners. I usually use this shop all the time, but other branches have excellent manners. It's not surprising that there are few customers at this branch. They seem unwilling to work and don't know why they were hired.

reviews.name: Selina
reviews.text: On arrival they only had a male massage therapist for a full body which was fine with me. However, he didn’t maintain my modesty at all with the towel during the whole session. He also went too close to my privates whilst massaging my legs. The whole experience was traumatic and to top it off he was rubbing my skin instead of massaging it. There was also no consistency to it either (spend more time on the right hand side of my back!). The worst massage ever!!! Do not go here!

reviews.name: Gerard Perez
reviews.text: I don’t understand the 4.6 rating on Google. This is not a serious massage place. My massage was very bad: for one hour the therapist just kneaded parts of my body without any real technique (I say “kneaded” and not “massaged”). The therapist offered me a “special massage” twice, even specifying the price, and I had to refuse both times. Some areas of my body weren’t even touched (no neck, no left arm, no upper thighs, no glutes). Two stars only because the place is clean and they offer you some water.

reviews.name: Romeo Pole
reviews.text:
I recently had an unfortunate experience at Olivia Massage, and I feel compelled to share my thoughts. This was, without a doubt, the worst massage I've ever had.

From the moment we arrived, things felt off. My friend and I were separated into different rooms, which was surprising and disappointing. We had hoped to enjoy the experience together, but instead, we were left feeling isolated. The masseurs seemed inexperienced and lacked any real understanding of how to provide a therapeutic massage. Instead of relaxation, I felt more tension and discomfort.

Additionally, the way the staff handled our visit raised red flags. It felt as if they were more interested in upselling services rather than providing a genuine and satisfying experience. The separation into different rooms seemed like a tactic to make us feel pressured and potentially rip us off.

Overall, I cannot recommend Olivia Massage. If you're seeking a professional, relaxing massage, I suggest looking elsewhere. Save your time and money; you deserve better.

title: Samatha ( ส ม ถ ะ ) - Thai Massage
ownerDescription:
Discover serenity in the heart of Bangkok at Samatha Massage Spa, nestled in Hua Lamphong.
Our spa's name, inspired by ancient Sanskrit words for 'tranquility' and 'serenity,' embodies our commitment to providing a soothing experience.

From Thai traditional massage to Foot Reflexology, Thai Traditional Massage, Office Syndrome Massage, and Aroma Therapy. our extensive menu offers a wide range of services designed to harmonize your body, mind, and soul.

Experience rejuvenation with our Jet Lag Massage Package. It combines hot essential oils and a soothing head massage, complemented by Blue Lotus Tea to reduce stress, anxiety, elevate consciousness, and enhance your sleep quality. You'll emerge refreshed and revitalized.
