reviews.name: Xmoon
reviews.text: I booked the most expensive massage, but the room was very small, the environment was different from IG page ,and the service and techniques were not as good as some cheaper places. The hot essential oil burned me several times. Of course, the staff were friendly. The front desk service was not very attentive. When I was moved to a different seat, she didn't help me to move tea. I had to carry the tea while I was carrying two bags. I hope the service can be more enthusiastic and attentive.

reviews.name: Flat white please
reviews.text:
Saw on IG that their shoulder massage is good, so decided to give it a shot. Location is a bit hidden, better to call a car la.

The Good:
Therapists are super hardworking and put in real effort. Definitely give them credit for that.

Room for Improvement:
Changing Clothes: Had to change in the toilet, but there are zero hooks to hang anything. Super inconvenient.

Too Rushed: Once the session ended, they immediately cleared the bed and asked me to go to the toilet to change. I was still in a "half-asleep" post-massage daze. Would be better to give a few mins to buffer or just let guests change at the bed. Felt like I was being chased out.

Package Clarity: Only found out on the spot that the "Office syndrome" is upper-body only and is kind of deep tissue oil massage. Datz fine for me, but shld probably state this clearly in the menu or when booking.

Seems like a new small shop, by appointment only. After finish, got serve tea and one small pandan cake. Based on the price, location, and service... ummm, can try if want.

reviews.name: Pitiphorn Singplord
reviews.text: The store is very convenient, and the surrounding trees make the place feel fresh and relaxing. 🌳The therapist was very lovely and the pressure was great.

reviews.name: GiGi Marie
reviews.text:
My experience was truly elevated by my masseuse, P'Jane. Her skill is exceptional; she has ability to locate and release tension exactly where it lives, hitting every targeted muscles and joints.It was less of a generic rub and more of a personalized treatment.

***Foot reflexology needs improvement--to put more pressure on. But the Deep tissue massage treatment is spot on. Felt relaxed and released.

The staff throughout the spa are wonderfully attentive and create a calm, welcoming atmosphere.

***
Tucked conveniently next to a charming art and craft studio cafè, (TaiBan) it’s an ideal setup for a friends' day out—you can enjoy a creative session and then unwind completely, all in one trip. 👍

reviews.name: SC H
reviews.text:
Amazing massage experience with attentive and skilled therapists. They took the time to understand what I wanted to focus on and adjusted the treatment thoughtfully throughout the session - I felt so light after!

Definitely recommend booking ahead as this place is popular for good reason.

reviews.name: shieloves
reviews.text: I had the Deep Tissue Massage and thought it would be very painful, but it wasn’t. It was the best massage I’ve ever had, it really hit the sore spots in my muscles. The place feels very serene and relaxing, with a touch of greenery from the plants. Truly relaxing and reasonably priced. You have to book a slot in advance since they usually get fully booked throughout the day, but luckily, I was able to get a last-minute slot.

reviews.name: Sarinpat P.
reviews.text: Love the Sorana massage so much! The hot oil was so relaxing, and it was the perfect way to unwind. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.name: Kevin Tan
reviews.text: Came here this evening for essential oil massage and was really impressed! The exteriors and interiors of the building were amazing! Service was exceptional, and the massage was one of the best I’ve ever had in Thailand! Facilities were clean and modern too! The bed was comfortable and the lighting conditions were very conducive! Had a very restful and therapeutic time! Will be back!

reviews.name: Katenapat K
reviews.text: It felt like a cafe that also offers massages คาเฟ่ที่นวดได้นิดหน่อย, not a proper massage place. The space inside was cozy but very small. To be fair, I didn‘t book a private room (not sure if they have one). I got the massage in a shared area, with only thin curtains separating each bed where you can clearly hear what people were talking at the reception. The beds were quite small. I felt like the therapist didn’t even have enough space to work and I’m not even tall. They brought a small basin to wash your feet right at the bed, in a narrow hallway where two people could barely pass each other. The massage itself was nice, at least the one I had. The snack and tea were delicious. The price was reasonable (500 THB for a 1-hour deep tissue massage).

reviews.name: Aranee Tanchavalit
reviews.text: One of the best massage I’ve ever had. The place itself feels like Bangkok oasis, giving a relaxing vibe the moment I stepped in. The massage was incredible, not unbearable hurtful but the muscles are relieved. The essential oil smells wonderful and lasts nicely on the skin. The snack and tea afterwards are tasty as well, perfect way to end the session.

reviews.name: Oranat Charoenpol
reviews.text: Absolutely the best massage I’ve had in Bangkok, and at a very reasonable price. Very professional, gentle, and incredibly relaxing. The service was excellent, the place was clean with beautiful interiors, and both the staff and masseuse were lovely. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Victory V
reviews.text:
Even though Bangkok has a lot of spa and massage places, it’s actually really hard to find one that checks all the boxex - great atmosphere, good service, and everything else you care about
This place honestly has it all! So highly recommend it

reviews.name: Chosita Teppitak
reviews.text:
As soon as you step around the spa, you feel like you’re in nature, and inside the spa is super lovely! The smell, cleanliness, organic style, decorations, atmosphere, and just everything.
Save the last for the best. The masseurs are so professional and really good at their jobs. I always have the best relaxing time whenever I get a massage here. Absolutely excellent value for money. 🤍✨

reviews.name: Paphachita Panparitchaya
reviews.text:
Absolutely impressed with Samata! The place is surrounded by lush greenery, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere from the moment you step in. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive—I honestly felt like a princess the whole time I was there.

I had the 1.5-hour Asana Massage and it was pure bliss. My therapist was highly skilled and knew exactly how to work on my tension points. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly quality massage experience.

The location is also super convenient, just a short walk from MRT Hua Lamphong

reviews.name: Manassawee Charoen
reviews.text:
I was truly impressed by this place! It’s surrounded by greenery with trees everywhere, creating such a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff treated me like a princess from the moment I walked in.

I had a 1-hour aromatherapy massage, and it was incredibly relaxing. The massage therapist clearly knew what she was doing and even identified the issue with my shoulder as soon as she touched my body — amazing skills!

The location is also super convenient, being so close to MRT Hualampong.

reviews.name: Bolshakova Oxana
reviews.text: Booked a slot for 3 people 1 day in advance but was told at the door that they can massage only 2 of us. The place itself is very cozy and nice. Filled the card before the massage, circling areas which shouldn’t be massaged but had to explain it again because no one checked it. Was provided with nice tea and deserts after massage.

reviews.text: nice massage place! tira was a very welcoming and kind host. we did the foot massage, which was quite value and the masseuse found a lot of knots in my feet that i didnt have😅 enjoyed it a lot and would def recommend!

reviews.name: Nadeem Khan.London
reviews.text: We have Thai Massage, it was very good. Place is well run and all the staff are professional and polite. Fairly price as well.

reviews.name: Nicola Joss
reviews.text: Excellent place to go for massage. The staff are so friendly, polite and professional. I always return to Tira when I'm in Chiang Mai and feel relaxed and refreshed when I leave. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Phoebe B
reviews.text: Wow amazing! Me and my partner had a Thai oil massage each, the perfect level of pressure and the best I’ve had since being in Thailand. reviews.name: Shin
reviews.text: Tira massage is simple and unpretentious, hands down the best thai massage I ever had at this price point. For the 5 days in Chiangmai I went 3 days and tried 3 different therapist. Of of them are well trained by the lady boss herself. They know the exact pressure point hit all the right spot. The shop might look empty but don't be fooled, the therapist stay nearby and come right away once there are customers. 10 out of 10.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much.🙏🙏😊

reviews.name: Jenny
reviews.text:
Run, don’t walk!
Get the Thai oil massage.
They hit all the right spots. Very relaxing, yet the muscles feel fully worked.
You can tell they truly listen to what your body needs and they move toward that. Clean and peaceful environment as well.
Khop Khun Kha!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Alice
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand. All of the staff were lovely and very professional. The space is clean and neat. The masseuse was great and did an awesome job. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much ..🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: 功囍
reviews.text:
Best massage ever! I have been practicing Thai massage myself for nearly 10 years & Tira is truly a professional! I had the 1hr back/head/shoulder massage with Tira. Was incredible! I asked for strong massage and she delivered!! Did a wonderful job massaging my low back & hips with her elbows/knees. She also walked on my back/legs in a wonderfully therapeutic way. She also listened to my requests and felt very conscious & loving during the massage. Thank you so much!!!

Highly recommend! I will return!

🙏💜✨

reviews.name: Ben Kingham

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.text:

I already had a few foot massages in Thailand, but I really liked this one. Right after the session my legs felt much lighter. Would recommend and would definitely come back. ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: antonella torres
reviews.text: Amazing massage! Best one I have had in Asia. I was so happy and they treated me so welcoming and warmly. I really recommend this massage place if you are visiting chiang mai

reviews.name: Elizabeth Banach
reviews.text:
I was there 3 years in a raw many times, had great thai massage, oil massage,
Foot massage. Stuff is very friendly and owner is wonderful. I will contact her from Bangkok and we can plan trip to Hong Song Mae. I plan to visit chiang mai around January 12
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Mike Copeland
reviews.text: Tira massage was so great. The massage was traditional and the masseuse was small but mighty strong. She found all of the knots in my back and legs and worked them out. I would definitely recommend them to all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Tessa Rizzoli
reviews.text: Average massage. If you are looking for a strong and good pressure massage, this is not it. Unless you ask beforehand if they can make it especially strong for you. I wasn’t asked at any point if the pressure was good enough and did not dare asking as it was the end of the day and the women working looked tired. Some points of the massage (neck and some stretch positions) were good but there were several bits where I could barely feel it. Reading other reviews I get a feeling that people who like this massage think it is relaxing. For me personally I look for good amounts of pressure. Ladies were also chatting while massaging.

reviews.name: Arthur
reviews.text:
Me and my girlfriends first massage experience in Thailand! We went here due to the positive reviews and it being within walking distance of our hotel. And it did not dissapoint!

We had the foot, shoulder & head massage.

The masseuses were very talented and kind - making us both feel very comfortable despite not having many prior massage experiences. They were very communicative in order to be sure we felt comfortable.

They gave it their all & it was a great experience. We feel extremely relaxed now 😌.

Can only recommend this massage shop.

Thank you Tira Massages! 👋🏻☺️

reviews.name: wanderlust

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: ᆞᆞ

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Elsa Chan
reviews.text:
Got a massage today here at Tira, we were the only ones at 1230pm. The ladies working there are all super sweet and down for a laugh. Don’t underestimate them though because they have a lot of strength but aren’t out to torture you. We got the 1 hour Thai massage and they focused a lot on the legs which was great. The back cracks they did also released so much tension in my lower back, I was almost on another dimension after.

This place is nondescript and no frills but 100% worth going. The ladies are the nicest and most professional. Too bad we only went on our last day, otherwise I would’ve gone back every day. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากคะสำหรับรีวิว พวกเราดีใจที่คุณมีความสุขกับการให้บริการของพวกเราและหวังว่าพวกคุณจะกลับมาใช้บริการในครั้งต่อไป..🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Wenqian Yan
reviews.text:
I came here literally everyday during my week long stay in Chiang Mai. Their masssage is better than other fancy ones I tried nearby, that’s why I keep coming back.

Tira the owner is a really sweet lady, she’s warm with every customer. You can tell how good their massage and the whole vibe is by seeing all the returning customers.

They are also the only one around that opens slightly early (9:30 am), so if you are jet legged and want a massage early, they are a great choice
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much.🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Maria Flach
reviews.text: great massage for first timers. got the full body thai massage for 300baht. we were given pyjama type things to change in to, and felt comfortable the entire time. we told them it was our first time and i think they went a bit easy on us, although it was still very strong! they were extremely polite and professional. would definitely recommend for a first time massage (and others)

title: The Absolute Massage
subTitle: The Absolute Massage Branch 1
ownerDescription:
Welcome to our rejuvenating world at The
Absolute Massage.

The Absolute Massage service will allow you to unwind, re-energize and emerge completely refreshed while following the principle of providing quality and devoting service at modest prices. With caregiving experience of over 20 years and our expertly trained therapists, we provide soothing and caring massages spa experiences with an archaic and unique ambiance which can only be found here in Charoenkrung or Bangkok oldest road, where you can lay back into the antique atmosphere, go on a journey to pure bliss and feel the hospitality offered at our spas and engage in life again with restored inner balance.
address: 1466 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: 1466 ถ. เจริญกรุง

reviews.name: DrJimi
reviews.text: Wonderful massage in Silom. Excellent staff, professional service and good value. We opted for the massage buffet at 600 baht for 2 hours and did 1 hour foot massage and 1 hour back and shoulder thai massage. Really great facility, staff and definitely will be back! Close to Lebua hotel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Very much appreciated. We are delighted you like our service. Looking forward to seeing you again❤️🙏

reviews.name: Michael Banas
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I had an amazing message here while staying in Bangkok. 10/10 I would travel from anywhere in the city to come back! They had great deals for 2hr massages. The spa smells amazing and the ladies really know where your body holds the most tension. I've left many massages feeling like they could have worked that one spot a bit longer. Not here. It's as if their hands are a magnet to your most needed areas of your body. Wonderful staff and we will "ABSOLUTE"ly be returning!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Super nice of you for reviewing you. We are so happy you both enjoyed the experience here with us. 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Asha Bhagaretti
reviews.text: My son and I chose the 2hrs Forest Package (1hr body scrub/1hr oil massage). Absolutely exhilarating!!! I feel so refreshed and relaxed.  Lisa used the perfect pressure, it was sooooo good. The facility is very sanitary, everything they use is clean,  staff very friendly. I would highly recommend and definitely return again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Glad you and your So  liked the treatments and felt relaxed after. 
Your review is very important to us. Thank you very much and we hope to see again soon. 🙏🍃❤️

reviews.name: Polly Hilton
reviews.text: Both my husband and I had fantastic massages with friendly, welcoming and very skilled therapists. I get sports massage weekly at home in Australia and this massage was excellent. About 5 hours after our massages, after a day out and walking back to our hotel, I heard someone call down the street. The beautiful owner came chasing me down the street with a big smile on her face, “Madam your watch!!”. She was so kind and relieved to have found me, she’d been watching out for me all day hoping I’d come back past the parlour. I had no idea I’d even left it and it is a very special and valuable heirloom. I am so so so grateful to this wonderful lady and can’t recommend them more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: To take care of our customers is one of our main focus. We do hope everyone walk out from us and have a good experience. We are glad you did! Take care and look forward to welcoming you again. 🙏🍃❤️

reviews.name: Jevaris Johnson
reviews.text: Visited Thailand for the 1st time and Absolute was amazing! Visited 3 straight days. Got the for and leg massage 2 days and a Thai body massage the next day. Ploy runs a great establishment! Meng, Tum, and my favorite Pad, took care of us! Please visit when in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for coming to see us. Hope you to see you again soon  your review is greatly appreciated. ❤️⛳️

reviews.name: Shraddha Jadhav
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at Absolute Spa, Bangkok! We chose the Sky Package (3 hours) with a facial, and it was absolutely relaxing. The staff was very courteous and professional, and the therapists were true experts. Loved the tea served before we left — such a thoughtful touch.
The ambiance was calm, and beautifully maintained. Perfect spa before catching our flight — slept like a baby on the plane! ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We are delighted you had a great time with you. ❤️⛳️

reviews.name: Sirichai Jiwasurat
reviews.text:
It is a great experience for me. I came to work around here, then I try to have an oil massage.

The first impression is good welcome, and I get the best advice from staff. Price is reasonable. The staffs are professional massage therapists.

After taking oil massage, my whole body feels very good. The muscles are relaxed.

If you come around here, and you want to have a great experience. Please try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sirichai,
Thank you for coming to  the Absolute and giving us this review.
We hope to welcome you back again so soon. Have a wonderful day. 💚

reviews.name: Brandon Kim
reviews.text: It was fantastic experience for me in BKK. After using 4hands massage that is signiture menu in shop, my body was refreshed. It was not massage, it was remedy for my body. Brcause of this, I visited once again (next day). I used Thai massge second time, it was also great. I will visit again whenever I come to BKK. Kindness of manager made me happy too^^ perfect!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Brandon,
We are so glad that you like our service and thank you very much for the review. 🥰

reviews.name: Paul Frehse
reviews.text:
Very professional, high-quality massage. No tourist trap—just pure relaxation.

I’m familiar with European massages, and this was the best I’ve had.

I’ve been here before and came back again today. The foot massage and the four-hand Thai massage are excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Lovely review. We appreciate you spending time with us. 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Matt Smith
reviews.text: Great massages at great prices. Got the 90 minute Asian Blend full body massage for 1,000 baht and only had to wait about 20 minutes after walking in. The massages are done on a mat on the floor (would be nice if it was a proper massage bed but can’t beat the price) in a room on the second floor that is partitioned by curtains. The massage was great and the masseuse adjusted the level of strength depending on my preferences. I highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Matt!
Thank you and thank you again.
See you next time for your Bangkok visit! 🥰💚

reviews.name: Caroline Dilger
reviews.text: We had an amazing 90 minute foot & leg massage from Yupin & Tip..finished off by a head and shoulder massage. Just incredible, we are returning before going home. Very clean, professional, friendly..perfect all round, treat yourself 😊

reviews.name: steve ebertz
reviews.text: Absolutely the best massage in Silom Bang Rak!  My massage therapist was very intuitive and found tight muscle groups to work on and was totally accommodating to level of massage pressure.  For maximum health benefits I prefer the 2-hour Thai table oil massage.   I have chronic shoulder and mid-low back issues and my therapist has relieved 90% of my pain that I have returned to swimming plus I am sleeping better!  You owe it to yourself to try The Absolute Massage spa!  You will feel 100% better!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was it our Signature Absolute massage? I took inspiration from both Thai and European massage techniques to design that course. I’m very happy you enjoyed it!

reviews.name: Tatiana Tarasova
reviews.text: I recently visited The Absolute Massage and had a fantastic experience! The atmosphere was serene and welcoming, making it the perfect place to unwind. Kh. Ploy, the manager, was incredibly attentive and ensured that everything ran smoothly. The massage therapists were all exceptional, each bringing their unique skills to the table. I particularly enjoyed my session with Kh. Mona, who worked wonders on my tense muscles. Overall, I highly recommend The Absolute Massage for anyone seeking a top-notch massage experience. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: renee luna
reviews.text:
Came here on day 1 of Thailand and the staff was very friendly, professional, and did incredible work!
2 hr massage with 2 staff for $60 USD - it’s truly like getting two massages for one.
Their technique was really impressive and I appreciate how they massaged unconventional areas (for US at least - like stomach and groin area) which need their own love and attention.

Place was beautiful and clean! Only request is to make instructions for rinsing off, wearing robe, when to lie down, etc a little clearer.

Otherwise everything was perfection! And staff was very receptive to any modifications needed

Khop kun ka!

reviews.name: Nathalie Janssen
reviews.text:
Went here because of the good reviews... we had the 90 minute Thai Aroma Therapy Massage for 1100 Bht...
The therapist used way too much force and put her full weight pressure on certain points on my back, shoulders and legs which really hurt. I cried out in pain several times and even pulled away, but she did not adjust her strength at all... the massage therapist did not feel professional at all to me. Several times I thought about telling her to stop and just leave the salon, which I regret to not have done. The day after I can still feel and see bruises from the treatment. Would not recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We do appreciate your comment and had found what had happened. I understand you and feel strongly sorry for what you had the experience with us. You might not come back to us again but for your future experience please ask the therapist to reduce the pressure or call the manager to change the therapist. All the best. 🙏

reviews.name: Jovian Ting
reviews.text: A very nice Thai massage. We come here every time we visit Bangkok. A must for us, we even choose to stay nearby in order to enjoy their massage during our trip. Clean and great relaxing aroma inside the shop. Friendly staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jovian, 



Thank you so much for your kind review and positive feedback from your visit to the Absolute Massage. It’s a pleasure hosting you . We are so pleased to read your feedback and grateful for you taking time to share this with us. We very much look forward to welcoming you back to the Absolute on next visit.  
Regards, 
Abso Team

reviews.name: Peter X
reviews.text: My favorite massage parlour in Bangkok. Not only tourists, also many locals. Perfect location , perfect staff and everytime perfect massage.

reviews.name: Ivan Gainulin
reviews.text: This Thai massage spa is fantastic! The ambiance is clean, relaxing, and infused with a refreshing lemongrass scent. The massage was top-notch and really helped me unwind. Highly recommend to try!

reviews.name: Christian Werner
reviews.text: The aroma massage and shower room is always great, the best place in Bangkok. Very friendly staff and great team. I highly recommend to try when you are there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Christian. It was really nice having you with us. We hope to see you again soon. 💚🌿🙏

reviews.name: Anjeer Khan
reviews.text: My back was hurting (due to the long flight) so I did my research and found a good Thai massage therapist at Absolute.  Pa (massage therapist) was excellent.  Very knowledgeable and professional!  Thank you!

title: Chivarome Massage (Taina Road)
ownerDescription: Chivarome is an old Thai word meaning "to take pleasure in the things that you do." In this busiest of times, we can all understand why this word is no longer used. But here at Chivarome Massage, Chivarome is not just a name. Our skilled therapists, masters of ancient Thai massage, tailor each treatment to harmonize body, mind, and spirit. Choose from an array of luxurious massages, including traditional Thai, aromatic oil, and hot herbal compress therapies. At Chivarome Massage, escape the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary. Step into an oasis of tranquility that is Chivarome Massage located on Kata Beach Road in Karon, Phuket and step into a sanctuary inviting you to rediscover harmony in both body and spirit.
address: 4 Taina Rd, Karon, Amphoe Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R8H2+65 Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Mina Mina
reviews.text: I had a great experience here. The staff were friendly, skilled, and I felt very relaxed during and after the massage☺️❤️

reviews.name: Siti Nurazlin Hanafi
reviews.text: Very good massage with reasonable price. The ambiance also very nice. Good job!

reviews.name: Claudelle Njoukam
reviews.text:
We were a group of 7 and it was awesome!

We had a Thai massage and we would definitely come back. They insisted on
knots in my shoulder blades and in area I asked.

The place is very clean and they are very welcoming. I recommend!

reviews.name: Karoline Mathilde Nielsen
reviews.text: I got the scrub+coconut oil treatment for 90 minutes. The ambience was very calm and nice and the treatment was very relaxing. Also, the one who did it was really sweet and served tea afterwards.

reviews.name: Danielle Ahn
reviews.text: We came late night at 1030 and got a 60 min  oil massage. It was AMAZING!! I’ve gotten a couple of massages in Phuket and in Bangkok and this place has, by far, been the most relaxing one. They find the knots and don’t shy away from it. I definitely recommend to people visiting!!!

reviews.name: Lauren Gruszka
reviews.text: My husband and I both got massages today at Chivarome Massage. They welcomed us right in and gave us water and cool towels. The staff were very friendly and our massages were wonderful! I had the Thai oil massage and my husband had the sports massage which sounded similar to mine but with more pressure. After our massages they gave us warm tea and candy. I am happy to add another 5 star review for Chivarome Massage!

reviews.name: Rene Henze
reviews.text: I have been visiting Thailand almost every year since 2017 and typically enjoy a Thai oil massage once or twice a week. I can say without hesitation that my two sessions with Fah were the best I’ve ever had. She strikes the perfect balance between gentle and firm—starting with relaxation before transitioning magically into the deeper pressure needed to release knots and tension. She is incredibly skilled and instinctively knows exactly how and where to focus. She now sets the standard that I will use to compare all future massages.

reviews.name: Nuenida Samrichponchock
reviews.text: Nice and clean with a really good massage 💆‍♀️, helpful staff, i asked a strong massage for my back and i get it exactly the hard level i need.., me and my daughter have been there for 1 hr. My daughter doesn’t want to leave the place 🤣🤣 recommend everyone to try.

reviews.name: mehdi megdoud
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience together with my family. Great massage, great skills by very kind staff. Will definitely come back. Thank you!

reviews.name: Gladys Kang
reviews.text: I came here to have sports massage after reading the good review and they never disappoint. I had a 90 minutes sports massage at 950 Baht by Fah. She is really good. She put ointment and oil on the body before the message. The room is clean with sound of water and soothing music. If you are looking for strong massage to remove the body ache, I would strongly recommended you to try the Sports massage.

reviews.name: Terry
reviews.text: This is my first time is Phuket, and second time ever getting a massage. I requested a back massage from Nit and I am more than satisfied with her and the staff. Very welcoming and professional. Nit was great. Until next time Phuket 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Arailym Seilkhanova
reviews.text: The service is top notch! We got caught in the rain, they invited us in, helped dry our things and gave us an incredible Thai massage. 💆‍♀️ Super, the girls are very kind and responsive, we relaxed not only our bodies but also our souls. The prices, by the way, are very reasonable. 5 stars 👍

reviews.name: Jasmina Botonjic
reviews.text:
Amazing place!!! Best massage I ever had. Cozy and clean place.
Fah did great massage for me. All staff are so polite!
All recommendations. You will not regret it!

reviews.name: Юлия Ермакова
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently visited this salon and was very pleased! I want to highlight the professional approach of the master - you can feel their great experience and knowledge of their craft. The massage was performed with high quality, taking into account all my preferences.

I was particularly impressed by the attention to detail: comfortable atmosphere, cleanliness, pleasant music - everything is thought out down to the smallest details. The staff is very courteous and polite, creating a sense of care for the client.

After the session, I feel rested and relaxed. The result exceeded my expectations!

I definitely recommend this salon to everyone who values quality service and a professional approach. I will definitely come back again!

reviews.name: JasB
reviews.text: Had a two hour Thai massage and wow they got knots I didn't even know I had! And they basically had me doing gymnastics by testing my flexibility. I have never had a massage that thorough. My only reservations is that the bathrooms were not super clean when I went. Other than that I had a great time

Beautiful salon
Good job

reviews.text: Wonderful place for relaxing… atmosphere, music, massage masters- all are great! Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
One of my favorite massages in Thailand. My family and I did a 1hr foot, neck and back massage (400 baht each).

Very friendly staff was all smiles. Used techniques I’ve never seen before. Solid pressure. AC and bathroom inside.

Highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Elise Benoit
reviews.text:
Our favorite massage place in Phuket!
All the ladies are super nice and friendly, and the massages were wonderful! I highly recommend!!

reviews.name: gixer08
reviews.text:
Finally after 2 1/2 weeks in Kata and surrounding area we have found our go to massage place . Absolutely 1st class with a gentle but soothing touch when required and enough pressure to take away any aches and pains also . After numerous massages from May and colleague a mutual friendship was formed and we will treasure our parting gift 🎁
Thanks again for your professionalism and expertise and we will no doubt see you again in the future 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Merve K.
reviews.text: We were very satisfied with the Thai massage we had. The staff are attentive and professional. Credit cards are accepted.

reviews.name: Jason Tabrett
reviews.text: Very friendly and respectful staff from our front to the inside and all 4 of us loved our different massage types from the traditional Thai massage to the one with aloe vera oil. Prices were the same or cheaper than all of the competitors around and what I really loved were the massive beds! There was no need to dangle my arms off the sides in order to fit. But, we had a really good massage and will be back often!

reviews.name: The D Walden Group LLC.
reviews.text: Excellent foot and leg massage by well trained hands. I had massive swelling, due to some unknown factors. My husband and I stopped by to get my legs and feet massaged. The ladies are so kind, sweet and willing to help. The young lady was amazing. She took her time to insure my problem areas were addressed and healed properly. They are so very compassionate and caring. Afterwords we were served a delicious tea and cookie snack. A wonderful place in deed and I will be sure to come back next time we are in town! 🌼

reviews.name: M C
reviews.text: I had a massage with Air. She was tender and strong at the same time. Gentle but precise. Don’t underestimate this small and mighty place. Humble but professional and amazing. I will be coming back

reviews.name: Patricia Piticas
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place!!! ❤️ I can't express enough how much I cherished my daily visits to this massage haven in Thailand.  I tried different massages and the one with coconut oil was my favourite (PS: the coconut oil is made by their family and smells incredible). The massages were in a serene atmosphere of privacy and silence, setting it apart from other places.  But apart from this, the girls are amazing and such beautiful people. They felt like family, spoiling me with love and care. Can't wait to come back 🙏🏼🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're grateful that you opted for The 1 Thai massage services. Your visit means a lot to us, and we genuinely hope you had an exceptional and enjoyable experience.

reviews.name: jx
reviews.text: Very good massage we were satisfied. The strength of staff was good and they were nice in explaining. Overall a good activity to end the trip

reviews.name: Aleksei Polovinkin
reviews.text: They're definitely one of the best in the whole Thailand. I got to them with a huge pain in the neck and they were able to remove it. I've had many massages in different places and rarely masters know human anatomy as well as the master I've had here.

reviews.name: JoshBC2304
reviews.text: This massage is really good. They aren’t pushy at all and don’t beg for reviews or anything like other places do. Just a great professional service.

reviews.name: Beck Delude
reviews.text: Third place I’ve tried in Kata and I finally feel like I found what I’m looking for! The perfect balance of pressure in all the right places. My body felt amazing afterwards and Aoy was extremely sweet and attentive. I’ll definitely be back. The tea afterwards is always a lovely touch!

reviews.name: Димка Кю
reviews.text: I like this place so very very much. Every time I'm in Phuket and want a massage, I come here. This place is a kind of standard of Thai massage for me. You can choose your favorite masseuse and only go to her. I've been to everyone and they're all great. So come and get your best Thai massage here, you won't regret it.

reviews.name: Nadiia Denysenko
reviews.text:
I would like to thank you to amazing massage therapists in One Thai Massage! You are amazing! Thank you for your professionalism and service.
To people out there, if you’re looking for a place with great Thai massage - this is the one! You will love everything about this place. It’s cozy and very relaxing atmosphere created by amazing people. Choose One Thai massage and you will not regret.

reviews.name: zhengyi li
reviews.text: It just feels so good to get massage here. It’s way better than the one that I got in Bangkok. The shop is located on the second street near the coast road and that’s bringing the shop a sense of tranquility. Moreover, the staff here are so talented and well skilled that the 60mins of massage is full of strength and techniques and it’s definitely renewing my shoulders and necks. Thanks to the amazing masseuse Lisa. Every part of your body will get care and you won’t have to worry about waste of money for even one second. Strongly recommended.

reviews.name: rosa ma
reviews.text: every foot massage. better than what I got from bangkok. cheap price good technique! Will come next time.

reviews.name: Mathilde Sundgård Anker
reviews.text:
Definitively the best massage we got in Thailand so far! We have had 9 massages  in total and this was by far the best! Great pressure, new techniques, good value for money! Super luxurious, with warm towels and feet cleaning. We all got Thai massage with oil +foot. They knew what they were doing and were super professional from start to finish.
Highly highly highly recommend. Especially if you have pain!

reviews.name: Graja Souha
reviews.text: Hands down THE BEST massage I’ve ever had! This my first day here and I already went twice. I took my 8 months old baby with me and they help me with her. The stuff is very friendly especially Downy she is AMAZING! Highly recommend it

reviews.name: 林晓玲
reviews.text: I came yesterday and today, and the experience was great. I want to come every day. I really like this masseur. She can speak English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, she's very cute. I will definitely come back to Thailand next time.

reviews.name: Angelique Thai Thuc
reviews.text: At Thai Massage 1 Kata, we had the best massages of our entire trip. We tried many places, but this one stood out. The ladies at this salon are super friendly and professional, and you can feel that in the quality of the massages. They use techniques that you don't often encounter in many other massage salons. We visited daily with our family and had different masseuses each time, and one by one, they were all excellent. We highly recommend this salon if you're in Kata.

Bangkok expats and long-term visitors are among the guests who find the head spa most transformative. Not because it's a treatment for hair loss, but because regular scalp work improves circulation, removes buildup, and gives the scalp what the city keeps stripping away.
Two locations. Silom and Sukhumvit 39. Open until 11PM.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Fariha Raisa
reviews.text: Excellent service through and through! Took the 2 hours head spa+ Aroma package and the whole experience was amazing. They really take care of you, checking in to see you’re okay every now and then. The 120mins were full of relaxation and then they took extra time for hair drying. Even offered a little pouch of complimentary bath salts as gift. Highly recommend them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Fariha, this truly made our hearts full! ❤️ We are so happy the 2-hour Head Spa and Aroma package felt like a complete experience from start to finish. Those little check-ins during your treatment, the extra care with drying, and the bath salts are all part of how we like to show our guests they are truly looked after.
And what a beautiful photo of our reception area, thank you for capturing that!
We hope to welcome you back for another 120 minutes of pure relaxation very soon!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Melissa C
reviews.text:
Every aspect of Chandee was the best spa experience I have had in Thailand, and actually anywhere to-date! This location was walking distance from my hotel, so I happened upon it, checked the reviews (which were stellar) and decided to book a 60-minute head spa and 60-minute facial. Bee at the front desk was so welcoming and helped me make my reservations for the next day. I also observed her taking care of other clients with such genuine kindness. The aesthetics of the spa are top-tier with beautiful design, comfy new looking furniture, and calming lighting and music. They give you a refreshing welcome drink, hand towel, and bring you slippers.

On the day of my appointment, Bovy was working the front desk, and she also had amazing energy and excellent customer service. We had great conversation while she checked me in and helped me pick the right oil scent and hair product for me.

Wan then appeared to bring me upstairs to begin the services. She had a very calm, gentle presence. The beautiful spa aesthetics continued at every floor. The massage table and room was well maintained and calming.

The facial happened first. I noted that I have sensitive skin, and Wan absolutely treated my face with care. It was so relaxing that I fell in and out of sleep. This rarely happens to me during services because I tend to have challenges quieting my mind, but Wan was so good at every aspect! I relaxed right into it all.

The head spa was next, which included some ASMR sound components. All very relaxing. The warmth of the water, the head massage, shampooing, and upper body massage elements felt so nice.

I was truly in heaven throughout this entire experience. I signed up for their member rewards program and cannot wait to return into the future for more services. I could see this being great for couples too. They have two locations. I’ll be sure to stay near one of them again. 100% recommend Chandee!

Oh and the pricing is totally comparable to the quality of the experience and the team who truly cares about creating the perfect spa experience! I’m from the US where we’d have to pay almost triple, and still wouldn’t be guaranteed the level of care, skills, and genuine customer service that Chandee offers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Melissa, reading this from start to finish genuinely made us emotional. Thank you for taking the time to share every detail so beautifully. ❤️
A happy accident that you happened to walk past, checked the reviews and decided to give us a try. That is exactly how we hope Chandee finds the people who truly appreciate it. And knowing every single aspect of the experience landed the way it did means the absolute world to us.
Bee and Bovy will be so touched to read your words. The warmth you felt at the front desk is not something we train into people, it is simply who they are, and you saw that clearly.
And Wan. A calm, gentle presence who took such care with your sensitive skin that your mind finally let go and you drifted in and out of sleep during the facial. That is one of the most beautiful things a guest can experience, and it tells you everything about how much she cares about the person in front of her. We will make sure she reads every word you wrote about her.
The head spa with the ASMR water sounds, the warmth, the shampooing, the upper body massage. Knowing it all flowed together into something that felt truly heavenly is exactly what we set out to create with every visit.
Your comparison to what this level of care would cost back in the US genuinely touched us. We believe that feeling truly looked after should not require a luxury price tag, and it means so much that you felt the value so clearly.
Welcome to the Chandee family, we are so happy you joined the membership. We have two locations ready to welcome you back whenever Bangkok calls you again, and we promise to take just as good care of you every single time.
Thank you, Melissa. Truly.
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Lorena R
reviews.text:
One the best massage I ever had!!
My partner and I had a head spa session here and it was absolutely incredible. The massage and the water waterfall therapy were amazing, deeply relaxing, and highly professional.
The owner and the staff are incredibly sweet, polite, and attentive. They treat you with so much care and respect from the moment you walk in. The treatment itself was worth every single bit. We highly recommend this place to everyone visiting! Thank you so much for taking such good care of us.

"They treat you with so much care and respect from the moment you walk in" is everything we stand for, and knowing you and your partner felt that from start to finish means the world to the whole team.
Thank you for trusting us and for recommending us so warmly. We hope to see you both again very soon!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: MAGGiE LAM
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with the Head Spa and Radiance Facial Treatment (120 minutes). The entire session was incredibly relaxing from start to finish. The head spa was soothing with just the right pressure, relieving stress and helping me completely unwind—I almost fell asleep! The facial treatment was equally impressive. The therapist was professional and attentive, adjusting the steps based on my skin condition. After the treatment, my skin felt deeply hydrated, radiant, and refreshed. The environment was clean and comfortable, and the service was thoughtful throughout. Definitely worth the full two hours. Highly recommended, and I will absolutely come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Maggie ❤️ Almost falling asleep during your head spa is honestly the highest compliment we can receive.
We're so glad the facial felt truly personal. Our therapists always adapt to what your skin needs on the day, so hearing that it showed means a lot to us.
Hydrated, radiant, refreshed and coming back. That's everything. We can't wait to welcome you again for your next two hours of bliss.
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Aimee Cross
reviews.text: What a fabulous experience. Beautiful people here at the salon. So kind and courteous. I had the 17 stage head spa and enjoyed every moment. Felt so relaxing and invigorating too. And my blow dry afterwards was excellent. Left ready to pop my dress on and head out for dinner tonight. 5 stars don’t feel enough! 10 star salon. Must visit. Highly recommend.

The Chandee Team

reviews.name: Alifah Irbad Riyati
reviews.text: Amazing experience here. The staff are very friendly. The place is comfy and relaxing. The pressure is perfect and you can adjust as you like with the therapist. Very recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We're glad the pressure was just right and that our team made you feel comfortable. Thank you for the beautiful photos and your kind recommendation. We hope to see you and your friends again soon!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Fahad Sawad Al Shehhi (Rahal Dibba)
reviews.text:
is a great place to unwind if you’re looking for a focused, relaxing massage experience without a lot of fuss. The setting in Silom feels convenient and easy to access, and the staff are generally welcoming and attentive.

What stands out most is how calming the service feels—especially the head/neck-focused sessions—making it a good option for stress relief after a busy day in the city. Overall, it’s a solid, convenient choice for a reset in Silom.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Fahad! A focused, calming and fuss-free experience is exactly what Chandee is designed to be ❤️ We are so happy the head and neck session helped you reset after a busy day in the city. With 496 reviews under your belt you have seen a lot of places, so this means a great deal to us. We hope to welcome you back to Chandee Silom very soon!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Adrianto Indratjuatja
reviews.text:
Me and my partner visited chandee spa silom branch on 6 Sept 2026, 7pm, for the couple aroma zen therapy, and despite a minor mishap, I would like to sincerely thank the staff, especially the store manager, for the outstanding service, and exceptional sense of responsibility.

Toward the end of the treatment, there was a minor issue with my partner's hair, which resulted in her hair getting tangled at the ends. My initial reaction was understandably one of disappointment. However, the staff took full responsibility and not only did they express remorse, they also immediately got to work to resolve the problem, painstakingly resolving the tanglement strand by strand. During this time, they explained to me the possible causes, how it was extremely uncommon, and that they were extremely apologetic. Although it did take some time to resolve, they eventually managed to fix the issue, working well after their closing time, showing their sense of responsibility over the matter.

Furthermore, they made sure to make both of us feel at home during this process, offering us some light snacks and beverages while we waited.

In the end, not only was my partner's hair restored to its previous condition, but the establishment has clearly displayed their customer-first approach through their sincerity and actions. I would highly recommend anyone looking to undergo headspa treatment to try out Chandee spa, as customers can be rest assured that the staff at this shop always puts customers first.

I wanted to visit them again but unfortunately, as of writing this review, I will be leaving the country in 2 days and am unable to fit another session into my itinerary.

(Do be sure to clarify which branch you are speaking to when calling them to make your appointment, since they have 2 branches, and the contact number for the google listing on the sukhumvit 39 branch actually was the contact number for the silom branch)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for writing this, and thank you both for your patience that evening. The tangling should not have happened, and we are sorry your partner had to sit through it at the end of what was meant to be a calm evening. What you have written about the team means a great deal to us, because how we behave when something goes wrong is the part we care most about, and the manager and therapists will be very proud to read your words ❤️ We are so glad her hair came back to itself in the end. 
Thank you also for flagging the phone number on the Sukhumvit 39 listing, we are getting that corrected. Safe travels home, and whenever you are back in Bangkok, please message us directly and we will look after you both.

Warm regards,
Chananchida & Dennis (owners)

reviews.name: Grace Tan
reviews.text:
Amazing place that I highly recommend! I did a 90 min head spa + aroma oil massage here, in a room with starlit lights. After the 30 mins aroma oil massage, the massage bed ‘transforms’ into a head spa bed. Both services were comfortable, with customers being able to choose which massage oil and shampoo type that we want. The head spa was so comfortable in which they use different tools to give your hair and scalp a real relaxing and comfortable feeling, and therapists’ skills were great as well. All the staff including front desk managers, therapists and lady boss were all very friendly and warm with excellent service. Even before we went for the treatment, from email reservation till WhatsApp replies, they’ve been very prompt and accommodating and also delivered what they promised in the email conversation.

I would definitely revisit again during my next trip to bkk. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review, Grace! 🌟
We're so happy you enjoyed the 90-minute head spa + aroma oil combination, it's one of our favorites too! The way the bed transforms from massage to head spa is part of the magic we love creating here.
Your kind words about our team truly mean the world to us. Katai (our "lady boss" 😊) and the whole crew work hard to make every guest feel welcomed from that very first WhatsApp message.
We can't wait to welcome you back on your next Bangkok trip. Sweet dreams until then!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Evelyn Dietert
reviews.text: I have no experience with head spas but I don't think it could get any better than this. I had the 90 mins head and hair spa treatment and it was beyond fantastic. Unfortunately, I didn't ask for the name of the woman doing the treatment, but I would like to send out many thank yous to her as she did an amazing job! Perfect pressure, luxurious shampoo massage, oil neck and arms, a beautiful blow dry and style. Knowing every part of the experience landed so well means the world to us.
We hope to welcome you back again very soon!
The Chandee team

reviews.name: Anirut Amonissarataz

We hope to welcome you back the next time you are in Bangkok.
Warm regards,
The Chandee Team

reviews.name: Juliana Wee

Chananchida & Dennis (owners)

reviews.name: evAns fontanilla
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience at Chandee Sleep Spa and Massage. The service was amazing, very professional, and extremely relaxing. The staff were attentive and made sure everything was comfortable from start to finish. We left feeling refreshed and well taken care of. Thank you so much for your kind words and beautiful photos! We're thrilled that both of you had such a relaxing experience with us.

Warm regards from the Chandee Team

reviews.name: Full Dishclosure
reviews.text:
Chandee, Chandee, Chandee… what can I say?

The concept is actually quite good. In addition to the usual foot and body massages you find everywhere in Bangkok, Chandee has added a head spa experience, which was what attracted us in the first place.

Unfortunately, the reality did not quite match the impression created online.

Given the pricing and all the social media hype, I went in expecting a more upmarket, luxurious spa experience. Instead, the Silom branch is really a small, fairly basic local massage shop. There’s nothing necessarily wrong with that — except that the prices and online marketing suggest something rather more premium. Chandee itself describes Silom as a “boutique” location with just six dedicated head-spa beds, so manage your expectations accordingly.

The therapists were reasonably experienced and the massages were fine, but nothing particularly outstanding or memorable. At these prices, I personally think there are better options in Bangkok, including larger established massage houses and even some hotel spas.

My biggest disappointment, however, was the products used during the treatment. Chandee advertises the use of organic Yves Rocher products. Whatever was used on me unfortunately did not agree with my skin at all, and I developed rashes over my body afterwards. That obviously made an already underwhelming experience considerably worse.

Overall, Chandee markets and prices itself like an upper-tier spa, but the actual Silom experience felt much more like a small neighbourhood massage shop dressed up with clever concepts, social-media-friendly gimmicks and very effective marketing.

Ignore the influencer hype and judge it for what it actually is. For the money, I would spend it elsewhere.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to write this so carefully, and we are sorry the visit fell short. Two things in your review matter most to us. The first is that you left with rashes, which is not something we take lightly. We would like to know exactly what was used during your treatment so we can check the products and our records, and make sure you are alright. The second is the gap between what you expected from our online presence and what you found at Silom. Silom is our original branch, and it is small and intimate by design. If what we put out online suggested something grander, that is for us to put right, and we have taken your words to heart as we review how we describe each branch ❤️ Since we do not know your name from the review, please would you message us directly on WhatsApp at +66 82 539 9908 so we can speak with you personally.
Warm regards,
Chananchida & Dennis (owners)

reviews.name: Lotty
reviews.text:
I found this spa on Instagram when searching for a place to find a Head Spa experience, I booked in for the 60 minute treatment which includes 17 different steps including various types of massage with hands and other tools, hair wash, and neck, arms and shoulders too.  The whole experience from start to finish was wonderful, from the warm welcome with friendly smiles, a lovely welcome drink of butterfly pea juice, I even got to select my own scented oil for the massage, and my preferred shampoo for my hair type.

The head spa was delightful, so relaxing, I fell asleep for some of it!

The whole spa is beautifully decorated, the treatment room itself had soft spa music playing and tiny lights on the ceiling that look like stars.

After the treatment I had my hair blow dried neatly and enjoyed another drink, this time a warm herbal tea, with a sweet sesame biscuit, and was given a little pouch of bath salts to take home.

I’d recommend this place and hope to visit again in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lotty,
Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review, I hope this will help other people to see what is actually happening when you visit us! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed every part of your head spa experience, from the butterfly pea welcome drink and personalized shampoo selection, to the starry ceiling and relaxing treatment itself. Knowing that you felt so relaxed you drifted off to sleep truly makes us happy, as that’s exactly the comfort we wish to give our guests.
We’re also glad you enjoyed the finishing touches with the tea, thai snack, and bath salts, it’s our way of extending the spa experience a little further. Your kind words mean a lot to our team, which we will happily share with them, and we look forward to welcoming you back again for another relaxing escape.
Warm regards,
The Chandee Team

reviews.name: Yvette Liu
reviews.text:
Absolutely waste of time and money!

I’ve tried hair spa with similar price range around the region, but this is the WORST I’ve ever experienced, really regretted coming by believing all the influencers’ posts

1. The aircon is blowing at you directly in the room, I had 4 towels covering me to keep me warm

2. They use COLD WATER for hair washing, which shocked me from my sleep! What a horrible and stressful way to wake up to in a spa! Only upon our complaints then someone came up to make the water warm. However it’s impossible for us to fall back to sleep anymore!

3. The “therapists” have poor skills for handling hair!
They blow straight my friend’s permed hair, and ruined my newly permed hair by not following my instructions.
My hair became so rough, greasy and heavy after the session, forced me to re-wash my hair when I returned my hotel near midnight!

4. The body oil they used is with full fake strong fragrance, and super greasy texture

If you want to spend more than 2000 baht to relax, there are plenty of choices out there, with at least decent services and better environment, DO NOT give a try at this hair spa! It does NOT WORTH any of your penny!

I don’t know how they got such good reviews from, but I must share my fair review here to prevent more victims!
The shop returned me and my friend 350baht each voluntarily hoping us not to be angry, but no, I feel it’s such a scam!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to write this so fully, and we are genuinely sorry. Feeling cold in the room, being startled by the water, and the way we handled your hair are not the experience we want for anyone, and we are taking all of it seriously.

We have already reached out to you personally, and we are taking each point straight to our team so it is put right. If you are open to continuing the conversation with us, we are here.

With care ❤️
Chananchida & Dennis (owners of Chandee)

reviews.name: aotearoa
reviews.text:
As a professional certified masseuse that’s given and received thousands of massages over the years, I was utterly disappointed with my massage at KUMO

In summary: high price tag for a low effort, poor technique massage

I’ve been getting daily 200baht massages at The Cave next door, which has been consistently good to great, but decided to treat myself with a “four hands” head + foot massage for 700baht

Generally the higher the price, the better the massage, right? Unfortunately, that was not the case here

First off, I wasn’t asked if I wanted soft medium or firm pressure 🚩

The foot massage was below average. 20% foot, 80% leg, and most of that was just low effort stroking up and down, lacking any proper technique. No pressure points, no pressure. Lazy.

The “Indian head massage” wasn’t any better, which consisted almost entirely of prodding to my shoulders, chest and arms.

After she spent maybe 8 minutes on my left arm I said no arms, just head, and admittedly I got a good 5 minutes of head massage. That was bliss. That was what I came for. But alas, after 5 mins, she moved back to prodding my chest and shoulders again. For being advertised as a head massage, that was a total disgrace.

The masseuse putting my sandals on the wrong feet at the end was pure irony and perhaps emblematic of her overall care and effort

You’re paying a large premium here for a quieter room, some weak tea, a boring little biscuit, but no better massage than anywhere else

As a side note, for a 200baht massage I generally tip 40baht for a good massage, 60baht for a great massage, and 100baht for an amazing massage. I did not tip either masseuse, as paying 700baht for a sub par was already a big waste of money.

**Came back again in 2026 and they are still as good. Thank you! Attached the latest price list as of Feb 26 as well (last photo)**

This was my second visit to Bai Po Massage and I’ve loved both experiences. The first time I had a full body massage, and this time I tried the foot massage, both were excellent! The masseurs apply just the right amount of pressure, making it very relaxing and comfortable.

The shop is tucked away in an alley near Nana BTS station, which makes it convenient to get to. For now, there’s no need to make a reservation, which is a nice bonus.

They accept card payment.

reviews.name: Danska
reviews.text:
Absolutely excellent experience at Bai Po Massage in Sukhumvit. I had a sore and slightly inflamed right knee from too much hiking and walking while travelling, and the staff were incredibly professional and attentive.

I explained that I wanted medium pressure and asked them to avoid aggressive work on the knee itself. They understood perfectly and focused on the surrounding muscles instead — calves, quads and legs — which helped a lot with stiffness and mobility.

The 60-minute foot reflexology treatment this morning was outstanding, the atmosphere was relaxing, and the service felt genuinely caring rather than rushed. Everything was clean, professional and very reasonably priced at only 450 THB. I happily tipped extra because the treatment was that good.

Highly recommended if you’re staying around Nana/Sukhumvit and want a proper, professional massage experience.

Tangmo has strong hands but is still gentle and understands needs well and did an amazing massage—highly recommend because of her and my overall experience!

reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience during my traditional Thai massage. The masseur was highly skilled, professional, and attentive throughout the entire session. Truly one of the best Thai massages I’ve ever had. Highly recommended.

reviews.text: A wonderful experience with a knowledgeable and kind staff, I felt very secure from booking to landing! reviews.name: Nelson Janumala
reviews.text:
Thai Sky Adventures – 5/5
Location: Pattaya, Thailand
Experience Date: July 2025

Did my first tandem skydive here, and I’ve got only one word for it — flawless.

The team was solid — calm, experienced, and clear. They didn’t just help me jump, they made me believe I could.
From the briefing to the freefall, every second felt safe, sharp, and surreal.

Special thanks to my instructor — kept it cool, cracked jokes mid-air, and gave me the confidence to trust the process and enjoy the fall.
And the view from 13,000 ft? Pure magic.

This wasn’t just an adventure.
At 37, it was a reminder — you’re never too old to fly.

Would I do it again? Hell yes.
Thai Sky Adventures, you’ve set the bar. 👏

title: Diving Koh Tao

reviews.name: Larissa Campbell
reviews.text: Ban's Diving resort may seem big but it feels like a small family. I started my journey with a refresher course where June was my dive master, not only is she lovely but very patient and a fantastic teacher. After my refresher I went on some fundives, with Opal he was amazing, friendly and explains the dive site extremely well but always makes it a fun time in and outside the water. My other fun dives Tri was my divemaster his loveable personality and passion for diving is contagious....even after my fundives finished all my previous divemasters would say hi to me and always check in. They also convinced me to do my advanced open water.....best decision I made. Jason Byrk was my Dive Master, his knowledge and passion for the ocean and his students is awe-inspiring. Not only was he extremely knowledgeable but very calm, always assisting and there to improve your skills further.

reviews.name: Tayla Egart
reviews.text: Just finished my Open Water and Advanced Open Water Course with Jason Byrk at Bans Diving Resort!!! It was the most unreal experience ever must do if your ever in Koh Tao!!! Jason made the whole course fun and enjoyable wouldn’t do it with anyone else!!! I’m now officially scuba diver certified world wide and can scuba dive anywhere!

reviews.name: Lauren Shuker
reviews.text: I just completed my advanced open water PADI course with Jason and had the best three days! I cannot recommend Jason enough - he is so fun and enthusiastic, and ensured that we were always confident, comfortable and safe in the water. All of the theory was clearly explained and Jason made all information very understandable and digestible. Following the advanced course, we completed a fun dive to Sail Rock with Jason. We saw giant barracudas, grouper fish and schools of thousands of fish - it was absolutely incredible. I couldn’t have wished for a better instructor or group, and will certainly be returning to dive with Jason!! We also have some incredible photos of the dives, with many thanks to Nikki and Jason, and we were lucky enough to be accompanied by Olivia for our course as well, who was so calm, knowledgable and made us feel so safe.

reviews.name: K
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the underwater photography course with Jason! It was a fun and personalized experience, and I got to use two devices—Samsung phone and Olympus camera. I was able to try different styles like landscape and macro (which is incredible). We were blessed with whaleshark and giant grouper encounters as well! Jason shared many photo tips and also taught me how to edit photos in Lightroom. I recommend taking this photo course when you come to Koh Tao!

reviews.name: Alex Day
reviews.text: Doing my open water PADI course with Bans Diving was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. Jason our instructor was such a great guy, super chill but an incredible teacher. I started the course slightly nervous about the experience but by the end of the 4 days I felt so much more confident and comfortable under water. Couldn’t recommend the experience more. On the final day we had Nicki, who was also so lovely and a qualified instructor, come to dive with us and she took some incredible photos for us underwater. So grateful to have such amazing memories to take away. 11/10 experience if you’re ever in Koh Tao, you must try diving if you are able to. Thanks again to Jason, Nicki and Bans diving team!

I’m glad I did this with you at Ban’s diving resort.

reviews.name: Gabriele Cattaneo
reviews.text:
I recently completed a diving experience and training course, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better instructor than Jason. From the very beginning, he created such a relaxed and fun atmosphere that any nerves I had completely disappeared.

Jason is not only incredibly knowledgeable and professional, but also genuinely His jokes and energy made every lesson enjoyable, whether we were learning theory or practicing skills in the water. He has this amazing ability to explain.

The dives themselves were unforgettable beautiful underwater views combined with the excitement of learning something new. Thanks to Jason, I didn’t just learn how to dive properly, but I also truly enjoyed every second of the experience.

If you’re thinking about doing a diving course, I firmly recommend to do it with Jason.

reviews.name: Amy Byrne
reviews.text: Great experience with Ban’s diving! Jason was a really enthusiastic and informative instructor for my open water certification. Koh Tao has beautiful scenery and the water was really warm - perfect for learning in

reviews.name: Lea Wenzl
reviews.text:
Amazing experience doing my Open Water certification at Ban’s Diving School! Jason and Austin were fantastic instructors – very patient, professional, and always attentive to our needs. I felt comfortable the whole time and had so much fun. Highly recommended!
🌊🤿

reviews.name: Giles
reviews.text:
Wow, what an experience! It’s hard to put into words just how incredible the last three days of diving with Jason have been. I completed a total of seven dives, including a deep dive at 30 metres, navigation, a night dive (one of my personal highlights), and even learned how to use nitrox tanks.

Jason is a hugely talented and dedicated diver and instructor, spending a great deal of time both in and out of the water guiding us and genuinely helping to optimise our skills. One of the most valuable things he taught me was how much we can control our buoyancy simply through our breathing.

I enjoyed it so much that I joined the Sail Rock dive trip, where we swam through enormous schools of bigeye trevally as they circled around us — something truly memorable and unlike anything I’ve ever experienced. To top it all off, as we ascended, we were lucky enough to encounter a whale shark.

I cannot recommend Jason highly enough. Whether you’re just starting out or continuing your dive education, his years of experience, combined with a teaching style that makes everything feel accessible and genuinely enjoyable, make him an exceptional choice.

reviews.name: Emily Moore
reviews.text: Did my AOW PADI with Jason at Bans. He was the best instructor ever, super knowledgeable and supportive. I knew exactly what we were doing the whole time and we did some amazing dives. Even when I was nervous for the night dive he was really kind and encouraging. Ended up having the best experience with him and the group, would highly recommend to anyone wanting to dive / learn to dive in Koh Tao.

reviews.name: Cam Duncan
reviews.text: I’ve just completed my Open Water PADI course with Jason and it completely exceeded all expectations, easily one of the best three days (if not the best) I’ve had whilst travelling round SE Asia. Jason is an incredible instructor: patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate, making everything feel relaxed, clear, and fun while building real confidence in the water. The dive sites around Koh Tao were unreal, with crystal-clear water, stunning coral, and unforgettable marine life, including an eagle ray, a stingray, and so many other incredible species. If you’re even thinking about learning to dive, do it here in Koh Tao, and make sure you get Jason, because he’ll make your experience 10 times better. Truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience. 🌊🐠

reviews.name: Darragh Markey
reviews.text: We did our Open Water PADI course with Jason & Austin at BANS and had the best time! The guys were amazing; super knowledgeable, helpful and patient. Would 100% recommend if you’re in Koh Tao and looking to go diving!

hotelDescription:
This down-to-earth resort on 4 hectares of lush gardens is an 11-minute walk from the nearest beach and 20 km from Wat Chalong, a Buddhist temple.
 Featuring balconies with garden or pool views, the relaxed rooms offer flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and minifridges. Upgraded rooms add complimentary minibars; some include outdoor hot tubs. Suites provide separate living areas. Room service is available.
 Parking, a breakfast buffet, and a shuttle bus to Patong Beach are included. Other amenities consist of 2 outdoor pools, 2 poolside bars, 2 open-air restaurants and a gym. There's also a spa.

Every member of the staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and helpful, always going out of their way to make sure I had a great stay. Their hospitality really made the experience even more enjoyable.
I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and will definitely be returning on my next trip to Phuket. Highly recommended!

It means a lot to know you enjoyed your 10-night stay and that our team helped make your experience so memorable. Your kind words and recommendation truly encourage us, and we can't wait to welcome you back to Deevana Patong Resort & Spa for your next Phuket getaway. Safe travels until then!
Warm Regards,
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: chante louwrens
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Deevana Resort and Spa and would happily return. From the moment I arrived, the staff stood out—they were genuinely friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile. Their hospitality really made the experience feel special.

The rooms were spacious, clean, and well-equipped with air conditioning, reliable Wi-Fi, and a TV, making it easy to relax after a day out. Everything was comfortable and thoughtfully maintained.

One of the best aspects of the location is its balance—you’re just a short walk from the beach and the nightlife, yet the resort itself is tucked away from busy roads, so it remains peaceful and quiet.

Breakfast was another highlight. There was a huge selection of options to choose from, catering to different tastes, and everything I tried was delicious. It’s clear the hotel puts effort into both quality and variety.

Overall, Deevana Resort and Spa offers a great combination of comfort, location, and exceptional service. The staff truly make the difference here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your wonderful feedback. We are delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay, especially our staff, room comfort, location, and breakfast. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.
Warm Regards,
The Management

reviews.name: Emmanoel Scharf
reviews.text:
What a great experience I had with my wife at Deevana. Beautiful garden and big pool with a bar. They are very well located in Paying, close to many shops and a 7-Eleven. The spa is really good and I recommend at least one massage with them. Bed very comfortable and air-conditioning works perfectly. They also provide sein towels and good quality drinking water.
The breakfast is complete and offer a good range of foods, although the menu doesn't change much throughout the week (we stayed 5 nights).
A deposit of 3000 Baht is required in cash and will be returned at the check out. But whatever you consume on the resort can be deducted from this value, including the spa.
And of course, the staff was extremely friendly and helpful all the time. Their smile makes total difference!

We look forward to welcoming you again in the future.
Yours sincerely, 
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Harrison Davies
reviews.text: Couldn’t recommend this hotel enough. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, with no problem they couldn't help with. It's location is very convenient for the beach and close to lots of the places you'll be going. The rooms are well looked after and very spacious, especially those with their own pools. Would definitely go back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review and recommendation. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our convenient location, spacious rooms, and especially the friendly and attentive service from our team. Your kind words mean a lot to us.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back to Deevana Patong Resort & Spa for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
Deevana Patong Resort & Spa Team

reviews.name: Garth Hall
reviews.text: Great Hotel... Very quite relaxed atmosphere, just back from the main road. All the staff are very happy, polite, welcoming and hospitable. In the Dictionary, the word  hospitable means, warmly and generously welcoming guests, visitors, or even strangers. It goes beyond basic politeness, actively creating an environment where people feel safe, valued, and a sense of belonging. The hotel Deevana is all this. A special thanks to... the Manager Kevin for his visible Leadership, support and excellence a true Manager and a Gentleman 🙏. Mr Sor and his team at breakfast yum 😋 and my room cleaner Mrs Cream, always welcoming full of cheerfulness and cleans immaculately 🌹Well done The Deevana team 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr.Garth,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review and kind words about our team. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere and hospitality during your stay.

Your compliments to Kevin, Sor, our breakfast team, and Ms. Cream will be shared with everyone with pride.

We truly appreciate your support and hope to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards,
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviewContext.Nearby activities: Close

reviews.name: Ankur Patel
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing time at Deevana Plaza Phuket. The location is perfect—it’s tucked away enough to be peaceful and quiet, but only a short 7-10 minute walk to Patong Beach, Malin Plaza, and the lively Bangla Road.
​The rooms were incredibly clean, spacious, and the balcony overlooking the massive swimming pool was a huge plus. Speaking of the pool, the kids loved the water slide! The hospitality here is top-notch; the front desk and staff are extremely polite, welcoming, and always ready to help. Highly recommend this resort for anyone visiting Phuket!
