The hotel is perfectly located close to most attractions as well as the beach . The best part of this hotel is its EXCEPTIONAL STAFF. Every single person we interacted with was extremely helpful, friendly and welcoming. MEJI and her team , Rosdee , Amin , housekeeping by Cream , even the security guy and everyone else went out of their way to make our stay very comfortable and special :) . MEJI was exceptional & all our queries were answered patiently and  everything was handled perfectly with a smile . There was even a beautiful decoration and cake for my wife's birthday which was a fabulous surprise and made her day :) We were totally blown over by their genuine hospitality and care. Thanks a lot MEJI :) Highly recommend this wonderful place and we will definitely be back again 👍.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Your kind compliments about MEJI, Rosdee, Amin, Cream, and our security team mean a lot, and we will be very happy to share your appreciation with them. We're also glad you enjoyed the birthday surprise for your wife — it was our pleasure to make your stay special.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

Warm regards,

Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Captain Michael
reviews.text:
I had an excellent stay at Deevana Patong Resort & Spa and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Phuket. The property offers a perfect blend of comfort, tranquility, and accessibility. The rooms are well-maintained, clean, and very comfortable, while the overall ambiance of the resort creates a relaxing tropical getaway.

The location is ideal—close enough to the vibrant Patong area, yet peaceful and quiet within the resort grounds, allowing for a truly restful stay. The facilities, including the pool and dining options, were impressive and well looked after.

What truly stood out during my stay was the exceptional service provided by the team. I would like to extend my special thanks to Mr. Phassakorn Mohmas (Kevin), Guest Service Manager, and Ms. Kojchabhorn Tantayya (Buim), Reservation Manager. Their professionalism, responsiveness, and warm hospitality made a significant difference in my experience. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was handled smoothly and that my stay was both comfortable and enjoyable.

Overall, a fantastic experience with outstanding service. I look forward to returning again in the future.

Thank you once again to the entire team for your hospitality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your wonderful review and kind recommendation. We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the comfort, peaceful atmosphere, and convenient location of our resort.

Your kind words about our team mean a lot to us. Kevin and Buim will be especially pleased to know they made a positive impact on your stay.

We sincerely appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back again for another relaxing stay.

Warm regards,

Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Rashmi G
reviews.text:
We had a really nice & memorable stay at Deevana Patong Resort & Spa. We stayed for 2 days & 2 nights. We are so thankful from the bottom of our hearts to the team for giving us a luxury room upgrade.

We were hosted and taken care of so well throughout our stay. Special mentions to “Yoshi”, “Saii”, “Tammy” & “Kevin” for having shown utmost care and great hospitality. They were so kind, helpful & available always.

The restaurant at Deevana Patong Resort & Spa was so good. Special mention to “Pleng” for hosting and treating us with so much love & care. We loved the hospitality.

The pool was maintained so well and the view was absolutely stunning. We loved the overall experience at Deevana Patong Resort & Spa.

Thank you so much to the entire team at Deevana Patong Resort & Spa.

- Love & Best wishes,
Rashmi, Kaushik & Family.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your wonderful review. We are delighted that you had a memorable stay and enjoyed the room upgrade, restaurant, and pool. Your kind compliments will be proudly shared with Yoshi, Saii, Tammy, Kevin, Pleng, and the entire team. We truly look forward to welcoming you back again soon!
Warm Regards,
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Riya Ratra
reviews.text:
1 star.

Very disappointing experience. We had a genuine medical emergency in the family and submitted a rescheduling request before the original check-in date with supporting documents. Despite this, we received contradictory responses. At one point we were told rebooking might be possible up to 20 May, but later the booking was marked as no-show and finally we were told there would be no refund and no reschedule, and that we should make a completely new booking.

We understand non-refundable bookings can be strict, but the issue was the inconsistent and insensitive handling of a genuine emergency case. Mixed signals, false hope, and poor communication throughout.

Edit: The hotel has now resolved the issue and issued a revised voucher without any additional charge. I appreciate the eventual resolution, but the lack of timely communication and the need for repeated follow-ups during a medical emergency made the experience quite stressful. There is definitely room for improvement in responsiveness.

Edit 2: We stayed at this hotel, and the sweet staff upgraded our rooms, very close to patong beach and the market. Great breakfast service, clean and comfortable rooms, and all the amenities provided were great as well. The pool was also very well maintained and not deep so non swimmers can have a good experience. The only inconvenience was no elevators in the deluxe rooms area. I would definitely recommend this hotel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Riya Ratra,

Thank you for your feedback and please accept our sincere apologies for the inconvenience. We received a request from your agent to postpone your stay due to urgent health reasons and were happy to assist without charge. However, as we did not receive final confirmation from the tour company, the original booking remained active and was processed as a no-show.

We have now contacted your agent to reconfirm your new stay and are reviewing the no-show charge accordingly. We look forward to welcoming you soon.

Warm regards,

Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Ravi Sangam
reviews.text:
*Pros:*
Location is excellent - right in the center, close to restaurants, shopping, and nightlife.

*Suggestions for improvement:*
1. *Room lighting*: Both the room and bathroom lighting could be brighter for better comfort.
2. *Toiletries*: Please add basics like moisturizer and toothpaste to the amenities.
3. *Breakfast*: The options feel too basic right now. More variety and better taste would make a big difference.
4. *Safety*: No first aid kit available on site, which is important for emergencies.

Overall, great location but a few small upgrades would really improve the stay.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ravi Sangam,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our central location and found it convenient for exploring the area.

We also appreciate your valuable suggestions regarding room lighting, amenities, breakfast variety, and safety facilities. Your comments have been shared with our management team for review as we continuously work to enhance our guest experience.

Thank you once again, and we hope to welcome you back in the future.

Warm Regards,

Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Jordan Jacob
reviews.text:
Deevana is a really solid choice if you want to stay somewhere central in Patong while still having a proper resort feel. The location is excellent, close to everything but tucked away enough that you are not dealing with constant street noise.

The rooms are comfortable and well maintained, and the facilities are good, especially the gym, which is much better than what you usually get in a hotel. That made a big difference for us while travelling. The pool and spa areas are also great for relaxing after a big day out.

There is a bit of walking involved between the lobby and the rooms, but it is manageable and does not detract much from the stay.

Prices were higher during the Christmas and New Year period, which is to be expected, but outside of peak season it represents much better value. What really stood out was the customer service. The staff were consistently friendly, helpful and professional, which made the whole stay feel easy and well looked after.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jacob Jordan,
Thank you very much for your thoughtful review.
We’re glad you enjoyed our central yet peaceful location, comfortable rooms, and facilities, especially the gym. Most of all, we truly appreciate your kind words about our friendly and professional team.
We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again in the future.
Warm Regards,
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

reviews.name: Lisa Menrath
reviews.text:
Room was a bit musky smelling when we arrived, but nothing a couple of air fresheners and an open door didn't fix.
A full Buffet breakfast would of been preferred each day, but the menu concept wasn’t bad.
Otherwise the resort and the staff were amazing. Meji, Solly, Simmy & Mike, plus everyone else- thank you for making our first trip to Thailand one we will never forget. Nothing was too much of an ask. We had a ball with our bartenders at the swim up pool.
Thank you Deevana- we are super sad to be leaving!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We're sorry the room wasn't as fresh as expected upon arrival, and we appreciate your comments about the breakfast as they help us improve.

It truly means a lot to know that Meji, Solly, Simmy, Mike, and the rest of our team helped make your first trip to Thailand so memorable. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with everyone.

We’re delighted you had such a great time, especially at our swim-up pool! Thank you for choosing Deevana, and we hope to welcome you back for another unforgettable stay soon. Safe travels!

Warm Regards,
Deevana Patong Resort and Spa

title: The Prime Massage
address: 128, 23 Si Lom 6, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Tilong Vang
reviews.text: Very very busy massage parlour so best to go and make a booking and not expect to have a spot right away.  They offer different combos , the foot/head and should 2 Hour was absolutely amazing.  One of the best I’ve had.  The place is clean and the therapists really know what they’re doing.   The next day I had the 2 hour Thai massage and it was also equally great.  Thb for 2 hour Thai and thb 750 for 2 hour combo foot/head and shoulder so quite good prices

reviews.name: Danny Lin
reviews.text:
A perfect place to relax after a long day of sightseeing. The atmosphere was clean, quiet, and welcoming, making it easy to unwind from the moment I walked in. The staff were friendly and professional, and the entire experience felt comfortable from start to finish.

The massage was excellent, with just the right amount of pressure. The therapist paid attention to the areas that needed extra care and helped relieve a lot of tension in my shoulders and back. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and ready to continue exploring Bangkok.

If you're looking for a clean, professional, and reasonably priced massage in Bangkok, The Prime Massage is definitely worth a visit. I'd happily come back the next time I'm in the city.

reviews.name: Tristan
reviews.text:
I can understand the hype and strong reputation behind this place. The shop has a great location and a very smart business model.

The reception staff are excellent at what they do and speak very good English, which really helps avoid any language barriers or confusion. Everything was smooth from booking to check-in.

The masseuse was professional and skilled, and the room was cozy and comfortable. I truly enjoyed my massage experience. The pricing is also reasonable for the quality you receive.

Definitely one of the go-to massage spots for me.

reviews.name: Aki
reviews.text: Just had my 6th visit at The Prtime Massage and it is still the best massage experience I’ve had. Every time I come here, the therapists are incredibly professional, attentive, and skilled. They really know how to release tension and make you feel completely relaxed. Highly recommended

reviews.name: amir afandi
reviews.text:
After trying four different massage places in Bangkok during this trip, this one is easily the best.

The prices are very reasonable, the place is clean and comfortable, and the service is excellent. A special shoutout to my therapist, Alun, who provided one of the best massages I've ever had. He was very attentive, accommodating, and took the time to understand the areas where I was experiencing discomfort. Most importantly, he applied exactly the right amount of pressure and worked on the right pressure points, which made a huge difference.

Highly recommended, and I'll definitely be coming back on my next visit to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Daniel Lim
reviews.text:
I've always had good massages at The Prime Massage. Its not clear how many masseuses they have as their premises is segregated across three buildings. But every massage I had with them had been excellent. The masseuse use sufficient strength to loosen the knots, and are professional in the delivery of their services.

Environment-wise, the premises are clean and conducive. If you're doing a full body massage, there are shower facilities to clean up before and after the session. There's always a nice scent in their premises.

Price-wise, it is reasonable. I usually go for their 2hr package that comprises of one hour of foot massage and one hour of oil massage. You will get to choose one type of scented oil from six options at the counter.

Its true that its difficult to reserve a session with them as they are very popular, especially during peak tourist seasons like Songkran and year end celebrations. I last visited them during off-season on a weekday and secured a slot immediately.

This place differentiates itself from the average palours through its consistent good standards and clean environment, and the higher end ones through its reasonable price. They've hit a sweet spot!

reviews.name: nwauthier
reviews.text:
The Prime Massage is hands down the most wonderful and professional massage and spa experience I’ve had in Bangkok. The service is consistently exceptional, the staff is highly skilled, and the entire atmosphere is relaxing and welcoming.

I’ve been here many times over the years and always leave impressed. This is one of the first places I recommend to anyone visiting Bangkok and looking for a truly top-quality massage experience.

reviews.name: Thiong-Ann See
reviews.text: I went there twice. The first time, I had Cha. The massage was excellent. The second time, Cha was fully booked, so I was assigned a different masseur. The experience was only average. I guess it really depends on choosing the right masseur.

reviews.name: Raymond Kam
reviews.text:
Some of the best Thai massages I've ever had have been at The Prime.  High quality and affordable.  300 THB for a 1 hour Thai massage.

I've been going here since 2018 and they've consistently kept a high quality of service.  It's a clean place spread out across different buildings.  They have great masseuses that give nice, consistent pressure; great after a day of walking or training.

A couple of notes:
- they are walk-in only and they book up very quickly for same day appointments. No Line or online booking methods.  If you want to book an appointment ahead of time, you need to pay to confirm your appointment.  They don't seem to answer the phone often
- They take cash, credit card (3% surcharge) and Thai QR codes.  No Alipay or WeChat pay.

Just a note that you are expected to tip your masseuse (normally 100 baht)

After your massage, you get a nice cup of tea and a hot towel.

Amazing place.  Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Zhihai Ng
reviews.text:
Was there for 2 day

Try the 2 hour Thai massage
Try the 1 hour foot and 1 hour oil massage

Very profession and resonance price, prefer the 1 hour foot + oil

They have different combination
Have male and female masseurs, good for couple as well

Friendly staff and they can communicate with you in English. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Husky
reviews.text:
The masseur performed a one-handed massage with a scrub and essential oils. He supported himself on the edge of the bed with his other hand while massaging. He added a few drops of water and massaged from my back to my waist. Then a few drops were added again, massaging from my waist to my calves. He was basically dry-massaging (crying).

It hurt, it hurt.

I asked him to add some water. If he didn't understand, fine. He massaged my back haphazardly. He didn't even massage my heels (he didn't even massage the backs of my hands).

Then he moved to the front. He directly massaged my upper and lower arms (right side of my body).

He didn't massage my palms or the backs of my hands.

He was almost entirely drawing circles with one hand. He even put a glove on one hand.

He added very little water.

Even worse, on the front—chest, arms, stomach, thighs, calves—he only added one drop of water. He didn't even massage my feet.

Then he moved to the left side of my body.

I immediately said, "I don't want a massage anymore, I want to go back to my hotel."

I always stay in Thailand for 6-7 days.

I get massages at this shop every day.

This time it was very uncomfortable. I feel regretful.

This time (dry scrub) my neck and the back of my thighs, and it stings even when I shower, although I can't see any wounds.

Thank you to the receptionist, and she offered to refund me.

I said no,

because I showed the receptionist two sentences (she was massaging with one hand, the other hand supporting her on the edge of the bed).

The scrub was very long in the middle. I can't explain it all.

Thank you for your hard work.

reviews.name: Paul Chay
reviews.text:
This place is really busy, either you call and make an appointment ahead of time or walkin and take a scheduled appointment for later, definitely worth the wait.I haven't even began the massage and I am already impressed.......... And when it all started,.... Oh wow,.... 10000 points/ stars for great technique..... The crowd speaks volumes for itself....I don't need to reiterate the obvious....

Totally recommend even if you have to wait. Good things happens when you give it time and wait.

The place smells great too....... Lemongrass.

My therapist is Mr. Nuts.... So so good!!!

reviews.name: Robert
reviews.text:
Great massage and very professional. Hands down the best Thai massage I ever had.
Lemon grass oil smells great too.
Just hope the aircon is abit colder, the room was kinda hot.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this place.
Clean and good massage by male massagers.
Is was strong enough and consistent pressure to whole body.
2 hours Thai traditional massage was only 500 Baht.

Massage 10/10
Cleanness 10/10
Atmosphere 10/10

They have 3 different buildings under same management.
Place on Google map to make payment.
And then a person will bring you to different building to do massage.

reviews.name: Belle Zaldivar
reviews.text:
Personally rating the quality of massage I experienced a 5 out of 5. The therapist assigned to me is commendable. I made a reservation through phone as recommended by other google local guides to avoid the wait. You can also specify if you like your therapist male or female (I guess their protocol is if client is male or female, same gender will be assigned).

We got the Foot Massage and Aroma Massage 2 Hours - 750 baht per person. Considering the quality of the massage and worth of service is definitely plausible and reasonable enough for me to recommend Prime Massage.

Couple of things Id like to highlight
- Foot Massage Area is inconveniently designed. In what way? This is where customers mainly enter and exit out and also the area of recovery and waiting. So if one is having their foot massage and customers are to come in/out or perhaps wait, there is inconvenience experienced due to 1. massive noise and 2. movement (doors being opened and closed every single minute, people passing by every so often). Foot massage area should be provided with some sort of privacy at least. With my experience, I had 0.
- Payment should be done before any service is rendered.
- Tip is “required”.

reviews.name: Arif Krismunandar
reviews.text: after having massage here, my body feels sore, and they are forcing me to give a tip. overrated place, good things only clean and smell good

reviews.name: Hongyu Wang
reviews.text: Came here two weeks ago and I would say definitely recommend this place. The cheaper Thai massage option sells out quickly. I don’t speak Thai and was not able to call ahead and book the cheaper option. However, the fancier oil option was available. I had 90 minutes massage and every moment was the best. The therapist knew every detailed spot to massage proficiently. The therapist also cracked my body at the end like a chiropractor. Every crack made the sound. It was so good. Definitely would go again though only the more expensive option might be available!

reviews.name: HiDe86
reviews.text:
This was my first time using this place, so I started with a Thai massage (90 minutes for 450 THB).
First, they washed my feet, and then I was shown to the room. The massage pressure was just right—not too strong and not too light—and I was able to spend a very relaxing 90 minutes.

The reception staff could speak English, but the massage therapist did not, so it might be helpful to use Google Translate or a similar app for communication.

reviews.name: Daryl
reviews.text:
Located at Silom area, this place do have very professional services, not hanky panky and just really good quality massages.
Visited here many times and each time is always a great session, its like everyone is trained well to massage.
There is a minimum tip of 100baht, but I think it's worth it

reviews.name: Aoo .z
reviews.text:
Let's make it fair:
1. The massage skill here is very excellent
2.Both genders therapists, not just males, so no worry.

Some points I might not recommend:
1. Difficult to make a reservation, I'd called them 4-5 times , no answers.
2. I accept tips, and I knew about it. I gave 200 as my appreciation at the end , but the therapist looked not happy at all.....I felt I gave him too less or something?

reviews.name: Akshay Hooda
reviews.text: This is a hidden gem and rare spa retreat and massage parlour in Chiang Mai, Thailand. The expert staff can give you the real massage you want and the prices are much better than some other big spa retreats here.  The best part is you can hear birds chirping from the garden.  The spa experience is my favourite and the place is lovely, nestled inside a garden full of plants and flowers. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a genuine experience without the risk of back pain from unskilled staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful and thoughtful review 😊
We’re truly honored to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful garden atmosphere, the sounds of nature, and the authentic massage experience with our team 💜

Creating a relaxing sanctuary with skilled therapists and genuine care is exactly what we strive for every day.

Your kind words mean so much to us, and we sincerely appreciate your recommendation 🌿✨
We hope to welcome you back again soon for another peaceful retreat in Chiang Mai.

reviews.text:
The staff here deserve a massive shout-out! Every single employee was incredibly polite and enthusiastic. They showed so much patience and care toward the kids' little needs, making us feel completely at home.
The shop is cozy, comfortable, and absolutely immaculate—it's an instant mood-booster the second you step in. The attention to detail is remarkable. Easily our favorite family-friendly find lately. Highly recommend to everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your incredibly thoughtful review and recommendation! 😊 We are truly delighted that your family felt so welcomed, comfortable, and well cared for by our team.

Creating a warm, clean, and relaxing space for guests of all ages is very important to us, so your kind words mean a great deal. We look forward to welcoming your family back to Lila Thai Massage again soon! 🙏💜

reviews.name: Alexandra Böhm
reviews.text: Everything was great. We came here in the pouring rain, very soaked and the staff welcomed us kindly. They gave us a towel and clothes to change into. The price is very fair for what you are getting. There are a lot of different options and the atmosphere is really great. The massage was very professional and the time was fully used. I would recommend it to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and recommendation! 😊 We’re delighted that our team could make you feel welcomed and comfortable after arriving in the rain.

It means a lot to know that you appreciated the fair pricing, variety of treatments, relaxing atmosphere, and the professional massage experience. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back to Lila Thai Massage again soon! 🙏💜

reviews.name: Nir Atar
reviews.text:
Great location and facilities. I had two treatments. First one, Thai massage was great and very relaxing. Second one, oil massage that felt like it was done by an unskilled therapist. My body is in more pain than it was when I got in.
My wife and kids had several treatments in this place and we have mixed feelings about the overall quality. Some say wonderful, other say that it is ok'ish.
I guess it really boils down to the therapist assigned to you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your detailed and honest feedback.
We’re glad to hear that you enjoyed the Thai massage and our facilities.

However, we’re truly sorry to hear that your oil massage experience did not meet expectations and caused discomfort. This is certainly not the standard we aim to provide.

We understand your point regarding consistency between therapists, and we take this very seriously. All of our therapists undergo training, but we will continue to improve consistency and supervision to ensure a high-quality experience for every guest.

Thank you again for sharing your experience. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you and your family again and provide a much better experience 🌿💜

reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Lila Thai Massage, Ratchapakhinai, Chiang Mai. My therapist, Muay, was exceptional—truly one of the best massages I’ve had in my lifetime.

She skillfully combined reflexology with a variety of massage techniques, applying just the right pressure and precision to bring complete relaxation. Every movement felt purposeful and effective, leaving me refreshed and completely at ease.

The staff were also very courteous and welcoming, always greeting with a warm smile, which made the overall experience even more pleasant.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly relaxing and professional massage experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your truly wonderful and detailed review.
We are honored to hear that your experience with us was one of the best massages in your lifetime.

Muay will be especially happy to receive your kind words. We’re delighted that you enjoyed her technique, precision, and the combination of reflexology and massage.

Your appreciation of our team’s warm hospitality means a lot to us.
We truly look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing experience 🌿💜

title: Sarinna Thai Massage
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Sarinna Thai Massage

Sarinna Thai Massage invites you to experience refined and premium relaxation inspired by authentic Thai healing traditions. Our professional therapists combine skill, intuition, and care to deliver exceptional results.

Please note:
We accept walk-ins, but we highly recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred appointment time.

reviews.name: Stephen ong
reviews.text: Located in a small room in the Holiday Inn Express building is a typical massage operator. The high price did not justify the quality of service as after 90 minutes none of your aches have been massaged well compared to cheaper  services found in Sukhumvit. There is no private room for the service just a narrow massage bed and curtains. No feet soaking or ointment for tired legs. A massage place only for convenience before transfer to airport.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Stephen ong

Thank you very much for sharing your feedback 🙏🏼

We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not fully meet your expectations.

At Sarinna Thai Massage, we aim to offer a boutique massage experience within a comfortable hotel setting. Each treatment includes a pre-massage consultation to understand individual preferences, complimentary tea before the session, and tea with snacks afterward to support a relaxed experience.

Our space is designed for comfort and ease, with extra-wide massage beds and a quiet, focused environment to support a quality treatment experience.

While our prices may be slightly higher than some walk-in massage shops in the area, they reflect the overall level of care, comfort, and service we aim to provide.

We understand that massage pressure and style are highly personal, and we regret that we were unable to meet your expectations on this occasion. We appreciate your feedback and thank you very much for visiting us.

Warm regards,
Sarinna Thai Massage

reviews.name: Dr Anish HV
reviews.text:
📍 Exceptional massage quality, great service & fair pricing – Sarinna Thai Massage (Holiday Inn Central Pier, Bangkok)
(Visited in Dec 2025)

If you’re a couple, first-time visitor to Bangkok, or staying around Central Pier / Sathorn, this is a very smart choice.

1. First impressions & booking experience 🧾✨
✔ Located conveniently inside Holiday Inn Central Pier
✔ Clean, calm environment from the moment you walk in
✔ Smooth communication and easy to understand options

✅ Special mention: Katherine (front desk)
✔ Very fluent English
✔ Extremely helpful and polite
✔ Communicates clearly and quickly understands what kind of massage you want
✔ Makes the whole experience smooth, especially for International travellers

2. Massage we chose 💆‍♂️💆‍♀️

✔ Sarinna Signature Massage (for me + my wife)
✔ Great if you want relaxation + strong technique (not just “light rubbing”)

3. Essential oil options 🌸🌿

They let us choose between:
✔ Lavender essential oil
✔ Sakura essential oil

🌸 I chose Sakura
💜 My wife chose Lavender

Both oils smelled great and felt high-quality during the session.

4. The therapist quality – Khun Jeab was excellent 🔥

Our masseuse was Khun Jeab, and she was genuinely amazing.
✔ Kind and professional
✔ Strong, powerful technique but still controlled
✔ Very precise and knows exactly where pressure is needed
✔ Massage left us feeling lighter, refreshed, and relaxed
⭐ The head massage was spectacular
✔ The stretching was also excellent and felt really satisfying

This was the kind of massage where you walk out feeling like your body got “reset”.

5. Comfort, hygiene & thoughtful details 🍵🌼

✔ Great tea options before and after the session
✔ You also get a Thai sweet, which is a nice touch
✔ Clean and hygienic environment (important for travellers)
✔ High-quality oils

🌼 Small detail I really loved:
✔ The massage table face hole has a pretty flower underneath — such a sweet and thoughtful touch. The space is small, but everything felt clean and well-managed.

6. Privacy setup 🚫

🚫 No fully private rooms
Beds are separated with curtains, so privacy is still maintained, but it’s not the same as a private room with a door. Not a dealbreaker for us, but worth knowing in advance.

7. Price vs value 💰

✔ Pricing felt fair and not too high. Yes, you may find cheaper massages outside (we tried), but overall:
✅ Better technique
✅ Better vibe
✅ Better cleanliness
✅ Better consistency

So for quality + comfort, this spa wins.

8. Insider tip for travellers 🔥

📌 If you’re staying at Holiday Inn or near Central Pier, this spa is super convenient after a long day out
📌 If you want a proper massage, ask for Khun Jeab (if available)
📌 Don’t just chase the cheapest price outside — quality matters when it’s your body

9. Would I recommend it❓

✅ Yes, absolutely!
If you’re in Bangkok and want a reliable, clean, professional massage—especially as a couple—Sarinna Thai Massage is a great option.

📸 I’ve attached photos of the menu/prices and a few glimpses of the spa.

💬 Did this review help? Hit 👍 & share your experience below!

reviews.name: Taka Honda
reviews.text:
To be honest, I had high expectations for this place since it is part of the Michelin Guide in the Bib Gourmand category. Because of that, I think having certain expectations is completely normal.

Let’s start with the place itself. It’s kind of a pop-up space with a casual and informal atmosphere and a nice vibe. One funny detail is that they seat you on office chairs with wheels.

The service was friendly, but at the same time it felt very amateur. It looked like the whole team were students, with no management visible or checking what was happening on the floor.

The restaurant is well known for their fresh, seasonal Thai fish, and they offer different varieties and sizes with separate prices alongside the main menu. However, on a Friday evening, before 6:30 they had already run out of at least 80% of the fish selection. They first showed me one fish, I agreed to order it, and then about ten minutes later the waitress came back to tell me they had sold it to another table. I have to admit I was quite upset and frustrated. At that point, there were hardly any fresh fish options left.

The food wasn’t bad, but it was far from remarkable. It certainly wasn’t the kind of meal that stays in your memory as a foodie experience.

I definitely won’t be coming back, and I can’t recommend it. Honestly, I don’t understand how Michelin has this restaurant in the Bib Gourmand selection.

reviews.name: i4designTV
reviews.text:
Let’s start with the positives.

At Maadae Slow Fish, the seafood is sourced directly from artisanal fishermen along the coasts of Chumphon and Prachuap Khiri Khan. These “Slow Boat” fishermen use traditional, low-impact fishing methods that help preserve Thailand’s coastal ecosystems. The restaurant is equally committed to sourcing local, seasonal ingredients and artisanal seasonings from small-scale organic and sustainable farmers and producers throughout the country whenever possible. Their philosophy is admirable, and it shows on the plate.

My grilled rabbitfish was succulent, with firm, slightly sweet white flesh. The mackerel curry, grilled in a banana leaf, was more of a fish loaf than I expected, but the curry itself was among the most flavorful I’ve had in Thailand. The ceviche was served warm rather than chilled, yet it was still delicious. The pumpkin tortilla chips were overly salty, as was the coconut milk accompanying the sago pearl dessert.

Despite those minor issues, the quality of the ingredients and the skill in the kitchen are undeniable. I would gladly return for the food alone.

Unfortunately, the front-of-house operation is where the experience falls apart. Service was disorganized, and the staff appeared to have little training in either the menu or basic hospitality. They were friendly and clearly trying their best, but they seemed to lack the support and guidance needed to deliver the level of service the kitchen deserves.

The atmosphere, however, was wonderful. A lively mix of locals and visitors, families, musicians, and artists created a relaxed, vibrant energy that made the restaurant feel genuinely special.

Maadae Slow Fish has all the ingredients to be an exceptional dining destination. The food is memorable, the sourcing philosophy is inspiring, and the atmosphere is inviting. If the front-of-house service can rise to the same standard as the kitchen, this restaurant has the potential to be truly outstanding.

reviews.name: Stuart March
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I visited Maadae Slow Fish Kitchen on a Thursday lunchtime and it turned out to be a great find in Chiang Mai.

The space is calm and relaxed, with a simple, modern feel. Lots of natural light and small details that make it feel considered without trying too hard.

I had a Thai milk tea with coconut milk and asked for no sugar. I liked that they don’t use additives or overly sweet mixes. It felt clean and natural, which fits well with their focus on quality ingredients and sustainable fishing.

For food, I went for the broccoli fried rice and a fried whole fish with garlic from the pop-up menu. Both were really good. The rice was light but full of flavour, and the fish was fresh, crispy, and cooked just right.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and spoke excellent English, which made everything easy.

It’s the kind of place that feels quietly special. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking for something fresh, thoughtful, and a bit different from the usual spots.

reviews.name: Marusha Mozolevskaya
reviews.text:
NOTE to the management: please ask the customers to not have their phones on loud speaker chatting with family and watching videos – it really kills the vibe. Today the whole time that we’ve spent at lunch two customers at the other tables were blasting their phones with no respect to others whatsoever 😒

Other than that, food was fantastic. The banana leaf-wrapped fish was tender like a cheesecake and pomelo salad was spicy, tangy, and full of character. Decent portions, too.

reviews.name: Terrance Siew
reviews.text:
This place is famous for its grilled fish. It’s fresh and definitely a must order here.
As for dessert , go for their mango sorbet that’s 100% all natural with no artificial coloring. The tom ka soup is “refreshing” and worth ordering.
Omelette crab is small portion suitable for 2 person sharing
Has indoor and outdoor seatings.
Credit card accepted but with 3% additional charges.
English menu available. Staff is able to converse  in English well.

reviews.name: Peter Seow
reviews.text: I am not a big fan of fish but this place serves good fish dishes. The fish is grilled perfectly without it being too dry. The fish green curry is delicious and vegetables cooked perfectly. We came early about 5:30 pm with enough room to accommodate us till 6:30 pm. You may want to make a reservation before coming which we saw many tables booked.

reviews.name: Amy Wu
reviews.text: It was one of the best meals that felt clean and sustainable of my trip! Also the most expensive of my trip, but worth it as a last meal. The clear seafood soup was the stand out. The pomelo salad was good but too salty and overpowering; could eat with white rice to taste better. I like their mission and a woman chef leading the change in the world :).

reviews.name: Worawat Lawanont
reviews.text:
Must visit. This is such a rare find in Chiang Mai, not really traditional northern food, but everything is on another level here.

The menu sounds so simple, yet made to perfect.

reviews.name: Tamara Trajkova
reviews.text: Excellent food, probably one of the best salad dressings I've tried in a while. The fish is extraordinary. It definitely requires reservations ahead since it's always full - and for a good reason. Fantastic service and food. One of the only places that gave us water as we sat down. Thank you!

reviews.name: Pei
reviews.text: I enjoyed the food and wine during the dinner. The crab fried rice was so good and impressive. However, I vomited all out later that night and had a diarrhea. I think it might be the grilled fish. For those who have a sensitive stomach, be cautious!

reviews.name: Sara K
reviews.text: Love the place! We literally ordered every food on the menu! Some dishes could taste alright but most of them are super delicious. Highly recommend to come with a group of friends so you can enjoy as many dishes as you can. We also ordered dessert which made from the real sako tree and they have homemade cola. Definitely going back there again! Highly recommend for those who wish to escape the normal northern local food!

reviews.name: Joyee
reviews.text:
One of our favorite meals in Chiang Mai! The chargrilled catch of the day was fresh and not too dry. We tried almost everything on the lunch menu - pomelo salad, mussels, 2 seasonal vegetables with and without salted fish and Southern curry with fish of the day.

Everything was amazing and I would recommend seasonal vegetables with salted fish (not too salty, not too dry)! The chargrilled fish is a must try and they grill it right outside the restaurant. Highly recommend a reservation as we tried to walk in for dinner and weren’t able to - booking through Google Maps is the easiest method. We heard about this restaurant through a recommendation and so happy we came here! 6-7 dishes with rice would be enough for 4 people based on our experience. I recommend coming with a larger group so you can try more things!

reviews.name: Adeline Ng
reviews.text:
Reservation is required as it’s always full. Good ambience and great service. Food wise I gave a 7 out of 10 for the fish dishes. My personal opinion: fish might be tastier if stuff with herbs into the stomach through the mouth, example crushed lemongrass/pandan leaves. Salad dishes are a 10 out of 10.
I had a fish and salad dishes for takeout and was beautiful packed in big banana leaves and Eco friendly straw bag.

reviews.name: WOO ISA
reviews.text:
We didn't book in advance, so we waited for almost 20 minutes. It was understandable that they were too busy to serve everyone properly, but I still had to ask for a glass of water after we got a table.

For the food we ordered, the fried rice was ok but served in a small portion so I don’t think it well priced. The grilled fish was just average, and broccoli was the only available vegetable. They could definitely do better.

Perhaps I'll try other dishes next time when I pass by. Anyway, if you live nearby, you can give it a try, but it's definitely not worth a long drive. Actually The view in the alley is great with plants which is a surprise for me. Adding a touch of greenery and vitality to the surroundings.

reviews.name: L MAY
reviews.text: This was our favorite meal in Chiang Mai. We were reassured that the Kitchen is peanut-free and everything was amazing and super fresh. I reccomend making a reservation as many couples were turned away while dining.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Crab Ceviche & Pumpkin Tortilla Chips, Catch of the Day, Stir Fried Cabbage with Homemade Salted Fish

This place is Michelin recommended

reviews.name: Jeremy Hodin
reviews.text: The stadium is really nice ! The organisation also is well managed everything is fast, no queue. The show was about 5 hours and we saw around 15 fights. We had a great time, is fun and the public is really into it. No video is allowed but pictures are ok !

reviews.name: Patrick Lazarus
reviews.text:

reviews.name: 405backpacker
reviews.text:
Even if you’re not an avid sports fan, this is a fun event. There’s a great vibe with music and food trucks outside the event. There is seating outside to eat which is good because food purchased outside must be consumed outside!

No pressure to be on time because there are several fights before the main event. If you like boxing or UFC, you’ll really like Muay Thai. There are also snacks and drinks available (for purchase) in the stadium.

The stadium tends to be a little chilly so dress appropriately or bring something in case you get cold!

reviews.name: aman relingpa
reviews.text: If you want to watch real fights ,this is the place . Definitely do visit if in Bangkok, it will be worth every penny.

reviews.text: I've been here several times for One Championship. And it has a really nice ambience, lighting and also ring-side view was nice. Came here for Regian Eersel and seems like I'll keep coming back!

reviews.name: OfficialG Tui
reviews.text:
Came here on a Saturday at 5 PM expecting a big fight. The staff even said it was a “big one” but the arena was about half empty. I also thought of getting wristband (like I’d seen in previous reviews) but nothing. The fights themselves were entertaining and the venue is clean and organized, but the atmosphere felt flatter than expected for this stadium. Prices aren’t cheap, so I was hoping for a bit more energy and a fuller crowd.
Worth checking out if you’ve never seen Muay Thai live, but I’d recommend coming when you know the event will truly be at capacity.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Kabir M Aswani
reviews.text: We got second-row seats — not ringside, but the view was perfect! The fights were incredible, full of energy and skill. Loved the vibe — electric crowd, great music, and super friendly staff who made the experience even better. A must-do in Bangkok if you want real Muay Thai action! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Exploring Z
reviews.text:
ONE Lumpinee Championship only once a month.

If you’re talking energy, violence, gold-standard Muay Thai action, and a crowd that actually lives Lumpinee Boxing Stadium is the real deal. This isn’t some tourist attraction or watered-down show. It’s a full-blown fight spectacle where fighters go to war under bright lights and 4-oz gloves that make every punch and kick hit like metal.

From the moment you walk in, you feel the  packed house, buzz in the air, and that vibe only true fight fans bring. Every Friday night, this legendary Thai stadium transforms into one of the hottest fight forums on the planet with global audiences tuning in.

This place still carries that old-school aura and crazy crowd! Modern, wild, and locked in from bell to bell. Fighters are introduced, and the whole arena goes berserk. It’s bloody, gritty, and far from boring.

This is fast-paced Muay Thai with hybrid rule sets 3 rounds, insane strikes, and finishes that make you shout.

You see multiple disciplines, Muay Thai but also kickboxing, MMA, and submission grappling at times — all under ONE’s banner.

Knockouts and wild finishes are the norm, not the exception — fighters go for glory, not decisions.
This place doesn’t baby you. It serves violence with respect.

It’s a Must-See
Whether you’re a die-hard fight fan or just love a high-octane night out in Bangkok, ONE Lumpinee has that rare combo of:
This is a legendary stadium with modern fight production

The crowd energy is deafening

No sausage fest org for tourists — this is combat for the people. You watch these warriors scrap, you FEEL the sweat, you hear the exotic lingo, you see the colorful shorts flying — it’s an experience, not a show.

If you’re in Bangkok, you’ve gotta hit ONE Lumpinee once. Whether you’re here for the culture, the chaos, or just to see someone get brutally KO’d in glorious fashion — this is an unforgettable night out.

4 stars only because its hectic and Bellamy in a good way.

reviews.name: N KEIKO
reviews.text:
Lumpinee Stadium is smaller than Rajadamnern Stadium, which actually makes it easier to find your friends and meet up before the event.

The seating is closer to the ring, so you can enjoy the fights from a much better perspective and really feel the action.

The air conditioning is also not as strong as at some other venues, making it much more comfortable to spend the whole evening here.

A great place to experience Muay Thai in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Mark Knight
reviews.text: Brilliant night out enjoyed every minute of it. So many mixed martial arts on display. Well organized venue with great views.

reviews.name: Mack Benz
reviews.text:
For a newer stadium it's okay. Fights were awesome. Energy is great but kind of a mediocre/poor layout.

Needs floor lighting, multiple people tripping throughout the events on black on black chair attachment to floor, quite dangerous. Concierges using flashlights the second someone gets up and guides them to the stairs, because they know this.

Small venue but fun experience. Great events but the stadium is not that good.

reviews.name: Rohan Berlin
reviews.text: Great place to watch muay thai. Authentic fights, not like you see in other 'muay thai fights' around the place. Very affordable.

reviews.name: Gültekin Temtek
reviews.text:
I went to Lumpinee Stadium tonight specifically to watch some truly world-class Muay Thai fighters compete at ONE Championship. I wanted to fully enjoy the experience, so I paid 4,800 THB for a VIP ticket. Unfortunately, while the fights themselves were absolutely worth watching, the overall VIP and event experience was extremely disappointing.

First of all, the area advertised as offering one of the “best views” was constantly obstructed by the camera crane/jib moving in front of us. For a VIP seat at this price, that simply shouldn’t happen.

Secondly, there was no visible screen showing the round timer for the audience. You’re watching a professional combat sports event and yet you have no idea how much time is left in the round.

The screens hanging above the arena, which are supposed to show highlights and replays, were ridiculously small. You practically need binoculars to see what is happening on them. For an organization of ONE Championship’s level, I expected much better production inside the venue.

And then there is the VIP experience itself. Compared with Rajadamnern Stadium, the difference is huge. At Rajadamnern, buying a VIP ticket actually feels like buying a VIP experience, with much better hospitality and service. Here, even water had to be purchased separately. After paying 4,800 THB for a VIP ticket, that says a lot about how little thought has gone into the customer experience.

And one more thing that honestly shocked me: the toilets were absolutely filthy. For a venue hosting an international event of this scale, and especially when you are selling VIP tickets for 4,800 THB, the condition of the toilets was unacceptable. This is a basic standard that should not even need to be mentioned.

To be clear, I have absolutely nothing negative to say about the fighters. The ONE Championship fighters were incredible, world-class athletes, and the fights were definitely worth seeing. My disappointment is entirely with the organization and the stadium experience.

Overall, from beginning to end, the event experience was far below what I expected from ONE Championship and Lumpinee Stadium, especially as a VIP customer.

If you are visiting Bangkok and want to experience Muay Thai live for the first time, I would absolutely recommend Rajadamnern Stadium instead. Go there and experience what a proper Muay Thai atmosphere, event production, and VIP experience can feel like.

The fighters tonight were fantastic. Unfortunately, the organization around them did not match their level.

reviews.name: Maria
reviews.text: Cool stadium with good fights! It's always freezing cold so bring a jacket.

reviews.name: Tim Powers
reviews.text: I took in a One Fighting championship Friday night fight last month. Witnessed to most brutal low blow I have ever seen. Great card of fights. The arena is very basic and most seats you have a great view. I would go back to watch fights here again.

reviews.name: Muffin
reviews.text: Great venue. You can see the action no matter where you sit. Food carts outside.. and they are good value. Just bring trousers and a hood because the air conditioning works over time here. Gets very cold. Well worth a visit. BE CAREFUL IF YOU BRING A LARGE CAMERA HERE... security will tell you off. Even though there is 100 other people live streaming on their phones and taking pictures. Seem to have a problem with "professional" looking cameras however big or small.

reviews.name: Zenette gabor
reviews.text: We watched multiple times of Muay Thai fights in this stadium. It is not as fancy as the other stadium, but it has the ambience of a sporty venue. The bleachers were clean, the staff spoke English very well. The lights were great and the sound wasn't very loud but just fine.

reviews.text:

The only thing is the transport is not convenient and no ideas how to go back to Bangkok main area by public transport.

title: The Ice Bath Club - Bangkok
ownerDescription: The Ice Bath Club is the world’s first Daily Recovery Club. Designed for ambitious people, our clubs make recovery simple with walk-in access to incredible ice baths, social saunas, magnesium hot baths and a café serving exceptional coffee and smoothies. Whether you’re looking to reduce stress, improve sleep, recover after training or simply reset for the day ahead, you’ll find everything you need under one roof. No bookings required. Just show up and recover. ⁠Located next to Nana BTS in the heart of Bangkok.
address: Floor 1, Unit 101 , JLK Tower , 129, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a detailed and thoughtful review! We’re so happy you felt fully taken care of—from the towels, swimwear, and amenities to the café and recovery spaces. reviews.name: Arissara Tantayanon
reviews.text:
I absolutely love coming to The Ice Bath Club. The place is always spotless, well-maintained, and has such a welcoming atmosphere.

What really makes this place stand out from other ice bath studios is the water system. Unlike many places that simply use regular tubs with stagnant water, The Ice Bath Club has a treatment and circulation system that keeps the water constantly filtered and clean, which makes the whole experience feel much more hygienic and comfortable.

Another thing I’ve never seen anywhere else is the swimsuit drying machine—it’s such a thoughtful touch and shows how much attention they put into every detail.

The entire team provides exceptional service and takes great care of every customer from beginning to end. They explain everything clearly and make sure everyone feels comfortable throughout the experience.

A special mention to the manager, Alex, who always goes above and beyond to look after guests. He is incredibly kind, attentive, and always willing to help with anything. His professionalism and genuine care make every visit even better.

Highly recommend The Ice Bath Club to anyone looking for a premium and well-managed ice bath experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this incredibly thoughtful and detailed review! 😊 We’re beyond happy to hear you love coming to The Ice Bath Club and appreciate the clean, welcoming atmosphere we strive to maintain every day. 💙

You’re absolutely right about our water system—keeping the water constantly filtered and circulating is a priority for us, because we believe hygiene and comfort are essential to the best ice bath experience. 🧊💦 And we’re thrilled the swimsuit drying machine stood out to you—it’s one of those details we’re proud of! 👙✨

A huge thank you for your kind words about our team, and especially for mentioning Alex. 🙏 

We can’t wait to welcome you back for more premium recovery sessions—your support means the world to us! 🙌🧖‍♂️❄️

reviews.text:
Had a great session at IBC. Beautiful sauna and the ice baths are properly cold and well maintained, and moving between the sauna and the hot bath makes it easy to do a full hot-cold cycle at your own pace.

They also have a great coffee bar and is genuinely good, which you don't expect from a recovery spot.

But what makes the place is the vibe. It's relaxed and social without being loud, the staff are friendly, and nobody rushes you. Easy place to spend a couple of hours. Will be back.

reviews.name: Aidan Kean
reviews.text:
A new recovery spot that’s just opened up in Bangkok. Great location with easy access from Nana BTS. All indoor space with showers, toilets, lockers, towels, and even swimsuits if you need some.

For recovery modalities they’ve got a sauna, cold plunges, cold showers, and magnesium hot pool. They also are attached to a Sarnies cafe for some drinks and snacks.

Forgot to take a photo of the sauna but it’s the most stunning part. The nicest finish of a sauna I’ve been to in Bangkok so far. Controlled water release onto the rocks so no one can come in and assert dominance with 10 splashes.

Both drop in and membership available!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the detailed review! We’re so glad you loved the facilities, Sarnies café, and especially our social sauna—no splash-dominance contests needed 😂💙

We usually go to our favorite massage place, but they were busy, so we decided to try somewhere new. At first, we were hesitant because of the cheap prices—but we were pleasantly surprised because the service was excellent.

reviews.name: Jan Dannemann
reviews.text:
I discovered the small massage salon “Khiang Raming Thai Massage Chiangmai” almost by chance, and I’m really glad I did. It’s located a little away from the main streets, which means it’s much quieter and less crowded than many of the massage places directly on the busy tourist roads. But it’s absolutely worth walking the extra few meters.

From the moment you walk in, you feel welcome and relaxed. The atmosphere is calm, clean, and very authentic. It doesn’t feel like a tourist-focused place, but rather a small, genuine salon where you receive very personal and attentive service.

The massage itself was excellent.  You can immediately tell that the therapist has a lot of experience and knows exactly what she’s doing. After the session I felt noticeably looser and deeply relaxed.

If you’re looking for a truly great Thai massage and don’t mind walking a little away from the main streets, I can highly recommend this place. Definitely one of the best massages I’ve had here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5-star review and thank you for trusting us to take care of you ❤️🙏 See you again next year. Thank you so much ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Paul Ndungu
reviews.text:
I had one of the best massage experiences at Aurasol Wellness and Spa.

From the moment I arrived, everything felt welcoming, they offered a nice drink right away, which was a great start. The background music was super relaxing and really helped me switch off.

I wasn’t sure which massage to choose, but the receptionist was very helpful in explaining the options and guiding me.

They even went the extra mile and informed the therapist to focus more on my back because of some past discomfort, which I really appreciated.

The therapist was very skilled and professional, but also warm and friendly, which made the whole experience even better. You can tell they know what they’re doing.

After the massage, a Thai coconut dessert with tea was provided, which was such a nice touch and a perfect way to end.

I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Simmy Kailath
reviews.text:
One of the best massages we’ve ever had. The Thai massage is quite intense, but you feel very relaxed afterwards. Both therapists, Olay and Natty, were very kind and highly professional. They always checked that we were comfortable, identified problem areas on their own, and adjusted the treatment accordingly.

Aurasol itself is a beautiful, clean place that feels both comfortable and luxurious. We will definitely come back the next time we visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: Vicky Chow
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience at Aurasol Spa Bangkok yesterday. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, elegant, and incredibly relaxing. The spa is beautifully maintained, and the soothing aroma of the massage oils immediately made me feel at ease.

A special thank you to Natt, who gave me one of the best deep tissue massages I've ever had. Natt was highly skilled, attentive, and knew exactly how to relieve the tension and tightness in my muscles. The pressure was perfect, and I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and rejuvenated.

The quality of the massage oil was exceptional—the fragrance was luxurious, calming, and lingered pleasantly throughout the treatment, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.

If you're looking for a professional massage in Bangkok with excellent service, a peaceful atmosphere, and outstanding therapists, I highly recommend Aurasol Spa. I'll definitely be coming back on my next visit to Bangkok!

reviews.name: AlexJiang0v0
reviews.text: My partner and I came here for a 60-minute Thai oil massage, and we had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was beautiful, relaxing, and felt very luxurious. The lovely scent of essential oils filled the entire spa, which made the experience even more calming. The therapists were highly professional and skilled—we both felt noticeably more relaxed and comfortable afterwards. At the end, they even served us pudding and hot tea, which was such a thoughtful touch. The service was absolutely excellent. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Janine
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve had in Bangkok. 90 minutes of pure relaxation. The therapists are incredibly professional, the surroundings are beautiful, and the whole place has this hidden-gem feel to it. If you’re in Bangkok, this is a must-visit. Five stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.name: Reem A
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience genuinely disappointed me.

From the moment we walked in, everything felt rushed. We were immediately told to choose an oil, as if someone was chasing the staff. There was no proper consultation whatsoever. We booked the Deep Sleep Warm Oil Massage, yet no one asked about our preferences, areas that needed extra attention, previous surgeries, medical conditions, allergies, or whether there were any areas that should be avoided during the massage. These are basic standards that every professional wellness spa should follow.

The massage bed was also extremely uncomfortable—hard and painful to lie on for 90 minutes. Ironically, after my treatment I noticed another room with a much more comfortable massage bed, which made the experience even more frustrating.

The treatment itself was so poor that I couldn’t even continue with my first therapist. I actually stopped the session and told the staff, “I came here to relax, not to suffer.” Unfortunately, almost every aspect of the experience was disappointing.

What surprised me the most is the reputation this place has. Based on all the praise and recommendations, I expected a premium wellness experience. Instead, I received a service that was below the standard of many ordinary massage shops I’ve visited.

I’ve experienced massages in everything from local massage parlors to luxury five-star spas around the world, so I believe I have a fair benchmark for comparison. Sadly, this was nowhere near the level I expected.

The price simply does not reflect the quality of the service. Spending 90 minutes here felt like a waste of both my time and my money. I genuinely thought I had chosen one of the best wellness experiences in Bangkok, but it turned out to be one of the biggest disappointments of my trip.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously because the service, professionalism, consultation process, and overall guest experience need significant improvement. At its current standard, I cannot recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations. We are especially sorry to hear that the consultation process, treatment quality, and overall service fell short of the standards we are committed to providing. Your comments regarding the lack of consultation, therapist performance, and treatment room comfort are deeply concerning, and we fully acknowledge your disappointment.
Please be assured that your feedback has been shared directly with our management team and will be carefully reviewed to strengthen our service standards and guest experience. We truly appreciate your honesty, as it helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to provide you with the level of care and professionalism you rightfully expected in the future

AURASOL Team

reviews.name: Maryna Y.
reviews.text:
I decided to treat myself for my birthday and visited this spa, but the experience wasn’t exactly “wow”, but just ok.  The only downside was that someone before me had left their underwear and a towel in the shower cabin, and it hadn’t been cleaned before my session, which was not very pleasant.
The massage itself ( a 1.5-hour aroma massage)  was generally good. However, I’ve had similar experiences before in regular massage salons and other SPAs. The only difference here might be the use of more “luxury” aroma oils, but overall, nothing particularly special.
I expected more from this place since I came here based on a recommendation.

reviews.name: Gamkaew Slp
reviews.text: The front desk staff speak excellent English and are very professional. The massage therapist provided exceptional service. I was truly impressed — an excellent experience and great value for money. The spa has a relaxing and pleasant aroma. Complimentary drinking water is offered upon arrival, and snacks are thoughtfully served after the massage. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Amber Ning
reviews.text: One of the best Thai massages I’ve had. very relaxing, therapist is skilled, and very attentive to pressure, it really helped release tension in my back and shoulders. Clean, calm space and friendly, professional staff. Great value and I’ll definitely be back :)

reviews.name: maggie
reviews.text: One of the best scrub and massage experience i have encountered! The masseuse was so good in handling her pressure after she knew what i want. I dont usually sleep during a massage but i definitely did here!

reviews.name: Trip Or Treats
reviews.text:
Absolutely worth the 120 minutes! I booked the De-Stress Signature and it was amazing, perfect pressure, great stretching, and they really worked on all my sore spots.

The ambience is beautiful and luxurious, and the Thai therapist was very skilled.

Walked out feeling completely relaxed. Highly recommend if you’re in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Faii Cotton
reviews.text: Im very impressed with the service and hospitality here. Most convenient to come with BTS Chongnonsi. But if you drive there are plenty of parking spaces available and you just need to get up to 11th floor. Masseuse here is very gentle and knows the real technique to massage. Really recommend!! Only sad point for me is that they dont do head massage here…

reviews.name: K M
reviews.text: Pure luxury! My husband and I did the 120 min Deep Sleep Warm Oil Massage and it was exceptional. It's the full experience- a serene atmosphere, luxurious massage bed, soft towels, fragrant massage oils, hot and cold scented compresses welcome drink, finishing tea and skilled technicians! Wow what a treat! Thank you Khun Lek and Khun Num for exceptional service!

reviews.name: Sarah Weiterschan
reviews.text: WOW! Such a great, luxurious place to spend time. Had the best massage ever here! Would come back anytime. Thank you!

reviews.name: Gayeshi Perera
reviews.text: I highly recommend this establishment to anyone seeking a peaceful retreat from the busy streets of Thailand. While it is slightly on the pricier side, the experience fully justifies the cost. The masseuse were highly experienced, professional, and courteous, making the visit genuinely enjoyable. We chose the Ultimate Relaxing Massage, and it was exceptional. From my feet to my face, every detail was thoughtfully attended to. I left feeling light, deeply rejuvenated, and thoroughly relaxed.

reviews.name: Federico De Luca
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, this was the best spa experience I’ve had in Bangkok, and honestly one of the best massages I’ve ever had anywhere in the world.

From the moment I walked in, everything felt incredibly calming, professional, and luxurious. The entire experience was thoughtful and seamless, creating the perfect environment to completely switch off and relax.

I had a combination of treatments including a neck and back massage, a full-body deep oil massage, and a facial, and every single part of it was exceptional. The pressure was perfect, the techniques were incredibly effective, and I genuinely walked out feeling lighter, refreshed, and completely recharged.

A special thank you to LILLY, who was absolutely incredible. Her attention to detail, intuition, and professionalism truly elevated the whole experience. She immediately understood exactly where I was holding tension and tailored the treatment beautifully. You can tell she genuinely cares about making sure her clients leave feeling their absolute best.

If you’re looking for a spa experience in Bangkok that goes beyond just a massage and feels like a true act of self-care, I cannot recommend this place enough. I’ll definitely be coming back.

Thank you for such an unforgettable experience. ✨🙏🏻

reviews.name: Supaporn A.
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this massage. The staff were very professional, friendly, and attentive. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and comfortable.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality massage experience ka. 😊

reviews.name: Kate Bass
reviews.text: I visited a luxury spa in Bangkok yesterday and was absolutely thrilled! The interior is incredible, very beautiful and cozy. The staff is extremely caring and professional. The spa has a lot of private rooms for treatments, which adds privacy and comfort. I had a scrub massage and an oil massage, and I was incredibly satisfied — I relaxed so much that I fell asleep! I highly recommend this place to everyone. And the Thai dessert was delicious, a perfect finishing touch to the treatment!

reviews.name: Michell Tan
reviews.text:
Booked a 2-hour deep tissue massage at Aura Spa in Bangkok as a birthday gift for my husband and I. Before the appointment, the service was good. Reminders and communication were prompt and professional. We also arrived 15 minutes early as advised.

However, despite having a 4pm appointment, we were only ushered into our room at around 4.30pm, which was disappointing given the premium pricing and expectation of service standards.

The massage itself was unfortunately quite mediocre. My husband and I are avid massage-goers, and for the rates charged, we expected much better technique and pressure. The masseuses were polite and pleasant, but they seemed to be working back-to-back and appeared tired, resulting in a lack of strength and consistency during the treatment.

Overall, while the pre-service communication was good, the actual experience did not justify the premium pricing.

reviews.name: Min Lim
reviews.text:
Poorly trained staff running this business as if it is a premium massage spa.

I get 2-3 hours massages everyday when I visit Thailand.

Among all the aroma massage spots I visited, this was the only premium spa I am disappointed and feel like it was a waste of money.

We made a reservation thinking it would be similar level to other 2500-2600 baht range for two hours massage places that we go to.

Appointment was at 7 pm.
The receptionist calls you during the day saying they are busy, therefore don’t be late to the appointment. We get there at 6:40 pm to be prepared. Guess what, they let us in our rooms at 7:20 pm. Disorganized than a factory chain level.

Specifically, requested to have aroma massaged trained masseuse. The receptionist over the phone and in person reassured they are trained.

In reality, got two masseuse who only know how to give aggressive rubbing thai massage. With oil rubbed on.
Sure, we told them to help us relax, but all it would do is slow down the pace with the same rough touch.

Not relaxing at all nor they know how to take knots out using aroma massage technique.

This was a lower end massage experience wrapped with a receptionist that is great at selling it as premium to foreigners who visit.

reviews.name: Praew Cheung
reviews.text: Very calm and clean facility. Well experience therapist, one of my go to place for my rest day.

reviews.name: Sumol
reviews.text:
The spa and massage area within the Racquet Club's sports community is quite spacious. It offers private massage rooms and a sofa area for foot massages, making it ideal for parents waiting for their children to finish sports activities.

Their foot massages involve using a wooden tool to press on specific points. This might not be suitable for everyone.

The foot massage area can be quite noisy due to its proximity to the swimming pool. The atmosphere may not be as relaxing as some might prefer.

reviews.name: Tara S.
reviews.text:
Location was easy to find. I used Grab bike so it’s a little Out of the main road.

Atmosphere: What a cute place! Very calm and clean atmosphere from the lobby up to the reception area. Welcome drink was great. Clean service room. My technician was very professional. She has knowledge on the facial set I picked! It also came with head, shoulder massage!

LOVE the mango jello and drink at the end.

reviews.name: Shunsuke Yoshida
reviews.text:
“I felt so relaxed!”
It was my first time visiting, but the staff welcomed me with a warm smile and provided attentive service, which made me feel comfortable from the start. By the end, my body felt so much lighter, and I could move my shoulders smoothly for the first time in a while. The tea served after the massage was also delicious, which added to the overall relaxing experience. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

reviews.name: Chitchanok Annonjarn
