title: White Wood Green Spa & Wellness, Ekkamai
ownerDescription:
White Wood Green Spa & Wellness (Ekkamai) is a calming boutique day spa near Thonglor in the heart of Bangkok. Inspired by the healing powers of nature, our Ekkamai spa offers luxury spa experiences in a tranquil environment that brings the warmth of the countryside to the city. Our massage spa is designed to be a restful escape from the bustle of Sukhumvit.
Our wellness spa services include traditional Thai massage, organic aromatherapy massage, reflexology, hot stone massage, deep tissue massage, facials, body scrubs, and curated wellness packages using organic ingredients and traditional techniques for our signature spa treatments designed to relax, restore, and reconnect the body and mind.
address: บ้านเลขที่ 53 Ekkamai 12 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: บ้านเลขที่ 53 Ekkamai 12 Alley

reviews.name: Jonathan L
reviews.text: Excellent service. They accommodated to my rescheduling and were very welcoming despite I was slightly late due to traffic. They made me feel very welcomed and settled me in. Beautiful ambiance very aesthetically pleasing. Massage was good, firm and strong. Highly recommended !

reviews.name: Kelly Tan
reviews.text:
I had a really wonderful hot stone massage experience, my therapist is IMM. From the moment I arrived, the environment was calm and welcoming, which immediately helped me relax.

imm was very skilled and attentive, checking in on the pressure and making sure I was comfortable throughout. The hot stones were used perfectly , not too hot, and placed with great technique to ease tension in my shoulders and back. I could literally feel the stress melting away.

What I appreciated most was how unhurried the session felt. It wasn’t just a routine massage, but a genuinely thoughtful and relaxing experience. I left feeling refreshed, lighter, and much more relaxed.

Overall, it was a very enjoyable experience and I would definitely come back again. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and recharge.

reviews.name: Alia Almuhairi
reviews.text: Had such a relaxing experience at Tarn Tara Spa. The atmosphere is so peaceful and really makes you forget the busy city for a while. The service was excellent, the staff were super welcoming and professional, and the hospitality made the whole experience even better. Definitely one of the most calming places I’ve visited in Bangkok 🤍

reviews.name: Melissa ChenJie
reviews.text: An absolutely luxurious and rejuvenating experience. The Organic Aromatherapy Massage was exceptional from start to finish — calming ambiance, exquisite aroma oils, and incredibly skilled techniques that melted away every bit of tension. Every detail felt thoughtfully curated, creating the perfect balance of relaxation and elegance. I left feeling completely refreshed, renewed, and deeply pampered. Truly a five-star experience.

reviews.name: Andrea Millado
reviews.text: Massage date with my bestfriends, and we had the best massage here! I did the aromatherapy massage using the summer scent oil. The place was clean, minimalist and very relaxing. Hot tea was served after massage with hot neck aromatherapy pillow. Thank you to the very attentive therapist and very polite front desk ladies.

reviews.name: Kate Bass
reviews.text:
Yesterday I visited a spa located right in the heart of Bangkok, and it was a truly wonderful experience.
The atmosphere is very pleasant, relaxing, and impeccably clean. There are several private rooms, including one with a personal bathtub, which adds a special touch of comfort and privacy.

They offer a wide selection of oils for aroma massage. I chose their signature massage, which combines warm oil, hot stones, traditional Thai techniques, and pressure on tension points. It was deeply relaxing and therapeutic at the same time.

At the end of the treatment, I was served delicious tea with homemade cookies, which was a perfect finishing touch. I also loved that they have their own production of massage oils, candles, and scrubs, as well as a clothing line made from natural fabrics.

The service is exceptionally friendly and attentive, with genuine care for the client’s comfort and enjoyment. I highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for a high-quality and relaxing experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sam Liew
reviews.text:
White Wood Green Spa at Ekkamai exceeded all our expectations many folds!

From the moment we stepped inside, we’re completely immersed into a peaceful oasis away from hustle and bustle of downtown Bangkok. The ambiance is absolutely stunning, calm, elegant, and welcoming.

We booked the 90 minute therapeutic signature massage and Thai heritage massage with compress ball.

WOW... every minute was pure bliss! The therapist, Su and IMM were highly professional, with an incredible touch that relieved of all our stress and tight muscles.

We have had massages in other countries we visited, including in Thailand however none came close to the level of skills of both of our therapists.

We both regretted for not opting for the 120 minute session. It would have been the best experience we can imagine.

What impressed us most was the attention to detail, from the warm welcome tea to the relaxing post treatment lounge.

If you are reading this and want to treat yourself to a top-notch spa experience in Bangkok, this is one worth your consideration !

reviews.name: Jan K.
reviews.text:
A great spa experience! We tried the White Wood Green Therapeutic Signature Massage and the Soothing Water Therapy both were super relaxing and well done.

Service was excellent! Friendly, attentive, and very professional. Would definitely come back!

reviews.name: Kalia
reviews.text:
I booked this a month out ahead of time to make sure there was an opening for me.

I had an excellent time here. I was late, and they were still willing to accommodate to me. They were all so kind and always smiling, uplifting my spirits. I mean it when I say that the interior design and little details is EVERYTHING. This is how I want my future home to feel and look. They even gave me 10% off because they were doing construction. But honestly, I did not mind the construction. This just shows how much they truly care about their work and presentation.

Yesterday’s 22 hour flight really got to me — but I felt so good afterwards. I’d love to come back if I have more time and try the other services they offer 🤎
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. We look forward to welcome you again in the future.

reviews.name: Marie Tan
reviews.text:
I did a head massage with Imm and it was the perfect way to finish the day after walking around all day!

The time went by too quickly and I can’t wait to be back next time 🙌

reviews.name: Casey Carl
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved our massages at White Wood Green Spa!!!!!!! Could not have asked for a better 90 minute massage. We did the signature massage which is a mix between their Thai and aromatherapy massages and it was perfect!

Thank you!

reviews.name: Moza Ali
reviews.text: Perfect place to be far away from all pressures. Rest, calm and feeling good because of the place's quite vibes, staff and services. I visited many times not only one. The staff are very helpful and CUTE. I really enjoyed my experience and I advise everyone visiting Bangkok to go & rest there. 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this. Our team is so happy to hear this!

reviews.name: Danah Photos
reviews.text:
I’ve been here today , and this experience was good! I enjoyed Aroma massage with one of technicians couldn’t remember her name. The room was beautiful and smells amazing! Everything went good except some points I wish they could take care of. The interior design is superb!!

• The bathroom was far away from the room, we you need it you can’t reach it.
• Room was cold, they better provide hot pads or at least extra towels!
• After the session I had only tea, I wish the got me some water and small piece of chocolate maybe? Or any type of sugar..

One more thing which is major in my opinion.. the therapist after the session was walking ahead, this time in specific the customer is dizzy after the spa, she should at least walk with me and insure the safety..

reviews.name: sol
reviews.text:
This is a place I always return to whenever I’m in Bangkok, a place where calm and peace truly meet. Everything about it is dreamy, starting with choosing which body part to focus on and selecting from a variety of essential oils (which, let me tell you, is harder than it sounds!).
The aromatherapy massage itself is absolutely wonderful, you leave feeling light and refreshed. The experience is beautifully finished with a cup of tea of your choice, and you can stay as long as you like without feeling rushed.

reviews.name: Savan
reviews.text:
I’ve been looking forward to trying this spa for a long time, and today I finally got the chance.

My mom and I booked a 90-minute essential oil massage and chose one of their seasonal organic essential oils. Before the massage, they provided a form for customers to fill out, indicating their preferred pressure level.

The spa environment is elegant and minimalist, mainly decorated in white and wood tones—very peaceful and comfortable. We were taken into a suite, and after a foot wash, the essential oil massage began.

I want to give special praise to the massage therapist, Vii (please forgive me if I’ve misspelled your name).
Since my mom had some aches in a few areas and wanted a deeper massage, we asked for help from the therapist. Vii was very enthusiastic and willing to assist, and her technique was excellent. It significantly eased my mom’s pain, and she couldn’t stop praising her (which is rare—my mom rarely compliments massage therapists). So, a big thank you to Vii.
She was also very considerate toward the elderly—before the spa session, she helped my mom up and down the stairs.
I hope the spa continues to nurture Vii’s talent so more customers can experience her excellent massage skills.

This spa is considered mid-to-high-end in Bangkok. Personally, I think the service quality is great and the environment is peaceful. What I appreciated most was how comfortable the massage bed was. I usually dislike lying face-down, but their method of propping up my forehead with towels was different from other places, and it helped me breathe more easily.

As for the therapists, my mom’s was outstanding, as mentioned above. Mine was just average—not bad, but nothing exceptional. So I think the skill level really depends on the individual therapist, and it’s a bit of “by luck “.

reviews.name: Stephanie Wong
reviews.text: White Wood Green Spa in Ekkamai offers a calm and relaxing atmosphere with a natural, soothing environment. There’s a good selection of oils to choose from, and the staff are friendly and professional, tailoring the massage to your preferences. After the treatment, a warm cup of tea nicely rounds off the experience. A solid spot if you want a peaceful break - I’d definitely return.

reviews.name: Angelica Rose Gonzales
reviews.text: i love the place and the therapist really professional her name is SU she’s the best. it’s so relaxing, so worth it!

reviews.name: Aaron Romero
reviews.text:
Beautiful spa, amazing treatments and environment. Sadly I can only give 3-stars due to being charged unexpectedly for additional services upon checking out.

I booked a couples White Wood Green Therapeutic Signature massage and it was very pleasant, the room and overall aesthetic was amazing. Service from the therapists and staff we encountered ahead of our treatment was top class.

At the end of the massage we told that we could take our time, use the bath, and steam room. We pre-heated the steam room while taking a bath and 10-minutes into using the bath we had a knock on the door asking us to get ready to leave the room, which we didn’t have an issue with despite sadly not being able to use the steam room.

Upon checking out with our green tea, we were asked to pay for the extra services (using bath and steam room) which came as a surprise because we weren’t informed that they were extras beforehand. This was a miscommunication on their part, we didn’t use the steam room because we didn’t have the time and were rushed out of the bath.

I ended up paying an extra 1,600 baht for unexpected services which were rushed, which after paying 5,800 baht, leaves a sour taste.

I was planning on making this a monthly ritual, but due to this I will be seeking another luxury spa and wellness facility to unwind monthly.

reviews.name: Sam C
reviews.text:
I had an aromatherapy massage. The spa’s environment is very big and cozy. There’s a lot of wood elements. It’s very pretty.
My therapist Nam was very nice and the massage was lovely.
After the massage I was given tea and a heated neck pillow. It’s very relaxing

reviews.name: Cherry Thuang
reviews.text: The massage was so comfortable that I actually fell asleep. It was incredibly relaxing, with great privacy throughout the session. The environment is beautiful, cozy, and thoughtfully designed, making the whole experience truly enjoyable and calming. Highly recommended.

Aroma Oil + Thai massage 2 hrs only 699 B

reviews.name: Emily
reviews.text:
Honestly such a great find for the price. I paid only 350 baht for a foot massage. The place is simple and no-frills, but clean and comfortable.

The massage itself was good—firm pressure, very thorough, and the therapist clearly knew what she was doing. I walked out feeling so much lighter and relaxed.

Service was friendly and efficient, no hard selling, just a genuinely good experience. For this price, it’s definitely worth it and I would come back again without hesitation.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a solid, affordable massage in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review, Alway welcome!

reviews.name: Mert KIRATLI
reviews.text:
I went to Friends Massage in Nimman and asked for a 350 baht Thai massage. I told the receptionist that I found the place on Google Maps and that I would leave a review about my experience.

She told me that if I wanted a “strong” massage, I would have to pay 600 baht, and that they could not do a strong massage for 350 baht.

I have been living in Thailand for 6 years and have had massages in many different places. Normally, soft, medium, or strong pressure is based on the customer’s preference and does not require an additional charge.

I did not appreciate this pricing policy. For this reason, I do not recommend this salon.

reviews.name: Tik134
reviews.text: Good massage and good price in a quiet place ..We had 1 hour foot massage me and my husband we will come back again for hot oil massage in next few days.. Highly recommended..

reviews.name: Delly
reviews.text: One of the best massage experiences in Thailand. The foot wash at the beginning was so unique and great smelling, the massage rooms have a luxury spa-like vibe, and the masseuse really got into my knots. The tea at the end was also very unique and delicious - definitely coming back here!

reviews.name: Eglė Goleckytė
reviews.text:
Came here many times! Very good massage (I tried Thai and Back Neck Shoulder). Never got disappointed.
Very clean and nice interior. Recommend!

reviews.name: javid raeisy
reviews.text: Very nice massage place. Staff are very friendly and their massage is really good. Will definitely visit again

reviews.name: Juha Junttila
reviews.text:
I had a very good foot massage here. Finally! Took a while to find one in Chiang Mai.

Do note that they offer cookies if you give a five star review so the score might be a bit skewed. The massage I received was honestly top notch.

(I wrote this review after leaving the shop - cookies don't interest me as I'm on a diet)

reviews.name: Trisha Thow
reviews.text:
Nice service from the girls. I really enjoy the clean ambiance :)
Foot soak - nice smell
I did a 1.5 hr thai Full body with ointment .. love the smell. In the end have ginger tea plus rice cake 🎂
Wifi also available.
#nohankypanky
#legit for ladies

reviews.name: Elaine Huang
reviews.text: Came back 2 days in a row for Oi because she was just that good! Been to multiple places to get massages already and this one is the best. Fair prices and good pressure. Would keep coming back everyday if I was staying in the area much longer!

reviews.name: Claire
reviews.text: Everybody in the shop was very kind and friendly. We were all satisfied with the skilled massage. Facilities are clean and tidy. We would like to recommand this shop. :)

reviews.name: Kwang Sujinno
reviews.text: We have been regular customers since branch 2 and have never been disappointed. The massages are always amazing, leaving us feeling relaxed. The staff and the owner are very friendly and kind. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: YANG ZHAI
reviews.text: Nice place with good hygiene and peacul herb scent. The therapist I got is a decent lady with good skills in oil massage. With a proper pressure and very accurate locationa on my back and shoulders, she also pointed out my years of awulf habits of using my right side too much and often and therefore caused balanced should heights. Thats why I came here for the second time in next day but unfortunately she was not available for my session. Later my friend came to me and I highly recommend her and so he enjoyed an hour magical touch and felt the same way. We will definitely come back to this massage place if we were in Chiangmai again. Thanks for your excellent job done.

reviews.name: Derrick Nguyen
reviews.text: Our last day in Chiang Mai and we wanted to get a massage before we left. We went to a few, and they didn’t offer any aromatherapy massages, only Thai. We didn’t want a Thai massage, so we stumbled upon this place. Very nice people working here, as they greeted us very kindly. I got the 90-minute aromatherapy massage, and it was amazing. I train BJJ and Muay Thai, and my body has been pretty beat up the last few weeks here, and the masseuse did an excellent job of giving me the right amount of strength as well as avoiding all of my bruises on my body while still massaging the area calmly. It may not look super cute as the others around Nimman, but that’s exactly why this one is better than those. I wish we had another day, or else I’d come back tomorrow. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Raven
reviews.text: Such a good massage wow. I did the 90min combo number 3 which included a foot massage, thai massage, head back and neck. Every inch of my body was massaged and stretched. After my massage I was given tea and a snack which was super yummy.  I will definetly be back!

reviews.name: Stephanie Nguyen
reviews.text:
I had an incredible 90-minute Body Scrub and Aromatherapy session here, and it was exactly what I needed. After days of feeling drained and dealing with the Chiang Mai smog, this treatment completely revived me.
The body scrub felt so cleansing—it was like shedding all the toxins and stress of travel. Following it up with the aromatherapy massage was amazing; the oils were so nourishing for my dry skin and I felt a deep sense of relaxation I haven't felt in a long time. The staff is professional, the atmosphere is incredibly comfortable, and I left feeling grounded and light. I am definitely coming back! Highly recommend this spa to anyone looking for high-quality care in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Naila Alam
reviews.text: Oh my goodness. Such an amazing massage by Meaw. I came here every single day for my five day stay in Chiang Mai. I am a seasoned massage customer and Meaw has got to be the best massage therapist in the WORLD. The entire staff is wonderful and the spa is very clean. Delicious ginger tea served and yummy rice crackers after massage. Highly recommend 👌🏽💝🌎

reviews.name: Kania Maniasa
reviews.text: By far the best massage in Chiang Mai! Next to the G Niman Hotel, this place provides the best wellness offerings. I come with highly tensed upper body, I come out feeling super light. The therapists are caring and professional. You will want to return!

reviews.name: Alex Lee
reviews.text: I had an amazing Thai massage here for two consecutive days. I’ve been to many Thai massage shops, and this was hands down one of the best experiences. Highly recommend Tawan!

reviews.name: Thom Holstein
reviews.text: First time massage in my life. Really liked it And felt great afterward! Really can recommend this place. The staff was very welcoming, helpful and friendly.

reviews.name: Karolina Józefczyk
reviews.text: I had here the best foot massage in this place. The staff was very professional, kind and welcoming. The place is brand new and has a nice relaxing atmosphere and competitive prices. The whole experience was exceptional. I highly recommend it to everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you.

reviews.text:
Did a 2.5 hour massage package (foot massage, body scrub, oil massage with herbal compress) for TBH3000. My masseus, Olay, was FANTASTIC. I asked for soft-medium, and she got the pressure just right. She also worked my shoulder knots. Bonus to have mango sticky rice after. Pricier but professional.
Will recommend this place.

reviews.name: Gwen Chew
reviews.text:
The whole experience is amazing! The aromatherapy is working so well and almost put me to sleep. Every touch put the right amount of pressure, and at the end of the session, my whole body feels great and relaxed.

Also, at the end of session, they serve very nice sweet sticky rice and mango.. Delish!

reviews.name: Berekti Desanges
reviews.text: I love it here. Everyone is so pleasant and eager to assist. My treatment was marvelous. Noy really outdid herself with my treatment. I left so relaxed and rejuvenated. You get tea and a cold towel before and a hot tea and a treat afterwards (I won't COMPLETELY spoil it for you). But I enjoyed and didn't expect the before and after treats. The spas in the USA I've been to don't do this. MONEY WELL SPENT!

reviews.name: soseiji
reviews.text: Really good massage experience overall. The therapist was skilled and attentive, and the pressure was just right. The place was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. Great value for money. Would definitely come back again!

reviews.name: Irene Montenegro
reviews.text:
The staff are very kind and approachable, and the massage is truly relaxing—it really melts away the fatigue from years of hard work.
It’s affordable, too, and they have promos... Thank you very much; I hope we get the chance to come back here... I really love it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Daer Irene Montenegro,

Thank you for taking your time giving us a feedback. It is great to know you had a relaxing time at our spa and your kind words mean a lot to us.

We look forward to welcome you again.

Best regards
DIORA Langsuan

reviews.name: Lala Go
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with the
DIORA HEAVENLY BLISS package.
The therapists were both professional and attentive, making me feel truly cared for. I also appreciated the staff's helpfulness in allowing us to store our folding bikes securely. The only suggestion I have for improvement is regarding the massage bed, which I shared with the staff. I look forward to seeing enhancements during my next visit!

reviews.name: Laura Walsh
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience, we walked in without an appointment and the staff were extremely friendly and accommodating. As a couple we shared a room but had different massages. I had the oil body massage 60min and hubby has the Thai massage. Both were absolutely incredible. The masseuse gave me a towel and made sure my breasts were comfortable without me having to ask which is highly appreciated. They had a hair tie when needed also. The place is so clean. They give you a feet wash to start and finished with fresh mango and hot tea. I would definitely recommend for a spa treatment venue. Thanks 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Ay Dan
reviews.text: I had a wonderful Organic Aroma Oil Massage at Diora Spa Langsuan. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, and the massage was professional, soothing, and exactly what I needed. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches: a refreshing drink was served before and after the treatment, and I was pleasantly surprised with a sweet little portion of mango sticky rice at the end. Overall, it was a fantastic spa experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing treat in Bangkok. 😊

reviews.name: Adrian Kao
reviews.text:
Popped in for a quick massage on my last day in Bangkok since it was near by my hotel. This was my first time trying Diora, and I went with the 100% oil massage. The front desk was very professional, asking beforehand about my preferred pressure and specific areas to focus on or avoid.

​I was extremely satisfied with the experience; the therapist was highly skilled. My only regret is that I was short on time and could only do one hour. It’s definitely worth booking 2 hours for a full, deep relaxation.

reviews.name: Lucky foodie
reviews.text:
I had a rather disappointing experience at this place.

I went with a group of 6 people and we all did different treatments. I chose a 2-hour aroma oil massage and requested for stronger pressure, but unfortunately the massage was not up to expectation. The therapist did not manage to hit the right pressure points, and even after asking to increase the strength, it still felt quite ineffective.

Overall service was also not very attentive considering the price is higher than average in the market. For what you’re paying, the experience doesn’t quite match.

Personally, I don’t find it worth the price and would probably not return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Yuyin treasure,

We sincerely apologize that our service didn't meet your expectation. We will take your feedback seriously to improve our service to serve you better in the future.

We hope to have an opportunity to welcome you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Langsuan

reviews.name: Pierre PANCHOU
reviews.text: The best in the suburb, clean, they have the sense of true relax there. I recommend 1000% this place. All the massages are amazing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Pierre PANCHOU,

Thank you for your review. We are happy to know that our team gave you a peaceful and relaxing experience.

We are looking forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Langsuan

reviews.name: Ersin Balcı
reviews.text: When we arrived, they served us traditional Thai tea while we waited for the massage. We had a Thai massage. All the staff were very kind, helpful, and friendly. It’s a very clean and trustworthy place. The therapists are truly professional and know exactly what they’re doing. I feel like I’ve been reborn. After the massage, they also offered us a traditional sweet treat. I highly recommend coming here!

reviews.name: Martha Raupp
reviews.text: Lovely upscale ambiance, clean and spacious. I got the heavenly package and a facial so spent four hours there for only US$145. Lovely person who checked in on the pressure and such. It wasn’t the best scrub - too gentle and superficial to get any skin off - and the foot massage was only short and basic. The facial wasn’t thorough but was relaxing. Overall, it was a good experience for the price but I’d probably just get a normal massage next time and skip the package.

reviews.name: Stella
reviews.text: Did a 60-minute oil massage and it was the best I've ever had. Lek and Pat was very professional and gave use the perfect experience.

reviews.name: Stefanie Chua
reviews.text: I DO NOT RECOMMEND this place.  The massage is more expensive compared to else where. The masseuse skill was lousy. The manager didnt provide any service recovery despite my complaint. And i left the place as an angry and unsatisfied customer. I did a 1 hour foot massage with my son. My masseuse, Cha applied very soft stroke throughout the whole session. Towards the end of the session, I really couldn't stand it anymore and questioned her whether she is doing soft or medium massage on me. I told her that at the beginning of the session, i already informed the counter staff that i wanted medium massage. In fact she was just touching and not massaging my foot! Half the time, she will pause, daydream a while and not applying strength at all! She didn't even cracked my toes which was what normal foot massage was supposed to have. However i did observed another masseuse, Kate who massaged for my son was quite diligent and applied sufficient strength on my son. My conclusion was Cha is simply lazy. So my recommendation is to avoid this place as it is really not worth it.!The dessert was also very sweet! Not nice 👎
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Stefanie Chua,

We apologize that you didn't have a good experience during your visit. We were checking your booking details and considering to take a appropriate responsibility and found you are already left. Kindly contact us at spamanager@dioraworld.com and we hope to have an opportunity to welcome you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Langsuan

reviews.name: RJ
reviews.text: This was such an amazing and rejuvenating massage! Olay was my massage therapist and she did a fantastic job relieving my neck and shoulder pain. I came in pretty tense since I workout often and spend a lot of time on my feet. Olay was able to work out knots I thought I’d have forever haha. The atmosphere is very calming and feels very luxurious. I love the scent selection as well. I’ll definitely be returning!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear RJ,

Thank you for your wonderful review. We're pleased to know our team provided you an excellent service. We'll be sure to share your compliments with Olay.

We look forward to welcoming you again.

Best regards,
DIORA Langsuan

reviews.name: Dana Lewis
reviews.text: This was absolutely the best massage I have ever had in my life. The staff is so pleasant and welcoming. Definitely a 10 out of a 10.

reviews.name: Patricia Goh
reviews.text:
Had the foot massage here by Plearn. She was really good that I was lulled to sleep. We requested for no foot scrub so it’s THB 950 for 60 mins. My first atas massage 😊

There was a short hot towel head and shoulder massage included at the end. About 10 mins.

They served mango sticky rice and a hot drink after then session.

I Would come again if I want to pamper myself.

reviews.name: Toh Zi Hui
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Diora! The place is classy, welcoming, and beautifully designed, which immediately sets a relaxing mood.

The massage itself was absolutely soothing. I requested extra focus on my thighs, and they really listened and delivered exactly what I needed. A big thank you to Mai, my masseur, who clearly works with heart and care. Her attention to detail and genuine dedication made the session feel extra special.

The front desk staff were also very helpful, patiently explaining the services on the menu so there were no misconceptions.

I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.text:

My last visit was a hot stone massage with my boyfriend. He was very happy with his therapist, Aoy. My massage was good overall, but the hot stone part and the last few minutes of the head massage felt a bit rushed, which made it harder to fully relax.

Still, the staff are very nice and the mango and tea at the end make it a pleasant experience.

Will definitely be back over the next 2 weeks of my stay in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Anastasia Arcibal
reviews.text: This was the best. I got the 30 min foot massage and 30 min head, shoulder, and back combo.  I feel so relaxed afterwards, I think all the pops that needed to happen in my spine definitely did. The staff is super nice and professional.  Loved the mango and tea at the end too 😊.

reviews.text:

The water given at the beginning was very nice of them and then the feet wash at the beginning was very nice too. Then the massage…. WOW WOW WOW! These ladies will straight away make you fall asleep! The massages were incredible! The stretches, the elbow techniques, foot massage… was out of this world! We all knocked out and fell in love. We didn’t want to leave!
We also really appreciated the complimentary mango & tea at the end.

All in all, we all really loved it and would definitely come again and recommend highly!

Thank you to the team that worked there :)

reviews.name: Bel
reviews.text: I have a mixed feeling about this "Rose Quartz Gua Sha Facial" THB1290 for 60 minutes. First of all, the lady at the reception asked for the payment first, which was fine. Before making the payment I asked how long I would have to wait. She said 5 minutes to prepare for it. So I made the payment, she brought me upstairs to a private room which was quiet and comfortable. But nobody came for 25 minutes, then a male popped into the room. Never in my life had I gotten a facial done by a male. I found it a bit odd. Ok, I was thinking, keep an open mind. In terms of the facial steps, he was good and gentle.  However, when massaging my arms, shoulders and head, he was way too gentle. He did use gua sha and some roller on my face, but the duration was quite short.  Whenever he dried his hands on the towel covering my pillow that I was resting my head on, he tapped it too hard so the motion kind of disturbed my calm and relaxation. It seemed to be more of a facial treatment than a gua sha massaging session.  I felt misled by the description of the treatment which started with the words "rose quartz gua sha".  And because of these reasons, I feel THB1290 is way overpriced for a facial and a brief use of this special rose quartz gua sha.  For the facial I would give 4 stars. For the arms/shoulders/head massage, 2 stars. For the ambience in a private room (I was the only customer in the entire building), 5 stars. For the unreasonable wait time of 25 minutes when she told me only 5 minutes, 0 star. For the gua sha massaging part, 1 star.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to provide such detailed and honest feedback about your recent "Rose Quartz Gua Sha Facial" experience. We are deeply sorry to hear that your visit was affected by several disappointing issues, and we sincerely apologize for failing to meet your expectations and our own high standards. We will improve based on your feedback.

Please don’t be misled by the many positive reviews. False reviews are being systematically posted here and many accounts leave duplicate ratings within just a few months and these are often their only reviews!

Unfortunately I had my worst massage experience in Bangkok here. At first the receptionist was very friendly and the place itself was clean. However the positive first impression quickly faded. The masseuse clearly had no motivation to work. It even felt as if she was intentionally giving a poor massage so that another therapist would have to take over. From the very beginning she was rough and completely unsystematic - touching random areas without any depth or technique.

After about 20 minutes I told her that I wanted to stop the massage, which didn’t seem to surprise her at all. She immediately offered to have another masseuse continue but I declined.

On the positive side I did receive a full refund of around 1,000 Baht. I understand that my experience may not be representative of all the staff but I am genuinely surprised that this particular therapist is employed there. I can hardly imagine this was the first incident of this kind.

reviews.name: Ell Ell
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Without a doubt, the best massage spot in Chiang Mai.

From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with a refreshing cold drink and a chilled rose-soaked towel - such a thoughtful, luxurious touch that instantly set the tone. We were invited to choose our own massage oil before starting our aromatherapy treatment, which made the whole experience feel personalised and premium.

The masseuse was incredibly professional, kind, and attentive to our needs. Every movement felt intentional and perfectly executed. The entire experience was simply wow. I had Jane the second time and she is without doubt the most talented masseuse I have ever experienced.

We loved it so much that we returned the next day to try the lymphatic drainage massage - and both my partner and I agreed it was one of the best massages we’ve ever had. The aromas of the high-end oils were beautiful, and the attention to detail was next level. You can tell the therapists are true perfectionists who take pride in their work.

The reception team are also so warm and welcoming. They answered all of my (many!) questions with patience and genuine care. Shoutout to Pang for her hospitality; so professional and friendly, she’s a real delight to the establishment.

We’re already hoping to book a third visit before we leave. If you’re in Chiang Mai, this place is an absolute must. Can’t wait for our third visit before we leave Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Travel Reality Check
reviews.text:
Stayed at Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok and one of the best parts of the whole experience was Amaranth Spa, which fits the hotel perfectly.
The hotel itself already does a lot right. It feels calm, elegant, and genuinely luxurious without becoming cold or overly formal. The room was very comfortable, service was polished, and the whole property has that smooth five star rhythm where everything seems easy. It is the kind of place that helps your nervous system stop behaving like it has email.
Then Amaranth Spa takes that feeling and pushes it even further. The space felt beautiful, quiet, and very well designed, with a relaxing atmosphere from the moment I walked in. Everything felt clean, refined, and thoughtfully done. The treatment was excellent, the staff were professional and welcoming, and the whole experience felt properly restorative rather than rushed or mechanical.
What worked especially well is how naturally it connects with the hotel. Kimpton gives you the stylish, peaceful luxury stay, and the spa gives you the full reset button. Together they make the whole visit feel more complete, not just like a hotel stay but like an actual break from normal life.
By the end of it, I was so relaxed that I briefly felt qualified to give advice to clouds.
Very strong combination if you want a high quality Bangkok stay with excellent service, real comfort, and a spa experience that genuinely adds value to the hotel rather than just filling space on the property.

reviews.name: RB Bon
reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to enjoy a massage here in the Patong area, and I must say it was such a wonderful experience. Let’s Relax never disappoints. The spa is very clean with a relaxing atmosphere. The staff welcomed me warmly, being both friendly and polite. I was served a refreshing pandan drink and a cold towel upon arrival, which set the mood perfectly. Before the session began, I was given a tablet to select my preferences — which areas I’d like the therapist to focus on, which areas to avoid, and the pressure level I preferred.

My therapist, Miss Ladarat, was truly attentive to every detail. I chose a 2-hour Thai massage with a hot herbal compress, and she was excellent. She carefully asked about my needs before starting, sprayed a calming mist on the pillow, and then delivered a highly professional massage. The pressure was just right — not too strong, not too light — and every movement felt precise. I could literally feel the tension and fatigue melting away. At the end, an aroma spray was offered, which left me feeling even more refreshed and relaxed.

After the massage, instead of sticky rice with mango (like some Bangkok branches), this branch served hot tea with crispy rolled wafers, which I found charming and delightful. Overall, I was deeply impressed and will definitely return. For anyone seeking a high-quality massage, this place is a must-visit. I recommend coming in the morning or early afternoon when it’s quieter and more peaceful. In the evenings, it tends to get busy, so making a reservation in advance is a good idea :)

reviews.name: Kamalesh Murugesan
reviews.text:
Let’s Relax Spa is one of the most well-known spa chains in Thailand, and after visiting, I can see why it’s so popular. They offer a wide range of services including foot massages, Thai traditional massages, aromatherapy, facials, and full body treatments. The spa is clean, professional, and has a calming atmosphere that instantly makes you feel relaxed. The therapists are well-trained and attentive, ensuring the experience is comfortable and soothing.

That being said, the services are definitely on the expensive side compared to other local spas. While the quality is excellent, the price point may not be suitable for everyone, especially when you can find decent alternatives at much lower rates nearby. However, if you don’t mind paying extra for a premium experience, it can still be worth it.

One very important thing to note is that booking an appointment in advance is a must – especially if you’re planning for a full body massage. The spa is almost always busy with visitors, and walk-ins are rarely accommodated. Without an appointment, you might face long waiting times or may not get a slot at all, which can be quite inconvenient.

Overall, Let’s Relax Spa offers high-quality treatments and a professional environment, but it comes at a premium price. My recommendation would be to plan ahead, book your appointment early, and be prepared to pay a bit more for the brand and reliability. It’s a relaxing experience, but not the most budget-friendly option.

reviews.text: A great place to relax… it’s one of the best spas in this area highly recommend it after a super tiring day!

reviews.name: Arindam Das
reviews.text: I have visited this place after a long time. Beautifully decorated and managed. Place is right inside the patong beach area. After a long walk it was time to end the night with me and my other half enjoying a relaxing massage. Hot oil massage cost 1600 Baht per person however it is very important that you tell the receptionist as how much strong pressure you want. We got a therapist who was very old and me and my partner had to ask multiple times for more pressure since the pressure was extremely low. So if you are looking for more pressure then do mention at the reception for the right kind of massage with right kind of therapist. Also the place has some kind of noise coming from the nearby area. So the room that we had was not a great room because of the noise coming inside from the window which was actually quite disturbing. Shower and other amenities were great. Staff was courteous and humble.

reviews.text: Beautiful interior and clean massage rooms. The massage was very good. The reception was a bit busy when I arrived, so the welcome felt less attentive, but overall it was a great experience and worth the price.

reviews.text: Was honestly quite an underwhelming and disappointing experience on overall. Was expecting a good massage given the brand and reputation of this chain but the masseuse was really inexperienced. Most of the 1 hour back and shoulder massage were leveraging very basic techniques, essentially simply applying pressure to my muscles with her palms and sometimes even just brushing over. Requested for more strength but still the intensity was not there for a well worth time. Felt I wasted my 1 hour here without feeling more relaxed at all. She was also unable to respond and comprehend basic level English. That said, the environment is clean and staff otherwise is helpful and friendly. Refreshments are also served before and after.

reviews.name: lalit naik
reviews.text: Incredible first experience at Let’s Relax Spa! The staff is welcoming, the ambiance is serene, and the massage was perfection. My therapist was skilled and hit all the right pressure points. Highly professional service from start to finish.

reviews.name: Vonne L.
reviews.text:
After great experiences in other branches across Bangkok, I took the priciest package for a self pampering session. But what a let  down it was. A far cry from my experiences with their branches in Bangkok. I specifically choose Let's Relax and made a journey from Phuket Old Town to Patong just for their branch. And that journey via Grab is not a cheap journey.

Package Taken : Spa Experience (Executive) THB4,900

Room :
Was rather dirty and floor was oily like it hasn't been cleaned. To boot, taking a full spa package, room is located next to a store/utility. It's literally like being in an attic.

Massage :
This was the biggest let down. My masseuse either doesn't care enough and just wants to finish off her time or she's untrained. The scrub was so half hearted and she just skipped some areas. Then came the massage, she was randomly rubbing hot stones without even testing the heat of the stones. I'd specifically told her an area to focus but she just went ya ya and ignored. I've been to enough spas and experienced enough hot stone massages where there are different stone sizes and angles for different areas of the body. Hers was just rubbing. She literally wrapped a whole pile of hot stones and just placed them at the mid of my back. There were no specific placements at all. She randomly skated her palms over. There was zero technique. Zero flow. Massages are supposed to soothe in a flowing movements. Mine were just abrupt movements randomly and awkward rubbing motions. Literally she was just trying her best to beat up the session.

Prior to this session, I made an effort to come over 1 day earlier to communicate but apparently, service is also zero.

Summary : I'd never ever take for granted that Let's Relax as a chain massage and spa brand to be a reliable brand after this utterly disappointing experience. I'd a way way better experience at a way way cheaper price the following day with Kim's. Such an utter let down experience for me.

The shoulder and head massage was the highlight for me — I carry so much stress in that area, and the skilled hands worked out every knot with just the right amount of pressure. I left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and lighter than when I arrived.

The staff were friendly, professional, and genuinely attentive to my comfort throughout the session. The overall ambiance, combined with the quality of the treatment, made this one of the most relaxing spa visits I’ve had in a long time. I would highly recommend Kim’s Spa!

reviews.name: Jeny Lopez
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience! The ambiance was excellent—peaceful, elegant, and incredibly relaxing from the moment I walked in. The entire place was clean, beautifully maintained, and designed to make guests feel comfortable and at ease.

The massage was truly exceptional. The therapist was skilled, professional, and attentive to my needs, making the experience both relaxing and rejuvenating. I left feeling refreshed, stress-free, and completely satisfied.

What made the experience even more special was the outstanding customer service. The receptionists were warm, friendly, and very accommodating. They greeted me with genuine smiles, assisted me throughout my visit, and ensured that everything was perfect. Their professionalism and hospitality made me feel valued as a guest.

Overall, this was an amazing experience, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for high-quality service, a relaxing atmosphere, and an unforgettable massage. I will definitely be coming back again!

reviews.name: Claudia Farias Jimenez
reviews.text:
Loved it! Poi was a great masseuse.
I had an Aloe Vera treatment after a day in the sun and I highly recommend it. The packages are very convenient. The ladies in reception are lovely, the cookies they give with the tea are delicious.

reviews.name: Shanti Yuliastiti
reviews.text:
I got the foot + back and shoulder for 650 baht (2026 Jan). I didn’t expect it was so effective. The place was very cozy and Kiouw is an amazing and such a nice massager! she adjusted to my desired strength and was very accommodating. Despite being foot and back/shoulder, she also massaged my hand and head a bit. It was overall a worthwhile and definitely a MUST TO GO IN PHUKET!!! ❤️

things that could be improved: asking the costumer if the air-conditioning temperature is alright or not. I felt a bit cold as I came from warm climate.

reviews.name: Kushani Anushika
reviews.text: Amazing Relaxing message.  I got the aroma oil message and 1 and half hour it was so relaxing relive all my muscle sourness and pain from traveling. Warm oil was so good on the skin . Staff is very friendly and welcoming. Definitely recommend this place. Price is  bit high than some of the other small places but quality of the message service get from is worth it. Very clean and hygienic place.

reviews.name: Amsyah Mchaggis
reviews.text: Great massage at Kim Massage. One of Phuket Old Town iconic massage establishment. Highly recommend to get massage when here. Super affordable and clean place. Well maintained. Get the full body Thai Oil Massage.

reviews.name: Alfiia
reviews.text:
I visited this branch because I regularly go to their other locations in Rawai and Phuket Town. Unfortunately, this experience was extremely disappointing.

I booked a neck, shoulders, and head massage, but the therapist performed random and painful movements, not the treatment I requested. I had to correct her several times. The room lights were left on very bright, making it impossible to relax, and my hair was covered in oil because it wasn’t properly protected, despite me asking multiple times.

The administrator spoke loudly in the room while my husband was also trying to relax. No one apologized or attempted to resolve the situation. We were simply given our shoes and that was it.

I do not recommend this salon. The service and management were unprofessional.

reviews.name: Amanda Rodriguez
reviews.text: Really good experience. Amazing massage, really nice staff and great service. I’ll definitely recommend this massage parlour in Phuket.

reviews.name: Daria Gordeeva
reviews.text: Had a really nice experience in Kim’s massage. Was super tired after a long walk and the feet massage was super nice, smooth and relaxing! Definitely recommend if you’ll be in the Old Town! Also they give you a nice hot tea after the experience <3 thanks!

reviews.name: Николай Иванов
reviews.text:
Great place! Wife and I have visited spontaneously but we were left very pleased with the level of service and the quality of the massage. Before the massage we were treated to a cup of tea. The full body & head massage itself felt extremely relaxing and rejuvenating.
Highly recommend, specifically the Thai massage + shoulder massage with herbs combo.

reviews.name: Burak Gümüş
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience here — easily the best Thai massage I’ve had in Phuket. The technique was outstanding, with the right balance of strength and precision, and everything about the treatment felt professional and well-executed.

From the therapist’s skills to the overall application, it was a truly high-quality massage experience. I left feeling relaxed, relieved, and very satisfied. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: hairun asad
reviews.text: I had the best male  therapist named KASAM! Place is awesome and very welcoming.recommended 100%

reviews.name: Wai Yee
reviews.text: After a long, hot, and tiring day exploring the old town, I decided to try this massage shop — and I’m so glad I did! The environment is clean and relaxing, the staff are incredibly friendly, and the service was excellent from start to finish. The massage was exactly what I needed, and they even served refreshing drinks that made the whole experience feel extra thoughtful. Truly a great place to unwind and recharge. Highly recommended! 🌿✨

reviews.name: ilina ye
reviews.text: Great massage in a heritage building - snacks are served right after as well. Recommend if youre in old town 👋

reviews.name: Bagmita Kashyap
reviews.text:
I had an amazing foot reflexology session here. The staff are incredibly kind, gentle and very attentive. They really take their time to understand what you need, and the pressure was perfect throughout. The therapists were professional and checked in often to make sure I was comfortable.

Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Marica Hill
reviews.text:
Terrible customer service. Lost all 4 of us as customers & we ended up demanding our full reimbursement before the massages even started.

Update*****

DO NOT GO HERE!

Walk just a few shops down from Kim's & go to SOUL. Absolutely exquisite. Immaculate. Top notch service. The spa is an immersive 5 star experience, extremely large, clean & professional. For the SAME price as Kim's- you get a FULL spa treatment. But with foot, back, neck, arms & cleansing of the feet, tea & mango sticky rice.

Don't waste your time or money at Kim's.

reviews.name: Sofie Bergman
reviews.text:
WoW!
One of the best massage in Thailand. Travel around the country and tryed 100+ massages and this is very good. Bael té included, choose a scent to the massage-oil and very clean and professional massage🙏🥰

reviews.name: Faisal Javaid
reviews.text: Kim’s Spa offers an exceptional experience that combines professionalism, cleanliness, and a serene atmosphere. We enjoyed both a full-body massage and a foot massage, and the quality of the treatments was outstanding. The therapists were highly skilled, ensuring we felt relaxed and rejuvenated. The spa itself was spotless, with a calming aesthetic decor that added to the overall experience. If you’re looking for a top-notch spa in the area, Kim’s Spa is definitely worth a visit!

title: The Amalaki Spa
ownerDescription:
NAMASTE!

Here's your invitation to embark on an exhibition of an Ayurvedic Art Form where wellness becomes your new favorite canvas, your chakras awaken, and your spirits blossom!

Nestle at The Fig Lobby, we invite you on a transformative journey of holistic well-being. Inspired by the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda, our sanctuary spa is a haven of tranquility where the harmony of mind, body, and spirit are revitalized.
address: 55 Rimthangrotfaisaipaknam Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Shayne Valerie
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Fig Lobby and kept walking past The Amalaki Spa, so we finally decided to book a treatment and we’re so glad we did!

What we loved most is how they blend traditional Thai massage with crystals, astrology, and a really calming zen atmosphere. It’s such a unique concept, and somehow all these elements come together beautifully to create a truly relaxing experience.

We booked the Crystal Essential Massage for 1 hour, and Jenny & Joy took such great care of us from start to finish. They were incredibly warm and welcoming, and their massage techniques were amazing. I requested a soft, lighter-pressure massage, and they followed my preference perfectly throughout the session.

One of the highlights was the little astrology reading after the massage. It genuinely resonated with me and made the whole experience feel even more special. We also spent the afternoon sharing laughs and chatting with Jenny & Joy, which made everything feel so personal and memorable.

Such a lovely experience from beginning to end. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something relaxing, unique, and a little bit magical ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Namaste 🙏 Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear that you decided to visit us during your stay and that your experience exceeded expectations 🌸✨

It means so much to know that you appreciated our unique blend of traditional Thai massage, crystals, astrology, and a calming zen atmosphere. We’ve carefully designed each element to create a truly relaxing and memorable experience, so it’s wonderful to hear that it resonated with you 💛

Thank you for your kind words and support. We hope to welcome you back again on your next visit for another peaceful and rejuvenating experience 🌿✨🙏🏻💛.

reviews.name: J a (Ja)
reviews.text:
I initially thought this place might just be gimmicky but it turned out to be one of the best body scrub and oil massages I’ve ever had in Bangkok. I left feeling refreshed with incredibly silky skin.  The interior is beautiful and the room is spacious with private shower and very comfortable, padded massage bed.

A huge thank you to the wonderful Jenny, she was cheerful, attentive and highly skilled, ensuring I was comfortable before every treatment.

I will definitely be back on my next trip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Namaste 🙏 Thank you so much wonderful to know you enjoyed the beautiful interior, spacious private room, and the comfort of the massage bed. Most of all, Jenny will be so happy to hear your kind words about her cheerful, attentive, and skilled care 💛

reviews.name: Nattapong Suntayopas
reviews.text:
Khun Jenny and Mewky did us a favor giving us a good laugh and professional spa treatment and fortune telling. This place allowed us to choose the preferred weight and area of massage and they did it  precisely accordingly.

Good gimmick, warmth, and professional.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another peaceful and rejuvenating experience 🌿🙏🏻✨

reviews.name: Jace Fernandez
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jenny. The massage helped me relax and unwind, and I left feeling much better. The tarot reading was a unique and interesting addition to the experience. I would definitely come back.

reviews.name: m k

therapist, P’Mai, was professional and had great technique. The massage was incredibly relaxing, and I left feeling refreshed. The spa itself is beautiful with a calm, welcoming atmosphere. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Nicole Vella
reviews.text: Had the most wonderful and relaxing massage with Mai. The experience from start to finish felt luxurious and the interior was stunning. Thank you so much for this wonderful experience, it was incredible.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Namaste 🙏 Thank you so much for your beautiful and thoughtful feedback! We’re truly delighted to hear that your experience with Mai felt so luxurious and relaxing from start to finish 🌸✨

reviews.name: Mint Sakvorak
reviews.text:
Massage with great pressure and a very relaxing atmosphere. I felt so comfortable and refreshed afterward.
K'Jenny took great care of me very attentive and kind.
I was especially impressed that they also offered tarot reading and crystals. Such a unique and memorable experience

reviews.name: Chloe Becker
reviews.text:

The spa itself is very beautiful, inviting, and comfortable. The prices are good and lots of promotions. All the staff are kind and welcoming.

reviews.name: John Lizcano
reviews.text:
I had the Lavender Essential Oil Massage, and it was exactly what I needed.

My therapist Orn was excellent. She has a very careful and attentive touch, the pressure was perfect, and the technique she used felt both relaxing and therapeutic. You can really feel her professionalism and experience throughout the session.

The atmosphere of the spa is calm and beautiful, making it a perfect place to unwind.

I highly recommend this massage  and especially Orn,  to anyone visiting Bangkok and staying at Fit Lobby. It’s truly a great experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We hope to welcome you back again whenever you’re visiting Bangkok and staying at Fig Lobby ✨💛

reviews.name: Nailah Alam
reviews.text:
Would highly recommend Amalaki! Best spa experience my partner and I have ever had.

Staying at the fig lobby we decided to have a slow day and opted for a last minute spa experience as a treat and it was sensational! The staff were so friendly and made us feel at ease.

It was my partners first time and got the Back stress eraser with volcanic balm 60 mins and he fell asleep and woke up feeling like a new person.  I got the Luxury Spa retreat 120 mins and honestly blew my mind (also fell asleep during the massage).

10/10 experience ✨

reviews.name: C L

I had Sandy as my therapist, and she was exceptional. She created such a calming, healing space throughout the body scrub, full-body massage, and facial massage. Every part of the treatment was wonderful, and I left feeling completely refreshed.

reviews.name: Shyara Bastiansz
reviews.text: The spa was amazing. One of the best face massages. The place is beautiful, clean and has a great energy. Khun Mai was my therapist. She was amazing. So friendly, professional and warm. Loved my first experience here and definitely coming back again soon.

Thank you very much. ขอบคุณมากนะคะ☺️

reviews.name: Nele Zeuschner
reviews.text:

Sandy made me feel completely comfortable the entire time and perfectly adjusted the pressure to exactly what I asked for. I walked out feeling like I had gained two inches in height. My body felt lighter, more aligned, and completely renewed. Every knot and bit of tension seemed to melt away.

I loved every minute of the treatment and genuinely didn’t want it to end. Thank you, Sandy, for such a wonderful experience. I will definitely be back! ✨🙏🏻

title: Zense Spa & Hair Salon
ownerDescription:
Zense Spa is a serene sanctuary hidden in the forest where nature and quietude soothe the soul. Whether you are jetlagged from a long journey, stressed from the pressure of work or just in need of some pampering, the Zense Spa has the perfect remedy.

Soak and soften your skin in the outdoor bathtub and indulge in a wide choice of massages and beauty treatment that use fresh tropical ingredients such as coconut, herbs, fruit and fine quality aromatherapy oils as well as imported Guinot beauty products.

reviews.name: Carolina-reviews
reviews.text:
I had the Phuket Bliss package at Zense Spa and it was honestly one of the best massages I’ve ever had. My therapist, Koy, was absolutely incredible.

She immediately found all the areas where I was holding tension and worked on them with such skill and care. The stretching and massage released so much tightness in my back and shoulders and I felt muscles relax that I didn’t even realise were tense.

The foot reflexology was amazing and really thorough. I even noticed improvement in my bunion, which felt much more mobile afterwards.

The Indian head massage at the end was so relaxing that I actually drifted off to sleep, which says everything about how calming and professional the treatment was.

Koy is clearly extremely experienced and intuitive in what she does. If you visit Zense Spa, I would highly recommend requesting her.

An unforgettable experience and the highlight of my spa visits in Phuket.

Thank you again , Caroline ♥️🌸🌺🦋

reviews.name: Skye Asha
reviews.text:
I had a 1.5 hour Thai massage here. The place itself was clean and welcoming, and the staff were kind but unfortunately, the massage itself wasn’t very good. I left more tense than relaxed. I hope the therapists here receive more training in how to work with the body in a safe, attuned, and connected way

The movements were rushed and lacked the sense of grounding that creates the safety a body needs, especially with the level of pressure he was using. Rather than gradually building trust and easing into deeper work, he went straight in with sharp fingers with allot of pressure.. not good… and ineffective.

He focused a lot on my calves (a sensitive area), applying very strong pressure for a long time, returning to them many throughout the session, which became very painful. Meanwhile, my back (usually a key area) got very little attention. I’ve had a lot of Thai massages and have studied Thai massage, and some of the positions he put me in just didn’t make sense. They felt awkward and unnecessary, when there are so many other, more natural positions that would’ve made it easier for him to do what he was trying to do.

Overall, while the environment was nice, the massage didn’t leave me feeling relaxed or cared for.

reviews.name: Sophie
reviews.text:
An excellent massage salon with wonderful and caring service for guests.

Before the massage, we were served small bottles of cool herbal honey tea and given forms to indicate our preferred massage intensity, restricted areas that shouldn’t be touched, and any medical conditions or preferences the therapist should be aware of. The salon radiates silence, tranquility, and incredible aromas.

During the massage itself I felt complete relaxation and pleasure, the therapist massaged everything from my toes to my head and removed the tension in my back. My bf said that he had a problem area that had been hurting for several weeks and the therapist worked on it so that he felt relief and the pain went away.

After the massage session, we were treated to warm tea with cookies and given a choice of a hand cream or a souvenir as a gift — such an incredibly thoughtful gesture. It makes you want to come back more often. The interior of the salon cannot go unnoticed — it is absolutely stunning and delightful.

Thank you to the staff and therapists for this amazing experience!

reviews.name: Connie Chiang
reviews.text:
We accidentally ran into this amazing newly opened place! It’s situated an old street that looks like an old closed hotel that says “the royal paradise hotel and spa”.
I love the interior and it’s incredibly clean. My husband picked the Thai massage (400 baht) and I picked the hot herbal compress massage + aromatic oil massage (800 baht). Both are 60 minutes.
The price is very reasonable considering it’s service and how luxurious the space is. We got a private room with two beautiful massage beds.
They gave us a complementary foot scrub before we start our massage. Then we are greeted with cold tea and towel while they get our space ready. The massage therapist is very attentive during the session. She checked with me multiple time if the massage pressure or the temperature of the herbal ball suited my expectations.
After the massage, we were greeted with hot tea and a delicious snack.
I would definitely come back in the future.
I hope they’ll be able to take credit card!

reviews.text:
I had a great experience at this massage salon! The atmosphere is very cozy and stylish, with a clean and beautiful interior. I tried the oil massage, and it was really nice. They offer six types of oils to choose from—I went with lavender. The oil massage cost 550 baht. My friend had a foot massage, which was 350 baht. Both massages were done very well, with high quality and great technique.

Another nice touch is that they serve tea before and after the massage. Beforehand, you get a refreshing cold tea, and afterward, they give you hot tea with cookies as a little treat.

We highly recommend visiting this place!

reviews.text: Very good massage, very nice organize, private room with very reasonable price

reviews.name: May P. Cat
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this spa. The massage was absolutely amazing — relaxing, therapeutic, and beautifully done. They used a fantastic aromatic lemongrass oil that smelled incredible and made the whole treatment even more soothing.

The therapist was so, so good — very skilled, attentive, and professional. I felt completely relaxed and refreshed afterward.

The place itself is extremely clean, well-maintained, and the atmosphere is calm and lovely, making it the perfect environment to unwind.

Highly recommended! I will definitely come back again before leaving.

reviews.name: Yuwalee Strom
reviews.text:
I felt the place is very nice and clean.
My foot massage was great, the therapist is very professional.
Price is reasonable and I like the hot tea they served after you got the massage.

reviews.name: Ivy Z.
reviews.text: Such a lovely experience from the moment we walked in. Service was excellent and massage was extremely professional. I am a big fan of Thai oil massage & I think this is the best one I’ve had so far. Price is very good as well. 550 bhat for 1h, while other places with similar standards charge for 700-900 bhat. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: George Barnes
reviews.text: Best message I have ever had!! Me and my partner had Lamyai and Prim, couldn’t recommend them more. The attention to detail was amazing and great atmosphere. Will definitely be back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you so much for this incredible review! 🥰 We're truly honored to be the best massage you've ever had. Lamyai and Prim will be over the moon reading this . they take great pride in their attention to detail. So glad you and your partner loved the atmosphere too. Can't wait to welcome you both back! 🙏

reviews.name: Anqi Lin (Alicia)
reviews.text: Excellent massage experience! The spa is on the 9th floor with a clean, peaceful atmosphere. The staff speak excellent English, and booking by phone was smooth and easy. We chose the traditional Thai balm massage, which was both relaxing and therapeutic. The service was outstanding—they washed our feet before the treatment and served us tea afterward. Everyone was warm, attentive, and professional. Highly recommended!❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the review!🙏🥰

reviews.name: Zecharia Oren
reviews.text:
Amazing experienc!
Super affordable for what you’re getting!
90 minutes of a full body scrub + aromatherapy massage for only $35.
They let you choose the scents of the oil and pilling scrub material. There are noice private showers for you to use after the massage/ body scrub. The Masseuses are super nice and professional. Definitely recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your amazing review. Your encouragement inspires us every day.

reviews.name: Ashley Ng
reviews.text:
Just had a 1.5-hour foot and head & shoulder massage, and after trying so many different massage places, this is definitely one of the best.

I was honestly tempted to gatekeep this place, but my therapist, Nene, deserves the shoutout. Her technique was amazing, and my shoulders feel so much lighter and relieved after the session. The pressure was just right - firm without being too much. She could somehow tell exactly which areas needed more attention and focused on those spots without me even having to mention them.

Thank you, Nene! I’ll definitely be back. 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review. We truly appreciate you taking the time to support us.

reviews.name: Victor Corbin
reviews.text: I have been having massages since I arrived in Bangkok, several times a week. They are located in the Sabai Sathorn hotel (flr 9). The staff is fantastic, friendly and helpful. The receptionist speaks English, and they offer a array of massages. I highly recommend stopping by. They are very popular and busy so it's a good idea to schedule in advance, especially if you want a specific individual. I just finished a two hour massage and am feeling great.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review 🙏🙇🏻‍♀️

reviews.name: 劉彥葳
reviews.text:
按摩兩小時有15%折扣。位置在9樓，雖然不易找到但是現場的人員溫暖有禮貌，按摩手法純熟，非常能解除工作以及走路太多的疲勞。

一定要再來一次的地方！

A must-visit place!"
There is a 15% discount for a 2-hour massage. Although the location is on the 9th floor and a bit tricky to find, the staff are warm and polite. The massage techniques are professional and highly effective at relieving fatigue from work and long hours of walking.
I will definitely be back!

"¡Un lugar al que definitivamente hay que volver!"
Hay un 15% de descuento en masajes de 2 horas. Aunque el local está en el piso 9 y es un poco difícil de encontrar, el personal es cálido y muy amable. Las técnicas de masaje son expertas, ideales para aliviar el cansancio del trabajo y de caminar mucho.
¡Sin duda regresaré!

"Today’s massage experience was incredibly disappointing, especially since my previous two visits were wonderful. I even brought a friend along today based on my recommendation.
During the session, I repeatedly heard text notification sounds. At one point, I felt only one hand massaging my leg, which made me want to sit up and see what the therapist was actually doing.
The entire two-hour session felt like an ordeal. The body massage was careless and half-hearted, yet when it came to the head massage, the pressure was so excessive it was painful. I had to ask them to lighten up. Honestly, I wanted to terminate the session halfway through.
I’ve been here three times and even wrote a positive review before, but I feel I must share this terrible experience to let others know how inconsistent the service can be."
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 谢谢你🙏

reviews.name: ดา วี
reviews.text:
This is hands down the best massage place I’ve ever been to. Everyone here is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and genuinely cares about their customers.

They recommended their signature 100% organic aroma oil massage, and it was absolutely amazing. As someone with sensitive skin, I really appreciated the high-quality organic oil—it felt so gentle and left my skin feeling great.

One thing I highly recommend is booking in advance. I’ve tried to walk in twice before and they were fully booked both times. That’s definitely not their fault—they’re just extremely popular, especially in the evenings.

If you’re reading this review, please leave them a 5star rating after your massage. They truly deserve it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're grateful for your trust and your wonderful feedback. Thank you!

reviews.name: Taylor Wolfe
reviews.text: Amazing experience! The massage was excellent and exactly what I needed after walking around Bangkok all day. The staff were friendly, professional, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and welcoming. Great value for the price, and I left feeling completely refreshed. I would definitely come back and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing us and for leaving such a thoughtful review.

reviews.name: Raphael
reviews.text:
This place was great. My wife and I stopped in before dinner, and they were able to squeeze us in, which we really appreciated. The pricing is very reasonable as well.

We both left feeling relaxed and completely reset after our massages. I work out and run a lot, so the Thai massage really helped loosen up my muscles, exactly what I needed.

Thank you to the staff for the excellent service, and for the delicious tea at the end!!

reviews.name: Ali Murtaza
reviews.text: I found this place while I was having breakfast next doors. My 8 year old wanted a full Thai massage session. We walked in and had an amazing 1 hr experience as father and daughter. My daughter said I did not have to tell her anything, she used the perfect pressur and her next statement was:"Can we come again!!!"  This is absolutely the perfect comment I can give. I had an amazing experience as well, and got fixed some issue i did not realise I had walking in!! Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: rio segundo
reviews.text:
Stumble upon this place because our flight was delayed and needed to spend a couple of hours before heading out to the airport. And its been one of the best experience that I have had during my short stay here in Bangkok 😊😊😊.

Everyone was so nice and they managed to squeeze us in on the spot. The massage is something that would be dreaming about until the next time I visit Bangkok.

I highly recommend this place and will definitely visit again, and again, and again.😊😊😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. We look forward to your next visit.

reviews.name: Anna Bauer
reviews.text: Traditional Thai massage was so so good! I was completely relaxed after it. The studio is very clean and quite, harmonious atmosphere. I can recommend it from the heart ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate your review. Thank you for encouraging us with your kind words.

reviews.name: Yvette
reviews.text: He was the best foot massager I've ever met. The key point is that you're good at massaging. Of course, I'm willing to revisit. The lift to the 9th floor is inside behind the front desk.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your experience! We hope to see you again ❤️❤️🙏

reviews.name: Miss RC
reviews.text: Best massage place, a hidden gem, but you must call and book as they are usually booked up because they’re so good. It was one of the best foot massages and body massages I’ve had in Thailand. The people are very sweet and professional and the place is clean and the ambience is very nice

reviews.name: Mark Ang
reviews.text: I have been massage hopping since i arrived in thailand and so far Zone Sabai has the Best foot , shoulder and massage ive had so far. Value for money. Will be back for more!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your support. We’re glad you chose our service.

reviews.name: Linh Tran
reviews.text:
I had such a lovely massage at Zone Sabai Massage. From the moment I arrived the staff was incredibly kind and sweet which made me feel very comfortable.

I chose the 90-minute aromatherapy massage with oil and it was really amazing.
Nan did a wonderful job. She immediately found the knots in my neck and worked on them with so much care.

I’m so happy that I found this massage place and I will definitely come back next time. Khop khun kha 🙏🏽✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. It helps us improve.

reviews.name: Dan Manning
reviews.text: Nan. That’s all I can say. Her name was Nan. I had a shoulder surgery in Feb of 2020, and I couldn’t explain that because of the language barrier. But she just knew. It was incredible. She spent the time where it was needed, she was responsive to my feedback. Amazing. I can’t speak for the rest of the team there but I can speak for Nan. Bless her soul as she blessed mine. Really quality experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your review 🙏🙇🏻‍♀️

reviews.name: Cheng Yu Han
reviews.text: The lady who gave me the massage had incredibly skilled and mature techniques — it felt like she could understand my body’s condition just through her hands. After the session, I felt like a completely renewed version of myself. If you ever happen to be in the area, don’t miss this place! It’s a place that makes both women and men feel completely comfortable and safe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you very much for your review 😊🙏 , we're hope to massage you again

reviews.name: IkkyuDiscovery (Ikkyu)
reviews.text: I had the oil aroma massage with jasmine scent, and the experience was absolutely amazing. The atmosphere was calming, the therapist was skilled and attentive, and the jasmine aroma added a perfect touch of relaxation. Highly recommended if you’re looking to truly unwind and treat yourself!

reviews.name: Moutint
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at this massage shop! The service was so excellent, staff were professional and welcoming. The shop itself was very clean and cozy. I had a sense of relaxation here. It’s also conveniently located, easy to commute.

There were many options and I chose coconut oil massage. It was so great! I felt immediately refreshed and comfortable after the massage. I’ll definitely come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed your experience with us.
