reviews.name: 유빈해
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience here! The atmosphere is so peaceful, clean, and relaxing. The staff were incredibly welcoming and professional. The therapist really knew what they were doing—they hit all the right spots and managed to relieve all the tension in my shoulders and back. The traditional Thai massage was authentic and perfectly tailored to my preferred pressure. I walked out feeling like a completely new person.
Will definitely be back！^^
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your glowing review. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed every aspect of your visit, from our serene surroundings to the skillful massage. Your kind feedback is truly appreciated and inspires us to continue creating exceptional and authentic spa experiences for every guest. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing and rejuvenating escape soon.

reviews.name: Nhan Phan
reviews.text:
Nice spa and massage place — part of the same chain as Oasis Spa.

It’s very convenient to book, and communication by phone is easy. The staff are also very lovely and welcoming.

Overall, the experience was nice. I tried the aroma/oil massage, while my friends tried the Thai massage (there are different names on the menu, so feel free to ask the staff for advice). My oil massage was just okay, but my friends said the Thai massage was excellent. At the end of my oil massage, there was a bit of stretching, which felt really nice — so I think this spa might be especially good for Thai massage.

🚫 One small downside: the room isn’t fully soundproof. The doors are sliding doors with small gaps, so I could hear people walking or talking outside. It wasn’t too noisy, but better soundproofing would make the experience more relaxing.

It’s just a few minutes’ walk from EmQuartier, so the location is quite convenient.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your thoughtful and detailed review absolutely made our day! Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience at GAAYA by Oasis Spa. We're so happy to hear you found our staff lovely and welcoming and that your friends enjoyed an excellent Thai massage. We truly appreciate your valuable feedback on the soundproofing and your oil massage. Your insights are incredibly helpful and allow us to keep improving the relaxing experience we provide for our guests. We look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you and your friends back again soon.

reviews.name: Diamond Path
reviews.text: We had a really good treatment at Gaaya. It was not out of this world good or memorable but I would say the hands of the masseuses were smooth and soft. They were very kind and well trained. The amenities were also good. Toilets are separate from the room so you’ll need to walk a bit down the stairs. Everything was clean and as it should be. Just not phenomenal rather a bit generic but good.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you sharing your experience at GAAYA by Oasis Spa. It’s truly wonderful to hear that you found our masseuses kind, skilled, and professional. Creating a clean, high-quality environment is at the heart of what we do, and we’re delighted to have met that expectation for you. We deeply value your patronage and genuinely look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you back soon.

reviews.name: VARN
reviews.text:
The room was private, though not particularly luxurious. The selection of massage oils was nice, and the receptionists were friendly and welcoming.

However, considering the price, the room, bedding, decoration, and overall service could be improved. I also had to ask the therapist several times for a stronger massage.

There is no parking available, and overall it did not feel like a luxury spa experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate you sharing your experience at GAAYA by Oasis Spa. It's wonderful to hear that our welcoming staff and massage oil selection made a positive impression. We also appreciate your candid feedback on the areas where we can improve. Your observations have been shared with our team to help us further enhance our services and facilities. We hope you will give us another opportunity to provide you with the peaceful and relaxing spa experience we strive to create

reviews.name: Stephanie Gastelbondo C.
reviews.text:
I had the most incredible massage experience in Gaaya by Oasis Spa in Bangkok, and I honestly can’t recommend it highly enough. From the moment I walked in, I felt completely welcomed and cared for. The place itself is absolutely beautiful, spotless, calming, and thoughtfully designed to help you relax the second you step inside.

Yu is, without a doubt, the best, most caring, thoughtful, and attentive massage therapist I’ve ever had. She took the time to understand exactly what I needed, adjusted the pressure perfectly throughout the session, and constantly made sure I was comfortable. Her technique and experience is exceptional. Strong when needed, gentle when appropriate, and always precise. You can truly feel his experience and dedication in every movement. Yu made the entire experience feel personal rather than routine.

What impressed me even more was the flexibility and genuine kindness of the people. They were accommodating with scheduling and changed one sectionof the package after my request. On top of that, the pricing is very reasonable for the outstanding quality you receive. Incredible value for such a high-level massage.

If you’re in Bangkok and want a massage that goes beyond expectations, Gaya is the right Spa. I left feeling completely renewed, relaxed, and grateful. I will absolutely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are absolutely delighted to read your wonderful feedback about your visit to Gaaya by Oasis Spa. Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderfully detailed and heartfelt review of your experience with us. Your words have truly brightened our day!

We are especially proud to hear about the exceptional, personal care you received from Khun Yu. We will be sure to pass along your high praise; she will be thrilled to know she made such a positive impact on your visit. It's fantastic to know that you found our spa's atmosphere to be calming and that our team's flexibility helped make your experience perfect.

We are so grateful for your kind recommendation and are already looking forward to welcoming you back for another renewing and relaxing experience soon.

reviews.name: Betty T
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience! Was running late and they were able to accommodate me for a later time. The experience was so relaxing from start to finish. I would highly recommend a Thai massage here. Wish I could’ve stayed longer!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to leave such a positive review. We are thrilled that your visit was a relaxing one, and we're especially glad our team could adjust to your schedule while ensuring your experience was perfect from the moment you arrived. Your support is greatly valued, and we would be delighted to welcome you back for another session whenever you need to unwind.

reviews.text:
GAAYA OASIS SPA is truly an excellent place. The staff are highly professional, skilled, and very attentive. The spa itself is elegant, modern, and beautifully designed, creating a relaxing and luxurious atmosphere.

A big thank you to the entire team for their wonderful service, and a very special thanks to Paulina for her professionalism, kindness, and excellent care. She made the experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended! I will definitely visit again.

We are incredibly grateful for your recommendation, and we can't wait to welcome you back the next time you are in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Ki ki
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Flawless and Rejuvenating Experience!

I recently visited Gaaya by Oasis and had an absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish. It truly deserves a full five stars.

The convenience began right away with their complimentary pickup service from the BTS station. It was so easy to find and a lovely, stress-free start to the visit.

The environment at the spa is stunning—serene, beautifully designed, and immaculately clean. It’s the perfect oasis of calm away from the busy city. My therapist was incredibly skilled; the pressure was perfect, firm and therapeutic exactly as I requested, working out all the knots and tension.

A small but appreciated note: they don't serve a dessert after the massage, would be even nicer if they serve the same mango rice from Oasis Spa, it was amazing!!

A major tip for future visitors: I discovered that booking directly through their official website was noticeably cheaper than using third-party sites like Klook. It’s the best way to get a great deal!

I cannot recommend Gaaya by Oasis highly enough. I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated and will definitely be returning. A top-tier experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear about your amazing experience at GAAYA Spa. It’s fantastic to know that our complimentary BTS pickup service made your visit stress-free and that you found our spa environment to be serene and beautifully designed.

We truly appreciate your compliments about our skilled therapist and the therapeutic massage you received. Your feedback regarding the dessert service is very thoughtful, and we will definitely take this into consideration for the future. 

Thank you for sharing your tip about booking directly through our official website. We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating experience soon!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi, Sawadeekrap 😀🙏🏻. Thanks for your support.For more information, oil massage is using spa bed that we had and Thai massage is traditionally performed on a floor bed. This is because the Thai massage technique involves a combination of acupressure, stretching, and yoga-like movements, which require the therapist to have full control over their body positioning and leverage. Here are a few reasons why Thai massage is commonly practiced on a floor bed:

Stability and Balance: Performing Thai massage on a floor bed provides a stable and solid surface for both the therapist and the client. The therapist can maintain balance and use their body weight effectively to apply pressure and perform stretches without the risk of slipping or losing stability.
Full Body Engagement: Thai massage involves the therapist using their hands, feet, elbows, and knees to apply pressure and manipulate the client's body. With a floor bed, the therapist can utilize their entire body to control the movements and exert pressure, which can be difficult to achieve on a raised massage table.
Range of Motion: The floor bed allows for a wider range of movement during Thai massage sessions. The therapist can easily guide the client into various stretches and positions, benefiting from the support and firmness of the floor. The client can also fully relax and allow their body to be positioned comfortably without concerns about falling off a raised table.
Tradition and Cultural Roots: Thai massage has deep cultural and historical roots in Thailand. Traditionally, it was practiced on the floor as part of Thai medicine and spiritual practices. The floor bed setup reflects the cultural heritage and authenticity of Thai massage.
Accessibility and Versatility: Floor-based Thai massage is accessible to people of various sizes, ages, and physical abilities. It allows the therapist to adjust their techniques and movements more easily, ensuring comfort and safety for the client.

It's important to note that while Thai massage is commonly performed on a floor bed, it can also be adapted to a massage table based on the preferences and needs of the therapist and client. The choice of the floor bed is primarily based on the traditional practices and practical considerations related to the nature of Thai massage techniques.

reviews.name: Baljinder Singh IRG
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Ultimate Life Experience at The Westin Phuket

My stay at The Westin Phuket with my friend Amanjot was truly an ultimate life experience. We stayed for 2 nights, and every moment of the trip was memorable. From the moment we arrived, the beautiful surroundings, peaceful atmosphere, excellent hospitality, and stunning views made the entire stay feel special.

The resort has a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty. The rooms were comfortable and well-maintained, the ambience was relaxing, and the overall property was absolutely beautiful. Waking up in such a peaceful environment and enjoying the breathtaking Phuket views was an experience I will always remember.

What made the trip even more special was sharing it with my friend Amanjot. The two-night stay gave us some wonderful memories, great conversations, beautiful moments, and plenty of time to relax and enjoy the beauty of Phuket.

The hospitality and service were impressive, and the entire experience felt luxurious without losing the warmth and comfort of a home away from home. It was not just a hotel stay—it was a beautiful experience that I will cherish for a long time.

The Westin Phuket is definitely a place I would love to visit again. A truly unforgettable stay, beautiful destination, and wonderful memories with a great friend. ❤️🌴🌊

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Alex P
reviews.text:
We had a mixed experience at The Westin Siray Bay Resort & Spa. Upon arrival, we were initially checked into a very dated, tired room. However, after we requested a change, the staff moved us to a quiet room in a different wing, which we appreciated. Curiously, the welcome amenity (a fruit platter) from our first room was never transferred to the new one a small detail, but a bit disappointing nonetheless.
The resort itself is colossally tired and in dire need of a global renovation. You can see tiles falling apart, weathered woodwork, and general wear and tear everywhere; in fact, a few spots felt downright unsafe.
On the positive side, the location is absolutely stunning, surrounded by beautiful nature and filled with local birdlife. However, you should note that the beach is completely unswimmable you will only be able to swim in the pools.
As for the dining, the local restaurant left me confused. The burger was incredibly dry, and the Tom Yum soup tasted quite strange, which was disappointing given the price of around 700 THB per portion. On a brighter note, the breakfasts were quite good, and the service was pleasant the staff were always smiling and helpful.
I truly hope management invests in a full renovation and launches a renewed version of the property. Right now, seeing such a beautiful location in this state is a bit of a sad sight.

reviews.name: sarayu agarwal
reviews.text:
We had a truly wonderful stay at the The Westin Siray Bay Resort & Spa Phuket. The property itself is stunning—set on a hillside with beautiful views, yet very easy to navigate thanks to the electric golf carts that are always just a quick call away.

While the rooms are slightly dated (and currently being renovated), everything else more than makes up for it. What really stood out to us was the exceptional staff. They consistently went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable. The breakfast team thoughtfully remembered our order each morning, which added such a personal touch to our stay. When our 3-month-old daughter wasn’t feeling well, the front desk promptly arranged for an in-house nurse—something we deeply appreciated as new parents.

The private beach is another highlight—peaceful, scenic, and equipped with very comfortable sun beds. The only minor downside is that it’s a bit rocky, and swimming is limited to certain hours due to low tide.

The hotel’s location is also a big plus—tucked away in a quiet area, far from the crowds and hustle of Phuket, yet only about a 20-minute drive to the Old Town.

Overall, a fantastic experience. We would absolutely recommend this property for a relaxing and well-cared-for stay.

reviews.name: Ankita Chandra
reviews.text: What a wonderful and amazing stay at this resort. Breakfast was excellent in terms of quality and choice. The staff was exceptional and provided a top-notch services. There is nothing around, but it’s quiet and serene. The hotel is by the beach, so you can go down and swim.

reviews.name: Matthew Barsdell
reviews.text:
The Westin Siray is phenomenal. Beautiful views, excellent staff and great rooms.

Checking in was easy and quick, front desk staff were really helpful and knowledgeable. All staff were fantastic.

The resort has some amazing views, sunset, sunrise and during the day. It's hard to find something with these types of views at the price we paid.

Rooms were excellent. We opted for the private shared pool, water was clean and kept looking excellent. Bed was comfortable. Shower and bath both worked and had lots of pressure. Rooms were clean and cleaned every day.

Pools and gym were kept clean and tidy. Didn't have a single complaint about them. We didn't see many kids while there so it was quiet, but I expect this resort to be very family popular.

Ok, on to a couple of gripes I have.
Food is good but extremely overpriced (five minute drive-15 minute walk and you'll have better cheaper food). The restaurants were clean but honestly, boring. We decided to go out almost every meal as the restaurants didn't have the atmosphere the rest of the resort alluded to.
Beach is beautiful but rocky. I didn't see any signs saying anything about the rocks in the water. I'd be very careful paddle boarding and falling in. We went canoeing and felt big rocks as we were paddling out.

But overall the resort is beautiful. Don't let anything I say ruin this resort for you. It's certainly an ideal holiday location.

reviews.name: Reviewer Account
reviews.text:
Overview:
The Westin Siray Bay is a property with immense potential, but it currently sits in a frustrating middle ground. While the bones of a five-star resort are there, the lack of basic maintenance makes it feel more like a low four-star experience.
The Room & Maintenance:
The rooms are impressively large and the layouts are great, but they are being let down by a lack of upkeep. It isn't just that the decor is "dated"—it’s that the finishings are neglected. We saw nicks in the walls, unpainted patches, and deteriorating grout. There was visible blackness and mold-like spotting around the tubs and sinks that really detracts from the luxury feel. It’s a shame because the rooms are actually kept very clean by the housekeeping staff; they just need a maintenance crew to spend a day on "touch-ups" to bring them back to life. When you’re paying five-star prices, you shouldn’t be able to look in any direction without seeing a needed repair.
Facilities & Location:
• The Views & Pools: Absolutely stunning. The cliffside location offers world-class vistas, and the multiple pools are a highlight of the stay.
• The Beach: Be aware that the beach is rocky and tidal. It’s lovely to look at, but it isn’t a "swimming beach." It serves more as a beautiful backdrop than a place for water sports.
• Location: One of the best perks is being so close to Phuket Town. It’s a short trip to get to the local restaurants and culture, which we really enjoyed.
Dining & Vibe:
The breakfast was a typical, standard buffet. It was fine, but didn't feel premium—the coffee, in particular, was not up to five-star standards. Also, note that this is a very family-heavy resort with a busy "Discovery Zone." If you are looking for a quiet, kid-free retreat, this might not be the spot for you.
The Service:
The standout feature is the people. The staff are incredibly kind and professional, providing the high level of service you’d expect in Thailand.
Closing Thoughts:
If management would invest in a simple, annual maintenance program for the grout and paint, this would be an incredible hotel. Right now, the service and views are carrying the weight of a building that needs a bit of love.

Will update as we’ve only been here for 2 days out of 9 so far.

reviewContext.Rooms: See above - needs love which they don’t give for some reason.

reviews.text: The stay was pleasant. The staff were all very pleasing. In particular, 2 staff, Bambi & Fern, both dedicated and smiley. The software - people is good but the hardware - hotel needs much upgrading and sprucing up as it showed signs of wear and tear everywhere. At least the main swimming pool is still properly  maintained. But one thing’s won’t change and that’s the view from the rooms facing the Bay. It’s superb and mesmerising in the evening. Word has it that June 2026 will be their last month and after that this property will embark on a major renovation to gain a new identity - Ritz Carlton.

I came for the italian restaurant but it was close the night I stayed. Weird that a 5* hotel close some of its restaurant twice a week. Response time by chat was quite slow. Elite recognition was ok. Bed is confortable

reviews.name: Subodh Agarwal
reviews.text:
Had an amazing stay here. The experience started not so great when our room was upgraded automatically and downgraded automatically as well without informing us. When I complained to the team, they were very prompt and professional. They gave us a great upgrade. It made our entire stay exceptional. The staff was very friendly and prompt with all of our queries. We were visiting the hotel to celebrate my wife's birthday. They decorated our room and kept a small cheesecake, which was a great gesture. They also helped us book excursions to Phi Phi Island, which was very professionally handled. They even surprised us by informing the staff there to celebrate my wife's birthday. As vegetarians, we had no issues with food options available. The views from the room were also exceptional.
One important thing to note is that their rooms are a bit outdated and the duty manager did inform me that they are planning to refurbish the property. However, that aside, everything else was amazing.

Overall, our stay was exceptional and we would highly recommend this hotel to everyone visiting Phuket.

reviews.text: Overall a very disappointing experience that does not live up to the Westin brand.||The westin brand is known for being a luxury / premium brand that focuses on wellness, health and fitness. It definitely did not uphold any of it. ||First off we never were told the hotel was undergoing renovations when we booked, rather just told a week before the stay.  More than 50% of the hotel was blocked off. The gym was a makeshift token gym, the facilities were limited.  Breakfast was severley overpriced for what it was. Limited options, not the freshest food, slow service and limited healthy options.||Service was, the check-in and check-out process was completely unsatisfactory.  Check-in took 15-20mins, not great when its close to 11PM local and you've been on a 9hr flight and 1 hr taxi ride to the airport.  On check-out, agian it was very slow and they didn't charge me appropriately and instead had to email me later and take further funds from my card on file.  The staff at the makeshift lobby clearly have not been trained appropirately.||The only saving graces were the amazing views and the on-point buggy service.  ||Given the news about renovating to a Ritz-Carlton in the future, its clear to me that this hotel simply does not care anymore and is happy to take customers money without delivering the value.  I would hesitate before I choose to stay at the Westin again. I'm also not sure I'd trust the future Ritz Carlton at this location.

I was not impressed with the shuttle bus service. They were not frequent enough and 5 hours was too long before pick up. We resorted to taxis as times were not suitable for us.
We went to the beach on our final day which was lovely and wished we had gone before then. However the sea looked a bit grim and it would have been good to see the water quality.

hotelDescription:
A 12-minute walk from lively Patong Beach, this relaxed, polished hotel is 15 minutes' stroll from the bustling nightlife on Thanon Bangla road and 10 km from the vibrant Wat Chalong.
 Modern rooms with streamlined decor offer free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, along with minibars and coffeemakers; some rooms add balconies. Suites come with separate living rooms and whirlpool tubs. Room service is available.
 Parking is free. Amenities include a casual open-air restaurant, a laid-back lobby lounge with a pool table, and a breezy bar next to an outdoor pool. There's also a spa, a gym and a kids' playroom.

reviews.name: KNOWLEDGE HUB by Technical Guru
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent 5-Night Family Stay in Patong

We stayed at Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani for 5 nights with our family, including senior citizens and kids, and overall had a very comfortable and enjoyable experience.

🏨 Rooms & Upgrade:
The room was clean, comfortable and well maintained. One of the best things about our stay was that the hotel upgraded our rooms and arranged rooms closer to the pool, which was very convenient for our kids and senior family members. This thoughtful gesture made a big difference for us.

🧹 Housekeeping & Cleanliness:
Housekeeping was good and the rooms were cleaned regularly. Towels, toiletries and other essentials were replenished when required. The common areas and surroundings were also well maintained.

🍳 Breakfast:
Breakfast had a good variety of options. Since we were travelling with an Indian family, we requested Indian-style food, and the kitchen was kind enough to prepare Indian dishes for us on request. This was a huge plus, especially when travelling with kids and senior citizens. The staff were accommodating and tried their best to make sure we were comfortable with the food.

👨‍💼 Reception & Staff:
The reception team was friendly, helpful and cooperative throughout our stay. Check-in and other requests were handled smoothly. The staff were approachable whenever we needed assistance.

🏊 Pool & Family Experience:
The pool area was enjoyable, especially for the kids. Having our upgraded rooms close to the pool made it much easier for our family to manage the children while also keeping our senior family members comfortable.

🛎️ Service:
Room service and overall hotel service were satisfactory, and the staff generally responded positively to our requests. We especially appreciated their willingness to accommodate our family’s needs.

📍 Location:
The location is convenient for exploring Patong, with easy access to shopping, restaurants and nearby attractions.

Overall, Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani was a very good choice for our 5-night family stay. Travelling with kids and senior citizens can sometimes be difficult, but the staff’s cooperation, room upgrade, cleanliness and willingness to prepare Indian food made our stay much easier and more enjoyable.

Would definitely recommend this hotel to Indian families travelling with children and senior citizens. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guests,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a detailed and wonderful review of your 5-night family stay with us.

We are truly delighted to know that you and your family, including the senior citizens and children, had a comfortable and enjoyable experience. It is especially wonderful to hear that the room upgrade and convenient location near the pool helped make your stay more comfortable and enjoyable.

We greatly appreciate your kind words about our housekeeping, breakfast, reception team, pool area, and overall service. We are particularly pleased that our team was able to accommodate your request for Indian-style dishes and make your family feel comfortable throughout your stay.

Your generous feedback and recommendation to Indian families travelling with children and senior citizens mean a great deal to us. We will be delighted to share your wonderful comments with our entire team as encouragement to continue delivering memorable experiences to our guests.

We sincerely look forward to welcoming you and your family back to Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani for another enjoyable stay in the future.

Best regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Stayed here for the 5th time and it’s still a reliable and comfortable hotel. The staff are friendly and check-in is fast. Room was clean, comfortable for two people and the WiFi was good. It’s also great value for money. The location is convenient with many massage shops and eateries within walking distance and the area is not noisy, which makes it good for rest.However, compared to my previous stays, the room no longer provides basic amenities like toothbrush, slippers and some toiletries which was a bit disappointing. The swimming pool also closes early at 8pm. I’m not sure why but it would be much better if it stayed open later for guests who prefer a night swim.Overall, still a great hotel and I would return again but there is room for improvement in these areas.

reviews.name: Semih ÖZKAN
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Sawaddi Patong. Everyone was so friendly and helpful from the moment we arrived. The service was excellent, and the staff always greeted us with a smile.

Special thanks to Jo for being so kind and taking great care of us throughout our stay. Jo’s positive attitude and hospitality made a big difference to our vacation. We truly appreciate everything. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We truly appreciate your thoughtful feedback and look forward to welcoming you back to Sawaddi Patong for another exceptional stay in the near future.

Best regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa by Tolani.

reviews.name: AUTUMN TAN
reviews.text:
Overall, my stay at the hotel was very pleasant. The facilities were well-maintained, the environment was comfortable and relaxing, and I felt safe throughout my stay. The breakfast was also enjoyable with a good variety of options.

The location is also very convenient, with nearby amenities such as laundry services, massage shops, and a 7-11, making it easy to get everything you need.

However, one area that could be improved is the room housekeeping. During my stay, the toiletries in the bathroom were not refilled consistently, which was a bit inconvenient.

Aside from that, everything else was great. I would still recommend this hotel and hope to see improvements in this area on my next visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Autumn Tan,

Thank you for sharing your experience at Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa. We are delighted to hear that you found our facilities well-maintained and enjoyed the relaxing environment we strive to create. Your positive remarks about our breakfast offerings and convenient location are greatly appreciated.

We sincerely apologize for the inconsistency regarding the replenishment of toiletries in your room. This is an important aspect of our housekeeping service, and your feedback will be taken into account for future improvements. We aim to ensure that all guests have a seamless and enjoyable stay.

Thank you for your recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back in the future to experience the enhancements we will implement.

Best regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani.

reviews.text:
We told them I was celebrating my graduation and they did such a cute set up in our room.

The staff here is all so so friendly and attentive. We got the breakfast included in our reservation and it was delicious. My favorite part was the omelet station :)

The pools are beautiful and the decorations in the common areas are so well done. Overall, I’d totally recommend staying here. We were so happy with our stay.

Thank you for sharing your delightful experience at Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa By Tolani. We are thrilled to hear that your graduation celebration was made special with our room setup and that our staff's friendliness and attentiveness contributed to your enjoyable stay. It is wonderful to know that you appreciated the breakfast, particularly the omelet station, as well as the beauty of our pools and common areas. Your recommendation means a great deal to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

Best regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa By Tolani

reviewContext.Walkability: There aren’t many sidewalks, but it’s totally fine to can walk along the main road to walk around Patong. Just keep near the curb.

reviews.name: Benedict Tan
reviews.text:
Our room was upgraded as it seemed that the original room type we booked wasn't available so we ended up staying in a much better room! It was a wonderful experience being very comfortable and clean. The facilities are good and the location is very central. The only downside is the location isn't the most friendly to pedestrians but that's effectively most of Patong anyway.

Sadly someone in the hotel was using a proxy which caused Netflix on the hotel wifi to not work for us in the evening. Should get a technician to block proxies on the network.

All in all super happy and can wholeheartedly recommend. Easily our favorite hotel of the whole trip.

reviews.name: مجد حاتم
reviews.text: Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. The hotel placed all Saudi guests on the same floor, which I don’t think was a good decision. The floor was very noisy due to the behavior of some guests, making it difficult to relax or get a good night’s sleep. As someone who values a quiet and respectful environment, this significantly affected my stay. I recommend that the hotel assign rooms based on availability rather than grouping guests by nationality, and take better measures to ensure a peaceful environment for everyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We sincerely apologize that your stay did not meet your expectations, particularly regarding the noise disturbance you experienced. We understand how important a peaceful and relaxing environment is, and we regret the inconvenience this caused.

Please be assured that our room allocation is based on operational requirements and room availability, and we do not intentionally assign rooms based on guests' nationality. We also appreciate your suggestion, which has been shared with our management team for review as we continually strive to improve the guest experience.

Thank you once again for your valuable comments. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much more comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Kind regards,

Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani

reviews.name: Jasmine Kappler
reviews.text:
Look the hotel is nice on arrival and 2 large pools which play music during the day. The accommodation is near some cool ethnic Thai food places and the muay thai stadium. The room however is not to standard.

They don't help you with your bags, my bed was wet when I hopped into it at 2am and was too late to request a new room so I slept on a towel.

The rooms are not sound proof or limiting I was woken up multiple times by other guests returning to their rooms. The aircon is Loud and doesn't work well. Your view is rubbish 🗑 on the street unless you go poolside.

Look its cheap but for the same price you can probably locate a better hotel elsewhere.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jasmine Kappler

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're pleased to hear you enjoyed our pools and our convenient location near local restaurants and the Muay Thai stadium.

We're sorry to learn about the issues you experienced with your room. We were not informed during your stay that the bed was wet, and if we had been notified, our team would have arranged to inspect the issue immediately and, if necessary, move you to another room.

We also appreciate your comments regarding noise and the air conditioning. Your feedback has been shared with our management and maintenance teams so we can continue improving the guest experience.

Thank you again for your review, and we hope you'll consider giving us another opportunity to provide you with a much better stay in the future.

Bests regards, 
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa  By Tolani.

reviews.name: Sukunlaya Singhaphan
reviews.text:
Nice service, however there are many issues making me disappoint for staying this 4 stars hotel:
- This hotel is not 100% non-smoking  though there is "non-smoking sign" at the entrance.  I found an ashtray at a balcony and cigarette smell in my room.
- There are some dust on the bed.
- The room is not soundproof. In the middle of the night, I still heard some voice from outside.
- The drainage system is very poor. It seems that a drainage is lack of cleaning for a loooooooooooooooooooooong time. When I touched it, it's quite slippery and covered in slime.
- Water temperature is not stable. Sometime cold and sometime hot.

Your comments have been shared with our Housekeeping and Engineering teams for immediate review and corrective action. We will also reinforce our non-smoking policy and conduct additional inspections to ensure that our rooms and facilities are maintained to the appropriate standards.

Kind regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa by Tolani

reviews.name: Sato N
reviews.text:
This hotel is truly reasonably priced compared to other hotels, has a great atmosphere, and the service is excellent. The breakfast is delicious, and the atmosphere is fantastic. There's a pool and a gym, and all the facilities are clean and well-maintained, making for a very comfortable stay.

Furthermore, I was happy that I could use the hotel's showers after spending time on the beach and even after checking out. I was truly impressed by the hotel's hospitality. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sato N,

Thank you for your kind words regarding your recent stay at Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani. We are delighted to learn that you found our pricing reasonable and enjoyed our excellent service, delicious breakfast, and well-maintained facilities. It is our priority to provide our guests with a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

Best regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort & Spa by Tolani

reviews.name: Nicole Singh
reviews.text:
Our stay at Sawadi Resort & Spa was deeply disappointing.

Rooms:
The Studio rooms are extremely small. While the beds are comfortable, the bathrooms are cramped and had a foul smell.

The Superior Deluxe rooms are much better spacious, with large bathrooms and very neat overall.

Service:
We checked in late and were met with shockingly rude behavior from the night staff. A porter screamed at us, threw our bags, and walked away.

Staff demanded a $100 deposit despite our confirmed booking through an agent.

The rooms we had booked months in advance were not available. The night staff refused to help and told us to leave if we weren’t happy. Only after our travel agent intervened did we get our rooms well after midday.

The only bright spot was Mark and Jo, who genuinely tried to assist us.

Food & Facilities:
Breakfast was bland, with everything steamed except the eggs. Food was only replenished when specifically requested.Hotel only caters for certain people.

The pool closes at 8 PM sharp, and guests are chased out of the pool as the clock strikes 8. Snacks are not allowed by the pool you’re told to return to your room.

Atmosphere:
This resort has no vibe whatsoever. No themed evenings, no energy it feels dry and lifeless.

Everything quiets down by 8 PM, making it unsuitable for young couples. It clearly caters more to older guests and families.

Sawadi is far removed from the party life. If you’re looking for fun, DEEVANA or SUNSET Beach are far better options.

Final Verdict:
Sawadi Resort & Spa is not for young couples or anyone seeking a lively holiday. While the Superior Deluxe rooms are decent, the poor service, lack of atmosphere, and restrictive policies overshadow everything. I rate this hotel 2 stars. The management Team has to date not contacted us to give ear to the problems we encounted
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nicole Singh,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We are truly sorry to learn that your stay did not meet your expectations and that several aspects of your experience left you disappointed.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the issues you encountered during check-in and for the level of service you received. Providing courteous and welcoming hospitality is one of our highest priorities, and it is concerning to hear that your experience fell short of our standards. We appreciate you recognizing Mark and Jo for their efforts, and we will be sure to share your kind words with them.

We also value your feedback regarding the room allocation, breakfast, pool policies, and the overall atmosphere of the resort. Guest comments like yours are important to us and will be reviewed with our management team as we continually look for ways to improve our services and the overall guest experience.

We regret that we did not have the opportunity to address your concerns during or after your stay, and we apologize if you felt your feedback was not acknowledged. Every guest's experience matters to us, and we take comments such as yours seriously.

Thank you again for sharing your honest review. We appreciate your feedback and wish you all the best in your future travels.

Best Regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa By Tolani.

reviews.name: Jonathon P
reviews.text:
Rooms and common areas are beautifully clean, with the pool areas being particularly immaculate. The rooms themselves are fine, though storage is lacking. I had a room to myself and only 6 clothes hangers, I cant imagine sharing a room would be comfortable; i chose to live out of my suitcase.

The hotel doesnt really have much on an atmosphere, there are plenty of people but just nothing going on. If you prefer peace and quiet then this would be ideal, if you prefer a more upbeat vibe then it won't be to your liking.

All the pros and cons are personal preference, I can see how anybody would love this place but would also understand if they didnt. The only stand out negative is the food. I understand trying to accommodate so many different tastes would be difficult but felt even the basics weren't great and need improvement.

If you're looking for somewhere to rest your head which is clean and only a short walk away from the beach then this place is great.

We're delighted to hear that you appreciated the cleanliness of our rooms and common areas, especially our pool areas. Our housekeeping team takes great pride in maintaining a high standard, and your kind words will mean a lot to them.

We also appreciate your honest feedback regarding the room storage, atmosphere, and dining experience. Your comments are valuable and will be shared with the relevant teams as we continue to improve our facilities and services. We understand that every guest has different preferences, and we appreciate you recognizing that.

We're pleased that you found our hotel to be a clean and comfortable place to stay, with a convenient location just a short walk from the beach. Thank you again for your balanced and constructive feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide an even better experience.

Best Regards,
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa by Tolani.

reviews.name: Lauren P
reviews.text:
Overall we had a good stay at Sawaddi Patong.

Fantastic location—about a 10 min walk to Bangla and under 15 min to Patong beach.
The grounds are very nice: pools and pool bars were a great way to spend hot days. Breakfast was affordable and had a good variety, including vegetarian food.

However our room upon arrival was not clean. We asked staff to switch rooms and while they did accommodate us they also accused us of already dirtying the old room (we only put our bags on the bed). Despite the strange start to our stay, service improved after that. The cleaning staff that serviced our new room was much better.  The room was small with not many places to unpack; it was crowded for 2 people. The shower was unpleasant—going from scorching hot to freezing every 30 seconds.

Despite the issues, we had an overall good stay and would recommend Sawaddi Patong for its location and overall value.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lauren P

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback following your stay with us.

We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our convenient location, our swimming pools and pool bars, and the variety offered at breakfast. It's wonderful to know that you found our hotel to be a good value and that you would recommend us.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize for the issues you experienced upon arrival. We take your feedback seriously and will review your comments with our team as we continue to improve our services and ensure a better experience for all our guests.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for an even more enjoyable stay in the future.

Best Regards, 
Sawaddi Patong Resort and Spa by Tolani.

reviews.name: Daria “Patrycja”
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic stay at this hotel in Patong. The food was excellent with plenty of choice and everything we tried was really tasty. The hotel has two large swimming pools which were both great for relaxing during the day, and there was always plenty of space around the pool.
The bar area was also very nice with a good atmosphere, perfect for a drink at any time, from open to close. What really made the stay special though was the staff, everyone was incredibly friendly, welcoming and always happy to help.
Overall, a wonderful place to stay in Patong and we would definitely come back again. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Toni Carrington
reviews.text:

The pool areas are very clean. Rooms are good with comfy beds & a good shower.
We took the free shuttle bus into Phuket & Jo our driver was a really good guy 👍 always smiling!
A young lad in the restaurant was really kind fetching me hot tea ☕️
Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable 😊

reviews.name: D C
reviews.text:
Let's Relax Spa is consistently my top choice whenever I visit Thailand. The spa has a remarkable ability to create a stable, comfortable, and calming environment that instantly puts me at ease. I'm delighted to find that they have a couple of branches here in Phuket, as this is my first time visiting the area.

Due to time constraints, I could only indulge in a 45-minute foot massage, but it was truly rejuvenating. I'm already looking forward to returning in the next few days to experience more of their services.

One suggestion I have for improvement is to offer booking options through WhatsApp or Line. Currently, they only accept reservations through telephone or their website, which may not be completely convenient for everyone. Having additional booking methods would provide more flexibility for guests.

Overall, I highly recommend Let's Relax Spa for its consistent quality and the serene experience it offers.

The house has maintained its original architecture & atmosphere so that you would feel warm and relaxing like ‘being at home’ during the treatment. Located on historically and culturally outstanding Ratchadamneon Road, one of the tourist attractions in the heart of ChiangMai. Walking along bustling this road to Time to Massage, you will feel like escaping to another world of tranquility and serenity, aligned with the simple way of life in ChiangMai city. “ChiangMai I love you” is the our pride that we would like to portray. reviews.name: Kay Summerville (Keiron SUMMERS)
reviews.text:
We stumbled across Time to Massage in Chiang Mai a few days ago, and it quickly became part of our daily routine. No joke, three visits in three days.

After traveling around Thailand and trying quite a few massages, this place really stands out. The therapists are highly skilled, the pressure is perfect, and they clearly know exactly what they’re doing. Every session left us feeling completely reset.

The atmosphere is relaxed, the place is spotless, and the staff are genuinely welcoming without the typical “tourist spa” vibe. It feels authentic, professional and very easy to relax the moment you walk in.

Also, the value for money is incredible. You get a top quality massage without the inflated prices you sometimes see in tourist areas.

Safe to say we’re hooked and we’ll definitely be back again before leaving Chiang Mai.

If you’re in Chiang Mai and your body needs fixing after too much walking, hiking, scooters or night markets, this is the spot.

reviews.text: I had forgotten how good the real massage is until I received one here. Their professionalism surprised me! First of all, they actually give you a form to fill out to check your health and your condition (such as if you are pregnant, on period, if you have any chronic disease etc), and your preference about the massage. (Which part you want to focus, which part you don't feel comfortable touched etc) They give you a small bottle of water before the massage, and delicious hot tea and a snack after the massage. They gave me a small gift too! (which melted my heart) A male therapist, his name is Tan, was very soft spoken, polite, and respectful, yet very steady and good pressure of massage! This was actually the first time I felt like the therapist was "approaching" my body, not just "I know how to do massage and I'm going to do the procedure on you" massage. A receptionist and admin women were very friendly and kind too. This is by far the only place I feel like you get more than what you paid for. I recommend asking for Tan because he is very very good.

很推荐！Highly recommended! Fabulous!! Excellent!!! I visited Siam Thai Massage three times throughout my stay in Chiang Mai.
My first two appointments were with the excellent therapist Jim, who treated me to relaxing foot massages and full-body coconut oil massages. On my third visit, I was attended to by Joy, a wonderfully witty and engaging masseuse. Both of them delivered incredibly soothing sessions that left me feeling completely at ease.
I attended regular yoga classes while in Chiang Mai, which often left my muscles sore and tense afterward. This shop quickly became my go-to spot to relieve all that post-yoga discomfort. The venue boasts a tranquil, pleasant atmosphere, and best of all, the pricing is incredibly reasonable and great value for money.
To top off each massage, they serve warm herbal tea, cold mineral water, and a chocolate stick, adding such a lovely, thoughtful touch to the whole experience. I wholeheartedly recommend Siam Thai Massage to anyone seeking a premium Thai massage experience in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Teh
reviews.text:
I have had hair washes in countless countries, from cheap street salons to luxury hotels and premium salons. This was, without exaggeration, the worst hair washing experience of my entire life.

I just want to find a good place for hair wash without considering the price but the staff member did not actually wash my hair. She simply poured shampoo onto my scalp for a few seconds and rinsed it off immediately. There was no proper cleansing, no massage, no effort, no professionalism — absolutely nothing that could even be called a “hair wash.”

It honestly felt insulting as a paying customer.

I have never experienced service this careless, lazy, and indifferent anywhere in the world. Even the most basic budget salons usually provide better technique and more respect to customers.

If you expect an actual hair wash, basic hygiene standards, or even minimal service quality, avoid this place completely.

Extremely disappointing and embarrassingly poor service. The worst salon ever encounter.

reviews.name: Shivani Kadam
reviews.text:
1 star only because of the receptionist, Eva, who did not properly clarify the services included. I booked a combined pedicure + gel polish package for THB 800, but the service only included nail cutting and gel polish application. No proper pedicure care was done, such as removal of dead skin or foot cleaning, which is generally expected in a pedicure service.

When I raised this concern and explained what a standard pedicure usually includes, I was told that “in Patong it’s the same everywhere” and was asked to check other salons. That response felt dismissive and unprofessional, especially after spending around THB 7100 on multiple services at the salon.

What disappointed me most was the lack of effort to resolve the issue or offer any alternative when a customer clearly expressed dissatisfaction. A simple attempt to accommodate or reassure the customer would have made a big difference. But I get it; since you are a tourist they don’t actually take it seriously.

That said, 5 stars to Mai, Mariam, and Khau (not sure if I spelled her name correctly) for their excellent work and service. They were polite, skilled, and professional throughout.

reviews.name: Susanna N
reviews.text:
This is only the second negative review I have ever written, and I only do so when I genuinely feel a business needs a wake-up call or when future guests should be aware of the experience they may receive.

I booked the “Spa Harmony” package in advance and arrived 15 minutes early. Unfortunately, my room was not ready, and I spent around 25 minutes waiting in the lobby while the owner conducted job interviews on speakerphone in front of guests. Not exactly the relaxing start one expects from a spa.

Once my room was ready, I was rushed through the introduction and given only a few minutes to change. There was no hanger for my dress, and I was advised to place it inside a small cabinet. The foot-washing ritual was also uncomfortable due to poorly designed seating.

My therapist was kind, but she spoke virtually no English, making communication difficult throughout the treatment. The steam room was so cold and I eventually took a hot shower to warm up, only for the hot water to run out. I also had to repeatedly request support under my knees, and improvised rolled towels were eventually used instead of proper bolsters.

The oil massage itself was good, but the rest of the treatment lacked confidence and professionalism. The heated bed fluctuated between too cold and uncomfortably hot, the towels were heavily worn, and the restroom had not been properly cleaned, with urine still on the toilet seat.

At several points I considered ending the treatment early and now regret not doing so.

To their credit, when I shared my concerns with reception, they apologized and offered a 20% discount. However, I still left feeling that I had wasted 3.5 hours of my day.

I am genuinely surprised by the high rating of this spa. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend it and would suggest looking at other options in the area instead. Alanna Spa across the street is, in my opinion, far superior.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Susanna N, thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback about your experience at divana Anda Spa, and we are truly sorry that your visit did not reflect the peaceful, professional, and caring standard you expected from us, especially regarding the room readiness, waiting experience, communication during the treatment, room temperature, towels, restroom cleanliness, and overall comfort throughout your Spa Harmony package, we sincerely appreciate that you also mentioned the kindness of your therapist and the quality of the oil massage, and please know that your comments have been taken very seriously as we will review this with our team to improve our service flow, facilities, cleanliness checks, and guest care more carefully, we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again one day and provide the relaxing spa experience you originally hoped for 🌿

reviews.text: A perfect place in Chiang Mai for a massage! The owner is sweet and professional, and they have private rooms for treatments. The therapists are skilled and professional. Highly recommended! The photo shows the tea and fruit offered at the end of the massage. Competitive prices.

reviews.name: Ruby McBeath
reviews.text: I had the best massage I have ever experienced at Old City Massage! Everything from when I was greeted to walking out the door was incredible. The space is so soothing and peaceful, you feel so calm and comfortable by the time you are ready for your massage. After they offer you fresh fruit and tea ☕️ 10/10 would recommend to you to try while in Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Dorien Thys
reviews.text:
Best massage I had in Chiang Mai. We had a 1 hour oil massage for 400 baht and 1,5h for 600. Very good prices for such a relaxing atmosphere.
We also received a tea and some fruit afterwards. 🌸👌

Definately recommended!

reviews.name: Louise T
reviews.text:
Wonderful and so relaxing ✨ it's just off the main road but is really well sound proofed. It was our first time having a Thai massage and we were a little anxious about finding a decent place - really happy that we listened to the reviews! The massage rooms are on a separate floor so there's privacy, unlike the spas on the mains strip.

Everyone was super lovely and calming - thank you 🩷 we'll definitely return!

reviews.name: Jackson Yang
reviews.text:
Was staying in the Kata area and wanted to get a massage. Searched online and found this highly rated massage parlor nearby.
Looked like the shop had recently renovated, looking even more comfortable, refreshing and modern than the pictures I saw in reviews. Decided on an hour foot massage, was greeted with water and a cool towel to wipe off my sweats. After foot bath, moved to the comfortable sofa chair for the massage, the masseuse was friendly, polite, and skillful, and checked on me about the right pressure to apply. After the massage, was served hot green tea and delicious dried banana chips. Overall it was an excellent experience, very relaxing and comfortable, good pricing, highly recommended, I will definitely be back to the shop again to try other massages the next time I am in the area.

reviews.name: CK CK
reviews.text:
Have been to many Thai massage places, this stands out as one of the best. The place is clean and nicely renovated with 3 stories of massage rooms. The service is great and the massage was very well executed. Every points are meticulously positioned and pressure is applied in a very conscious manner. Unlike some other massage place where it’s is just brush thru without much effort.

We were served with a cup of cold drink and nice cold towels to wipe down our face and hands while our legs are being washed with warm water. After the massage we were also treated with some banana crisp snacks and hot tea. The level of service and care is comparable to that of a Spa and at an excellent price point starting from 300baht for 1hr traditional massage. We came back for 4 straight nights and u can get their number to book in advance. High recommended 👍🏽

reviews.name: hideo kondo
reviews.text:
I had a 90-minute massage after surfing earlier. It was very thorough and I felt completely at ease during the treatment.
While 90 minutes for 900 baht might not seem cheap, it's a genuine, high-quality massage, so you can rest assured👍

reviews.name: Korn Ni
reviews.text:
Highly recommend!!!

Professional Traditional Thai Massage in Kata.

This lovely place have a good value for everything. A place is pleasant
Greeted with lovely thai style welcome drink😍
The staff are pretty nice , polite and professional.
Besides, Green tea and dessert after that are superb
I have such a relaxing and peaceful moments there.

reviews.name: ADITYA ACHARYA
reviews.text: My wife and I recently experienced a 60-minute foot massage, and we were thoroughly impressed with the quality of service. Additionally, we were offered green tea and sweet banana chips upon completion of the treatment. The foot massage service also encompassed a head, neck, and shoulder massage towards the end of the session.

reviews.name: Julia M
reviews.text: I always choose this salon for massages whenever I’m on vacation — I’ve been coming here for two years now. The massages are consistently excellent, the salon is clean and welcoming, and the therapists are kind, professional, and very positive. I always leave feeling relaxed and happy. And the green tea is absolutely delicious. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Haley Slook
reviews.text: Great overall experience! Very kind staff and a lot of options to choose from. Definitely would recommend stopping here during your trip.

reviews.name: Nikki
reviews.text: I've had quite a few massages from various areas in Phuket but I was not expecting a luxurious experience like this. When I walked in I could hear quite snores from some of the relaxed customers. I was greeted with a wonderful foot wash, water, and a cool towel. After my wonderful massage, I was given tea and cookies. I'm going to visit a few more times before I leave.

reviews.name: Kevin Ray
reviews.text:
Came across this shop while exploring Kata beach area.
It's nice and clean. Price is always good in Thailand.
Very relaxing hour massages...
I only feel asleep like 2 times.

reviews.name: Mattias Å
reviews.text: Best massage i've ever had, they are very professional and the atmosphere is so relaxing

reviews.name: Francesca Boniatti

Nice location, good price, water, tea and banana chips at the end
Good massage

reviews.name: Niamh Robertson
reviews.text:
Highly recommend. On my last day of a month traveling (and trying massages) in Thailand, I visited ThaiEng. My therapist was extremely skilled and used techniques I hadn’t had before. It was private and clean and very relaxing.

The whole process was like a spa, feet cleaned carefully whilst you sip water and wash your face. After there is tea and biscuits and relaxing.

Nam has amazing English and will be able to help you.

Must visit if you are looking for a great quality massage for a great price starting at 300bhat.

reviews.name: Vigneswaran Subramaniam
reviews.text: I often visit massage parlours for full-body and leg massages, and this place truly stands out. It is exceptionally clean, and the staff provide service with great professionalism and warmth. The leg massage, in particular, is done expertly. It’s one of the few places where I’ve been able to fully relax and even fall asleep during the session.

reviews.name: דניאל סדיקוב
reviews.text: My experience was amazing, the service and personal attention are worth it all, I traveled the island for a month, and this was the only place I went to get a massage, worth trying, I promise you won't be disappointed.

reviews.name: Egor Suchkov
reviews.text: Thai Foot Massage is absolutely amazing! The massage was incredibly relaxing and the perfect way to unwind. The staff is friendly and professional, and I can't wait to come back!

reviews.name: Anna Antonelli
reviews.text:
TERRIBLE. More like torture than a massage.

I’ve had so many massages over the last few days in Bangkok and Cambodia, and every single one of them was amazing… but this place honestly made me regret walking through the door.

First of all, the chairs were incredibly uncomfortable. Your back was forced backwards while the headrest pushed your head forward. Absolutely awful.

Then there was the guy giving me the massage. He used WAY too much pressure. I told him several times to be gentler, but he just kept pressing harder.

There were four of us, and not a single one enjoyed it.

Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else. I walked out with sore legs, sore shoulders, a sore neck… and the head massage (which is usually my favorite part) was ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE! It hurt so much! WAY TOO MUCH PRESSURE!

Seriously, do they not realize they’re massaging a human being and not cracking walnuts?! 😤😤😤

I should have gotten up and shouted, “STOP!”

Now I’m feeling dizzy, my shoulders hurt where he kept pressing, and the back of my head is sore because he pushed so hard even though I repeatedly asked him to be gentler.

I honestly don’t know why I was so polite and just kept enduring it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอโทษลูกค้าเป็นอย่างมากค่ะสำหรับประสบการณ์ที่ไม่ประทับใจ ทางเราจะนำข้อมูลที่ลูกค้าติชมปรับปรุงและแก้ไขทันทีค่ะ 🙏🙏

It felt incredibly relaxing, and my legs felt so much lighter afterwards. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and comfortable. Definitely would come back again😊

reviews.name: Sara Jiménez

reviews.name: J’s Life Bites
reviews.text: The price was affordable, and the staff were friendly. Although the Thai massage was a bit painful, I felt comfortable and relaxed after the massage.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: J s
reviews.text: The Thai massage is great! I have very good experience here! The lady is nice and professional!

reviews.name: Kai
reviews.text: Found this massage place by chance, and it was really good. Service and quality of the message were great. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Priscilla Tay
reviews.text: Chanced upon this massage place near our hotel during our stay in Chiang Mai and ended up visiting 3 times! reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience at this shop. It was not worth the money. During the massage, the staff kept talking the entire time, which made it impossible to relax. Overall, it felt very unprofessional.

ขอบคุณสำหรับคำแนะนำของลูกค้าค่ะทางร้านจะนำคำติชมของลูกค้าไปปรับปรุงทันทีค่ะ

reviews.name: Dkohs K
reviews.text:
Visited on 21 Feb 2026 My experience with an older male masseuse (longer hair) was horrid. We did 1 hour foot massage and I wanted it to end the moment it began. My partner’s masseuse was good though with a lady. The lady was attentive and pressure points were there. But this proves that there is no consistency in the massage place. I’m actually writing this while having the massage cos it’s that bad. I’ve been to many massages throughout Thailand, this is the worst. First time I did not bother to tip.
He was just marinating my foot with oil and basically there is no momentum to the massage, just random touching at different parts of my foot and leg. It’s  feels like at some point he fell asleep and there was no pressure at and it paused. He was distracted while basically just applying oil, looking around, looking outside. Looking at other masseuse. At 5 mins to end time he was still applying oil. Didnt understand, didn’t like it. When I look at the poor reviews. I wonder if it’s the same nonsense guy. Recommend to go else where with more consistent massage. Rubbish massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

หากลูกค้าสะดวกทางร้านยินดีคืนเงินเต็มจำนวน หรือลูกค้าสามารถเข้านวดฟรีอีกครั้งโดยไม่เสียค่าบริการ สามารถติดต่อกลับผ่านเจ้าของร้านโดยตรงได้ที่เบอร์ 0612978822

reviews.name: Grace Wong
reviews.text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at this spa. From the moment I walked in, I was captivated by the beautiful environment. The design has a mysterious Eastern touch blended with a slightly French-inspired style, creating an elegant and unique atmosphere. The overall ambiance is incredibly relaxing, with soft lighting and soothing scents that immediately help you unwind.

The staff were professional and friendly, and they were able to communicate clearly in English, which made everything very comfortable and easy. The massage itself was absolutely amazing — the technique was excellent and the pressure was just right. It was so relaxing that I almost fell asleep!

I visited with my seven-year-old daughter, and I was delighted to find that they offer a children’s massage package. It’s a wonderful option for families who want to enjoy a spa experience together. My daughter had a great time, and it made our visit even more special.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to relax and enjoy some quality time — whether on your own or with your child. I will definitely be coming back! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a joy it is to read your beautiful review! We are delighted to know that you and your daughter enjoyed the serene atmosphere and the warm, professional care from our team at Urban Oasis Spa. It is always our goal to provide a peaceful retreat, and we are so pleased that we could create such a memorable experience for your family. We look forward to welcoming you both back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Miss MoMo
reviews.text:
tranquil oasis in the midst of a bustling city! relaxing atmosphere the moment we stepped in, & they fitted us in even though we arrived without any prior booking.

the private rooms were clean, spacious & comfortable, & the coconut scrub was super aromatic, reminding me of pandan chiffon cake. my therapist Teddy was gentle with her hands, kneading away all the tension in my neck & shoulders. also loved the hot compress used to gently tap away all my body aches.

would love to be back to try out other packages on their menu! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so grateful for your thoughtful review. It was a pleasure to know how much you enjoyed the service and tranquil ambiance at Urban Oasis Spa. Knowing that we could create a relaxing and restorative experience for you is the greatest compliment we could receive. Thank you for your kind words and support. We eagerly await the opportunity to welcome you back for another relaxing escape.

reviews.name: Junkun
reviews.text:
I recently visited this Oasis Spa branch located a bit outside Bangkok city, and it was absolutely worth the trip. The spa itself is beautifully renovated, blending modern elegance with classic Thai design, creating a calm and premium atmosphere from the moment you arrive.

The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend trying the four-hand massage — having two therapists working in perfect synchronization really elevates the experience. What would normally take a longer session feels more efficient yet incredibly high quality. The therapists don’t just apply oil lightly; they deliver real pressure into the muscles, making it deeply relaxing and genuinely therapeutic.

While the price is slightly higher than what you would typically pay for a spa in Bangkok, the overall quality and experience make it completely worth it. This is easily one of the best spa experiences I’ve had so far, with no regrets at all.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely appreciate you sharing such detailed and glowing feedback about your visit to our Urban Oasis Spa. It is a pleasure to know that the attentive care of our team and the unique harmony of our Four-Hand Massage made your experience one of the best you have ever had. We are committed to delivering exceptional spa experiences, and your kind words are a wonderful encouragement to our team.
We look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional spa experience in the near future.

reviews.name: Sherly Mokhtar
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved this place! ✨ The spa is beautiful, the service was excellent, and the massage was honestly **perfect**. It was so relaxing that, for the first time ever during a massage, I actually completely passed out! 😂 That says it all.

If I’m ever back in Bangkok, I’ll definitely be coming here again. And an added bonus — they’re open until **midnight**, which is perfect if you’re looking for a late-night massage after a long day.

**One small note:** the road leading to the spa can be quite quiet, especially at night. I’d recommend taking a Grab/taxi rather than walking there alone, or bringing a friend if you’re planning to walk around the area.

Overall, a **wonderful experience and highly recommended!** 💆🏻‍♀️✨

(picture reference welcome drink and post massage treat)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sherly Mokhtar,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful review! We’re truly delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing and memorable experience at Urban Oasis Spa. Knowing that you felt completely at ease and were able to drift off peacefully during your treatment is such a lovely compliment to our therapists.

We also sincerely appreciate your thoughtful note about our location and the quiet surroundings in the evening. Your feedback is valuable to us and helpful for guests planning a later visit.

It was a true pleasure having you with us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another blissful escape and a little more well-deserved relaxation the next time you’re in Bangkok!

Warmest regards,
The Oasis Spa Team

reviews.name: Nat Sang
reviews.text: A tranquil spa tucked away in the bustling Ekkamai area. The service was excellent, and the treatment room was beautifully designed, creating a relaxing atmosphere. They also offer a complimentary shuttle service to and from the BTS station, which makes getting there very convenient. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate you sharing such a glowing review. It is a true pleasure to know that you enjoyed the beautiful design of our treatment rooms and the excellent service provided by our team at Urban Oasis Spa. We look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you back in the near future.

reviews.name: Petlada Ouratanakawee
reviews.text: Beautiful, green, and peaceful setting. My therapist, K. Fairy, was exceptional. I find that nothing relieves my pain quite like a traditional Thai massage, and she gave me one of the best massages I’ve ever had, she really listened to my requests and helped my body feel refreshed. Also very friendly and helpful front desk staff, tasty mango sticky rice at the end, and a handy shuttle to the BTS. An absolute gem in BKK!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a wonderful review to read. Thank you for your kind words about your therapist, our front desk staff, and the peaceful atmosphere of our Urban Oasis Spa. We are so glad you enjoyed every aspect of your visit, and we truly appreciate your support. We look forward to your next visit with us.

reviews.name: Aditya Tak
reviews.text:
Went on my birthday with my partner for a Royal Oasis King & Queen Massage and it’s the best massage experience ever!

The staff is really friendly, cheerful and courteous and our masseuses Rita & Nita were very professional and did a fabulous job.

Highly recommended Oasis Spa :)

We look forward to the opportunity to welcome you back for another exceptional spa journey.

reviews.name: qwq
reviews.text: After a perfect experience last year, I made sure to book well in advance before setting off on this trip. I ended up coming here twice during my stay to try out different treatments. It was incredibly relaxing, and the service was top-notch and attentive. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your five-star experience has truly brightened our day! It is delightful to know that you enjoyed our treatments and the high standard of service at Urban Oasis Spa. Your kind words are a great encouragement to our team. Thank you for your valued support, and we look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you back for another exceptional visit soon.

reviews.name: Sumol
reviews.text: I recently visited Oasis Spa Ekkamai and had a good experience. The massage was good, especially if you enjoy medium to strong pressure—it really helped release tension. Each guest is provided with a private room, which adds to the comfort and sense of relaxation. The design of the spa reflects traditional Thai aesthetics, creating a serene atmosphere that enhances the overall experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the fantastic review!  We're so pleased you enjoyed your experience at Oasis Spa (Bangkok, Urban Oasis Spa). Your feedback on the massage, private rooms, and serene Thai atmosphere helps us continue providing excellent service, and we'd love to welcome you back soon!

reviews.name: Michelle Chuen
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at Oasis Spa. The peaceful ambiance immediately put me at ease. My hot oil massage was excellent — just the right pressure, very relaxing, and the therapist was professional and attentive. The facilities are clean, beautiful, and comfortable.
Definitely will come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience at Urban Oasis Spa. reviews.name: Wanrada Sathawornsmith
reviews.text:
The best spa and massage in Bangkok. I’m local here and this is the best place for relaxing. You will got amazing experience and perfect service here like no where else can do. I’ll come back here again for sure

reviews.name: KatSven
reviews.text: The Oasis Spa is truly an oasis! One of the cosiest spas in Bangkok, so quiet and quaint. Excellent service, beautiful, clean rooms. Massage was great and after service with a little mango and sticky rice an added bonus. Also have to say that the pick-up and drop-off service to Phrom Phong is really great as the spa is located quite deep into the soi. I would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Angel Lim
reviews.text: Very relaxing and cozy environment with cleanliness, serenity and attention showered. Massage is relaxed and masseuse Katie is polite and good. Only feedback is that some back acupoints can be more spot on. I like the coconut scrub and hot compress!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your glowing review has truly brightened our day! reviews.name: Razel Ildefonso
reviews.text: Really had a great experienced! Very friendly staff especially K. Biw , K. Anya and K. Smile @ K. Buri Treatment was very relaxing, the ambiance is very cozy and clean. Shouldn’t miss to visit if you’re coming to Bangkok, one of the best experience. 💯

reviews.name: E. W.
reviews.text: What an incredible experience. I came with a group of friends and we’ve had many massages throughout Bangkok - our experience at oasis was by far the best. It’s a beautiful little sanctuary in a cute neighborhood. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts on your recent visit. We are thrilled to hear that you and your friends had such a positive experience and that you consider our Urban Oasis Spa the best you've encountered in Bangkok.
