reviews.name: Éric Pséat
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Oasis Spa Bangkok! We visited as a family with our son and chose the “Sweet Dreams Kids” treatment for him, which included a 30-minute body scrub followed by a 60-minute aromatherapy massage. My wife and I opted for the 30-minute herbal steam treatment followed by a 60-minute aromatherapy massage.

From start to finish, everything was top-notch. The location and facilities are absolutely beautiful, peaceful, lush, and perfectly designed for relaxation. The staff were incredibly polite, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit.

We especially appreciated being able to enjoy all our treatments together in the same room, which made it a truly special family experience. It’s rare to find a spa that caters so well to both adults and children.

The little touches really stood out too, delicious pomegranate juice served before our treatments, and a lovely tea with mango sticky rice afterward. It made the whole experience feel even more thoughtful and indulgent.

This is easily one of the best spa experiences we’ve had, and we wouldn’t hesitate to come back. Highly recommended for couples and families alike!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly grateful for your beautiful review. It genuinely warms our hearts to hear that your family's visit to the Urban Oasis Spa was one of the best spa experiences you've ever had. Our team takes immense pride in creating a peaceful and luxurious atmosphere, and we are absolutely delighted that you enjoyed everything from the treatments to the refreshments. Knowing that we helped create a special and cherished memory for your family means the world to us. Thank you once again for your recommendation. We sincerely look forward to welcoming you all back very soon.

reviews.name: Yamini Haridas
reviews.text:
My mother and I recently visited Urban Oasis Spa, and we had a wonderful experience from start to finish. The staff were incredibly courteous, polite, and attentive. They took the time to understand our preferences and helped us choose the treatments that suited us best.

A special thank you to the manager, Ms. Biw, who was welcoming, professional, and ensured that everything went smoothly throughout our visit. Our masseuses were excellent, skilled, attentive, and made us feel completely relaxed and comfortable.

The spa has a peaceful and calming atmosphere, making it the perfect place to unwind. We left feeling refreshed and thoroughly enjoyed our experience. We would definitely recommend Urban Oasis Spa to anyone looking for a relaxing and professional spa experience, and we look forward to visiting again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share your wonderful experience at Urban Oasis Spa. We are delighted to know that you and your mother enjoyed your visit, from the calming atmosphere to the attentive service provided by our team. It is especially rewarding to know that our manager, Ms. Biw, and our skilled therapists made your experience both relaxing and memorable. Your kind feedback is a wonderful encouragement to our team and inspires us to continue creating peaceful and exceptional spa experiences for every guest. Thank you for your recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you both back for another relaxing spa experience soon.

reviews.name: Leslie F.
reviews.text: This is my first time visiting Bangkok and my first massage here as well. It was amazing. The location was beautiful and peaceful. Very clean and had a very pleasant aroma. The massage was excellent and my masseuse was very attentive and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire process. I would not change a thing about the process. Will definitely come here again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing such a positive and detailed account of your visit. We are truly delighted that you enjoyed every aspect of your time with us, from the serene atmosphere of our Urban Oasis Spa to the attentive care provided by your masseuse. It means a lot to us that you plan to return, and we warmly look forward to welcoming you back soon.

reviews.name: kr1stos
reviews.text:
Oasis Spa is a truly beautiful and peaceful place.
The spa itself is very cozy, surrounded by nature, with pomelo trees growing in the garden.
The therapists are incredibly attentive and caring, and the products used are of excellent quality.
The entire experience feels almost like being in paradise — calm, harmonious, and deeply relaxing.
I would definitely love to come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!  We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the cozy atmosphere, the beautiful garden with pomelo trees, our attentive and caring therapists, and the excellent quality products at our Urban Oasis Spa branch. Your description of the experience as "calm, harmonious, and deeply relaxing" truly means a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing spa journey.

reviews.name: TheJoneses
reviews.text:
It was super easy to book via WhatsApp. At the spa (Urban Oasis branch) the staff were friendly, polite and spoke good English.
The premises were immaculate, clean, very good condition. Didn’t look like a 5 year old spa. Looks like they really care for the place.
My husband’s therapist was very good. Experienced.
However, the therapist that was looking after me didn’t speak English and didn’t understand what I needed, on top of that I believe she’s new - which resulted with me not having a great massage as my husband. However, she’s learning.
Saying that, we’ll definitely come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the convenience of booking via WhatsApp, the warm hospitality of our team, and the cleanliness and ambiance of Urban Oasis Spa. It is also wonderful to know that your husband's massage met your expectations.

At the same time, we sincerely apologize that your own massage experience was not equally satisfying. We regret that the communication barrier and therapist's experience affected your treatment, as we are committed to providing every guest with a personalized and relaxing experience.

Please be assured that your feedback has been shared with our spa management team. We will continue to strengthen our therapist training and communication skills to ensure a consistently high standard of service.

We truly appreciate your understanding and are delighted to know that you plan to visit us again. We look forward to welcoming you back for an even better experience.

title: บ้านไทยลานนา นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ (Baan Thai Lanna Massage)
ownerDescription: Good massage good serviceWe take care in every detail in our service. We have staff who are highly skilled in massage.
address: 138 3 ถนนมรรคา Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXPM+8F Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Agostina Tesan
reviews.text: I got to this place thanks to the good reviews and it didn’t disappoint. The service was top notch from the moment we arrived, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. I went for the oil massage and it was not only deeply relaxing, but it also helped a lot to loosen and soften my muscle knots. I left feeling refreshed and much lighter. They greeted us with tea and a yogurt and tea were waiting by the end. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Nicolas BRETON
reviews.text:
What looked around Old Town Chiang Mai to find a nice place for massage, and we had the chance to find this one.

We came a first time for one hour of feet, shoulder, and back massage, and really enjoyed it. The owner was very friendly and helpful, and the staff was very skilled.

Then, we decided to come back again another day for two hours of oil massage with hot compress, recommended by the owner. It was also a great choice and we enjoyed it even more that the first day.

The massage service also include (good!) tea and yogurt.

We will definitely come again the next time we are in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Leo Roffey
reviews.text: They absolutely nailed it- 10/10 service and massage. We were warmly welcomed and served delicious hot tea, with beautiful scents throughout the spa and tranquil music. It was an incredible massage, with the perfect combination of satisfying pain and relaxation. They also washed and massaged our feet as a little extra. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: coco
reviews.text: I give this store a low point not because of the massage. The massage is fantastic. It’s just that I’m not sure whether the boss is treating her employees fairly and well. I seriously doubt it.  Wouldn’t go again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I think you've misunderstood something. We never take advantage of our employees. You can check, because yesterday we gave you a discount. And regarding the customer tipping the office, we always give it to our employees. You don't have to worry. You might have misunderstood something. We can verify this; we have cameras in the store. I apologize for the misunderstanding.

reviews.name: Eric Li
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best massage places in Chiang Mai. The staff are incredibly friendly and speak fluent English and Chinese. Most importantly, they have really professional massage techniques!

reviews.name: Karen S
reviews.text: I found this lovely massage place near my hotel and went back every night for a hot stone massage, perfect pressure for a great price. The place is very clean and the staff is wonderful. They cleaned my feet, provided tea and delicious fruit :) Def will come back next time I am visiting Chiang Mai
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking time to leave us a review! We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed your massage. Your kind words mean a lot to us and keep us motivated. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

reviews.name: Dominika Floriánová
reviews.text: The massage was great, not too strong, very nice and relaxing setting and you even get a free tea and a little snack. The owner and staff were very friendly.

reviews.name: Juls
reviews.text:
I was looking for a massage place that was still open late at night and accepted card payments, and I found this one. Amazing Thai massage experience! The masseuse and receptionist were very accommodating - they even let me borrow a charger for my phone. I had tea before and after the session, along with some yogurt. 😊

Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. We will use it to further develop our massage staff. We sincerely hope you will return to use our services again.

reviews.name: Kevin Hofmann
reviews.text: It has been my third time here now. It's always a pleasure to come back here, the owner is super friendly and welcoming. The massages are a blessing. It's very quiet inside with calm ambient music which makes it much more enjoyable. Feeling so much better afterwards. Can absolutely recommend this place 🙏

reviews.name: Its me
reviews.text: Very good service also the therapist have good massage skill!!!! I really enjoyed lot here all so kind and friendly

reviews.name: Kathryn Davis
reviews.text:
I had such a relaxing experience last night at Baan Thai Lanna Massage! I found them because I was looking for a shop that was open late and luckily they are open until midnight. I was greeted by the lovely lady at the front desk who settled me in with some bael fruit tea and gave me some time to look over the menu.

I choose the traditional Thai massage (400 baht) and the Thai facial (600 baht). They also start off with washing your feet, making it feel even more luxurious without the super high price tag. Although you can technically find better prices nearby, the quality of the massage was one of the best I've had and the amount of pressure she applied was fantastic! My body was so relaxed, I fell into a meditative state and was able to fully decompress. She was gentle with me but firm enough to give a deep massage. Although I can't say the facial did any wonders for my acne (and to be far this is not what was advertised), it felt so wonderful!!!

The lady who gave my massage was so kind, courteous and welcoming. When I was done, I was greeted downstairs with more bael fruit tea and a yogurt, fruit cup; such a nice little surprise!!

I would highly recommend Baan Thai Lanna massage as it was a very relaxing and professional experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for giving us a lovely review 🥰 We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed your massage. Your kind words mean a lot to us and keep us motivated. We look forward to welcoming you again ✨🙏

reviews.name: Killian PLUZANSKI
reviews.text:
Went there twice, amazing team, very skilled.
I did the foot massage and the deep tissue massage both were very good. You can choose the degree of intensity you like, you let them know about which area you want to focus. I highly recommend!

reviews.name: SARA DE LA TORRE CAPITÁN
reviews.text: The massage was one of the best I’ve got and I’ve living in Thailand for a year now. They ask you which areas you’d like them to focus and the level of strength to use. As soon as they start you can feel they are very experience. They received me with an ice tea and afterwards gave me a hot tea plus yogurt with fruit. The whole experience is a 10.

reviews.name: PK
reviews.text: A small massage place but full of kindness and cares from the owner and massagers. After the massage, I got a small cup of yogurt & herbal tea for refreshment. So niceeee! As a Thai person, the massage here is also good. I would come back again when I am in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your appreciation of our service. We will use this feedback to improve it further.

reviews.name: Mak Mijatovic
reviews.text: Very good, best massage in Chang Mai. After massage you get a good tea and yougurt with fruits. Nice. All recomendation👏

reviews.name: I. Cecilia Hinojosa
reviews.text: Great place for massages, pedicures and so on. We stayed 3 days in Chiang Mai and went each day. The first one we went in the night to get head-shoulder-foot massage with oil for one hour and it was one of the best massages we have ever had, as it was raining the owner offered us a ride to our hotel, so attentive of her!  The second one we got a Thai Massage on the happy hour that is from 10am to 6pm,  we paid 250 baht for each. And the third one I got pedicure with color also in the happy hour for 250 baht, on this occasion the owner shared us chicken coconut milk soup she prepared. In all the sessions you are received with hot tea and at the end you are provided yoghurt with fruit and cold tea. All the staff is very attentive and the owner take cares of every detail. Would totally recommend to anyone to take any of their services!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for good reviews in my shop.🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Sofia Kamyshenko
reviews.text:
The best deep tissue massage in Chiang Mai!

I was literally everywhere and I know for sure that master Mam is the best of the best. Very professional, skillful and generous.

Thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. We will use it to further develop our massage staff. We sincerely hope you will return to use our services again.

reviews.name: Deep Sathe
reviews.text: Amazing experience. The owner is so nice and welcoming! Very wide range of massage options from traditional Thai to more common western treatments. Really good if you carry tension in your upper back from bad posture or sitting at a desk for work.

reviews.name: Scott Wilson
reviews.text:
The environment and atmosphere is nice. Very pretty very nice. The staff is very friendly and there is a form to fill out. Unfortunately, the masseuse ignored what I filled out on the form.

I went for Head, Neck, Shoulders and Back and she spent an inordinate amount of time on my legs? I was really confused. I went because I get stress headaches from the tension in my shoulders and neck. There's a part on the form that asks what area to focus on. I wrote Neck and Shoulders. She almost never did anything on my neck.

I didn't write my review until now because I went to other places. It was my first time getting a massage and perhaps I was just ignorant of what to expect.

Now with several more massages under my belt I'm quite certain they just either didn't inform the staff or they didn't feel comfortable working on my neck? Or I don't know. All I know is what I asked for I didn't get.

My wife thought it was just okay. She also hasn't wanted to go back after trying other places as their touch was too light.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Sorry for about that ka . Maybe my staff her wrong listen for that ka .🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Ravi Jaipaul
reviews.text:
Wonderful massage, incredibly skilled staff and lovely good English speaking owner, Buend Bund!

We loved it so much we came back to Thailand the year after for these massages! Over 50 and counting!

This place is special. We keep coming back and one lady does great manicures!

Lovely coconut and salt and lime scrub for your feet before and fruit bowl afterwards too.

My therapist, Om, was disrespectful from the very beginning. She made comments about my body size and laughed while doing so. I clearly explained, using a translation app to avoid any misunderstanding, that her comments were inappropriate and made me uncomfortable. Despite this, she continued to laugh and even asked me, "What do you eat to get this big?"
I felt humiliated and uncomfortable, so I decided to stop the massage before it was finished.
I have visited Pattaya many times and have never experienced anything like this. I chose this establishment because I expected a professional massage, not to be judged or mocked for my appearance.
My body size is not an invitation for disrespectful comments. Every customer deserves to be treated with dignity and respect.

I cannot recommend this place based on my experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Vinu,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

At V6 Thai Massage & Spa Pattaya, we believe every guest should be treated with kindness, dignity, and respect, regardless of appearance or background. We are very concerned by what you described, as this is not the standard of professionalism and hospitality we strive to provide.

We sincerely apologize if any comments or actions by our therapist made you feel uncomfortable or disrespected. That was never our intention. We have already taken your feedback seriously and will speak with our team to reinforce the importance of respectful communication and professional conduct at all times.

We truly appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention, as it helps us improve. We hope you will accept our sincere apologies, and we wish you all the best in your future travels.

– V6 Thai Massage & Spa Pattaya

Nestled between centuries-old trees and meandering canals, this upscale resort and spa is 7 km from iconic Wat Chedi Luang temple and 18 km from the edge of Doi Suthep-Pui National Park.
 The posh, Lanna-style rooms and villas come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, minibars, and tea and coffeemakers. They also feature whirlpool tubs, and balconies with garden or pool views. Villas add private plunge pools, hot tubs and steam rooms. Room service is offered.

Thank goodness for Pon!!! (8 days later, Air Canada is still sending us emails that they will let us know when they find our bags…)||She also walked with us to assist us with a Thai ATM (there’s some things that Google Translate just can’t do). reviews.name: Chloe Chan
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a peaceful vacation in the city of Chiang Mai, this resort is the place to be. It does offer a quiet and calming atmosphere. It is a bit out of town, however ordering bolt was easy, usually takes around 15-20 mins to get to major attractions within the city.

HOWEVER, there is so much this resort can do to improve the overall experience.

1. Renovation please. I like the furnitures in the room, it gives off a traditional Thai vibe. Yet you can tell it’s VERY old. At the very least, please please please change the window curtains. Mine was broken, there were old stains on the curtains, and the curtain rails and parts were all rusty. And also please change the clothes hangers, those were very old too.

2. People management. I’m not saying the staff were not friendly. However, there is a lack of professionalism. Some staff were just playing with their phones at the reception. You can tell most staff were not taking initiative to greet you. It is totally fine if you are a 3-star hotel, but if you are claiming to be a 4-star hotel and charging people with this amount of money you should provide a certain level of customer service. Sadly the service did not meet the expectation.

3. Mosquitoes control. I believe there is something you can do with the mosquitoes around the resort area. I never had a problem with mosquitoes in the resorts that I have stayed in before. Mosquito was the reason why even I have a pool-assess room, I was not able to just sit outside, chill, read a book, and enjoy the environment.

4. Breakfast. The fruit was fresh and plenty but other than that it was okay. We only had breakfast for one day. There were not many options. For $450 baht per person, you can definitely get sth much fresher and tastier. Again, for the price and a 4-star hotel, the resort definitely needs to do better.

This resort is definitely impressive from a distance, but falls apart once you get up close and check the details. There is so much potential for this resort, given the overall design and atmosphere. But without active management, I don’t see how this hotel can sustain in the long term.

reviews.name: Vladimir Zakharov
reviews.text:
Школу выбрал по хорошим отзывам и высокой оценке.
Обучают многим видам массажа, но я прошёл только один вид - традиционный Тайский массаж. Стоимость озвучена для меня за курс 15к бат, срок обучения предполагается 22 дня.
Класс чистый, учителя доброжелательные. Туалет один но в принципе проблем нет. Обучают с усердием, чтобы каждый студент усвоил. Много раз показывают, пока не поймёшь суть.
Закончил курс за 14 дней, получил диплом.
Благодарен за тёплый приём. Студенты доброжелательные, помогают в усвоении материала, обрёл много друзей.
reviews.textTranslated:
I chose the school based on good reviews and high ratings.
They teach many types of massage, but I only took one – traditional Thai massage. The course price was quoted at 15,000 baht, and the training period was 22 days.
The classroom is clean, and the teachers are friendly. There's only one restroom, but that's generally not a problem. They teach diligently, ensuring every student understands the material. They show you the concepts many times until you get the gist.
I completed the course in 14 days and received a diploma.
I'm grateful for the warm welcome. The students are friendly, they help me learn the material, and I've made many friends.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing your experience! 🌟 We're thrilled you enjoyed not only the traditional Thai massage course but also the friendly vibe and dedication of our teachers 👩‍🏫💪. It's awesome to know you made new friends along the way and felt supported by both staff and fellow students 🤗💬. If you're ever up for learning a new massage technique or joining one of our workshops, we'd be delighted to welcome you back! ✨👐

reviews.text: จากปาณิประสบการณ์ได้ความรู้หลายๆอย่างดีมากรู้หลักการเทคนิคจากครุสอนใจดีมากเพื่อนๆดีมากรุ้สึกภูมิทึ่มีวันนี้ครูใจดีสอนเข้าใจง่ายครูน่ารักโดยเฉพาะครูมีนาครูแววครูกีกี้และเพื่อนๆพี่ๆน้องๆรุ่นพี่ใจดีรักกันช่วยเหลือช่วยสอนการนวดท่าปาณิเส้นน้ำและของกินของใช้แบ่งปันกันรุ้สึกดีชื่นชมค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: From this experience, I gained a lot of valuable knowledge. I learned principles and techniques from the kind teachers. My friends were wonderful. I feel proud to be here today. The teachers were kind and taught in an easy-to-understand way. They were lovely, especially Teacher Meena, Teacher Waew, and Teacher Kiki. My friends, seniors, juniors, and older students were all kind, loving, and helpful. They taught me the massage techniques, including the Pani water pressure points, and shared food and supplies. I felt great and appreciative.

The instructors were lovely and friendly, providing guidance until I could perform massages proficiently, understanding the pressure points and key areas. There were also wonderful senior students who offered guidance and were very friendly. I definitely don't regret coming to this course, 100%!

title: Choeng Doi Massage & Spa Nimman
ownerDescription:
Thai massage and spa in the heart of Nimman, Soi 17 — open daily 12:00 to midnight since 2010.

Our therapists are known for real pressure and finding the right points, not a tourist-style light rub. Deep tissue from 500 THB, traditional Thai, foot and head massage from 350 THB, hot aroma oil from 480 THB, and bamboo massage.

Two-hour sessions from 700 THB. Packages from 820 THB.

Every guest starts with a warm herbal foot soak with kaffir lime and rose petals, and finishes with hot tea and pineapple cookies — no extra charge.

Walk-ins welcome. Card and cash accepted. LGBTQ+ friendly.

reviews.name: Britt Ms. D
reviews.text: My new favorite massage place. It's aesthetic is charming and authentic. I was welcomed with a warm footbath, the massage was the best I've ever had in Thailand-excellent pressure and knowledgeable hands, and when I was finished I was greeted with warm tea and biscuits. It was so good I had to go again the very next day- and will for sure be again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you — going again the very next day is the highest compliment we get, and we do not get it often.

The footbath at the start and the tea at the end are not extras to us, they are part of the massage. Glad they landed that way for you too. See you on the next trip.

reviews.name: Vincente Life
reviews.text:
Exceptional massage place close to nimanheimen.
Real thai experience in a very nice atmosphere. Not just fashion tourism place. Amazing professionals with top anatomical knowledge.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you — "not just a fashion tourism place" is exactly what we try to be, and that is not something you can convincingly say about yourself. It means more coming from you.

The anatomical side is the part our therapists take most seriously. Come back whenever you are near Nimman.

reviews.name: Larry Wan
reviews.text:
I back Choeng Doi. The services remain outstanding. Friendly and professional!!
As stay Chiangmai shortly, I picked the 15-min treatment to release my "cell phone" neck tension. I feel much better after treatment now. Thank you so much, Master!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for coming back. "Cell phone neck" is something we see every single day now — fifteen minutes will not undo a whole year of it, but it buys you some room.

Next time you are in Chiang Mai, even for a short stay, you know where we are. Safe travels.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you! Short and to the point — we will take all four. See you next time you are in Nimman.

reviews.name: Chiara
reviews.text: The best, most professional massage I received, probably ever. I’ve been coming for several years and the massage therapist is always very professional and knows exactly what he’s doing. He felt that I clench my teeth at night without me telling him. I can’t recommend this place enough. Plus point is the cute dog!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you — this is the review I will remember. Berm picking up that you clench your teeth at night, without being told, is exactly the kind of reading of the body we hope for. I will tell him.

After several years of visits you know this place better than most. Next time just ask for Berm when you book and we will keep him for you.

reviews.name: Teik Yong Liew
reviews.text: Super value for money with high quality massage standard. It may not be as well decorated like the expensive spa centre but everything you need is available with need and cleanliness. The masseuer are also well trained and my 3 hour session really as it's name takes me to paradise. Definitely would be back again when I am in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Act C.
reviews.text: It’s very good for this massage. I‘m impressed by the friendly conversation and the massage therapist makes me feel very refreshed. After I’ve been walking all day, it‘s like getting new feet. For Christmas, there are also candies for you. Very attentive to customers.❤️

reviews.name: Susana T
reviews.text: I recently had an amazing experience at Choeng Doi Massage & Spa in Chiang Mai. The service was excellent, and the prices were very affordable. But what made my experience truly exceptional was the massageur named Burn, who was undoubtedly the best I've ever had. He was incredibly professional and knew exactly what he was doing. My back was in an absolute mess, but I felt so much better after my treatment. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality massage and spa experience in Chiang Mai. The place is also very clean, which is always a plus. Overall, a fantastic experience!

reviews.name: Miki
reviews.text: Went to this place because of the Google review score but had a very disappointing experience. Visited on a Monday afternoon and the reception guy (possibly the boss) was very unfriendly! He gave us the vibe that he did not want to entertain us. Left us unattended without telling us that we need to wait for the therapists to arrive at the shop. The massage was okay (had better ones), room was small and did not feel that the blanket was clean. Not recommended as you can easily find better places nearby.

reviews.name: Poupée P
reviews.text: Me and my family did a 2-hour Thai massage and we all were satisfied with their services. They pressed at the right point with perfect pressure and made me fall asleep. I felt relieved afterward. They made us feel welcome, super friendly staff. We will definitely be back for sure. If you are looking to have a wonderful massage in Nimman area, you should try this place out!

reviews.name: Demetros Demetriou
reviews.text: Wow!!! Ive had nunerous massages over the last few years that I visit Thailand but this was by far the best!! Booked an hour deep tissue and ended doing 90min. The lady, who was sort of in charge there, was the one who massaged me and definitely found all spots i had issues with. Spoke great english so was easy to guide her. Thank you so much!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you — booking an hour and staying for ninety is the best review a therapist can get.

Finding the right spots and being able to talk about them with you is most of the job. I will pass this on to her. And next time, just say at the start that you might want longer and we will hold the room so you can decide at the end.

reviews.name: Nukul Jorlopo
reviews.text: Choengdoi Spa & Massage is a true oasis of relaxation. From the moment I entered, I was transported to a world of tranquility. The calming music, soothing scents, and skilled therapists create an atmosphere of pure bliss. The range of treatments is impressive, and the staff's professionalism is exceptional. Their attention to hygiene and post-treatment comfort is noteworthy. If you're seeking a rejuvenating escape, Choengdoi Spa & Massage is an absolute must-visit. 🙂🙂

reviews.name: Mariana Ensley
reviews.text: One of my favorite spas in the area. I’ve been to some of the more expensive wellness spas, and while they’re great, the staff at Choeng Doi are incredibly welcoming and the massages consistently leave me feeling refreshed and in noticeably less pain. The value is excellent—especially the foot soak after a long day of exploring. I always make sure to shower beforehand (no one deserves stinky feet 😄), and the tea and snacks after the massage are truly the icing on the cake. It’s a genuine spa experience without the luxury price tag.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you — "a genuine spa experience without the luxury price tag" is the best description of this place anyone has written, and we did not write it ourselves.

The foot soak after a day of walking is exactly what it is there for. Thank you also for the note about showering first, which made us laugh. See you on the next visit.

reviews.name: Johnny Loh

My first time here. I opted for a 2hour session for 700b that included: 30min body scrub, and 1.5hr hot aromatic oil massage + Thai herbal ball compress.

After a 60km morning bike ride, it’s exactly what my body needed. My masseuse Dow was amazing, she knew intuitively knew all the right spots to focus on without direction. The aromatic oil massage in combination with the hot herbal ball on different parts of my body really helped to easy my muscle aches and fatigue.

It was such a splendid and relaxing experience. Highly recommend this shop if you happen to be visiting the famous Roast8ry flagship coffee shop next door:

reviews.name: Nickeekun
reviews.text:
Nickeekun's honest review

What a wonderful place!! I've been here many times and I'd love to finally review this place.

I went in with a friend for a great deal that they've got going on,
2990 baht (about 90 us $)
This was a 3 and 1/2 hour long spa package which included:
Soaking feet in mineral water,
Sauna,
Body scrub with organic ingredients,
Hot oil aroma massage (my favorite)
Body wrap, and also neck, back and shoulder massage.
(I believe I've named them all, I was so relaxed that I was almost too sleepy to go home)

The awesome thing was that this package is for 2 people at the price of 2990 baht!! Such a great deal! Oh and they always bring us these healthy drinks and snacks, free of charge.

Ratings:
Hospitality and friendliness: 5/5
Atmosphere: 5/5
Quality: 5/5
Worth the money: Absolutely!

I really felt welcomed! The owner and the staff are great! A must in Chiang Mai (especially near Nimmanhaemin area)

reviews.name: Rainia
reviews.text:
We were 2 months in vietnam and compared to there, the massage here was not a match.

In the beginning there was not a list where you can write your wishes and injuries. They just recommended us two massages after asking some questions and the massage started. The therapists know how to massage, however most of the movements were energy saving movements. Sometimes they were using strength and slow movements. You could say they did this for balance, however i don't see my massage as efficient as a customer.

We are still giving 4 stars, since it was our first visit in thailand and overall the experience was good.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are truly sorry to hear that the massage did not meet your expectations.
At the time of your visit, we were informed in advance that the guest was 4 months pregnant. For this reason, and in accordance with our safety policy, we do not apply strong pressure for pregnant guests, as the safety of both mother and baby is always our top priority.

We completely understand that this may have felt too gentle compared to massages you experienced elsewhere, and we sincerely appreciate your understanding that this was a necessary safety precaution, not a reflection of service quality.

We truly value your feedback and hope to have another opportunity to provide you with a more satisfying experience in the future under suitable conditions.
Thank you again for your kind understanding.

reviews.name: Co
reviews.text:
This is one of those places that looks good on the outside but it’s average on the inside. The service is average at best. I didn’t get my welcoming drink. Feels like a factory inside. I ordered the Thai massage. They put me in a room with 4 or 5 other people separated by a curtain. Normally I would be ok with that but it’s premium pricing here. I can hear all sorts of sounds here and there wasn’t any relaxing spa music.  A kid was in another section randomly yelling out sounds. He was playing a game on his phone waiting for his mom.
The massage was decent but I was laying face down on a possibly used towel. Again this is premium pricing here.
If it were normal pricing, I wouldn’t have this high of an expectation. This place is average.

reviews.text:
I like to do face massage and been read the reviews and looks up this place, that seem nice so worst the try,
Paid 990 Baht for face massage at Rinn Spa Pattaya. Unfortunately, it was very disappointing.
They put me in a shared room (not private) with many other customers talking loudly. Staff kept opening the sliding door, so it was noisy and not relaxing at all.
The face massage technique was average at best, definitely not worth the price. The neck and shoulder part was noticeably better. I would not recommend the face massage here. Perhaps their foot massage is okay, but for face work, look elsewhere.

reviews.name: Larry Liu
reviews.text:
Beautiful interior at this spa with A/C.

Staff are friendly and they offer tea on arrival.
I took the neck/shoulder/foot massage for 90 minutes.

After a foot wash I was taken to the massage chair studio.

My masseuse was very skilled and professional.

There were some loud tourists and staff members which ruined the atmosphere.

My suggestion is to close the doors to the massage chair room and encourage individuals to be quiet and respectful of others.

I was offered tea and a cookie once we were done :) I’d return the next time.

reviews.name: Praseeth k
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for Rinn Spa and Massage in Pattaya, given its spacious and neat ambiance. However, my experience fell far short of expectations. Despite opting for a full-body massage with scrub and a lengthy 2.5-hour session including a face massage, the quality of the massage was inconsistent.

Initially, the masseuses seemed competent, but their performance deteriorated after about 20 or 30 minutes into the session. The pace slowed down significantly, and the overall experience was not relaxing. Having tried similar massages in various spas around the world, including Thailand, I can confidently say that Rinn Spa and Massage did not meet the standard.

While the spa's appearance may be impressive, the quality of the massage service does not justify the expense or time. I would not recommend this place to anyone seeking a genuinely rejuvenating massage experience. It was a disappointment and a waste of both time and money.

reviews.name: Rami Rauhala
reviews.text: Five stars for RINN Spa/Massage! It is hard to find a place that offers such a high-quality, professional massage. The staff is skilled, the facility is clean, and you can tell they really care about their clients' well-being. I left feeling like a new person.

title: BHAWA SPA on the eight
description: Tranquil day spa with vibrant massage & treatment suites, an outdoor pool & quaint garden.
ownerDescription: Escape to a serene haven in the heart of Bangkok at the BHAWA SPA on the eight, an exquisite day spa that combines traditional Thai wellness practices with modern luxury. Immerse yourself in a world of indulgence as you embark on a journey of rejuvenation and relaxation, where the serene spa garden and aromatic treatment rooms provide a sanctuary for the senses. Established in 2019, this urban oasis offers a diverse range of holistic therapies and rituals, each designed to nurture the body, mind, and soul.
address: 34/1 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Janeki-neko
reviews.text:
I’ve been to many spas in Southeast Asia and this one is so memorable for its beauty. It’s quiet, elegant, refined. 10/10 I recommend coming here.

I bought an off-peak massage voucher from Klook which was a good deal. The spa manager was kind and efficient. All the staff were really kind and professional. I had a massage by Yupa and loved it. The rooms are beautiful. They also have their Bhawa products in the room for you to try.

I love that this place felt spacious and was quiet. I will return!

reviews.name: Haseeb Muhammad
reviews.text:
The spa is thoughtfully designed across two elegant stories, centered around a serene courtyard adorned with a graceful fountain 🌿⛲. The wooden staircase leading to the upper level adds a distinctive architectural character—its occasional creaks may feel distracting to some, yet to others, they enhance the building’s rustic charm and authenticity 🪵✨.
Each treatment room is generously proportioned, offering both a shower and a bathtub for complete comfort and convenience 🛁🚿. Notably, the toilet facilities are located outside the treatment rooms, maintaining a clean and tranquil therapy environment.
Prices typically range between US$100–200, depending on the selected treatment and duration, reflecting the quality of service and the relaxing ambiance provided 💆‍♀️💎.

Best regards,
The management

A local friend who knows Bangkok better than I do booked Bhawa on the 8 through Gowabi. We left CentralWorld with plenty of time, but due to a sudden heavy rain, the taxi ride ended up taking two hours.

Even though the spa closes at 9 p.m., the staff kindly waited for us until 9:20 and extended their working hours to give us the massage. The massage itself was truly satisfying, and even when we had trouble calling a Grab afterward, the staff postponed their own departure to help us.

I was deeply touched — truly heartwarming service!

reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience at Siamese Cookery House in Bangkok on Sunday, February 22, 2026. This hands-on class truly teaches you the secrets behind authentic Thai recipes.

We began the day at Huai Khwang Market, learning how to choose the best ingredients for Thai dishes. Walking through the market was a full sensory experience — the aromas of fish, chicken, fresh herbs, and vegetables filled the air. We even watched fresh shredded coconut being made right in front of us. After gathering our ingredients, we hopped into a tuk tuk and headed to the cooking school, which made the experience even more fun and local.

In a traditional Thai-style kitchen, we learned how to properly cook Thai rice for mango sticky rice, make fresh coconut milk, and prepare tamarind paste from scratch.

Our menu included:

Tom Yum Goong (Thailand’s famous spicy-sour national dish)

Pad Thai (the classic noodle favorite)

Thai curry with homemade curry paste made completely from scratch

Mango sticky rice — and ours was beautifully blue using natural blue flowers

The food was incredibly flavorful, colorful, and aromatic. Everything ran smoothly, and the host made the class feel relaxed, natural, and fun. They even customize dishes if you don’t eat certain things, which I appreciated.

You also receive a recipe book to take home, so you can recreate everything yourself.

This experience went above and beyond my expectations. From selecting ingredients at the market to cooking multiple dishes in an authentic setting, it was a true Thai culinary experience. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok.

title: Smile Organic Farm Cooking School Office
ownerDescription: Learning how to prepare and cook Thai food at our organic farm with the chef who's certified by Chiangmai Center for Skill Development. We'll stop at a local market on the way to the school, then take you to our organic farm which is located 45 minutes away from the city; near San Kamphaeng Hot Springs. You'll see many different kinds of organic herbs, vegetables and fruits that we grow by ourselves. You'll have your own cooking station and enjoy your meal that you proudly cook yourself.
address: 4 ถนน สามล้าน ซอย 1 Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
street: 4 ถนน สามล้าน ซอย 1
plusCode: QXPJ+MV Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Samantha Tay
reviews.text: We started the day with a visit to the local market to understand the common ingredients used in Thai dishes. Our instructor Lily was fantastic! Had a good sense of humor that was so entertaining. Clear instructions and we ended up with really yummy dishes. Will recommend this cooking class to everyone! 😁 #teamlily

reviews.name: Minuca Carreño
reviews.text: The class with our instructor was fantastic. With Mr. K, we cooked four dishes: a curry, a soup, a rice dish, and spring rolls—each one better than the last, thanks to our instructor. Mr. K was so much fun; he taught us a lot about how to blend spices and herbs. First, we went shopping for the ingredients, then we went to the garden to pick the herbs, and then we cooked them. Mr K the best of the cooking lesson by far!!!!

reviews.name: Maude Bally
reviews.text: We loved cooking with natty. We stopped at a local market where she showed us many interesting things, then we had a walk around their garden to see vegetables, fruits and herbs that we used in our recipes later. We cooked three different dishes and the spring rolls and it was absolutely delicious. The kids were our assistants and were able to cook with us. It was a great experience overall and we would recommend it 100%!

reviews.name: Jeroen Backelandt
reviews.text:
I had an amazing cooking class today and it was one of the highlights of my time in Chiang Mai. Milly was incredibly kind, warm and enthusiastic, and she explained everything in a very clear and relaxed way.

She guided us through the ingredients, techniques and flavors of Thai cuisine step by step, and we learned so much while having a lot of fun. Milly creates such a welcoming atmosphere that you immediately feel comfortable and excited to cook.

If you are thinking about doing a cooking class in Chiang Mai, I can highly recommend this one. Milly is truly fantastic and the perfect person to learn Thai cooking from. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.name: S Irani
reviews.text:
This was such a great experience. We got picked up right when they said they would in a nice air conditioned van. It took another half an hour to pick up the rest of our group. We then headed to a small local market where they showed up the spices and vegetables and gave us a bit of an explanation on the ingredients used. We had a chance to use the washroom and even try a local Thai donut which i should add was delicious.

We then headed out into the country and went to the actual farm that the cooking school was located out. It was nice to drive into the countryside a little and see some greenery after the hustle and bustle of Chaing Mai. We then had a guided cooking class with breaks to eat what we made. It was all very well organized and run and i have to say it was an excellent experience. The guide (Anya) who spent the day with us was extremely knowledgeable and skilled and did an excellent job answering our questions and showing us how to make the dishes we selected. At the end of the day we were dropped off back at our hotel with full bellies and a host of wondeful memories.

Ps: they also send pictures and the cookbook to you later which is a nice touch.

reviews.name: Cass Goldie
reviews.text: Great experience. Definitely worth doing. Our chef, Kay, made it so much fun. We did the evening class. DO NOT eat before - there is so much lovely food. Excited to cook some authentic Thai dishes at home.

reviews.name: Kim Rhindress
reviews.text:
Excellent experience for my husband and I. Prompt hotel pickup in an air conditioned van. Our guide Julie was engaging, informative and funny!
The market stop enroute was interesting and the prices among the cheapest we have seen in Thailand.
The school is very professionally laid out with 12 people per group and 4 groups rotating. We all had our own cooking station.
The organic farm garden is beautiful and all of the plants are thriving - so good to see where so many of these ingredients come from.
We cooked pad Thai, green and red curry, Tom Yum soup and spring rolls from scratch.
Everything was delicious and we were emailed the recipes. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Damian Tapley
reviews.text:
The half-day class is such a well-organised and enriching outing. One of the highlights of my travels in Thailand so far. Our guide Lily is a beast - beyond excellent at what she does.

The market stop is a lot more informative than I thought it would be. The drive to the farm is quite picturesque and relaxing. The farm itself is great. They have turtles and peacocks there, and dozens of herbs which we got a little tour of, where you smell and taste things like Thai ginger, lemongrass, holy basil, ginseng, and plenty more.

The cooking itself is done in a way where you learn a lot yet it’s quite hard to get it wrong. I was amazed how we were able to make all the dishes we chose *from the ground up* in that time. It’s fascinating making the curry paste, seeing the herbs transform into flavours that are so recognisable.

…and then you eat it all!!

I was lucky to have such a nice group. But the other groups seemed nice too. I think it’s just a great activity. I was super happy with the price as well. A highly recommended activity.

reviews.name: Skip Hodges
reviews.text: I did the full day course, and it was great!  We cooked 5 dishes (plus a couple of extras). Our teacher, Smile, was really nice and friendly. She really knows her stuff and cares that we had a good experience. We ate what we cooked and tried each other’s dishes. Amazing food!  I was so full that i needed a nap, and still had a whole dish to take away. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Ali Alamri
reviews.text:
Jo wad the master chief we had in our group. I learned green curry pad Thai, spring rolls, and Tom Yum soup.
The half day lesson is recommended as there is not much else to do after.
The garden is beautiful. The place is hygienic with multiple hand wash stations. Food was the best I ate in Thailand I guess the reason was the fresh organic ingredients we used.
Thank you Jo & Smile Farm team

reviews.name: HsuanMin Lin
reviews.text: Natalie kept mentioning that she was tired and hardly smiled; it felt like she was just going through the motions (following the SOP). She would even yell if a student made a mistake. I felt that the experience that day created quite a bit of stress for everyone 😅. Apart from the instructor's personal issues, the overall process was very smooth, and the participants were so warm and friendly. I believe the entire experience was largely affected by the cooking instructor that day, and for me, it was disappointing.

reviews.name: Kavita Krishnaswamy
reviews.text: Lovely experience learning thai cooking . Our instructor Lily was charming, funny and made the whole experience a great one for the entire family. We are vegans and the team was able to customise the cooking to our needs as well. All in all a great experience and highly recommend doing this on your trip to Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Meier Lucie
reviews.text:
We had a great time and cooked delicious food in the half day cooking class. Smile was super fun and gave us great tips to replicate those dishes at home. Small advice though: come hungry! You’ll have a lot of delicious food to eat!
#teamsmile

reviews.name: Sally Walsh
reviews.text:
I have travelled the world & always considered a cooking class but never done one. My partner & I booked this class for less than $50 on Viator & it’s been one of the best things I’ve done.
You are collected & dropped off from your hotel, the ride is half hour from Chang  Mai but you stop at a market on the way so they can educate you on veg.
Once there we were greeted by 2 pugs which made my day as I have a puff back home.
Our cooking g guide was Smile & she was a big personality with lots to tell & wasn’t scared to tell those who were holding you up to get moving (in a good way). We started with Smile makings the inside of spring rolls & then we learnt to roll them.
From there we choose what we want to learn & our group of 12 broke up individually & you cook your own dish.
We were on a half day so made the spring roll, curry, soup noodles.
Value for money this is a no brainer. Not for kids, someone brought along a 5yr old but it wasn’t the best for the kid, parent or operator.
You should totally book, I love what I cooked.
Very hygienic, very fast to come past & clean everything, it was like having a cleaning genie.
We had a guided walk through the farm herb garden & Smile spoke us through what we would be using.
We all sat on a mat later to make our own curry paste in a team. Bloody hard work lol but wow it was worth it!
For the money make the time this is a great way to spend half a day.

reviews.name: Thomas Ho
reviews.text:
What an amazing cooking class. I loved this experience. I had a great cooking group with great atmosphere and vibes but I had the best guide/cook called Mimi who taught us and had great humour

Highly recommend this cooking class, most affordable too at 800 BHT for morning half day course

#teammimi

reviews.name: Denise H
reviews.text: Me and my friend did the half morning cooking class and was really really amazing. The whole experience was very pleasant and the crew were awesome. Special thanks to our teacher Tay who was very fun and kind with everyone besides her excellent and professional way to share her knowledge the Thai cooking and culture. And the Smile Organic Farm is such a wonderful place. Totally recommend it! :)

reviews.name: naim joubran
reviews.text:
We signed up for this class but we were picked up by another cooking school. When we found out and called our instructor, they waited for us at the local market and then we headed to the school.
Our instructor Julie was funny and informative at all times and explained everything to us.
We even took a small tour in the farm behind the school.
We cooked many items from scratch each on his own station.
It was a pleasant experience that i recommend for everyone.

reviews.name: Anne Victoria
reviews.text: Natalie was our instructor and so knowledgeable and nice. We had a tour to the market, and then around the organic garden. All of our dishes were so delicious and the team was so fun! I would recommend to everyone that is interested in Thai cooking to come here for a day, especially good for a rainy day!!

reviews.name: Théo Furst
reviews.text:
Really nice half-day experience! We started by a tour in a local market in order to better understand what are the popular products in Northern Thailand. We then get to see the local garden along with some interesting explanations!

Then the cooking begins! Very nice group atmosphere and very funny staff! Everyone has a cooking station and you get to choose a few dishes you want to prepare. Really nice! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Kimberly Quesenberry
reviews.text: Went to this cooking class today January  4th, 2024 with #anya as our chef, leader, friend and cheerleader. Do come hungry for the half or full day cause your gonna be eating several full size courses. We got picked up at our accommodation and then We went together as a group to the local market. We received instructions on what to get and where to find it in the market. Then, straight to the cooking school and directly outside to the gorgeous, organic garden for some plant identification. #Anya, our leader, was fantastic. She spoke English super well so you do not have to worry that you might not understand. She explained so that everyone knew exactly what to do. We were assigned cooking stations and pretty much went after it. We got to choose what dishes and sauces we each wanted to make. You'll learn about all that but i will tell you what I chose.  First I made a spring roll, then cashew chicken, then curry paste, coconut milk based chicken soup, papaya salad, hibiscus tea, and mango sticky rice. It was a lot of delicious food and a lot of information covered. This is a hands on class! You will be dicing and chopping and stirring and sauteeing, then boiling and simmering and crushing and squishing with a mortal and pestal. So much fun! You will learn so much and get to prepare so many dishes in either class. #anya is super , if you can get her. I highly recommend Smiles and #Anya !

Very disappointing experience. I won’t be coming back.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We sincerely apologize for the unpleasant experience you encountered during your visit.

​Regarding the room temperature, we deeply regret the discomfort caused. Our air conditioning had just been switched on shortly before your session, which unfortunately resulted in the room being warmer than usual. We are also actively addressing your concerns regarding cleanliness and staff service to ensure our standards are strictly maintained.

​Please note that Traditional Thai Massage involves deep tissue pressure and stretching, which can often feel intense or lead to temporary soreness. If you prefer a gentler and more soothing experience, we warmly recommend trying our Aromatherapy Massage on your next visit.

​We truly regret that your experience fell short of your expectations, and we hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a much better service in the future.

ummm I booked a hot stone massage through the app because that’s exactly how the service is listed. During the massage I realized it didn’t feel like a hot stone treatment and asked twice to confirm. I was told it was, but it turned out to only be a hot compress.
After the session I was told that the real hot stone massage requires booking a different service and paying extra. This was never clear in the listing. As a customer, I booked exactly what was written.
Being told afterward that I should book something else next time doesn’t make sense when the service is already labeled “hot stone massage.” The menu and app listing should be corrected so customers know what they are actually paying for.

reviews.name: Zixuan Zhao
reviews.text:
Money Muay Thai Gym is hands-down the best Muay Thai gym I’ve trained at — and the reason is simple: they actually teach.

A lot of gyms fall into the trap of endless, mindless repetitions where you’re just copying movements until you’re tired, without really understanding what you’re doing. Money is the complete opposite. The trainers pay close attention to how you move and why you’re doing it that way. They don’t just call out combinations and walk away — they actively watch, step in, and correct your stance, balance, guard, hips, timing, and technique until it feels right. You can tell they genuinely care about your progress, not just getting you through a workout.

Fair warning: the warm-up is brutal. It’s seriously taxing and will test you right away. But once you push through that, the session becomes all about sharpening your actions and building real muscle memory. The focus is on fine-tuning technique and making your combos clean, efficient, and repeatable — not just throwing strikes for the sake of it.

One of the biggest highlights was how welcoming they were, even as beginners. They even let me and my friend spar in the ring while we were still super green — and what made it special was that the trainer didn’t just “let it happen.” He stepped in throughout and coached us as we went, correcting mistakes in real time and helping us understand what to do differently on the next exchange. That kind of attention is rare.

I’ve trained at three different Muay Thai gyms, and Money stands out by a mile. The amount of feedback and personal guidance you get is honestly amazing. If you want to improve your technique properly — not just sweat and repeat — this is the gym.

reviews.name: Gracjan

reviews.name: Shea Smith
reviews.text: This was the best experience I’ve had training in Thailand. The instructors were attentive and helpful, even taking plenty of time after class to answer questions in great detail. If you’re looking for a place to train in Chiang Mai this is it. Thank you!

reviews.name: 김규철
reviews.text:
Do you already have experience in combat sports and are looking for more serious training? This is the best place.
Are you completely new to martial arts? This is the best place.
Are you visiting Thailand and simply want to create a memorable Muay Thai experience? This is the best place.

The session begins with a light warm-up and free work on the heavy bags. It feels like a deliberate period for the coaches to carefully assess each participant’s level. I come from a boxing background and was new to Muay Thai, and the coach quickly picked this up and asked a few simple questions.

From there, the class naturally splits into level-based groups. Casual visitors start with the fundamentals, while experienced trainees move on to more detailed and technical skill drills.

If you are lucky and the group is small with compatible skill levels, the training can even extend to light sparring.

The coaches are very mindful of ensuring that every participant completes an appropriate amount of training. They are also kind, attentive, and genuinely friendly.

I enjoyed the experience so much that I signed up multiple times, and eventually even bought a T-shirt because I wanted to support them and stay connected.

This is easily one of the best places I experienced during my time in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: LEO.C
reviews.text:
Perfect night !
Highly recommend everyone to come and try their group Muay Thai classes!

reviews.name: Andrei Stoian
reviews.text:
This is my experience after 3 sessions:

Very friendly Kru's, intensive training that will take you to your limit, even if you're already somewhat fit.
If you're just starting out, let the trainers know, you can sit some rounds out. But the intensity itself is part of the culture here, so be prepared for that especially in group classes.

Training starts with a lot of running and dynamic drills, physical exercise then heavy pad work for 3 rounds of 4 minutes.  Between rounds you can take a break for 5-10 minutes, which makes it manageable given how hard the rounds themselves are.

Sometimes the more advanced trainees do light sparring at the end, beginners focus on technique in the mirror.

Overall a good experience, lighthearted athmosphere.

-Mamuang

reviews.text: Great boxing gym near Nimman Road! The space is open and clean, and the equipment is well-maintained. Coach Money is outstanding — professional, experienced, and able to teach in Chinese, English, and Thai. He pays close attention to details and corrects techniques throughout the class. I’ve been training with him for a long time; he’s strict, but that’s exactly what makes the training so valuable. Highly recommended! 👍😊

reviews.name: Anthony Gray
reviews.text:
Siripanna!

Checking in was a little stressful considering this is marketed as a health and wellness retreat. The car park at the front is super small and can be difficult to manoeuvre in. The check-in desk only really has enough space for one person or couple at a time, despite there being two staff members on duty, so the process can feel quite slow. We were also unfortunate enough to have another guest cut in front of us while we were waiting.

That said, the reception staff handled everything professionally and seemed to be working very hard despite being extremely busy with paperwork and arrivals. They were also very accommodating. Initially, we were told we had received a complimentary upgrade from the Loft room to the Lanna Hotel section. However, after seeing the room, we requested to switch back to the Loft and the staff were happy to arrange it. In our opinion, the Loft feels much more modern and vibrant, while the Lanna rooms have a more traditional style and feel a little dated, although both were comfortable.

The room itself was pleasant. There were a few slightly dusty corners, but nothing significant enough to affect our stay. The bed was exceptionally comfortable and provided a great night's sleep.

The gym was probably the weakest part of the property. It's quite old, hot, and has a noticeable smell, so it's not the most enjoyable place to work out. However, it does have the basic equipment needed for a simple session.

The grounds are beautiful and one of the highlights of the resort. They're perfect for a leisurely walk and taking photos. There are also plenty of friendly stray cats wandering around, which is a nice touch if you're a cat lover. Pools around the hotel are good but get leaves and feathers in them easily, still good for a swim.

Happy Hour runs from 3–6pm, although you need to order two of the same cocktail (for example, two mojitos). Even with the promotion, the drinks felt expensive compared to prices in central Chiang Mai. Unfortunately, the cocktails themselves weren't particularly impressive, so I wouldn't recommend spending too much money on them.

We didn't get the opportunity to try the spa as we were only staying for one night. The standard foot massage was around 950 THB, although there appeared to be an early-bird promotion offering buy-one-get-one-free treatments, which could be worthwhile if you can make use of it.

Breakfast was excellent and offered plenty of variety. I'd definitely recommend including breakfast with your room as it provides some of the best value at the resort. As an Englishman, I was especially pleased to find beans and toast among the options.

The rice barn area at the back looks lovely, and there's also a small café that appeared to offer more reasonably priced food, although we didn't have time to visit.

Overall, the staff were friendly, the grounds were beautiful, and the beds were incredibly comfortable, which made for an enjoyable stay. That said, as residents of Chiang Mai, we're unlikely to return. While we had a pleasant experience, it wasn't quite special enough to leave us feeling that we absolutely had to come back.

reviews.text:
For context I am not a 5star gal - I can be easily pleased.

Overall it needs updating and some tender loving care! Old doesn’t have to be dank and musty. The rooms albeit large felt dark and moldy.
We wanted quiet and it felt like the couple beside us was with us (paper thin walls on first floor).
- Plunge pool not private you see your neighbour and the mosquitos chase you away anyway so we couldn’t use it.
-Staff were transactional and at times friendly. They were fairly responsive when you call for something (within minutes for water one time, another time we waited 15 minutes).
- Bed hard as a rock, pillows flattened and/or hard.
- Shower some mould and water temp varied every shower we took from chilled to burning hot. Quite unpleasant!
- Mosquitos were very bad when we arrived then they sprayed and felt a world of difference. Sadly the spray was 330p on Friday - optimal pool time.
- Everything additional is over priced. Buffet for breakfast has everything but it’s over priced considering we can go to market for under $100 baht and get amazing fresh meat, chicken porridge and sticky rice.
- Use grab from airport (for context it was $25 Canadian on Wed night night hotel pick up versus $7 Sunday morning via grab)
- Pool ok - it was clean for us, some nice sun early (11am-2pm) but the green towels are awful, shredded and holes in them…sad.

For what we are paying it seems misaligned and unfortunate. They could really take the bones and make it charming again. Freshen it up with a little paint on the exterior, fresh linens and new towels, and make it feel a little nicer with better lighting.

reviews.name: Gunjan Puri
reviews.text:
0/5 — Siripanna Resort Chiang Mai: A Hospitality Horror Show

If there were a Hall of Fame for Hospitality Disasters, Siripanna Resort would be the poster child. I wish I were being dramatic, but no — this place delivered a full-blown lizard-to-the-face experience. Literally.

I opened the tea kettle expecting, you know… water. Instead, a full lizard popped out like it was auditioning for Mission Impossible and launched itself onto my face. If I wanted wildlife encounters, I’d have booked a jungle trek, not a “resort.”

And the service? Imagine sending a request into a corporate void where time stands still. You could grow old, retire, and watch your legacy mature before they show up. Absolutely unacceptable response times.

The pool? Oh, that swampy situation deserves its own operational risk audit. Insects floating like garnish, murky water, and mosquitoes thriving as if the resort had pivoted to becoming an official breeding center. I half-expected WHO to show up with hazard suits.

To top it off, the place has the audacity — the strategic misalignment — to charge premium prices for substandard, downright shabby service standards. Talk about negative ROI.

Bottom line: Overpriced, underperforming, and genuinely unsafe. If you value your sanity — and your face — please deploy your travel budget elsewhere.

Sometimes when you see nothing but 5 star reviews, you get suspicious and wonder if people are getting rewarded for favorable reviews. But in this case, this is a wonderful and fun filled adventure that really teaches participants about cooking Thai cuisine. Of course much of that is due to Benny’s wonderful and corny personality. “Sexy Benny” is anything but and really shows you cooking methods and techniques.

First up, the market visit is really important as she purchases many items for the group to taste and discusses them from a cultural perspective. So you learn from a local about markets, produce, fruits and vegetables.

Secondly, the cooking class is substantial and you cook four different items and your partner can choose different dishes as well. You learn to use multiple mortar and pestle in making curries and flavors. You’ll use a wok as well as making a broth and a dessert as well. It’s extremely well organized but more importantly the class size of up to 8 means great individual attention compared to other schools with 20 or 30 students at a time.

The value and quality of this school is excellent and is highly recommended!!!!

The taste is delicious, just the right amount of sweetness, not too sweet. The place is clean and private. Teacher Nam Sup was a great teacher, so much fun! 🥰🩷

reviews.name: FHAJA
reviews.text: เรียนแล้วสนุกมากค่ะ ได้ความรู้ดี ได้ชิมรสชาติต่างๆ ชอบเมนูมะนาวปั่นมากค่ะ แถมได้ทริคดีๆอีกเยอะเลย ได้สูตรเมนูกลับบ้านด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The class was so much fun! I learned a lot and got to taste different flavors. I especially loved the lime smoothie. Plus, I learned lots of great tips and even got some recipes to take home.

reviews.name: Apichai Chantana
reviews.text: ใครที่ต้องการเปิดร้านขายน้ำผลไม้อยากให้มีโอกาสมาเรียนเพราะเราจะได้รู้อะไรมากมาย ที่นี่เขาได้ทดลองหลายสิ่งหลายอย่างมสให้เราแล้ว เราไม่ต้องไปเสียเวลาศึกษาเอง ผู้สอนสอนได้อย่างละเอียดและมีความเป็นกันเองมาก อุปกรณ์ทุกอย่างพร้อม เรียนไปชิมไปมีความสุขและได้ความรู้กลับไปเปิดร้านของตัวเอง
reviews.textTranslated: Anyone who wants to open a juice bar should consider taking this course because you'll learn so much. They've already done a lot of testing and prepared everything for you, so you don't have to waste time researching on your own. The instructors are very detailed and friendly. All the equipment is provided. You'll enjoy learning and tasting, and gain valuable knowledge to open your own shop.

reviews.name: Yssp n

reviews.textTranslated: Today I got to learn how to make fruit smoothies. I learned all the details and tips on how to blend them smoothly and deliciously. I loved it! The taste was great, and the instructor was lovely. I learned so much! 🥰

reviews.name: Lek 2442
reviews.text: เรียนทำน้ำผลไม้ปั่นที่เทรนนิ่งเฟรช รสชาติอร่อย ถูกปาก ขายดีแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Learn how to make fruit smoothies at Training Fresh. They taste delicious and are sure to sell well.

reviews.name: Napaphat Pensangon
reviews.text: เรียนทำน้ำสมุนไพรบรรจุขวดค่ะ วันนี้ได้ความรู้และสูตรในการต้มน้ำสมุนไพรหลายอย่างเลยค่ะชอบทุกรสชาดเลยค่ะเพราะสามารถดึงจุดเด่นของน้ำสมุนไพรแต่ละอย่างออกมาได้อย่างลงตัวมากๆเลยค่ะ และครูผู้สอนใจดีสอนเข้าใจและน่ารักมากค่ะไว้จะมาเรียนคอร์สอื่นๆเพื่มแน่นอนค่ัะ
reviews.textTranslated: I learned how to make bottled herbal drinks. Today I gained knowledge and recipes for brewing many different herbal drinks. I liked all the flavors because they were able to bring out the unique characteristics of each herb perfectly. The instructor was kind, easy to understand, and very lovely. I will definitely come back to take other courses.

reviews.name: Soranut Soisang
reviews.text: วันนี้เทรนนิ่งเฟรชผมได้มาเรียนการทำชาไข่มุข ที่รู้สึกประทับใจมากเลยครับ ได้เรียนรู้วิธีการทำชาที่เข้าใจง่ายผ่านอาจารย์ผู้สอนที่น่ารัก รวมถึงเมนูใหม่ๆ จากสถาบัน เเละผมสามารถนำไปต่อยอดและประยุกต์ใช้ในการเปิดร้านได้เลยครับ
reviews.textTranslated: Today's fresh training session taught me how to make bubble tea, and I was very impressed. I learned how to make tea in an easy-to-understand way from a lovely instructor, and also learned new menu items from the institute. I can definitely use this knowledge to expand my skills and open my own shop.

reviews.name: พัทธนันท์ สันติจารีย์
