title: Smile Organic Farm Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Smile Organic Farm Cooking School Chiang Mai, we offer guests the opportunity to learn and practice skills and knowledge necessary to prepare delicious, healthy Thai food. We teach you how to be creative and understand the basic of cooking Thai food as we don’t have a fixed menu for you, you cook what you wish to cook.

At Smile Organic Farm, we don’t teach you only how to cook Thai food. Our school is set in a beautiful, serene organic farm and garden, you will learn how to grow vegetables and taste herbs in our own garden, as well as cooking and enjoy your food in a relaxing atmosphere.
address: 165, On Nuea, Mae On District, Chiang Mai 50130, Thailand
plusCode: Q7Q3+VC Ban Sa Ha Khon, Mae On District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: darya tennyson
reviews.text: Experience was quite nice I have no complaints, we did a half day class which started with a market tour before heading to the farm where you are able to smell and taste ingredients and look at the farms. You chooses one curry, one stir fry, and one soup. I chose paanaeng, pad tai, and hot a sour soup; all were quite delicious however we are all very full. All children had fun as well I would recommend if you like cooking classes/tours or have many people with which you want some kind of activity. The tortises were named a,b, and c

reviews.name: Mia Carruthers
reviews.text: Thank you Aunty Natty❤️ we had an exciting but relaxing half-day course. We each chose  our own soup, a stir fry and a curry to make. We did not feel rushed and the group environment was perfect. You also get picked up and dropped off to your hotel which made it so easy.

reviews.name: Keith Lawton
reviews.text: We all had a great day with Smile Organic Cooking Farm. Smooth pick-up and drop, easy to follow courses and special shout to ‘Natty’, our fab chef that blended knowledge, patience and passion for Thai cooking and ingredients. Would highly recommend, good value and super memories.

reviews.name: Holly Williams
reviews.text: Natty was so funny, knowledgable and a fantastic teacher. We had such a good time and we got choice in what we ate and she was able to change to account for different dietary needs.

reviews.name: Farley Engelhardt
reviews.text: Had a great experience at the half-day Thai cooking class at the organic farm. Our guide and chef, Luna, did a fantastic job entertaining us throughout the class. We first stopped at the market to pick up ingredients and then visited their garden. Afterwards, we had the chance to cook three delicious dishes of our choice. Overall, it was a really enjoyable and memorable experience!

reviews.name: Calvin Duong (The Goods)
reviews.text:
Attended a half-day cooking course at Smile Organic Farm, and it was an amazing experience! Our teacher, Love, was fantastic and really made the class enjoyable. With a group of just 12 people, the size felt perfect, allowing Love to give everyone the attention we needed while we prepared four delicious dishes.

The set menu offered some flexibility in choosing which dishes to curate, and it was great to learn various cooking techniques using a wok and mortar. We also explored ingredients commonly used in Thai cuisine, which was a nice addition to our culinary skills. Overall, highly recommend this cooking school for anyone looking to enhance their cooking abilities in a fun and engaging environment!

reviews.name: Emily
reviews.text: Did the half-day evening cooking class and absolutely loved it! The experience is so personalised as you can select which dishes to cook for each course. The food was delicious, but expect to have a lot of leftovers!

reviews.name: Peter Beebe
reviews.text: Did the half day afternoon class with Luna - had the best time! She was educational and engaging throughout the entire day. Best tour/class I’ve ever done. Plenty of food and definitely a great value. Also really enjoyed getting to see the garden with herbs and plants used in the recipes. Would love to come back again for the full day!

reviews.name: Ofri Leberman
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience! The food was great, the farm is lovely and the guide, love, was so kind, patient, knowledgeable and professional. We loved it!

reviews.name: L d
reviews.text: We had a great time cooking with Natalie, we made and ate three delicious meals and learnt a lot about the ingredients !

reviews.name: Julina S.
reviews.text: Amazing experience, we loved it. We did the half day cooking class in the afternoon and it was so funny, informative and of course so yummy. They even give the opportunity to do vegan meals. Lizzy our guide was so nice and everything was well organized with a nice structure and no stress at all. Also the garden and scenery is beautiful and you have the opportunity explore it on your own while the staff is preparing each cooking place.

reviews.name: Svenja Meyn
reviews.text: My friend and I did the half day cooking class and we loved it. It was great that everyone could choose their own dishes to cook including vegetarian options. The equipment was perfect and we were impressed by how well everyone in the 10 person group got their instructions at the right time.

reviews.name: Krishnadev Jothydev
reviews.text: I highly recommend this farm to anyone looking for a homely, delightful, and satisfying cooking experience with exceptional Thai food. It’s located about 30 km from the city center. The package includes a vehicle that takes you there after a stop at a local market, where you can explore colorful Thai sweets and fruits. The cooking space is beautifully arranged, and the chefs are skilled and fluent in English. The facilities include clean and well-maintained toilets. One highlight was the unlimited supply of chilled water. You get to choose and cook a soup, a curry, and a main dish. Our chef, Lizzy, was lovely and lively. This is a must-try experience!

reviews.name: Jonathan Gilde
reviews.text:
Really loved our cooking class with Natalie!

They were very communicative right up front as they picked us up in a nice van. We stopped by a market to learn about the ingredients and then went to the class.

You get do everything, but your teacher is also there to guide you every step of the way. The food came out great! Don't eat beforehand though since you'll be eating a good bit.

reviews.name: Inbar Nissim
reviews.text: Hear me out when I say this was the BEST experience ever! Everything about this cooking school was incredible. We took the evening class and first went to a local market tour where they explain about the ingredients you’ll use. Then we headed to the most beautiful farm! Got explanation about the plants and the farm and got to smell and taste. Then Lily (who’s the best teacher ever) showed us step by step how to make everything by ourselves and was so kind and explaining and so funny. Thank you Lily! Honestly this was the best experience ever and so professional. Worth every second. First thing I’m cooking just doing what she explained next thing I know I made pad Thai! What! Haha. Really. Awesome day and I’m very thankful. Everyone seems great here but if you can ask for Lily! Also mentioning you have a big variety of thai dishes you can make, Just choose your taste!

reviews.name: Thom Zalm
reviews.text: We had an amazing Thai cooking class here. Everybody is so nice. Highly recommend thus if you are looking to do a Thai cooking class in chiang mai. We could choose out of several popular dishes, walked through their fresh garden and cooked with the fresh ingredients.

reviews.name: Joe Heavey
reviews.text: Attended a half day cooking class and it did not disappoint! Cici was flawless from start to finish - very attentive, kind, and a talented teacher. If you’re visiting Chiang Mai and want to learn how to cook some amazing Thai dishes, definitely visit Smile Organic Farm Cooking School - can’t recommend this place enough! Thank you Team Smile for everything we had the best time❤️

reviews.name: Jorge C
reviews.text: This class was a highlight of our recent trip to Chiang Mai. The class was well organized and informative. It was nice to visit the market and pick fresh from the on site garden. Lizzie was such a treat to have as a teacher, she was one of the funniest people i’ve ever met.

reviews.name: Rabi Gmz
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at smile cooking class and with Cici, who guided us through a hands-on Thai cooking class filled with delicious recipes and authentic flavors. She also took us to the local market and guided us through the ingredients. Her passion and knowledge made the session both fun and informative. The dishes turned out incredibly tasty. If you’re looking to learn Thai cookinh in an enjoyable and welcoming environment, I highly recommend this class!

reviews.name: Ashley Brown
reviews.text: Amazing half day cooking class. Number one recommendation would be to skip breakfast. You get a lot of food. We had Lily as our instructor and she was fantastic. Everyone gets to choose their own curry, soup and noodle dish so the ability to manage everyone during this process at the same time is very impressive. The venue is lovely and clean and the tour of the markets and organic garden on site is really interesting. Food is delicious!!!

title: Chef Non

reviews.name: Khant Soe Naung
reviews.text: We’ve visited this place several times now, and it never disappoints. The crab omelet is packed with flavor, and the seafood pad krapao is absolutely delicious. We always end up ordering the same two dishes because they’re just that good! Great taste, generous portions, and definitely a place we’ll keep coming back to.

reviews.name: L
reviews.text: Really good and affordable food. Squid with sauted egg is my favourite. Recommended.

reviews.name: YinBen Lee
reviews.text: Like the restaurant environment with green plants, food is good, food i order is shrimp omelette, black pepper seafood with rice, chilli paste chicken with rice. With aircond room. Food Suitable for foreigners as well.

reviews.name: Take ทาเค
reviews.text:
The crab fried rice here is really delicious. And it's quite reasonable so it's worth a try once.

Please be careful of their business hours. They normally close at 17:00.

reviewContext.Parking: You can park on the street in front of the restaurant.

reviews.name: Brian Defayette
reviews.text: This is a very hidden 💎 gem, it is set in garden setting with a lot of greenery and has plenty of comfortable seating and the Thai food is excellent, service speedy and food was hot and well presented. A friend and I, had Black pepper chicken with rice, spicy pork salad 🥗 😋,  fried rice with crab, all excellent 👌 😋  , definitely will dine here again .

reviews.name: Menno de Ruiter
reviews.text: The fried rice with crab was really good & the squid eggs are a big plus. Overal it was a good meal, great atmosphere and quick service. Was it mindblowing? Not for me, but defenitly worth a visit.

reviews.name: David Matthews
reviews.text: Relaxing and shady outdoor atmosphere. Chef created menu of traditional Thai ingredients with a twist. Very affordable with prompt service. No alcohol served on premises.

reviews.name: Tarzx Shzep
reviews.text:
Fried rice is very good! Crispy seafood is the best.
Table is outdoor, so it’s a bit hot and there’re some bug.

reviews.name: ST
reviews.text: Very good dishes. Delicious, quick, quality ingredients and very good price. A must-try restaurant.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Fried Rice with Crap, Crab Meat Omelette, Egg Noodle with Pork

reviews.name: wasant s
reviews.text: Fast serving, tasty dishes, green and breezy. Good price.

reviews.name: Mike H
reviews.text:
Updated 30May2019: there's a small aircon room with 4 tables to escape the heat! WiFi is fast.

Original: This is a good find. A bit out of town, near int'l convention center, no aircon, seating in garden. Easy street parking just in front. Value for $ Thai food, taste the freshness, enjoy the portion sizes!

reviews.name: MasterPeach Brand
reviews.text:
Finally, I found the best fried rice with crab meat in Chiangmai. The rice is not overcooked and it has little smoky smell. Although, the rice is not covered by egg york 100%, this dish is still simply the best in town.
Other menus (fried noodle and omelet) are so so to me so I took 1 star back.

reviews.name: Maggie Tian
reviews.text: We’ve been here for several times, the crab omelet and krapao seafood is very good, always order the same thing!!!

reviews.name: Nam Supani
reviews.text: For me, good fried rice should have a bit smoky taste when you eat. I couldn’t find it from this restaurant ‘s fried rice and even in Guaytiao Kua Gai . The rice was cooked perfectly for making fried rice but it turned out bland and no smoky taste when it became fried rice as mentioned.

reviews.name: Frontier Patron
reviews.text: Simply amazing and got surprised at the very first taste, the food is fantastic good, too good so the only thing we could do was just eating

reviews.name: Polo
reviews.text:
Spectacular food. I eat Thai food often, hard to see how this is so much more delicious 😋

Outdoor rustic seating
Fans and misters

Staff is very friendly

reviews.name: Anastasia Cagle
reviews.text: We love this place and probably go once a week! It’s very delish and priced well! They have menus in English and Thai. I will take a photo of the English the next time I go.

reviews.name: Jonky Dawson
reviews.text: Outside seating but does have a small air con room too.  Fastest service In record.  Food was very flavorful and spicy good.  Liked it!

reviews.name: Tris Lim
reviews.text: very local and love the fried rice! if you are fried rice lover … should try this place.

reviews.name: Stéphane Busso
reviews.text: Affordable traditional Thai food. Popular for  Thai basil dishes. Can be busy at lunch time but service is usually pretty fast.

title: Sipolle Italian Food by Chef Dan
subTitle: Sipolle By Chef Dan
address: ช้างเผือก 116/99 เมือง Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: RXC2+9C Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Trace
reviews.text: Like the atmosphere so much. Food are good but only some dishes, service is average

reviews.name: L H GOH
reviews.text:
Came here without checking any reviews or recommendations and simply trusted our instinct. Glad we did.

The tomahawk was the highlight. We requested it medium, and while some parts were closer to medium rare and others slightly more done, it suited everyone’s preference at the table. Tender, juicy, and full of flavour.

The tiramisu was also excellent when we buy our own alcohol to add on and a perfect way to end the meal. Overall, a very enjoyable dining experience. We’ll be back.

reviews.name: Adeline Ng
reviews.text:
Went for dinner at 5:30 pm. We decided to sit by the wine bar instead of the dining room, which is across from the car park, but in the same vicinity. Landscaping was beautiful as you can see. Went to the dining room to take some pics and video and staffs were friendly and warm to welcome.

Nase hosted us at the Wine bar with warmth and with great smile.
And yes, food will have to be brought across the carpark from the main dining room.

So they did bring everything all at once be sure to order a few dishes at a time as understandable that doesn’t make sense for them to serve you appetiser all across the car park and then dish by dish and so on and so on…
Great selection of wine that you can pick from the wall.
I would say prices for beverage/wine are quite affordable and reasonable. A place that I would definitely visit whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Really really warm and cosy with great hospitality from the staff Nase.🤩

reviews.name: Keith Moore
reviews.text:
Sipolle is an excellent example of quality Italian food in Chiang Mai.  It's out of the way, but the trip is worth it.

The food is excellent.  We started with the burrata and parma ham.  The cheese was terrific, but a few slices of the ham were a bit too thick.  Still, it was good value.  The fresh lobster was the highlight of the evening, and while it was expensive, the dish was big enough to share.  And the lobster was excellent.  We also had the seafood risotto, which was very good, with generous portions of seafood.  The chocolate lava cake for dessert was almost too much... but we struggled through it :).

Prices were expensive, but good value for a special occasion.  The prices are modest if you stay on the 'regular' menu.

The service is excellent, and the staff is well-trained and ready to look after you.  The head waiter makes his rounds unobtrusively and ensures everything is running smoothly.

The atmosphere was okay, but no drapes or sound baffles were around, so the space was a bit echoey.  The music was pleasant but a bit too soft for the space.  Also, the lighting could use some improvement.  It was too harsh for the high-quality space the restaurant was going for.

Finally, the wine list is excellent. If you want a red, there is a wide range on offer. However, the white wine offerings are minimal. I'd like to see a few premium whites on offer.

Still, Sipolle is an excellent find for us, and we will build it into our regular rotation of local restaurants.

reviews.text:
You can find best Risotto in Chiangmai here !

Never worry about ordering food here, every dish gonna be good and I highly Recommend to try the risotto! I love it so much.

The restaurant set it a little inconvenient location cause it a bit out of CM town but the food will make you forget about it. Worth every penny.
Staff are nice, everything is neat and clean.

It’s a must !

reviews.text: The service in the restaurant is not bad.  The decor fits well with the whole estate, but not so much as an Italian restaurant.  As far as the restaurant itself is concerned, there is nothing amazing about the food.  But if it is part of a leisure club, it is acceptable to provide quality club meals.  If you are staying at this manor or have other leisure activities to eat here, I think it is ok; if you are just looking for a delicious restaurant, I can only say lower your expectations, maybe you will have a different experience.

reviews.name: anucha watcharapasorn
reviews.text: The food tastes great. Spaghetti with crab meat, cherry tomatoes, and rockets is a nice combination which gives quite a flavor. Mushroom soup is also good and comes with bread. Chocolate lava cake is soft and sweetness is just right, and certainly goes well with vanilla ice cream. Quite cozy atmosphere. Parking space is available.

reviews.name: Vivianne
reviews.text: Great food here. They did it in a real Italian way which is really nice as it is quite rare to find proper Italian food in Chiang Mai. A complementary to the chef 🙏☺️ We came here for 3 course lunch and it was a lovely experience. Will come again 🥂

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Grilled Rib-Eye in Pepper Sauce, Homemade Black Ink Tagliolini in Roasted, Parma Ham & Melon, Beef Carpaccio, Stir Fry Potato & Spinach

reviews.name: Greg Alexander
reviews.text: Thank you Sipolle for providing our family with a wonderful Sunday evening night together. We came early as you open at 5pm and enjoyed several appetizers before our main meal.The crab salad is a favorite of my son. The caesar salad was my starter although it came on the other end of our meal ? I am fine with that yet salads always come first or no later than after finishing appetizers. The garlic cheese toast was great and 6 pcs is a more than ample serving . We shared several pasta dishes, a pizza for my grandson,  a trio of well prepared lamb chops complemented nicely with mint jelly and a red wine sauce. My accompaniment of roasted potatoes were fine and I appreciate the server allowing my substitution of more potatoes while dismissing the sauteed spinach. I am certain to be forgetting something yet I hope the photo shares will more than adequately show our meal in its entirety.The environment is clean and with an understated elegance. The service re : correct delivery of what one orders, timely delivery,plate removal, water glass topping off, etc. was fine.I only wish the service staff would engage in a bit of chatter, inquire as to whether we are enjoying our dishes and even suggest appropriate wine pair ups with the meals we ordered. By not doing so Sipolle is leaving a lot of money on the table ? Finally, after 100% satisfaction with every dish we indulged in two desserts and one takeaway. The Lava cake vanished and the remark came " this is the best I have had " from my nearly 8 year old grandson. The apple tarte w/ vanilla was fabulous, fresh, flavorful and warmed . We took away a Tiramisu and it was devoured at home upon arrival. Parking may be ify after dark along the road. The restaurant does not appear to be open at first glance from the outside so it becomes easy to drive by. At the very rear of the restaurant is a refrigerated wine/ champagne case. Red wines do not need refrigeration ? There is a side banquet room/ private party space which may seat 20 or so guests, an ideal place for family, best of friends, co- workers, couples, etc.Thanks once again, there is no question I will be back and of course my son and his bride are regulars coming to Sipolle most every week.

reviews.text: Recommended by a friend for Italian cuisine in Chiangmai. It is local favorite for Italian food. The place is at the front of Merchant villa, which is a bit out of city zone. There is plenty of parking space. The restaurant offers garden view though glass walls, suitable for friends or family gathering. A wide selection of wine to pair with food is also offered here. Staff and service is on par for this kind of place. To be honest, food quality and taste is nothing special.

title: The orchid massage & spa Sathon
ownerDescription:
The Orchid Massage & Spa Sathon offers professional massage and spa treatments in Sathorn, Bangkok. Our services include Thai massage, deep tissue massage, oil massage, aromatherapy massage, foot massage, and relaxing body treatments in a clean and peaceful environment.

Our experienced therapists help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and restore body balance. For guests looking for deep tissue massage in Sathorn, we provide firm, focused pressure for tight muscles and areas of discomfort.

Suitable for office workers, local residents, and travelers. Walk in or book your session today.

reviews.name: Yeojeong Jeong
reviews.text:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but I really wanted to write this one because I truly hope this therapist becomes more well-known. When I come back to Bangkok in the future, I want to be able to find him again.

My husband and I made a reservation together. He chose a traditional Thai massage, and I went for the deep tissue massage. I was treated by the therapist with glasses — and honestly, he is on a completely different level. This was nothing like the typical “tourist-style” massages.

He worked through every joint and muscle in my body, one by one. I walked in feeling stiff like an orangutan and walked out feeling like a bird ready to fly. After just one hour, my body felt unbelievably light and refreshed.

It’s definitely painful, so beginners might be a bit scared — but if you want to go from orangutan to flying bird, a little pain is part of the journey.

If you’re a modern office worker stuck at a desk all day, you know how bad your neck, shoulders, and wrists can get. This massage is honestly next level. I’ve had many massages in Korea, and this one easily ranks among the very best.

The pressure was strong but incredibly precise. You can really feel how focused, sincere, and skilled he is. He doesn’t rush — he truly takes care of your body.

If this shop were in Korea, I would definitely be a regular customer.
I only wish I had found this place earlier in my trip.
Wishing you continued success!

reviews.name: Gradaw
reviews.text:
This gym felt quite commercial and impersonal compared to other gyms where I have trained. At many gyms, coaches greet students when they arrive and create a welcoming environment. At this gym, however, the coaches generally did not acknowledge students when entering, training, or leaving.

When I visited for the first time, it was not clear who I should speak with, where to make payment, or where to store my belongings. There was little guidance or interaction from staff, so I had to figure these things out on my own.

I trained with the same coach for three sessions. Before each session began, the coach did not approach me, so I would typically warm up and stretch on my own and then go find him to let him know that we were scheduled to train together. During my sessions, he did not appear to remember my name, and on one occasion he initially ignored me because he thought he was scheduled to train someone else.

The sessions also tended to end promptly at, or sometimes slightly before, the scheduled end time, and the coach would leave immediately afterward.

Overall, the training itself was decent, but the overall atmosphere felt quite impersonal and lacked the welcoming interaction that I have experienced at other gyms.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your experience with us — we truly appreciate your honest feedback.

We’re sorry that your visit did not feel as clear and welcoming as it should have been, especially for a first session. We’re taking this seriously and will use your feedback to improve how we guide and communicate with our clients moving forward.

We hope to provide you with a better experience in the future.

reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
reviews.text:
During our recent trip, my husband and I decided to indulge in a bit of relaxation and came across ThaiThong ThaiThong Massage. We opted for their Thai Oil Deep Massage, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Each of us took a 1-hour session, priced very reasonably at 500 baht per person, which felt like an absolute steal for the quality of service we received.

From the moment we walked in, the ambiance set the tone for a peaceful and rejuvenating experience. The reception staff was welcoming and professional, creating a calm atmosphere that instantly made us feel comfortable.

I was lucky to have Tad as my massage therapist, and I must say, she was incredible. Her technique was both relaxing and therapeutic – the perfect balance of firm pressure and gentle strokes. It felt like she intuitively knew all the pressure points, and by the end of the session, I felt completely relaxed and recharged. My husband had a similarly positive experience with his therapist, and we both agreed that it was one of the best massages we've ever had.

After our session, we were offered the chance to take a shower, which was a thoughtful touch that added to the overall comfort. Once we were freshened up, the manager personally served us complimentary tea and water, which added a warm, hospitable finish to our visit.

What truly stood out was the professionalism of the entire team. The environment was clean, serene, and, most importantly, entirely genuine. There's nothing shady or questionable about this place, just a top, quality, traditional Thai massage experience delivered with integrity and care.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy a truly authentic massage in a respectful, relaxing environment. We’ll definitely be coming back on our next visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for coming and, Adv! We’re glad both you and your husband enjoyed the massage and felt rejuvenated afterwards 😊 we hope to seeing you again soon 🙏🇹🇭

They both didn’t seem to have had any training and kept pressing hard on the spine with their elbows and then going far to light where the muscles actually needed worked. We walked up four flights of stairs and the entire place just felt ghetto.. no music in the room just sounds of the busy street below. We paid for 90 minutes and they ended about 15 minutes early. You aren’t given anything to cover yourself at all and no other nice extras like tea, cookies or washing your feet to start. We also felt the least respect for privacy in how we were touched but neither person spoke one word of English so it was difficult to express this. We were just glad I had a woman and he had a man (which we requested and thank goodness).

I was nearby and since there are so many different masseurs it was unlikely to get the same person again. Which I didn’t. reviews.name: Melanie Giles
reviews.text:
Mai Thai is my fave local Thai massage in Sathorn. I’ve tried all the other places along the same street as I’ve lived here 26 years, Mai Thai is by far the best!

All the ladies here are deeply skilled in their techniques. Firm, deep strokes - able to unknot tight fascia and bring flow of energy and flexibility back. They are also very aware of what is ok or not ok and you can let them know what to adjust for your own needs and they will listen.

I try to come at least once a week their prices are so reasonable for the quality. My favourite massages here include:

🪷90 mins Thai Balm
(when I’ve been teaching lots of yoga to relieve aching muscles)

🪷90 mins Oil Massage
(when I need to deeply relax and rest I bring my own oil they do provide coconut or scented but I prefer to know my oil is organic)

🪷60-90 mins Foot/Neck/Shoulder/Head Massage
(When I need specific relief in those areas)

🪷90 mins Thai Hot Herbal Compress
(Pure bliss!)

I highly recommend therapists: Amm, Mo, Peung, M. & Petch.

The place itself is simple and nothing fancy but it’s the real deal and their massage chairs are super comfy downstairs.

Enjoy!

We went through the whole massage with giggles and laughs, which suited us so well and you couldn’t help but feel happy in their presence! The massage was strong and perfect. I had a very humiliating experience at this massage salon.

I arrived at the salon at approximately 7:30 PM 16 march. (Today). The owner can verify the situation by checking the security cameras if there are cameras on the second floor.

I had already undressed and was lying on the massage table waiting for the therapist. When the staff member entered, she opened the curtain, saw me and immediately started shouting “ooo” and laughing loudly at my body. Another massage therapist who was working with my friend also joined in the laughter. They were speaking in Thai and laughing while looking at me.

They did not say anything in English, but their reaction made it very clear they were laughing at my body. It was extremely disrespectful, humiliating and unprofessional.

I felt insulted by this behavior and immediately refused the massage and left.

No customer should ever be treated this way. Respect and professionalism are basic standards in any service business.

The quality of the massage was better than the top spas in North America. The place was nice and clean inside. They had two very well behaved cats inside. A cold drink and towel was provided before the massage and hot ginger tea with sweet rice biscuit afterwards.

reviews.name: Hristiana
reviews.text:
The massage was amazing and also for a fair price. The staff is very friendly and mindful 🧘🏻‍♀️. Additionally, we received delicious herbal tea and ate rice cookies for free!
100% recommendable.

reviews.name: Fatima Zhakupzhanova
reviews.text:
One of the best massages I've had in my life! Came back here again after few days. I was searching for the place that offers health massage rather than just a relaxing one.

I loved it, my body felt much better after the deep tissue massage, which later also showed off during the workouts. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Shelley Strzalkowski
reviews.text: I had two foot massages here by two different massage therapists. They were both different but wonderful. Prior to the massage they provide a cool cloth and tea and afterwards they have ginger tea and a biscuit. The place was clean and peaceful.

reviews.name: Alex Andzia
reviews.text:
The best massage place in Chiang Mai 🙏🤍
The owner is very welcoming, friendly and patient, answering all the questions, and trying to find the best options according to your needs. And the therapist doing my massages was the not sweet and very skilled lady, which I’m very grateful for how she treated my body 😌

reviews.name: Eamon Valaei
reviews.text: I did some research on places in Chiang Mai for massage and this place really did meet expectations. As traditional Thai massage is too intense for me, I tried the relaxing 90 minute full body massage. And it was my best experience. The staff are lovely and friendly, I was offered a juice at the beginning which I forgot the name of, however tasted amazing. After the massage I was also offered Mango, sweet/savoury snack and ginger tea. This experience was exactly what I was looking for. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Eamon, for taking the time to share your lovely experience and for supporting our local business!
We are so happy to hear that you had such a wonderful and relaxing time with us. Just to clear up the mystery, the drink you enjoyed at the beginning was Bael fruit juice! 🌿
Your kind words mean so much to our whole team. We look forward to seeing you again next time you're in Chiang Mai!
Best wishes,
Reliever Health massage Team

reviews.name: Ricardo Kim (Ricardo)
reviews.text:
One of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Chiang Mai!
The atmosphere was relaxing, the staff were incredibly kind and professional, was perfect. I felt completely refreshed and stress-free afterward. The place was also very clean and smelled amazing, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. I will definitely come back next time I visit Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: David Cheng
reviews.text:
Reliever demonstrates the high watermark of Thai massage craft in Chiang Mai and are rightly proud of their skills. I went for a two hour Thai massage and have never felt better. Competition in Chiang Mai is tough, but if you’re looking for a proper Thai massage, look no further.

Also the cats are so cute.
Their masseuses attention to their customers,

reviews.name: Ju
reviews.text:
I went there with my wife, 3 stars because my masseuse was very skilled but the other masseuse was not good.

We booked 2 hours and my wife was in pain the all duration because masseuse put pressure on wrong pressure points. We asked for strong massage, it’s supposed to be painful and it was for me but for her it was strong at the wrong pressure points. She endured the all 2 hours in pain, and waited for it to be over. Now a few hours later she is in pain everywhere, it ruined her day.

This shop is higher price than the other shops, I was expecting only high skilled masseuse.

For me it was one of the best massage I had in Thailand and I’ve lived here a few years.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ju,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.
We are truly sorry to hear about your wife’s experience. While we are glad that your own massage was one of the best you’ve had in Thailand, we are deeply concerned and saddened to learn that your wife experienced discomfort and pain during and after her session. This is certainly not the standard of service or care we aim to deliver, especially given the high expectations you placed on us.
We take your feedback regarding therapist skill consistency and pressure point accuracy very seriously. We will immediately review this with our team and reinforce our training standards to ensure that every therapist provides a safe, effective, and comfortable treatment tailored to our guests' needs.
We would love the opportunity to make this right for you and your wife. Please reach out to us directly via message or phone so we can discuss how we can offer proper support and compensation for her experience.
Thank you again for your honest review, as it helps us continuously improve our service.
Warm regards,
RelieverHealth massage.Team

reviews.name: Thu Pham
reviews.text:
Service is excellent. No upsale no asking for tips
All the ladies were so nice and I even had a cat therapy 🥰
Highly recommend 👌

reviews.name: analuxy
reviews.text:
​Highly Recommended! Amazing Professional Massage
​I booked a session via WhatsApp just 10 minutes before walking in because of my neck and back pain. I chose the deep tissue foot and oil body massage. Even though the decor is quite simple, the masseuse was incredibly professional. They hit all the right spots that I mentioned with perfect precision!
​After the session, the herbal tea and snacks were delicious—the mango was so sweet. I 100% recommend this place!

reviews.name: Madeleine Williams
reviews.text: May gave me the most amazing massage I’ve ever had, she was very attentive to my injuries. They gave a cold drink and foot wash beforehand and let you choose which oil you want then tea and a sweet treat after. Really couldn’t have had a better experience and will definitely be back when I visit Chiang Mai again!! Ka Bom 🤍

reviews.name: Kate
reviews.text:
My experience at your massage shop this time was acceptable, but unfortunately my partner received one of the worst massages he has ever had. I have left a one-star review — and would leave zero if I could — due to the lack of communication and the issues that occurred despite me clearly explaining our requirements before the massage began.

Before we started, I spoke directly with the staff on behalf of my partner, as I believed communicating in our own language would make things easier and avoid misunderstandings.

1. Clear instructions were ignored
I informed the staff member who provided my partner’s foot spa that he has a very sensitive spot on his back and that it must be avoided. I also asked for a relaxing massage with firm pressure, not pressure-point work. She was very polite and confirmed everything we requested.

However, she was not the person who ended up doing my partner’s massage. Instead, another masseuse came in later without speaking to or confirming anything with my partner, so we assumed the message had been passed on. It clearly was not.

My partner said the masseuse repeatedly pressed directly on bone and sensitive areas, causing significant pain. It was clear she did not understand or follow the instructions at all.

2. No communication about therapist gender preference
I would also strongly recommend that the manager or owner ask customers whether they prefer a male or female masseuse — just as your staff did on our first visit. This time, no one mentioned it at all, and all the staff we saw in the back area were female, so we did not expect a male masseuse to appear.

If the shop is busy, it is still important to ask for customer consent before assigning therapists.

Why my partner did not speak up:
He tried to be polite and assumed perhaps it was just a different style of Thai massage. He also noticed the shop was very busy and didn’t want to cause inconvenience. We would not give negative feedback unless it was absolutely honest and necessary.

The outcome:
I was extremely disappointed and upset. I was the one who chose this place for our holiday treatment, and I had clearly explained our conditions beforehand. To then see my partner bleeding and with bruising on his back was shocking and unacceptable.

Please take more care with your customers and ensure therapists receive the correct instructions before starting any treatment. Assigning “whoever is available” without communication is unsafe and unprofessional.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
เรียนลูกค้าที่เคารพ
เราขออธิบายเป็นภาษาไทย

      ก่อนอื่นเราต้องขออภัยกับเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้น และขอน้อมรับกับความผิดพลาดในครั้งนี้
 
1.ในกรณีที่เกิดขึ้นเรายอมรับว่าเราผิดพลาดที่ไม่ได้เน้นย้ำนักนวดบำบัดอีกครั้งและต้องขออภัยจากใจจริง หากพนักงานของเรานวดไม่เป็นไปตามความต้องการของคุณ 
    แต่ในกรณีนี้ลูกค้าก็ทำการนวดจนจบครอส 90 นาที ซึ่งระยะเวลาดังกล่าวลูกค้าสามารถแจ้งให้พนักงานหยุดนวดได้ทันทีตั้งแต่เริ่มรู้สึกว่าพนักงานนวดไม่ดี หรือไม่ตรงตามความต้องการ ของท่าน และหลังจากการนวดเสร็จสิ้น เราไม่พบว่าลูกค้าเกิดบาดเจ็บหรือมีเลือดออกตามที่ลูกค้ากล่าวอ้าง และไม่ได้แจ้งถึงปัญหาใดๆแก่เรา มีเพียงการขอใบเสร็จการนวดสำหรับ1ท่าน (นวด2ท่านแต่ขอลงบิลแค่1 ท่าน) ในราคา1200บาท เพื่อไปเบิกกับทางบริษัทของลูกค้าเท่านั้น


ประเด็นที่2 เรื่องเพศสภาพของนักบำบัด ที่นี่เราเปิดกว้างสำหรับความหลากหลายทางเพศของนักบำบัด เราเคารพ ความหลากหลายทางเพศ 
         ซึ่งนักบำบัดของเราทุกคนล้วนได้รับการอบรมและมีใบอนุญาตเป็นผู้ให้บริการในสถานประกอบการนวดเพื่อสุขภาพ ซึ่งโปรแกรมที่ลูกค้าเลือก เป็นนวดไทยน้ำมัน ซึ่งเป็นโปรแกรมที่ไม่ได้ถอดเสื้อผ้า ซึ่งเรามองว่าไม่ได้มีอะไรที่ไม่สมควรและลูกค้าก็เป็นผู้ชายหากลูกค้ารู้สึกไม่สบายใจหรือไม่ชอบ ควรแจ้งให้เราทราบเราจะเปลี่ยนนักบำบัดให้ทันที

สุดท้ายนี้ เราขออภัยกับเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นอีกครั้งค่ะ

reviews.name: Eunice Tan Lian Ching
reviews.text: Such a comfortable massage experience! I chose the normal-pressure foot massage, and the strength was just right. It truly made my feet feel incredibly relaxed. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: snot jong
reviews.text: 90 min thai massage before flying left me feeling rejuvenated. Very kind ladies and peaceful shop. After massage they give yummy tea and cookie. Recommended and will come back when visiting Chiang Mai again :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We are delighted that you enjoyed your visit to our local massage shop. Our goal is always to customize our treatments to offer the best care possible for every guest.
​We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back in the future. Have a lovely day!

reviews.name: Jaden Phu
reviews.text: Best massage I had in Thailand. Staff was supper accommodating I explained to them I have a fractured collar bone but I still want a deep tissue massage they worked the muscles around it gently or completely avoided up to my discretion while massaging the rest of my body accordingly. Thank you! ❤️

reviews.name: Алексей Колеватов
reviews.text: Very professional staff, strong deep tissue massage, relaxing head massage, and the aroma oil was really nice. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Clean place, friendly atmosphere, and great value for the price. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Kyaw Kyaw (ChunkyBunny)
reviews.text: This was definitely one of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand. I mentioned to my therapist that I had a headache and she adjusted the pressure perfectly. Her technique combined with the hot compress completely relieved my headache. Absolutely worth it.👍👍👍

reviews.name: Aye Nyein Aung
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at this Thai massage shop! The massage was incredibly relaxing, and the therapist was highly skilled. The shop owner was so warm and welcoming, making the whole visit even more enjoyable. Plus, the two adorable cats added a cozy and charming touch. Highly recommend!

title: Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House
ownerDescription: Hidden serene sanctuaries in the heart of the bustling city. Providing a private space to escape the chaos and find tranquility for a peaceful mind.
address: 98 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

reviews.name: Warra V.
reviews.text: I oot Body Scrub and Aroma Thai Massage with P’Daeng. It was so good and relaxing. Thank you P’Daeng ❤️ for taking care of me.

reviews.name: Desmond Vincent
reviews.text: Wonderful massage place to take a breather after visiting the very vibrant song wat. Found in a very tranquil area on a street, this place is just next to a boutique hotel. Massage is relaxing and I was able to nap for a while. Clean environment and excellent service. Very much recommended.

reviews.name: Brian Baharin
reviews.text: I am extremely happy with the massage that I got today here specifically from Noy. It is honestly one of the best (if not the best) massages I’ve ever had and this is coming from someone who is very critical about getting a high quality massage. The service is top tier and I’d highly recommend coming here for the massage. I’d definitely come back and hopefully get to experience the massage from Noy again. Thank you Noy! I love you!

reviews.name: Aye's Vacation time
reviews.text:
Quiet hidden gem retreat in busy area
Very nice and calm atmosphere with oldtown vibe
Good service
Reasonable price for overall
I have Thai balm massage for 1100 baht 2 hours.
Really good place to rest and escape from city.

reviews.name: valerie lim
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Khagee! The staff are very professional and genuinely friendly, which made me feel comfortable right away. The massage was excellent—they really focus on proper technique and actually work on your muscles, not just light touching. You can tell they know what they’re doing.

Highly recommend coming here if you’re looking for a quality massage and great service! Also free massage balm 🤭

reviews.name: Laura Ferraris
reviews.text: Beautiful, lovely location that really stands out. The massage was good, although I’ve had better experiences.

reviews.name: Jalaj Mehta
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had — super relaxing and professional. The place is in a beautiful heritage house surrounded by nature, with a cute coffee shop right next to it. If you’re on a tight schedule, definitely make an appointment in advance. Totally worth it!

reviews.name: Ane Gundersen
reviews.text: Excellent massage! The best we had in Thailand. Calm, relaxing environment. Very skilful therapists. The shoulder and neck massage was so good. It is a bit more expensive than other places as it’s upscale (the rooms are nice and with an attached bathroom). Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Lim Siew Lee
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Khagee Boutique Spa.

We made a reservation for 4 people and were told that it was confirmed. However, when we arrived, we were suddenly informed that they could only accommodate 2 people. After we expressed our frustration, they changed their story and said they could do 3 people instead. This immediately raised questions about whether they actually knew their own availability.

When we asked why they didn’t inform us of this before we arrived, the manager’s explanation was that the receptionist “was not aware.” That is simply not an acceptable excuse. Internal miscommunication is the spa’s responsibility, not the customer’s.

Instead of resolving the issue, they asked us to walk to another outlet. We even suggested sending one additional therapist from the other outlet so our group could stay together, but they refused without offering any meaningful solution.

The most shocking part was when we requested to speak to the owner or someone more senior. The manager hung up on us. That level of customer service is completely unprofessional and disrespectful.

We wasted our time travelling there based on a confirmed booking, only to be met with confusion, contradictory information, and rude service. If your group booking matters to you, I would strongly recommend avoiding this place. There are many spas that value their customers and honour their reservations.

I would have given a zero star if I could!

reviews.name: Amelia Jane
reviews.text: We had the most amazing combo massage. Foot shoulder and head massage. The chairs were so comfortable. The ladies were so welcoming. Professional and absolutely amazing. Will definitely come back on my next visit! Thank you!

reviews.name: Sulagna Ghosh
reviews.text: Deang was amazing! Had the best massage - all my knots are out! I’m so happy 🧘🏽‍♀️ and at peace! One of the best spas in the city.

reviews.name: Ana Gehlhar
reviews.text:
I loved their foot massage in combination with neck and shoulders. From the greeting, the massage, the place, the cleanliness & staff were excellent!!! Perfection! And I will return when I come back to Bangkok!

Thank you so much!🙏🏽☺️

reviews.name: Loh Wanping
reviews.text: a hidden gem in the middle of Chinatown. will visit again. did the winter package (scrub + bath + oil massage) and had such a good & relaxing time. staff are friendly and responsive. towels nice smelling. the grounds are so beautiful, like a green oasis providing a brief respite from the busy roads. loved the glasshouse!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you very much for your wonderful review! Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we're glad we could meet your expectations.

We look forward to serving you again in the future.

Best regards,
Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House

reviews.name: Prin Thanapisitikul
reviews.text: Peaceful hideaway in an alley just off the main bustling Chinatown strip. The foot massage chairs are in this gorgeous glasshouse surrounded by greenery while the massage rooms were in a lovely heritage building. The massage therapist for the Thai balm massage was both skilled and attentive (would recommend doing at least 90 min, it was so good!) Would definitely come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, greetings from Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House.

Thank you very much for your wonderful review! Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we're glad we could meet your expectations.

Best regards,
Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House

reviews.name: Ann Chung
reviews.text: This massage place feels like a little villa, offering a sense of luxury! The environment smells great, with high-quality pre-massage towels and drinks provided, plus the option to shower. It’s truly a relaxing and enjoyable experience. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, greetings from Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House.

Thank you very much for your wonderful review! Your kind words mean a lot to our team, and we're glad we could meet your expectations.

We look forward to serving you again in the future.

Best regards,
Khagee Boutique Thai Massage House

reviews.name: Hilary S
reviews.text: Amazing massage after a long flight. My masseuse found all the tight knots that’s been accumulated from work and exercise. I feel lighter after 2 hours, and will definitely come back at some point in my trip!

reviews.name: Ivanna M
reviews.text: Went in for an hour long foot massage. Really good relaxing and felt like I was walking in clouds after. Highly recommended if you’re doing a lot of walking or touring around.

reviews.name: Jen-Hao “GoGo” Liu
reviews.text:
This massage place is tucked away behind a restaurant and a hotel. We were around the area and decided to give it a try even though the price is a bit more expensive.

The place is clean and quiet. The staff were attentive and friendly. My partner and I both had foot massages for an hour. It was a great foot massage better than I expected. The lady was so on the point with each move, and I was so pleased. I used to work as a masseur so I am a bit more particular when I get massages.

With the higher price, I think it is worth it despite the atmosphere and the service you get. My partner fell asleep as soon as he hit the couch so I assume his was as good as mine.

Would recommend you to try this place if you like a calm and clean environment when getting a massage.

reviews.name: Ariana Larrosa
reviews.text: I came to get an oil massage and I can say the experience was 10/10. The place was very neat and clean, and Noy (who gave me the massage) was a very pleasant woman with great hands. I felt extremely relaxed—even to the point of falling asleep. I definitely recommend this place. Thank you!

reviews.name: Tony Stylu
reviews.text: Khagee Boutique Thai Massage is an amazing place and absolutely worth 5 stars. The therapists are very professional, kind and attentive, they really listen to what you need and adjust the pressure perfectly. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, the place is clean and smells beautiful, and everything feels very well organised from the moment you walk in. I left feeling lighter, relaxed and properly taken care of. One of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Thailand.

title: TARA Thai Massage
address: 1487, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

reviews.name: Eveboktor
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Tara Thai Massage. The shop is beautiful, clean, and has a very relaxing atmosphere. The therapist was professional and skilled, and the massage helped relieve a lot of tension.

The location is very convenient, just near Nueng Nom Nua, making it an easy stop while exploring the area. If you’re visiting this part of Bangkok and looking for a quality Thai massage, I highly recommend stopping by. I left feeling refreshed and relaxed.

reviews.name: Kaday San
reviews.text: Got a chance to get TARA Thai massage in Ban Tad Thong road. Everything they use is so clean and hygienic. The staff are friendly and professional 🌟

reviews.name: Yinpoz Bankai
reviews.text: The place is well renovated and cleanliness was great, very comfy and air con isn’t too strong as well. Opted for a 90 mins Thai Massage with therapist Tae, she is very experienced and knows where to go hard and where to go soft, the massage itself is really relaxing. Some small complaints will be that the place is located along a busy street so there will be some vehicle noises but it’s bearable.

reviews.name: Massage Reviewer
reviews.text: While which package was purchased is a mystery at this point, the service here was top notch. Clients are treated very well and the sanitation went above and beyond expectations. The massage chair was so comfortable that sleep was certainly induced. This is a very legit place with great staff.

reviews.name: Pisutkan Sanemuang
reviews.text:
Amazing massage experience!

This place is truly a hidden gem. The therapist was incredibly skilled — one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The bed was very comfortable, and the overall ambiance was so relaxing and peaceful. The location is also super convenient and easy to find. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind and treat themselves to a top-quality massage.

reviews.name: Kate Suwan
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at this massage place! The massage was excellent and super relaxing. The shop is very clean and has a pleasant atmosphere. The staff are lovely and provide great service. I’ll definitely come back again 🥰

reviews.name: Janeypdiz
reviews.text: I found this massage place randomly while walking around the Banthadthong area and decided to try a 90-minute foot massage. It turned out to be an excellent choice. The massage was incredibly relaxing and well done — I actually fell asleep during the session, which says a lot. The therapist was attentive and professional, and the overall atmosphere was calm and comfortable. A great spot to unwind after a long day of walking. I’d definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Frances Galang
reviews.text: Booking the appointment was very easy and quick. It was a 10 min walk from our place. Even tho the street is busy, the place has such a great ambiance. Moo did a great job, hitting all the important pressure points!

reviews.name: hazel tan
reviews.text: very clean environment, comfortable massage, professional😆

reviews.name: Stephenie Wong
reviews.text:
I decided to give this place a try despite the mixed reviews, but unfortunately the experience did not meet expectations.
The environment was generally clean, which I appreciated. However, the overall setting was quite noisy. The foot massage area is located right next to the reception and waiting area, so there was very little privacy and constant noise throughout the session, which made it hard to relax.
More importantly, the therapist did not seem fully attentive during the massage. I am someone who is quite sensitive to pressure and usually can feel the difference in technique quite easily, but throughout the entire session I did not feel any relief or proper muscle release. It felt more like light touching than an actual massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback, and we sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet expectations. We’re truly sorry for the noise and the quality of the massage. This is not the standard we aim for, and we will definitely take your comments seriously and improve. We hope to have the chance to serve you better next time.🙏🤍

reviews.name: Caroline Kepler
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend went for Tara Experience package and it was absolutely amazing. My back never felt better. Peaceful ambient, calm music, perfect relaxation. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Katey Tan
reviews.text: The place is clean, the staff is friendly, and they really know what they’re doing. I asked for medium pressure and the therapist adjusted perfectly throughout. I appreciated being able to take a quick shower before the session. It was relaxing, therapeutic, and very professional. Highly recommend, especially if you like strong, traditional Thai techniques. Lastly, their boss is soooo preeety hhh.

reviews.name: NicBoh
reviews.text: A group of 5 of us walked in around 6 pm, and they saw all of us within half an hour. The services are priced very well, especially for the high quality Thai massage. They offer “light”, “medium”, and “hard” for intensity, and hard means VERY hard, so choose your own adventure.

reviews.name: Wee Val
reviews.text: Maybe i came too late in the evening. Seems like the masseuse was too tired to give a decent massage. 90 mins of feeling  like someone giving you kitty paw massage and light finger kneading. I tried telling her many times to use more strength and "harder" but it seemed like she took no heed. Thinking it might be language barrier that she doesnt comprehend, I took out my phone to translate to tell her to use more strength but seems like there wasnt much difference in the strength. Total waste of money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly sorry for your experience. We sincerely apologize that the massage did not meet your expectations, especially after you clearly asked for stronger pressure. This is not the standard we aim for. We understand how frustrating that must have been, and we will take your feedback seriously to improve our service.

reviews.name: ThÁmø tHámo
reviews.text: Massage is good and clean environment. Well recommended.  Did a two hours Traditional Thai massage.

reviews.name: Joning
reviews.text:
They are professional. They are not newbies/“young baby”, and their massage techniques are truly on point — targeted on the right muscles, no repetitive motions, and the pressure is just perfect. Before the session starts, they even provide a form for you to indicate your preferred pressure and the areas you want them to focus on.

Highly recommended, and I would say it’s definitely worth the price.

Besides, I don’t remember the lady’s name, but I would like to give her credit for her professionalism

reviews.name: Mingze Fan
reviews.text: No words to describe how amazing this store is. Staffs from reception are nice and patient when we randomly came in on the first day. And the masseurs helps three of us constantly for 3 days with the amazing performance as how professional they originally are. And the other reason why i highly recommend is because they listen what problem we have and focus on their job without talking that much. Highly recom to come in and try, then you will love them as what we did!! Thanks team!!

reviews.name: Stella Koh
reviews.text: We did a quick 30 minutes office syndromes 3-in-1 massage. Khun Porn was amazing and she did her best to alleviate the tensed up muscles. She may be petite but she is so strong. My partner enjoyed his massage too. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ellen Melawaty
reviews.text:
Randomly find a thai massage during my holiday here and found a good one! ❤️
the receptionist can speak english and the therapist all good. there are so many foreigners too visit here so i would recommend all travelers to go here and try their massages. all worth the money 🩷🩵

reviews.name: Bob Cook
reviews.text:
Very professional massages that performed wonders on my tight muscles. These ladies don’t just go thought the motions they are experts at what they do and at getting to the exact right point on the body.
Can I be honest and say that while my wife loves massages I’m less of a fan, but nevertheless I went here four times in the time we spent in Chiang Mai, just because I could feel the difference when I woke up in the morning.
💆🏻‍♂️ Since I was aiming to lossen the body muscles I went for the Thai massage rather than anything else. They have lots of different massages and treatments.
💵 Their prices are very reasonable 60 Min/400 THB. 90 min/550 THB. Note that if you book you need to pay a deposit in cash (200 for 2 people), but if you want to pay by card you can if the total is over 500 (they’ll give you the deposit back).
👩🏻‍💼Apart from being skilful masseuses were friendly  with a good sense of humour. The masseuses are ex-prisoners who have been retrained, and the standard of work is high.
🌟 Overall: strongly recommended based on the quality, value, and results. 🌟
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your incredibly thoughtful and detailed review 😊
We’re truly honored to hear that our Thai massage helped relieve your muscle tension and made such a noticeable difference during your stay in Chiang Mai 💜

It means even more to us knowing that you chose to return multiple times despite not usually being a massage fan. That is truly one of the greatest compliments we could receive.

We also deeply appreciate your kind words about our therapists and the mission behind our project. Our team works hard every day to provide skilled, genuine, and meaningful care to every guest 🌿✨

Thank you for your strong recommendation, and we sincerely hope to welcome you again on your next visit to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Vilai Baume
reviews.text: There are many other cheaper, nicer and cleaner place than this place. Dont fall asleep here or this masseur on the left will just pat you to sleep, not massaging you like you had paid her to do.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback.
We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Providing attentive and professional massage service is very important to us, and we take comments like yours seriously. Your feedback will be shared with our team for further review and improvement.

We appreciate your honesty and thank you for giving us a try 🌿

reviews.name: Nicholas Bendor-Samuel
reviews.text: Amazing service by the staff. They catered to what I needed, a quick massage before an airport run. And they were efficient and kind as they helped me get a Grab. The massage was not only relaxing but went into deep tissue without too much pain. Perfect one hour!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! 😊 We’re delighted that our team could provide an efficient and relaxing massage before your airport trip, as well as assist you with arranging a Grab.

We’re especially happy that the pressure was deep and effective while still comfortable for you. We look forward to welcoming you back to Lila Thai Massage on your next visit to Chiang Mai! 🙏💜

reviews.name: Wanida Srion
reviews.text: The place is great, the cleanliness is very high standard, I really liked the Thai massage and everything else. I'm a pure Thai person, I highly recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review and recommendation! 💜 We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed our Thai massage, appreciated our high standards of cleanliness, and had a great overall experience with us. Your kind words and support mean a lot to our entire team. We look forward to welcoming you back to Lila Thai Massage again soon! 🙏😊

reviews.name: Floris T
reviews.text: My first and not last massage. Very pleasant foot massage. The people that were giving the massage were very friendly and you get slippers and pants to put on. Very comfy. Also a good front desk.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review 😊
We’re truly happy that your first massage experience was such a pleasant one with us 💜

It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the foot massage, the comfort of our facilities, and the friendliness of both our therapists and front desk team 🌿✨

We look forward to welcoming you again for your next massage experience!

reviews.name: Genevieve Miller
reviews.text:
Very professional. The ladies did a great job. Thai massage is pressure based and it works different but it does work.

The place is clean. The ladies are smiling.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful review 😊
We’re delighted that you appreciated the professionalism of our team and enjoyed the authentic pressure-based Thai massage experience 💜

We’re also happy that you noticed the cleanliness and warm smiles from our therapists 🌿✨
Hope to welcome you again soon!

reviews.name: Lucia
reviews.text: Great massage and they inquire your massage strength preference before massage🥰
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much 😊🥰
We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the massage and appreciated being able to choose your preferred pressure before the treatment 💜

Providing a personalized and comfortable experience is very important to us 🌿✨
Hope to welcome you again soon!

reviews.name: Richie Huang
reviews.text: The location is central and the facility is quite clean, front desk speaks good English so it was easy to communicate. Here’s the bad - the therapist was very rough, she use mainly brute force rather and did not hit a single pressure point, she mostly pushed down my body rather than single points of the nerve system. At one point when she was trying to massage my shoulder she had rest one hand on my spine and I felt like I would get injured if i had not quickly push her hand out of the way. There was a pillow for my head when I was rest on my back but it was taken away when I was on my front and it was quite uncomfortable. I think the therapist was attentive but definitely felt not properly trained. It also didn’t help when I had specific requested to the front desk that i wanted someone more skillful. I came out of my message more stressed and with more body tightness than before.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback.
We truly appreciate your comments regarding our cleanliness, location, and front desk service.

We are very sorry to hear that the massage experience did not meet your expectations and that you felt uncomfortable during the treatment. Guest safety, comfort, and proper technique are extremely important to us, so we take your feedback seriously.

We sincerely apologize that the pressure and massage style were not suitable for your needs despite your request for a more experienced therapist. Your comments will be shared with our team for further review and training improvement.

Thank you again for your honest feedback. We truly value it and will continue working to improve the quality and consistency of our services 🌿

reviews.name: M R
reviews.text: Had a massage from Ladda here and it was absolutely amazing.  I wish I had come earlier in my holiday so I could have visited more than once. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and recommendation! 😊 We’re delighted that you had such an amazing massage with Ladda. We will be sure to share your kind words with her.

We wish you could have visited us more during your holiday too, and we hope to welcome you back to Lila Thai Massage on your next trip to Chiang Mai! 🙏💜

reviews.name: Fara Walling
reviews.text: I came across Lila Thai Massage Phrasingh while walking  down the street on my first day in Chiang Mai. I immediately loved their mission of training and employing female ex-inmates, and knew I wanted to support them with my business. I received a foot massage and Thai massage from Mook, who did an excellent job. I will be back before I have to leave in a few days, and highly recommend Lila Thai Massage Phrasing to anyone looking to engage in a little self-care.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and heartwarming review 💕
We’re truly grateful that you connected with our mission to support and empower women through meaningful work 🙏
We’ll make sure to share your kind words with Mook — she’ll be delighted to know you enjoyed your massage.
We look forward to welcoming you back before you leave Chiang Mai 🌿💆‍♀️✨

reviews.name: Carol
reviews.text: I had an amazing time with lovely lady call Nuch. The massage took around 2 hours and it was a true Thai massage ending up with hot herb compress, which its heaven in earth. Its unbelievable how kind Thai people are!

After the massage you get water, a wet handkerchief and hot tea. Very pleasant experience and definitely to recommend.

reviews.text:
Sweet Lemongrass in Patong remains a must-do on my Phuket trips. It is an absolute essential – and my multiple visits (this being my 6th visit i think ) prove it. This time, I indulged in the Bliss Package, a delightful combination of coconut body scrub and body oil massage.

This time, I indulged in the Bliss Package, a delightful combination of coconut body scrub and body oil massage. The price for the couple package was 2200 baht.

From the moment the scrub was applied, I knew I was in for a treat. The therapist used firm yet gentle pressure, effectively exfoliating my skin without any discomfort.

The quick shower afterward revealed incredibly soft and moisturized skin. The subsequent oil massage was pure bliss. The techniques felt intuitive and soothing, and I especially appreciated the gentle yet effective stretching at the end – no awkward or uncomfortable movements. I actually drifted off to sleep, that's how deeply relaxed I was!

Sweet Lemongrass has consistently delivered exceptional experiences for me, making it a reliable choice with virtually no risk of disappointment.

The price has had a slight increase (about 100baht) since my last visit a many years ago.

Currently, they only accept cash and Thai local bank QR. While understandable, I sincerely hope they will consider adding credit card payment options in the future, as many travelers prefer not to carry large amounts of cash 🫶🏼

reviews.text:
During my two weeks in Thailand I had around 10 traditional Thai massages. Two of them at Sweet Lemongrass Massage in Patong - as they were so good! Most likely the best during my trip.

My massages were executed by a lady named "Nack" (first time it was random, second time I specifically asked for her). Don't judge her by her size, she has one of the strongest grips I have ever experienced and more than enough techniques to even handle a tall man like me during the stretching!

I am pretty sure all the staff members have a high quality training - but I still can highly recommend "Nack".

The studio is very calm and clean. You will get a refreshing towel for your face/hands and a water while you pick your programm. After the massage you will - or course - get a fresh Lemongrass tea.

Incredible experience overall! Highly recommended!

Important side note, which is another plus: this studio does not try to push you to leave a rating on Google or anywhere else. So you can assume all ratings here are very real.

reviews.name: Summerday Berg
reviews.text:
I had to cancel the 5 star rating I gave before and change it to 2 stars! First of all, the masseur is very professional and very good, I am going to talk about the front desk! I have been to  three times, the first is with a friend,we had foot massage, the second is a back massage, the first two are very good,both the receptionist or masseur. But the third time, I do not understand why the receptions attitude has a big change, I ordered a mix of Thai and oil massage, it is clear that the reception was not particularly friendly. Then when I paid at the end of the massage, the ridiculous thing happened: I usually tip directly to the masseur, but I had no small money that day, so when I paid at the front desk I said to the reception that i want to give 40 baht tip to my masseur, and then the front desk gave me 600 baht (I gave 1,000 baht, and then the massage fee was 400 baht), I said why did not leave a tip, she said that she didn't have any change and then rudely asked me if I wanted to give 100 baht as tip, and finally impatiently gave me back 60 baht , I guess the receptionist is the boss. The tip should given to the masseur and I don't understand why she would withhold the tip from the masseur. Also I don't understand why the receptionist became so unfriendly on my third visit , maybe because I didn't order an expensive massage?
Anyway: I would still recommend this massage spa because the masseur is very professional and good, and not expensive! But note that if you want to tip the masseur, please remember to give it to the massager directly, not the tip to the reception, because if you give the reception directly, it is very likely that the masseur will not get the tip! Also remember to book on telephone in advance！

title: Green Bamboo Massage
ownerDescription:
Green Bamboo Massage - founded in 2009 - was one of the first studios in Thailand, that focuses on an eco-friendly and fair philosophy. We are a little, familiy-run and authentic place, that offers and preserves Lanna-style treatments, developed since centuries in the North of Thailand. Most of our products are organic or natural, many of them homemade by us. You can choose from a great variety of different treatments - that is hard to find in Chiang Mai - and perfect for your needs. All our therapists are certified and highly experienced in the arts of Traditional Thai Massage.
We are certified by the Thai Ministry of Health and won many prices for the quality of our services. Please come and discover the diifference.

reviews.text:
The best massage experience in Phuket! From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and well taken care of. The reception team is incredibly friendly, warm, and professional, making every guest feel comfortable and valued.

The therapists are highly skilled and truly know what they are doing. A special thank you to Kim and Namrin, who were absolutely amazing. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and caring approach made the experience exceptional. I would also like to highlight how clean and beautiful the place is. Everything is spotless, well-maintained, and designed to create a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. The combination of excellent service, professional staff, and a stunning environment makes this spa stand out from the rest.

I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Phuket and will definitely be coming back!

reviews.text:
My family and I had a great experience here. My wife, kids and I all got 2 hour massages. They are very responsive on WhatsApp and the front desk has good English. They also have forms that allow you to highlight any areas to concentrate or avoid during the massage, which is a nice touch. You can select between light or medium pressure, or you can also write in "deep" like I did. Each of us got our own private room with individual air conditioning that we could ask to adjust. They had refreshments for us both before and after our massages.

We drove in a car and they had a parking spot reserved for us to use, which was another great touch.

All in all, a great experience!

reviews.name: Daniel Kwon
reviews.text:
I visited Deva Zen Massage Phuket yesterday and had one of the most disorganized massage experiences I’ve ever had.

Before going in, I asked how much the massage would cost. Instead of answering, they told me to sit down first and said they would show me the menu. After selecting a foot, neck, and shoulder massage, they required full prepayment which is fine but only after taking payment did they inform me there would be a 30-minute wait.

The wait was closer to 50 minutes. During that time there was zero communication. No update, no apology, no tea or water offered nothing.

When it was finally my turn, I was brought into the foot massage room. After about 25 minutes of massaging just one foot, the owner came in and told us we had to move upstairs to make room for other customers. I had to physically relocate mid-session to get the other foot done. Completely disruptive and unprofessional.

After finishing the feet, the therapist moved to neck and shoulders. I specifically asked for a strong massage, but it was medium at best. Toward the end, she attempted to stretch me while I was sitting upright and ended up knocking me over. She apologized and said it was because I’m “too big” for her. To top it off thy short changed my time about 7-9 minutes.

From start to finish, the experience felt chaotic, poorly managed, and unprofessional. No organization, no communication, and no consistency in service. 0/10 overall.

Would not return.

The massage therapists are clearly well-trained in a variety of techniques. I found the Deep Tissue Oil Massage to be very helpful for tight muscles from long flights, long car rides, and much walking. The deep pressure helps to loosen tight muscles and the oil makes the lighter touch movements very relaxing.

The therapists are more than happy to adjust the treatment to meet your specific needs. For example, they worked around the limits of my frozen shoulder, and helped loosen it and regain some range of motion. I highly recommend the male therapist named Sunday; he is very attentive and accommodating.

reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had! Fantastic value for money, friendly and very welcoming! Had three already and only been here a week! It’s a must visit.

reviews.name: Doreen Maria
reviews.text: The best massage ever I have been, a good experience and service given.
