I am relaxed every time when I visit this place.
Clean, silent, only professionals doing this business🔥

reviews.name: theresa arthur
reviews.text: Been coming here every night in my 5 days 4 nights trip and the massage here is just fabulous!! Thank you!!

reviews.name: אלי פרז
reviews.text:
They were excellent, we did it twice
The first time was head and legs — it was really good and relaxing.
The second time was the whole body — and it was perfect.

reviews.name: Евгения Лугина
reviews.text:
Great place and massage!
All is clean, stuff is welcome, massage is great!
Definitely recommend to visit!

reviews.name: Anastasia Auld
reviews.text: Such a nice place to have a coconut oil massage 400 bath, fairly strong. I was offered a drink after the massage was complete.

reviews.name: Nofar Ye
reviews.text: A wonderful place for a massage, clean, well-kept and tidy. Pleasant staff. Definitely recommended.

reviews.name: Zlata Slutskaya
reviews.text: didnt expect massage here to be SOOO good! totally recommend this place! staff is very polite and helpful💓

reviews.name: Adelyn Chia
reviews.text: location was super convenient, located right outside our resort. the massage was good and price is reasonable. would come again!! highly recommended

reviews.name: 黄兆清
reviews.text:
very good ！
perfect experiences

reviews.name: Shriya Sarkar
reviews.text: Super relaxing massage. Must try in Phuket. Behaviour is great and very comforting.

title: Grand Massage and Spa - Nana
ownerDescription: Grand Massage & Spa offers an exquisite retreat for individuals seeking to escape the pressures of daily life. Emphasizing tranquility and rejuvenation, our establishment provides a comprehensive array of therapeutic massages and spa services, expertly delivered in a serene and welcoming environment. With a focus on holistic well-being, guests are invited to indulge in treatments designed to harmonize the body and mind, ensuring a restorative experience.
address: 6, 19-20 Soi Sukhumvit 3/1, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: MJ Yeong
reviews.text:
Fantastic service received.

Never been to this part of town so it was a nice walk around. Booking via WhatsApp was smooth, communication via English was not an issue.

Receptionist was very polite and explained the different services clearly.

Masseur was attentive and regularly check on me to make sure that I’m comfortable with the pressure.

Went for the 90 minutes, foot massage with back and neck. The room is clean and quiet, helps with the overall massage experience. Came out feeling well refreshed.

My masseur’s name was Meemee, attentive, pleasant, and overall great.

The waiting area and lobby is grand, spacious, and does not feel like you need to get in and get out kind of vibe.

Definitely a place for everyone. I’ll be sure to return in the future.

reviews.name: Solidly Dubaian
reviews.text:
I usually come to Grand Spa & Massage Nana for a 60-minute foot massage, as I find it a clean and decent place….but I often leave feeling a little underwhelmed. This visit, however, was a completely different experience.

I asked for a foot massage, and the receptionist recommended the Foot, Back & Shoulder Massage for THB 1,200. At first, I thought it was a bit expensive, but by the end of the session I genuinely felt it was worth every baht.

My therapist was exceptionally skilled, finding and working through tight knots I didn’t even realize I had. The combination of stretching, pressure, and technique left me feeling lighter, refreshed, and full of energy.

This was by far the best massage I’ve had here, and I’ll definitely be coming back. If you’re debating whether to upgrade from the standard foot massage, I’d say go for it. It’s well worth it.

reviews.name: Mark O'Kane
reviews.text: Recommended by locals I asked for a real massage. 4 sessions in a week with Meme and she was fantastic. Beautifully appointed, take card and cash. This is the only massage establishment I visit in Bangkok. Meme was trained in Singapore. 1000thb for an hour was great value.

reviews.name: Pakornxpp
reviews.text: The staff they’re very nice welcome and also they come to checking after the massage session if you’re okay or not, yeah and the massage room was very nice and clean, i’ll came back here again for sure

reviews.name: Rauana Ordabayeva
reviews.text:
A wonderful place in Bangkok! Zarina and I absolutely loved our experience at Grand Massage & Spa. The massage was excellent, the atmosphere was relaxing, everything was very clean, and the service was outstanding. The staff were incredibly polite, attentive, and welcoming — after the massage, we felt completely relaxed and refreshed. We will definitely come back again! ❤️

Coffee by Farida Ali was another lovely highlight. It’s such a cozy café with great service and amazing desserts! Everything was fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious. It was the perfect way to end our evening after the massage. 🥰☕️🍰

Thank you so much for such warm hospitality in Bangkok!

With love from Kazakhstan 🇰🇿❤️
Rauana & Zarina

reviews.name: Elwyn Ting
reviews.text: So far this is the best experience of massage in Bangkok city, staff is super friendly and top service had been provided. Really worth to try

reviews.name: Walde Trucking
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at a massage spot in Bangkok. Meme was exceptional—her technique, attention to detail, and professionalism really stood out. You can tell she knows exactly what she’s doing, and she made the whole session both relaxing and effective.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for quality, this place is definitely worth visiting. I’ll be coming back for sure.

reviews.name: Lulu
reviews.text: My husband and I stopped for a massage twice on our trip - the building itself as well as the service is luxurious, and the two hour oil massage was incredible. Compared to my 3 other luxury massage stops, this one was my favorite. I would absolutely stop by again my next visit to Bangkok.

reviews.name: John SYD
reviews.text: Feeling of grandeur in the foyer. Made to feel special from the moment you enter. Lovely reception. Exceptional welcome and hospitality from Faiza. Easy process, menu and options. Excellent massage, one of the best I've ever had in Bangkok. Amazing little surprise add ons that make your visit completely worthwhile.

reviews.name: momina zafar
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! Got thai massage done in privacy as I requested. The massage lady seemed quite experienced. Ambiance was very relaxing. Got served by welcome drink and later tea. Also received gift. 10/10 highly recommended!

reviews.name: Aki T
reviews.text:
We had a group a group of 6 and came here a few times for foot stone massages and shoulder/back/foot massages.

The massages were amazing, the rooms were super serene and luxurious, and the staff was really nice and accommodating both nights. They were flexible and made sure we all got seats together and allowed us to adjust the % of time we had spent on each body part as needed for each person. They also gave us snacks and tea both before and after the massages, so overall 10/10 experience for all of us. Can’t recommend enough vs other places we’ve been to in the area

reviews.name: Jasmine Sima
reviews.text: Just got a massage here and this place is good! Was so sore after my long flight and traveling around Bangkok. Facilities are clean, friendly and helpful workers, and the massage was incredible. For first time massage in Thailand definitely try this place out. I was impressed the have showers for you after to rinse off!

reviews.name: Natalie B
reviews.text: I love how my massage therapist, Mimi, checked on me throughout the process to ensure I received the best service. The place was clean, relaxing, and everyone is friendly. I received a welcome drink before, tea after, and a parting gift. The prices are great, I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Swapan Munshi
reviews.text: Went with wifey after some searching on Chat and Reddit I think. Chat gave other options and this is relatively new establishment which popped up in Sukhamvit area very close by and walking distance to JW Marriott. Thai Massage with Oil was incredible. Mimi had a lot of strength and skill which is what I wanted. I intuitively knew how to receive the massage for various areas of my body and she was receptive when I needed less pressure or pushed back. Wife was very happy with Naam as well. So much so, that she plans to come back at least once before we leave. The stretching all was jist what was needed after seeing all the temples today. Now time for a bite soon.

reviews.name: Jason Nakata
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my aromatic oil massage during my visit at this spa! It was honestly exactly what was needed after a long flight and was extremely sore from walking all day. I was able to get back into vacation mode and leave the stress behind. The masseuse was so nice and sweet yet gives a great massage and stretches! I highly recommend this place as I had a wonderful experience here in such a busy and bustling area

reviews.name: 岱西
reviews.text: I had an incredibly relaxing and thoughtful massage experience here. The staff were professional, kind, and very welcoming. The environment is spotless with a lovely fragrance, and even the tea they served was delicious. I’ll definitely be back😊

reviews.name: Thomas Thomson
reviews.text: The best massage experience in Thailand! 🇹🇭 The experience was amazing, classy and professional! The staff took very good care of me from the moment I walked in till the time I went back to my hotel!  Thomas ; California USA

reviews.name: kelly pua
reviews.text: Service was absolute and massage was so dang good!!! Worth the money and travel!!!!

reviews.name: Tougeedah Marston
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience and the staff is so nice. We had supper here and came back for a massage. We absolutely love it

reviews.name: Khoa Tran
reviews.text: I enjoyed my massage very much especially after multiple days of walking around and exploring Thailand.  The staff was very attentive and professional.  Bonus, you get a tea drink before and after your service along with a fruit of your choice.

title: White Orchid Massage
subTitle: ไวท์ ออร์คิด นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
ownerDescription:
Welcome to 'White Orchid Massage' Traditional Thai massage Services. Since 2009 on Loykhor road. We are little and cozy with friendly and mind service. All the masseuse are experienced and professional. We are Air-conditioned, Tea and Cracker serving after massage.
We are indeed grateful that everyone come to visit us. Hope to see you soon. Thank you so much!
address: 10 Loi Kroh Rd, Tambon Chang Khlan, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXMV+XG Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Leticia Chen
reviews.text: A very nice massage. Me and my husband been here 3 times in 5 days. Tried their Thai massage, upper body massage, foot massage, and all of them are excellent experience! Ae did the massage for me, she even remembered my pain points and changed the techniques accordingly🥹 Staffs are very friendly and nice, the cookies they offered after massage are also nice (tastes much better than others lol). We’ll definitely come back again!

reviews.name: nuevo
reviews.text: The massage therapist was very attentive and focused. The environment was very relaxing and clean. I thoroughly enjoyed the massage; it relieved all my fatigue.

reviews.name: Jenny Liu
reviews.text: Excellent value for the price. I had a 1.5-hour Thai massage with herbal compress, the pressure was just right, hit the spot. The environment is not at all luxurious, but it’s clean and relaxing.

reviews.name: Leo ZHU
reviews.text:
Once again doing massage here. For the first time I enjoyed the service as the masseur served seriously and ended the service on time. But for the second time, they were hurried to end my service so as to serve other new comings. Therefore you can clearly feel the quality down.
Besides, you may be disturbed by mosquitos in the room but I think this does not happen all the time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for visiting our homepage!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Bold Perceptions
reviews.text: Probably one of the best Thai massages I have every had, & I’ve had a lot. Shop open late hours as well, but was totally professional. Place is small, so maybe have some noise problems. But man, that Thai massage was out of a movie. I forgot her name, but it was an older Thai lady - very nice person. I told her I like it hard, & it was the first time I’ve had to tell someone to ease up a little. Left that place feeling in the clouds.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bold Perceptions Thank you very much for visiting our homepage!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Jamie Qin
reviews.text: It was just a normal oil massage, but when I was paying they suddenly said they used a more expensive oil, which didn’t make much sense. I didn’t want to argue so I just paid, but honestly it left me feeling really uncomfortable, like I was taken advantage of. Is this how people treat someone who’s easygoing?

reviews.name: Richard
reviews.text: My wife and I wanted a foot massage after relaxing a bit at Meilleur wine bar. I searched for a place nearby and the good Google reviews led us to choose this place. We initially started with the hour-long foot massage. I had Jade as my therapist, and my wife had Hun (sp.). I asked Jade to increase the pressure, and she was perfect. Not medium, but medium hard. The foot/leg massages were so good that my wife and I decided to do an hour-long head, neck, and back massage. Wow. Jade was skilled out of this world. She could detect every knot in my upper body and she got rid of each one as if she were an artist. I was in pain at times, but I asked for it, and she was very thorough. I would definitely rank that massage as one of the best I’ve ever had. I may go back for a full body Thai massage. Oh, and my wife was happy with her massage therapist as well. Also, the prices are among the lowest in town for a massage of this quality.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for visiting our homepage and review!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Ankit Dikshit
reviews.text:
One of the best massage experience in Chiang Mai. Chan and Muay gave us near to perfect massage sessions two times.

We also exchanged Indian and Thai cultures. Loved knowing more about Isaan (north eastern Thai culture from Chan).

reviews.name: Jessica Smits
reviews.text:
My husband and I enjoyed our final evening in Chiang Mai at the White Orchid. I got the one hour foot massage and my husband got the hot oil massage. It was 300k and 350k respectively. We arrived around 6:30pm on a Tuesday and had not called ahead. They were full, but let us know they'd have open spaces in about hour. We enjoyed a walk around the area and came back around 7:30pm. I was down to a chair along the wall inside the massage parlor. The chair was comfortable and reclined. My foot massage was wonderful. Really a 5/5 star experience for me. My husband got the hot oil massage and was on a table inside the curtained-off area. It was a 3/5 star experience for him, siting the lack of pressure.
We were able to pay with our Visa without any additional service charge.
Overall, I would recommend the white orchid if you are in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jessica Smits Thank you very much for visiting our homepage!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Jas
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a no frills massage place, this is it. Nothing fancy, but definitely a good massage. My masseuse was skilled and had so much strength despite being so petite. She’s also really polite and checked on me to ensure her strength was alright through the massage.

Was served a drink and rice cracker after the massage too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jas Thank you very much for visiting our homepage!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Sarah Rawsthorne
reviews.text:
Very nice massage!
Reasonable price (price list attached)
Tea and biscuit provided for free after massage.

My massage was very firm but can ask to be done softer.
Would recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Sarah Rawsthorne We are indeed grateful for your suggestion. We are looking forward to seeing you again in Chiang Mai. hope to see you soon, thank you so much.

reviews.name: Victor Yee
reviews.text:
Fairly average but definitely meets the bar for "knows what they're doing" (compared to places that actually don't). Standard floor setup with curtain separators. No intake form, not much communication during the massage itself, so didn't get the stronger pressure I prefer. Had to scrunch my neck to one or the other side for most of the session. Venue itself was clean but also fairly average.

6.8/10

reviews.name: Harvey Alemania
reviews.text:
One of the best Thai Massage in Chiang Mai. They are known in Chiang Mai as the best massage for reasonable prices. If its your first time, then they will massage you gently and they will apply the pressure afterwards.

Had a nice experience! Recommended to all!

reviews.name: Jorgen Frohlich
reviews.text:
It was my first time at white Orchid, I went after reading the positive reviews and I wasn’t disappointed.

The masseuses are professionals.
Pang was very good and clearly professional trained.

I’ve had issues especially with my right shoulder for years as a consequence of working all day at a computer using my right arm for mouse. Pang got rid off a lot of the tensions especially in my right shoulder.

(this is a serious place not an “ending that this is happy” 😂)

reviews.name: Danielle Waters
reviews.text: I've been coming for years and it continues to be the best massage. Occasionally I try other locations because of closer proximity but I always regret it.

reviews.name: Christina Zaksas
reviews.text:
My partner and I just had a massage here and it was amazing! The therapists are super professional and really know what they’re doing. They pay great attention to your needs — I even got an extra blanket when I felt a bit cold. My therapist noticed whenever I was tense, adjusted the pressure, and found every single knot in my body.

We went for the Deep Tissue Massage and loved that we could stay together in the same room. It was such a relaxing experience. Highly recommend White Orchid Massage!

reviews.name: Hannah Lee
reviews.text: The massage skill are very so so no strength, training are needed. Quite pricey compared to others. Just noticed that their price has been increased by at least around 20%.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are terribly sorry that our service wasn't to your satisfaction and we'll look into the matter and try to find the reason for it. We hope you'll come back to us again next time you are in Chiang Mai. We thank you for the complaint, which gives us an opportunity to find weak spots in our business. We take your complaint seriously!
Thank you!

reviews.name: Chua Xinni
reviews.text:
Really professional masseuses and fantastic service. Massage was great, reasonably priced and staff are very attentive and quick to adjust strength according to your preferences. They also have free Wi-Fi and serve warm water/tea + rice cracker after massages.

Accessible from most hotels by foot/bicycle and totally worth supporting. Superb experience - we couldn’t stop coming back during our stay in Chiangmai! 🧡
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Chua Xinni Thank you very much for visiting our homepage!
Should you ever come to Chiang Mai, we would be happy to see you at our massage parlour, which is authorized by Thai authorities, hope to see you again soon Thanks.

reviews.name: Kyla K
reviews.text: The staff were friendly but the services are not very good. I got a pedicure with gel polish,  they charged 600 THB for this and it was a poor job.  The girl didn't even scrub my feet,  just filed my nails and painted them. The paint wasn't even on straight. The manicure (200 THB) was also not amazing. The regular polish she used was old and dried with a very textured look to it, not nice and smooth. They are doing the mani pedi where they do the massages so they only have a lamp to see what they are doing which ends up not very professional looking. The Thai massage (200 THB) was ok at the time but I have had better.  It was not relaxing, I am not sure how well trained these girls are, in addition my neck hurt the next few days and I got a head ache. If you come here maybe try a foot massage or something basic, I would not recommend Thai massage,  manicure or pedicure. Overall not with my 1000 THB. I was going to go back and complain but I didn't have much time in Chiang Mai so I didn't get a chance. .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks  so much

reviews.name: HJ Oh
reviews.text:
I went here twice because I was so satisfied with my massage with May. Unfortunately she wasn’t there my second time, but it was still pretty good. They definitely know how to progress the massage from gentle to climax. There are certain points in the body along the muscles that they know how to work to truly release the tension in your body.
I had a lot of mediocre massages upon leaving this area, and with each new place I visited, I was reminded of my awesome massage with May at White Orchid.
The prices are also reasonable and the vibe of the place is relaxing and calm. I paid about 250 for the Thai Massage and 450 for the Herbal Massage.
I would definitely recommend the Thai Massage at this place and will probably go back if I’m ever in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear HJ Oh thanks you so much for your nice words We  are indeed grateful for your suggestion and will for sure consider bringing it into our program. We are looking forward to seeing you again in Chiang Mai!

title: C and R Thai Massage Sunday Walking Street
ownerDescription: Authentic traditional Thai massage on Sunday Walking Street in Chiang Mai Old City since 2014. Certified therapists (Thai Public Health 400-hour training) offer classic Thai stretching, oil massage, herbal compress, hot stone, and foot reflexology in a clean, air-conditioned spa with private family rooms. Walk-in welcome or book online. Open daily 10am–10pm. Two locations: Ratchadamnoen Rd (Walking Street) and Chiang Mai Gate. Starting from 350 THB.
address: 145, 8 Rajadamnern Rd Old City Subdistrict, Mueng, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQP+7M Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Adrian Petchey
reviews.text: There are quite a few traditional  Thai massage  parlours,I found C&R most to my liking very friendly nice surroundings, masuer,was excellent,I have a bad left arm and leg ,but came out feeling,capitol,able to walk and use them better fir a long time

reviews.name: Ellen Wachtelaer
reviews.text:
Chiang Mai has at every corner a massage place…nevertheless, this place is a staple of Chiang Mai and the real deal!!

I’ve had my first Thai massage in here, 10 years ago and today again!
It re-confirmed the quality and expertise the employees have and the owner wants to keep it up!

What a joy to be able to have again an excellent experience!

I can only recommend to go for a Thai massage or herbal compress massage or combine both, you won’t be disappointed!!

The owner surprised me with a gift, b/c I mentioned I visited her place 10 years ago and was so happy that I found it back 🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow, we are absolutely speechless. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for this truly incredible and moving review.

To hear that you returned to us after 10 years is the greatest honor we could ever receive. We are so deeply touched that you consider us a "staple of Chiang Mai" and "the real deal."

Maintaining the high quality of expertise that you remembered from a decade ago is our biggest passion, and your words re-confirm that we are on the right path. We are so, so happy that we could provide you with another excellent experience!

Thank you for your wonderful recommendations for the Thai and herbal compress massages. We were delighted to offer you a small gift as a thank-you for your loyalty and for finding your way back to us.

It was truly our joy to welcome you again. We hope your next visit is much sooner than 10 years! Thank you.

reviews.name: Marcelo Gottschalk
reviews.text: I paid 2h they gave me a bad 90 min massage. do not go there. cheap but not good
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Marcelo,
Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that you didn’t enjoy your experience with us.
We take all reviews seriously, so we checked our records and security timestamps regarding your visit. You arrived at 19:12, and the massage began at 19:17. The session was completed and we served your refreshment drinks at 21:21. This means you received the full 2-hour massage (plus a few extra minutes).
If you felt the session was shorter than expected or if anything was not to your satisfaction, we would have appreciated the opportunity to address it directly at reception so we could resolve it immediately. Unfortunately, we were not given that chance.
We’re happy to offer you another session to make things right. Please feel free to message us here or speak with our team at the shop anytime.
Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.
Best regards,
C&R Thai Massage Team

reviews.name: PrincessLeia
reviews.text: We had foot massage here. Excellent  massage. Very friendly, professional staff. 1 star less because the chairs for foot massage were not comfortable and the lighting in the foot massage area was not so pleasant.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We're glad to hear that you enjoyed the excellent foot massage and found our staff to be friendly and professional. Your input is valuable to us, and we appreciate your honesty.

We apologize for any discomfort caused by the chairs and the lighting in the foot massage area. We'll certainly take your comments into consideration as we strive to improve our facilities and ambiance.

We hope to have the opportunity to serve you again and provide an even more comfortable and pleasant experience at C and R Thai Massage.

reviews.name: Chung yeong
reviews.text: Very nice massage place with reasonable price. Masseurs are professional and other staff are so friendly and helpful. Had a wonderful and relaxing time here. Greatly recommend

reviews.name: Cherry Kong
reviews.text: The environment is decent. I had green bean body scrub and aloe vera whole body massage. My therapist Aoi can communicate in simple English and her skill was awesome. Aoi was dedicated and concentrated on the key areas. A great massage experience.

reviews.name: GENTHER BARING
reviews.text:
I spent my last day (and birthday) here for 3 hours and got the Deep Thai Tension Tame and facial. The massage changed my life and removed all the possible tension lingering in my body. Made me understand the idea "the body keeps score".

Prepare to cry (emotionally)

reviews.name: R M
reviews.text: This Thai massage was an exceptional experience that I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a thorough and revitalizing treatment. It’s an ideal escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life, leaving you refreshed and renewed. I can’t wait to return for another session!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this truly exceptional review!

We are so happy to hear that you found the massage to be a revitalizing and refreshing escape. That is exactly the experience we hope to provide for all our guests at C&R Thai Massage.

We truly appreciate your high recommendation and are already looking forward to welcoming you back for another session soon!

reviews.name: Mario Donato
reviews.text:
We came here pushed as the other massage places around that looked better were fully booked and gave it a try.
Person in the front desk was super sweet. Place looked clean but.. had 1hour Thai massage by obviously an untrained person. She was improvising, felt even dangerous at times. And I’m one that handles pressure really well.
I’ve been coming back to Thailand the past 7 years, and I can confidently say this was second to worst massage I’ve ever had in my life.
All three of us had a horrible experience.
Never again.

reviews.name: Nicolas Muntrez
reviews.text:
The oil massage itself was very good and professionally done. I have had many massages before, and the technique here was clearly experienced and serious.

Additionally, my partner did not receive any massage on his chest or arms, which was quite disappointing. Only the legs and feet were massaged, and while that part was very good, the overall massage felt incomplete. As a result, his massage experience was also more of a disappointment than a positive one.
However, I was very disappointed with the way the service was presented and managed. It was sold to us as a private duo massage in a private room, yet we had to wait around 20 minutes. Then, halfway through the massage, another couple entered the room to get their massage. Since this was supposed to be private, it completely broke the relaxing atmosphere, and I could no longer focus or enjoy the sense of privacy.
Overall, my experience is very mixed, mainly because of the poor management and welcome. In addition, the facilities are not pleasant — the place feels more like a hospital back room than a relaxing spa environment.

reviews.name: Radjoe Mangla
reviews.text:
Today, I had the pleasure of experiencing the Aloe Vera Facial Treatment at C&R Thai Massage & Spa, and I can confidently say it was one of the most relaxing and refreshing treatments I’ve ever had.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and genuine hospitality. The atmosphere in the spa is calm, clean, and beautifully serene — exactly what you want when you're seeking peace and restoration. The staff were professional, friendly, and carried a very grounded, calming energy. I was gently guided to a cozy treatment room where soft music, a subtle herbal aroma, and a comfortable environment immediately helped me unwind.

I had been feeling pretty exhausted — after a long day out, barely three hours of sleep the night before, and exposure to sun and dust from being out and about in Chiang Mai. My face felt bloated, tight, and a bit irritated. The Aloe Vera Facial came at exactly the right time.

The treatment started with a gentle cleansing, followed by a cooling application of pure aloe vera gel. I could instantly feel the soothing, hydrating effect on my skin. What stood out to me was the attention to detail and the therapist’s slow, intentional movements — every touch felt like it was relieving layers of stress.

The facial included a wonderfully light massage of the face, neck, and shoulders — an unexpected but deeply appreciated bonus. I could literally feel the tension melting away. It wasn't just skincare; it was healing. After just a few minutes, I was already drifting into a state of total calm.

When the treatment ended, I was offered a warm cup of herbal tea and had a few moments to relax in the peaceful lounge. I glanced in the mirror before leaving, and the difference was clear: my face looked brighter, more even-toned, and completely rehydrated. The puffiness I’d felt earlier was gone, and my skin felt incredibly soft and cool to the touch. Even my dark circles looked less noticeable — all in just 60 minutes.

What makes C&R truly special is not just the treatment, but the entire experience. You can feel the love and care in everything they do — from the welcome, to the ambiance, to the treatment itself. The quality of products used was excellent, and everything felt hygienic and professional.

In short:
If you're in Chiang Mai and in need of deep relaxation and skin recovery, I highly recommend the Aloe Vera Facial at C&R Thai Massage & Spa. It’s ideal for tired skin, sun exposure, or simply self-care. I left the spa feeling lighter, brighter, and truly rejuvenated.

5 stars. I’ll definitely be back!

Thank you again for your high recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back to C&R Thai Massage & Spa soon!

reviews.name: Forest L
reviews.text: Found this head spa on Google maps randomly - and came in here for a 60-min service. The staff were all so welcoming and nice, and the treatment was heavenly! It made my hair so smooth. The location is great too, just right by Saint Louis BTS. The welcome drinks were delicious. Overall it was an amazing experience and totally recommend this to anyone who would like a combination of salon + massage.

reviews.name: Anna Beresina
reviews.text: The overall service was outstanding! I was greeted by the team immediately and offered a nice cold sweet drink. I had a full service Kalm mind Head Spa booked, which was 90 minutes. It started with a nice neck and shoulder massage, followed by a head massage and washing procedure. At the end they even curled my hair professionally with a Dyson wrap. Couldn’t be more pleased! Definitely a go to place if you are in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sandra Śliwińska
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I can't recommend this salon. I went to a head spa. The massage itself was unpleasant. The lady pulled my hair very hard, braiding it so much that a lot of my hair fell out. During the massage, the air conditioning was set to 22 degrees above my head, blowing directly onto my wet head. When the products were being washed off, the lady used very hot water. My head was burned and sore. I had to ask her three times. Despite this, the lady continued pouring very hot water on my head. I lost a lot of hair instead of relaxation. Now I'm traumatized. It's a shame there's no good head spa in the capital.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We are truly sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations and that you felt uncomfortable during the treatment.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the discomfort caused, especially regarding the hair pulling, water temperature, and overall pressure during the massage. This is not the standard of service we aim to provide.

We take your feedback very seriously. Following this incident, we have:

•Re-trained our therapists to ensure gentler techniques and better control of pressure

•Reinforced strict guidelines to avoid any hair pulling

•Reviewed our procedures to ensure water temperature is always checked carefully with clients

•Improved our communication process — if there is any concern during the service, our receptionist will step in immediately to assist and ensure everything is adjusted to your comfort

Your experience is very important to us, and we deeply regret that we caused you distress instead of relaxation.

We would truly appreciate the opportunity to make this right for you in the future.
Kind regards,
Kalm Moments

reviews.name: Eugenia
reviews.text:
An exquisite experience from start to finish!
The therapists were incredible — attentive, skilled, and genuinely caring. I tried the Kalm Mind Treatment and it was absolutely worth every dollar. The combination of a soothing head massage, rejuvenating scalp treatment, and the relaxing waterfall ring spa made it the perfect way to unwind after a long week. I left feeling refreshed, lighter, and completely relaxed.

Truly a hidden gem. Definitely worth a visit!

Conveniently located near BTS Saint Louis Exit 2 - just a short 1 min walk.

reviews.name: Shona Hickey
reviews.text: Highly recommend! The women are so sweet and my massage was amazing. My masseuse took great care of me always making sure I was comfortable. And she did an amazing job on my hair!!

reviews.name: Ekin Khor
reviews.text:
3 stars. The experience wasn’t bad, but it did not quite match the premium image and pricing being marketed.

There were thoughtful touches, such as the aromatherapy selection, but the execution felt lacking. Guests were asked to smell and choose the scents themselves rather than being guided through the experience, which made it feel a little self-service rather than luxurious.

The venue itself also requires climbing a fairly long flight of stairs, and overall the experience felt somewhat piecemeal. Individually, none of these are major issues, but together they take away from the seamless, polished feel you would expect at this price point.

A decent experience overall, just not one that fully delivers on the premium positioning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. 🙏

We truly appreciate your honest comments, and we are sorry that the experience did not fully match your expectations.

At Kalm Moments, we try to create a relaxing and approachable experience rather than a formal luxury spa atmosphere. For example, we let guests personally choose their preferred aromatherapy scent because many customers enjoy selecting scents based on their own mood and preference. However, we understand your point that more guidance during the process could make the experience feel more seamless and premium, and we will continue improving this part of the journey.

Regarding the stairs and overall flow of the experience, we completely understand your feedback as well. Our space is located on the second floor, and while many guests enjoy the quiet and private atmosphere this provides, we understand it may not feel convenient for everyone.

We would also like to clarify that our pricing is designed to offer premium products and thoughtful service at a more accessible price point compared to many head spa concepts in Bangkok. Our programs include professional Shiseido Sublimic hair spa products, scalp treatments, waterfall spa, and Dyson styling tools as part of the experience. Still, we understand that “premium” is ultimately defined by how the guest feels throughout the entire journey — not only by the products used or certificated and skillful therapist. 

Your feedback is genuinely valuable to us, and we will use it to further improve the details and hospitality experience moving forward. Thank you again for visiting Kalm Moments and for sharing your perspective with us. 🙏✨

reviews.name: Melanie Hansler
reviews.text:
I had the 90-minute Calm Mind Head Spa combined with the 30-minute Mini Facial, and it was such a relaxing experience from start to finish.

As soon as I arrived, I was greeted warmly by the staff. Before the treatment, I was asked to fill out a short questionnaire about my health, preferred products, and how much pressure I like during massages.

I was welcomed with a refreshing drink before being taken to the treatment room. We started with the facial, which I thoroughly enjoyed. The products smelled amazing, felt gentle on my skin, and the facial massage was very relaxing.

After that, it was time for the head spa. This was my very first head spa experience, and I absolutely loved it! The massages throughout the treatment were heavenly. There were moments where I almost fell asleep because I felt so relaxed. The only part I personally didn't enjoy as much was the metal scalp ring that was used, but that's purely my own preference and doesn't take away from the quality of the treatment.

One lovely surprise was the gentle leg massage during the head spa. I wasn't expecting it at all, and it made the experience even more enjoyable.

To finish, my hair was blow-dried for me, and I was served a cup of tea with a cookie, which was the perfect ending to such a calming treatment.

Overall, this was a wonderful experience with friendly staff, great attention to detail, and an incredibly relaxing atmosphere. I would definitely recommend Kalm Moments to anyone looking to treat themselves to a luxurious head spa and facial in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Phatcha Papahom
reviews.text:
I recently visited Klam Moments for their Office Syndrome and Head Massage treatment, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish.

From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed by attentive staff who made me feel instantly at ease. The spa’s interior is beautifully arranged, with a calm, minimalist design, soft music, and a light, soothing fragrance that sets the perfect atmosphere for relaxation.

My therapist demonstrated outstanding expertise, focusing on the tension in my neck, shoulders, and upper back caused by long hours at the desk. The pressure was perfectly adjusted, and each movement felt purposeful and deeply relieving. The head massage that followed was incredibly refreshing, melting away lingering stress and leaving me with a clear, relaxed mind.

Every detail — from the cleanliness of the rooms to the quality of customer service — reflected Klam Moments’ high standards. I left feeling light, recharged, and completely free from stiffness.

I highly recommend Klam Moments to anyone seeking professional, restorative treatments in a peaceful environment. Their combination of skill, hospitality, and serene ambiance makes them a standout choice for wellness and self-care.

reviews.name: SaharaX23
reviews.text: I booked the Kalm Mind treatment that was 1290 THB for 100mins. The spa itself is lovely with a soft, minimalistic aesthetic. The ladies working there are very lovely and provided a cool drink before I started my treatment. I filled out a very quick survey (~1min) that took into account my preferences for massaging (light, firm, etc) and answered very brief health questions.  They then presented me with x4 oil options and I selected my preferred scent to use for the neck and shoulder massage. The spa provided a change of clothes for the duration of the treatment. The experience itself was so relaxing, especially with the lovely spa music in the background. The pressure of the massage was lovely and the therapist was gentle with my hair and scalp - I have a sensitive scalp and thin hair. I had a small coughing fit during the treatment and the therapist was kind enough to get me a cup of water, provided an extra blanket and turned off the AC for my comfort - something which I really appreciated as I find ACs drying and irritating for my throat. She was very professional and empathetic during this which helped ease my embarrassment, hahaha 😅 Afterwards, my hair was dried and styled and they provided a small snack and a warm drink ☕️🍪 I am very happy I chose this place and recommend it to anyone considering booking a treatment here. Thank you very much to everyone that works here, you made my experience very enjoyable 🌸

reviews.text: This place was fantastic. The atmosphere was soo relaxing and the headspa treatment was on another level. I highly recommend this place. The price was fantastic especially when visiting from overseas. No rushing. Complimentary drink on arrival amd tea and cookies on completion.

reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience during my visit. reviews.name: TE P
reviews.text:
The shop is conveniently located near the BTS and easy to find. The interior has a relaxing and cozy vibe, and I really appreciate how clean everything is. I chose the Kalm Mind program (100 minutes for 1,290 baht) and overall I was satisfied with the therapist who took care of the massage and hair washing.

However, there are a couple of areas that could be improved. After the wash and dry, my hair became oily again very quickly. Although my hair is naturally oily, I believe the soap/conditioner wasn’t rinsed thoroughly, leaving some residue.

Another issue was with the hair-drying process. When asked about my preferred style, I requested volume on top. The staff seemed unsure how to blow-dry my hair properly, likely because my hair is quite slippery. I even offered to demonstrate, hoping they could learn, but instead they simply handed me the Dyson dryer without assisting further. My hair was left partially wet, and no one checked or followed up after I tried to style it myself, which was disappointing.

I believe the staff could benefit from more training on handling different hair types and blow-drying techniques, since this is part of the package customers are paying for. While I enjoyed most of the experience, these details made me reconsider whether I would return.

reviews.name: Sel
reviews.text: My second time to Kalm moments, this time to the Sathorn branch. I love that their head spa is consistent across both branches, price is reasonable, and environment is lovely. This is the reason I will keep coming back.  Also the blowdry was lovely too, the therapist asked how I would like it done, which is wonderful. One suggestion is to reduce the time spent on the upper body massage and focus more on the scalp, that would make the head spa so perfect!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We also really appreciate your thoughtful suggestion regarding the balance between upper body massage and scalp massage. Feedback like this is incredibly valuable for us as we continue refining the experience to make our head spa even better and more relaxing for every guest.

We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon at Kalm Moments

reviews.name: Rahul Kumar
reviews.text:
Honestly, one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment I walked in, everything felt calm, clean and beautifully done. The massage was exceptional — the therapist was attentive to exactly what I needed, and the pressure and technique were perfect.

What really stood out was the overall experience. It didn’t feel like just another massage; it was genuinely relaxing and rejuvenating. I walked out feeling completely refreshed and honestly wished I had booked a longer session.

I’ve tried spas in different places, but this is easily one of the best experiences I’ve had.

reviews.name: Joyce Tan
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience at “Moontree Elemental Spa” in Patong, Phuket, and I cannot recommend it highly enough! It was our 2nd visit in December, and their staff were able to recall us from our initial visit in July. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by a team of genuinely friendly and attentive staff who made us feel completely at ease.

The explanations provided for the various treatments and products were clear, detailed, and very professional, allowing us to choose services that best suited our needs. The massage itself was exceptional — the masseuse was highly skilled and truly helped to alleviate the aches and pains we had been carrying, leaving us feeling relaxed, refreshed, and rejuvenated. We especially loved their “Elemental Massage” using the Sheer Bliss/Moon River essential oil which was very relaxing, and would also like to highly recommend that you try out the “Coconut Oil Massage” which greatly helped in relieving those tired and sore muscles.

I would especially like to give a special mention to Fern and Wendy for their outstanding service. Wendy, in particular, truly stood out with her warmth and radiant smile. She is incredibly sweet, thoughtful, and helpful, and her genuine care made our visit even more special. Her welcoming presence and kindness created a memorable experience that went beyond just a spa treatment.

Thank you, Moontree Elemental Spa, for such an exceptional and relaxing experience. I will definitely be returning and recommending this beautiful spa to others visiting Phuket.

reviews.name: M. Alothman
reviews.text:
5/5 ⭐ A Must-Visit Spa in Phuket!

Clean, peaceful, and professional. The staff are incredibly skilled, respectful, and provide excellent service. You can feel their expertise in every massage.

Perfect for tourists: The ideal stop after a day at the beach or exploring. For the full experience, try their traditional Thai massage or a soothing aromatherapy session.

Highly recommended for anyone needing authentic relaxation in Phuket. I will be back!

reviews.name: nanaty Nour

reviews.name: Mrs G
reviews.text: While on holiday in Phuket, we stayed at The Baan LaiMai Resort. The Moontree spa is situated on site at the resort so we decided to book a few treatments. We went to the spa a day earlier and booked an appointment for the specific treatments and what times we preferred. The process was easy and quick. The staff were very helpful and friendly. We arrived the next day for our appointment and was seen to promptly. The treatment rooms are set up beautifully with all the necessary equipment needed for the treatments. The ladies were very attentive and we had a relaxing session. We left feeling very relaxed and stress-free.

reviews.name: Su Anny
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!!! the whole spa experience was amazing!!! the front desk was super friendly, patient and detailed in explaining the different massage and scrub services so that we can choose the best for us (since different massage services are slightly different). I love the body scrub!! the whole place smells really nice too!! they are very detailed in the small things also, like they would even turn on the warm shower water for us first before they called us to wash off the scrub! the massage bed and headrest were really comfortable also!!! will certainly come back again :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your amazing review 💜💜💜 We are really happy to hear that you had a great memory at Moontree Spa. Please have a safe trip home 🙏😊

reviews.name: gerry berry
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service! The staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a comfortable and enjoyable experience from start to end, even providing complementary pastries and taking care of our luggage when we wanted to travel around afterwards. Therapist was incredible, this had to have been one of the most relaxing experiences of my life 😌 Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: C Alan
reviews.text: Very nice luxury spa. Service was top notch. The receptionists Tina and latte were very friendly and helpful. Many packages were available on the menu. My therapist Ou was great. Moontree Elemental Spa

reviews.name: Natalie Sinead
reviews.text:
Wow wow wow!

This is the best spa in Patong maybe even Phuket! The receptionist was very informative and extremely professional and was fluent in English.

The spa itself is immaculate, very clean, relaxing and calming.

They began my treatment with a foot bath and scrub and the massage was great! I got a Swedish massage and the pressure was perfect and I left feeling super fresh.

I got a couples massage with my boyfriend and we were sceptical because we’d tried other places in the area and all of the ladies would speak to each other which was not only unprofessional but also unpleasant, but not at this spa! Super quiet, and relaxing.

They end your treatment with complimentary cakes and tea and they place you in an indoor/ outdoor setting which was nice to ease out of the treatment instead of paying and leaving like most places.

It’s priced pretty expensive considering it’s in Patong BUT it it’s worth every cent, and reminded me of the quality salons we have in Australia.

Would 100% recommend, it is definitely worth the extra cash!

reviews.name: naczathul ismail
reviews.text: Recommended! The ambience clean, calm and relaxing. I had the organic coconut aromatics massage and ayurvedic head massage, it was really goood! The massage technique is what u have to experience. They served cool tea before massage and hot tea with scrumptious passion /lime fruit tart. What to gram? The tea and tart 🫶🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your excellent review! We appreciated for your eye for details we created for our guests. Our guests deserve the best of the best to offer at Moontree Elemental Spa 💜

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Moontree Elemental Spa in Phuket, and I can confidently say it was the best massage experience I've ever had! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the cleanliness and luxurious ambiance of the spa. The massage room was spacious and beautifully designed, providing the perfect setting for relaxation.

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure I was comfortable throughout my visit. Their professionalism and skill truly enhanced the experience. I left feeling rejuvenated and pampered.

If you're looking for a top-notch spa experience in Phuket, I highly recommend Moontree Elemental Spa.

A Truly Amazing Spa Experience

reviews.name: Olinsivver's Magic
reviews.text:
I paid 1300 baht for an aroma oil massage, and it was one of the worst spa experiences I’ve ever had. This was nowhere near spa level — it felt completely random and unprofessional.

The therapist seemed to have no proper training. She was just spreading oil and doing a sloppy, inconsistent massage, using different techniques and pressure on each side of the body with no structure whatsoever. It honestly felt like she had no idea what she was doing.

What makes this even more disappointing is that I’ve had oil massages here before, as well as many Thai and foot massages, and in most cases the therapists were at least decent. But this time I got someone completely unqualified. It made the whole experience feel like a lottery — just like in cheap street massage places — except here you’re paying 1300 baht with zero guarantee of getting a professional massage. For this price, this level of service is completely unacceptable.

When I complained to the manager, the response made things even worse. I was offered only a 10% refund, which is frankly insulting given the situation. I was told I should have complained within the first 15 minutes — but the problem is the quality kept getting worse over time, and it wasn’t immediately obvious how bad it would become. Then I was told I could have complained later as well, which only shows how poorly they handle customer issues, since this was never clearly communicated.

In the end, they refused to take real responsibility and hid behind excuses instead of offering a fair resolution. A 10% refund for such a bad experience is not acceptable. At the very least, a 50% refund or a complimentary voucher should have been offered.

Now I honestly don’t even feel comfortable coming back. This experience has created anxiety for me — I’m worried that I could end up with another unqualified therapist again. There’s simply no trust left.

As someone with anxiety, I came to relax, but instead I left feeling stressed and uncomfortable the entire time. I essentially paid 1300 baht for a stressful and frustrating experience💔

reviews.name: Mona Monalisa
reviews.text:
I came in around 10:30–11 AM and didn’t leave until 5 PM — that’s how GOOD it was. The entire experience was pure relaxation from start to finish. The onsen facilities were spotless, peaceful, and perfect for unwinding. I got a massage and a full body scrub, and both were absolutely amazing. The staff was professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable the whole time.

I walked out feeling refreshed, renewed, and completely relaxed. Definitely a 10 out of 10. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Toto H.
reviews.text:
Amazing, just wow! Me and my mom walked from the Terminal 21 mall which took less than 10 min. When we approached the building it was just 🤩! The onsen was set on 7th floor, we were met with this calm vibe, a staff member took care of our shoes and then we went up to the onsen. Got us a neat bag with everything needed for the onsen. Luckily, we were the only ones there! Excessively clean, and luxurious. After the onsen we decided to head down to grab a snack or so before our massage, and there were these cute Thai snacks with pandan drinks at the eating area - for free. The massage was top notch, fell asleep twice 😅. Ended it all with cute set of sticky rice with mango and a hot tea. Recommended for sure!

What I missed: besides the various signs, as a complete first timer at an onsen, we felt completely lost. Kept asking the cleaning ladies what to wear, what to do etc but in the end we managed to get it right thanks to another fellow onsen person 😅 would have been nice to be completely guided by someone at the reception - like literally, get undressed, wear this and bring that!

Also, it would’ve been better with some slippers? Felt a bit weird walking around barefoot through the whole area 😳

Last but not least - make sure you try everything, cause there’s so much! We both enjoyed the hot bed area(?) so peaceful and comfy. Also the relax room! I think it was extra nice since it was empty everywhere 🤭

reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the service here.

It started with the receptionist. Although she used polite words such as “คุณท่าน” which may sound respectful, her facial expression and manner clearly showed a complete lack of interest and friendliness.

When it came to the massage, I chose a 120-minute course: Thai massage with herbal compress. The female therapist applied extremely painful pressure. She did not seem professional at all and did not pay attention to the customer’s condition. She simply kept pressing hard. Even when I moved my body to show that I was in pain, she did not seem to care. The massage felt careless and half-hearted.

I also told her that I am very ticklish, but she still used her fingers, which made me feel uncomfortable. During the herbal compress, the therapist did not inform me beforehand that she was going to use the compress. She suddenly placed a hot herbal compress on me, which startled me a little.

After the massage was finished, the room was dirty, with items left scattered around messily.

The experience was so bad that those two hours felt like torture, and I kept wondering when the session would finally be over.

This experience was completely different from the Movenpick Pattaya branch and the Grande Centre Point Lumphini branch. Those two places made me want to come back for another massage. But this branch has made me certain that I will never return to use the service here again.

reviews.name: Claire England
reviews.text: My absolute favourite onsen in Thailand.  Let's Relax is just a little more upmarket than some of the other companies (cold ice cloths by the sauna, cloths to sit on in the sauna, Kakeyu for in-between features). There are also additional rooms where it's mixed, so the hot stone room, cold room and relaxation areas. The ladies get the black underwear, the men have to go naked (apparently). The location within the Space Hotel itself is quite breathtaking; it's all very new, modern, and fun. The onsen itself is faultless, immaculately maintained with a great variety of baths and features. I try to go at 10 am to avoid the crowds, and many a time I've been the only one there ( which is bliss). It has great views from the 7th floor overlooking Pattaya beach. Would highly recommend for a top-class onsen experience.

reviews.name: Co
reviews.text:
Amazing spa located on the 7th floor of the Grand Central Space hotel. This is probably one of the nicest I’ve been. You need to call and book ahead for the massage. It’s very reasonably priced as I had a 90 massage and onsen for only 1600 baht.
The area is very clean and tranquil. There’s a women and a men side. For those who are you shy, you can ask for underwear so you’re not exposed. No need to bring anything as the provide everything such as shorts and shirts, towels etc.
There are various onsen pools. There’s a milk bath, soda bath, hot spring, jetted pool, cold plunge, steam and sauna rooms. You can even get body scrub for an extra cost.
Massage was great too. I was brought into a private room but there’s two beds so can share a partner massage.
Just an amazing experience. I slept well that night having had sleepless nights. The pools must have released any toxins from me. Highly recommended if you’re feeling fatigued.

However, they do not do a 30 day pass like the other place and if you pay for their six-month pass, it is actually double the price of the other places as well. If the pricing was a little bit more competitive, I would give it five stars, but because it is so expensive and unreasonably priced for Pattaya Thailand, I have to only give it four stars.

reviews.name: Momo Nono
reviews.text:
Disappointing First Onsen Experience at Let’s Relax Pattaya

I would like to share my recent experience at Let’s Relax Onsen Pattaya, which unfortunately turned out to be deeply disappointing.

Yesterday was my first time visiting an onsen, and I chose Let’s Relax because of its reputation and promotional materials that portrayed a peaceful, relaxing environment. I was looking forward to a calm soak and some quiet time. However, the reality was far from what I expected.

During my visit, a man—presumably of Korean nationality based on the language he spoke—entered the onsen area with two young children, approximately 5–6 years old. While the father went to relax in one of the pools, the children were left unsupervised. They ran around the facility, screamed loudly, jumped into the pools repeatedly, and entered and exited the steam room continuously.

The most concerning behavior included one child standing and urinating near the bathing area, and both children spitting into the water. This behavior not only disrupted the peaceful atmosphere but also raised serious hygiene concerns. What should have been a serene and restorative experience turned into something more akin to a chaotic public swimming pool.

Equally troubling was the lack of response from staff. Several employees were nearby, casually chatting in a group, and made no effort to intervene or address the inappropriate behavior.

Given the 750 baht entry fee, I had expected a much higher standard of service and atmosphere. To add to the disappointment, the sauna room was also out of order on the day of my visit.

I strongly urge the management to consider implementing and enforcing stricter policies regarding child access to the onsen area. If children are to be allowed, parents should be held accountable for their supervision. In cases of rule violations, staff must be empowered to take appropriate action, including asking disruptive guests to leave, in order to maintain the comfort and safety of all patrons.

I hope this feedback will be taken seriously and lead to improvements in the service quality and onsen experience at Let’s Relax Pattaya.

Sincerely,
[A Concerned Guest]
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka.

We apologize that the atmosphere and facilities did not reflect our standards during your visit. The issue has been referred to the relevant department for evaluation as part of our ongoing commitment to quality. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. Please be assured that your input will support our continued efforts to create a more relaxing and pleasant environment for every customer at Let’s Relax Spa.

reviews.name: Eyal Hochman
reviews.text:
My wife and I had the signature old town massage.
The massage it self was good, a mixture of stretches and pressure at specific points and joints (less rubbing).

There are two reasons I gave 2 starts.
1) The description says "with oil", but they only put oil on our backs and it was for 2 minutes, then they wiped it off. I don't expect oil at every massage, but you can't write "with oil" and have it be such an insignificant part of the massage.

2) Since it was a couple's massage, there were two masseuses in the room, and they were talking and laughing half of the time.
I'm not trying to be harsh, obviously they can talk a bit, but they had a proper conversation, and all their laughing started to make us feel a little bit uncomfortable. It's funny that they put that speaker with relaxing nature music, but the main thing we heard was a conversation between two Thai ladies
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback. so sorry to hear about this and we hope you have a wonderful holiday in Phuket. Xxx

title: YU Onsen and Spa (Udonthani Branch)
ownerDescription:
YU 温泉 & Spa 是乌隆他尼首家日式私人温泉水疗馆，提供温泉、按摩与贴心尊享服务。

YU 온천 & 스파는 우돈타니 최초의 일본식 프라이빗 온천 스파로, 온천·마사지와 세심한 프리미엄 서비스를 제공합니다。

YU Onsen & Spa ออนเซ็นสไตล์ญี่ปุ่นแห่งแรกของจังหวัดอุดรธานี พื้นที่ส่วนตัวสำหรับการแช่ออนเซ็น นวด และผ่อนคลาย ในบรรยากาศมินิมอลอบอุ่น พร้อมการดูแลใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียดจากทีมต้อนรับและนักบำบัด — Be YU-niquely You

YU Onsen & Spa is Udon Thani's first Japanese-style onsen — a private retreat for soaking, massage, and quiet luxury, with attentive care in every detail from our receptionists and therapists. Be YU-niquely You.

ownerUpdates.text:
พักต่ออีกนิด…ก่อนกลับไปใช้ชีวิตในจังหวะของคุณ 🍵

หลังจบการนวดหรือแช่ออนเซ็น เติมช่วงเวลาแห่งความผ่อนคลายด้วยชาอุ่น ๆ ให้ร่างกายได้ค่อย ๆ ปรับตัว และให้ใจได้อยู่นิ่งกับความสบายอีกสักครู่

ที่ YU Onsen & Spa เราใส่ใจในทุกช่วงเวลาของการพักผ่อน ตั้งแต่ก้าวเข้ามา จนถึงก่อนกลับ ✨



Stay a little longer in the feeling of relaxation. 🍵

After your massage or private onsen, enjoy a warm cup of tea and take a quiet moment before returning to your day.

At YU Onsen & Spa, every detail is designed to make your experience feel calm, comfortable, and complete.


让放松的时光，再多停留一会儿。🍵

按摩或私人温泉结束后，享用一杯温热的茶，在离开之前静静休息片刻，让身心慢慢回到舒适的节奏。

在 YU Onsen & Spa，我们用心照顾每一个细节，让您的休息体验从开始到结束都舒适而完整。

คอ บ่า ไหล่ตึงจากการทำงาน…ให้ร่างกายได้พักอย่างลึกขึ้น 🌿

สัมผัสการนวด Deep Tissue ที่เน้นคลายกล้ามเนื้อบริเวณคอ บ่า และไหล่ ด้วยเทคนิคการลงน้ำหนักอย่างเหมาะสม ผสานการนวดน้ำมันและความอุ่นจากหินร้อน ช่วยให้กล้ามเนื้อที่ตึงล้ารู้สึกผ่อนคลายและสบายตัวมากขึ้น

เหมาะสำหรับชาวออฟฟิศ คนที่นั่งทำงานนาน หรือผู้ที่รู้สึกเมื่อยล้าสะสมบริเวณช่วงบนของร่างกาย



Tight neck and shoulders after a long day at work? 🌿

Experience Deep Tissue Massage focused on relieving muscle tension around the neck, shoulders, and upper back. Combined with oil massage and soothing warmth from hot stones, the treatment helps tired, tight muscles feel more relaxed and comfortable.

Ideal for office workers, people who sit for long hours, or anyone experiencing accumulated muscle fatigue.

长时间工作后，颈部和肩膀感到紧绷疲劳？🌿

体验 YU Onsen & Spa 的深层组织按摩，针对颈部、肩部及上背部的紧绷肌肉，以适当力度进行深层放松，并结合精油按摩与温热石护理，让疲劳的身体逐渐舒缓、更加轻松。

特别适合久坐办公、长时间使用电脑，或颈肩容易感到疲劳的人士。

ให้ร่างกายได้พัก…และให้ใจได้ผ่อนคลายอย่างเต็มที่ 🌿

สัมผัส Foot Massage ในบรรยากาศสงบและเป็นส่วนตัวของ YU Onsen & Spa พร้อมเก้าอี้ปรับเอนนุ่มสบาย ให้คุณเอนกายพักผ่อนได้ตลอดการบริการ

เหมาะสำหรับวันที่เดินเยอะ ยืนนาน ทำงานหนัก หรือเพียงอยากมอบช่วงเวลาดี ๆ ให้ตัวเอง  
เพราะการพักผ่อนที่ดี ควรสบายตั้งแต่วินาทีแรกจนจบ ✨



Give your body a break and your mind a moment to unwind. 🌿

Enjoy a relaxing Foot Massage at YU Onsen & Spa in a calm, private setting with comfortable reclining chairs designed to help you fully relax throughout your treatment.

Perfect after a long day of walking, standing, working — or simply when you need some time for yourself.


让身体慢下来，也让心真正放松。🌿

在 YU Onsen & Spa 宁静舒适的私人空间里，享受轻松惬意的足部按摩。舒适的可调节躺椅，让您从坐下的那一刻起，就能自在放松。

适合长时间走路、久站、工作疲劳之后，或只是想给自己一段安静舒适的休息时光。

พักคอ บ่า ไหล่ จากความเหนื่อยล้าในทุกวัน 🌿

การนั่งทำงานนาน ๆ ใช้คอมพิวเตอร์ หรือก้มดูโทรศัพท์เป็นประจำ อาจทำให้กล้ามเนื้อบริเวณคอ บ่า และไหล่รู้สึกตึงและเมื่อยล้า

ที่ YU Onsen & Spa ให้ทุกสัมผัสของการนวดค่อย ๆ คลายความตึง พร้อมบรรยากาศเงียบสงบและเป็นส่วนตัว ให้ทั้งร่างกายและใจได้พักอย่างเต็มที่

เพราะบางวัน…สิ่งที่ร่างกายต้องการ อาจเป็นเพียงช่วงเวลาที่ได้หยุดและผ่อนคลายอย่างแท้จริง 🍃



Release the tension. Restore your sense of calm. 🌿

Long hours at a desk, computer use, and everyday routines can leave your neck and shoulders feeling tight and tired.

At YU Onsen & Spa, our therapists focus on gentle, attentive massage techniques to ease muscular tension while you unwind in a calm and private Japanese-inspired atmosphere.

Give your body the quiet moment it deserves.



放松肩颈，让身体真正休息下来 🌿

长时间办公、使用电脑或低头看手机，容易让颈部、肩部肌肉感到紧绷和疲劳。

在 YU Onsen & Spa，理疗师通过细致舒适的按摩手法，帮助放松紧绷的肩颈肌肉。配合安静、私密的日式环境，让身体与心情都能慢慢放松下来。

给忙碌的自己，留一段真正属于休息的时间。🍃

ปล่อยกาย พักใจ ที่ YU Onsen & Spa 🌿

บางครั้งช่วงเวลาแห่งการพักผ่อนที่ดีที่สุด คือการได้ใช้เวลาดี ๆ ร่วมกับคนที่เราสบายใจ

มาสัมผัสบรรยากาศสปาสไตล์ญี่ปุ่นที่อบอุ่น สงบ และเป็นส่วนตัว พร้อมเลือกทรีตเมนต์ที่เหมาะกับคุณ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นออนเซ็น นวดอโรม่า นวดเท้า หรือนวดเพื่อคลายความเมื่อยล้า

ชวนคนพิเศษ เพื่อน หรือคนในครอบครัว มาพักจากความวุ่นวาย แล้วให้ YU ดูแลช่วงเวลาแห่งการพักผ่อนของคุณอย่างละมุน ✨


Relax together at YU Onsen & Spa 🌿

Sometimes, the best way to recharge is to slow down and enjoy a peaceful moment with someone special.

Experience a warm, calm and private Japanese-inspired spa atmosphere, with treatments including private onsen, aroma massage, foot massage and relaxing body massage.

Come with your partner, friends or family and enjoy a gentle escape from the busy day at YU Onsen & Spa. ✨



与重要的人，一起在 YU Onsen & Spa 放松身心 🌿

有时候，最美好的休息方式，就是和让自己感到自在的人一起放慢脚步，享受一段宁静时光。

在温馨、安静且注重私密性的日式氛围中，体验私人温泉、芳香精油按摩、足部按摩及多种舒缓按摩护理。

无论是情侣、朋友还是家人，都可以一起暂别忙碌，在 YU Onsen & Spa 享受属于你们的放松时光。✨

YU Glow ✨ พักผ่อนให้เต็มที่ พร้อมดูแลผิวในเวลาเดียวกัน

เริ่มต้นด้วยการขัดผิวอย่างอ่อนโยน ช่วยผลัดเซลล์ผิวที่เสื่อมสภาพ ให้ผิวสัมผัสเนียนนุ่มและดูสดใสขึ้น ก่อนเติมเต็มช่วงเวลาแห่งการพักผ่อนด้วยการนวดอโรม่า พร้อมน้ำมันออร์แกนิกที่ช่วยมอบความชุ่มชื้นให้ผิว

หนึ่งทรีตเมนต์ที่ให้คุณได้ทั้งความผ่อนคลาย และความรู้สึกดีเมื่อได้ดูแลตัวเองอย่างเต็มที่ ณ YU Onsen & Spa 🌿✨


YU Glow ✨ Relax your body while giving your skin a little extra care.

Begin with a gentle body scrub to remove dead skin cells and leave the skin feeling smoother and refreshed. Follow with a relaxing aroma massage using organic oil to moisturize and nourish the skin.

A soothing spa ritual designed for both relaxation and beautifully soft-feeling skin at YU Onsen & Spa.



YU Glow ✨ 在放松身心的同时，给肌肤一份温柔呵护。

首先通过温和的身体磨砂去除老废角质，让肌肤触感更加细腻柔滑；随后享受芳香精油按摩，搭配有机按摩油，为肌肤补充滋润，同时享受舒适放松的疗愈时光。

在 YU Onsen & Spa，让一次护理同时满足放松与肌肤呵护的需要。🌿✨

สัมผัสบรรยากาศออนเซ็นสไตล์ญี่ปุ่น พร้อมแร่ธาตุสำหรับออนเซ็นที่นำเข้าจากประเทศญี่ปุ่น ให้ทุกช่วงเวลาของการแช่น้ำอุ่นเต็มไปด้วยความสงบและผ่อนคลาย

ที่ YU Onsen & Spa เราใส่ใจตั้งแต่การเตรียมน้ำ ไปจนถึงบรรยากาศที่เป็นส่วนตัว เพื่อให้คุณได้พักจากความเหนื่อยล้าและใช้เวลากับตัวเองอย่างเต็มที่

ให้ความอบอุ่นโอบล้อมร่างกาย แล้วปล่อยวันหนัก ๆ ไว้ข้างนอก 



Experience a Japanese-inspired private onsen with onsen minerals imported from Japan.

At YU Onsen & Spa, every detail—from the warm bath preparation to the calm and private atmosphere—is designed to create a deeply relaxing escape from your busy day.

Slow down, soak in the warmth, and enjoy your peaceful moment at YU.



在 YU Onsen & Spa，体验日式私密温泉与从日本进口的温泉矿物质。

从温暖的泡汤体验到安静、舒适且私密的环境，我们用心打造每一个细节，让您暂时放下忙碌与疲惫，享受属于自己的放松时光。

沉浸在温暖之中，感受宁静舒适的日式温泉体验。

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for letting us take care of you. ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Gar Nelson
reviews.text: I never tried an Onsen spa when I was in Japan, so I have no idea how authentic Yu Onsen is, but I do know I think it is great. I treated myself to the Onsen bath/scrub/massage and have no reservations about recommending Yu Onsen to anyone. It was a treat, and time well spent. As an 182 cm person, to me, the bath was the most wonderful part. I think it's been at least a decade since I've immersed myself to the neck in a tub of hot water. It was a wonderful soak. You can find a scrub elsewhere, you can find aromatherapy elsewhere, but you won't find the Onsen package elsewhere (that I know of) in Udon. If I was going to point out one tiny niggle to a hugely positive experience, I would have put a more Japanese-themed audio track in the Onsen room rather than the generic massage track that I heard. But, that is also searching for a niggle to an otherwise perfect experience. On my visit several of the staff spoke English so communication was not a problem.

reviews.name: Judy Ng
reviews.text: Tastefully done up, no expense spared, no detail overlooked. My friend and I enjoyed every moment of our onsen (a little awkward as we had to share a single tub) and massage thereafter. And the ending was even better: we were served mochi and wheat tea which was perfect for finishing up. Will definitely return to YU.

reviews.name: Debbie Wang
reviews.text:
We booked Tarn Tara Spa based on all these positive reviews on Google. Two issues to be mindful of:

1. Transport: The package included pick up from our hotel. We did not receive any confirmation of the pick up time so I spent the morning making sure a driver would indeed show up. Our spa appointment was at 2:00pm and the staff at Tarn Tara Spa said that the driver will be coming at 2:00pm. I had to reach out to Viator Tour Company to request an earlier pick up time and ending up having the driver come get us at 1:00pm as the drive was an hour away.. If I had not reached out to confirm our ride, I am doubtful that  a driver would actually show up or if he did, he  would come at 2:00pm, at the start of our appointment and then we would have wasted a day in Phuket. So, be sure to confirm car service.

2. Bait and Switch: Upon arrival at Tarn Tara Spa, we were greeted with a beverage and the staff went over what services we would be receiving. We were supposed to have a massage and hair and scalp treatment (which was the reason we chose this particular package  and had  planned our hair washing schedule accordingly), however, we were not offered the hair treatment but instead a longer massage. Whatever, we went along with it because what else could we have done?

Other notes: The oil and body scrubs was done by two older nice ladies. The facilities were dated and did not reflect the pictures posted on the website. The staff was friendly. We were offered sandwiches as a light refreshment at the end.  Driver was also nice.  Final verdict: go elsewhere.

reviews.name: Ean Earl Ramos
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of visiting the Let's Relax Ginza branch in Bangkok recently, and I have to say, it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. I’ve been to a fair number of spas, but this one really stood out, especially thanks to the incredible service I received, beginning with the receptionist.
First Impressions

As soon as I walked in, I was immediately struck by the clean, calming atmosphere. The spa has a very modern yet cozy feel to it, with soft lighting, pleasant scents, and relaxing music playing in the background. It felt like the perfect place to unwind after a busy day.

But what really made this place stand out was the warm welcome I received from the receptionist. I didn’t expect the level of attentiveness I got from the moment I stepped through the door.
Fantastic Service from the Receptionist

I was greeted with a smile and a genuine, “Welcome!” right when I walked in, which made a huge difference in setting the tone for the visit. The receptionist was friendly, professional, and really took the time to make me feel comfortable. She didn’t rush through the check-in process at all, and made sure I had all the information I needed about the services they offer.

She also asked a few simple questions to help tailor my experience to what I was looking for. For example, she checked if I had any areas of tension or specific preferences for my treatment, which I really appreciated. It showed that she wasn’t just going through the motions—she genuinely cared about making my experience as relaxing and enjoyable as possible.

The receptionist took the time to explain what to expect during the treatment, which helped me feel more at ease. Afterward, she walked me to the waiting area and gave me a moment to relax before my treatment started.
The Treatment: Exactly What I Needed

The treatment itself was fantastic. The room was peaceful and inviting, and the therapist really knew what they were doing. The massage was perfect, and I felt completely relaxed throughout the session. I loved the attention to detail and the little touches that made the experience stand out, like the temperature of the room being just right and the calming music playing in the background.

But again, the overall experience felt that much better because of the receptionist. She made sure I felt taken care of from start to finish. She even checked in with me afterward to make sure I was happy with the treatment and to ask for any feedback, which I thought was a nice personal touch.
Little Things That Matter

What really stood out to me was how the receptionist paid attention to the small details. After the treatment, she offered me some water and explained a few ways I could continue the relaxation at home, which I didn’t expect but really appreciated. It was these little things that really made my visit stand out compared to other spas I’ve been to.

She also took the time to thank me for coming and said she hoped to see me again soon. It wasn’t just polite—it felt genuine, and that made the experience feel even more special.
Conclusion

Overall, my visit to Let's Relax Ginza was fantastic, and I can honestly say the service was top-notch. The receptionist made a huge difference in my experience—her friendly demeanor, professionalism, and attention to detail made the visit that much more enjoyable. If you're looking for a great spa experience in Bangkok, I highly recommend Let's Relax Ginza. The treatments are excellent, the staff is friendly, and the atmosphere is perfect for a little relaxation.

If you happen to meet the receptionist during your visit, know you’re in good hands—she truly knows how to make guests feel welcome and cared for.
